job.title: Assistant Editor, Data Journalism
job.description:
The mission of The New York Times is to seek the truth and help people understand the world. That means independent journalism is at the heart of all we do as a company. It’s why we have a world-renowned newsroom that sends journalists to report on the ground from nearly 160 countries. It’s why we focus deeply on how our readers will experience our journalism, from print to audio to a world-class digital and app destination. And it’s why our business strategy centers on making journalism so good that it’s worth paying for. 

 

 

The Data Journalism team is looking for an experienced journalist with editing, management and data analysis skills to serve as an assistant editor. You'll help to run a group of data journalists who collaborate across the newsroom. You'll also advise on analyses conducted elsewhere in the newsroom.

You should be obsessed with detail and rigor, display a knack for lifting stories to the next level and care deeply about developing your colleagues' talents. Collaboration is at the heart of this role; the Data Journalism team works with virtually every other desk in the newsroom. We'll expect you to deftly navigate these partnerships, which require crisp communication, a problem-solving attitude and a dash of diplomacy.

This is an in-office position and includes regular attendance in the office four days a week. We have a preference for candidates who will work in New York City, with a secondary preference for Washington, DC.

Important application requirement: Please submit a cover letter that describes your qualifications in the context of three stories (or projects) you helped to shape. For each, please provide a link to the work and describe your contributions in one to three paragraphs. Your cover letter should not exceed four pages in total. Within that limit, you are also welcome to provide a more traditional (but brief) description of your career and talents.

Responsibilities:

  • Help to lead the Data Journalism team

  • Directly supervise several data reporters on the team

  • Shepherd, shape and stress-test the team's data analyses

  • Consult on data analyses conducted by reporters outside the Data Journalism team

  • Be comfortable working on an unpredictable mix of short, medium and long deadlines

  • Demonstrate support and understanding of our value of journalistic independence and a strong commitment to our mission to seek the truth and help people understand the world.

  • You will report to the Data Editor, who is based in New York City.

Basic Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of data journalism experience

  • Proficiency working with data in Python and/or R, spreadsheets and relational databases

Preferred Qualifications:

  • 2+ years of leadership, editing and/or mentorship experience

  • Experience leading a data journalism team

  • Experience with, and a preference for, working collaboratively on multidisciplinary teams

  • Experience data-editing in response to major news cycles

  • Comfort with command-line tooling, version control, working with large language models and other key technical skills

 

 

REQ-020639

job.description:
Overview

Job Title: Executive Producer - The Chris & Amy Show

 

Department: Programming

 

Reporting To: Brand Manager

 

Employment Type: Full-Time

 

Location(s): St. Louis, M.O

 

Work Arrangement: On-Site

Salary to be determined by the education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities and location of the applicant, as well as internal and external equity.

 

Audacy offers employees who are eligible for benefits with a comprehensive benefits package which includes: a health care coordinator, medical, dental, vision, mental health, telemedicine, flexible spending accounts, health savings account, disability, life insurance, critical illness, hospital indemnity, accident insurance, paid time off (sick, flex-time away/vacation days, personal, parental, volunteer), 401(k) retirement plan, student loan payment assistance program, legal assistance, life assistance program, identity theft protection, discounted home and auto insurance, and pet insurance.

 

Overview:

KMOX Radio, the legendary Voice of St. Louis, is looking for a modern, creative and digitally savvy Executive Producer to help take The Chris & Amy Show to the next level. We're looking for someone who understands that a great show can live far beyond the radio clock — on YouTube, social media, podcasts, video, digital platforms and wherever St. Louis audiences consume content. The Executive Producer will oversee the show's daily content strategy, preparation and execution while helping expand The Chris & Amy Show into a multi-platform St. Louis media brand. You'll work closely with Chris and Amy to develop ideas, create compelling conversations, find great guests and stories, and turn the best moments from the show into content that can reach new audiences. You should have a great ear for radio — but you should also have a great eye for content.

Responsibilities

What You'll Do:

  • Develop the daily content strategy and show rundown with Chris and Amy.
  • Identify the stories, conversations and personalities that will drive the show.
  • Create original features, recurring benchmarks, games, bits and listener-driven content.
  • Research for interviews, conversations and major topics.
  • Constantly look for ways to make the show more entertaining, surprising, relevant and local.
  • Running a live radio board and executing a show in real time.
  • Understanding clocks, formats, commercial breaks and station logs.
  • Editing and producing audio quickly and cleanly.
  • Booking and preparing guests.
  • Writing compelling intros, teases, promos and digital copy.
  • Managing live callers, interviews and breaking content.
  • Working with newsroom, traffic, weather and other station resources.
  • Making quick decisions when the show doesn't go according to plan.

Qualifications

More About You:

 

Required & Preferred:

But you also need to think beyond radio.

We're looking for someone who understands that the best moments on The Chris & Amy Show shouldn't end when the microphone is turned off.

You should be able to identify an on-air conversation and immediately see its potential as:

  • A YouTube video.
  • A short-form video.
  • A podcast segment.
  • A social clip.
  • A behind-the-scenes piece.
  • A digital-only conversation.
  • A community or live event opportunity.

The goal is not simply to produce a better radio show.  The goal is to build a bigger Chris & Amy audience — on the radio and everywhere else people consume content.

Expand the show beyond radio

  • Develop a daily content strategy that extends the show across YouTube, video, social media, podcasts and digital platforms.
  • Identify moments during the live show that have the potential to become compelling digital content.
  • Think proactively about content that should be created specifically for digital audiences.
  • Develop short-form video, social clips, interviews, behind-the-scenes content and other original digital features.

The ideal candidate is:

  • An experienced radio producer with a modern content mindset.
  • A strong writer and storyteller.
  • Someone who understands personality-driven radio.
  • Highly knowledgeable about digital video, social media and audience growth.
  • Comfortable creating and editing short-form video and digital content.
  • Someone who understands platforms such as YouTube, Instagram, TikTok and Facebook and knows that each platform requires a different approach.
  • Highly organized but not afraid to throw out the rundown when a great idea comes along.
  • Curious about culture, entertainment, sports, news and — most importantly — St. Louis.
  • Comfortable working with strong personalities.
  • An idea generator who is constantly thinking about "What more can I do?"

job.title: Audience Intern
job.description:
Audience Intern

Job Description

The Houston Chronicle is looking for a curious and versatile student journalist to join its Audience team for the summer 2027 internship program.

Audience journalists help determine how journalism reaches people — and what makes them want to come back. You’ll work alongside editors, reporters and audience strategists to help shape coverage, craft compelling headlines and social posts, engage readers across platforms and use data to understand what matters to our audience.

You’ll gain experience at the intersection of journalism, storytelling and digital strategy while helping the Chronicle reach hundreds of thousands of readers across Houston and beyond. You may help package breaking news, promote enterprise reporting, build newsletters, identify search opportunities, analyze reader behavior and develop new ways to connect with audiences. 

This position is designed for motivated student journalists who want to build careers in audience journalism and gain hands-on experience in a major newsroom. Past interns have gone on to full-time roles at the Chronicle as reporters, producers and editors across our newsroom and audience teams.

Responsibilities:

  • Monitor real-time analytics and identify patterns in what readers are viewing, sharing and returning to

  • Help editors and reporters frame stories for maximum clarity, relevance and impact
  • Write and refine headlines, social copy, push alerts and other promotional language with attention to SEO and news value
  • Create social posts and contribute to strategies for platforms including Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, Reddit and more
  • Assist with newsletter planning, writing and audience-focused story selection
  • Help package stories for the homepage and other digital platforms
  • Research search trends, audience interests and emerging platforms
  • Pitch ideas for reaching new audiences and deepening connections with existing readers

  • Collaborate across the newsroom to translate Chronicle journalism into useful, compelling digital experiences

Requirements:

  • Juniors, seniors or recent graduates with prior experience at a college news publication or professional news organization.
  • A personal laptop and Wi-Fi or hotspot access.
  • Must obtain housing in Houston and work in the Chronicle’s office at least 3 days a week.

 

Internship Details:

  • 40 hours a week for 10 weeks, from early June and to early August. Interns will be paid $15 an hour. 
  • Interns will work Monday through Friday, with occasional weekend coverage based on news demands. 
  • The recruiting committee will assign all interns a mentor from the newsroom based on their interests.

 

Application details:

Interested candidates are invited to submit their applications, including the required documents, by October 25, 2026. 

Please submit a portfolio of 5 audience-related clips (social media posts, newsletters, alerts, etc.), a resume, and a 1-page cover letter addressed to the recruiting committee detailing your passion for journalism and what you hope to achieve through this internship.

About the Houston Chronicle:

The Houston Chronicle, recognized for its Pulitzer Prize-winning journalism, serves its 2.3 million residents with content and marketing solutions across two of Houston’s largest websites — HoustonChronicle.com and Chron.com, along with our magazine, television and newspaper brands.  Our mission is to spark conversations that inspire action to create a better Houston.  All our content and the innovative business solutions we provide invite Houstonians to join conversations about a community we’ve been committed to covering and helping prosper for more than 120 years. The community we all call home.

About Hearst Newspapers:

With 2,500 employees across the nation, HNP encompasses a network of 24 daily and 52 weekly publications, including the San Francisco Chronicle, Houston Chronicle, San Antonio Express-News and Albany Times Union, several top digital-only news and lifestyle sites, marketing services businesses, and entertainment businesses such as King Features Syndicate. 

At HNP, we are investing in new and innovative ways to tell stories – growing newsrooms, diversifying tools, evolving platforms – to support the millions of people who trust us each month to help them make decisions, take action and be inspired.  

Be a part of something bigger – your headline awaits.

Recognizing the diverse needs of our candidates, if you are interested in applying for employment and need assistance or an accommodation to use our website or regarding the application process, please contact us by email at hnpemployment@hearst.com.  Please do not use this email address to inquire about the status of applications. job.title: VP, Nordics and Baltics - The Orchard
job.description:
The Orchard is seeking a dynamic, entrepreneurial leader to manage and execute its growth strategy, team building and client relationship initiatives in the Nordics & Baltics. Driving efficient communication and best practices, setting and attaining measurable goals, developing and upskilling staff, and articulating, operationalising and evolving the company’s value proposition are critical to the candidate’s success.  The candidate must have relationships across the industry at all levels and the ability to elevate the company’s revenue and profile within the current client and retail base.

The VP is the primary conduit for new revenue and value proposition opportunities. The successful candidate must be able to drive the business at a fast pace in an ever-changing environment.  While not required, experience in the independent sector is preferred.

The Orchard is a leading music distribution company operating in over 50 markets worldwide – distributing and marketing music from independent artists and labels. With cutting-edge operations and an unparalleled global team, The Orchard partners with labels of all sizes to make their music and video available across hundreds of digital and physical retailers around the world. At The Orchard, our focus is to provide a comfortable, social and engaging environment to encourage productivity and creativity.

What you’ll do:

  • Act as the primary conduit for identifying and securing new business opportunities within the Nordics and Baltics, ensuring a constant pipeline of high-value independent label and artist signings.
  • Drive revenue growth by articulating and operationalising the company’s value proposition to the local market.
  • Manage relationships with distributed music clients across a variety of genres, including high-touch frontline and high-volume catalogue labels.
  • Oversee regional offices, ensuring local compliance and operational efficiency is met while supporting the local leadership team.
  • Lead and develop the local regional team, providing mentorship to local leadership.
  • Maintain high-level relationships with major retail and industry partners across the territory, elevating the company's profile at events and conferences.
  • Collaborate with the MD, UK & Europe, and other global stakeholders to align Nordic strategy with the broader company-wide strategy
  • Drive product adoption of The Orchard’s tools and services across the client base.
  • Act as local industry representative, attending events and conferences as required. 

Who you are:

  • Previous experience in a senior management/business leadership role, leading high performing teams, preferably in the independent music sector.
  • Strong experience and understanding of the local music industry and digital landscape.
  • Experience within a label or distribution company managing catalogues, frontline releases and relationships. Independent sector experience preferred.
  • Excellent knowledge of the digital space, including music retail, analytics and social media, with an ability to adapt to a constantly changing landscape.
  • Highly advanced organisational skills with the ability to multitask and prioritise to tight deadlines.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to speak effectively across all levels of business, both internally and externally.
  • Passionate about Independent music, with a willingness to attend industry events and shows.
  • Flexibility to work evenings and weekends as required and able to travel internationally.
  • Fluent in English

What we give you:

  • You join a vibrant global community with the opportunity to channel your passion every day 
  • A modern office environment designed for you, empowering you to bring your best 
  • Investment in your professional growth and development enabling you to thrive in our vibrant community 
  • The space to accelerate progress, positively disrupt and create what happens next

job.title: Senior Video Journalist, Opinion
job.description:
The mission of The New York Times is to seek the truth and help people understand the world. That means independent journalism is at the heart of all we do as a company. It’s why we have a world-renowned newsroom that sends journalists to report on the ground from nearly 160 countries. It’s why we focus deeply on how our readers will experience our journalism, from print to audio to a world-class digital and app destination. And it’s why our business strategy centers on making journalism so good that it’s worth paying for. 

 

Times Opinion is hiring a senior video journalist. You will focus on original reporting, producing and editing of our enterprise video journalism.

You have extensive journalism experience and are passionate about making videos that live at the intersection of news, opinion and documentary film. You have an extensive track record of pitching, producing and editing timely, visual, impact-driven digital video.

You will work with a high degree of autonomy in developing and pushing story lines beyond what is already in the pages of the Times. You are eager to innovate, thrive on collaboration and have strong news judgment.

You're a self-starter who can dig deep and craft nuanced storytelling, but you're equally excited to jump on breaking news. You can spot trends, generate scoops and have a track record of juggling multiple projects at once.

This position is based in New York and requires four days a week in the office. There may be some flexibility to work remotely per your departmental guidance.

Responsibilities:

  • Pitch original groundbreaking journalism.

  • Produce, report and script and edit enterprise video stories.

  • Oversee the work of cinematographers and editors and other collaborators.

  • Identify news and enterprise opportunities that are journalistically powerful and visually transformative.

  • Collaborate with visual editors to develop video formats that bring our best journalism to new audiences.

  • Work closely with video leaders and other Opinion writers to ensure our work follows newsroom standards.

  • Must be able to handle newsroom deadlines and juggle multiple projects.

  • Demonstrate support and understanding of our value of journalistic independence and a strong commitment to our mission to seek the truth and help people understand the world.

  • You will report to a Senior Producer.

Basic Qualifications:

  • 8+ years of journalism experience, including multimedia storytelling, video producing and editing, production experience at a major news organization or production company.

  • Experience producing shoots and interviewing experts on camera.

  • Experience creating original videos that incorporate audio, video, still images, graphics and text.

  • Excellent news judgment and reporting skills, with a proven ability to work with colleagues and other reporters to synthesize newsgathering and/or investigations into a tight, informative and engaging video.

  • Video editing skills with Adobe Premiere.

  • Facility in using photo, video, audio, graphics and animation in storytelling.

Preferred Qualifications:

job.title: Director - Technical Accounting
job.description:
SoundCloud empowers artists, tastemakers and fans to connect and share through music. Founded in 2007, SoundCloud is a creator-first platform helping artists build and grow their careers by providing them with the most advanced tools, services, and resources. With over 4x the music catalog of every other major streaming platform, spanning 40+ million artists across 190+ countries, SoundCloud is where emerging artists find their sound, hidden gems are discovered, and music culture is shaped in real time.

SoundCloud is looking for a Director of Accounting, someone with a passion for numbers, to join our great finance team. Joining our Accounting & Tax department in Berlin, you will serve as the senior accounting leader locally  and directly to the VP Group Controller. As an ambitious and driven team member, you bring enthusiasm to make a significant impact across multiple areas. You will hold genuine accountability from day one, with the autonomy to elevate our financial group reporting standard.

You will take full ownership of group consolidation, IFRS financial reporting, German local statutory reporting (HGB), intercompany accounts, and technical accounting positions. Additionally, you will guide the annual audit process and direct the local accounting team and serve as a counterpart to the Berlin-Based Tax Team.

This position combines strategic enhancement with core stewardship. While financial consolidation currently relies on Oracle Fusion and spreadsheets, you will lead the selection and roll-out of a dedicated platform. You will collaborate closely with key stakeholders across US accounting leadership, Treasury, Tax, and external partners.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Prepare consolidated IFRS financial statements and related Notes
  • Manage monthly consolidated reporting packages
  • Oversee German HGB statutory financial filings and directing local audits
  • Drive end-to-end management, reconciliation, and settlement of intercompany activity across all subsidiaries
  • Evaluate complex technical accounting developments under IFRS, drafting technical memorandums, and offering guidance across business functions
  • Serve as primary liaison for external auditors during annual group audits, ensuring high-quality audit deliverables and prompt issue resolution
  • Mentor and expand the local Berlin accounting team, overseeing AP, procurement operations and reconciliation of VAT/Sales Tax accounts in cooperation with the Tax Team
  • Lead the evaluation and implementation of a new software solution for group financial consolidation
  • Partner closely with US finance leadership to align accounting policies and improve group-wide close efficiency

Experience and Background:

  • 8+ years of relevant experience within top-tier audit firms or corporate group accounting environments, including a proven track record of managing and developing accounting teams
  • Fully certified professional credentials (such as CPA, Steuerberater, Wirtschaftsprüfer, ACCA, or an equivalent designation)
  • Practical, hands-on background in IFRS multi-entity consolidation, with demonstrated experience preparing or auditing full consolidated statements and disclosures across foreign currencies
  • Solid understanding of German HGB statutory framework, local compliance, and tax audit procedures
  • Proven supervisory leadership, managing and nurturing the professional development of accounting personnel
  • Fluency in written and spoken English and German, paired with strong, constructive interpersonal skills
  • Advanced capabilities in Excel and familiarity navigating modern systems across ERP, financial close, and procurement technologies
  • Exceptional problem-solving abilities, high self-motivation, and a collaborative mindset
  • Thriving in a dynamic, high-growth environment focused on high performance and tangible impact
  • Prior involvement in implementing financial consolidation platforms is a plus
  • Familiarity with Oracle Fusion tools is preferred
  • Background in tech, digital media, music, or subscription businesses, including specialized royalty and intellectual property accounting, is desirable

About us:

  • We are a multinational company with offices in the US (New York and Los Angeles), Germany (Berlin), and the UK (London)
  • We provide a flexible work culture that offers the opportunity to collaborate and connect in person at our offices as well as accommodating work from home
  • We are deeply committed to ensuring diversity, equity and inclusion at all levels of our organization and fostering a community where everyone’s voice, perspective and experience is respected and heard
  • We believe a strong team is made by investing in employees through mentorship, workshops and enrichment opportunities

Benefits:

  • Not located in Berlin? No worries, we offer extensive relocation support including allowances, one way flights, temporary accommodation and, by partnering with Startcon, on the ground support on arrival
  • Interested in a gym membership, photography course or book? We have a Creativity and Wellness benefit!
  • Employee Equity Plan
  • Generous professional development allowance
  • Flexible vacation and public holiday policy where you can take up to 35 days of PTO annually
  • We offer free German courses at beginning, intermediate and advanced
  • Various snacks, goodies, and 2 free lunches weekly when at the office

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion at SoundCloud

SoundCloud is for everyone. Diversity and open expression are fundamental to our organization; they help us lead what’s next in music by understanding and empowering our creators and fans, no matter their identity. We acknowledge the challenges in the music industry, and strive to influence an inclusive culture where everyone can contribute respectfully and thrive, especially the historically marginalized communities that many of our creators, fans and SoundClouders identify with. We are dedicated to creating an inclusive environment at SoundCloud for everyone, regardless of gender identity, sexual orientation, race, ethnicity, migration background, national origin, age, disability status, or care-giver status.

job.title: Houston Chronicle Visuals Internship
job.description:
The Houston Chronicle is looking for a creative and ambitious student journalist to join its Visuals team for the summer 2027 internship program

The position is designed for motivated student journalists who want to build careers in visual journalism and gain hands-on experience producing photography and video in a major newsroom. The intern will help produce compelling still photography and short-form video for the Chronicle’s website and social platforms, including TikTok, Instagram and YouTube Shorts. They will have the opportunity to collaborate across the newsroom to tell visually driven stories that capture Houston’s people, culture and breaking news moments.

Our summer interns are integral members of the newsroom, producing work that reaches hundreds of thousands of readers and viewers. Past interns have gone on to full-time roles at the Chronicle as reporters, producers and editors across our newsroom and audience teams.

 

Responsibilities:

  • Photograph and film daily and enterprise assignments in coordination with editors and reporters

  • Pitch, shoot, edit and publish short-form videos optimized for social platforms

  • Identify visual storytelling opportunities across beats and social trends

  • Edit and caption photos and videos with attention to accuracy, tone and engagement

  • Collaborate with reporters, editors and the audience team to translate Chronicle journalism into visual stories

  • Contribute ideas for visual storytelling that strengthen the Chronicle’s reach and connection with audiences

Requirements:

  • Juniors, seniors or recent graduates with prior experience at a college news publication or professional news organization.
  • Valid driver's license and access to a car.
  • Must obtain housing in Houston and work in the Chronicle’s office at least 3 days a week.

     

Internship Details:

  • 40 hours a week for 10 weeks, from early June to early August. Interns will be paid $15 an hour.

  • Interns will work Monday through Friday, with occasional weekend coverage based on news demands.

  • The recruiting committee will assign all interns a mentor from the newsroom based on their interests.

     

Application details:

Interested candidates are invited to submit their applications, including the required documents, by October 25, 2026. 

Please submit a portfolio of 5 visuals clips (portfolio websites are acceptable), a resume, and a 1-page cover letter addressed to the recruiting committee detailing your passion for journalism and what you hope to achieve through this internship.

The Houston Chronicle, recognized for its Pulitzer Prize-winning journalism, serves its 2.3 million residents with content and marketing solutions across two of Houston’s largest websites — HoustonChronicle.com and Chron.com, along with our magazine, television and newspaper brands.  Our mission is to spark conversations that inspire action to create a better Houston.  All our content and the innovative business solutions we provide invite Houstonians to join conversations about a community we’ve been committed to covering and helping prosper for more than 120 years. The community we all call home.

With 2,500 employees across the nation, HNP encompasses a network of 24 daily and 52 weekly publications, including the San Francisco Chronicle, Houston Chronicle, San Antonio Express-News and Albany Times Union, several top digital-only news and lifestyle sites, marketing services businesses, and entertainment businesses such as King Features Syndicate. 

At HNP, we are investing in new and innovative ways to tell stories – growing newsrooms, diversifying tools, evolving platforms – to support the millions of people who trust us each month to help them make decisions, take action and be inspired.  

Be a part of something bigger – your headline awaits.

job.title: Director - Internal Communications
job.description:
SoundCloud empowers artists, tastemakers and fans to connect and share through music. Founded in 2007, SoundCloud is a creator-first platform helping artists build and grow their careers by providing them with the most advanced tools, services, and resources. With over 4x the music catalog of every other major streaming platform, spanning 40+ million artists across 190+ countries, SoundCloud is where emerging artists find their sound, hidden gems are discovered, and music culture is shaped in real time.   THIS IS A CONTRACT (12 MONTH) WITH THE POTENTIAL TO CONVERT TO A PERMANENT FULL-TIME POSITION, IN OUR NEW YORK CITY OFFICE.

SoundCloud is looking for a Director of Internal Communications to lead the strategy and execution of our global internal communications program. Based in New York, this role will partner with senior leadership and teams across the company to strengthen how SoundCloud informs, engages, and connects our global workforce.

A key priority for this role will be leading the successful migration and launch of SoundCloud’s next-generation intranet. You will serve as the communications and program lead for a large, cross-functional team spanning People & Culture, IT and Cybersecurity, Brand, Communications, Finance and SoundCloud’s Webflow owners. You will establish the project’s governance and roadmap, align stakeholders, oversee content strategy and migration, and drive employee adoption of the new platform.

This role is crucial to fostering a strong culture of collaboration, inclusion, and connectivity by ensuring employees have timely access to clear, useful, and engaging information.

If you are a strategic leader, skilled storyteller, and experienced change communicator who is passionate about creating a best-in-class employee experience, and you know how to bring complex, cross-functional programs from strategy through implementation, keep reading.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop and oversee a comprehensive internal communications strategy serving employees across SoundCloud’s global offices, including New York, Los Angeles, Berlin and London, setting the strategic direction in close partnership with the executive team
  • Lead SoundCloud’s intranet migration from planning through launch and adoption, including platform governance, stakeholder alignment, information architecture, content strategy, content auditing and migration, testing, training and ongoing optimization
  • Serve as the central program lead for a cross-functional intranet working group spanning People & Culture, IT, Brand, Finance and more, establishing clear roles, milestones, decision-making processes and accountability
  • Partner with technical and business stakeholders to ensure the new intranet meets employee needs while aligning with SoundCloud’s brand, security, privacy, accessibility and operational requirements
  • Partner with Chief of Staff to produce agenda, content, and coordination of speakers for internal events, including monthly company-wide All Hands 
  • Counsel executives and senior leaders on communications that provide employees with clarity, context, and connection to SoundCloud’s business priorities
  • Identify and manage opportunities to elevate SoundCloud and its executives through relevant industry awards and recognition programs, including developing and submitting compelling nominations
  • Oversee SoundCloud’s internal editorial calendar, delivering timely communications related to company strategy, People initiatives, organizational change and workplace culture
  • Align internal messaging, employee experience and employer branding with SoundCloud’s mission, core behaviors and product positioning
  • Partner with the Talent Acquisition team to develop employer-branding strategies that position SoundCloud as a best-in-class employer and help attract a diverse pool of candidates on Linkedin, Glassdoor and beyond.
  • Manage and continually improve SoundCloud’s internal communications channels, including the intranet and employee newsletters, using engagement data and employee feedback to assess effectiveness
  • Partner with People and Workplace teams to develop communications strategies that increase engagement and enhance the employee experience
  • Collaborate with the DEI team and Diversity Resource Groups to promote initiatives and programming through messaging that fosters understanding, inclusion, and engagement across the organization
  • Monitor trends and emerging practices in internal communications, employee engagement, and workplace technology, providing guidance and new ideas to internal stakeholders

Experience and Background:

  • 8+ years of internal communications experience within a global company or agency environment
  • Demonstrated experience leading a large-scale intranet implementation, migration or digital workplace transformation involving multiple business and technical functions
  • Strong program and project-management skills, including experience establishing governance, coordinating complex workstreams, managing competing priorities and holding stakeholders accountable to deadlines
  • Experience leading change-management and employee-adoption programs for new platforms, systems or ways of working
  • Ability to translate business, technical, security and employee-experience requirements into a clear strategy and executable plan
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively across cultures, functions and levels of seniority
  • Experience developing and executing internal communications strategies within a global organization
  • Confidence working with and providing counsel, guidance and constructive feedback to senior executives
  • Exceptional design and branding acumen, with experience developing presentations, videos and creative collateral
  • Strong sense of ownership, accountability and attention to detail
  • Ability to work independently, exercise sound judgment, adapt quickly and prioritize effectively in a fast-paced environment
  • Proven ability to build alignment, navigate differing stakeholder perspectives and move complex cross-functional initiatives forward
  • Experience using data, analytics, and employee feedback to assess communications effectiveness and improve engagement

The salary range for this role is $160,000 - $175,000 annually. The final salary offered will be determined based on relative experience, skills, internal equity, and location. We also offer a generous total rewards program - read more about additional benefits and perks below! 

About us:

  • We are a multinational company with offices in the US (New York and Los Angeles), Germany (Berlin), and the UK (London)
  • We provide a flexible work culture that offers the opportunity to collaborate and connect in person at our offices as well as accommodating work from home
  • We are deeply committed to ensuring diversity, equity and inclusion at all levels of our organization and fostering a community where everyone’s voice, perspective and experience is respected and heard
  • We believe a strong team is made by investing in employees through mentorship, workshops and enrichment opportunities

Benefits:

  • Comprehensive health benefits including medical, dental, and vision plans, as well as mental health resources
  • Robust 401k program
  • Generous professional development allowance
  • Interested in a gym membership, photography course or book? We have a Creativity and Wellness benefit!
  • Various snacks, goodies, and 2 free lunches weekly when at the office

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion at SoundCloud

SoundCloud is for everyone. Diversity and open expression are fundamental to our organization; they help us lead what’s next in music by understanding and empowering our creators and fans, no matter their identity. We acknowledge the challenges in the music industry, and strive to influence an inclusive culture where everyone can contribute respectfully and thrive, especially the historically marginalized communities that many of our creators, fans and SoundClouders identify with. We are dedicated to creating an inclusive environment at SoundCloud for everyone, regardless of gender identity, sexual orientation, race, ethnicity, migration background, national origin, age, disability status, or care-giver status.

At SoundCloud you can find your community or elevate your allyship by joining a Diversity Resource Group. Diversity Resource Groups are employee-organized groups focused on supporting and promoting the interests of a particular underrepresented community in order to build a more inclusive culture at SoundCloud. Anyone can join, whether you share the identity or strive to be an ally.

  • Deactivation Procedures: Execute comprehensive deactivation procedures, ensuring badges are assigned the correct status (e.g., "Lost," "Non-Op/Broken," "Returned," or "Inactive").

job.title: Business Development Consultant - Orlando Radio
job.description:
Location: FL-Orlando-John Young

Job Title:  Business Development Consultant - Orlando Radio

 

Position Overview

At Cox Media Group (CMG), our Business Development Consultants are provided with a roadmap to a successful career in sales.   

 

Are you interested in expanding your sales career and want to grow faster while working for an industry-leading media company with dominant brands? CMG is looking to hire motivated sales professionals to join one of the most enjoyable media environments around. Business Development Consultants will be given the unique opportunity to participate in a comprehensive developmental program to expand their sales skills while performing the primary duties and responsibilities provided below.   

 

Our Business Development Consultants with our Sales Support Teams to leverage data that identifies consumer insights, sales strategy, and execution plans for cross platform (audio and digital) campaigns. With an internal advertising fulfillment team our Business Development Consultants have a firsthand look at their campaigns and can optimize in real time.  

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Learn about and sell fully integrated advertising solutions utilizing our full suite of audio and digital products 
  • Proactively and independently identify and connect with qualified prospects to maintain a full pipeline 
  • Identify, understand and communicate trends within client markets and industries to lead with insights and engage prospects in business conversations 
  • Uncover desired business results for each prospect / client by regularly meeting in person with prospect/client 
  • Build strategic agency and client-side relationships in order to present the best solutions based on desired business results 
  • Discuss expectations, measurement with prospects and clients to ensure the proposed solution will deliver ROI 
  • Drive advertising revenue through direct sales   
  • Work outside of the office and on the road to develop and maintain professional relationships; be prepared to meet with clients in person and when needed on their premises or at other locations they desire 
  • Manage sales pipeline   
  • Communicate effectively internally with Sales Managers, sales support, as well as externally with clients 
  • Create proposals to be presented to Sales leaders as well as existing and potential clients  

Essential Duties and Responsibilities (continued)

  • Consult and instruct clients on all CMG solutions, offerings and demonstrate a deep understanding of product capabilities measurement, attribution and KPIs 
  • Responsible for meeting and exceeding all sales goals as they are outlined by the Integrated Sales Manager (ISM)   
  • Increase revenue through a balance of new business development and upselling of current clients 
  • Manage time well and be able to handle complex work 
  • Maintain consistent self-motivation and high attention to detail  
  • Manage, organize, and prioritize tasks in a fast-paced environment 
  • Proactively and independently prospect, qualify, close, grow and retain clients and relationships 
  • Build strategic direct client and agency relationships to secure revenue growth and build credibility in the marketplace by meeting with clients face to face, video meetings, and through digital correspondence 
  • Drive advertising revenue through direct sales   
  • Develop and maintain professional relationships; be prepared to meet with clients in person and when needed on their premises or at other locations they desire 
  • Communicate effectively internally with Sales Managers, sales support, as well as externally with clients 

Minimum Qualifications

  • Must be comfortable with constant change and operating in a fast-moving, ever-changing world of digital and media   
  • Must be comfortable working outside of the office and traveling to meet clients or prospective clients     
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills   
  • Valid Driver’s License with clean driving record   

Preferred Qualifications

  • 1+ years of successful sales experience preferred   
  • Strong business acumen across media and advertising is preferred 
  • 4-year College Degree preferred but not required  

About Cox Media Group 

CMG Media Corporation (d/b/a Cox Media Group) is an industry-leading media company with unparalleled brands, award-winning content, and exceptional team members. CMG provides valuable local and national journalism and entertainment content to the people and communities it serves. The company's businesses encompass 17 high-quality, market-leading television brands in 9 markets; 45 top-performing radio stations delivering multiple genres of content in 9 markets; and numerous streaming and digital platforms. CMG's TV portfolio includes multiple primary affiliates of ABC, CBS, FOX, NBC, Telemundo and MyNetworkTV, as well as several valuable news and independent stations. For more information about CMG, visit www.coxmediagroup.com

job.title: Producer
job.description:
Overview

Job Title: Producer

 

Department: Programming

 

Reporting To: Brand Manager

 

Employment Type: Full-Time

 

Location(s): Houston, TX

 

Work Arrangement: On-Site

 

Overview:

Audacy Houston has a rare full time producer opportunity on 95.7 The Fan. We are searching for a technically sound, organized, content creation focused producer for Payne and Pendergast, Houston’s most recognizable morning sports talk program. Strong communication skills, an intimate knowledge of WideOrbit and all radio production software, understanding of digital and social media platforms, and a full, honest investment in Houston sports and culture are vital for this position. This is a live and local position that requires the producer to be based in the Houston area. Previous producing experience in a medium to large market is ideal, but not necessary.

 

Audacy offers full time employees with a comprehensive benefits package to include:  health care coordinator, medical, dental, vision, telemedicine, flexible spending accounts, health savings account, disability, life insurance, critical illness, hospital indemnity, accident insurance, paid time off (sick, vacation, personal, parental, volunteer), 401(k) retirement plan, discounted employee stock purchase, student loan payment assistance program, legal assistance, life assistance program, identity theft protection, discounted home and auto insurance, and pet insurance.

 

This position will also include, but not require or guarantee, additional opportunities and considerations for on air opportunities, paid sales endorsements, and promotional appearances.

Responsibilities

What You'll Do:

  • Produce and run the audio board for Payne and Pendergast, 6a-10a M-F on 95.7 The Fan
  • Develop a signature “show sound” through the use of music beds, drops, and daily featured audio
  • Help develop topic ideas and content for both on air conversations and social media/digital videos
  • Handle podcasting, live video clipping, social media posting, and other ancillary production  responsibilities for Payne and Pendergast

Position Overview

WPXI Pittsburgh TV is seeking a Director of Engineering to lead the station’s technical operations, broadcast infrastructure, facilities systems, regulatory compliance, and technology modernization efforts. This role is responsible for ensuring reliable on-air operations, protecting the station license, maintaining studio and transmitter facilities, and partnering with News, Production, Sales, Traffic, Master Control, IT, and station leadership to support high-quality local journalism and business continuity. The Director of Engineering leads the technical team, oversees capital and operating budgets, manages vendor relationships, and drives continuous improvement across broadcast, IT, RF transmission, automation, production, network, cloud, and facility systems.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Lead all technical operations for the station, including studio production systems, newsroom technology, master control workflows, automation, media storage, signal distribution, ENG, remote production, and transmission facilities.
  • Ensure reliable, compliant operation of transmitters, towers, RF systems, satellite and microwave systems, EAS equipment, monitoring systems, generators, UPS systems, HVAC, and other critical infrastructure.
  • Protect the station license by maintaining compliance with federal, state and local regulatory agencies, including required documentation, inspections, testing, and corrective actions.
  • Develop and lead a strong engineering culture focused on safety, accountability, service, collaboration, training, responsiveness, and continuous improvement.
  • Manage, coach, and develop the station technical team, including staffing plans, performance expectations, succession planning, technical training, and emergency coverage.
  • Partner with station leadership to align engineering priorities with operational goals, audience needs, local news production, company initiatives, and long-term technology strategy.
  • Plan, execute, and track annual operating and capital budgets, including forecasting, business case development, bid solicitation, vendor selection, documentation, and project delivery.
  • Lead capital projects from concept through implementation, ensuring projects are delivered safely, on time, within budget, and with minimal disruption to on-air operations.
  • Support modernization of the station’s broadcast and IT environment, including IP-based workflows, automation, cloud or hybrid systems, cybersecurity practices, disaster recovery, network resilience, and scalable production tools.
  • Maintain strong working relationships with vendors, contractors, corporate technology teams, property management, and internal departments to resolve issues and improve service.
  • Communicate clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders during outages, planned maintenance, project work, and operational incidents, including impact, status, timelines, and follow-up actions.
  • Lead after-action reviews for significant technical incidents, document root causes and corrective actions, and implement improvements to reduce repeat issues.
  • Prepare timely status reports, budget updates, project documentation, technical records, and leadership briefings as required.
  • Serve as an essential leader during emergencies, severe weather, breaking news, major technical failures, or other events requiring immediate technical response.

  • Working knowledge of IT infrastructure, networks, firewalls, switches, servers, operating systems, endpoint management, cybersecurity fundamentals, and business continuity practices.

  • Demonstrated ability to lead, coach, prioritize, and develop technical staff in a fast-paced, deadline-driven, 24/7 operational environment.
  • Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical issues clearly to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, organizational, and decision-making skills, including the ability to assess operational risk and respond effectively during urgent situations.
  • Customer-service mindset and professional approach when working with internal departments, corporate partners, vendors, contractors, clients, and the public.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively, manage multiple priorities, and provide leadership during nights, weekends, holidays, emergencies, or outages as needed.

Preferred Qualifications

Job Title

Cloud Platform Engineering Intern

Job Description

About People Inc:
People Inc. is America’s largest digital and print publisher. Our 40+ iconic and fast-growing brands harness the best intent-driven content, the fastest sites, and the fewest ads to help nearly 200 million people every month, including 95 percent of US women, make decisions, take action, and find inspiration. People Inc. brands include PEOPLE, Better Homes & Gardens, Verywell, FOOD & WINE, The Spruce, Allrecipes, Byrdie, REAL SIMPLE, Investopedia, Southern Living and more.

About The Role:

We are seeking a Cloud Platform Engineering Intern to help build, automate, and validate infrastructure across Amazon Web Services (AWS), Google Cloud Platform (GCP), and Kubernetes environments.

This role is ideal for someone interested in cloud engineering, platform automation, and the emerging use of AI in infrastructure operations. The intern will work alongside Cloud Platform engineers to build tools that interact with infrastructure, collect and analyze operational data, validate configurations, and produce actionable reports.

The position will have a strong focus on Kubernetes, Infrastructure as Code, Configuration as Code, and AI-assisted infrastructure management. The intern will gain practical experience working with production-oriented cloud platforms while learning how to build automation that is secure, observable, repeatable, and safe to operate.

Responsibilities:

  • Develop tools and scripts that query, inspect, and report on AWS, GCP, and Kubernetes resources.

  • Build infrastructure inventory, configuration validation, compliance reporting, and operational health-check utilities.

  • Help automate cloud and Kubernetes infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform.

  • Contribute to Configuration as Code using tools such as Helm, Kustomize, Ansible, and declarative YAML.

  • Develop AI-assisted workflows for infrastructure analysis, troubleshooting, configuration generation, and validation.

  • Implement safeguards for AI-enabled infrastructure workflows, including schema validation, policy checks, dry-run capabilities, approval gates, and human review.

  • Integrate infrastructure tools with cloud APIs, Kubernetes APIs, CI/CD pipelines, Git repositories, and observability platforms.

  • Assist with validating Kubernetes manifests, Terraform plans, deployment configurations, and cloud resource settings.

  • Build reports and dashboards that identify configuration drift, resource usage, security risks, operational issues, and optimization opportunities.

  • Write unit and integration tests for infrastructure automation and validation tools.

  • Document tools, workflows, configuration standards, and operational procedures.

  • Participate in code reviews, technical design discussions, and platform engineering planning.

  • Work with engineers to investigate infrastructure issues and identify opportunities for automation.

Required Qualifications:

  • Currently pursuing a degree or equivalent training in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field.

  • Foundational programming or scripting experience in one or more languages such as Python, Go, JavaScript/TypeScript, or Bash.

  • Basic understanding of Linux, networking, APIs, source control, and software development practices.

  • Familiarity with containers and an interest in Kubernetes and cloud infrastructure.

  • Familiarity with Git and collaborative development workflows.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

  • Ability to learn unfamiliar technologies and ask effective technical questions.

  • Clear written and verbal communication skills.

  • Interest in automation, developer platforms, and reliable infrastructure operations.

Preferred Qualifications:

Experience with any of the following is helpful but not required:

  • AWS or Google Cloud Platform.

  • Kubernetes, Docker, Helm, or Kustomize.

  • Terraform or another Infrastructure as Code framework.

  • Ansible or other configuration-management tools.

  • CI/CD platforms such as GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Argo CD, or Argo Workflows

  • REST APIs, cloud SDKs, or Kubernetes client libraries.

  • Data collection, reporting, dashboards, or observability tools.

  • Large language models, AI agents, tool-calling systems, or Model Context Protocol (MCP).

  • Automated testing, policy-as-code, or configuration validation.

  • Cloud security concepts such as IAM, workload identity, secrets management, and least-privilege access.

The Executive Business Partner plays a critical role in helping executive leaders operate effectively in a fast-paced, highly collaborative environment. By providing proactive support, coordinating priorities, managing critical communications, and ensuring follow-through on key activities, the Executive Business Partner acts as a force multiplier for executive leadership, creating the capacity for leaders to focus on strategic objectives and business results.

Operational Excellence

Initiative

Accountability

job.title: Assistant Creative Manager
job.description:
The Assistant Creative Manager will be primarily responsible for leading local creative marketing, content production, and artist campaign execution for Sony Music's international repertoire in Hong Kong. In addition to driving the Hong Kong market, this position will provide expanded creative support for campaign initiatives across Taiwan and Southeast Asia (SEA).

This position will play a key role in various creative marketing functions — assisting with pitch development, coordinating agency deliverables, maintaining release timelines, supporting in-market promotional visits, and creating assets (social media, short-form video, photo, and digital marketing materials) to craft engaging fan experiences on behalf of some of the biggest international artists in the world. 

The role is based in Hong Kong and covers Hong Kong, Taiwan and Southeast Asia (SEA). You will sit within Hong Kong, Taiwan and Southeast Asia (SEA) International Marketing community, reporting to the Director, International Marketing in Hong Kong and working closely with the Head of Creative, Southeast Asia, ensuring regional creative alignment while executing tailored campaigns locally.

What you'll do:

  • Campaign Ideation & Execution: Be a creative visionary, developing and implementing innovative marketing and superfan campaigns that enhance Sony Music artists’ presence and engage fans across Hong Kong, Taiwan, and Southeast Asia.
  • Vendor & Agency Coordination: Manage relationships with external creative partners such as agencies, photographers, and production teams to deliver high-quality content and assets on time and within budget.
  • Workflow & Asset Management: Assist with the end-to-end creative workflow—from routing concepts for approval to monitoring production schedules—ensuring asset alignment with artist and company brand guidelines.
  • Trend & Platform Research: Monitor music, pop culture, events, TikTok, digital marketing, and emerging tech trends to provide actionable ideas for creative asset production.
  • Data & Insights Application: Collaborate with the data and insights team to pull audience analytics, assisting in applying performance metrics to optimize asset design and content formats.
  • Content Calendar & Delivery: Build and maintain the master content calendar for campaign launches, promotional schedules, and artist activities across the company’s international releases.
  • Cross-Functional Alignment: Support cross-functional integration across digital, audience development, catalogue, local PR, and content teams to ensure messaging alignment.
  • Post-Campaign Reporting: Gather feedback, compile post-campaign performance data, and draft summary reports to help refine future creative strategies.
  • Asset Production & Collaboration: Develop and produce engaging creative outputs that reflect the artist's unique identity, story, and vision across multiple platforms. Coordinate with graphic designers, videographers, and editors to produce visually compelling content. while remaining adaptable to artist management feedback.

Who you are:

Technical capabilities

  • 3–5 years of experience executing creative marketing campaigns within music, entertainment, media, or agency environments.
  • Passionate about the music and entertainment industry with a strong desire to grow your creative career.
  • Highly organized multi-taskers with strong communication skills and experience supporting cross-functional teams.
  • Curious, proactive, eager to learn, and attuned to the unique cultural trends across Hong Kong, Taiwan, Southeast Asian markets.
  • Skilled at translating artistic concepts into practical, engaging digital and social assets.
  • Solid understanding of modern digital platforms, music streaming mechanics, and short-form video creation.
  • Analytical mindset with basic proficiency in reviewing campaign analytics and key performance metrics.
  • Excellent written English and Chinese, with fluent spoken English & Cantonese. Fluent spoken Mandarin is an advantage.

Behavioural capabilities

  • Ownership and agility: takes complete responsibility for assigned artists and markets, and adapts quickly to shifting timelines, artist priorities and market trends.
  • Execution excellence: delivers high-quality work with meticulous attention to detail, timing and cross-functional coordination.
  • Curiosity and innovation: proactively explores new creator trends, media hooks, platform features and commercial opportunities beyond assigned tasks.
  • Collaboration and problem solving: works effectively with cross-border teams and external partners across different markets, time zones and working cultures, bringing practical solutions to complex challenges

What we give you:

  • You join a vibrant global community with the opportunity to channel your passion every day 
  • A modern office environment designed for you, empowering you to bring your best 
  • Investment in your professional growth and development enabling you to thrive in our vibrant community

job.title: Senior Software Engineer - Anti-Abuse
job.description:
SoundCloud empowers artists and fans to connect and share through music. Founded in 2007, SoundCloud is an artist-first platform empowering artists to build and grow their careers by providing them with the most progressive tools, services, and resources. With over 400+ million tracks from 40 million artists, the future of music is SoundCloud.

SoundCloud is looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to join our Anti-Abuse Team, with a mission to keep connections between fans and creators safe and authentic, while building and operating an abuse prevention platform at global scale. The role can be based in either our Berlin or London office.

Our services are at the heart of SoundCloud’s user journeys. We operate a substantial suite of event-based services, combining specialised and generalised detection approaches to tackle complex architectural problems where scale, adaptability and fast decision-making are critical.

You’ll join a self-sufficient team passionate about abuse prevention, building scalable and adaptable solutions that stay ahead of emerging risks. The role combines long-term platform and architecture work with rapid response to new abuse vectors, giving you the opportunity to solve both strategic and time-sensitive engineering problems.

You’ll have significant end-to-end ownership to identify problems, shape solutions and drive projects from the ground up, working directly with engineering and T&S Professionals. If you’re creative, proactive and enjoy being the expert who turns complex problems into effective solutions, you’ll have plenty of room to make an impact.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build and evolve reusable platform capabilities and services that enable other teams to detect and respond to emerging abuse patterns at scale
  • Shape the platform architecture and technical strategy, balancing long-term scalability with rapid responses to emerging challenges
  • Partner with Product, Analytics, Trust & Safety professionals, and Engineering teams to identify and address abuse patterns across the organisation, driving alignment on solutions and communicating complex technical concepts clearly to diverse stakeholders.
  • Own problems end-to-end, from identifying opportunities and defining solutions to driving projects through delivery
  • Make pragmatic technical decisions, balancing cost, latency, complexity, scalability and maintainability
  • Drive architecture discussions, contribute to technical strategy, and improve engineering practices, processes and tooling.
  • Debug complex issues across data pipelines and distributed systems
  • Continuously learn and share knowledge of industry best practices in abuse prevention and detection
  • Be part of on-call rotation to ensure the reliability and availability of SoundCloud’s systems

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience designing APIs and backend services consumed by multiple client platforms
  • Strong SQL skills for massive datasets (e.g. BigQuery or similar)
  • Knowledge of different API communication patterns (e.g., gRPC, GraphQL)
  • Strong professional experience with Go; experience with Scala or another language is a plus
  • Nice to have: Experience in abuse prevention, fraud detection or Trust & Safety is a plus
  • Nice to have: Experience using AI-assisted development tools and a strong intuition for their strengths, weaknesses, and emerging opportunities

Experience and Background

  • Extensive professional software engineering experience, including significant experience designing and operating distributed, event-driven backend systems at scale.
  • Hands-on experience with infrastructure as code (IaC) using Terraform and cloud-native environments such as AWS or GCP
  • Experience in building distributed data processing and ETL pipelines, metrics and supporting ML infrastructure 
  • Experience with microservices, SQL and NoSQL databases, container technologies
  • You care about the craft of software engineering: continuous delivery, defensive programming, automated testing, security, clean code principles
  • You have a strong sense of ownership and are comfortable navigating ambiguity in fast-moving environments
  • You bring a humble, collaborative, team-first mindset and an eagerness to learn and support your colleagues
  • Bonus point: You love music

About us

  • We are a multinational company with offices in the US (New York and Los Angeles), Germany (Berlin), and the UK (London)
  • We provide a flexible work culture that offers the opportunity to collaborate and connect in person at our offices as well as accommodating work from home
  • We are deeply committed to ensuring diversity, equity and inclusion at all levels of our organization and fostering a community where everyone’s voice, perspective and experience is respected and heard
  • We believe a strong team is made by investing in employees through mentorship, workshops and enrichment opportunities

 

Benefits: The Recruiter will supply the benefit points based on the location

 

Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion at SoundCloud 

SoundCloud is for everyone. Diversity and open expression are fundamental to our organization; they help us lead what’s next in music by understanding and empowering our creators and fans, no matter their identity. We acknowledge the challenges in the music industry, and strive to influence an inclusive culture where everyone can contribute respectfully and thrive, especially the historically marginalized communities that many of our creators, fans and SoundClouders identify with. We are dedicated to creating an inclusive environment at SoundCloud for everyone, regardless of gender identity, sexual orientation, race, ethnicity, migration background, national origin, age, disability status, or care-giver status.


At SoundCloud you can find your community or elevate your allyship by joining a Diversity Resource Group. Diversity Resource Groups are employee-organized groups focused on supporting and promoting the interests of a particular underrepresented community in order to build a more inclusive culture at SoundCloud. Anyone can join, whether you share the identity or strive to be an ally.

job.title: Intern
job.description:
The WESH 2/ CW18 News Internship Program is a paid, rigorous and highly competitive hands-on experience that provides individuals the opportunity to learn about the operations of a broadcast television station. You will develop news writing, producing, reporting, and digital media skills while learning from award-winning staff at WESH 2 News. Additional opportunities are available in the behind-the-scenes areas of production/studio operations, weather and marketing/promotions. Your internship will prepare you for work in a real newsroom, giving you opportunities in nearly every aspect of news production.
 

Spring 2027 Session
Application Window: Nov. 14th, 2026– Dec. 15th, 2026
Session: Jan. 25th, 2027 – April 16th, 2027
*Dates are subject to change
 

WESH 2/CW18 offers paid internships in the departments below. In order to apply for an internship at WESH 2/CW18, please provide a cover letter with your application. The cover letter should include:
•    Semester i.e. Spring, Summer, or Fall (if applicable)
•    Department preference
•    Available start and end dates
•    Days and hours available to intern
 

Available Internships

Newsroom

Interns will work alongside reporters, producers, and news managers to learn skills in nearly all aspects of television news production. Examples include on-scene reporting, producing, video editing, research, and working at the assignment desk.

Production/Studio Operations

Interns will learn the technical aspects of live news broadcasts. Behind-the-scenes training will include learning robotic cameras, floor directing, lighting and show set-ups. Interns are required to be comfortable with height, able to lift light equipment, and work non-traditional hours.

Digital

Interns will learn how newsrooms publish content to digital platforms, analyze real-time online metrics and more. Interns will get the opportunity to research, write, and publish stories for WESH.com.

Weather

Interns must have working knowledge of a meteorology curriculum or closely related program of study. You will work with our team of meteorologists to learn the skills necessary in creating and delivering forecast information for a television and online audience.

Marketing/Promotions

Interns with an interest in marketing, advertising, promotion, or production will be given hands-on experience in these areas.

Orientation

Once you are accepted as an intern at WESH-TV, you will receive an instruction packet. Your first day at the station is set aside for orientation and you Must attend this. You will work three days a week, eight hours each shift with varying schedules. During the internship you should always check in with your assigned adviser upon entering the building.

Securing housing and transportation during the internship are the responsibility of the student. WESH-TV cannot offer support in this area.

Values in Action

At Hearst Television we tell stories every day. Stories about people of all backgrounds, perspectives, and identities. That's why, behind the scenes, we believe in being an organization that fosters collaboration and open communication, ensuring that the content we create is authentic, accurate, and connected to the communities we serve.

job.title: Audience Development Executive
job.description:
The Audience Development Executive grows and deepens the audience for Sony Music's C-POP and J-POP repertoire across Taiwan, Hong Kong and Southeast Asia. You will own how fans find our artists, how they move from a first stream to a committed fan, and how we understand and act on what those audiences tell us. 

C-POP and J-POP are two of the fastest-moving parts of our regional business, with releases and campaigns increasingly running across several markets at once and audience behaviour that differs sharply between the two. This role is the connective tissue: setting audience strategy per artist and per release, coordinating rollout across markets, and turning streaming, social and first-party data into decisions the marketing teams can act on. Success looks like measurable audience growth market by market, a healthier conversion from casual listener to superfan, and a release calendar for both repertoires that runs as one regional plan rather than several disconnected ones. 

The role is based in Taiwan, and covers Hong Kong, Taiwan and Southeast Asia (SEA). You will sit within Hong Kong, Taiwan and Southeast Asia (SEA) International Marketing community, reporting to the Director, International Marketing in Hong Kong and working closely with the Head of Creative, Southeast Asia, ensuring regional creative alignment while executing tailored campaigns locally. 

 

What you'll do:

Own audience strategy for C-POP and J-POP repertoire 

  • Develop and deliver audience development plans for priority C-POP and J-POP artists, releases and catalogue across Taiwan, Hong Kong and Southeast Asia, with clear objectives for audience growth, retention and conversion. 
  • Segment and size audiences by market, identifying where an artist is over- or under-indexed and where the realistic growth is, then shape campaign priorities and budget recommendations around that. 
  • Build the discovery-to-superfan funnel for each project: map how listeners enter, what moves them deeper, and where they drop out, and design interventions at each stage. 
  • Own the audience narrative for both repertoires in regional planning sessions, bringing a clear point of view backed by data to marketing, creative, commercial and repertoire centre stakeholders. 
  • Recognise where C-POP and J-POP audiences behave differently, in discovery route, fandom structure, spending patterns and platform preference, and build strategies that reflect those differences rather than applying one regional template to both. 

Grow audiences on DSPs and across the streaming ecosystem 

  • Work with digital service partners including Spotify, Apple Music, YouTube Music, LINE MUSIC, JOOX, KKBOX and regional platforms on pitching, editorial support, on-platform programming and audience-growth opportunities across both repertoires. 
  • Drive playlist strategy across owned, editorial and algorithmic surfaces, including Filtr and other in-house playlist brands, and track how placement translates into sustained audience rather than a single-week spike. 
  • Partner with the digital marketing and media buying teams to align paid audience targeting with organic audience strategy, so spend is directed where it compounds. 
  • Monitor the creator and short-form ecosystem, identifying tracks and moments gaining traction and working with creative and digital teams to amplify them quickly. 
  • Track and act on the discovery routes specific to J-POP in this region, including anime, film and game sync, tour and event moments, and catalogue resurgence, and convert those spikes into retained audience. 

Build first-party data and superfan capability 

  • Grow first-party data capture across C-POP and J-POP campaigns, working with local teams to embed sign-up and data collection into releases, tours, fan events and D2C moments. 
  • Turn first-party data into usable audience segments for CRM, direct-to-consumer and superfan activity, and support markets in activating those segments responsibly. 
  • Identify and develop superfan opportunities that deepen the relationship with the most engaged part of each artist's audience, and support the commercial cases that sit behind them. 
  • Partner with Sony Music Japan and Greater China repertoire centre teams on first-party data and superfan initiatives, feeding regional audience insight back to them and translating their priorities into market-level plans. 
  • Work within local data protection and privacy requirements across each market, in partnership with legal and the relevant local teams. 

Coordinate across markets and repertoire centres 

  • Act as the regional coordination point for C-POP and J-POP releases and activities, aligning timelines, asset delivery and campaign moments across Taiwan, Hong Kong and Southeast Asia. 
  • Consolidate requirements from local marketing teams into workable regional plans that scale while still allowing for hyper-local adaptation. 
  • Maintain visibility of the release calendar and audience plans across both repertoires so markets and the repertoire centres know what is coming and what is expected of them. 
  • Flag risks, clashes and gaps early, and keep regional stakeholders informed of progress and performance. 

Measure, report and improve 

  • Track and report on audience KPIs including listener growth, retention, market share, playlist performance, and first-party data capture, and communicate results clearly to senior stakeholders. 
  • Lead post-campaign reviews, identifying what drove audience growth and feeding those learnings into the next cycle. 
  • Work with the insights, data and analytics team to develop reporting that markets will actually use, and build data literacy across the regional teams. 
  • Stay ahead of platform, format and consumption changes across Greater China and Southeast Asia, and advise the business on what they mean for how we grow audiences.

 

Who you are:

  • 2+ years' experience in audience development, digital marketing, streaming or artist marketing at a label, DSP, artist management company or comparable media business. 
  • Demonstrable track record of growing an artist, catalogue or content audience, with the numbers to show it. 
  • Strong working knowledge of the streaming landscape across Greater China and Southeast Asia, including DSP editorial and algorithmic mechanics, playlist strategy, and platform-specific audience behaviour. 
  • Genuine fluency in C-POP and J-POP: the artists, the fandoms, the platforms they live on, and how audience behaviour differs between Taiwan, Hong Kong and the Southeast Asian markets. 
  • Comfortable with data. Able to work with streaming, social and first-party data, draw a defensible conclusion from it, and explain that conclusion to people who are not analysts. 
  • Experience with first-party data capture, CRM or direct-to-consumer fan initiatives is a strong advantage. 
  • Fluent in Mandarin (Traditional Chinese) and English. Japanese is a strong advantage given the J-POP scope, and Cantonese an advantage given the Hong Kong scope. 
  • Strong coordination skills across multiple markets, time zones and stakeholders, with the ability to keep several campaigns moving at once. 
  • Ability to articulate an idea or point of view succinctly, with clarity and confidence, adapting the message to different audiences, seniority levels and cultures. 
  • Responds and adapts quickly to change, maintaining a flexible attitude and using new conditions to evolve their thinking. 
  • A thorough understanding of lifestyle and cultural trends across Greater China and Southeast Asia.

 

What we give you:

  • You join a vibrant global community with the opportunity to channel your passion every day
  • A modern office environment designed for you, empowering you to bring your best
  • Investment in your professional growth and development enabling you to thrive in our vibrant community
  • The space to accelerate progress, positively disrupt and create what happens next
  • We give you the platform to champion positive change, with the opportunity to contribute to our social impact, diversity, equity and inclusion initiatives
