job.title: ESPN Network Sales and Marketing Coordinator
job.description:
Sales & Marketing Coordinator

(Milwaukee, WI)  

The ESPN Radio Network & Good Karma Sports are seeking a full-time Sales & Marketing Coordinator. The Sales & Marketing Coordinator will support the ESPN Radio Network’s sales, marketing, content, and partnership efforts by coordinating partnership obligations, live-read copy, campaign execution, reporting, invoicing, and day-to-day operational details across talk shows, play-by-play broadcasts, podcasts, and other programming.

The ideal candidate is highly organized, detail-oriented, proactive, and has an AI Forward mentality with strong communication skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities while working collaboratively with sales, marketing, content, programming, and partner teams. This person will be a critical connector who helps ensure campaigns are accurately executed, properly documented, ready for launch, and delivered with an exceptional partner experience.

Career responsibilities include but are not limited to: 

  • Coordinate sponsorship obligations and live-read copy for talk shows, play-by-play broadcasts, and podcasts.
  • Manage airchecks and campaign documentation, including video, audio, social links, and other supporting materials.
  • Maintain the content fee tracker, ensuring fees, obligations, and deliverables are accurate and up to date.
  • Manage the social media tracker and coordinate campaign execution details.
  • Create campaign recaps and partner-facing reports summarizing key deliverables and results.
  • Support campaign reconciliation by tracking delivered obligations, billing details, and open items in Attio.
  • Build & support the development of partner-first campaigns by helping create compelling stories and narratives.
  • Send partner invoices accurately and as needed.
  • Support receivables aging efforts by tracking outstanding balances and open billing items.
  • Review podcast campaigns to ensure all requirements are complete and ready for the following week’s launch.
  • Collaborate with sales, marketing, programming, content, finance, and partner teams to support campaign execution.
  • Integrate AI tools into daily workflows to support campaign development, event planning, content creation, reporting, and operational efficiency while maintaining accuracy, quality, and brand standards.
  • Attend and support events on a working capacity as needed.
  • Complete other responsibilities and projects as assigned.
  • Be a Good Karma Sports ambassador by adhering to Good Karma’s core values: Listen, Be Honest, Work Hard, Over Deliver, Follow Through, and Teamwork.

Preferred knowledge, skills and qualifications 

  • Strong organizational, project-management, and time-management skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Creative and collaborative marketing mindset with the ability to work effectively across departments.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects, deadlines, events, and priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Experience creating campaign materials, partner-facing recaps, promotional content, or other marketing deliverables.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office, specifically PowerPoint, AI platforms and/or other business related applications.
  • Valid driver’s license. 
  • Occasional travel & availability to work evenings and weekends as needed.

Hours/Salary/Benefits

This is a non-exempt role with overtime eligible for hours worked over 40 per week. The salary rate is to be determined by the education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities, and location of the applicant, as well as internal and external equity. 

This role is eligible for full benefits including health, dental and vision insurance, Life Insurance, STD, LTD, 401(k) Plan, Dependent Care, paid parental leave, and more with opportunities for salary growth increase with skills and responsibilities and meeting targeted goals. The position will be required to work some evenings and weekends based on station events, promotions, and community activities.

Opportunity for Growth  

Teammates have the opportunity to continuously learn and grow within Good Karma and are responsible for representing Good Karma Sports, our story, and our core values inside and outside the workplace. Teammates are encouraged to take a proactive role in building relationships and seeking opportunities throughout the company.  

How to Apply  

Apply by submitting resume to www.goodkarmasports.com/careers no later than October 22, 2026. All are encouraged to apply.  

About Good Karma Sports

Good Karma Sports is a sports media and marketing company that helps brands build meaningful connections with fans in and around the game. Combining national reach, regional expertise and deep local relationships, the company develops and executes multi-platform strategies across audio, podcasts, video, digital, social, talent, live experiences and premium sports partnerships. 

For nearly 30 years, Good Karma has paired sports-first expertise and trusted relationships with best-in-class execution to deliver results for brands, publishers, leagues, teams, communities and fans. Today, Good Karma Sports has more than 500 teammates across 12 offices nationwide and has been recognized as a Best Place to Work by Front Office Sports, Sports Business Journal and USA TODAY.

job.title: R1 Traffic Manager
job.description:
Job Position:  Traffic Manager 

Department: Traffic 

Reports to Regional Traffic Director

FLSA: Exempt(ADM) 

Status: Full-time  

Location:   Indianapolis, IN

 

OVERVIEW: 

The Radio One story began simply with a dream and one radio station. Over Forty-five years, 13 markets, and 70+ stations later, we are an urban media empire, spanning multiple media platforms. We are in your ears with Reach Media/Radio One, on your televisions with TV One, and may even be the name behind your favorite website, with our digital platform Interactive One. Information is power, and our mission here at Radio One, Inc. is simple – to be the most trusted media source in the African American community. At Radio One, we pride ourselves on hiring people who are dedicated and continue to challenge the norm, while embracing a corporate culture built on creativity and passion. We are our employees’ biggest fans, and it is our daily mission to attract, develop, and retain the brightest stars in the business.

The Traffic Manager will be responsible for managing station logs for commercial, programming and promotional content.

ESSENTIAL RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Prepare logs using Wide-Orbit System, including creation, scheduling, processing , contract generation, and submission to the Programming 
  • Monitor competitive codes, rates, spot rotations, and available inventory and schedule commercials accordingly. Reconcile post-logs for approval and posting to boardfile; research and report discrepancies for follow-up 
  • Merge music logs
  • Produce, edit and advise on “time-sold” and pre-emption reports to maximize inventory; post inventory to other systems as required 
  • Analyze daily bump commercial reports and distribute relevant information to affected departments for follow-up
  • Review on-air time sales, promotion and programming, and news orders and/or public service announcements to verify accuracy and completeness 
  • Review sponsor requests for specific dates, and times of announcements; recommend alternate dates, and times and input information to update the log
  • Liaison with other departments, i.e. Accounting, Sales, Programming, Production, Promotions etc. as required
  • Demonstrate the ability to lead and direct a team to include but not limited to:
  • Provide regular constructive feedback in accordance with HR department expectations

job.description:
About SBS:

As a pioneer in Spanish-language media, SBS has always been at the forefront of the evolution of Hispanic entertainment in the U.S. In this era of technological advancements and media convergence, SBS is poised to capitalize on its vast array of proprietary content across multiple platforms. SBS remains steadfast in our leadership position in today's dynamic and ever-expanding U.S. Hispanic market, and we are determined to continue pushing boundaries and shaping the future of Hispanic media.

Position Summary

On-air Talent Personality is responsible for the daily broadcasting of a radio station to which is assigned, and their work focuses on engaging the listening or viewing audience in a creative and engaging manner while maintaining FCC compliance for content. 

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

•   Perform live broadcast show that is entertaining and informative to their audience

•   Interview personalities and guests

•   Record commercials for later broadcast.

•   Serve as a reporter as assigned, including special reports 

•   Select program content, in conjunction with producers, based on factors such as program specialties, audience tastes, or requests from the public.

•   Provide commentary and conduct interviews during “Live” transmissions, and other events

•   Develop sources and story ideas

•   Make promotional appearances at public or private events in order to represent the company.

•   Participates in regular internal meetings to review new content, topics, with Executive Producer and team

•   Have an active presence on social media that engages the audience

•   Other duties as required

Essential duties and responsibilities are those most important or most frequently performed duties.  Employees will be required to perform other job-related duties as required.

Supervisory Responsibilities

  • None

Minimum Requirements

  • Minimum 2 years’ experience in a similar position
  • Must have engaging on-air presence.
  • Must possess impeccable diction in Spanish language, preferably fully bilingual (Spanish/English)
  • Be creative and have great story telling and writing skills in Spanish. 
  • Pleasant and well-controlled voice and good timing when speaking on air.
  • Ability to interact with audience and clients in a public setting.
  • Gather news information and prepare it for on-air delivery.
  • Familiar with current events (national and international), enjoys participating in conversational debates.
  • Must be able to work well under strict deadlines and pressure.
  • Able to work long hours, including weekends and holidays, when necessary
  • Teamwork/Cooperation with positive working relationships
  • Must be creative, have a sharp wit and able to improvise and think quickly while on air.

In addition to meeting the minimum qualifications listed above, an individual must be able to perform each of the established essential functions to perform this job successfully.

Physical Requirements

Work involves exerting up to 10 pounds of force occasionally or a negligible amount of force frequently to lift, carry, push, pull, or otherwise move objects. Sedentary work involves sitting most of the time but may involve walking or standing for brief periods of time. Jobs may be defined as sedentary when walking and standing are required only occasionally, and all other sedentary criteria are met.

Why work for SBS?

Spanish Broadcasting Systems (SBS) offers a unique and exciting opportunity to be part of the leading Hispanic-focused media company in the industry. By joining our team, you will become an integral part of shaping and influencing the landscape of Spanish-language broadcasting. We take pride in our rich heritage and commitment to serving the vibrant Hispanic community with compelling content and innovative programming. At SBS, you will be surrounded by a diverse and talented group of professionals who share a passion for media, creativity, and cultural connectivity. We foster a collaborative and inclusive work environment where your ideas and contributions are valued and recognized. With access to state-of-the-art facilities and cutting-edge technologies, you will have the tools to bring your ideas to life and create impactful experiences for our audience. Additionally, SBS provides ample opportunities for personal and professional growth, with ongoing learning and development programs designed to enhance your skills and advance your career. If you are seeking a dynamic and rewarding career in the world of Spanish-language broadcasting, SBS is the place to be. Join us and be part of a team that is making a difference in the lives of millions of people every day.

OVERVIEW OF THE COMPANY

Fox TV Stations

FOX Television Stations (FTS) owns and operates 29 full power broadcast television stations, including stations in 14 of the top 15 markets and duopolies in 11. Eighteen are FOX Network affiliates, and together the stations produce approximately 1,300 hours of local news every week. FOX LOCAL, the company's free ad-supported digital and streaming product, extends that news, weather and local content across connected TV & mobile devices. LiveNOW from FOX expands the FTS portfolio even further as the only national streaming services to be truly live 24/7, covering breaking news and events as they happen.

JOB DESCRIPTION

KTVU is seeking a News Photographer to work with a team of journalists covering stories in the Bay Area. Photographer will work with reporters to craft daily stories, execute live shots, provide pictures and video to digital teams and provide information to the assignment desk and producers. The ideal candidate will have a curiosity for their community and the world around them; be creative in developing unique and engaging content for our broadcast, streaming and digital platforms; and be competitive in creating the best coverage and challenging themselves to be different to continually elevate KTVU’s product.


Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Capture high-quality video footage for daily newscasts, special projects, and breaking news coverage.

  • Collaborate with reporters and producers to assemble cohesive news stories that meet station standards and deadlines.
  • Ensure edited content is accurate, engaging, and adheres to newsroom style and brand guidelines.
  • Manage and organize raw video files, archive footage, and edited content for future use.
  • Set up and operate live transmission equipment, including microwave, satellite, or cellular bonded systems (e.g., LiveU, TVU, etc).

  • Respond quickly to breaking news events and demonstrate flexibility in scheduling to meet newsroom needs.
  • Adhere to all newsroom safety protocols, especially during inclement weather and hazardous situations.
  • Maintain positive relationships with colleagues, reporters, and the community while representing the station professionally.
  • Stay updated on new technologies, industry trends, and best practices in news production.


What You’ll Bring:

  • Bachelor’s Degree preferred. Minimum of three years of professional News Camera experience is required or equivalent combination of education and experience. 
  • Candidates must have an excellent driving record. A professional level of skill in operation of ENG live trucks, ENG field cameras and field editing systems, including non-linear and associated photographic equipment is required.
  • Assignments may include out of market and overnight travel, and may involve early mornings, late evenings, weekends, and holidays to meet newsroom demands.
  • Other duties assigned as deemed appropriate and necessary.

We will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories consistent with applicable law.

This role is also eligible for various benefits, including medical/dental/vision, insurance, a 401(k) plan, paid time off, and other benefits in accordance with applicable plan documents. We are seeking a decisive, high-energy, and exceptionally organized Assignment News Editor to help lead evening news-gathering operations. The ideal candidate is a galvanizing leader who thrives in a fast-paced environment, possesses impeccable news judgment, and maintains a calm, collected demeanor under the intense pressure of breaking news. As the central nervous system of our newsroom, you will coordinate our field crews, monitor breaking developments, and collaborate across digital and broadcast platforms to ensure our coverage is fast, accurate, and impactful.

Duties/Key Responsibilities include (but are not limited to):

Editorial Leadership & News Judgment:
* Drive the Daily Agenda: Actively monitor scanner traffic, social media, wire services, public records, and viewer tips to identify compelling, original local stories.
* Daily Pitching & Collaboration: Attend daily editorial meetings and pitch story ideas for potential coverage.
* Decisive Prioritization: Exercise sharp, ethical news judgment to determine which stories merit coverage, dispatching crews efficiently to maximize impact.
* Galvanize the Team: Serve as an inspiring and motivating force in the newsroom, encouraging collaboration, high energy, and dedication to our community-first mission.

Operations & Breaking News Management:
* Strategic Logistics: Coordinate daily assignments, scheduling, and logistics for reporters, photographers, and multi-skilled journalists (MSJs).
* The Calm in the Storm: Maintain absolute composure and clear-headed decision-making during breaking news, guiding field crews safely and directing information flow with precision.
* Ability to Pivot: Adapt instantly as news conditions change, seamlessly shifting resources and re-prioritizing stories without losing organizational focus.
* Deadline Performance (A MUST): Demonstrate the ability to meet short deadlines, prioritize assignments, and handle multiple tasks simultaneously with a positive, can-do attitude.

Clear & Collaborative Communication:
* Cross-Platform Integration: Partner closely with Executive Producers, Digital/Streaming Leaders, and the Digital Team to ensure content is optimized for broadcast, web, and streaming platforms.
* Outside Relationship Building: Proactively build and maintain strong professional relationships with outside sources, including public information officers (PIOs), subject experts, and community leaders.
* Concise Dispatching: Deliver clear, brief, and actionable instructions to crews in the field and anchors in the studio.

Qualifications/Requirements:

Hard & Soft Skills:
* Experience: 2+ years of experience in a commercial newsroom (assignment desk, producing, or digital reporting preferred).
* Sharp News Judgment: Deep understanding of defamation laws, journalistic ethics, AP Style, and what makes a story impactful for local audiences.
* High-Volume Multitasking: Able to track multiple moving parts, crews, and short-term deadlines simultaneously under pressure.
* Calm & Collected: Possesses a naturally steady, reassuring presence that stabilizes the newsroom during high-stress breaking news cycles.
* Galvanizing Leadership Style: Known for rallying teams around a shared vision, mentoring emerging talent, and building a positive, collaborative newsroom culture.
* Exceptional Agility: High tolerance for ambiguity and a proven ability to pivot strategies in seconds when the situation demands.

job.description:
Under the FOX banner, we produce and distribute content through some of the world’s leading and most valued brands, including: FOX News Media, FOX Sports, FOX Entertainment, FOX Television Stations and Tubi Media Group. We empower a diverse range of creators to imagine and develop culturally significant content, while building an organization that thrives on creative ideas, operational expertise and strategic thinking.

We take a multiplatform approach spanning podcasting, video, FAST, and more, backed by our proprietary technology stack, including Supercast for subscriptions and Speakeasy for hosting, distribution, and monetization.

Named after Ted Williams’ longest home run at Fenway Park, Red Seat Ventures was built with a simple mandate: swing for the fences. Today, we are the fastest-growing creator network, backed by Tubi Media Group and Fox Corporation.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Red Seat Ventures is looking for a Manager, Podcast Marketing to lead cross-promotional campaigns across our portfolio of nearly 70 podcasts while building relationships with external shows, creators, and platforms. Reporting to the Senior Director, Podcast Marketing, you will own campaigns from initial planning and creative development through ad operations, measurement, and reporting. You will translate campaign performance into clear insights that help senior leaders understand what worked and what we should do next.

This position sits within a growing Audience Development function with established systems and active campaigns already in place. The work is currently hands-on and high-volume as we continue to improve and automate our processes. This is an opportunity for someone who enjoys owning complex systems, maintaining operational precision, and turning campaign data into a compelling and actionable story.

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Book and manage in-network and out-of-network cross-promotional campaigns, including launches for new shows and always-on promotional rotations
  • Own campaign execution details, including flight dates, frequency caps, audience targeting, creative trafficking, and delivery
  • Build and deliver weekly and monthly reports on net-new listeners, conversion, and retention for senior leadership
  • Develop clear performance narratives and recommendations based on campaign data
  • Maintain consistent campaign naming conventions across booking, hosting, and measurement platforms so promotional activity can be accurately matched to results
  • Research and pitch podcasts and YouTube channels for promotional swaps, collaborations, and client guest appearances
  • Manage scheduling and promotional materials, including biographies and headshots, in partnership with client teams, host-show contacts, and Creator Partnerships
  • Maintain the programming calendar for editorial pitches to Apple Podcasts, Spotify, Amazon Music, iHeart, and YouTube
  • Track upcoming show moments, platform requirements, and submission lead times to support timely and relevant editorial pitches
  • Help improve and automate campaign workflows, reporting processes, and other repetitive operational tasks

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • 3–5 years of experience in audience development, marketing operations, campaign management, or ad operations within podcasting, audio, or digital media
  • Hands-on experience booking campaigns in an enterprise podcast hosting and advertising platform
  • Advanced proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets, including experience using pivot tables and lookup functions to create clear reports from raw data exports
  • Familiarity with podcast measurement or attribution platforms such as Magellan AI, Podscribe, or Podtrac
  • Strong written communication skills and the confidence to present performance data, insights, and recommendations to senior stakeholders
  • Experience managing outreach or partnerships, including promotional swaps, guest bookings, creator collaborations, or platform relationships
  • Careful and consistent execution, with the judgment to identify incorrect date ranges, mismatched metrics, or other discrepancies before they reach a final report
  • Ability to manage multiple campaigns, deadlines, and stakeholder relationships in a fast-paced environment
  • A proactive approach to improving systems, solving operational challenges, and identifying opportunities for audience growth

NICE TO HAVE, BUT NOT A DEALBREAKER

  • Day-to-day experience working with podcast attribution tools such as Magellan AI, Podscribe, or Podtrac
  • Previous experience working within a podcast network
  • Listener fluency across podcast genres such as news, true crime, comedy, and sports
  • Working knowledge of SQL or light Python

job.title: Senior Systems Design Engineer
job.description:
Fox News Media is seeking an experienced Senior Systems Design Engineer to develop, maintain, and implement broadcast systems designs across our media facilities. This role will establish engineering standards, produce and review technical documentation, and ensure that system designs are accurately implemented in our in house NDOX documentation tool.

The ideal candidate has strong broadcast engineering experience, exceptional attention to detail, and the ability to translate operational requirements into clear, scalable, and supportable systems designs.

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Design broadcast systems for studios, control rooms, production spaces, technical facilities, and supporting infrastructure.
  • Define and maintain systems design standards, engineering guidelines, documentation requirements, drawing conventions, and design workflows.
  • Develop system architectures, signal-flow diagrams, block diagrams, equipment lists, rack elevations, wiring documentation, network requirements, and technical specifications.
  • Implement and maintain systems designs in NDOX, ensuring that design data, equipment information, system relationships, and documentation remain accurate and current.
  • Review engineering drawings, system designs, technical specifications, bills of materials, vendor submittals, and installation documentation for accuracy, completeness, and compliance with established standards.
  • Perform design reviews and provide technical feedback to engineering teams, vendors, contractors, and project stakeholders.
  • Ensure that approved designs are implemented consistently during installation, integration, testing, commissioning, and operational handoff.
  • Design and support baseband, IP, and hybrid broadcast systems using current industry practices and technologies.
  • Develop solutions incorporating SMPTE ST 2110, NMOS, PTP, multicast networking, routing, storage, monitoring, control, and facility infrastructure.
  • Collaborate with broadcast engineering, operations, IT, networking, facilities, and vendors to validate requirements and ensure system interoperability.
  • Evaluate proposed technologies and equipment for technical suitability, lifecycle support, scalability, reliability, and alignment with engineering standards.
  • Maintain accurate as-built documentation and update NDOX records following system modifications, upgrades, migrations, and commissioning activities.
  • Participate in system testing, troubleshooting, acceptance reviews, and post-implementation assessments.
  • Support continuous improvement of design processes, documentation quality, and system lifecycle management.

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Broadcast Engineering, or a related field.
  • At least five years of experience designing, integrating, or supporting complex broadcast, media, audiovisual, or technical infrastructure systems.
  • Strong knowledge of broadcast system architecture, signal flow, routing, synchronization, monitoring, control, and facility infrastructure.
  • Experience developing and reviewing detailed engineering documentation and technical drawings.
  • Experience defining or applying engineering standards, design criteria, documentation practices, and quality-control processes.
  • Experience working with systems databases, documentation platforms, or facilities engineering management tools; experience with NDOX is preferred.
  • Hands-on experience with IP-based broadcast technologies, including SMPTE ST 2110, NMOS, PTP, multicast, and networked media systems.
  • Experience designing baseband, IP, and hybrid broadcast environments.
  • Working knowledge of broadcast control systems, media asset management, storage, automation, monitoring, and cloud-based media workflows.
  • Proficiency with technical design and documentation tools such as AutoCAD, Visio, Lucidchart, or similar platforms.
  • Strong understanding of networking, VLANs, routing, switching, storage, cybersecurity principles, and system interoperability.
  • Experience reviewing vendor designs, submittals, installation drawings, test documentation, and as-built records.
  • Strong communication, collaboration, presentation, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Project coordination experience and PMP certification are preferred but not required.

  • Review work completed by staff members to ensure sufficient documentation, quality, and support for audit conclusions
  • Support the Internal Audit Vice President in periodic risk assessments and development of the annual audit plan
  • Draft, edit, and review audit reports, executive summaries, special project reports, and administrative communications
  • Develop the technical, management, and audit capabilities of IT Audit Managers and Staff through coaching, mentoring, and formal development activities

  • Partner with stakeholders to drive continuous improvement initiatives and strengthen risk management and control environments across the organization

  • Prior IT consulting, cybersecurity, technology risk, or technical operational experience is a plus
  • BS or MS in Information Systems, Accounting, Information Systems Auditing, Computer Science, or a related field required
  • Ability to work successfully with senior business and technology leaders and establish credibility across all levels of the organization
  • Demonstrated team management capabilities, with a track record of developing high-performing audit teams
  • Strong project management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and complex engagements simultaneously
  • Ability to understand the Company’s operational and technology environment, business objectives, key processes, and associated risks
  • Advanced knowledge of IT governance, cybersecurity, cloud security controls, infrastructure operations, application development and support, data privacy, and technology risk management practices
  • Experience applying IT and information security frameworks (e.g., NIST, SOX, COBIT) to audit testing and risk assessments
  • Strong comprehension of system development and implementation lifecycle methodologies and related controls
  • Experience auditing automated environments, enterprise applications, cloud technologies, and complex global security and compliance functions
  • Ability to influence stakeholders, build consensus, and drive successful outcomes in a matrixed organization through collaboration rather than direct authority
  • Proficiency with ERP systems, audit management tools, Microsoft Office applications, and collaboration platforms
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking capabilities
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to tailor messaging for executive audiences
  • Sound judgment, curiosity, and the ability to think strategically and creatively

job.title: Social Media Coordinator
job.description:
Social Media Coordinator

We’re looking for a creative and driven social media coordinator to join our growing advertising operations social media team at Hearst Newspapers. You’ll be focused on fulfilling content requests (often referred to as “sponsored” or “co-branded” posts) from our advertisers on 6+ publisher social profiles. Other key job responsibilities will include supporting paid and organic strategists with their current agency clients. This is a great role for fine-tuning both organic and paid social media skill sets, all while working with nationally recognized media brands and clients!

What You’ll Do

  • Own advertiser’s content request fulfillment process from start to finish. You will ensure that the advertising client has provided the necessary assets for post creation, write/edit the copy for the social post, modify links/visuals as needed, get editorial and client approval on the post, and publish the post on the publisher’s social profile.
  • This process also includes managing the boosting budget for these sponsored content. This includes building the target audience, properly pacing the budget spend, and being able to share reporting on results if requested.
  • You will also support the rest of the social media team with the agency clients. Requests include copywriting, organizing client content assets, and setting up paid social media audiences/campaign structures.
  • You may also manage several publisher’s promotional-focused social media profiles. This means reviewing and responding to comments and ensuring daily content (through manual posting or automated feed implementation).

What You Need

  • 1 year of proven experience in creating and executing social media content and proven paid campaign experience from start to end.
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in marketing, communications, advertising, or related field
  • Superior written and verbal communication skills, as well as the ability to effectively work with editorial teams
  • Experience with creating posts on Facebook, Instagram, and LinkedIn. Twitter and other social channels are a huge plus!
  • Experience using Facebook Ads Manager and other paid social media tools
  • Ability to perform light design work (typically in Canva)
  • Self-starter and quick to execute, brainstorm, and communicate with clients and sellers
  • Content marketing and SEO writing experience is a plus!
  •  

The estimated base salary for this role is $50,000 - $55,000. The actual base pay offered is dependent upon many factors, such as transferable skills, work experience, business needs, market demands and conditions, including geographic location where the work will be performed, and other factors permitted by law. 

This role requires the position to have an in-office presence of 3 days a week.

Our Benefits: At Hearst Newspapers we not only support our employees through personal and professional development, but we also believe in promoting each individual’s physical, financial and emotional wellbeing (and that of their family).  Our industry-leading benefits include:

With 2,500 employees across the nation, HNP represents a network of 24 daily and 52 weekly publications, including the San Francisco Chronicle, Houston Chronicle, San Antonio Express-News and Albany Times Union, several top digital-only news and lifestyle sites, marketing services businesses, and entertainment businesses such as King Features Syndicate. job.title: Staff Technical Program Manager
job.description:
Who We Are:

SiriusXM and its brands (Pandora, SiriusXM Media, AdsWizz, Simplecast, and SiriusXM Connect) are leading a new era of audio entertainment and services by delivering the most compelling subscription and ad-supported audio entertainment experience for listeners -- in the car, at home, and anywhere on the go with connected devices. Our vision is to shape the future of audio, where everyone can be effortlessly connected to the voices, stories and music they love wherever they are. 

 

This is the place where a diverse group of emerging talent and legends alike come to share authentic and purposeful songs, stories, sounds and insights through some of the best programming and technology in the world. Our critically-acclaimed, industry-leading audio entertainment encompasses music, sports, comedy, news, talk, live events, and podcasting. No matter their individual role, each of our employees plays a vital part in bringing SiriusXM’s vision to life every day. 

 

SiriusXM Media

SiriusXM Media is the gateway for marketers to the largest digital audio advertising ecosystem in North America, spanning owned and operated platforms, innovative ad tech solutions powered by AdsWizz, and an extended content network reaching more than 150 million listeners each month. 

 

AdsWizz

AdsWizz, a subsidiary of SiriusXM, is the leading global provider of digital audio and podcast advertising solutions, operating in over 40 countries and connecting buyers and sellers through dynamic ad insertion, advanced programmatic platforms, and innovative audio formats. 

 

How you’ll make an impact:

As a strategic and adaptable Staff Technical Program Manager, you will own the strategy and delivery of large-scale, cross-organizational initiatives across Ads Engineering. This role is critical to driving execution of high-impact programs spanning ad-serving systems, data platforms, monetization workflows, and cross-program integrations with Pandora and broader SiriusXM systems. 

 

This is a senior individual contributor role requiring deep architectural literacy, systems thinking, and the ability to define program strategy — not simply execute against it. You will partner directly with engineering and product leadership to shape multi-year roadmaps, co-own program strategy, streamline org-wide governance, and deliver outcomes that materially impact platform scalability, monetization performance, and global platform capabilities to deliver outcomes that make an unmistakable enterprise-level impact across: scalability targets, RTB latency/SLA, fill rate, yield/monetization lift, reliability, and global rollout readiness. This includes leading multi-year, cross-functional programs such as global ad-serving modernization, real-time bidding (RTB) latency/scale programs, and technical consolidation across the Pandora and SiriusXM ad technology stacks.

 

What you’ll do:

Enterprise Program Strategy & Delivery

  • Establish and own the strategy and end-to-end delivery of large, cross-organizational Ads Engineering initiatives (eg: broadcast ads digitization and modernization, ad insertion, consolidation across SiriusXM and Pandora tech stacks), from intake through launch.
  • Function as Workstream lead for select cross-organizational initiatives spanning multiple engineering teams - from planning through launch.
  • Maintain roadmap and delivery commitments for multiple teams within the Ad Technology organization, aligning Product, Engineering and GTM on execution plans, ROIs and outcomes (e.g., latency/SLAs, yield/monetization lift, reliability, rollout readiness).
  • Coordinate program structure, milestones, sequencing, interdependencies, and success metrics in close partnership with engineering and product leadership. 
  • Proactively identify, forecast, and mitigate delivery risks and issues, communicating mitigation plans and status clearly to stakeholders.
  • Use data to drive sustainable planning and transparent tradeoff discussions for new work or conflicting priorities.
  • Provide portfolio-level visibility and structured analysis to advise on prioritization and resource allocation decisions.
  • Drive high-stakes tradeoff decisions (scope, sequencing, resourcing, risk) with Director/VP level engineering and product leadership and be directly accountable for program-level outcomes and delivery across multiple teams.

Technical Leadership & Systems Thinking

  • Apply proficient architectural literacy across ad-serving, real-time bidding, data pipelines, monetization platforms, and distributed infrastructure.
  • Guide teams toward scalable, aligned technical solutions by deeply understanding platform constraints and cross-program tradeoffs.
  • Review system designs, challenge assumptions, and proactively solve downstream impacts across tightly coupled Ads and platform integrations.
  • Manage capacity, risks, technical debt, velocity, and operational readiness.
  • Anticipate long-term platform risks and scalability constraints, including across globally distributed systems.
  • Serve as the go-to Technical Program Manager and subject matter expert for complex cross-program integrations, major platform constraints, and critical cross-domain dependency resolution.

Roadmap Alignment & Program Strategy

  • Influence roadmap alignment across Ads, Pandora, and related programs.
  • Own program-level strategy across multiple teams, including dependency mapping, sequencing, and integration planning for complex, ambiguous initiatives where outcomes and constraints evolve.
  • Co-own Ads Technology program strategy, shaping roadmap prioritization based on business impact, technical feasibility, and cross-program dependencies.
  • Advocate for program(s) health and long-term strategy.

Organizational Effectiveness & Governance

  • Define and institutionalize Ads TPM org-wide program governance standards, operating models, and best practices, elevating execution rigor across the entire Ads Engineering organization.
  • Mentor and uplevel other TPMs, and cross-functional partners by creating playbooks, templates, and coaching that improve execution quality beyond your immediate scope.
  • Continuously improve governance and delivery processes to increase predictability, execution quality, and program health over time.
  • Establish and facilitate team-level ceremonies including daily standups, sprint planning, backlog refinement, retrospectives, and/or other meetings needed to ensure smooth execution and team alignment.
  • Partner with TPM leadership to run program level ceremonies like intake and refinement if required.
  • Define, instrument, and socialize delivery and operational health metrics (e.g., predictability, cycle time, throughput, readiness, and post-launch outcomes) to drive transparent decision-making and continuous improvement.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Executive Communication

  • Build formal cross-functional networks across Product, Engineering, Data, Infrastructure, and partner programs to drive alignment and coordinated execution; influence roadmap and investment tradeoffs with senior leadership.
  • Serve as the connective layer between Engineering, Product, Quality, Operations, and external stakeholders.
  • Present clear, scenario-based decision paths to engineering and business leadership, driving consensus through clarity.
  • Resolve conflict and maintain alignment across directors, tech leads, and cross-functional partners with authority and credibility.

 

What you’ll need:

  • Typically requires a minimum of 7 years of related experience with a Bachelor’s degree; or 5 years and a Master’s degree; or a PhD with 4 years experience; or equivalent experience, leading complex, enterprise-scale initiatives.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent work experience.
  • Demonstrated experience owning Enterprise program strategy — including multi-year roadmap partnership, portfolio-level decision support, and org-wide process improvement — not just execution.
  • Significant experience in advertising technology, including ad-serving systems, real-time bidding, monetization platforms, data pipelines, and analytics systems.
  • Proficient architectural literacy across multiple platform programs; ability to guide teams toward scalable solutions and evaluate cross-program constraints and tradeoffs.
  • Executive-level communication skills; ability to craft scenario-based decision paths for senior engineering and business leadership and drive consensus through clarity.
  • Proven ability to drive delivery across tightly coupled, interdependent systems at scale. 
  • Demonstrated ability to operate with minimal oversight across ambiguous, high-stakes programs.
  • Experience working across multiple Agile methodologies; proficiency with Jira and related program management tooling.
  • Experience with automation and/or AI tools such as chatGPT, Gemini, etc.
  • Strong propensity toward relationship building and influencing without authority.
  • Experience in digital audio or media platforms preferred.
  • Experience managing vendor or third-party technology integrations, including global or multi-region platforms preferred.
  • Experience in high-availability, real-time systems environments preferred.
  • Experience leading platform transformation or cross-organizational consolidation programs preferred.
  • Must have legal right to work in the U.S.
     

At SiriusXM, we carefully consider a wide range of factors when determining compensation, including your background and experience. These considerations can cause your compensation to vary. We expect the base salary for this position to be in the range of $105,000 to $180,000 and will depend on your skills, qualifications, and experience. Additionally, this role might be eligible for discretionary short-term and long-term incentives. We encourage all interested candidates to apply.

About the Role, Mission or Department Overview

The Senior Engineer, Cybersecurity is a hands-on contributor who designs, builds, and operates security controls and services that protect The Times' systems, data, and users. As a member of the Security Architecture team, you will own complex initiatives end-to-end, drive measurable risk reduction, and collaborate across product engineering and enterprise technology with technical depth, operational rigor, and clear communication aligned with business outcomes.

Who are we?

Cybersecurity helps prevent The Times from becoming news. Our teams work to protect the news makers, their support staff, the platforms they rely on every day, as well as all of The Times' products and services, and our readers who consume them.

This role reports to the Director of Engineering, Cybersecurity.

Responsibilities:

  • Create an environment that favors context, not control. Empower product engineers and ensure they have the relevant information and tools to deliver secure products and services.
  • Design, implement, and operate security controls and services (e.g., identity and access management, secrets management, endpoint/agent hardening, network segmentation, detection, and response automation) that meet reliability, security, scalability, and observability standards.
  • Partner with product and platform teams to integrate security into architecture and developer workflows while articulating business impact and tradeoffs.
  • Perform security reviews, threat modeling, and risk assessments (code, design, 3rd-party apps).
  • Investigate and resolve urgent and/or complex security issues, triaging effectively and driving architectural changes that prevent recurrence.
  • Participate via RFCs, community of practices, and other internal knowledge sharing channels to share learnings, align on standards, and influence secure patterns across areas; model The Times' core values in cross-functional collaboration.
  • Support team growth through peer design/code review, pairing, and clear feedback; on security engineering practices across the department.

job.title: Executive Producer
job.description:
Who We Are

Translation is a well-established independent agency and thriving music business, built to help ambitious brands harness the power of culture to solve their biggest challenges. As a unique mix of experts in culture, technology, and storytelling, we are united by a passion to grow brands in ways that advertising alone can never do. 

We are an entrepreneurial business – not a traditional “ad agency.” That means we value resourcefulness and tenacity just as much as we value creativity and intelligence. We’re unapologetically ambitious, but we’re also a tight-knit crew. 

We are looking for an Executive Producer to join Translation!

What You'll Do

  • Produce great work. 
  • Serve as the production lead for a major account, owning the vision, quality, and health of the work from first idea to final delivery.
  • Responsible for all aspects of the production process from concept development through job wrap on specific accounts, including management of other producers, internal teams, outside vendors and clients.
  • Produce various types of large, complex jobs as well as quick turn assignments, on time and on budget. 
  • Develop good working relationships with other account leads, clients, and 3rd party client vendors (i.e. procurement groups, media agencies, PR firms, etc)
  • Manage, mentor and grow the producers working on your account and delegate assignments based on project needs.
  • Work closely with account leads on upcoming projects to vet ideas while bringing production solutions to the table to accomplish the creative vision and get to the best work possible.
  • Set up processes and ways of working to ensure production on your accounts runs smoothly.
  • Attends shoots and post sessions to ensure the creative output is at its highest quality.
  • Follow financial and job wrap policies of the production department, client and agency.
  • Seek opportunities for underrepresented creators both in the agency and within the industry. 

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • Have an outstanding creative sensibility with a proven track record of producing industry leading work.
  • Existing relationships with best in class industry partners plus a network of talent to consider and recommend for freelance / specialty consulting needs when required.
  • A track record of gaining the trust and respect of clients, internal teams and industry partners. 
  • A passion for mentoring junior production staff.
  • The ability to work under pressure with flexibility, agility, and a good sense of humor.
  • Well versed in managing budgets and deadlines of all types with accuracy and diplomacy.
  • Superb problem solving, organizational, and communications skills.
  • Demonstrate, evangelize and live the core values of the agency.
  • Incorporate the passion, excitement and experience of one’s MINOR in relevant ways that inform the quality and output of the company.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 10+ years of production experience at a creative driven company.
  • Experience running accounts and/or managing key pieces of business through large campaign work where you were the client facing production lead.
  • After hours work and overnight travel to shoots and post sessions required.                                                                           

Preferred Qualifications

  • A portfolio of work showing large and small budget productions for various media.
  • Experience as a production lead on pharma business.
  • Experience working with celebrities, athletes, musicians, influencers, etc. 
  • Experience with union and non-union crew productions, including both SAG and non-SAG talent. 
  • Passion and knowledge of latest industry trends (music, media, distribution, directors, film, tech, etc).

About UnitedMasters 

UnitedMasters has over 1.5 million artists on its platform and is growing rapidly. Brands like Diageo, Ally, and ESPN come to UnitedMasters to partner with these artists and play a role in moving culture forward. In the past year, UnitedMasters subscribers have grown rapidly. With $170M raised to date and valued at $550M, UnitedMasters is backed by Andreessen Horowitz, Apple, Alphabet (aka Google), and Disney amongst others. Over the last year, UnitedMasters artists have used our platform to land sync deals with major brands including the NBA, ESPN, Overtime Elite, Bose, Warner Brother Studios and in the NBA video game 2k. These deals give them additional money for their work and increase their exposure.

Salary Hiring Range: $156,000-$184,000

Our salary ranges are based on paying competitively for our size and industry, and are one part of many compensation, benefits and other reward opportunities we provide (e.g. in some cases that may include bonus, stock options, 401k match).

Individual pay rate decisions are based on a number of factors, including qualifications for the role, experience level, skillset, and balancing internal equity relative to peers at the company.  We expect the majority of the candidates who are offered roles at our company to fall healthily throughout the range based on these factors. 

The range above is for the expectations as laid out in the job description, however we are often open to a wide variety of profiles, and recognize that the person we hire may be less experienced (or more senior) than this job description as posted.  If that ends up being the case, the updated salary range will be communicated with you as a candidate.

The salary range above is for NY/CA.  As a company, we have a location based strategy, which means the salary range could be lower or higher than this if the role is hired in another location.

In this role, you will build SoundCloud's growth operating system, own the end-to-end customer journey strategy, and lead performance, lifecycle, and organic growth channel strategy, while ensuring our platform remains discoverable in a world increasingly shaped by AI-powered search and recommendation engines. Reporting to the Chief Growth & Marketing Officer, you will be ultimately responsible for how users discover, engage with, subscribe to, and advocate for SoundCloud,  maximizing long-term customer value across our entire ecosystem.

  • Own the overarching performance strategy for acquisition, lifecycle marketing, paid media, and conversion optimization, while expanding emerging discovery channels including SEO, AI search, AEO, App Store Optimization, and growth loops

job.description:
At Corus Entertainment, we’re shaping the future of media in Canada—home to the country’s biggest hits, most trusted news, and greatest value. Our mission is simple: to create engaging content, connect with audiences wherever they are, and drive meaningful growth.

Guided by our values—Think Boldly, Make a Positive Impact, Win as a Team, and Own the Outcome—we bring creativity and collaboration to everything we do.

If you’re ready to make an impact, there’s a place for you at Corus.

Division: Programming & Multi-platform

Work Status: Full-time

Location: Toronto, Ontario (Hybrid)

About the Role

We are looking for a highly organized and detail-oriented Multi-platform Content Scheduler to support the scheduling and operational management of content across our on-demand and FAST channel platforms.

Reporting to the Supervisor, Multi-platform Content, this role is responsible for building and maintaining content schedules, ensuring content availability aligns with programming priorities and rights windows, supporting platform quality control, and coordinating content updates across internal and external partners.

This is an ideal opportunity for someone with an interest in streaming, television operations, and digital content management who enjoys working with schedules, systems, and data in a fast-paced environment.

You will contribute by:

• VOD Content Scheduling

• Create and maintain weekly VOD schedules across streaming platforms.

• Ensure content availability aligns with linear schedules and approved rights windows.

• Issue metadata updates, program adjustments, and takedown notices as required.

• Coordinate content availability changes with internal stakeholders and distribution partners.

• Monitor scheduled content and resolve scheduling discrepancies.

• FAST Channel Scheduling

• Build and maintain weekly schedules for FAST channels.

• Manage content rotations, collections, and channel lineups.

• Support long-range planning of channel schedules and content inventories.

• Make schedule adjustments based on programming priorities and operational requirements.

• Monitor channel presentation and ensure schedules are executed accurately.

• Content Operations & Quality Control

• Conduct routine QC checks across VOD and FAST platforms.

• Verify metadata accuracy, episode sequencing, rights availability, and platform presentation.

• Track the availability of newly delivered content and ensure timely scheduling.

• Troubleshoot scheduling and content issues and escalate where necessary.

• Assist with merchandising across platforms as needed

• Partner & Stakeholder Coordination

• Work with internal and external partners, including BDUs, platform partners, and vendors, on operational scheduling, distributing lookback grids, and content delivery matters.

• Support launches of new content, channels, and promotional initiatives.

Skills and experience you will bring:

• 1 to 3 years of experience in television, digital media, streaming, scheduling, media operations, or content management.

• Strong attention to detail and time management skills.

• Experience working with large datasets and scheduling systems.

• Strong Excel skills.

• Excellent communication and coordination abilities.

• Ability to troubleshoot issues and manage competing priorities.

• Experience with VMS, CMS, ARI, or similar content management systems.

• Knowledge of content rights and windowing.

• Experience with FAST channels, streaming platforms, or broadcast scheduling.

• Passion for television and digital content.

Are you tired of just watching from the sidelines? Ready to stop "shadowing" and start actually doing the work that reaches thousands of people every single day? We’re looking for the next generation of media powerhouses, producers, reporters, weather experts, and sales executives who are hungry to dive head-first into the fast-paced world of local media. This isn't your typical "get the coffee" internship. The Gray Media Training Program is a high-octane, 10-week immersive experience where you don’t just learn the job; you own it. Whether you’re crafting the lead story for the evening news, tracking a cold front on our weather tech, or closing a digital ad deal, you’ll be a vital part of our award -winning team from day one.

What You’ll Do:

  • Own the role: Step into the shoes of a producer, MMJ, Meteorologist, or Media Sales executive and handle real-world assignments (yes, the kind that may go on air and online). 
  • Drive digital engagement: Create content that lives beyond the TV screen; think social media, streaming apps, and web stories—because we’re digital-first, always.
  • Collaborate with pros: Work side-by-side with seasoned veterans who are the best in the business, gaining insights you won’t find in any textbook.
  • Commit to the craft: Dedicate 25 hours per week for 10 weeks to mastering your specialty and building a professional-grade portfolio.
  • Make an impact: Tell stories that matter to the community or help local businesses grow through innovative media strategies. 
  • Build your future: Position yourself at the front of the line for full-time career opportunities within Gray Media’s network of 113 stations.

What You Bring:

  • Current enrollment: You’re a college student (Junior or Senior status preferred) chasing a degree in Journalism, Communications, Sales, Marketing, or a related field.
  • A "doer" mindset: You aren't afraid to get your hands dirty and take initiative; you’re here to work, not just watch.
  • Digital savvy: You understand that media happens everywhere, from the big screen to the palm of someone’s hand.
  • Strong work ethic: You bring urgency, organization, and a "can-do" attitude to every shift.
  • Communication skills: You can tell a story, pitch an idea, or explain a forecast with clarity and confidence.
  • Reliability: You’re ready to commit to the full 10-week program and the 25-hour weekly schedule.
  • Passion for local: You care about the community and want to see how local media makes a real difference.

Why You’ll Love It Here:

  • Real-world experience: You’ll graduate with more than just a line on your resume; you’ll have the experience of having done the job.
  • Unprecedented access: With 113 stations across the U.S., you’re part of a massive, innovative network that’s leading the future of media.
  • Career fast-track: We love hiring our own. This program is designed to be the ultimate audition for your first full-time role with Gray.
  • Paid training: Earn while you learn. This is a paid internship. 
  • A culture of innovation: We’re evolving on purpose, and you’ll be right there on the front lines of that evolution.

    Qualifications/Requirements:

          • Be currently enrolled in a college/university, preferably in your senior year.
          • Strong work ethic and organizational skills.
          • Earning a degree in Broadcast Journalism/Communications, or related fields, with a desire to get hands-on experience in the local media industry.

    • Marketing
    • Creative Services
    • Sports
    • Weather
    • News Production

job.title: Sales and Marketing Specialist - Business Development
job.description:
This Job Description May Cause Extreme Excitement and Career Growth 

At AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions, we believe a great workplace isn't just something we say — it's something you can feel when you join the team. Here, it's all about great collabs, ambition, and results but most importantly, we grow here, and we enjoy here.  We're searching for that special someone — a driven, talented individual to join our innovative media sales team. In this role, you'll engage with new clients and show them how our innovative media solutions can amplify their brands and deliver measurable success. If you're energized by building relationships, closing deals, and making an impact, we'd love to hear from you. 

 

Sound like the right fit? Check out the checklist below and if it sounds like you, hit "Apply Now" and let's chat. 

 

Your Day-to-Day (aka the Playbook) 

Help Brands Thrive: 

Join our media sales team and play a pivotal role in helping brands and companies grow. By identifying new opportunities, building strong client relationships, and delivering impactful solutions, you'll showcase how our multi-media content platforms and digital assets can drive meaningful results for our partners. 

 

Your focus will be on helping clients achieve their goals, ensuring that every campaign is a success. When our clients win, we win—and we believe in celebrating those victories together! 

  

Make Connections: Embrace your powers of persuasion and make every handshake and meeting count! Every interaction is a chance to build a genuine connection and show clients how we can help them succeed. You're not just selling; you're building partnerships and long-lasting relationships. You're helping businesses find the right audience in the right place at the right time. When we say One Partner, Endless Possibilities, we mean it! 

 

Be A Trusted Guide: In this role, you'll connect with clients on a human level, understand their unique needs, and craft tailored sales and marketing solutions that deliver results. As their trusted advisor, you'll help them navigate the ever-evolving marketing landscape, ensuring every step of the journey is planned with care and precision.  

 

Shake Things Up: Bring your creativity and fresh ideas to the table! We're looking for someone who challenges the status quo, embraces innovation, and finds new ways to connect with our audience. Your contributions will help elevate our brand and drive meaningful results for your clients.  

 

Join us and Conquer the Media Landscape: You'll be part of a dedicated team of A1 media sales professionals, committed to achieving market leadership. Together, we amplify our impact, deliver exceptional outcomes, and help our clients succeed in ways that truly matter. 

 

Identify Emerging Opportunities: It's about being able to see what others can't, anticipating market shifts, analyzing data and predicting the next big thing. Your insights will position our clients and AMP for long-term success.  

  

What We're Looking For 

Proven Sales Ability and an Unstoppable Desire to Learn

You're a seasoned sales professional and we value your drive, energy, and passion for achieving results. 

 

Strong Communication Skills: You're a natural at building relationships and communicating effectively. Proficiency with digital tools and applications is a must. 

 

A Passion for helping Others: You're committed to understanding clients' needs, providing top-notch customer service and making a difference. You're not just selling a product; you're providing a solution.  

 

A Competitive Spirit: Do you get a little boost when you achieve a goal (especially if it was a tough one)? We love that for you (and us)!  We want someone who's driven to excel but also knows how to celebrate the victories (big and small) with their team. That drive makes you a valuable part of our organization.  

 

A Willingness to Grow: Do you thrive in environments where you're always learning something new? Excellent, you'll fit right in! The media world is constantly evolving, and the ability to learn, adapt, and embrace challenges in a fast-paced, digital-first environment is key.  

 

The Practical Stuff 

A valid driver's license, up-to-date insurance, and reliable transportation are necessary for connecting with clients in your community. 

 

Why Join AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions? / The Reasons You Should Hit "Apply Now" 

 

Serious Work, Seriously Cool People: Be part of a dynamic team that values creativity, collaboration, and fun! We are all for work that is rewarding.  

 

The Compensation Package: We offer a base salary, commission structure, and benefits package designed to support your success and well-being. Happy employees don't stage rebellions! ;) 

 

We Make a Real Difference (Not Just Talk About It): At AMP, we help local businesses thrive through advertising strategies that create tangible impacts. Our media sales specialist isn't just selling ads; they're the boots on the ground, making a real difference where it counts. (And yes, it feels pretty good.) 

 

Top-Notch Training and Support: We're not the kind of company that hires you and then disappears into the corporate abyss. We carefully select candidates for a cohort-based training program, where you'll join a group of sales professionals from all over the country. From onboarding to ongoing mentorship, we invest in your success with training programs that set you up for long-term growth. 

 

Career Growth Opportunities: We believe in investing in you. That's why you'll have access to training, mentorship, and career advancement opportunities to help you thrive. We are a leader in our industry, flexing our local charm and national muscle, providing you with options to amplify your career in your local market or join one of our AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions teams in another city.  

 

Comprehensive Media Education (We Are Your Power Source!): New to the industry? We've got you covered with training programs that turn curiosity into expertise.   

 

AMP is us. It's you. It isn't just a name; it's a mission. A promise to amplify our reach, amplify our innovation, and most importantly, amplify you. If you're ready to grow your career and help businesses achieve their goals, we'd love to hear from you.

Position Title: Manager, Membership Growth

I. Position Summary:

Manager of Membership Growth to help launch and scale a new digital membership product. This role will focus on converting a broad fan audience and large and growing waitlist into a paid membership base. The ideal candidate can build lifecycle campaigns, segment audiences, test messaging and offers, analyze performance, and coordinate cross-functionally to drive membership growth. This is primarily an owned-channel growth role, rather than a paid media role. Previous experience in subscription, membership, ecommerce, loyalty, ticketing, sports, media, entertainment, or consumer products is a plus. 2–5 years of relevant experience preferred, but open based on fit.

II. Core Responsibilities:

  • Own paid member growth for the digital membership product, with responsibility for converting waitlist users and owned fan audiences into new paid members

  • Build and manage lifecycle campaigns across email, SMS, web, app, landing pages, and other owned channels to support launch and ongoing membership growth

  • Partner with CRM and Data teams to segment audiences based on fan behavior, engagement, purchase history, geography, event interest, and stated preferences

  • Support launch planning and execution, including campaign calendars, audience sequencing, and testing plans

  • A/B test and optimize campaign messaging, subject lines, CTAs, offers, timing, landing pages, and conversion flows

  • Work closely with Product to identify and improve key funnel moments from waitlist sign-up to paid membership conversion

  • Collaborate with Creative and Marketing teams to develop campaign assets that clearly communicate membership benefits and drive action

  • Coordinate with Ticketing, Ecommerce, Social, Content, and CRM teams to maximize owned-channel promotion and conversion opportunities across digital touchpoints

  • Partner with Events, Marketing, and on-site teams to plan and execute live event activations that drive waitlist growth, paid member sign-ups, and fan engagement

  • Track funnel performance and prepare weekly readouts covering waitlist growth, email engagement, click-through rate, landing page conversion, checkout completion, paid member conversion, revenue, retention, key learnings, and next steps

  • Help establish repeatable growth processes for future membership campaigns, renewals, benefit drops, event pushes, and seasonal moments

We’re looking for a Senior Producer for an overnight shift on a dynamic morning show who thrives in live news, leads with clarity in the control room, and elevates every segment with sharp editorial judgment and strong production instincts. This is a hands-on leadership role — guiding a team of Segment Producers, Associate Producers, and Production Assistants while partnering closely with the Executive Producer and Anchors to shape daily coverage.

If you’re energized by building a show from the ground up, confident making high-stakes decisions under pressure, and committed to mentoring journalists, this is an opportunity to have real impact every day.

What You’ll Do:

  • Partner with the Executive Producer, Senior Producer and Anchors to shape the daily editorial vision and build smart, urgent shows finding the best and freshest possible angles
  • Oversee and elevate scripts, intros, teases, and banners to ensure clarity, authority, and consistency
  • Guide Segment Producers, ensuring segments are visually strong and editorially sharp
  • Play a key leadership role in the control room during live broadcasts, especially during breaking news
  • Ensure all scripts, graphics, and video meet NBC News standards for accuracy, fairness, and tone
  • Collaborate with colleagues across NBC to leverage reporting, bureaus, and enterprise coverage
  • Submit ideas for story coverage, guests and correspondents on stories breaking overnight
  • Spot and execute on high potential stories
  • Fill in for Executive Producer as needed
  • Oversee the long-term and day to day staffing schedule & assignments to make sure the team’s resources are being effectively used
  • Help troubleshoot technical problems in real time
  • Oversee the production, writing, and editing of occasional tape spots
  • Mentor and develop junior producers, fostering a culture of excellent journalism, dynamic producing, collaboration, and accountability
  • 6+ years of experience in broadcast, cable, or streaming news. Morning TV experience a plus.
  • At least 2+ years in a leadership role on a live daily news program
  • Fact-check under pressure, ensure strict adherence to journalistic standards, and handle copyright or legal & standards issues
  • Demonstrated experience leading in or closely alongside a live control room
  • Excellent and efficient writing, editing, and copy-editing skills
  • Strong editorial judgment and ability to make decisions quickly under pressure
  • Proven ability to manage multiple segments and priorities simultaneously
  • Confident, calm leader who communicates clearly in a breaking news situation in person and via Slack
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience
  • Must be willing and able to work in person Monday–Friday at 30 Rock

Desired Characteristics:

  • A journalist first, with deep knowledge of national and breaking news
  • Strong visual sensibility and commitment to elevated production values
  • Experience editing video in Avid and/or Premiere
  • Willing and able to mentor and grow junior members of the team
  • A positive and infectious attitude
  • Collaborative and solutions-oriented in a fast-paced environment
  • A demonstrated commitment to building a long-term career in journalism

Additional Requirements:

  • Required On-Site: This position is required to be performed full-time from NBCUniversal’s 30 Rockefeller Plaza office in New York, NY, five days per week. This is an overnight shift that starts at 1am

Focus on implementing minor enhancements or process changes to prevent future issues.  Manage the end-to-end response to major incidents impacting Legal business processes.  Manage RCA sessions and ensure timely executive – level communications.  Reduce “noise” in the system by analyzing ticket trends and automating routine fixes.

The Manager, Retail Development, Products & Experiences is in charge of executing retail and e-commerce strategies that drive sell-in of licensed merchandise across key retail partners. This role manages day-to-day relationships with Amazon, Costco and additionally coordinates all Canadian retailers.   This is an onsite position at our Los Angeles office.

  • Manage relationships with retail partners (Primarily Canadian retailers, Amazon and Costco) and licensees to drive sell-in and sell-through of licensed products across all major product categories including Toys, Sporting Goods, Apparel, Home, Accessories, Food & Beverage and Essentials & Beauty.

  • Be the account and retail expert across categories
  • Contribute to overall account long term planning and strategy
  • Monitor online detail-page content, search performance, and in-club retail performance to identify opportunities to increase sales and distribution
  • Partner with licensing category teams to support product launches and retail activations in partnership with licensees

  • Analyze sales data, market trends, and competitive activity across e-commerce and club channels
  • Collaborate with internal teams (marketing, category, franchise) to support campaigns

  • 5+ years of experience in retail, e-commerce, licensing, consumer products, or business development
  • Bachelor's degree

 

Additional Qualifications:

  • Solid written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to work individually with solid organizational skills, attention to detail and follow-up
  • Experience working with licensed brands or retail partnerships preferred

Strategic Marketing Lead Texas

Overview
The Marketing Lead is the primary strategic partner to the Regional Marketing Director in Texas (RMD) and drives marketing execution across the full ecosystem of centralized capabilities: Production, Paid Media, Social, CRM and Lifecycle. This role translates strategy into integrated campaign plans, owns the campaign calendar, and is the day-to-day marketing contact for station leadership across the portfolio.

This person excels at navigating complexity, building stakeholder trust, and leading integrated work across multiple teams and markets.

Strategic & Campaign Leadership
•    Develop the campaign brief for each initiative — translating RMD strategy into an integrated plan with clear objectives, target audiences, key messages, channel mix and success metrics — and submit to the RMD for approval before execution begins.
•    Own the regional campaign calendar and integrated delivery timeline; ensure all campaigns are planned, resourced and launched on time and to spec.
•    Lead campaign development and execution, coordinating across Production, Paid, Social, CRM, Lifecycle and other centralized capabilities.
•    Direct Marketing Specialist to initiate campaign setup in monday.com; confirm boards are complete with the right assignments, timelines and deliverables.
•    Collaborate with Production through the creative development process — bring the audience, brand, and business context to concept development and scripting.
•    Hold creative and strategic standards across all campaign deliverables; ensure every asset is on-brand, on-message, and built to perform.
•    Drive clarity and prioritization across a complex portfolio of concurrent campaigns; make informed trade-offs and escalate strategic conflicts to the RMD as needed.

Station Partnership & Communications
•    Serve as the day-to-day marketing partner to station general managers, news directors and content leaders across the region.
•    Communicate campaign plans, status, and results clearly to station stakeholders; manage expectations, align on priorities and surface issues early.
•    Maintain the continuity and market context that allow centralized teams to move fast and with credibility in each market.

Campaign Performance & Team Development
•    Establish measurement frameworks for campaigns; track and report performance against objectives for the RMD and station leadership.
•    Apply audience data, ratings, digital analytics and market feedback to sharpen campaign strategy; translate performance patterns into recommendations that improve future planning and strengthen the team's overall approach.
•    Model campaign management discipline, strategic thinking and stakeholder communications; raise the overall capability and consistency of the marketing team.

Requirements:
•    5–7 years in marketing, integrated campaign management or brand strategy — media, broadcast or a fast-moving content environment strongly preferred.
