job.title: B2B Engagement Marketing Lead
job.description:
Join the future of news

We’re on a mission to deliver riveting storytelling for all of America. At The Washington Post, you’ll help reinvent news. Our work is driven by a deep investigative spirit and enhanced by innovation to bring audiences closer to the stories that matter most.


About Our Team


The Washington Post is powered by the passion and talent of our people. It takes all of us to reinvent news. Beyond our award-winning News and Opinions teams, we work across many departments, including Brand & Events, Communications, Customer Care, Engineering & Product, Finance, Human Resources, Legal, Marketing & Advertising, Print Operations, and Sales.


Why This Role Matters

 

The Washington Post is one of the most influential newsrooms in the world, and our subscriber base is growing to match. This role sits at the center of that growth responsible for how enterprise clients and professional product subscribers experience The Post after they sign up. WP Intelligence is our professional intelligence product line, delivering curated reporting, data, and analysis for decision-makers across industries. As the Engagement Marketing Lead for Enterprise and WP Intelligence, you will own the subscriber journey from activation through renewal designing omnichannel programs that help organizations and professionals get lasting value from their subscriptions.

Reporting to the Director of Engagement and Retention, you will partner closely with Enterprise Sales and Account Management, WP Intelligence Editorial, Product, Engineering, Analytics, Finance, and Brand Marketing to build and execute strategies that drive measurable engagement and long-term retention.

Why This Role Matters

  • You support The Post’s mission to deliver world-class journalism while expanding reach and influence

  • You drive data-informed marketing strategies that improve activation, usage, and long-term retention

  • You thrive in collaborative environments that value initiative, clarity, and continuous improvement

  • You enjoy leading fast-paced, cross-platform programs that enhance subscriber experience and fuel business growth

How You'll Support the Mission

Lifecycle Strategy

  • Develop and execute full-funnel lifecycle programs that increase usage and deepen engagement across app, site, newsletters, and subscription benefits for enterprise and professional product subscribers.

  • Build subscriber journeys spanning lead progression, account activation, onboarding, education, loyalty, and renewal maintaining playbooks that support scalable, repeatable execution.

  • Design approaches that serve multiple audiences within a single account, including corporate and higher education end users, students, and key decision-makers.

  • Identify and promote product features, upsell, and cross-sell opportunities that drive long-term value and contract renewal.

  • Partner with Brand, Product, Engineering, and Editorial to align lifecycle initiatives with broader business goals and the group customer experience.

Performance and Experimentation

  • Monitor engagement trends, feature adoption, and lifecycle performance using dashboards and core KPIs.

  • Translate subscriber behavior into insights that guide strategy and experimentation.

  • Run A/B and multivariate tests to refine segmentation, messaging, channel sequencing, and timing.

  • Identify friction points in the subscriber experience and collaborate cross-functionally to improve activation, engagement, and renewal rates.

  • Partner with Analytics and Data Engineering to refine audience definitions, data inputs, and targeting models.

Execution and Operations

  • Design and manage integrated engagement campaigns across email, onsite surfaces, in-app messages, and push notifications.

  • Develop clear creative and technical briefs that guide asset production; lead QA and auditing to uphold accuracy across all touchpoints.

  • Document processes and improve operational workflows to support scalable delivery.

  • Use subscriber signals and feedback gathered in partnership with Enterprise Sales, Account Management, and Support — to inform proactive engagement strategies and feature improvements.

The Skills and Experience You Bring

  • 6-8 years of experience in digital, growth, EdTech, or subscription marketing with deep expertise in customer engagement, activation, or habit formation across diverse audiences.

  • Experience working with B2B customers and partnering with internal Sales teams.

  • Hands-on experience with Marketing Technology platforms like Iterable, and familiarity with customer data systems and e-commerce platforms.

  • Proficiency with analytics tools such as Tableau, Looker, and Google Analytics; strong ability to evaluate performance and translate testing outcomes into decisions.

  • Excellent communication and project management skills, with a track record of influencing cross-functional partners and driving clarity in complex environments.

 

Collaboration makes us stronger. That’s why our offices are designed with open layouts, modern technology, and easy access to transportation. With certain exceptions for newsgathering and business travel, we work on-site five days a week.

Compensation and Benefits

Wherever you are in your life or career, The Washington Post offers comprehensive and inclusive benefits for every step of your journey:

  • Competitive medical, dental and vision coverage

  • Company-paid pension and 401(k) match

  • Three weeks of vacation and up to three weeks of paid sick leave

  • Nine paid holidays and two personal days

  • 20 weeks paid parental leave for any new parent

  • Robust mental health resources

  • Backup care and caregiver concierge services

  • Gender affirming services

  • Pet insurance

  • Free Post digital subscription

  • Leadership and career development programs

Benefits may vary based on the job, full-time or part-time schedule, location, and collectively bargained status.

The salary range for this position is:

$85,100 - $127,700 Annual

The actual salary within this range will depend on individual skills, experience, and qualifications as they relate to specific job requirements. This position may be eligible for a bonus or incentive program, and a member of the Talent Acquisition team will discuss bonus payment terms and conditions during the interview process.

Your story awaits. Apply today!

Learn more about The Post at careers.washingtonpost.com.

A Little Bit About Our Team:

The Record to Report (RTR) Accounting Team serves as the central operational backbone for financial integrity, revenue recognition, cash management, and financial reporting across Warner Music Group.

Operating within our Shared Services / Global Business Services framework, the Recorded Music RTR team provides specialized accounting expertise, revenue assurance, and critical month-end closing support across WMG’s renowned domestic and international record labels. We work with the GBS Revenue Team translating complex data into accurate financial reporting under US GAAP.


Your Role:

As the lead Revenue Accountant for Recorded Music, you will serve as the technical subject matter expert (SME) for our recorded music revenue accounting life cycle. This role bridges technical accounting, data analytics, and financial systems design. You will take ownership of the end-to-end accounting for high-volume, multi-source revenue streams, drive compliance with ASC 606, spearhead systems automation, and unlock actionable financial insights through advanced data mining. In addition to technical execution, you will provide training and education to other members of the Recorded Music RTR team.


Here you'll get to:

  • Lead the technical accounting, accrual modeling, and reconciliation for all Recorded Music revenue streams, including Digital Streaming Partners (Spotify, Apple, YouTube, Amazon), Digital Downloads, DMCA statutory royalties, Physical manufacturing and distribution (vinyl, CD, merch), Synchronization (film, TV, gaming, advertising), Master Licensing, and foreign affiliate distributions.
  • Architect and maintain robust ASC 606 recognition schedules, monthly flash revenue accruals, deferred revenue tracking, and automated reversals based on consumption ingestion files vs. actual cash settlements.
  • Query, clean, and analyze Revenue Operational Reporting datasets across disparate DSPs using Analysis for Office and Gemini AI Tools.    Reconcile Multi-System Reporting from Source to Financial Ledger.
  • Bridge consumption metadata (streams, downloads, play counts, tier rates) with transactional general ledger activity to detect anomalies, underreported royalties, missing catalog codes, and system mismatches.
  • Conduct granular month-over-month (MoM) and quarter-over-quarter (QoQ) variance analyses; present variance drivers to label finance leaders.
  • Serve as the RTR business lead for financial systems optimization across SAP (ECC / S/4HANA), BlackLine, and proprietary music revenue sub-ledgers.
  • Design, test, and implement automated reporting simplify manual journal entries and compress the monthly close cycle.
  • Direct the monthly and quarterly close deliverables for recorded music revenue, reviewing high-volume journal entries, complex accruals, and balance sheet reconciliations.
  • Review work products prepared by staff accountants and offshore shared service partners (e.g., Shopify D2C sales tie-outs, DSP settlement matching, clearing account reconciliations), providing structured guidance and establishing standard operating procedures (SOPs).
  • Actively investigate and resolve persistent balances in revenue clearing, suspense, and partner withholding accounts.
  • Maintain and enhance internal control matrices under Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX 404), ensuring proper segregation of duties, automated validation checks, and data lineage documentation.
  • Serve as primary revenue audit liaison for internal and external auditors (e.g., Big 4), providing PBC audit schedules, roll-forwards, sample testing support, and technical accounting memos.
  • Partner proactively with Label Finance VPs/Directors, Commercial Revenue Operations, Business & Legal Affairs, IT/Data Engineering, and Corporate Royalty teams to align accounting treatments with evolving contract structures and deal terms.

About you:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Accounting, Finance, or related analytical field required.
  • Active CPA license (or international equivalent) strongly preferred.
  • Master’s Degree (MAcc, MBA) or coursework in Financial Data Analytics / Information Systems is a significant plus.
  • 10 to 15+ years of progressive, hands-on accounting experience in Corporate Accounting, Shared Services, or Big 4 Public Accounting.
  • Extensive specialization (7+ years) in high-volume revenue accounting, billing assurance, or royalty accounting within the music, digital entertainment, streaming media, or intellectual property/licensing sectors.
  • Proven track record leading technical ASC 606 revenue recognition implementations or oversight for complex multi-element arrangements.
  • Demonstrable experience directing and reviewing work performed by distributed, hybrid, or offshore delivery centers.
  • Deep experience working with enterprise ERPs (specifically SAP FI/CO, S/4HANA) and automated balance sheet reconciliation tools (such as BlackLine or Cadency).
  • Expert-level Microsoft Excel proficiency (SAP Analysis for Office, Power Query, dynamic arrays, VBA/macros, advanced nested logic).
  • Experience with eCommerce and digital billing platforms (e.g., Shopify, DSP vendor reporting portals) is highly desirable.

We’d love it if you also had:

  • Ability to untangle intricate data anomalies and synthesize findings into clear executive summaries.
  • Proactive drive to evaluate status-quo manual workflows and design scalable, automated alternatives.
  • Exceptional verbal and written communication skills with the confidence to collaborate across label executives, data engineers, and external auditors.
  • Proven capacity to manage high-pressure close deadlines and competing stakeholder requests with composure and precision.

job.title: Graphics/Multimedia Editor, News
job.description:
The mission of The New York Times is to seek the truth and help people understand the world. That means independent journalism is at the heart of all we do as a company. It’s why we have a world-renowned newsroom that sends journalists to report on the ground from nearly 160 countries. It’s why we focus deeply on how our readers will experience our journalism, from print to audio to a world-class digital and app destination. And it’s why our business strategy centers on making journalism so good that it’s worth paying for. 

The Graphics department at The New York Times is looking for a versatile, experienced visual journalist to report, design and create graphics and multimedia stories, with a primary focus on breaking news and fast-turn news response.

You will execute visual coverage on major breaking stories, producing maps, charts, diagrams and interactive graphics on deadline. Your work may also include statistical visualizations, video, photography and animation. You will identify visual story angles, analyze data, and collaborate closely with Graphics colleagues and newsroom journalists across desks. This role combines quick-turn breaking news execution with high-impact journalism. You may also be required to work weekends.

The Graphics department is a diverse group of journalists and visual thinkers with creative backgrounds ranging from architecture to cartography to computer science. We are curious about all kinds of things and seek to find individuals who bring their own curiosity to bear in creative approaches to storytelling.

This is an in-office position based in New York City, and includes regular attendance in the office four days each week.

Applications should include links to a portfolio or work samples to demonstrate the creation of visual journalism. Please feel free to describe your role in specific projects in your cover letter.

Responsibilities:

  • Conceive, report, design, and publish breaking news graphics and multimedia stories using a variety of visual forms.
  • Design and build interactive and static visualizations.
  • Collaborate with Graphics staff and journalists from other newsroom desks on major breaking news events.
  • Conceptualize new lines of reporting and analyze data to discover visual stories with accuracy, clarity, and impact.
  • Share responsibility for regular weekend news graphics coverage, ensuring prompt, high-quality visual response to breaking news.
  • Demonstrate support and understanding of our value of journalistic independence and a strong commitment to our mission to seek the truth and help people understand the world.
  • You will report to the news editor on the Graphics team.

Basic Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of professional experience producing, reporting, or editing visual journalism or news graphics.
  • Proven track record of identifying visual opportunities quickly and delivering effective graphics in a fast-paced breaking news environment.
  • Expertise in visual software (Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, Figma) and front-end web development tools (HTML, CSS, JavaScript).
  • Demonstrated experience with data reporting, interface design, and information graphics design.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Excellent news judgment, strong written and oral communication skills, and ability to work effectively both independently and collaboratively.
  • Familiarity with interactive web frameworks (such as Svelte), web mapping/GIS tools, and tools like ai2html.
  • Experience integrating multimedia elements such as video, photography, and animation into news coverage.
  • Experience prioritizing, organizing, and managing multiple fast-moving visual projects under tight deadlines.
  • Flexibility to work a schedule that includes regular weekend shifts.

#LI-Hybrid

This position is represented by the NewsGuild of NY.

job.description: About Suno We're building the world's first creative entertainment platform, where the entire world can feel the joy and fulfillment of making music. Music is for everyone: Our users include everyone from grandmothers creating songs for their loved ones, to Grammy winners using Suno Studio, our power tool, to make the most popular hits in the world. Building the future of entertainment requires ambition. The pace is fast, the problems are hard, and the work demands ownership and intensity. For the right people, it’s incredibly rewarding: a chance to shape a new medium, work with a small team that cares deeply about quality, make music, drink too much coffee, and build something that millions of people use to express themselves in ways that were never before possible. Suno is the fastest growing consumer entertainment company and the leader in AI music. We are backed by leading investors including Bond Capital, Menlo Ventures, Lightspeed Venture Partners, IVP, Forerunner, Union Square Ventures, Alkeon, Quiet, Matrix Partners, Schroders Capital and, NVentures (venture arm of NVIDIA). About the Role We're looking for a Staff Security GRC Analyst to build Suno's security compliance program from the ground up. You'll report to our CISO, work alongside our AppSec and InfraSec teams, and own the control framework that ties everything together: which controls we have, how they map to SOC 2 and NIST CSF, and whether they actually work. You're as comfortable reading a cloud config as an audit standard, and you'd rather automate evidence collection with AI than chase screenshots. It's a greenfield build with real stakes and a direct line to leadership. Listen to the song we made about it: https://suno.com/s/8U6fbhqLEghsnRsm What You'll Do Build and own Suno's security control framework, mapping controls to SOC 2, NIST CSF, and future frameworks, and writing control descriptions with the teams who run them. Lead SOC 2 preparation end to end, from gap assessments and readiness tracking to driving remediation with control owners and working with our external auditor. Automate evidence collection and control monitoring with scripts, integrations, and AI tools, deciding where human review stays in the loop. Run vendor security reviews, keep our security policies current, and answer customer security questionnaires alongside Product and Legal. Partner with the CISO to give leadership and the board a clear, evidence-backed view of our security posture, and lay the foundations of GRC as part of a growing Security team. Help earn the trust of the partners and customers who bring Suno to more people, so creating music can be part of everyone's day. What You'll Need Must-Haves 7–9 years in GRC, security compliance, or IT audit. Hands-on, end-to-end ownership of a security compliance program as its primary owner, ideally including taking a company through its first SOC 2. Deep working knowledge of SOC 2 and NIST CSF, including control mapping, audit mechanics (design vs. operating effectiveness, sampling, evidence), and staying current as requirements evolve. Enough technical fluency to read a cloud configuration, access setup, or pipeline and judge whether it enforces what the control says. You don't need to write production code. Comfort building your own automation with scripts or AI tools. Nice-to-Haves Experience standing up continuous controls monitoring or automated evidence collection, including what it covered and what changed as a result. Experience applying LLMs to assurance work, such as control drafting, framework mapping, or evidence testing. Experience with cloud environments such as AWS or GCP, and with a modern GRC platform. job.title: Commerce & Artist Marketing Coordinator
job.description:
Who We Are

UnitedMasters is building a marketplace that connects artists, brands and fans – empowering artists to earn and grow. UnitedMasters has taken the bold step of building a music distribution service that, radically, puts artists first – disrupting the legacy music business by letting up-and-coming artists distribute their music directly to fans through streaming services while maintaining ownership of their master recording rights and up to 100% of royalties. Through the combination of UnitedMasters’ music distribution platform and its deep ties to brands, UnitedMasters enables independent artists and change-makers to grow and earn unlike any other platform.

The UnitedMasters team is made up of musicians, marketers, engineers, and storytellers with backgrounds from YouTube, SoundCloud, Pandora, Facebook, Uber, Dropbox, Complex, VICE, and more. We work hand in hand with the award-winning creative teams that forge those innovative partnerships at Translation (our in-house creative advertising agency).

We are looking for a Commerce & Artist Marketing Coordinator to join UnitedMasters! Please note that this role is a Hybrid role: four days in office and one day remote.

The Role

As a Commerce & Artist Marketing Coordinator, you will help make sure our artists’ music lands in front of the right audiences and their physical product reaches the fans who want it. You will support the Commerce team as the day-to-day connective tissue between UnitedMasters and our DSPs: Spotify, Apple Music, Amazon Music and others — keeping pitch calendars, release grids and editorial follow-ups running on time, and tracking what placements actually delivered. Alongside that, you will help coordinate physical products: vinyl, CDs and special collector formats, from manufacturing timelines through inventory and retail distribution.

Beyond the commerce remit, you will serve as a coordination point for the broader Music team — running the logistics behind our recurring team and leadership meetings, supporting our Artist Management team on high-priority administrative needs, and helping bring our label events and partner presentations to life. This is a role for someone who is energized by being the person who keeps a lot of moving parts on the rails.

This is an entry-level role built for someone who wants to learn the commercial engine of the music business from the inside while working directly alongside our artist management and label leadership. You will sit close to the decisions that determine how an independent release performs, and the relationships and instincts you build here with DSP partners and our artist-facing teams are the foundation of a career in music.

What You’ll Do

Commerce & DSP

  • Prepare and maintain the DSP pitch calendar for upcoming releases, ensuring every priority release is submitted on time and with complete, compelling supporting materials.
  • Assemble release assets, artist context and performance data for editorial submissions across Spotify, Apple Music, Amazon Music and emerging platforms, and draft supporting pitch copy in partnership with the Commerce lead.
  • Track playlist adds, editorial placements and store features across all DSP partners, and maintain a shared record the Commerce and Artist Marketing teams can rely on.
  • Pull and format weekly and post-release performance reporting from DSP partner portals, flagging trends, wins and misses to the Commerce lead.
  • Support partner meetings and DSP check-ins by building agendas and one-sheets, taking thorough notes, and driving follow-up items to completion.
  • Maintain a monthly roundup of DSP product changes, new pitch tools and editorial priorities for the broader team.

Physical Product

  • Coordinate physical product timelines for vinyl, CD and special collector formats — tracking manufacturing milestones, test pressings, approvals and in-stock dates against release dates.
  • Support inventory and retail distribution tracking, surfacing stock, reorder and sell-through issues to the Commerce lead and our manufacturing and distribution partners.

Music Team Coordination

  • Coordinate the Music team’s recurring meetings — including the weekly Artist Marketing meeting and the full Music Team meeting — owning agenda and deck preparation, notes, and follow-up to completion.
  • Provide administrative support to the Artist Management team for our highest-priority artists, including payment requests, contracting workflow and travel coordination.
  • Keep Brand Partnerships and Sync current on artist marketing activity through shared calendars, decks and marketing collateral.
  • Support the planning and execution of UnitedMasters label events and partner presentations, from run-of-show through day-of logistics.

Across Both

  • Set up vendors, process invoices and keep budget trackers current for DSP campaigns, physical product runs and artist management requests.
  • Partner with Artist Marketing, Creative and Artist Relations to align commerce moments with release and campaign plans.
  • Organize, catalog and distribute release assets and metadata so partners always have what they need, when they need it.

Who You Are

  • A genuine fan of music with real curiosity about how releases actually perform. You follow charts, playlists and drops because you want to.
  • Entry-level familiarity with the music streaming landscape and how DSPs surface and program music.
  • Comfortable in DSP partner portals — Spotify for Artists, Apple Music for Artists, Amazon Music for Artists — or able to get up to speed on them quickly.
  • Solid working knowledge of Excel or Google Sheets: you can build and maintain a tracker, use basic formulas, and turn a raw export into something readable.
  • Experience with project management tools or clear aptitude for keeping many moving deadlines organized in one system.
  • Exceptionally organized and detail-oriented, with the discipline to hold a calendar of dates that cannot slip.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to write a clear, persuasive pitch.
  • Strong meeting craft — you can build a clean agenda, capture what actually mattered, and chase follow-ups until they are closed.
  • Genuine comfort with high-touch administrative work in service of senior stakeholders and top-priority artists.
  • Discretion and sound judgment. You will be close to artist contracts, payments and travel, and to leadership-level conversations.
  • A self-starter who can own weekly recurring tasks independently while taking direction from multiple stakeholders across Commerce, Artist Marketing and Artist Management — and who is comfortable asking which priority wins when two deadlines collide.
  • A team player who is not afraid to roll up their sleeves and known as the resourceful, positive person others want to work with.
  • Interest in the operational and commercial mechanics of a music release, from editorial pitching to what it takes to get vinyl into a fan’s hands.

Our Values

  • We Get on the Plane Entrepreneurial spirit means fully committing to the journey not just having the idea.
  • We Expect Challenge + Respect We constantly challenge each other and the work to reach excellence, always with respect.
  • We Are Defined by Our Resilience We stay resourceful, fail fast, keep getting better, and never quit on our mission or our team.
  • We Pursue Answers Before the Question Has to Be Asked We understand our customers so well that we anticipate what they need before they ask.
  • We Run Towards Darkness We have the courage to work through uncertainty rather than settling for an easier, inferior plan.
  • We Know What We Don’t Know We bring confidence in what we do know, and honesty about what we don’t.

Compensation

Salary Hiring Range: $29-34/ hr (~$60 - 70k)

Our salary ranges are designed to be competitive for companies of our size and within our industry and represent just one part of our overall rewards package. We also offer company-sponsored medical, dental, and vision plans, a 401(k) with company match, and, depending on the role and individual circumstances, additional compensation opportunities such as bonuses and stock options.

Individual pay rate decisions are based on a number of factors, including qualifications for the role, experience level, skillset, and balancing internal equity relative to peers at the company. We expect the majority of the candidates who are offered roles at our company to fall healthily throughout the range based on these factors.

The range above is for the expectations as laid out in the job description, however we are often open to a wide variety of profiles, and recognize that the person we hire may be less experienced (or more senior) than this job description as posted. If that ends up being the case, the updated salary range will be communicated with you as a candidate.

The salary range above is for NY/CA. As a company, we have a location-based strategy, which means the salary range could be lower or higher than this if the role is hired in another location.

About UnitedMasters, Inc.

UnitedMasters Inc. represents the creative solutions company, Translation, and the leading software and services platform for independent creators, UnitedMasters. UnitedMasters enables ownership, exposure, and new paths for financial return for independent creators, while Translation helps brands leverage the power of contemporary culture to achieve transformational growth. Combined, UnitedMasters, Inc. is the world’s leading marketplace for cultural capital, connecting independent artists and brands to realize a future in which all creators own their future. Backed by Alphabet, Andreessen Horowitz, and Apple, UnitedMasters, Inc. is reimagining how brands and artists come together to tell their stories, build profitable growth, and push culture forward.

Equal Opportunity & Accommodation

UnitedMasters is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We seek to bring together diverse ideas, experiences, skill sets, perspectives, backgrounds and identities to drive innovative solutions. We commit to promoting a welcoming environment where inclusion and belonging are held as a shared responsibility.

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

Phishing Scam Warning

PHISHING SCAM WARNING: UnitedMasters is among several companies recently made aware of a phishing scam involving con artists posing as hiring managers recruiting via email, text and social media. The imposters are creating misleading email accounts, conducting remote “interviews,” and making fake job offers in order to collect personal and financial information from unsuspecting individuals. Please be aware that no job offers will be made from UnitedMasters without a formal interview process. Additionally, UnitedMasters will not ask you to purchase equipment or supplies as part of your onboarding process. If you have any questions, please reach out to TA@unitedmasters.com.

job.title: Sr. Business Director
job.description:
Who We Are

We are an award-winning independent creative solutions company that aspires to be the most culturally-influential company in the world. We help ambitious brands harness the power of culture to solve their biggest challenges. As a unique mix of experts in culture, technology, and storytelling, we are united by a passion to grow brands in ways that advertising alone can never do. 

We are an entrepreneurial business – not a traditional “ad agency.” That means we value resourcefulness and tenacity just as much as we value creativity and intelligence. We’re unapologetically ambitious! 

We are looking for a Sr. Business Director to join Translation and lead one of our most visible and consequential client partnerships. The Sr. Business Director is a senior client and business leader responsible for the success, growth, and health of a significant, complex account. This person has already demonstrated success at the Business Director level and brings greater executive influence, commercial judgment, and organizational leadership. They will serve as a strategic advisor to senior clients, lead integrated teams, and remain close to the work while actively shaping and pushing clients forward in culture.

As a Business Director, you will serve as a strategic leader and trusted client partner, deeply invested in understanding your clients’ business challenges and uncovering opportunities to solve them through innovative, culturally attuned creative solutions. You’ll cultivate strong, proactive client relationships, guide cross-functional teams, and drive initiatives that deliver measurable business impact. With Program Management leading operational excellence, you will focus on shaping strategic agendas, fostering growth, and ensuring our work drives tangible results for both the client and agency.

What You’ll Do

  • Own the overall health, performance, growth, and senior client relationships for a flagship national account.
  • Serve as a trusted strategic advisor to Director-level stakeholders, shaping agendas, influencing decisions, and constructively challenging clients with a clear point of view.
  • Translate complex business, consumer, category, and cultural dynamics into clear strategic direction and stronger creative work.
  • Lead integrated teams across Business Leadership, Strategy, Context, Creative, Program Management, Production, Analytics, and Partner Agencies, creating clarity around objectives, priorities, roles, and decisions.
  • Ensure work meets Translation’s standards for strategic rigor, creative ambition, cultural excellence, and client readiness before presentation.
  • Develop and drive the organic growth strategy, identifying and converting opportunities across stakeholders, business units, audiences, and workstreams.
  • Co-own account financial health with Program Management, including revenue, profitability, staffing, forecasting, scope performance, and investment recommendations.
  • Anticipate relationship, delivery, and commercial risks, intervening before they affect the client partnership, the quality of the work, team health, or profitability.
  • Lead, coach, and develop Business Supervisors through clear expectations, ongoing feedback, performance reviews, and meaningful development opportunities.
  • Contribute to agency leadership through new business, recruiting, shaping departmental standards, cross-functional improvements, and the development of future Business Leadership talent.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Exceptional business judgment and the ability to connect marketing decisions to broader client goals, organizational dynamics, and commercial outcomes.
  • Executive presence and communication skills, including the ability to read complex rooms, tailor counsel to different stakeholders, and navigate sensitive issues with discretion.
  • Strong strategic fluency and the ability to turn ambiguity into clear, actionable direction without prescribing the creative solution.
  • Commercial acumen across scopes, staffing models, forecasting, profitability, and investment decisions.
  • Ability to lead and inspire multidisciplinary teams, resolve tension constructively, and create accountability without relying solely on hierarchy.
  • A growth mindset, with the curiosity and proactivity to identify unmet client needs and translate them into meaningful opportunities.
  • Cultural fluency and a strong understanding of how contemporary culture, audiences, and communities influence brands and business.
  • Sound prioritization and decision-making skills in a high-volume, fast-moving, and highly visible client environment.
  • A coaching orientation and the ability to raise the performance, confidence, and judgment of other leaders.
  • Ability to balance client needs, creative ambition, executional feasibility, team sustainability, and financial health

Minimum Qualifications

  • 10+ years of experience leading integrated client relationships within a creative, marketing, or communications agency, including demonstrated success operating at the Business Director or equivalent level.
  • Proven experience owning senior client relationships, complex integrated campaigns, organic growth, account economics, and cross-functional team leadership for a major consumer brand.
  • Demonstrated experience coaching and developing account leadership talent while independently navigating high-stakes client and business decisions.      

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience leading a large, complex, or matrixed national account across multiple stakeholders and workstreams.
  • Experience in QSR, retail, CPG, telecom, financial services, sports, entertainment, or another high-velocity consumer category.
  • Experience working within/leading an integrated agency team or multi-agency ecosystem.
  • Experience leading culturally specific or multicultural marketing while connecting the work to a broader brand and business strategy.
  • Track record of identifying and converting organic growth opportunities.
  • Experience leading scope development, staffing recommendations, forecasting, and profitability management.
  • Experience supporting new business pitches, agency initiatives, recruiting, or talent development.

About Gray Media:

Today, we are a growing multimedia company headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia. We are the nation's largest owner of top-rated local television stations and digital assets serving 117 full-power television markets that collectively reach approximately 37% of US television households. The portfolio includes 80 markets with the top-rated television station and 100 markets with the first- and/or second-highest-rated television station in average all-day ratings across 116 of such markets that were measured by Nielsen in 2025. We also own the largest Telemundo Affiliate group with 46 markets and Gray Digital Media, a full-service digital agency offering national and local clients digital marketing strategies with the most advanced digital products and services. Our additional media properties include video production companies Raycom Sports, Tupelo Media Group, and PowerNation Studios, and studio production facilities Assembly Atlanta and Third Rail Studios.

We understand that life needs balance. That is why we offer our employees and eligible family members a comprehensive benefits package, including:

  • Comprehensive Medical(Rx), Dental, and Vision Coverage
  • Health Savings Account with Company contributions
  • Flexible Spending Account
  • Employer-paid life and disability benefits
  • Paid parental leave benefits
  • Adoption and Surrogacy Benefits
  • 401(k) Plan, including matching and profit-sharing contributions
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Voluntary benefits, including Hospital Indemnity, Critical Illness, Accident Insurance, and supplemental life insurance coverage
  • Paid Time Off, including Relocation PTO
  • Focus on Caring

Salary/Wage:

$40,000 - $50,000/yr. (depending on experience)

Shift and Schedule:

Mon. - Fri. (8:00 am - 5:00 pm), weekends as needed

Job Type:

Full-Time

_______________________

Job Summary/Description:

This position will support our commercial production team in creating commercials and video content for clients, assist our promotions team in creating promos for our TV station with on-air talent, and help create photo/video social media content for our creative departments.

Duties/Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

* Basic Post-Production: Organize digital photo/video files, sort through raw clips, and perform initial cuts, basic transitions, or simple color adjustments using Adobe Premiere Pro, with support in After Effects, Photoshop, Illustrator, and Media Encoder.
* Filming & Capturing Footage: Record B-roll, interviews, events, client commercial scenes, and promotional scenes following pre-determined shot lists, storyboards, or producer/director instructions.
* Social Media Content Support: Assist in capturing and assembling photo/video content optimized for trending social media platforms (TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, Facebook) for our creative departments and clients.
* Team Collaboration: Work alongside commercial producers, promotions producers, senior videographers, and on-air talent to ensure visual style matches client goals and station brand guidelines.
* Equipment Setup & Operation: Assemble, test, and operate cameras, tripods, lighting kits, and external microphones or lavalier mics on location or in-studio for commercial shoots and station promo shoots with on-air talent.
* Audio Management: Monitor sound levels, place lapel or directional microphones, and ensure clean dialogue capture for both client spots and on-air talent promos.
* Pre-Production Assistance: Help with basic planning tasks such as scouting locations, charging batteries, organizing gear checklists, and conceptualizing social media, commercial, or promo videos.
* Equipment Maintenance: Clean, pack, inventory, and properly store cameras, lenses, cables, and lighting equipment after a shoot.

Qualifications/Requirements:

Technical Familiarity (Required): Coursework, internship, or hands-on experience with:

* Adobe Premiere Pro
* Adobe Photoshop
* Adobe Illustrator
* Adobe Media Encoder
* Social Media Acumen: Comfortable shooting and editing short-form photo/video content for social platforms.
* Portfolio/Demo Reel: A link to a reel or portfolio showing class projects, commercials, promos, motion graphics, or social video work is strongly preferred.

job.description:
WKBW, The E.W. Scripps Company ABC affiliate in Buffalo, NY, is looking for a passionate Multimedia Journalist to join our team. In this role, you'll research, write, capture visual content, and edit stories that inform and engage our community — from the field to the digital screen. If you thrive in a fast-paced newsroom and are ready to make a real impact on the audience we serve, we want to hear from you.


WHAT YOU'LL DO:


  • Receive assignment or evaluate news leads and news tips to develop story ideas.
  • Gather and verify factual information regarding stories through interview, observation, and research.
  • Organize material, determine slant or emphasis, and write story according to prescribed editorial style and format standards.
  • Shoot video and still photos to illustrate stories.
  • Edit, or assists in editing, videos for all multimedia platforms.
  • Appear on television program when conducting taped interview or narration.
  • Give live reports from site of event or mobile broadcast unit.
  • Work cooperatively with photographer assigned to story, if one is assigned.
  • Assist news producer in preparing newscast.
  • Assist online staff in preparing for multi media stories.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:


  • BS/BA in related discipline or equivalent years of experience preferred
  • Generally, 3+ years of experience in related field preferred
  • Valid driver's license, good driving record, and ability to provide proof of insurance with the company required insurance limits

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:


  • Computer literacy required, including newsroom computer systems
  • Videography and non-linear editing experience preferred
  • Knowledge of broadcast quality camera equipment
  • Edit video on Final Cut Pro editing systems, or similar equipment
  • Strong broadcast and AP style writing skills
  • Proficient at posting content to various websites
  • Self-motivated and able to work in a fast-paced deadline-driven environment
  • Must be able to lift up to 50 pounds

WHERE YOU'LL LIVE, WORK, AND PLAY:

Buffalo, NY, is a city with serious heart — a place where gritty determination meets genuine community pride. Situated on the eastern shore of Lake Erie in western New York, Buffalo has undergone a remarkable revitalization, with a booming culinary scene, a thriving arts community, and a waterfront that draws visitors and residents alike. The city is, of course, the birthplace of the Buffalo wing, and its food culture runs deep — from beef on weck at neighborhood taverns to sponge candy from beloved local chocolatiers. The rejuvenated Canalside district pulses with concerts, festivals, and waterfront activities year-round.


Culture runs deep in Buffalo, too. The Buffalo AKG Art Museum (formerly the Albright-Knox) is one of the oldest public art institutions in the country and houses one of the most significant modern art collections in the world. Frank Lloyd Wright's Darwin Martin House and the city's magnificent Olmsted-designed park system — one of the most intact in North America — speak to Buffalo's extraordinary architectural heritage. Shea's Performing Arts Center brings Broadway touring productions and world-class performances to a stunning Rococo Revival theater right in the heart of downtown.


And if you love sports, Buffalo is your town. The beloved Buffalo Bills (NFL) and the Buffalo Sabres (NHL) inspire some of the most passionate fan bases in professional sports. Beyond the games, outdoor adventure is always close at hand — Niagara Falls is just 20 miles away, and the surrounding region offers hiking, skiing, boating, and state parks in every season. Buffalo is a city that rewards those who put down roots, offering an affordable cost of living, a welcoming spirit, and a community proud of its comeback story.

job.title: Social Media Manager - Pickleball TV
job.description:
Pickleball TV is looking for a Social Media Manager to own its Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube channels, with YouTube a key priority across both long-form and Shorts. This is a hands-on role: you'll set the strategy for each platform, concept and create the content, run day-to-day publishing, and lead a production coordinator supports video edits. You'll also travel to select pickleball events to capture content on site and build relationships across the pickleball community.

This role is onsite and located in Santa Monica, CA.

In this role, you will…

Develop Strategy

  • Build and own a distinct strategy for each channel — audience, content pillars, formats, cadence, and growth tactics.
  • Set quarterly plans for each platform and plan for events, programming moments, campaigns, and sponsor deliverables.
  • Identify growth opportunities, such as new series, formats, and creator collaborations, and bring recommendations to the Head of Social.
  • Track performance, report weekly and monthly to the Head of Social, and adjust based on what's working.

 

Create & Publish Content

  • Concept and create social-first content and series: player features, highlights, skills content, trends, and behind-the-scenes.
  • Shoot, write, and edit short-form video; turn Pickleball TV programming into platform-native clips.
  • Own the content calendar across all three channels and publish daily, including captions, sound, hashtags, and platform-native styling.
  • Run live publishing during key events and QA every post for accuracy and brand voice.

 

Manage & Grow YouTube

  • Own Pickleball TV's YouTube strategy across long-form and Shorts, growing subscribers, views, and watch time.
  • Concept and produce long-form YouTube content, such as event recaps, player profiles, instructional series, and behind-the-scenes features.
  • Repurpose Pickleball TV programming and match footage into long-form videos built for YouTube audiences.
  • Own packaging and optimization: titles, thumbnails, descriptions, chapters, playlists, and upload cadence.
  • Use YouTube analytics (retention, click-through rate, traffic sources) to shape what gets made next.

 

Cover Events, Engage the Community & Stay Ahead of Trends

  • Travel to select events to plan and capture on-site content and publish from the ground.
  • Manage community engagement across all channels, including responding to comments and DMs and joining trending pickleball conversations.
  • Run UGC sourcing, including securing rights and credit.
  • Build relationships with players, creators, and event partners.
  • Stay ahead of trends and platform changes on TikTok, Reels, and Shorts, and move quickly on the right ones.

 

Lead the Team 

  • Manage and develop the production coordinator; brief and review video edits for short- and long-form content.

  • Partner with the wider social, video, programming, marketing, and sales teams.

 

Key Qualifications:

  • 3-5 years in social media, ideally in sports, live events, or entertainment, with a track record of growing channels
  • A portfolio of content you've concepted and created for Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube

  • Experience growing a YouTube channel, including long-form content, packaging, and YouTube analytics
  • Experience managing or directing others, such as a coordinator, freelancers, or interns
  • Fluency with trend cycles and platform best practices
  • Strong writing and analytical skills
  • Comfort under live-event pressure and willingness to travel, including weekends
  • Knowledge of pickleball a strong plus

job.title: Senior Manager, Social Media
job.description:
The Senior Social Media Manager for Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, YouTube and X — accountable for whether those channels hit their annual growth targets and for the quality, consistency, and premium feel of Tennis Channel's presence on them. Translates the Head of Social's overarching strategy into platform-specific organic and paid plans, content pillars, and campaign calendars; oversees content creative direction; leads campaign execution; produces the weekly and monthly executive reporting narrative; owns the community management program and UGC; and serves as the resident expert on platform changes and emerging trends. Operates in close partnership with the Director of Video Content on shared channel ownership across the cross-platform content calendar and tournament coverage. Provides the Head of Social with proactive strategic counsel on channel performance, risks, and recommended actions.

This role is onsite and located in Santa Monica, CA.

In this role, you will…

Develop Strategy and Plans

  • Translate the Head of Social's overarching social strategy into platform-specific quarterly plans for IG, FB, TikTok, and X — content pillars, posting cadence, growth tactics, and organic-plus-paid mix calibrated to each platform's audience and the 2026 growth targets.
  • Own the editorial point of view across IG, FB, TikTok, and X day-to-day; partner with the Director of Video Content on shared channel ownership where formats overlap (e.g., short-form cross-publishing, IG/FB long-form pieces, tournament coverage).
  • Maintain a forward-looking 90-day view: anticipate tournament tentpoles, brand campaigns, influencer pushes, and platform tests far enough in advance that the team is briefed and resourced — not reacting.
  • Identify platform-building opportunities and bring them to the Head of Social with a recommended action and a resource ask, not just an idea.

 

Guide Content & Creative Direction

  • Oversee content production and publishing across IG, FB, TikTok, and X — uphold a premium, consistent brand voice and visual standard regardless of who in the pod is producing the post.
  • Approve daily editorial calls across the four owned channels; serve as the final voice on tone, framing, and brand fit before posts go live (with manager handling fact-check, score-accuracy, and grammar QA).
  • Partner with the Director of Video Content on cross-functional content quality — ensure short-form, highlights, and long-form pieces meet the same brand standard whether they originate in the social pod or the video pod.
  • Hold producers, editors, and coordinators to a clear content quality bar; create documentation for asset/platform creative best practices, including specific & timely feedback when output drops below it.

 

Lead Campaigns

  • Lead social campaigns from concept to execution across IG, FB, TikTok, and X — tournament tentpoles, brand pushes, sponsor activations, and platform-specific programs.
  • Own and maintain the Master Cross-Platform Content Calendar (IG, FB, TikTok, X), and partner with the Director of Video Content on the integrated view that includes YouTube and long-form.
  • Build and publish the weekly Tournament Coverage Plan T-1 week ahead of each tournament — coordinator block coverage, tentpole moments, partner deliverables, and paid flags.
  • Update and manage Weekly Coordinator Coverage Schedule — published Friday EOD for the following week. Names which coordinator is on AM, PM, and Overnight each day, with overnight rotation honored.
  • Coordinate with PR and integrated marketing to align campaign timing, messaging, and asset hand-offs.
  • Partner with the Paid Media team on day-to-day coordination: uphold the per-tournament paid strategy set by the Paid Team, surface organic posts that are strong boost candidates, and manage asset delivery to the Paid Team. 

 

Analyze Performance & Report Results

  • Author the Weekly CEO Report and Monthly Executive Report, translating engagement, reach, growth, and conversion data into an executive narrative with a clear point of view and a channel-strategy view across IG, FB, TikTok, and X (what's working, what isn't, recommended actions for the next period).
  • Use analytics inputs (native platform analytics, third-party tools) and tournament reporting as the data foundation; layer in strategic interpretation and recommended actions based on KPI metrics (audience growth, engagement volume and rates, etc.) against weekly, monthly and annual pacing targets.
  • Surface ROI-meaningful insights to leadership on a continuous basis — where to invest more, where to pull back, what to test next — and own the recommendation, not just the observation.
  • Provide the Head of Social with proactive, real-time updates on channel health, risks, and decisions as they emerge between reporting cycles.

 

Manage Community Engagement & UGC

  • Own community management as a named program — defined as proactive owned outreach to grow Tennis Channel's organic presence, not reactive comment moderation: identify trending and topical tennis-adjacent conversations across IG, FB, TikTok, and X (other brands' posts, athlete posts, fan threads, breaking-news threads, viral moments) and direct the team to jump in with on-brand commentary, replies, and quote-posts that put Tennis Channel in front of new audiences. 
  • Define the target communities and conversation types, set the voice and tone for outbound engagement, decide what counts as a high-signal opportunity to jump on, and oversee daily execution by the on-shift coordinator and the video team.
  • Monitor sentiment and audience signal across the four owned channels; flag rising issues to the Head of Social before they become crises.
  • Own the UGC sourcing program: define the rights-and-usage process, oversee the Trending Content Creator's UGC pipeline, and sign off on rights/usage approval before any UGC publishes.

 

Apply Platform Expertise & Stay Ahead of Trends

  • Act as the resident expert on IG, FB, TikTok, and X — emerging formats, algorithm shifts, native feature releases, and platform-specific best practices. Translate platform changes into actionable tactics for the team within days, not weeks.
  • Chair the Weekly Trending Content Meeting across social and video teams. The social pod and the video pod bring proposed content ideas (daily and tournament) built on the week's emerging trends. Evaluate each idea against the social strategy and brand voice, decide which to ship, assign ownership and timing, and route execution to the right pod. 
  • Oversee trend-spotting between meetings: review trends being surfaced by the broader team, decide which to lean into in real time, and route execution to the right pod.
  • Run platform-feature tests on owned channels (new format, new placement, new cadence); document what works and roll learnings into the strategy.
  • Brief the Head of Social monthly on the platform landscape — what's changing, what it means for the 2026 plan, and where to invest.

 

Lead the Team & Oversee Operations

  • Manage junior team: set clear weekly priorities, run 1:1s, give direct performance feedback, name underperformance early, and own each direct report's development plan.
  • Own the Weekly Coordinator Coverage Schedule: assign the team to blocks each week, balance tournament load, and rotate the Overnight block monthly so no coordinator is on overnights more than four consecutive weeks.
  • Serve as a strategic partner to the Head of Social. Provide proactive counsel on channel performance, risks, and decisions — through the weekly and monthly executive reports and in real time as situations emerge. 
  • Partner with the Head of Social on hiring across the social pod (sourcing input, interviewing, recommendations).

 

Key Qualifications:

  • 5-7 years in social media management with at least 2 years managing direct reports
  • Demonstrated track record of driving channel growth — not just running publishing operations
  • Strong analytical and writing skills — must be able to compile data from multiple sources into an executive narrative weekly with a clear point of view
  • Hands-on experience coordinating with paid social teams or agencies, and partnering with PR or influencer programs
  • Demonstrated ability to lead live crisis response on social and to manage to deadlines under live event pressure
  • Sports, live news, or entertainment social experience strongly preferred

job.title: Social Media Producer
job.description:
We are looking for a soccer-obsessed, social-first Social Media Producer to help drive audience growth and content strategy across AMP Media’s soccer portfolio, including Unfiltered Soccer and Style of Play.

This role is designed for someone who lives at the intersection of soccer culture, social media, and content creation. The ideal candidate has a deep understanding of the global game and stays constantly plugged into the news, players, clubs, leagues, tournaments, memes, fan conversations, and cultural moments shaping soccer around the world.

Beyond being a soccer expert, this person should be a highly capable social producer and editor who can independently take an idea from concept through execution. They will identify and source compelling UGC, create memes and highly shareable content, produce and edit original social-first video, and capture behind-the-scenes content with talent at live shows, shoots, matches, and other on-site activations.

This role will work closely with producers, editors, social leads, and high-profile talent to help make our soccer brands part of the daily conversation around the sport — not just when a new podcast episode drops.

What You’ll Do

  • Live and breathe the global soccer conversation, staying ahead of breaking news, emerging storylines, viral moments, players, clubs, leagues, tournaments, and broader soccer culture.
  • Ideate, produce, edit, and publish original social-first content for Unfiltered Soccer and Style of Play across Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Facebook, X, Threads, and emerging platforms.
  • Identify, source, and package high-potential UGC from across the soccer ecosystem, using fan moments, player content, matchday culture, and internet trends to drive reach, engagement, and follower growth.
  • Create memes, reactive content, trend-driven videos, graphics, and other highly shareable formats that allow our brands and talent to participate organically in the soccer conversation.
  • Develop content that extends beyond traditional podcast cutdowns, leveraging talent voices and expertise to create original social franchises, reactions, explainers, rankings, debates, and culturally relevant moments designed specifically for social audiences.
  • Independently edit polished, platform-native short-form video with a strong understanding of hooks, pacing, captions, sound, storytelling, and retention, with minimal oversight required from concept through final delivery.
  • Monitor soccer news and social conversation in real time and proactively identify opportunities where our shows, talent, and channels should participate.
  • Understand the nuances of different soccer audiences — from USMNT and USWNT supporters to Premier League, Champions League, MLS, NWSL, international soccer, and the broader global game — and tailor content accordingly.
  • Support real-time matchday and breaking-news coverage, quickly turning developments into compelling social content while maintaining editorial accuracy.
  • Capture point-and-shoot behind-the-scenes content at live shows, production shoots, matches, events, and other on-site activations, with an instinct for identifying candid and personality-driven moments that will perform on social.
  • Work directly with talent on-site to capture original vertical video, social concepts, reactions, interviews, and other platform-specific content.
  • Support organic audience-growth strategies, including collaborations, UGC, community engagement, cross-promotion, talent amplification, and other opportunities to expand reach and attract new followers.
  • Optimize content for searchability, discoverability, and platform performance, incorporating relevant keywords, metadata, SEO principles, and platform best practices.
  • Execute sponsored and branded social content while ensuring deliverables meet creative, editorial, and contractual requirements.
  • Analyze content performance to understand what is driving views, retention, engagement, shares, and follower growth, and translate those insights into future programming decisions.
  • Collaborate closely with Social, Production, Editorial, Marketing, Design, and Sales while maintaining the ability to work independently and move quickly when opportunities arise.
  • Other duties as assigned.

 

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in social media, digital content creation, video production, editing, or a related role, preferably within sports, media, or entertainment.
  • Deep knowledge of and passion for soccer is essential. Candidates should have a strong understanding of the global soccer landscape and be able to confidently
  • identify the players, clubs, leagues, storylines, and cultural conversations that matter to fans.
  • A demonstrated understanding of soccer internet culture, including memes, fan communities, UGC, trends, creator content, and the types of moments soccer audiences are likely to share.
  • Strong social-first creative instincts with a portfolio demonstrating the ability to create engaging, timely, and highly shareable sports content.
  • Advanced video editing and production skills, with experience using Adobe Premiere Pro, Photoshop, and/or other professional social editing tools.
  • Ability to independently take content from idea → production → edit → publish without requiring significant creative oversight.
  • Strong understanding of Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Facebook, X, and Threads, including platform-specific formats, algorithms, audience behaviors, and growth strategies.
  • Comfortable shooting high-quality social content using a phone or lightweight camera setup in fast-moving, on-location environments.
  • Strong editorial judgment and the ability to move quickly around breaking news without sacrificing accuracy.
  • An eye for viral content and an understanding of why people stop scrolling, watch, comment, and share.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously and operate effectively within the fast-moving, 24/7 news cycle of soccer and social media.
  • A proactive self-starter who identifies opportunities rather than waiting for assignments.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, including experience working directly with producers, editors, executives, and high-profile talent.
  • Experience working with high-profile talent while maintaining professionalism and sound judgment.
  • A calculated risk-taker who is comfortable experimenting with new formats, trends, and creative approaches while protecting the voice and reputation of each brand.
  • Ability to work nights, weekends, and holidays as needed, particularly around major matches, tournaments, live events, and breaking news.

 

The base salary compensation range for this role is $72,000 to $90,000. Final compensation for this role will be determined by various factors such as a candidates’ relevant work experience, skills, certifications, and geographic location. Full time positions are eligible for benefits that include participation in a retirement plan, life and disability insurance, health, dental and vision plans, flexible spending accounts, sick leave, vacation time, personal time, parental leave and employee stock purchase plan.

Corporate Narrative & Storytelling 

  • Help shape externally NBCU’s overarching story, positioning and messaging. 
  • Translate complex business strategies, innovation, and company priorities into compelling stories that are accessible and differentiated. 
  • Identify the stories, milestones, people, businesses, and innovations that can strengthen the company’s reputation and bring its strategy to life. 
  • Develop integrated messaging frameworks and communications platforms that can be used consistently across external and internal audiences. 
  • Anticipate emerging issues and opportunities and proactively develop communications strategies around them. 
  • Partner with internal stakeholders to ensure communications are aligned with the company’s business objectives and broader reputation strategy.

  • Drive earned media opportunities across business, corporate, trade, broadcast, podcast, and digital platforms. 
  • Develop rapid-response strategies when appropriate while maintaining a strong emphasis on proactive reputation building. 

Executive Communications & Thought Leadership 

  • Serve as a trusted communications advisor to senior executives, providing strategic counsel on positioning, messaging, visibility, and reputation. 
  • Develop executive communications strategies that establish leaders as credible, distinctive voices within the industry and broader business community. 
  • Create speeches, keynote remarks, talking points, presentations, and other executive materials. 
  • Identify opportunities for executives to participate in high-value industry conversations, conferences, interviews, panels, podcasts, and other forums. 
  • Develop proactive thought-leadership platforms and campaigns that connect executive voices to the company’s strategic priorities and broader industry trends. 
  • Prepare executives for high-profile media interviews, speaking engagements, and other external appearances. 

Integrated Communications Leadership 

  • Partner closely with internal communications, business communications, public affairs, marketing, and other functions to ensure a coordinated communications approach. 
  • Establish clear communications priorities and measurement frameworks to evaluate impact and inform strategy. 
  • Lead high-priority corporate communications initiatives and special projects from strategy through execution. 
  • Serve as a senior representative of the communications function with executives and key internal stakeholders. 
  • Help build and mentor a high-performing corporate communications team and foster a culture of strategic thinking, creativity, collaboration, and accountability. 

Basic Requirements:

  • 10+ years of experience in corporate communications, public relations, executive communications, media relations, journalism, or a related field, with significant experience advising senior executives. 

Desired Experience, Skills, and Characteristics:

  • Proven track record of developing and executing proactive corporate communications and media strategies that generate meaningful earned media. 
  • Exceptional writing and storytelling skills, with the ability to make complex business topics compelling and accessible. 
  • Deep understanding of the media landscape and established relationships with influential business, industry, and/or trade journalists.

  • Strong strategic judgment and the ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, highly visible environment. 
  • Ability to influence senior leaders and collaborate effectively across a large, complex organization. 
  • Experience managing sensitive or high-profile communications issues with discretion and sound judgment. 
  • Strong team leadership, project management, and cross-functional collaboration skills. 
  • A proactive, entrepreneurial mindset with a demonstrated ability to find the story, create the opportunity, and move quickly to capitalize on it.

    • Concept design to execution
  • Advanced 3D graphics skills, including c4d, Blender, Maya, 3ds Max, and Adobe AFX

  • Solid communication skills

As an Audience Acquisition Specialist for MACS, you will own the day-to-day execution of paid mobile app user acquisition campaigns across Paramount+ and PlutoTV. You will manage recurring performance reporting, budget pacing and shifting, creative delivery and trafficking, and end-to-end PlutoTV campaign operations, while serving as the primary point of contact for key acquisition partners (e.g., InMobi, Moloco, Jampp, YouAPPi) and spearheading ongoing CPA optimization and A/B testing. The ideal candidate has prior experience in paid app user acquisition and is looking to grow their career within mobile app marketing, with a well-developed awareness of how to drive business goals and evaluate performance against key metrics (KPIs). Knowledge with the mobile app ecosystem - including app post-back tracking, the iOS ATT measurement framework, SKAN attribution, and MMP technology (e.g., Kochava) - is a strong plus. The candidate shows a robust work ethic and a drive to continually learn and grow their digital marketing skills, and must be organized, punctual, and professional. The role will support the team’s efforts on paid acquisition campaigns, with special focus on mobile app campaign operations and processes.

 

Your Day-to-Day:
●    Build, traffic, and manage paid mobile app user acquisition campaigns across Paramount+ and PlutoTV, working through various ad managers/DSPs and partner platforms (e.g., InMobi, Moloco, Jampp, YouAPPi)
●    Manage budget pacing and shifting across the app portfolio, including twice-weekly pacing checks, IO issuance, and reconciliation against monthly spend and CPA/CPIA targets
●    Own recurring performance reporting, including Monday/Wednesday reporting checks across Paramount+ app campaigns, bi-weekly US insights reporting, and monthly ad hoc reporting for priority titles
●    Coordinate creative delivery and trafficking, including banners, videos, and native creatives for top-tier shows, plus monthly creative selection across app partners

job.title: Digital News Producer, Chron
job.description:
Digital News Producer, Chron

Are you a fast, digitally savvy journalist who thrives at the intersection of breaking news and audience growth? Join Chron’s audience team and help shape how our stories reach and engage readers across Houston and Texas.

Job Description

Chron, a digital-first news publisher, is seeking a Digital News Producer to play a critical role on our audience team, helping drive daily coverage, optimize the site experience, and ensure our journalism reaches the widest possible audience. This is a hybrid role combining audience production and fast-turn news writing.

The ideal candidate has strong news judgment, understands what audiences are searching for and sharing in real time, and can quickly turn around clean, accurate and buzzy stories and video rooted in verification and light additional reporting.

This role is scheduled Sunday–Thursday and will serve as the lead audience producer on Sundays. This person will report to the Deputy Managing Editor of News & Sports, with a dotted line to Chron’s Audience Editor.

What will you do?

  • Write 2–3 daily quick-turn stories, including breaking news and trending topics, with a focus on speed, accuracy, and strong headlines 
  • Shoot and edit timely, highly shareable video that connects with audiences off platform
  • Serve as the lead audience producer on Sundays, helping guide coverage, distribution, and real-time decisions
  • Package and distribute Chron content across social platforms to drive traffic, with a focus on emerging and secondary platforms such as Reddit and Nextdoor
  • Track newsletter cadence and performance, identifying gaps, trends, and opportunities, and regularly sharing insights with the audience manager

 

What will it take to be successful?

  • Minimum 2 years of experience in a digital newsroom as a digital content producer, reporter, or audience producer 
  • Strong news judgment, particularly regarding issues that Texans care about, and the ability to prioritize quickly in a fast-paced environment 
  • Proven ability to write clean, accurate, and engaging news stories on tight deadlines 
  • Experience with breaking news and/or trending content workflows 
  • Familiarity with content management systems and digital publishing tools 
  • Understanding of audience metrics and tools such as Google Trends, Google Analytics, or Marfeel  
  • Solid understanding of AP Style and journalistic standards
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills across newsroom teams 
  • Interest in Houston and Texas news and an understanding of what resonates with local audiences 

 

About Business Unit

Chron is a digital-first Texas newsroom based in Houston, covering the conversations, culture and everyday moments that shape life across the state—with the perspective of an independent culture publication and a voice that’s sharp, current and unmistakably Texan.

Since 2012, Chron has maintained an independent newsroom separate from the Houston Chronicle and provides free access to its coverage. 

 

About Hearst Newspapers

With 2,500 employees across the nation, HNP represents a network of 24 daily and 52 weekly publications, including the San Francisco Chronicle, Houston Chronicle, San Antonio Express-News and Albany Times Union, several top digital-only news and lifestyle sites, marketing services businesses, and entertainment businesses such as King Features Syndicate. 

At HNP, we are investing in new and innovative ways to tell stories – growing newsrooms, diversifying tools, evolving platforms – to support the millions of people who trust us each month to help them make decisions, take action and be inspired.

Be a part of something bigger – Your Headline Awaits.

At Sony Music Entertainment, we fuel the creative journey. We’ve played a pioneering role in music history, from the first-ever music label to the invention of the flat disc record. We’ve nurtured some of music’s most iconic artists and produced some of the most influential recordings of all time.

In everything we do, we’re committed to artistic integrity, transparency, and entrepreneurship.

Sony Music Entertainment is a member of the Sony family of global companies.

As the Senior Director, Commercial Partnerships, you will play a key role in strategy for growing Sony Music Nashville's artists across DSPs and commercial partners. You'll secure visibility and editorial support, build campaigns that drive discovery and streaming growth, and help develop new revenue opportunities. Reporting to the SVP, Commercial Partnerships, you'll be a primary point of contact for key partners and a strategic voice across the label.

What you'll do:

  • Own and deepen relationships with DSP and commercial partners to maximize exposure for priorities
  • Lead pitching strategy for new releases and current priorities, using internal data to build compelling cases for editorial, marketing, and programming support.
  • Build playlist and campaign plans that grow fans for new and established artists, both on streaming services and beyond them.
  • Help execute commercial campaigns that add revenue on top of streaming for artists and the label.
  • Weave artist and partner opportunities around key cultural and country-format moments such as CMA Fest, holiday, and tentpole releases.
  • Work efficiently with other departments to align strategy and goals for our artists and releases.
  • Act as an ambassador for the SMN roster internally, with management, and with partners.

Who you are:

  • Established relationships with key DSP and commercial partners.
  • Strong analytical skills. You're comfortable with streaming and consumption data (e.g., Luminate, platform analytics) and can turn insights into strategy and pitches.
  • Commercially versatile across formats: streaming, physical, D2C, and retail.
  • A strategic thinker who can also execute, managing multiple priorities in a fast-moving release schedule.
  • A collaborative, positive leader who influences across teams and with senior partners.
  • Knowledge of and passion for country music and the Nashville community is a plus.
 

What we give you:

The Catalog Efficiency Coordinator ensures client catalogs move accurately and efficiently through Songtrust’s publishing systems. This role identifies catalog bottlenecks, resolves metadata or system issues, and collaborates across teams to maintain transparency and accuracy throughout Songtrust’s catalog workflows.



How You'll Create:

  • Conduct periodic reviews to identify and address duplicate works, claims, and client records across systems.
  • Monitor and investigate RMP ETL errors, ensuring songs successfully process for delivery.
  • Review RMP catalog for songs failing to reach the CWR process, documenting issues and recommending improvements.
  • Provide regular insights on catalog flow and partner with teams to enhance metadata accuracy and system efficiency.
