  • Commitment: We pursue excellence for our team and our talent. Everything in music starts with a leap into the unknown, and we’re committed to keeping the faith, acting with integrity, and delivering on our promises.

WMG is home to a wide range of artists, musicians, and songwriters that fuel our success. That is why we are committed to creating a work environment that actively values, appreciates, and respects everyone.  We encourage applications from people with a wide variety of backgrounds and experiences.

Consider a career at WMG and get the best of both worlds – an innovative global music company that retains the creative spirit of a nimble independent.
 

The Finance Transformation team is a group of professionals across the WMG organization brought together to re-imagine our processes and systems to establish more standardized and efficient ways of working that will drive WMG’s growth and business aspirations. 


Your role:

The OTC Manager holds a global remit and is responsible for defining the future state Order to Cash (OTC) processes and measures that are aligned with organizational strategies, country-specific knowledge, and operational requirements. This process lead will strive to assemble opportunities, reviewing existing and best-practice workflows, tools, and data. The role moves through design, architecture, implementation, release, and steady state with an ongoing focus on continuous improvement and the integration of OTC finance processes into the overall WMG landscape. Specific accountability from revenue to the sales order and billing documents (plus ebilling where required) for digital, physical, D2C, 3rd party licensing and merchandise revenue streams.


Here you’ll get to:

  • Support the transformation team by leading cross-functional and virtual teams in the review, design, development, and implementation of global processes and procedures, including customer master data, credit management, order management/billing, accounts receivable (AR), collections, cash application, and revenue recognition. 
  • Lead process design meetings with internal Subject Matter Resources (SMRs) and third-party vendors through design, implementation, and release. 
  • Lead technical and operational teams to conduct testing, defect resolution, and ongoing configuration of SAP SD/FI-AR modules and associated sub-systems. 
  • Be responsible for OTC testing across credit limit setting, billing, cash application, dispute management, credit/debit memo processing, customer statement generation, and collaborate with sales, distribution, and licensing platforms. 
  • Work closely with the SAP Master Data Management team to ensure customer master data configuration and governance are consistent with global processes. 
  • Work closely with WMG Tax to solve complex scenarios involving worldwide tax.
  • Act as representative for intercompany billing between service centers and transformation.
  • Leverage OTC and industry process and systems knowledge/experience to implement standardization of global, regional, and/or local processes, challenging the status quo while taking input from SMRs and program partners to understand required localizations. 
  • Lead the design, documentation, and ongoing socialization of end-to-end OTC processes. 
  • Obtain consensus for Finance Transformation from key WMG partners across the globe by credibly communicating deep operating process and systems knowledge and an appreciation of the impact at a local level. 
  • Attend and/or present in update meetings as required for key decision, issue, and risk points. 
  • Work with collaborators to ensure Product / Policy / Process / Procedure / System decisions account for territory variances, commercial needs, and local legal/regulatory requirements. 
  • Partner with IT to identify integration points between commercial/sales operations systems, billing platforms, and core finance systems. 
  • Partner with people and change management resources to develop job aids, communications, and training approaches to embed new ways of working and systems training for the OTC area. 
  • Act as a spokesperson across the WMG organization for the benefits delivered by the Finance Transformation in the OTC space. 
  • Represent the OTC Business Process at individual Fit/Gap sessions in markets to ensure all business requirements are considered (and documented via User Requirements Specification). Ensure that any business needs driving a requirement for customization are strongly challenged and options for process redesign are considered. Where customizations are needed, ensure justification is documented and changes progress via the governance model. 
  • Update relevant OTC documentation based on changes to the global template (including SOPs, User Guides, and training materials). 
  • Participate in the preparation of OTC training materials. 
  • Be responsible for the resolution and review of OTC issues, risks, and business impacts for the owned process. 
  • Proactively and on an ongoing basis identify internal and external OTC guidelines (e.g., automation in cash application, AI-driven credit scoring, streamlined collections) that will enable improvement of the standard end-to-end process. 

About you:

  • Bachelor's degree from a four-year college or university in Business, Finance, Accounting, Business Information Systems, Management Science, or equivalent practical experience. 
  • Proven experience focusing on OTC processes (Credit, Collections, Cash Application, Billing, AR) or related finance transformation experience. 
  • Strong Order to Cash process and systems knowledge, preferably within a music, media, digital licensing, or entertainment industry context. 
  • Facilitative style, with prior experience leading workshops and engaging collaborators through a series of approaches that require a targeted level of consensus. 
  • Relevant operational OTC experience supervising credit management, order fulfillment/billing workflows, cash management, dispute resolution, AR ledger management, and internal controls. 
  • Technically savvy with a robust organizational change skillset. 
  • Experience with a previous SAP implementation (specifically SAP SD, FI-AR, or FSCM) is crucial. 
  • Exemplary collaborator engagement and management skills internationally and within complex, multi-faceted organizations. 
  • Strong analytical skills and the ability to perform complex dispute, credit risk, and receivables analysis. 
  • Ability to develop, articulate, and build support around a long-term OTC vision and implement incremental turning points in support of that vision. 
  • Team player who can participate and collaborate with varied business units (sales, licensing, supply chain, legal, finance) to effectively implement transformation initiatives. 


We’d love it if you also had:

  • Transformational leadership experience. 
  • Media, entertainment, digital distribution, or music industry experience preferred. 
  • Familiarity with SAP FSCM (Credit Management, Dispute Management, Collections Management) and modern automated cash application tools. 


As the home to 10K Projects, Asylum, Atlantic Music Group, East West, FFRR, Fueled by Ramen, Nonesuch, Parlophone, Rhino, Roadrunner, Sire, Warner Records, Warner Classics, and several other of the world’s premier recording labels, Warner Music Group champions emerging artists and global superstars alike. And our renowned publishing company, Warner Chappell Music, represents genre-spanning songwriters and producers through a catalog of more than one million copyrights worldwide. Warner Music Group is also home to ADA, which supports the independent community, as well as artist services division WMX. job.title: Lead Broadcast Infrastructure Technician
job.description:
Who We Are:

SiriusXM and its brands (Pandora, SiriusXM Media, AdsWizz, Simplecast, and SiriusXM Connect) are leading a new era of audio entertainment and services by delivering the most compelling subscription and ad-supported audio entertainment experience for listeners -- in the car, at home, and anywhere on the go with connected devices. Our vision is to shape the future of audio, where everyone can be effortlessly connected to the voices, stories and music they love wherever they are.

This is the place where a diverse group of emerging talent and legends alike come to share authentic and purposeful songs, stories, sounds and insights through some of the best programming and technology in the world. Our critically-acclaimed, industry-leading audio entertainment encompasses music, sports, comedy, news, talk, live events, and podcasting. No matter their individual role, each of our employees plays a vital part in bringing SiriusXM’s vision to life every day.

SiriusXM

SiriusXM is the leading audio entertainment company in North America, and the premier programmer and platform for subscription and digital advertising-supported audio products. SiriusXM’s platforms collectively reach approximately 150 million listeners, the largest digital audio audience across paid and free tiers in North America, and deliver music, sports, talk, news, comedy, entertainment and podcasts. Pandora, a subsidiary of SiriusXM, is the largest ad-supported audio entertainment streaming service in the U.S. SiriusXM's subsidiaries Simplecast and AdsWizz make it a leader in podcast hosting, production, distribution, analytics and monetization. The Company’s advertising sales organization, which operates as SiriusXM Media, leverages its scale, cross-platform sales organization and ad tech capabilities to deliver results for audio creators and advertisers. SiriusXM, through SiriusXM Canada Holdings, Inc., also offers satellite radio and audio entertainment in Canada. In addition to its audio entertainment businesses, SiriusXM offers connected vehicle services to automakers.




How you’ll make an impact:

As Broadcast Infrastructure Technician at SiriusXM, you are in a front-facing role where you provide first line technical support for SiriusXM’s Broadcast and IT Systems, Studio personnel and Remote Users.

You will be a key player contributing to our 100% On-Air uptime goal by utilizing your troubleshooting skills, knowledge, and experience to support the Broadcast facility and studios of the Sirius XM

Project work is an important aspect of the role, helping to improve workflows and increase our level of technology. You will be an active contributor and implementer of Sirius XM Broadcast Projects and will be expected to lead projects and resolve complex issues.


What you’ll do:

This is a shift work position in a 24/7 facility. During your shift you will review systems operations logs, install software and firmware updates to a range of broadcast specific hardware and IT based workstations and servers- both physical and virtual. You will assist and troubleshoot technical issues for both in-house and remote studio users. You will address networking issues that are local or across sites.   Using your troubleshooting abilities, you will isolate and resolve the issues or escalate to subject Matter Experts (SMEs) via escalation procedures. In addition to troubleshooting, you will ticket issues and communicate status to management and affected teams.


What you’ll need:

  • Minimum 3 years of hands-on & remote technical experience in broadcast or media content creation facility
  • Minimum 0-2 years of leading technical projects and supervising technicians
  • Proficiency in a wide range of broadcasting or IT equipment and systems
  • Moderate decision-making authority, may make recommendations and implement solutions
  • College degree in a technical discipline or equivalent military or industry experience
  • Knowledge of standard MS office suite, Visio and AutoCad
  • Willingness to take initiative and to follow through on projects
  • Strong communication and organizational skills
  • Work independently and in a team environment
  • Project professionalism in all forms of communication
  • Ability to multi-task and shift priorities
  • Must be able to lift and carry up to 50 lbs and be comfortable on a ladder  
  • Must be able to work on-site and all shifts required in a 24x7x365 broadcast and production facility (i.e., days, nights, weekends, holidays)
  • Must have legal right to work in the U.S

Technical Experience

  • Extensive IT experience in the provisioning, supporting, and maintaining of endpoint and server hardware and software
  • Problem-solving and diagnosis of endpoint issues for users that are both remote and local.
  • Incident ticketing and management using ServiceNow (or similar)
  • Configuration and support of Windows and Linux server operating systems
  • Virtual infrastructure/computing support at the direction of Tier 3 staff
  • Advanced troubleshooting and problem-solving experience within a data center environment
  • In depth knowledge of Windows and Apple OS, including MS Office, Office 365, and Adobe Creative Cloud products
  • Understanding and troubleshooting of data network routers, switches, firewalls, and circuits using Splunk, ELK, Solarwinds, Wireshark or similar tools
  • CLI management and scripting experience a plus
  • Installation, configuration, and support of varied broadcast/production software
  • Digital and IP-based audio/video routing, playout and recording systems
  • Installation and deployment of systems, networks, and structured cabling within a broadcast facility
  • Demonstrated experience with broadcast consoles and related studio equipment
  • Familiarity with satellite downlink operations and hardware support
  • Ability to diagnose, detect and isolate equipment faults by equipment log review and analysis of signal flow documentation
  • Ability to read and create schematics and data flow documents (AutoCAD/Visio)
  • Knowledge of configuration of Telos, LAWO, Evertz, and other media encoding devices is a plus
  • This position requires the use of information or access to hardware which is subject to the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR). As required by ITAR, to perform this position you must be a U.S. Citizen, U.S. Permanent Resident (i.e., ‘Green Card Holder’), Political Asylee, or Refugee.
  • Must have legal right to work in the U.S.

At SiriusXM, we carefully consider a wide range of factors when determining compensation, including your background and experience. These considerations can cause your compensation to vary. We expect the base salary for this position to be in the range of $89,000 to $123,050 and will depend on your skills, qualifications, and experience. Additionally, this role might be eligible for discretionary short-term and long-term incentives. We encourage all interested candidates to apply.

job.title: Deputy Editor, Well
job.description:
The mission of The New York Times is to seek the truth and help people understand the world. That means independent journalism is at the heart of all we do as a company. It’s why we have a world-renowned newsroom that sends journalists to report on the ground from nearly 160 countries. It’s why we focus deeply on how our readers will experience our journalism, from print to audio to a world-class digital and app destination. And it’s why our business strategy centers on making journalism so good that it’s worth paying for. 

The Well desk is seeking a Deputy Editor to join its core leadership team to oversee editorial operations, including day-to-day scheduling, long-term planning and managing editors and reporters.

As our Deputy Editor, you will help the desk to pursue ambitious targets, set priorities, and home in on a consistent voice and mission. You'll push Well editors and reporters to collaborate internally and with the newsroom, and help guide inter-desk collaboration. You will do first edits on stories and top-read our report. You will also serve as the desk deputy and can run all aspects of the desk as a proxy for the Editor of Well, when necessary.

You will report to the Well desk's Editor. This is an in-office position, based in New York City and includes regular attendance in the office four days each week. There may be some flexibility to work remotely per your departmental guidance.

Responsibilities:

  • Oversee all aspects of the editorial workflow, including story presentation and promotion. Monitor the status of articles, photography, video and design, as well as display and social copy and any multimedia elements.
  • Serve as the primary liaison between Well's desk head and the Well Visuals Team.
  • In partnership with the desk head, lead and shape coverage for the desk; make publishing decisions and take ownership of what is published; set the editorial calendar, make sure that all editorial content is on track, and make adjustments when necessary.
  • In partnership with the desk head, support team development, culture and morale; accountable for success and development of direct reports and their respective teams.
  • In partnership with the desk head, shape and drive desk strategy; identify opportunities for innovation and collaboration.
  • Help the desk head to set audience goals and drive the team toward success. Collaborate closely with the desk audience editor.
  • Serve as a hiring manager and ensure that hiring decisions follow fair and equitable practices.
  • Manage a team of editors and reporters.
  • Run the desk's public representation and communications within the greater news organization, with a particular emphasis on helping us play in the big stories of the day Clearly communicate the desk's plans to other desks and stakeholders.
  • Lead the effort in defining editorial franchises and lanes of coverage.
  • Work closely with Well's operations manager on budget, payroll, freelance contracts and vacation scheduling.
  • Demonstrate support and understanding of our value of journalistic independence and a strong commitment to our mission to seek the truth and help people understand the world.

Basic Qualifications:

  • 10+ years of experience as an editor, ideally with experience across many forms of storytelling, from news to investigations, features and visual projects.
  • Experience with framing and elevating stories for the broadest possible audience.
  • Experience with brainstorming ideas and coaching reporters, editors and the visual team so they produce their best work.
  • Proven experience directly managing editors and reporters in a high-speed news environment.
  • Strong leadership, communication and interpersonal skills and an eagerness to coach and support colleagues.
  • A passion for innovative storytelling and a desire to deploy new formats.
  • Superior organizational skills.
  • A collaborative, enthusiastic team spirit and a desire to ask deep, tough questions about health and wellness.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Deep experience editing health and wellness journalism.
  • A deep understanding of video, visual, and audio storytelling.
  • A track record of fostering agility and successfully implementing new operational workflows.

And it’s why our business strategy centers on making journalism so good that it’s worth paying for. 

The Science desk of the New York Times is looking for a creative, energetic reporter to cover the world of space exploration. We’re looking for a heartbeat of stories that capture the wonder, the successes and failures, the big dreams and big personalities of the space world, whether at private space companies like SpaceX or in the orbit of NASA. The ideal candidate will be an accomplished multimedia journalist who can report and produce both text and video. You are adept at moving quickly on breaking news including launch coverage and other fixtures of the daily beat, but also able to identify stories with visual potential and eager to pursue a wide array of types of stories, including developing ambitious visual enterprise stories.

This is an in-office position and includes regular attendance in a New York Times bureau four days each week. There may also be flexibility to work remotely per departmental guidance.

Responsibilities:

  • Pitch, report and produce news, enterprise and explanatory stories in both text and video, including on-camera reporting.

  • Contribute to live and developing-news coverage, including launches, mission milestones, anomalies and breaking developments.

  • Help to develop well-structured scripts for linear videos and combine text and visuals in multimedia formats.

  • Monitor wires, local and regional outlets, social media feeds and other sources for developing storylines and reporting opportunities that help explain the beat and advance ongoing storylines, keeping us ahead of national competitors.

  • Cultivate existing sources and develop new ones to land exclusive stories to cover this beat authoritatively.

  • Work collaboratively across the newsroom including with editors, video producers, video and photo editors and motion graphics colleagues to develop stories from pitch through publication.

  • Ensure visual accuracy, fair representation and rigorous fact-checking.

  • Demonstrate support and understanding of our value of journalistic independence and a strong commitment to our mission to seek the truth and help people understand the world.

  • This role reports to the Space Editor.

Basic Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of experience covering space or science-related topics 

  • Experience covering complex subjects with elegance, sensitivity and fairness

  • A portfolio that demonstrates you are well-versed in a range of topics, and have a growing circle of sources across storylines

  • Demonstrated understanding of the video production process and creative instincts that go beyond traditional text formats

  • A willingness to be flexible as the news demands and the newsroom's needs evolve

  • An openness to trying new storytelling approaches, and a demonstrated ability to communicate clearly

  • Experience covering live events, launches, breaking news or rapidly developing stories

  • A strong understanding of Times style and standards

Work at CBC/Radio-Canada

At CBC/Radio-Canada, we create content that informs, entertains and connects Canadians on multiple platforms. Our successes and accomplishments are driven by embodying and upholding values, which include creativity, integrity, inclusiveness and relevance. 
 
Do you think you have the ability and drive to keep up with this exciting, ever-changing industry? Whether it be in front of the camera, on air, online or behind the scenes, you would be joining a team that thrives on making connections and telling stories that are important to Canadians.

Unposting Date:

2026-11-01 11:59 PM

At CBC/Radio-Canada, we all have a story to tell. What’s yours?

 

If you share our passion for Canadian storytelling, and you wish to help us engage with individuals and communities across our various digital platforms, this is where you’ll want to be!

 

Every day, you will have an opportunity to shape the way in which Canadians see themselves reflected in our digital services. Your work will have a direct impact on how millions of Canadians from various communities connect with our products, with one another, and with the diverse voices that make our country so unique.

 

You will have the opportunity to play a part in enlightening and entertaining Canadians through our innovative work in building the mediums that deliver our content. We are an innovative hub, where the talented professionals we work with are respected and valued for their contributions. Our product teams are vibrant and our work culture strives to achieve the highest standards of diversity and inclusion. We believe that hiring people with different career paths and backgrounds is fundamental in our shared success and in building healthy and highly performant teams.

 

When you join our mission, you are not only shaping the vision of CBC/Radio-Canada, but the future of our country.

 

We know that commitment to equity, inclusion and diversity is essential to creating content that mirrors and resonates with the rich and evolving makeup of our country.  We’re also committed to reaching out and connecting with our audience on multiple platforms this includes creating virtual places where communities can come together.

This is a hybrid role with a mix of in-office and remote work. Work arrangements will be discussed with hiring managers per departmental guidelines.

 

Why is this role important?

 

You will be an important element of our over-the-top platform team. As such, working closely with the product owners, architects and technical managers, your role is to ensure the smooth execution of product front-end development and coordinate the technical work required to deliver requested features, while adhering to the standards and practices agreed to by the development management team.

 

The team you will be part of is in charge of an harmonized product, powering CBC Gem and ICI TOU.TV.

 

Perks you can look forward to:

  • Flexible work schedules, allowing you to prioritize yourself, your family and your work
  • Work from home opportunities
  • Competitive total rewards package
  • Opportunities to work with cutting edge technology
  • Opportunities for continued learning and professional development
  • Opportunities to become a member of our Employee Resource Groups
  • Pair programming and mentorship opportunities, where you can learn from the best in the industry and help coach new talent
  • A creative and dynamic work environment, where your ideas and contributions can be heard, valued and respected
  • A supportive management team committed to upholding the highest standards of diversity and inclusivity
  • An environment which favours experimentation and an iterative approach in order to achieve the highest form of technical innovation.

 

Your responsibilities:

  • Design and/or modify reusable components for Radio-Canada's digital platforms; such as the audio/video player.
  • Ensure compliance with standards and control the quality of the product throughout the project's execution.
  • Stay informed of new trends in the various fields of digital development.
  • By being proactive, propose solutions to the challenges encountered.
  • Participate in Agile Scrum activities designed to review ongoing production projects in order to make necessary corrections and adjustments, or completed projects to measure their results.
  • Participate in the development of user stories for our various products.
  • Ensure the good performance of developed applications to handle high loads.
  • Participate in sprint planning, retrospectives, and application deployments.
  • Participate in code reviews and solution deployments.

We are looking for a candidate matching the following profile:

  • University degree or equivalent experience.
  • At least 3 years of experience in software development.
  • Proficiency in C#, ASP.NET Core and WebAPI.
  • Excellent grasp of REST API principles.
  • Knowledge of Git.
  • Knowledge of SQL Server, Entity Framework.
  • Knowledge of Redis is an asset.
  • Knowledge of JavaScript/TypeScript is an asset.
  • Knowledge of Azure Data Lake is an asset.
  • Knowledge of Docker, Kubernetes, and Azure cloud is an asset.
  • Knowledge of audio-video broadcasting on the web (streaming) is an asset.
  • Knowledge of other programming languages is an asset.
  • Knowledge of design patterns is an asset.
  • Good general knowledge and strong intellectual curiosity (to acquire and develop new knowledge and skills).
  • Critical thinking (to question and propose new ideas).
  • A keen interest in the major trends and challenges of the digital world.
  • Meticulousness, independence, and resourcefulness.
  • Excellent stress management and priority setting.
  • Analytical and conceptual thinking skills.
  • Flexibility, initiative, and dynamism.
  • Ability to work in a team, excellent communicator.
  • Bilingualism (English and French) spoken and written is mandatory.

 

Please note that due to the nature of the mandates and responsibilities of this role, all candidates will be required to work in a multilingual environment, where business will be conducted in both official languages (English and French). Therefore, employees working in this role will be expected to make the required efforts and adjustments to navigate this multilingual environment in a respectful manner for all.

 

Please note this is a 12-month contract position, renewable annually. This regular position is not a consulting assignment but a long-term opportunity with competitive CBC/Radio-Canada employee benefits.

job.title: Sales Internship, Townsquare Media Group – Boise
job.description:
Sales Internship, Townsquare Media Group – Boise

*This position requires you to work in-office and on-site as needed. * 

 

Launch Your Sales & Media Career:

Interested in a career in sales, advertising, or digital marketing? Townsquare Media’s Sales Internship gives college students the opportunity to gain real-world experience while learning how businesses use media and marketing to grow.

As a Sales Intern with our Boise team, you won’t spend your internship sitting on the sidelines. You’ll work alongside experienced sales professionals, learn the fundamentals of consultative selling, and gain exposure to the full sales process—from identifying prospective clients and qualifying opportunities to conducting needs analysis and securing appointments.

You’ll also get a behind-the-scenes look at how a local media company operates, with exposure to our radio brands, digital marketing solutions, on-air operations, community events, and the teams that bring it all together.

 

Why Townsquare Media Group?

Townsquare is a media, entertainment, and digital marketing solutions company dedicated to serving small and mid-sized markets across the U.S. We own and operate 354 radio stations and more than 400 local websites across 74 markets—including trusted Boise stations.  

We combine the power of local media with best-in-class digital solutions to help businesses grow—offering everything from broadcast and digital advertising to SEO, web design, and programmatic marketing.

 

What You’ll Do:

As an intern on our Boise sales team, you’ll gain hands-on experience with the fundamentals that drive successful sales organizations. You’ll have the opportunity to:

  • Learn how to identify and research prospective local businesses
  • Develop prospecting skills through phone, email, and other outreach
  • Learn how to qualify potential clients and identify strong sales opportunities
  • Practice conducting needs analysis to better understand a business, its goals, and its marketing challenges
  • Build confidence communicating with business owners and decision-makers
  • Learn how to secure appointments and create opportunities for our sales team
  • Shadow experienced Account Executives throughout different stages of the sales process
  • Gain exposure to client meetings, sales presentations, and marketing strategy
  • Learn how our team uses broadcast, digital, programmatic, and event sponsorship solutions to help local businesses grow
  • Develop an understanding of pipeline management, sales activity, and performance goals

 

You’ll also have opportunities to experience other areas of our Boise operation, including our radio stations, on-air teams, promotions, and off-site events, giving you a broader understanding of how sales connects with the entire organization.

This is a sales-focused internship designed to give you practical experience, meaningful coaching, and a strong foundation in consultative selling.

 

What You’ll Bring:

We’re looking for students who are curious, motivated, and excited to learn. You don’t need previous sales experience—we’ll help you build the skills.

  • Currently pursuing a college degree in Sales, Business, Marketing, Communications, Advertising, or a related field
  • Genuine interest in exploring a career in sales
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Confidence starting conversations and willingness to step outside your comfort zone
  • Coachable mindset and desire to learn
  • Strong work ethic, organization, and follow-through
  • Positive attitude and ability to work collaboratively with a team
  • Interest in media, digital marketing, advertising, or local business is a plus
  • Valid driver's license, auto insurance, and vehicle (required)

 

What’s In It for You?

This internship is designed to give you more than something to add to your resume. You’ll leave with real-world experience and a better understanding of what it takes to build a career in sales.

  • Hands-on sales training and coaching
  • Real-world experience in prospecting, qualifying, needs analysis, and appointment setting
  • Opportunities to shadow successful Account Executives
  • Exposure to digital advertising, radio, programmatic marketing, events, and local media
  • Experience working with local businesses and understanding their marketing challenges
  • Opportunities to attend station and community events
  • Direct access to experienced sales and market leadership
  • A chance to build your professional network and résumé before graduation
  • Exposure to potential career opportunities with Townsquare Media

 

If you’re competitive, curious, comfortable talking to people, and interested in learning how great sellers build relationships and create opportunities, we’d love to meet you.

job.description:
About Gray Media:

Today, we are a growing multimedia company headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia. We are the nation's largest owner of top-rated local television stations and digital assets serving 117 full-power television markets that collectively reach approximately 37% of US television households. The portfolio includes 80 markets with the top-rated television station and 100 markets with the first- and/or second-highest-rated television station in average all-day ratings across 116 of such markets that were measured by Nielsen in 2025. We also own the largest Telemundo Affiliate group with 46 markets and Gray Digital Media, a full-service digital agency offering national and local clients digital marketing strategies with the most advanced digital products and services. Our additional media properties include video production companies Raycom Sports, Tupelo Media Group, and PowerNation Studios, and studio production facilities Assembly Atlanta and Third Rail Studios.

About WILX:

Gray Media Lansing (WILX-WSYM) News 10, home of the highly rated NBC and FOX affiliates in Lansing, Michigan, is on a dynamic growth trajectory. Our combined operations produce over 50 hours of local news per week—and counting. We are Mid-Michigan's undisputed media leader, home to Emmy-award-winning journalists, the Michigan Association of Broadcasters’ “Station of the Year,” your exclusive home for the Detroit Lions on FOX 47, and home to Studio 10, our popular daily local lifestyle show. Alongside our powerhouse primary stations, our family of channels includes MeTV (10.2) and the regional Great Lakes Sports & Entertainment Network (47.2).

Beyond traditional broadcast, we are a true 24/7 multi-platform powerhouse. Through www.News10Lansing.com and our dedicated News 10 and First Alert Weather apps, and our continuous livestreaming channel News10+, our audience stays connected to trusted local coverage whenever and wherever they need it.
We are a breaking news and weather-first station with a fierce commitment to original, local reporting. Our respected anchors and reporters live in the community and have made our newsroom their home—including the longest-running sportscaster in the state of Michigan. Our leadership team is equally passionate about mentoring and developing the next generation of top-tier journalists.

Mid-Michigan (the Lansing/Jackson area) is a big news market, home to the state capital and Michigan State University. It is a vibrant, diverse, stable, and highly affordable region that offers an outstanding quality of life. Lansing is ideally located just an hour from Grand Rapids and downtown Detroit, and is perfect for day trips “up north” to explore some of the most beautiful scenic spots in the country. If you love lakes, boating, fishing, camping, beaches, downhill skiing, craft breweries, local wineries, Broadway shows, Big Ten sports, minor-league baseball, and professional NFL, NBA, and NHL games... Michigan has it all! Come grow your career with our winning, forward-thinking team.

Job Summary/Description:

Are you the kind of person who lives for the Friday night lights and the roar of a Big Ten stadium? Do you believe that sports are about more than just box scores — that they’re about the heartbeat of a community? We’re looking for a high-energy Sports Reporter and Anchor to join our powerhouse team at WILX and WSYM. Whether you’re breaking down a massive Spartans win, profiling a high school underdog, or owning the conversation on social media, you’ll be the face of sports in Mid-Michigan. This isn't just a job behind a desk; it’s a multi-platform mission to tell the stories that matter most to our fans.

Duties/Responsibilities include, but are not limited to: 

What You'll Do:
• Own the sports desk: Anchor high-energy sportscasts that move beyond simple highlights to provide the context and depth our viewers crave.
• Tell "More Than a Game" stories: Shoot, write, and edit compelling packages that capture the raw emotion and community pride of Mid-Michigan sports.
• Drive the digital conversation: Break stories on our website, mobile app, social media channels – engage with fans on digital platforms and find creative ways to grow our streaming presence.
• Lead the "Prep Rally": Take a front-row seat in our award-winning live high school, college, and pro sports coverage, from Friday night football specials to athlete profiles.
• Enterprise local features: Dig deep to find the stories no one else is telling, building relationships with coaches, athletes, and local legends.

Qualifications/Requirements:

What You Bring:
• A killer on-air presence: You’re confident, authentic, and you know how to connect with an audience.
• Digital-first DNA: You understand that "the game" happens on Twitter, TikTok, Instagram, and our app just as much as it happens on the field.
• Scrappy MMJ skills: You’re a pro at shooting your own video and editing on the fly.
• Deep sports IQ: You know your way around a playbook and can speak the language of everything from Big Ten basketball to local golf.
• Urgency and accuracy: You thrive under the pressure of a ticking clock and never sacrifice the facts for speed.
• A team-player mindset: You’re ready to jump in, take feedback, and help the whole team win.
• The essentials: A degree in Journalism or a related field, a valid driver’s license, and a clean driving record are must-haves.

Why You'll Love It Here:
• The Ultimate Sports Market: From the intensity of Michigan State University to the deep-rooted traditions of our local high schools, you’ll never run out of great stories to tell.
• Innovation First: We’re not stuck in the past. You’ll have access to the latest tech and a team that’s obsessed with the future of digital media.
• Community Impact: You’ll be a local celebrity with a purpose, using your platform to highlight the best of Mid-Michigan.
• Growth Opportunities: As part of Gray Media, you’re joining a company that invests in its people and provides a clear path for career advancement.
• A Winning Culture: Work with a team of exceptional journalists who are as passionate about excellence as you are.

Ready to take the field and make your mark in Mid-Michigan? Let’s talk.

Your Day-to-Day (aka the Playbook)

Join our media sales team and play a pivotal role in helping brands and companies grow. By identifying new opportunities, building strong client relationships, and delivering impactful solutions, you'll showcase how our multi-media content platforms and digital assets can drive meaningful results for our partners. 

 

Your focus will be on helping clients achieve their goals, ensuring that every campaign is a success. When our clients win, we win—and we believe in celebrating those victories together! 

  

Make Connections: Embrace your powers of persuasion and make every handshake and meeting count! Every interaction is a chance to build a genuine connection and show clients how we can help them succeed. You're not just selling; you're building partnerships. You're helping businesses find the right audience in the right place at the right time. When we say One Partner, Endless Possibilities, we mean it! 

 

Be A Trusted Guide: In this role, you'll connect with clients on a human level, understand their unique needs, and craft tailored sales and marketing solutions that deliver results. As their trusted advisor, you'll help them navigate the ever-evolving marketing landscape, ensuring every step of the journey is planned with care and precision.  

 

Shake Things Up: Bring your creativity and fresh ideas to the table! We're looking for someone who challenges the status quo, embraces innovation, and finds new ways to connect with our audience. Your contributions will help elevate our brand and drive meaningful results for your clients.  

 

Join us and Conquer the Media Landscape: You'll be part of a dedicated team of A1 media sales professionals, committed to achieving market leadership. Together, we amplify our impact, deliver exceptional outcomes, and help our clients succeed in ways that truly matter. 

 

Identify Emerging Opportunities: It's about being able to see what others can't, anticipating market shifts, analyzing data and predicting the next big thing. Your insights will position our clients and AMP for long-term success.  

  

What We're Looking For 

Proven Sales Ability (or an Unstoppable Desire to Learn) 

Whether you're a seasoned sales professional or just getting started, we value your drive, energy, and passion for achieving results. 

 

Strong Communication Skills: You're a natural at building relationships and communicating effectively. Proficiency with digital tools and applications is a must. 

 

A Passion for helping Others: You're committed to understanding clients' needs, providing top-notch customer service and making a difference. You're not just selling a product; you're providing a solution.  

 

A Competitive Spirit: Do you get a little boost when you achieve a goal (especially if it was a tough one)? We love that for you (and us)!  We want someone who's driven to excel but also knows how to celebrate the victories (big and small) with their team. That drive makes you a valuable part of our organization.  

 

A Willingness to Grow: Do you thrive in environments where you're always learning something new? Excellent, you'll fit right in! The media world is constantly evolving, and the ability to learn, adapt, and embrace challenges in a fast-paced, digital-first environment is key.  

 

The Practical Stuff 

A valid driver's license, up-to-date insurance, and reliable transportation are necessary for connecting with clients in your community. 

 

Why Join AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions? / The Reasons You Should Hit "Apply Now" 

 

Serious Work, Seriously Cool People: Be part of a dynamic team that values creativity, collaboration, and fun! We are all for work that is rewarding.  

 

The Compensation Package: We offer a base salary, commission structure, and benefits package designed to support your success and well-being. Happy employees don't stage rebellions! ;) 

 

We Make a Real Difference (Not Just Talk About It): At AMP, we help local businesses thrive through advertising strategies that create tangible impacts. Our media sales specialist isn't just selling ads; they're the boots on the ground, making a real difference where it counts. (And yes, it feels pretty good.) 

 

Top-Notch Training and Support: We're not the kind of company that hires you and then disappears into the corporate abyss. We carefully select candidates for a cohort-based training program, where you'll join a group of sales professionals from all over the country. From onboarding to ongoing mentorship, we invest in your success with training programs that set you up for long-term growth. 

 

Career Growth Opportunities: We believe in investing in you. That's why you'll have access to training, mentorship, and career advancement opportunities to help you thrive. We are a leader in our industry, flexing our local charm and national muscle, providing you with options to amplify your career in your local market or join one of our AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions teams in another city.  

 

Comprehensive Media Education (We Are Your Power Source!): New to the industry? We've got you covered with training programs that turn curiosity into expertise.   

 

AMP is us. It's you. It isn't just a name; it's a mission. A promise to amplify our reach, amplify our innovation, and most importantly, amplify you. If you're ready to grow your career and help businesses achieve their goals, we'd love to hear from you.

We’re looking for an Associate Producer for an exciting interactive entertainment project to support the creation, tracking, and execution of game assets for a discipline (environment, characters, audio, animation). In this role, you will help teams stay organized by maintaining asset schedules, tracking progress, coordinating priorities, following up on dependencies, and supporting milestone delivery. 

You will work closely with craft directors, producers, pod leads, and multidisciplinary teams to support asset production from request through review, approval, integration, and delivery. You will help ensure creative and technical asset goals are translated into clear tasks, visible progress, and reliable execution across disciplines, pods, and pillars. 

Key Responsibilities: 

  • Help build and maintain asset schedules, task lists, production plans, and milestone deliverables.  
  • Track daily progress across assigned teams and ensure asset status is accurate in project tools.  
  • Maintain visibility on blockers, dependencies, approvals, reviews, known issues, and next steps.  
  • Coordinate priorities between craft directors, product owners, producers, pod leads, and pillar needs.  
  • Support asset reviews, feedback sessions, approvals, and follow-up actions.  
  • Identify risks, blockers, or priority conflicts and escalate them to producers or production leadership.  
  • Facilitate communication between design, engineering, art, animation, audio, QA, and other departments.  
  • Help maintain production tracking tools such as Jira, Confluence, or similar tools.  
  • Work with QA and development teams to ensure asset-related issues are tracked and followed up effectively.  
  • Support milestone readiness by helping ensure asset deliverables, dependencies, reviews, and known issues are clearly tracked.  
  • Help refine asset workflows, pipelines, tracking practices, and communication habits.  
  • Contribute to retrospectives or post-milestone reviews and follow through on actionable improvements.

Dans ce rôle, vous aiderez les équipes à rester organisées en maintenant les plannings des assets, en suivant la progression, en coordonnant les priorités, en assurant le suivi des dépendances et en soutenant la livraison des jalons. 

Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les directeurs de discipline, les producers, les leads de pods et des équipes multidisciplinaires afin de soutenir la production des assets depuis la demande jusqu’à la revue, l’approbation, l’intégration et la livraison. Vous contribuerez à garantir que les objectifs créatifs et techniques liés aux assets sont traduits en tâches claires, en progression visible et en une exécution fiable à travers les disciplines, les pods et les piliers. 

Responsabilités Principales:

  • Contribuer à la création et au maintien des plannings d’assets, des listes de tâches, des plans de production et des livrables de jalons.  
  • Suivre la progression quotidienne des équipes assignées et garantir que le statut des assets est exact dans les outils de projet.

  • Contribuer à l’amélioration des flux de travail des assets, des pipelines, des pratiques de suivi et des modes de communication.

Atouts Souhaités:

  • Expérience en suivi de production, en gestion de listes d’assets, en reporting de livraison ou en planification de jalons.

We own and operate leading entertainment and news brands, including NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo, and Peacock, our premium ad-supported streaming service. We have a rich tradition of giving back and ensuring our employees have the opportunity to serve their communities. As part of the Security Operations Team, this position plays a key role in helping maintain a safe, secure and welcoming environment across CityWalk and Universal Studios Hollywood by planning, organizing and directing crime prevention operations throughout our iconic Theme Park destination.

  • Promptly resolve security issues that involve entities associated with Universal Studios Hollywood (USH) and CityWalk.
  • Conduct detailed analysis of Security incident/crime statistics, prepare statistical reports, conduct presentations to management and recommend appropriate Security deployment and tactics based on analysis.

  • Liaise with other NBCU and USH departments to provide timely notifications and conduct a variety of investigations.
  • Conduct detailed analysis of requests for security and law enforcement intervention, providing assistance and expertise.
  • Conduct periodic audits of security operations insuring the continual pursuit of efficiency, productivity and quality customer services.
  • Demonstrate the ability to maintain one's composure while handling multiple tasks simultaneously in a high-pressure, ever-changing, environment.
  • Prepare operational and situational reports to assist in security deployment planning and risk mitigation.
  • Provide complete, timely and accurate notification and documentation of incidents using company tracking systems.

Basic Requirements:

  • 10+ years' experience in a number of increasingly responsible positions in law enforcement or a related applicable security profession.
  • Proven organizational, written and verbal communications skills effective at all levels of the organization.
  • Availability and willingness to work Nights, Weekends and Holidays dictated by business needs.
  • Availability and willingness to adjust schedule and cover special events and shift with short notice.

Desired Characteristics:

  • BA/BS Degree preferred.
  • Previous media/entertainment experience.
  • Previous experience in a corporate security environment.
  • Certified law enforcement or security trainer (such as POST certification).
  • Demonstrate a working knowledge of a variety of security technology systems.
  • Familiarity with alarm monitoring and physical security systems.
  • Proficient with MS Office Programs (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
  • Ability to multi-task, overseeing multiple projects at the same time.
  • Experience and training in threat assessment, investigations, risk management and counter- terrorism.
  • Possess a Carry Concealed Weapon (CCW) Permit.
  • Possess a BSIS Guard Card and Exposed Firearm Permit.

job.description:
NBCUniversal is one of the world's leading media and entertainment companies. We own and operate leading entertainment and news brands, including NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo, and Peacock, our premium ad-supported streaming service. With unequalled scale, our teams make the most out of every opportunity to collaborate and learn from one another. We’re always looking for ways to innovate faster, accelerate our growth and consistently offer the very best in consumer experience. But most of all, we’re backed by a culture of respect. The Vice President, Content Delivery Networks will be part of the Global Video Engineering organization and will be responsible for overall strategy, design, and execution of content delivery for our OTT products. The Vice President will oversee a team of CDN, Data and Software engineers who are subject matter experts in next generation distribution, who will ensure the fidelity, quality, and availability of our delivery network for the benefit of our global audiences.

Job Responsibilities

Technical Expertise

  • Devise and execute Content Delivery Strategy to deliver current and planned media products & events at necessary performance & scale.
  • Attract and retain a multi-national team of subject matter experts to deliver strategy.
  • Develop relationships and engage with partner ISPs & telco industry to ensure performant access.
  • Collaborate with procurement teams to manage key vendor commercial relationships.
  • Ensure technology decisions supporting strategy are made from the latest market research of vendors and competition.
  • Engage with Legal and Finance teams to negotiate vendor contracts and manage budgets.
  • Conduct Short/long term technology evaluations (e.g. multicast, p2p, hybrid/ISP CDNs, deeper distribution, self-build CDN)
  • Involvement in E2E technology planning, product governance and regulatory/legal matters.
  • Own the end-to-end CDN roadmap, including capacity planning, performance optimization, resiliency, cost efficiency, and future-state architecture across global streaming products.
  • Set and govern CDN reliability, quality, and performance standards, ensuring measurable KPIs and SLAs for availability, latency, startup time, rebuffering, and overall viewer experience.
  • Lead incident readiness and operational excellence for high-profile live events and peak traffic moments, including escalation protocols, risk mitigation, and post-event learnings.
  • Partner with Product, Operations, Distribution, and Platform Engineering to ensure CDN strategy supports business priorities, product launches, global expansion, and audience growth.
  • Drive vendor strategy and optimization, including multi-CDN strategy, contract performance, vendor scorecards, cost modeling, and negotiation support.
  • Champion innovation in next-generation content delivery, including automation, observability, traffic steering, edge compute, ISP partnerships, and emerging delivery models.
  • Establish data-driven decision-making practices by using real-time monitoring, analytics, and performance insights to improve delivery quality and business outcomes.
  • Ensure security, compliance, and risk controls are embedded into CDN architecture and third-party partnerships, especially for global content distribution.
  • Develop succession plans and an organizational structure for the CDN function to ensure scalability, continuity, and long-term leadership depth.
  • Represent the CDN function with senior executives, translating technical performance, risk, investment needs, and roadmap tradeoffs into clear business recommendations.

Leadership Capabilities

  • Strategic leader with the ability to set a clear vision, translate business priorities into actionable technology roadmaps, and drive execution across complex, global teams.
  • Proven ability to lead through influence, build trusted partnerships across Product, Engineering, Operations, Legal, Finance, Procurement, and executive stakeholders, and align teams around shared outcomes. 
  • Strong people leadership skills, including attracting, developing, and retaining high-performing technical talent while fostering accountability, collaboration, inclusion, and continuous improvement.
  • Executive presence and communication skills, with the ability to simplify complex technical topics, make data-informed recommendations, and influence senior leaders.
  • Ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, high-scale environment, balancing innovation, operational excellence, risk management, and business impact.

Required Qualifications

  • Minimum of five (5) years’ experience leading a CDN function
  • Expertise in software security best practices and tooling
  • Expertise in digital video codecs and encoding profiles
  • Experience in digital media or direct-to-consumer video business highly preferred
  • Expertise in high-availability software patterns and performance testing
  • Knowledge of Cloud & Container Security

  • Passionate about leading a team of engineers and committed to building world-class software systems
  • Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, comfortable communicating with technical and non-technical colleagues and executives

job.title: Account Manager, Programmatic Sales
job.description:
Storytelling is, and will always be, the heart of what we do at Skydance.
Our vision is to build a thriving entertainment ecosystem where stories and worlds are imagined, brought to life and experienced. We create for every age and audience, anchored by the strength of our content and experiences and the depth of our connection with fans. We are creator-first, audience-focused, tech-forward, globally scaled.

 

Here, you’ll work with talented teams that move fast, think boldly and collaborate with purpose to deliver results. We aim high, champion the best ideas and win together, earning the trust of our employees, creators, partners and audiences every day.

 

If you’re energized by the opportunity to help build the next-generation global media and entertainment company powered by creativity and technology, we’d be thrilled to welcome you aboard. LET’S GO!

 

 

Overview:

As part of the Programmatic sales team, the Programmatic Account Manager plays an important role in growing our programmatic advertising revenue. Programmatic Account Managers are in charge of collaborating with the Programmatic and Direct AEs to manage existing business and generate new programmatic revenue from agencies and marketers, with a consultative and technical advertising approach.   This role requires deep knowledge and comprehension of programmatic advertising and the supporting AdTech ecosystem of DSPs and SSPs, and a strategic and analytical approach to troubleshooting, data analytics and client relations.   The Programmatic Account Management team is a central team within the Sales organization tasked with spearheading programmatic revenue and embracing the innovation and ad technology that our programmatic team brings to the marketplace. The Programmatic sales team partners with the convergent sales team and executives working with direct clients, agencies, and third-party partners (e. g. SSPs, DSPs, ATDs, etc).   Located in New York, the Programmatic Account Manager supports our programmatic sales team with planning, executing and monitoring the programmatic ad campaigns. This role works closely with Programmatic clients, the Programmatic and Direct Sales teams and the Programmatic Partnerships team to ensure impeccable campaign planning and execution. This includes diligent campaign management across all steps of the sales process (Pre-sales, Campaign Launch, Post Delivery) while working closely with internal stakeholders, clients and partners to maximize the effectiveness and revenue potential of their programmatic deals and campaigns.    

Responsibilities include but not limited to:

  • Support the education and evangelization of our programmatic strategy, best practices, and offerings both internally and externally. Serving as a key programmatic subject matter expert, evangelist and sales resource to drive programmatic revenue via PMPs and PG.
  • Develop a solid awareness of our Ad Tech stack, integrated partners and the general programmatic ecosystem
  • Become power user of key third-party systems such as Salesforce, Operative and SSP user portals (such as FreeWheel, Magnite and PubMatic) which are utilized for deal set up, management, troubleshooting and forecasting.
  • Serve as the PMP Deal Manager and Client Service Lead for your assigned Hold Co and Accounts with:
  • Pre Campaign Launch/Deal Creation - Lead PMP Deal Set up and Troubleshooting including Creative QA process, Forecasting support
  • Deal Launch - Forward-thinking Deal Monitoring, Continued Troubleshooting to ensure campaigns start on time and without any issues
  • Deal Monitoring - Observant PMP campaign monitoring to maximize spend - including PMP pacing spend/deal health, optimizations/recommendations, Internal and External PMP Reporting from Salesforce/Freewheel, continued forecasting support
  • Client Servicing - Forward-thinking involvement with your Programmatic clients through regular check ins to provide regular PMP reports and insights related to deal health while Instilling PMP Best Practices with buyers
  • Sales Prospecting - Support your assigned Programmatic Account Executives proactive prospecting providing spend reports through indirect opportunities, bid CPM optimization, week over week top spenders across Direct & Indirect businesses
  • Collaborate with the Direct Sales team with Programmatic Guaranteed Deal Management to ensure campaign delivery and troubleshooting.

 

Basic Qualifications:

  • A BS/BA degree, or equivalent training and experience
  • 2+ years proven advertising sales experience in the programmatic space

 

Additional Qualifications:

  • Programmatic-savvy expertise and an entrepreneurial spirit who will thrive in a team, solution selling and goal-oriented environment
  • A solid knowledge of the digital advertising ecosystem and current industry trends in display, video, and native
  • A deep desire to win and grow as a sales professional
  • A solid foundational comprehension of basic data analytics including key functions in programs such as Excel and Google Sheets
  • Remarkable organizational skills
  • An ability to solution-sell to both business and technical audiences
  • Well-developed presentation skills
  • An ability to manage stress well, and juggle multiple account challenges at once
  • An extremely detail oriented approach with solid analytical thinking, negotiation, strategic problem solving, organizational, and time management skills

 


About Skydance
Skydance is a next-generation global media and entertainment company, comprised of three business segments: Studios, Direct-to-Consumer, and TV Media. Skydance's portfolio unites legendary brands, including Paramount, Warner Bros., HBO and HBO Max, Paramount+, Pluto TV, CBS, CNN, CBS Sports, TNT Sports, Nickelodeon, Cartoon Network, MTV, Food Network, BET, HGTV, and Comedy Central.

Job Title

Security Operations Supervisor

Job Description

About The Position | Major Goals and Objectives and Location Requirements:

People Inc. is seeking an experienced former law enforcement professional to serve as Security Operations Supervisor, to oversee front-desk security operations and provide hands-on support for event security and incident response. Reporting to the Manager, Security Operations, this position is primarily stationed at the ground-floor front desk and combines a professional, welcoming presence with the judgment and experience needed to protect employees, executives, and visitors.

The Supervisor works alongside in-house and contracted security personnel, coordinates front-of-house coverage, and provides operational direction during events and emergencies. The role works closely with the GSOC, reception, Facilities, and event organizers to maintain effective communication and consistent security procedures.


Schedule Requirements:

Full In-Office

In-office Expectations: This position is a fully in-office role due to the nature of the work being done.
 

About The Team | The Team and/or Brand:

The Security team at People Inc. is responsible for ensuring the safety and security of employees, facilities, and assets across all office site locations. The team partners closely with contracted security staff, reception, facilities, event teams, and law enforcement agencies to deliver a consistent and resilient security program.


About The Position’s Contributions:

Accountabilities, Actions, and Expected Measurable Results


Front Desk Security and Guest Services

  • Oversee daily front-desk security operations, coordinate post coverage, provide operational direction to assigned security personnel, and ensure visitor access procedures and service standards are consistently followed.
  • Greet and assist employees, executives, visitors, vendors, and delivery personnel in a professional and courteous manner. Verify visitor identities, appointments, and access authorization.
  • Maintain awareness of lobby and entrance activity; identify and address unauthorized access, suspicious activity, disruptive behavior, and other security concerns.
  • Use sound judgment and de-escalation techniques to manage difficult interactions and respond appropriately to potential threats.
  • Support routine visitor badging and temporary access needs in accordance with established procedures, and coordinate credential issues with designated security personnel.
  • Coordinate front-desk, turnstile, and reception coverage, ensuring appropriate relief when responding to incidents or supporting events.

Event Security Oversight

  • Assist with security planning and oversee on-site security operations for internal meetings, executive events, and third-party events.
  • Coordinate event security staffing and post assignments; brief personnel on event details, expected attendees, access procedures, relevant security concerns, and escalation protocols.
  • Oversee event entry procedures, guest check-in, and visitor flow; coordinate with event organizers, vendors, the GSOC, and public safety personnel as needed.

Incident Response and GSOC Coordination

  • Respond to security incidents, medical emergencies, workplace violence concerns, and evacuations; provide initial direction to security personnel until relieved by Security Management or public safety responders.
  • Maintain communication with the GSOC during incidents and events, ensuring timely escalation, required notifications, and coordination of responding resources.
  • Prepare accurate incident reports and operational records, communicate concerns to Security Management, and assist with follow-up and after-action reviews.


The Role’s Minimum Qualifications and Job Requirements:


Education: 

College degree in criminal justice, security management, or a related field.


Required Qualifications


Law Enforcement and Leadership Experience

  • Minimum of five years of sworn law enforcement experience, including substantial field response, public interaction, and management of difficult or unpredictable situations.
  • Demonstrated experience in de-escalation, emergency response, and making sound decisions under pressure.
  • Experience directing personnel or coordinating operations during routine assignments, incidents, or special events.

Licenses and Certifications

  • Must be authorized to carry a firearm in the performance of assigned security duties and maintain all required licenses, certifications, and qualifications.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain required First Aid, CPR, AED, and applicable FDNY certifications.

Professional Skills and Operational Requirements

  • Ability and willingness to work primarily at the front desk in a hands-on security and guest-facing role.
  • Professional demeanor and strong customer-service, verbal, and written communication skills, including the ability to interact effectively with senior executives and the public.
  • Working knowledge of access control, CCTV, visitor management, and incident reporting systems; proficiency with Microsoft Office.
  • Ability to work independently, follow established procedures, and coordinate effectively with other security personnel and departments.
  • Ability to perform the essential duties of the position, including patrols and periods of standing or walking, with or without reasonable accommodation.
  • Successful completion of required pre-employment screening.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in corporate security, executive-facing environments, or event security operations.
  • Experience coordinating in-house and contracted security personnel and working with a GSOC or command center.

job.title: Insights Analyst, Implementation & QA
job.description:
OVERVIEW

A thriving, mission-driven multimedia organization, NPR produces award-winning news, information, and music programming in partnership with hundreds of independent public radio stations across the nation. The NPR audience values information, creativity, curiosity, and social responsibility – and our employees do too. We are innovators and leaders in diverse fields, from journalism and digital media to IT and development. Every day, our employees and member stations touch the lives of millions worldwide. 

Across our organization, we’re building a workplace where collaboration is essential, diverse voices are heard, and inclusion is the key to our success. We are committed to doing the right thing in our journalism and in every role at NPR. This means that integrity, adherence to our ethical standards, and compliance with legal obligations are fundamental responsibilities for every employee at NPR.

Application Deadline:

Please submit your application by 5:00 pm EST on October 23rd, 2026

Intro to Position

You will be critical to building a new, leaner, audience-centric, data-driven app that serves NPR and partnering stations in multi-modal formats. As the Insights Analyst, you will support data-informed decision-making for NPR’s digital ecosystem. Central to this role is hands-on SQL expertise—writing complex queries against massive, unaggregated datasets, translating raw digital behavior into actionable product insights.

In this role, you will be the main point of contact to create measurement plans, implement and QC analytics tags, build automated dashboards, and perform deep-dive analyses across app, web, and video platforms. Working closely with digital product teams, the newsroom, and member station leaders, you will apply a blend of data curiosity and technical pragmatism to expand weekly audiences, increase listening hours, and deepen daily habits.

This role reports to the Audience Insights Director, Digital Insights.

A thriving, mission-driven multimedia organization, NPR produces award-winning news, information, and music programming in partnership with hundreds of independent public radio stations across the nation. The NPR audience values information, creativity, curiosity, and social responsibility – and our employees do too. We are innovators and leaders in diverse fields, from journalism and digital media to IT and development. Every day, our employees and member stations touch the lives of millions worldwide. 

Across our organization, we’re building a workplace where collaboration is essential, diverse voices are heard, and inclusion is the key to our success. We are committed to doing the right thing in our journalism and in every role at NPR. This means that integrity, adherence to our ethical standards, and compliance with legal obligations are fundamental responsibilities for every employee at NPR.

Application Deadline:

Please submit your application by 5:00 pm EST on October 23rd, 2026

Intro to Position

You will be critical to building a new, leaner, audience-centric, data-driven app that serves NPR and partnering stations in multi-modal formats. As the Senior Insights Analyst, Mobile Analytics, you will drive data-informed decision-making for the NPR App, serving as the core owner of platform experimentation and advanced mobile product analytics.

Central to this role is high-level SQL mastery. You will extract actionable insights from complex, unaggregated datasets—frequently writing advanced queries (e.g., raw GA4 and Firebase exports in BigQuery) for deep cohort, behavioral, and retention analyses. Additionally, you will establish quality control standards for SQL execution across the team, train colleagues on query optimization, and design end-to-end A/B tests that expand weekly audiences, deepen listening habits, and maximize revenue yield.
