job.title: Senior Full Stack Software Engineer, Front End Subscriptions
job.description:
Join the future of news

We’re on a mission to deliver riveting storytelling for all of America. At The Washington Post, you’ll help reinvent news. Our work is driven by a deep investigative spirit and enhanced by innovation to bring audiences closer to the stories that matter most.


About Our Team


The Washington Post is powered by the passion and talent of our people. It takes all of us to reinvent news. Beyond our award-winning News and Opinions teams, we work across many departments, including Brand & Events, Communications, Customer Care, Engineering & Product, Finance, Human Resources, Legal, Marketing & Advertising, Print Operations, and Sales.


Why This Role Matters

 

We are looking for a Senior Full Stack Software Engineer to join the Subscriptions team at The Washington Post. This role spans the full application stack with a strong emphasis on frontend applications and customer-facing experiences. You will design and build modern web applications primarily using React and TypeScript, while also contributing to backend services built with Java and Node.js and the AWS infrastructure and deployment systems that support them.


As a senior engineer, you will take ownership of complex technical work from design through production, contribute to architectural decisions, and help improve the quality, performance, reliability, accessibility, and maintainability of the applications our subscription products depend on.


The ideal candidate brings strong frontend engineering experience, particularly with React, JavaScript, and TypeScript, along with practical experience working with backend services and APIs. You should be able to contribute to Java and Node.js applications and be comfortable with AWS, CI/CD, observability, and production operations. This is a frontend-focused role, but you should be capable of delivering effectively across the full stack.


We value autonomy, initiative, strong technical judgment, clear communication, and meaningful day-to-day use of AI-assisted engineering tools, including continually finding new ways to apply AI to software development, automation, operations, and team effectiveness.


What Motivates You

  • Strong sense of ownership and accountability for the software you build and the customer experiences it supports.
  • Passionate about designing accessible, performant, reliable, and maintainable frontend applications.
  • Enjoys solving complex frontend and full-stack problems and driving work from design through production.
  • Comfortable working across React applications, backend services and APIs, AWS infrastructure, and production operations.
  • Proactive and comfortable driving complex work with a high degree of autonomy.
  • Interested in understanding how applications operate in production rather than treating deployment and infrastructure as separate concerns.
  • Actively uses AI in day-to-day engineering and continually looks for ways to expand its impact on development, testing, automation, troubleshooting, and productivity.
  • Enjoys collaborating across engineering, product, and design while mentoring other engineers and communicating technical decisions clearly.

How You'll Support the Mission

  • Design, build, test, deploy, and operate customer-facing applications and services supporting our subscription products.
  • Develop modern frontend applications primarily using React, JavaScript, and TypeScript.
  • Build and improve subscription experiences such as checkout, offers, paywalls, product pages, subscriber lifecycle flows, and mobile web and native app integrations.
  • Own technical solutions throughout their lifecycle, from architecture and implementation through deployment, observability, production support, and continuous improvement.
  • Make thoughtful frontend architectural decisions around component design, application structure, state management, API integration, performance, accessibility, and maintainability.
  • Build reusable components, shared libraries, and frontend patterns that improve consistency and development efficiency.
  • Contribute to backend services, APIs, integrations, automation, and tooling built with Java and Node.js.
  • Collaborate with backend engineers to define reliable API contracts and integration patterns that support customer-facing experiences.
  • Work with AWS services and infrastructure supporting our applications and contribute to CI/CD, deployment automation, and Infrastructure as Code.
  • Establish strong observability and diagnose issues spanning frontend applications, backend services, integrations, infrastructure, and deployment systems.
  • Participate in the team’s on-call rotation, taking ownership of incident diagnosis, mitigation, communication, and follow-up.
  • Identify technical debt, performance bottlenecks, architectural limitations, and opportunities for improvement and proactively drive solutions.
  • Mentor engineers and contribute to technical standards, architecture discussions, documentation, code quality, and engineering best practices.
  • Use AI throughout the engineering lifecycle to improve development, testing, troubleshooting, automation, documentation, and operational workflows.

The Skills and Experience You Bring

  • Broad expertise building responsive, high-performance web applications using React, JavaScript, and TypeScript.
  • Solid background developing backend services and RESTful APIs using Java and Node.js.
  • Experience working within AWS ecosystems, including containerized workloads (Docker/ECS) and foundational Infrastructure as Code concepts.
  • Strong knowledge of core web technologies, responsive layouts, web accessibility standards, and browser performance optimization.
  • Hands-on experience establishing CI/CD automation and deployment pipeline configurations.
  • Familiarity with production monitoring and observability tools, including logging, metrics, alerting, and incident response.
  • Background building conversion-critical customer experiences, such as checkout flows, subscription systems, paywalls, or payment integrations.
  • Experience integrating web applications and micro-frontends with native mobile app environments.
  • Practical experience using AI-assisted engineering tools to support day-to-day software development, testing, and troubleshooting.

Minimum Qualifications

  • BA/BS in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5+ years of frontend development with React, JavaScript, and TypeScript.
  • 3+ years of backend development with Java, Node.js, or both.
  • 2+ years of experience deploying and operating applications in AWS.
  • Strong knowledge of HTML, CSS, responsive design, accessibility, browser behavior, and frontend performance.
  • Experience with frontend architecture, reusable components, state management, API integration, and automated testing.
  • Experience building and integrating with RESTful APIs and distributed backend services.
  • Experience with AWS services such as ECS, Lambda, S3, RDS, IAM, and CloudWatch.
  • Experience with CI/CD and deployment automation using Jenkins or comparable tooling.
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code using AWS CDK, Terraform, CloudFormation, or comparable technologies.
  • Experience building and operating containerized applications using Docker and ECS.
  • Experience with production observability, including logs, metrics, dashboards, alerting, and troubleshooting.
  • Experience supporting production applications through on-call rotations and incident response.
  • Ability to independently scope and drive complex technical work from design through production.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Significant hands-on use of AI-assisted engineering tools in day-to-day development, testing, troubleshooting, documentation, or automation.

Preferred Qualifications

  • 7+ years of frontend development with React, JavaScript, and TypeScript.
  • 4+ years of backend development with Java, Node.js, or both.
  • 3+ years of experience designing, deploying, and operating applications in AWS.
  • Experience with frontend monorepos, shared component libraries, design systems, or reusable application frameworks.
  • Experience building high-volume or conversion-sensitive experiences such as checkout, payments, subscriptions, ecommerce, registration, or account management.
  • Experience integrating web applications with native mobile applications.
  • Strong experience with Jenkins, AWS CDK, Terraform, containerized deployments, and automated delivery pipelines.
  • Experience with observability platforms such as Datadog, Catchpoint, and AWS-native monitoring services.
  • Experience improving frontend performance, accessibility, application reliability, and developer productivity.
  • Experience mentoring engineers and influencing frontend architecture and engineering practices across team boundaries.
  • Advanced use of AI-assisted engineering tools, including helping other engineers apply AI effectively across development, testing, automation, troubleshooting, and operations.

 

Collaboration makes us stronger. That’s why our offices are designed with open layouts, modern technology, and easy access to transportation. With certain exceptions for newsgathering and business travel, we work on-site five days a week.

Compensation and Benefits

Wherever you are in your life or career, The Washington Post offers comprehensive and inclusive benefits for every step of your journey:

  • Competitive medical, dental and vision coverage

  • Company-paid pension and 401(k) match

  • Three weeks of vacation and up to three weeks of paid sick leave

  • Nine paid holidays and two personal days

  • 20 weeks paid parental leave for any new parent

  • Robust mental health resources

  • Backup care and caregiver concierge services

  • Gender affirming services

  • Pet insurance

  • Free Post digital subscription

  • Leadership and career development programs

Benefits may vary based on the job, full-time or part-time schedule, location, and collectively bargained status.

The salary range for this position is:

$119,700 - $199,300 Annual

The actual salary within this range will depend on individual skills, experience, and qualifications as they relate to specific job requirements. This position may be eligible for a bonus or incentive program, and a member of the Talent Acquisition team will discuss bonus payment terms and conditions during the interview process.

Your story awaits. Apply today!

Learn more about The Post at careers.washingtonpost.com.

job.title: Information Technology Manager - WPXI TV
job.description:
Location: PA-Pittsburgh

Job Title:  Information Technology Manager - WPXI TV

 

Position Overview

WPXI TV, a Cox Media Group (CMG) station in Pittsburgh, PA, is seeking an experienced, highly motivated I.T. Manager. Operating in the nation’s 26th largest television market, this hands-on leadership role manages the station's entire computing environment, localized server architecture, high-security network perimeters, and integrated broadcast-I.T. ecosystems.

 

The I.T. Manager ensures 24/7/365 operational continuity for our live news, production, and multi-platform digital channels. The ideal candidate will blend advanced systems administration with deep technical knowledge of specialized, automated broadcast television environments. This role reports directly to the Director of Engineering and works in tandem with the station's local engineering team and CMG corporate technology group.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Broadcast-I.T. Integration & Support: Maintain high-level technical oversight, provisioning, and daily troubleshooting for mission-critical newsroom and automation systems including Avid, iNews, Grass Valley Ignite, Harmonic, Crispin, Chyron, and Wide Orbit.
  • Infrastructure & Storage Management: Administer and optimize local storage and server environments, directly overseeing the station’s virtualized server platforms (VMware/Hyper-V) and high-capacity NetApp network-attached storage (NAS/SAN) infrastructure.
  • Network & Security Enforcement: Serve as the local gatekeeper for network security. Manage, patch, and monitor the station's Fortinet infrastructure (firewalls, switches, and secure access points), ensuring strict adherence to CMG corporate cybersecurity mandates.
  • Systems & Automation Administration: Direct the optimization of Microsoft enterprise environments, Active Directory, endpoint systems, and localized automated script pipelines to minimize operational overhead and drive reliability.
  • User Support Leadership: Manage the local help desk workflow, ensuring high-priority, zero-downtime technical support for live control rooms, field news crews, digital production teams, sales, and administrative staff.
  • Disaster Recovery & Redundancy: Formulate, test, and manage strict local business continuity blueprints, ensuring off-site cloud backups and local hardware redundancies preserve the on-air and digital stream integrity during critical weather or emergency events.

 

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Broadcast Engineering, or equivalent combined professional experience.
  •  5+ years of experience in systems administration, network engineering, or I.T. infrastructure management, with a proven track record working inside a high-pressure, live broadcast television or multi-platform media environment.
  • Technical Proficiencies:
    • Advanced administration of Microsoft Server, Active Directory, Group Policy, and desktop operating systems.
    • Strong knowledge of virtualization technologies (VMware Horizon/vSphere) and enterprise storage management (NetApp solutions).
    • Profound understanding of core networking concepts (TCP/IP, VLAN segmentation, routing protocols, and QoS settings for media over IP).
  • Must be willing to participate in an on-call emergency rotation encompassing nights, weekends, and holiday coverage to support a continuous news cycle.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Security & Networking Certifications: Active certifications in corporate networking and perimeter protection (e.g., Fortinet Network Security Expert (NSE), Cisco CCNA, or Microsoft Certified Solutions Expert).
  • Industry Accreditations: Society of Broadcast Engineers (SBE) certifications—specifically the Certified Broadcast Networking Engineer (CBNE) or Certified Broadcast Networking Technologist (CBNT)—are highly valued.

About Cox Media Group 

CMG Media Corporation (d/b/a Cox Media Group) is an industry-leading media company with unparalleled brands, award-winning content, and exceptional team members. CMG provides valuable local and national journalism and entertainment content to the people and communities it serves. The company's businesses encompass 17 high-quality, market-leading television brands in 9 markets; 45 top-performing radio stations delivering multiple genres of content in 9 markets; and numerous streaming and digital platforms. CMG's TV portfolio includes multiple primary affiliates of ABC, CBS, FOX, NBC, Telemundo and MyNetworkTV, as well as several valuable news and independent stations. For more information about CMG, visit www.coxmediagroup.com

job.title: Director of SEC Reporting and Technical Accounting
job.description:
Director of SEC Reporting and Technical Accounting

*This is a remote position that requires you to work closely and collaboratively with internal teams.*

 

About Townsquare Media:

Townsquare is a community-focused digital and broadcast media and digital marketing solutions company principally focused on markets outside the top 50 in the U.S. Our assets include 340 radio stations across 74 local markets, more than 400 local news and entertainment websites and mobile apps, a subscription digital marketing services business (Townsquare Interactive) and a digital advertising division (Townsquare Ignite).

 

About the Opportunity:

The Director of SEC Reporting and Technical Accounting owns Townsquare’s external reporting and technical accounting and is a key member of the accounting leadership team.

 

Responsibilities:

  • Prepare and own SEC filings, including Forms 10-K, 10-Q and 8-K (including earnings releases), and the related financial statements, footnotes and MD&A.
  • Coordinate with Investor Relations on all financial aspects of the earnings release, conference call script and materials posted to the Company’s website, including non-GAAP measures and reconciliations in compliance with Regulation G and Item 10(e) of Regulation S-K.
  • Support Legal Counsel in preparing the proxy statement (including executive compensation disclosures) and Section 16 filings (Forms 3, 4 and 5), as needed.
  • Stay current on new and proposed SEC rules, FASB standards and SEC comment letter trends; assess their impact and ensure the Company is prepared for new reporting requirements.
  • Own the SEC reporting process, including the Financial Reporting SOX narrative and the design and timely, effective operation of key controls; partner with the Director of Internal Audit on SOX walk-throughs and testing.
  • Own inline XBRL tagging and compliance.
  • Prepare and review disclosure checklists.
  • Complete quarterly and annual lender reporting under the credit agreement, including covenant compliance calculations and delivery of financial results.
  • Lead the application of accounting standards for the Company, including documentation, resolution of issues and implementation of process changes, particularly revenue recognition (ASC 606), goodwill and FCC license impairment testing (ASC 350), business combinations and dispositions (ASC 805), leases (ASC 842) and segment reporting (ASC 280).
  • Prepare technical accounting memos on complex and non-routine transactions, and review position papers prepared by others.
  • Coordinate with Finance, HR and Legal to maintain equity award records and calculate stock-based compensation expense.
  • Drive continuous process improvement and automation of reporting and close tasks, including appropriate use of analytics and AI tools.
  • Serve as the day-to-day contact with the external auditors for quarterly reviews and the annual integrated audit.
  • Prepare Audit Committee materials on accounting, reporting and control matters, and present to the Audit Committee as needed.
  • Coordinate with Tax on income tax provision (ASC 740) disclosures.
  • Review the quarterly consolidation, segment results and statement of cash flows.
  • Build, supervise and develop a team of reporting and technical accounting professionals.

 

Qualifications:
To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

 

Education & Experience:

  • 8+ years of progressive accounting experience, including public accounting (Big 4 or national firm preferred) and either at least three years of SEC reporting at a public registrant or equivalent experience auditing public companies.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting; active CPA license required.
  • Strong working knowledge of U.S. GAAP and SEC rules (Regulation S-X and S-K).
  • Experience supervising and developing staff; month-end close experience strongly preferred.
  • Strong written communication skills and the judgment to present to senior management and the Audit Committee.

 

Computer Skills:

  • Advanced Excel required (Power Query, pivot tables, XLOOKUP/INDEX-MATCH, building and auditing complex models).
  • Hands-on experience with Workiva or similar reporting software, including inline XBRL tagging, strongly preferred.
  • Experience with Microsoft Dynamics GP and IBM Planning Analytics (TM1/Cognos), or comparable ERP and planning systems, preferred. Working knowledge of SQL a plus.
  • Comfort using AI tools (e.g., Microsoft Copilot, Claude) for research, drafting and automation, consistent with Company policy, a plus.
  • Proficiency in Word, PowerPoint and Outlook.

 

Benefits:

  • Competitive base salary
  • 3 weeks PTO
  • 9 paid holidays (including 2 personal/floating holidays)
  • Volunteer Time Off
  • Health, Dental, and Vision Insurance
  • Pet Insurance
  • 401(K) Retirement Plan with Company Match
  • Employee Stock Purchase Plan
  • Company-provided laptop
  • Comprehensive training and growth opportunities
  • Unlimited growth potential in a dynamic work environment

Own the product direction for one of the largest sports apps in the country. The CBS Sports App is home to some of the biggest sporting events in the world: The Masters, NFL, March Madness, Champions League, and more. This role owns the product strategy for the full app experience. You will lead a small PM team, work directly with design and engineering leads across squads, and stay close to the work. This is a player-coach role. You set the direction, and you’re in the details.  

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

  • Set product strategy for the CBS Sports App and translate it into clear priorities teams can act on.
  • Own the app's plan. Decide what we're building, sequence the work, balance risk, track outcomes, and make the hard calls on what to continue, change, or stop.
  • Prototype to think. We build working prototypes to remove ambiguity, test ideas with real fans, and learn before we commit. You'll use tools like Claude and Cursor to make concepts tangible, iterate on what you learn, and arrive at a better strategy because you've held the thing in your hand.
  • Coach and develop 1–2 PMs through structured feedback, calibration, and deliberate growth planning.
  • Partner with design and engineering directors on cross-squad alignment, delivery cadence, and how we evolve our process.
  • Represent product to executive leadership. Turn fan behavior, competitive dynamics, and product performance into a clear narrative that builds trust.
  How We Build (The Builder Culture):
  • We've moved past feature factories, PRDs, and slow-motion handoffs. We work in small, cross-functional squads with fixed timeboxes, clear ownership, and a focus on outcomes over output. When we need to figure out whether an idea works, we build a prototype and put it in front of fans. The goal is not a finished feature. It's removing ambiguity fast enough to make better decisions.
  • AI is how we make this possible. PMs prototype in code using tools like Claude and Cursor. Not to ship production features, but to make ideas tangible, test them with users, and learn before we commit. Designers do the same. Engineers ship with AI as a pair programmer. We build internal tools with prompts when a workflow can be automated. This is the operating expectation, and as a Director, you'll model it and push what's possible further.
  • The result is that we move faster than our size suggests. Small teams, short cycles, real signals from real fans, and the autonomy to act on what you learn without waiting for permission.
  What success looks like:
  • The app's product strategy is coherent. People across the organization understand what we're building, why, and what we're choosing not to do.
  • Ideas are tested before they're committed. Teams prototype, learn from fans, and start building with real clarity. Fewer false starts, less rework.
  • PMs on your team grow their craft visibly and operate with stronger judgment over time.
  • Prioritization decisions are defensible, tied to measurable fan impact, and adjusted when the signal says so.
  • Stakeholders trust your perspective because you bring receipts, not just opinions.
 

Basic Qualifications:

  • 10+ years in product, with meaningful time in a leadership role. Consumer environment, ideally mobile-first and at scale. You've owned the strategy, shipped against it, and developed other PMs.
 

Additional Qualifications:

  • Strong prioritization instincts. You can hold app-level strategy and problem-level detail in the same day.
  • Comfort prototyping in code with AI tools. You don't need to be an engineer, but you can use Claude or Cursor to build something testable and learn from it.
  • Fluency with product analytics, experimentation, and outcome accountability.
  • An AI-native working style. You already use LLMs to think through problems and accelerate your own work, and you have a point of view on how AI changes what a product team can do.

The Ingest/Transmission Operator and Editor oversees all inbound and outbound media, content distribution, and news-gathering operations. Responsibilities include monitoring on-air product quality, ensuring compliance with government regulations, troubleshooting technical equipment, editing news content, and preparing programming for broadcast. This position is governed by the National IBEW Broadcast Agreement for CBS television stations.

 

Duties & Responsibilities


• Monitor and manage inbound and outbound media using various transmission methods, including fiber, Skype, and LiveU.
• Ensure timely response to breaking news events and oversee broadcast delivery.
• Collaborate with team members and network staff, providing operational support as needed.
• Identify, edit, and insert broadcast-quality video and audio into news bulletins on short notice.
• Handle broadcast media and feeds, manage video and audio switching, and operate recording equipment.
• Utilize servers and monitoring systems to manage media acquisition and delivery.
• Ingest media into servers and prepare files for editing and broadcast.
• Perform basic troubleshooting and escalate technical issues when necessary.
• Support live studio production requirements and provide excellent service to internal and external media operations clients.

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

• Understanding of broadcast production workflows and technical standards.

job.title: Chief Engineer
job.description:
Chief Engineer 

WVTM, the NBC and CBS affiliates in Birmingham, Alabama “The Magic City” is seeking a Chief Engineer. The successful candidate will lead a team and demonstrate the ability to organize, plan, manage, document and complete assignments within a live broadcast environment. You will work in collaboration with the other department heads and directly oversee the daily operation of the station. We are looking for someone with experience in broadcast excellence and teamwork, with a passion for serving the local community, ready to embrace the challenges and opportunities of our ever-evolving industry. The ideal candidate must excel in motivating and working with a high-energy team, enthusiastic about collaborating with all departments, integrating AI into solutions and workflow, focused on the future of our industry. Candidate should demonstrate success in budgeting, capital planning and personnel management. This position reports directly to the General Manager and partners with Hearst Television leadership.   

 

What You’ll Do 

Engineering Leadership 

  • Lead, coach, and develop the station’s engineering team, including staffing, scheduling, AI adoption and implementation, performance feedback, technical training, and on-call coverage. 

  • Set priorities and service standards for engineering work, build strong working relationships across departments, and communicate technical issues and their operational impact clearly. 

  • Partner with the General Manager and station leaders to align technology plans with local journalism, production, business needs, and Hearst Television standards. 

Broadcast and Facility Operations 

  • Oversee the reliability, maintenance, troubleshooting, and lifecycle planning of broadcast, newsroom, production, automation, master control, media storage, network, streaming, and transmission systems. 

  • Maintain station transmission and RF facilities, studios, control rooms, remote production equipment, and critical infrastructure such as generators, UPS, and HVAC systems supporting technical operations. 

  • Provide engineering leadership during live programming, breaking news, severe weather, outages, and other urgent events; coordinate response, recovery, and follow-up. 

Compliance, Safety, and Resilience 

  • Ensure required FCC, EAS, and other applicable regulatory and industry obligations are met, with accurate records, scheduled testing, inspections, and timely corrective action. 

  • Maintain preventive maintenance, equipment inventory, technical documentation, safety practices, emergency preparedness, backup power, and disaster recovery plans. 

  • Coordinate with Hearst Television and enterprise IT partners on cybersecurity, network resilience, access practices, and business continuity for station systems. 

 

Planning and Modernization 

  • Develop and manage operating and capital budgets, equipment replacement plans, vendor relationships, service contracts, and engineering projects from proposal through implementation. 

  • Evaluate and implement improvements to IP-based workflows, automation, cloud or hybrid services, streaming, and other emerging technologies while protecting reliable on-air operations. 

  • Use approved AI tools, where appropriate, to support technical research, summarize logs or documentation, identify workflow improvement opportunities, and organize maintenance or project information; verify outputs before use and follow company requirements for confidential, employee, and operational data. 

  • Review significant technical incidents, identify root causes, document corrective actions, and apply lessons learned to improve reliability. 

 

What You’ll Need 

  • At least 7 years of progressively responsible experience in television broadcast engineering, media technology, or a closely related technical field, including experience leading or supervising technical staff. 

  • Working knowledge of television broadcast systems, RF transmission, studio and newsroom technologies, automation, IP-based media workflows, and applicable FCC and EAS requirements. 

  • Experience planning technical projects, managing budgets and vendors, prioritizing equipment lifecycle needs, and coordinating work across departments. 

  • Ability to troubleshoot complex systems, make sound decisions under deadline pressure, and explain technical issues to both technical and non-technical colleagues. 

  • Ability to provide support during live operations and occasional nights, weekends, holidays, or emergencies as station needs require. 

  • Education, training, or experience in broadcast engineering, electrical engineering, information technology, electronics, or a related field. Hearst Television will consider a college degree, trade school diploma, professional certificates, military training, or equivalent practical experience. 

  • Experience with broadcast automation, IP video and audio, streaming, cloud or hybrid media systems, cybersecurity practices, emergency planning, and relevant certifications such as SBE is valued. 

  • Related military experience will be considered.

job.title: Sr. Manager, Club Revenue Analytics & Data Science
job.description:
We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Sr. Manager of Club Revenue Analytics & Data Science to join our Data & Analytics team at the NFL. Based in the League’s New York office, this role partners with internal stakeholders and all 32 clubs to turn business questions and fan data into actionable recommendations, scalable analytics products, and measurable growth across ticketing, premium seating, sponsorship, and fan engagement. The role also works with Data Engineering and Business Intelligence to ensure solutions are accurate, governed, and scalable.

The ideal candidate combines business acumen, data science and advanced analytics experience, executive communication skills, and a consultative mindset to turn insights into action.

Responsibilities

  • Manage and collaborate with stakeholders from Club Business Development and the 32 clubs to understand their analytics needs and deliver actionable insights.
  • Oversee the development and ongoing maintenance of comprehensive analytics platforms to support ticketing, premium seating and sponsorship analytics and insights.
  • Lead advanced analytics to evaluate ticketing, premium seating, and sponsorship behavior, including KPI monitoring, segmentation, customer profiling, and predictive modeling.
  • Effectively communicate analytical findings to stakeholders, translating complex data analysis into clear and concise insights.
  • Collaborate with BI and technology teams to ensure ticketing, premium seating, and sponsorship platforms receive accurate, reliable data through regular quality audits and validation.
  • Perform data extraction, transformation and analysis using SQL and Python.
  • Develop and implement attribution models to measure the impact of different League-provided data products.
  • Work with the BI COE to create dashboards to provide insights and recommendations based on analytics findings.
  • Stay updated with industry trends and best practices in club analytics and data quality management.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including Club Business Development, Marketing and the 32 clubs to align analytics initiatives and drive data-driven decision-making.
  • Collaborate with analytics consulting vendors.
  • Foster a collaborative and agile work environment, leveraging tools like Jira for project management and task tracking.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Analytics, Economics, Statistics, Operations Research, Business Analytics, or a related quantitative discipline.
  • At least 7 years of relevant experience in revenue analytics, pricing, customer analytics, ticketing, consulting, ecommerce, hospitality, sports, media, or another commercially oriented industry or other relevant industry experience.
  • Demonstrated ability to structure ambiguous business problems, direct analytical work, and translate findings into clear commercial recommendations.
  • Strong proficiency in SQL and Python, with practical experience working with large customer, transactional, or behavioral datasets.
  • Experience with predictive modeling, customer segmentation, forecasting, experimentation or campaign measurement, and analytical storytelling.
  • Demonstrated experience leading complex analytical workstreams and coaching analysts
  • Proven ability to communicate with senior business and technical stakeholders and present complex analysis in a clear, concise, and influential manner.
  • Experience partnering with data engineering, BI, product, or technology teams to deliver scalable analytical solutions with strong data quality and governance.
  • 3 years of management experience.

Other Key Attributes / Characteristics

  • Sports, clubs, ticketing, live events, venue, hospitality, airline, subscription, or revenue management experience.
  • Experience with Ticketmaster, SeatGeek, or comparable ticketing and live-event datasets.
  • Experience developing club-facing, client-facing, or executive-facing recommendations in a consulting or analytics advisory environment.
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with high attention to detail.
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to convey complex analytical findings to stakeholders in a clear and concise manner.
  • Strong collaborator who communicates transparently, supports shared goals, and welcomes constructive challenges.

Salary / Pay Range

This job posting contains a pay range, which represents the range of salaries or hourly rates that the NFL believes, in good faith, at the time of this posting that it might be willing to pay for the posted job in the location(s) specified. The NFL expects to hire for this position near the middle of the range. Only in truly rare and exceptional circumstances, where an external candidate has experience, credentials or expertise that far exceed those required or expected for the position, would the NFL consider paying a salary or rate near the higher end of the range. 

Terms / Expected Hours of Work

  • This position may require some limited travel. (>10%)
Salary $130,000—$180,000 USD

Benefits Information
To learn more about our comprehensive benefits offerings, please visit: NFL BENEFITS

At the NFL, in-person work at our offices is a top priority because it allows us to collaborate more effectively, build stronger connections, and maintain the culture that drives our success. This role requires onsite presence at an NFL office or stadium location, and remote and/or hybrid working options are not offered. 

NO RELOCATION ASSISTANCE WILL BE PROVIDED.

The NFL is committed to building an inclusive work environment that reflects our incredible fan base. We provide an environment of mutual respect where equal employment opportunities are available to all employees and applicants without regard to status as protected by applicable federal, state, and local laws.

  • Team Responsibility: We support each other and our communities. No one is bigger than the game, and every action impacts others.

job.title: Senior Counsel, Regulatory Affairs & Corp Transactions (Remote)
job.description:
The E.W. Scripps Company is seeking a Senior Counsel, Regulatory Affairs & Corporate Transactions to provide legal counsel on matters related to the distribution of the Company’s local stations, networks, and programming across multiple platforms, including over-the-air, MVPD, streaming, and digital.


This role will structure, negotiate, and draft a variety of commercial agreements; prepare regulatory filings; and oversee compliance with FCC regulations in partnership with internal teams. The Senior Counsel will also support the Company’s mergers and acquisitions activity and advise business leaders on regulatory and transactional matters, with a focus on operational effectiveness, risk management, and alignment across the enterprise.

 

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Advise on regulatory and contractual rights, obligations, most-favored-nation provisions, and transactional standards related to retransmission consent, network, and program distribution.
  • Draft offers and contracts based on approved deal terms; coordinate with Distribution in negotiations.
  • Review and negotiate inbound contract requests from outside parties, including retransmission consent, network distribution, non-disclosure, master services, and related agreements.
  • Create new contract forms as needed to accommodate evolving business models.
  • Evaluate standard terms and template agreements to ensure accuracy and efficiency.
  • Coordinate with business units to manage deal flow and contract execution.
  • Manage outside counsel when appropriate and oversee contract management system.
  • Monitor FCC regulatory requirements and compliance obligations relevant to the Company’s operations.
  • Draft and coordinate FCC compliance materials in collaboration with internal teams.
  • Work closely with the VP of Government Affairs on compliance-related matters, with advocacy retained by that office.
  • Assist, as needed, with preparation and submission of monthly, quarterly, and annual FCC filings and reports.
  • Maintain accurate compliance records and ensure timely submission of required reports to federal agencies.
  • Provide guidance to internal stakeholders to uphold compliance standards across business units.
  • Support Company M&A activity, i.e., securing regulatory approvals.
  • Prepare required regulatory filings and notices including but not limited to FCC license transfer applications (incl. waiver requests).
  • Coordinate with Company’s corporate development and M&A counsel on strategy regarding regulatory approval.

 

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:

  • Juris Doctor degree from an accredited law school and active license to practice law in good standing with at least one state bar: OH, NY, NJ, or GA preferred.
  • Minimum 5 years of experience at a law firm, as a house counsel in technology, regulatory, or intellectual property law, and/or in a business role focusing on program licensing and distribution

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:

  • Strong contract drafting skills with experience in licensing, production, and local media distribution
  • Familiarity with FCC regulations applicable to broadcast and digital platforms
  • Accuracy and disciplined approach to compliance and risk management
  • Skilled in counseling creative and business partners, balancing legal and business considerations
  • Strong oral and written communication skills
  • Proficiency with Word, Excel, and related tools
  • Demonstrated experience in federal regulatory compliance requirements, including FCC rules and reporting processes
  • Demonstrated experience in retransmission consent, corporate governance processes, and related compliance requirements

 

#LI-SM2 #LI-Remote

COMPENSATION RANGE:

: $165,000.00 - 200000


 

Pursuant to state and local salary transparency laws, the salary range posted is specific to candidates who will perform this work in District of Columbia.


 

ADDITIONAL BENEFITS:

  • A career path to grow your professional experiences

  • Full medical, dental and vision benefits, as well as certain other health and wellness benefits

  • Retirement savings plan with company match

  • Other key company benefits include disability accident insurance, hospital indemnity, critical illness, life insurance, AD&D, ID protection, pet discount program, and employee assistance program. More details about timing and conditions of benefits eligibility and other plan terms and conditions will be provided upon hire.

If you are a current Scripps employee, please do not apply on this site. Please access our internal career site at Worklife > My Info > View Open Positions at Scripps.

SCRIPPS’ COMMITMENT TO A CULTURE THAT CREATES CONNECTION:

At Scripps, we are committed to a culture that reflects the audiences and communities we serve. We are intentional about creating an environment where employees, our audiences and other stakeholders feel valued and inspired to reach their full potential and create connections. To successfully deliver on this commitment, we must understand and reflect the values and perspectives those around us embody. That process begins by looking inward to build and celebrate a respectful workplace where everyone feels a sense of belonging and connection. By continuing to cultivate an environment where all employees have a fair chance to succeed, are included, valued, and seen, we will strengthen the connections that drive positive business impact and align with our core purpose. 

ABOUT SCRIPPS:

The E.W. Scripps Company (NASDAQ: SSP) is a diversified media company focused on creating connection. As one of the nation’s largest local TV broadcasters, Scripps serves communities with quality, objective local journalism and operates a portfolio of more than 60 stations in 40+ markets. Scripps reaches households across the U.S. with national news outlet Scripps News and popular entertainment brands ION, ION Plus, ION Mystery, Bounce, Grit and Laff. Scripps is the nation’s largest holder of broadcast spectrum. Scripps Sports serves professional and college sports leagues, conferences and teams with local market depth and national broadcast reach of up to 100% of TV households. Founded in 1878, Scripps is the steward of the Scripps National Spelling Bee and its longtime motto is: “Give light and the people will find their own way.”

job.description:
Ejecutivo de Enlace Comercial

Ubicación: Ciudad de México


Acerca del puesto y el equipo

Forma parte del equipo de TelevisaUnivision, la empresa líder en medios y contenido en español, con un ecosistema que integra televisión, streaming, plataformas digitales, redes sociales, deportes, entretenimiento y contenido. El equipo de Enlace Comercial trabaja de la mano con distintas áreas de TelevisaUnivision para transformar las necesidades de nuestros clientes en propuestas comerciales creativas, estratégicas y ejecutables. Nuestro objetivo es identificar oportunidades dentro del ecosistema de TelevisaUnivision y construir soluciones que conecten de manera relevante a las marcas con nuestras audiencias, combinando medios, contenido, talento, plataformas y nuevas formas de comunicación.

job.title: Comprador de Calle
job.description:
Objetivo del puesto

En TelevisaUnivision buscamos un Comprador de Calle dinámico, resolutivo y con gran conocimiento del mercado local, responsable de gestionar la adquisición oportuna de materiales, productos, suministros y servicios necesarios para apoyar las operaciones y producciones de la compañía.

Esta posición requiere una persona con excelente capacidad de negociación, sentido de urgencia y habilidad para identificar proveedores, conseguir las mejores condiciones comerciales y resolver necesidades de compra de manera ágil, eficiente y dentro de los presupuestos establecidos.


Responsabilidades principales

  • Realizar compras directas en establecimientos comerciales, mercados, distribuidores y proveedores locales, atendiendo las necesidades de las diferentes áreas de la compañía.
  • Buscar, identificar y desarrollar relaciones con proveedores que ofrezcan productos de calidad a precios competitivos.

  • Colaborar estrechamente con los equipos de Producción, Operaciones, Finanzas y otras áreas internas para anticipar y resolver necesidades de abastecimiento.

job.title: News Producer
job.description:
The News Producer is responsible for their individual, assigned newscast. Each Producer works with their Executive Producer and other newsroom staff to take daily reporter assignments, voiceovers (VOs), voice-over sound on tape (VOSOTs) and other stories to build compelling, informative newscasts.  Responsibilities include but are not limited to the following duties.

Duties/Responsibilities

  • Manage daily production of newscasts by compiling and writing stories, logging video, etc. within specific time constraints to meet news deadlines.
  • Manage the Control Room during assigned newscasts, working closely with Directors and Production teams to ensure live programs are executed flawlessly.
  • Provide direction and talent instruction to crews in the field and in studio.
  • Collaborate about changes with Executive Producer prior to air and during newscasts.
  • Supervise and oversee Writers assigned to the shift, assign writing ideas to APs, edit AP scripts, and provide feedback.
  • Work with reporters to develop story scripts, edit Reporter scripts, and provide feedback.
  • Assign voiceovers and VO-SOTs to Reporters and Anchors.
  • Collaborate with on-air staff to assist with story development and story support.
  • Work with field crews, via telephone, to manage stories, provide graphics support, video, and logistical support.
  • Log, edit, and transcribe soundbites, write VOs, teases and opens, create basic graphics and coordinate closely with video editors.
  • Work closely with Assignment Desk staff to coordinate live shots and Reporter and Photographer assignments.
  • Maintain open communication with News Director, the news management team, and all station personnel to efficiently, respectfully, and professionally complete news assignments.
  • Collaborate with web/social media team to coordinate coverage for online and on-air stories.
  • Quickly add appropriate information to newscasts in the event of breaking news.
  • Produce unscheduled breaking news or other items as events warrant.
  • Attend and participate in department meetings.  Provide suggestions for news related stories and participate in post-production critiques.
  • Demonstrate responsibility for all equipment issued by FOX.
  • Comply with all FOX Corporate computer requirements.
  • Comply with all FOX Corporate and station policies.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Required Skills and Abilities

  • Proficiency with MS Office including Outlook, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Excellent problem-solving and critical-thinking skills.
  • Ability to work under daily pressure and successfully manage multiple projects and deadlines.
  • This is a full-time position on a regular shift, but the news is a 24/7 world and that could occasionally include other shifts as breaking news or other circumstances warrant.

Education and Experience

  • One (1) year of experience in a medium to major television market is preferred.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Communications, Journalism, Radio/TV or related discipline preferred.

Physical Requirements

  • Prolonged periods sitting at a desk and working at a computer.
  • Regularly stand, walk, sit, reach with hands and arms, and talk or hear.
  • Occasionally required to climb or balance and stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl.
  • Regularly lift and/or move up to 10 pounds.
  • Vision abilities include close vision, distance vision, color vision, and ability to adjust focus.

job.title: Streaming News Producer
job.description:
KCPQ/KZJO FOX 13 Seattle is seeking a Streaming News Producer with strong technical instincts and a deep understanding of digital-first news production. This role is centered on live streaming, social video, and platform-native storytelling. You will be responsible for producing, managing, and optimizing live and on-demand content across FOX LOCAL and major social platforms, ensuring coverage is fast, accurate, visually compelling, and technically sound.

Reporting to the Streaming Executive Producer, the ideal candidate is fluent in the mechanics of streaming production and social/digital distribution, CTV, and understands how audiences consume news outside of linear TV with a balance of speed, quality, and journalistic integrity. This is a hands-on role for someone who thrives in a live environment and wants to build the future of local news.

Does This Sound Like You?

You are digitally native, technically confident, and calm under pressure. You understand streaming workflows, live video production, and best practices for digital and social platforms. You have strong news judgment, pay close attention to detail, and can make smart editorial and technical decisions quickly. You enjoy collaborating across teams, experimenting with new formats, and using data to improve performance. You want to create content that reaches audiences where they are and keeps them coming back.

Responsibilities

  • Produce and manage live streaming coverage of breaking news, live events, press conferences, and original programming for FOX LOCAL and social platforms.
  • Operate and oversee streaming production tools, including live switching, encoding, clipping, publishing, and real-time troubleshooting.
  • Create platform-native digital and social video content, including live clips, short-form video, graphics, and text-based storytelling optimized for mobile & CTV consumption.
  • Distribute and optimize content across the FOX Local app, YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, X, Facebook, and emerging platforms with an emphasis on audience growth and engagement.
  • Collaborate with newsroom, digital, social, and production/engineering teams to align coverage, workflows, and priorities across platforms.
  • Monitor real-time analytics, audience behavior, and trending topics to inform editorial and production decisions before, during, and after live streams.
  • Ensure all content meets journalistic standards, legal requirements, and FOX group guidelines for quality, accuracy, and consistency.
  • Participate in ongoing testing and refinement of streaming formats, tools, and workflows.
  • Assist in the planning, production and publication of regular podcasts on both VOD and audio platforms.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.



Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree preferred, ideally in Journalism, Communications, Media Production, TV/Film production, or a related field with a digital focus.
  • 3 or more years of experience producing digital video, live streams, or social-first news content; newsroom experience strongly preferred.
  • Strong technical proficiency with live streaming workflows, including video switching, live publishing, clipping, and distribution.
  • Hands-on experience with video editing tools and production software, Adobe Creative Suite experience is a plus.
  • Demonstrated understanding of social media platforms, video formats, and audience behavior across digital ecosystems.
  • Experience using analytics tools to measure performance and adjust content strategy in real time.
  • Excellent editorial judgment, writing skills, and attention to detail in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across teams.
  • Flexibility to work weekends, holidays, and non-traditional hours as news demands.

job.title: Senior Animator - Gameplay | Animateur ou animatrice senior, Jouabilité
job.description:
NBCUniversal is one of the world's leading media and entertainment companies. We create world-class content, which we distribute across our portfolio of film, television, and streaming, and bring to life through our global theme park destinations, consumer products, and experiences. We own and operate leading entertainment and news brands, including NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo, and Peacock, our premium ad-supported streaming service. We produce and distribute premier filmed entertainment and programming through our powerhouse film and television studios, including Universal Pictures, DreamWorks Animation, and Focus Features, and the four global television studios under the Universal Studio Group banner, and operate industry-leading theme parks and experiences around the world through Universal Destinations & Experiences, including Universal Orlando Resort, home to Universal Epic Universe, and Universal Studios Hollywood. NBCUniversal is a subsidiary of Comcast Corporation. Visit www.nbcuniversal.com for more information.

Our impact is rooted in improving the communities where our employees, customers, and audiences live and work. We have a rich tradition of giving back and ensuring our employees have the opportunity to serve their communities. We champion an inclusive culture and strive to attract and develop a talented workforce to create and deliver a wide range of content reflecting our world.

NBCUniversal est l’une des principales entreprises de médias et de divertissement au monde. Nous créons du contenu de calibre mondial, que nous distribuons au moyen de notre portefeuille de films, de télévision et de plateformes de diffusion en continu, et que nous faisons vivre à travers nos destinations de parcs à thème, nos produits de consommation et nos expériences à l’échelle mondiale. Nous possédons et exploitons des marques de premier plan dans les domaines du divertissement et de l’information, notamment NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo et Peacock, notre service de diffusion en continu haut de gamme financé par la publicité. Nous produisons et distribuons des films et des émissions de premier ordre par l’entremise de nos studios de cinéma et de télévision de renommée mondiale, notamment Universal Pictures, DreamWorks Animation et Focus Features, ainsi que les quatre studios de télévision mondiaux regroupés sous la bannière Universal Studio Group. Nous exploitons également des parcs à thème et des expériences de calibre mondial partout dans le monde par l’entremise d’Universal Destinations & Experiences, y compris Universal Orlando Resort, qui accueille Universal Epic Universe, et Universal Studios Hollywood. NBCUniversal est une filiale de Comcast Corporation. Visitez www.nbcuniversal.com pour obtenir plus d’information.

Notre impact repose sur l’amélioration des communautés où vivent et travaillent les membres de notre personnel, notre clientèle et nos publics. Nous avons une longue tradition d’engagement communautaire et veillons à ce que les membres de notre personnel aient l’occasion de servir leur communauté. Nous favorisons une culture inclusive et nous efforçons d’attirer et de développer des talents diversifiés afin de créer et de offrir une vaste gamme de contenus qui reflètent notre monde.

RESPONSIBILTIES

As a Senior Gameplay Animator, you will be responsible for bringing gameplay characters to life. You have a passion for NPC and player gameplay systems and a keen eye for animation detail and quality. You have a deep understanding of body mechanics and master core animation principles like weight, posing, arcs, anticipation, and follow-through.

In the role of Senior Gameplay Animator, you will be creating high-quality character animations for navigation, interactions, conversations, and other gameplay systems.

  • Collaborate closely with a team of skilled animators, designers, and gameplay programmers.
  • Ensure animation work meets artistic goals and quality standards while respecting project deadlines.
  • Participate in animation reviews and collaborate with other team members to maintain consistency and quality.
  • Exporting, implementing and testing animations into the game engine.
  • Troubleshoot animation gameplay issues and provide solutions to ensure smooth animation production.
  • Provide guidance and feedback to junior animators, helping to mentor their development and maintain consistent quality across the board.

RESPONSABILITÉS

À titre d’animateur ou animatrice senior, Jouabilité, vous serez responsable de donner vie aux personnages de jouabilité. Vous êtes passionné·e par les systèmes de jouabilité des NPC et des personnages joueurs et possédez un sens aigu du détail ainsi qu’un souci constant de la qualité de l’animation. Vous avez une compréhension approfondie de la mécanique corporelle et maîtrisez les principes fondamentaux de l’animation, notamment le poids, les poses, les arcs, l’anticipation et le suivi du mouvement.

Dans ce rôle d’animateur ou animatrice senior, Jouabilité, vous créerez des animations de personnages de grande qualité pour la navigation, les interactions, les conversations et d’autres systèmes de jouabilité.

  • Collaborer étroitement avec une équipe d’animateurs et animatrices, de concepteurs et conceptrices ainsi que de programmeurs et programmeuses de jouabilité hautement qualifiés.
  • Veiller à ce que les travaux d’animation répondent aux objectifs artistiques et aux normes de qualité tout en respectant les échéances du projet.
  • Participer aux revues d’animation et collaborer avec les autres membres de l’équipe afin d’assurer la cohérence et la qualité du travail.
  • Exporter, intégrer et tester les animations dans le moteur de jeu.
  • Diagnostiquer les problèmes liés à l’animation et à la jouabilité et proposer des solutions afin d’assurer une production fluide des animations.
  • Fournir de l’encadrement et de la rétroaction aux animateurs et animatrices juniors, contribuer à leur développement professionnel et maintenir un niveau de qualité constant au sein de l’équipe.

Basic Requirements: 

  • 6+ years of experience in 3D character gameplay animation.
  • Strong demo reel showcasing gameplay animations.
  • Solid animation skills with a great understanding of human motion, body mechanics, biped locomotion and animation principles.
  • Strong proficiency in industry-standard animation tools such as Motionbuilder or Maya.
  • Experience in working with motion capture data and keyframe animations.
  • Having shipped a AAA game.
  • Ability to work collaboratively and communicate effectively within cross-disciplinary teams.
  • Basic technical understanding of gameplay systems and animation blend systems.

Desired Characteristics: 

  • Working experience with game engines such as Unreal
  • Experience working on occupation, conversation and traversal systems
  • Understanding of animation-graph techniques and workflows
  • Understanding of root-motion and motion matching
  • Experience in developing first-person and third-person gameplay systems and good understanding of 3C concepts
  • Experience with different animation styles
  • Experience animating animal and creature characters
  • Rigging experience
  • Facial animation experience
  • Experience developing Multiplayer games

QUALIFICATIONS

Exigences de base : 

  • 6 ans ou plus d’expérience en animation de jouabilité de personnages 3D.
  • Démo professionnelle solide présentant des animations de jouabilité.
  • Excellentes compétences en animation et solide compréhension du mouvement humain, de la mécanique corporelle, de la locomotion bipède et des principes d’animation.
  • Maîtrise avancée des outils d’animation reconnus dans l’industrie, tels que MotionBuilder ou Maya.
  • Expérience de travail avec des données de capture de mouvement (motion capture) et des animations par images clés (keyframe).
  • Avoir contribué à la livraison d’un jeu AAA.
  • Capacité à collaborer efficacement et à communiquer clairement au sein d’équipes multidisciplinaires.
  • Compréhension technique de base des systèmes de jouabilité et des systèmes de fusion d’animation (animation blend systems).

Caractéristiques souhaitées : 

  • Expérience de travail avec des moteurs de jeu tels qu’Unreal.
  • Expérience de travail sur des systèmes d’occupation, de conversation et de déplacement (traversal).
  • Compréhension des techniques et des flux de travail liés aux animation graphs.
  • Compréhension du root motion et du motion matching.
  • Expérience dans le développement de systèmes de jouabilité à la première et à la troisième personne ainsi qu’une bonne compréhension des concepts 3C.
  • Expérience avec différents styles d’animation.
  • Expérience en animation de personnages animaux et de créatures.
  • Expérience en rigging.
  • Expérience en animation faciale.
  • Expérience dans le développement de jeux multijoueurs.

Reporting to the Art Director, the Associate Art Director – Characters will work closely with Character Art Leads, Technical Art, and cross-disciplinary teams to ensure alignment across pipelines, systems, and production goals. The role involves leading and managing Character Art Leads while providing high-level direction, establishing standards, and maintaining consistency across internal teams and external partners. 

Responsibilities

  • Ensure consistency and quality across the full character ecosystem (hero characters and crowd systems). 
  • Lead and manage Character Art Leads and Review Artists, providing mentoring, direction, feedback, and alignment. 
  • Review assets and validate quality to ensure alignment with artistic and technical standards. 
  • Drive cross-discipline collaboration with Animation, Design, Tech Art, and Lighting teams. 
  • Ensure alignment between art direction, production constraints, and scalable pipelines. 
  • Maintain visual consistency across internal production and external partners. 
  • Identify risks and guide teams to deliver quality at scale across large production environments.

NBCUniversal is seeking a Lead Artist (Props) to own and drive prop production quality and pipelines for an ambitious interactive entertainment project. This role is responsible for overseeing the creation and implementation of props across the project, ensuring consistency, scalability, and high visual fidelity across a wide range of content including city dressing, interiors, vehicles, and user-generated content (UGC). 

Reporting to the Associate Art Director – World, the Lead Artist (Props) will work closely with Environment, Technical Art, and cross-functional teams to ensure that prop production supports both artistic vision and production requirements. The role involves leading and managing a team of prop artists while establishing pipelines, workflows, and scalable solutions, and acting as a key bridge between internal teams and external development partners to ensure aligned production from high-end to mobile. 

Responsibilities 

  • Translate artistic direction into high-quality prop assets across diverse categories including city dressing, interiors, vehicles, and UGC. 

  • Drive the development and production of prop assets supporting large-scale world building and environmental storytelling. 

  • Lead and manage the prop art team, providing mentorship, feedback, and direction. 

  • Define, maintain, and evolve pipelines and workflows for prop production with a focus on scalability and consistency. 

  • Ensure consistency and quality across all prop assets and integration within environments. 

  • Collaborate closely with Environment, Lighting, Tech Art, and Production teams for proper implementation. 

  • Ensure prop creation workflows meet both artistic goals and technical constraints. 

  • Act as a bridge between internal teams and external development partners, aligning production standards and expectations. 

  • Optimize asset production pipelines for efficiency and scalability from high-end to mobile platforms. 

  • Support production planning, milestone readiness, and continuous pipeline improvements. 

  • Maintain visibility on quality, risks, and production challenges across prop content. 

RÉSUMÉ DU POSTE

NBCUniversal est à la recherche d’une personne pour occuper le poste Chef.fe d’équipe Artiste (Props)  afin d’assurer la responsabilité et l’orientation de la qualité de production des accessoires ainsi que des pipelines associés pour un ambitieux projet de divertissement interactif. Ce rôle est responsable de superviser la création et l’intégration des accessoires dans l’ensemble du projet, en assurant la cohérence, l’évolutivité et un haut niveau de fidélité visuelle pour une vaste gamme de contenus, notamment l’habillage urbain, les environnements intérieurs, les véhicules et le contenu généré par les utilisateurs (UGC).

Relevant de la direction artistique associée, Monde, la personne occupant le poste Chef.fe d’équipe Artiste (Props)  travaillera en étroite collaboration avec les équipes d’Environnement, d’Art technique et d’autres équipes multidisciplinaires afin de s’assurer que la production des accessoires soutient à la fois la vision artistique et les exigences de production. Ce rôle comprend le leadership et la gestion d’une équipe d’artistes d’accessoires, tout en mettant en place des pipelines, des flux de travail et des solutions évolutives. La personne retenue agira également comme principal point de liaison entre les équipes internes et les partenaires externes de développement afin d’assurer l’alignement de la production sur toutes les plateformes, du haut de gamme au mobile.

RESPONSABILITÉS

  • Traduire la direction artistique en accessoires de haute qualité dans diverses catégories, notamment l’habillage urbain, les environnements intérieurs, les véhicules et le contenu généré par les utilisateurs (UGC).
  • Diriger le développement et la production d’accessoires soutenant la création d’univers à grande échelle et la narration environnementale.
  • Assurer le leadership et la gestion de l’équipe d’artistes d’accessoires, en fournissant du mentorat, de la rétroaction et des orientations.
  • Définir, maintenir et faire évoluer les pipelines et les flux de travail de production des accessoires en mettant l’accent sur l’évolutivité et la cohérence.
  • Assurer la cohérence et la qualité de tous les accessoires ainsi que leur intégration dans les environnements.
  • Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes d’Environnement, d’Éclairage, d’Art technique et de Production afin d’assurer une intégration adéquate.
  • Veiller à ce que les flux de travail de création d’accessoires répondent à la fois aux objectifs artistiques et aux contraintes techniques.
  • Agir comme point de liaison entre les équipes internes et les partenaires externes de développement afin d’harmoniser les normes et les attentes de production.
  • Optimiser les pipelines de production d’actifs pour améliorer l’efficacité et l’évolutivité sur les plateformes allant du haut de gamme au mobile.
  • Soutenir la planification de la production, la préparation des jalons et l’amélioration continue des pipelines.
  • Maintenir une visibilité constante sur la qualité, les risques et les défis de production liés au contenu des accessoires.

Basic Qualifications 

  • Strong experience in AAA game development with a focus on prop or environment asset production. 

  • Proven experience leading and managing a team of artists to at least one shipped AAA title. 

  • Strong portfolio demonstrating high-quality prop creation across multiple categories. 

  • Solid understanding of production pipelines, asset scalability, and real-time constraints. 

  • Experience working on large-scale environments or open-world projects. 

  • Strong collaboration experience across art, technical, and production teams. 

  • Excellent leadership, communication, and organizational skills. 

Desired Characteristics 

  • Experience building scalable prop systems and modular asset libraries. 

  • Experience working with Unreal Engine pipelines. 

  • Experience collaborating with outsourcing teams or external partners. 

  • Strong understanding of urban environments, prop composition, and environmental variety. 

  • Ability to balance artistic quality with production efficiency and technical constraints. 

  • Strong problem-solving mindset and ability to bridge creative and technical constraints. 

  • Desire to think and explore innovative solutions. 

Qualifications de base 

  • Expérience significative en développement de jeux AAA avec un focus sur la production d’assets props ou environnement. 

  • Expérience avérée en gestion d’équipe d’artistes sur au moins un jeu AAA publié. 

  • Portfolio solide démontrant une expertise en création de props variés. 

  • Bonne compréhension des pipelines de production, de la scalabilité des assets et des contraintes temps réel. 

  • Expérience sur des environnements à grande échelle ou open world. 

  • Expérience de collaboration avec équipes artistiques, techniques et production.

  • Bonne compréhension des environnements urbains, de la composition et de la diversité des assets.

NBCUniversal is seeking a Principal Vegetation Artist to own and drive the quality, systems, and visual consistency of vegetation for an ambitious interactive entertainment experience. This role is responsible for defining high-quality standards across trees, plants, and ecosystems, while ensuring that vegetation content supports realism, artistic cohesion, and scalable world building. 

Reporting to the Lead Artist (Environment), the Principal Vegetation Artist will work closely with Environment, Procedural, Technical Art, and cross-disciplinary teams to ensure vegetation systems support artistic direction, production goals, and technical constraints. The role involves acting as an expert authority for vegetation creation and implementation, driving innovation, guiding workflows, and supporting scalable ecosystem solutions across large environments. 

Responsibilities 

  • Define and maintain vegetation quality standards across trees, plants, ground cover, and ecosystem content.

  • Support the design and evolution of vegetation assets pipelines, tools, and best practices. 

  • Ensure vegetation assets and systems meet artistic, technical, and performance requirements. 

  • Contribute to scalable world-building strategies from high-end to mobile targets. 

  • Guide vegetation direction across biomes, neighborhoods, and environmental storytelling needs. 

  • Review and validate vegetation content to ensure consistency, quality, and implementation standards. 

  • Maintain visibility on quality, risks, and production challenges across vegetation systems and content. 

RÉSUMÉ DU POSTE

NBCUniversal est à la recherche d’une personne pour occuper le poste d’Artiste principal.e en végétation afin d’assurer la responsabilité et l’orientation de la qualité, des systèmes et de la cohérence visuelle de la végétation pour une ambitieuse expérience de divertissement interactif. Ce rôle est responsable de définir des normes de haute qualité pour les arbres, les plantes et les écosystèmes, tout en veillant à ce que le contenu végétal soutienne le réalisme, la cohésion artistique et la création d’univers évolutifs.

Le rôle consiste à agir comme personne experte de référence pour la création et l’implantation de la végétation, à favoriser l’innovation, à guider les flux de travail et à soutenir des solutions d’écosystèmes évolutives dans de vastes environnements.

RESPONSABILITÉS

  • Soutenir la conception et l’évolution des pipelines, des outils et des meilleures pratiques liés aux actifs de végétation.
  • Veiller à ce que les actifs et les systèmes de végétation répondent aux exigences artistiques, techniques et de performance.
  • Contribuer à des stratégies évolutives de création d’univers adaptées aux plateformes allant du haut de gamme au mobile.
  • Orienter la direction de la végétation à travers différents biomes, quartiers et besoins de narration environnementale.
  • Réviser et valider le contenu végétal afin d’assurer la cohérence, la qualité et le respect des normes d’implantation.
  • Maintenir une visibilité constante sur la qualité, les risques et les défis de production liés aux systèmes et au contenu de végétation.
  • Extensive experience in AAA game development with a focus on vegetation, environment art, or ecosystem creation on at least one published title. 

  • Proven expertise in creating high-quality vegetation for real-time environments using tools like SpeedTree. 

  • Strong portfolio demonstrating vegetation quality across trees, plants, and natural systems. 

  • Strong understanding of vegetation pipelines, scalability constraints, and real-time performance for asset creation. 

  • Experience with ecosystem thinking, environmental composition, and world-building support. 

  • Experience collaborating across Environment, Procedural, Technical Art, and production teams. 

  • Strong understanding of modern game engines and vegetation implementation workflows. 

  • Excellent communication, collaboration, and problem-solving skills. 

 

Desired Characteristics 

  • Experience building vegetation assets for large-scale or open-world productions. 

  • Familiarity with procedural world-building workflows and systemic ecosystem approaches. 

  • Experience with tools such as Houdini, SpeedTree, or similar vegetation authoring solutions. 

  • Experience working with Unreal Engine pipelines. 

  • Experience collaborating with outsourcing partners or distributed teams. 

  • Strong artistic sensitivity to realism, biodiversity, and environmental storytelling. 

  • Problem-solving mindset and ability to bridge creative and technical constraints. 

  • Desire to think and explore innovative solutions. 

Qualifications de base 

  • Expérience significative en développement de jeux AAA avec un focus sur la végétation, les environnements ou la création d’écosystèmes sur au moins un titre publie.

Atouts souhaités

  • Expérience avec des outils tels que Houdini, SpeedTree ou autres solutions de création végétale.

The Counsel, Ad Tech & Partnerships will report to the VP, Ad Tech & Partnerships and help support the development, distribution and monetization of data-driven advertising products and services.  This role primarily involves drafting and negotiating a variety of commercial agreements and counseling on complex and novel legal issues in a fast-paced environment and requires a self-starter with a curiosity and enthusiasm for learning about NBCU’s ad technology stack and staying current on developments in caselaw and regulations impacting the digital advertising industry.

  • Lead team initiatives, such as scaling and optimizing use of AI in the team’s workflows, improving the contract intake and tracking process, updating contract templates, supporting corporate transactions, and coordinating information for compliance reviews.  

  • Work collaboratively with stakeholders teams across legal and business functions, and propose practical, responsive solutions.

  • Familiarity with the digital advertising ecosystem

    • Collaborate with cross‑functional teams including Engineering, Data Science, Program Management, Product, and Scrum to scope, develop, and deliver GenAI‑powered product capabilities

    • Stay informed on emerging AI, LLM, and machine learning technologies and relevant vendor offerings
    • Contribute to identifying reusable GenAI patterns and capabilities to support future product development
    • Identify opportunities to enhance product capabilities, improve operational processes, and drive efficiency

  • Strong ability to translate technical concepts and system behavior into clear product requirements for both technical and non‑technical audiences
  • Experience partnering closely with engineering and data science teams to deliver AI‑ or data‑driven products
  • Excellent organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast‑paced environment
  • Solid understanding of agile methodologies and modern product development practices

  • Advanced analytical, problem‑solving, and critical‑thinking skills
