job.title: AI Engineering Technical Lead
job.description:
#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?
We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, we’ve got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is… YOU! Becoming a part of Paramount means joining a team of passionate people who not only recognize the power of content but also enjoy a touch of fun and uniqueness. Together, we co-create moments that matter – both for our audiences and our employees – and aim to leave a positive mark on culture.

 

AI Engineering Technical Lead


The Applied Intelligence Data Engineering team is seeking an AI Engineering Technical Lead
to drive the design, development, and productionization of AI-powered data products acrossParamount streaming platforms.

 

This role will lead the development of intelligent systems that leverage real-time and batch data
to power personalization, recommendations, content discovery, and advanced analytics. You will
work at the intersection of data engineering, machine learning, and software engineering,
building scalable AI systems that integrate tightly with our real-time data ingestion platform.
As a technical leader, you will define architecture, guide implementation, mentor engineers, and
ensure production-grade performance, scalability, and reliability of AI-driven systems.


Key Responsibilities
Lead AI System Design & Development
● Develop real-time and batch inference pipelines integrated with streaming data
platforms.
● Design feature engineering pipelines leveraging high-volume behavioral and content
metadata.
● Implement end-to-end ML workflows from data ingestion to model serving.
Build AI-Powered Data Products
● Develop production-grade AI services that power user-facing and internal data products.
● Design APIs and services to expose AI capabilities to downstream applications and platforms.
● Ensure tight integration between AI systems and the core data platform.
Architect Scalable ML Infrastructure
● Define architecture for model training, evaluation, deployment, and monitoring.
● Build and optimize feature stores, model registries, and inference services.
● Design systems that support low-latency, high-throughput model serving.
● Establish best practices for reproducibility, versioning, and lifecycle management.
Production Reliability & Model Performance
● Monitor and optimize model performance, latency, and system reliability in production.
● Implement observability for data quality, feature drift, and model degradation.
● Establish automated testing, validation, and deployment pipelines for ML systems.
● Ensure scalability and cost efficiency across AI workloads.
Cross-Functional Collaboration
● Partner with Data Engineers to integrate AI pipelines with real-time and batch data systems.
● Collaborate with Product Managers to define AI-driven product capabilities and roadmap.
● Work with Software Engineers to integrate AI services into user-facing applications.
● Align with analytics and experimentation teams to measure model impact.
Technical Leadership
● Lead architectural decisions for AI/ML systems and data-driven applications.
● Mentor engineers in machine learning engineering, system design, and best practices.
● Establish standards for model development, deployment, and operational excellence.
● Drive innovation in applied AI across streaming and content platforms.

 

Required Technical Skills
Machine Learning & AI Systems
● Strong experience building and deploying machine learning models in production.
● Expertise in recommendation systems, personalization, ranking models, or NLP.
● Experience with model training frameworks (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch, or similar).
● Understanding of feature engineering, model evaluation, and experimentation frameworks.
Data & Feature Engineering
● Experience designing large-scale feature pipelines using batch and streaming data.
● Strong knowledge of data modeling and transformation for ML use cases.
● Familiarity with feature stores and real-time feature serving architectures.
Streaming & Real-Time Systems
● Experience integrating ML systems with real-time data platforms (e.g., Kafka, Pub/Sub).
● Understanding of event-driven architectures and low-latency processing patterns.
● Ability to design real-time inference and decisioning systems.
Cloud & Distributed Systems
● Strong experience with cloud-native architectures (GCP preferred).
● Experience deploying ML systems in Kubernetes-based environments.
● Understanding of distributed systems, scalability, and fault tolerance.
Software Engineering & APIs
● Proficiency in Python, Java, or similar languages for production systems.
● Experience building microservices and APIs for model serving.
● Strong software engineering fundamentals, including testing, CI/CD, and observability.

Basic Qualifications
● Strong foundation in machine learning engineering, data systems, and distributed
architecture.
● Proven track record of building and scaling AI/ML systems in production environments.
● Experience working with real-time data platforms and high-scale user-facing systems.
● Ability to balance long-term architecture with rapid product delivery.
● Excellent leadership, problem-solving, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
● Self-motivated, quality-driven, and focused on delivering measurable impact through AI.

Preferred Qualifications
● Experience in streaming, media, or consumer-facing platforms.
● Familiarity with experimentation platforms (A/B testing) and metrics-driven optimization.
● Experience building AI-powered data products and platform capabilities

 



 

Paramount Streaming, a division within Paramount Global, is the home to the company's direct-to-consumer services spanning free and paid in the form of Pluto TV and Paramount+. Pluto TV is the global leader in free ad-supported TV, delivering more than 1,400 global channels and an extensive library of streaming content, including live and original channels. Paramount+, digital subscription video-on-demand and live streaming service, combines live sports, breaking news, and A Mountain of Entertainment™. Paramount+ features an expansive library of original series, hit shows and popular movies across every genre from world-renowned brands and production studios, including SHOWTIME®.

 

 

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION

 

Hiring Salary Range: $156,800.00 - 235,200.00. 

 

The hiring salary range for this position applies to New York, California, Colorado, Washington state, and most other geographies. Starting pay for the successful applicant depends on a variety of job-related factors, including but not limited to geographic location, market demands, experience, training, and education.  The benefits available for this position include medical, dental, vision, 401(k) plan, life insurance coverage, disability benefits, tuition assistance program and PTO or, if applicable,  as otherwise dictated by the appropriate Collective Bargaining Agreement.

  • Generous paid time off.
  • An exciting and fulfilling opportunity to be part of one of Paramount’s most dynamic teams.

job.description:
#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?
We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, we’ve got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is… YOU! Becoming a part of Paramount means joining a team of passionate people who not only recognize the power of content but also enjoy a touch of fun and uniqueness. Together, we co-create moments that matter – both for our audiences and our employees – and aim to leave a positive mark on culture.

Experimentation Lead, Sign-Up & Cancellation Optimization
Team: Applied Intelligence
Company: Paramount Streaming (Paramount+, Pluto TV)


About the Role
Paramount Streaming is investing heavily in personalization, experimentation, and applied AI to shape how millions of viewers begin — and continue — their journey with Paramount+ and Pluto TV. We are seeking an Experimentation Lead to own and scale experimentation across the sign-up and cancellation flows. This is a highly strategic and execution-oriented role focused on identifying, prioritizing, launching, and scaling experiments that directly impact conversion, retention, and lifetime value. Reporting to the Principal Machine Learning Engineer for Sign-Up Optimization, you will act as the connective tissue between product, ML, engineering, data science, design, and growth — ensuring we are running the right experiments, running them well, and learning from them rigorously. This role blends product thinking, scientific rigor, experimentation design, and operational management.

 

What You’ll Do
Experimentation Strategy & Roadmapping

  • Define and own the experimentation roadmap across sign-up, onboarding, and cancellation flows for Paramount+ and Pluto TV.
  • Identify high-impact test opportunities across UX, messaging, offers, personalization, pricing, bundling, and model-driven experiences.
  • Translate business goals (conversion, churn reduction, engagement, LTV) into structured, testable hypotheses.
  • Prioritize experiments using data-driven frameworks balancing impact, risk, and resource constraints.

End-to-End Experiment Ownership

  • Drive experiments from ideation → design → instrumentation → launch → feedback → iteration.
  • Partner with ML engineers and applied scientists to test model-driven experiences (ranking, personalization, content ordering, offer targeting).
  • Ensure experiment configurations are correctly implemented and debug issues in targeting, logging, or exposure.
  • Monitor live experiments for integrity, guardrail breaches, or unintended side effects.
  • Lead post-test readouts and translate results into clear, actionable next steps.

job.description:
Storytelling is, and will always be, the heart of what we do at Skydance.
Our vision is to build a thriving entertainment ecosystem where stories and worlds are imagined, brought to life and experienced. We create for every age and audience, anchored by the strength of our content and experiences and the depth of our connection with fans. We are creator-first, audience-focused, tech-forward, globally scaled.

 

Here, you’ll work with talented teams that move fast, think boldly and collaborate with purpose to deliver results. We aim high, champion the best ideas and win together, earning the trust of our employees, creators, partners and audiences every day.

 

If you’re energized by the opportunity to help build the next-generation global media and entertainment company powered by creativity and technology, we’d be thrilled to welcome you aboard. LET’S GO!

 


Location: US - In Office (LA, NY, SF)

 

About This Role

Paramount is looking for a hardworking Lead Software Engineer - Android to develop cohesive solutions to content based technical obstacles. The role will be end-to-end from understanding the goals and roadmaps of the product and engineering teams, through design and architecture of any solution and the delivery and maintenance of those platforms once in place.

 

This role sits at the intersection of deep Android platform engineering and AI-native development: daily use of AI agents and coding tools (Cursor, Claude Code, Copilot) and hands-on collaboration with ML and data science teams on client-facing features.

 

We are seeking someone who will participate in the definition of product requirements, being able to articulate how the engineering effort will align to those requirements and provide accurate estimates of the effort. You will also be involved in platform architectural discussions and initiatives paving the way for optimizations and performance alongside. You will also be working with a team of engineers through the development process, including implementing standards around code, tooling, metrics, progress reporting and interactions with the QE team to ensure a quality first approach to any work.

 

Responsibilities

 

Technical Leadership

  • Drive the architectural direction and design of Android applications
  • Establish best practices for coding, testing, and deployment
  • Evangelize new tools, frameworks, and processes for continued innovation and development efficiency
  • Prepare architectural diagrams and technical specifications for the engineering team to deliver high quality, maintainable software
  • Lead architectural discussions around feature development and software development best practice
  • Involvement in performance and playback optimizations, overall app stability and profiling

 

Application Development

  • Design, develop, test, and deploy new solutions as well as maintaining, integrating and improving existing solutions using modern technologies and industry best practices
  • Ensure robust performance, responsiveness, and quality of applications, troubleshooting and debugging as needed

 

AI-Integrated Development

  • Leverage AI-driven coding assistants like Copilot, Cursor, or Claude as a core component of the daily engineering lifecycle, including architectural design, implementation, and refactoring.
  • Partner with technical leadership to establish and optimize safe, high-impact practices for utilizing AI tools within the development team.
  • Drive cross-functional initiatives to integrate LLM and ML capabilities into product features, such as advanced search, discovery, and personalized content understanding.

 

Mentorship

  • Mentor mid- and senior-level engineers, sharing technical expertise and guiding professional growth
  • Participate in code reviews to maintain code quality and consistency across the team

 

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with product managers, designers, and other engineering teams to clarify requirements
  • Coordinate with backend services and APIs to ensure seamless integration and feature delivery

 

Process Improvement

  • Enhance software development processes and policies, driving continuous improvement in code quality, development speed, and overall team productivity
  • Stay current with emerging Android technologies, libraries, and trends, recommending their adoption where beneficial

 

Ownership and Accountability

  • Partner closely with the Android Engineering Manager on development strategies
  • Ensure the application is highly responsive and performant
  • Safeguard against production incidents
  • Enable engineers to deliver mission-critical features and enhancements
  • Identify technical risks and potential bottlenecks, proposing solutions to mitigate them

 

Expertise in Android Development

  • Proficient in Kotlin and Java, with a solid understanding of the Android SDK and different Android versions
  • Deep knowledge of Architecture Patterns and Material Design (e.g., MVVM, MVI, Clean Architecture, Compose UI)
  • Experience using Gradle and Android Studio
  • Experience following and implementing software design patterns.

 

System Design & Architecture

  • Proven ability to design scalable, high-performing, and secure Android applications
  • Experience integrating complex RESTful APIs and third-party libraries

 

Testing and Quality Assurance

  • Strong experience in writing unit tests, UI tests, and automated tests using frameworks like JUnit, Espresso, and others
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and tools (e.g., Jenkins, GitHub Actions)

 

Performance Optimization

  • Ability to identify and resolve performance bottlenecks, including memory leaks, slow rendering, and network inefficiencies
  • Skilled in using performance profiling and optimizations (e.g., Android Profiler, Leak Canary)

 

Leadership and Communication

  • Ability to clearly articulate complex technical concepts to engineers, stakeholders, and executives
  • Strong mentoring skills, with a track record of developing and inspiring high-performing teams

 

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience)
  • 7+ years of professional software development experience, with at least 6 years focused on Android development
  • Demonstrated history of leading and delivering multiple large-scale Android projects in a production environment with multiple scrum teams in an agile process
  • Proven track record of architectural ownership and driving technical decisions
  • Excellent interpersonal skills with ability to facilitate conversations with business partners in project definition, business requirements definition and functional design sessions
  • Eye for quality and user experience
  • Translate business objectives into software requirements

 

Desired Qualifications

  • Hands on software development on the Android/Android TV/Amazon/Amazon Fire TV platform
  • Have shipped one or more apps to the Google Play and/or Amazon app store
  • Experience working remotely with globally distributed and multiple interdisciplinary teams
  • Experience working on Android projects with multi-module architecture
  • Experience with assistive technologies such as JAWS/VoiceOver, ZoomText, and keyboard-only input methods
  • Experience evaluating front-end code against the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG)
  • Experience developing accessible front-end experiences with techniques such as TalkBack properties used in XML (labelFor, contentDescription), TalkBack announcements, dynamic text scaling, and responsive design

 

AI Literacy

  • Hands-on, daily use of AI coding assistants such as Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or equivalent, with a clear sense of what these tools are good and bad at.
  • Comfort writing effective prompts, structuring context, and evaluating AI-generated diffs critically before they land in the codebase.
  • Working understanding of LLMs, embeddings, retrieval, and prompt engineering, enough to design client integrations and reason about latency, cost, and failure modes.
  • Practical experience shipping or seriously prototyping at least one ML- or LLM-powered product feature (search, ranking, personalization, content understanding, in-app assistant, etc.).
  • Judgment about responsible AI use: privacy, IP, attribution, and when a human review gate is required.

 

Bonus Skills (Nice To Have)

  • Experience with Video Streaming (HLS / MPEG-DASH)
  • Experience working with ExoPlayer
  • Widevine DRM knowledge

Overview

We are seeking a Machine Learning Engineer to join the PlutoTV pod. You will focus on Channel, Guide, and Schedule personalization. Your goal is to make the FAST (Free Ad-supported Streaming TV) experience feel as dynamic as a premium on-demand service. You will help build the models that select which channels appear in the guide and how content is scheduled to maximize viewer session length.   This role requires deep knowledge of FAST systems and the unique constraints of linear programming. You will implement features within our GCP stack, leveraging Qdrant for content similarity and Post-training RL to optimize the "Lean-back" viewing experience.   Why This Role Matters
  • Modernizing Linear TV: You are part of the team transforming the static EPG (Electronic Programming Guide) into a personalized, data-driven discovery engine.
  • Optimizing the "Lean-Back": Your models help users find something to watch immediately, reducing the friction inherent in "channel surfing."
  • Global Scale: PlutoTV is a leader in the FAST space; your code will impact the viewing habits of millions of users worldwide.
  Key Responsibilities
  • Feature Development: Design and deploy ML components for channel ranking and guide personalization.
  • FAST Metadata Integration: Work with linear scheduling data to create features that account for "Current" vs "Next" program relevance.
  • Vector-Based Similarity: Use Qdrantto group similar channels and content to improve the "More Like This" experience within the guide.
  • Model Refinement: Train and iterate on models using TensorFlow/PyTorch, focusing on session-start and watch-time metrics.
  • Independent Execution: Own the delivery of defined tasks within the PlutoTV roadmap, from data exploration to production deployment.
  Basic Qualifications
  • Minimum: 3+ years in MLE; proficiency in Python/SQL; experience with TensorFlow/PyTorch and GCP.

 

Additional Qualifications

  • Preferred: Knowledge with FAST or Broadcast TV data structures; experience with Qdrant or similar vector databases.

job.description:
About TEGNA

TEGNA Inc. helps people thrive in their local communities by providing the trusted local news and services that matter most. With 64 television stations in 51 U.S. markets, TEGNA reaches more than 100 million people monthly across the web, mobile apps, streaming, and linear television. Together, we are building a sustainable future for local news.

 

KSDK-TV Saint Louis, the TEGNA NBC station in Saint Louis is looking for a highly skilled artistic Photojournalist who can create shareable and exciting content for television, social media and mobile.  We want a photojournalist who can tell great stories on their own or with a team.  Our ideal candidates are familiar with the latest photography, editing tools, and techniques. They create unique and exciting content on all platforms. They are proficient with live news-gathering tools and are able to participate in live performance on-air and on live streaming when necessary. 

Current driver's license and ability to operate news gathering vehicle to and from various locations is required.

Responsibilities: 

  • Passion for capturing video & audio elements that produce compelling and engaging news, sports, features and documentary-style stories in a daily deadline environment.
  • Operate an ENG truck or IP video-based live unit (TVU) when assigned.
  • Be assigned to either work in a team or solo for daily news assignments. 
  • Attend editorial meetings, participate in discussions, and suggest story ideas. 
  • Use creative production techniques such as graphics and new forms of media (viewer pictures, webcam interviews, etc.) to enhance stories. 

Requirements: 

  • BA/BS in journalism, communications or related field preferred or equivalent years of experience  
  • 3-5 years of experience preferred in a newsroom environment. 
  • Experience in photojournalism, editing, and content management systems 
  • Must be flexible with schedule, reliable and dependable  
  • Proven ability to generate creative, engaging, content-driven live shots 
  • Member and active participant in NPPA a plus

  • Knowledge of EDIUS, or any Non-Linear base editing system preferred. 
  • Organizational skills and the ability to work under constant time pressure deadlines 
  • Ability to calmly handle live, breaking news situations and changing events 
  • Able to lift up to 40 lbs. and occasionally up to 80 lbs. with or without an accommodation

job.title: Audience Analyst
job.description:
Position Summary:

American Public Media Group is seeking an Audience Analyst to join the Audience Insights & Analytics team. This role offers a unique opportunity to use data, analysis, and insights to support audience growth, fundraising performance, and community impact at a mission-driven media organization.

This role supports strategic decision-making, revenue growth, and operational efficiency by analyzing audience, donor, and other first-party data. Its primary focus is partnering with the Membership and Audience Development & Marketing teams to provide reporting, analysis, and actionable recommendations for marketing campaigns, member drives, ongoing fundraising campaigns, annual planning, and overall strategy. The role also supports Philanthropic Development, Broadcast, Digital Products, and Finance teams.

The Audience Analyst will serve as a key contributor in utilizing data from the organization’s CRM, marketing activation platforms, data warehouse, and external sources. The role will develop and deliver efficient, reliable reporting and analysis while identifying opportunities to automate workflows, improve data quality, and strengthen analytical processes.

We are looking for someone who is self-motivated and demonstrates the ability to work collaboratively and effectively with colleagues in multiple departments across the organization. Success in this role requires combining technical depth with business judgment, producing accurate and reusable reporting, identifying meaningful patterns in audience and donor behavior, and translating findings into recommendations that stakeholders can act on.

Expected Compensation Range: $37.50 - $40.85 per hour. The exact salary rate is determined by experience and education related to the role, organizational compensation structure, and internal equity.

Location: Hybrid

Application Process: Applicants must be authorized to work for ANY employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time.

Application Deadline: Open until filled.

Position Responsibilities:

  • Collect, analyze, and interpret data from multiple internal and external sources with focus on CRM, marketing activation platforms, and other first-party data systems.
  • Develop proficiency with a variety of data platforms and reporting tools including Salesforce NPSP, Marketing Cloud, Power BI, and other tools as needed.
  • Provide analytics support for Membership teams by measuring and evaluating member drives, fundraising campaigns, and ongoing strategy; developing actionable reporting and recommendations; and supporting annual planning, revenue projections, and tracking of key performance indicators.
  • Provide reporting and analysis for our broadcast channels and teams across multiple stations and markets.
  • Translate data into clear recommendations, risks, and opportunities for senior leaders.
  • Query, mine, and analyze large data sets using SQL and other tools to identify patterns, troubleshoot discrepancies, validate data, and develop analyses that help the organization better understand its members and audiences.
  • Develop and maintain automated reporting and well-documented workflows that improve efficiency and ensure accuracy, consistency, and relevance across reporting used to support marketing, fundraising, and audience strategy.
  • Partner with technical and business teams to define business questions, develop measurement strategies, conduct analysis, validate findings, and deliver actionable insights and recommendations.
  • Collaborate with the Audience Insights & Analytics team to prioritize recurring reporting and ad hoc requests, meet agreed-upon deadlines, and communicate clearly with leaders and stakeholders about scope, timelines, tradeoffs, and analytical opportunities.

Required Education and Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Economics, Business, Analytics, Mathematics, Data Science, Statistics, related field, OR equivalent work experience.
  • 2+ years of experience in marketing analytics, business analytics, database analytics, audience analytics, donor analytics, or a similar role.
  • 2+ years of experience and proficiency using SQL independently for data extraction, transformation, validation, troubleshooting, and analysis of large or complex data sets.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to identify patterns and anomalies, retrieve and manipulate data, investigate discrepancies, and draw well-supported conclusions.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to translate data into clear business recommendations.
  • Ability to self-manage goals, priorities, workload, deadlines, internal client relationships, and process development.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Outlook, Excel, Word, PowerPoint, etc.), Teams, Slack, or similar productivity software.

Preferred Skills, Knowledge and Abilities:

  • Experience working with Salesforce, Marketing Cloud, or other CRM platforms and associated data.
  • Experience developing dashboards, reports, and data visualizations in Power BI, Tableau, Looker, or a similar business intelligence tool.
  • Proficiency in SQL or other analytical programming languages or tools, such as DAX, R, Python, or SAS.
  • Familiarity with advanced techniques to support marketing such as clustering, predictive modeling, lifetime value (LTV), attribution, media mix modeling, or other concepts to support marketing spend, conversion, and strategy.
  • Experience analyzing performance across content, media, digital publishing, or membership/subscription businesses.

Reporting To This Position:  None.

Physical Demands and Working Conditions:

  • Must be able to perform the essential duties of the position in an office environment with or without reasonable accommodation.
  • Physical Demands: Required to move about in an office environment and sit for extended periods of time. Frequent use of hands for data entry/keystrokes and simple grasping.

APMG offers a comprehensive benefits package including Medical plans with HSA and FSA options, Dental, Vision, Life and AD&D, Short-Term and Long-Term Disability, Paid Parental Leave and Paid Caregiver Leave after 1 year, Vacation (3 wks./per year, pro-rated, based on hours worked), Sick time (12 days, pro-rated, based on hours worked), Holiday Pay (10 holidays + 2 floating holidays each year), Volunteer Time (8 hours per year), Long-Term Care and Critical Illness insurance options, Employee Assistance Program, 403(b) Retirement Plan, and more.

Diversity creates a healthier atmosphere: All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, protected veteran status, disability status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by law. We are committed to hiring a breadth of diverse professionals and encourage members of diverse groups to apply.

job.title: Press Operator Nights - Tulsa
job.description:
Press Operator – Night Shift

Tulsa World, a Lee Enterprises company, and print and digital media solutions provider for broadcast and traditional news media, is seeking a Press Operator. The Press Operator is a vital role in the production of our newspapers and various other print products. This position is on the night shift, but will have initial training period during the day.

Press Operators will be required to operate and maintain press components and controls, quickly grasp a thorough understanding of every facet of the pressroom, maintain a commitment to quality and work within a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.

Key Responsibilities

Makes paster patterns and operates paster controls to load pasters and operate splicing sequence.

Spot plates according to job press order, mount plates involving reaching in and mounting plates into the slot lock up accurate

Manually lead webs with different web configurations involving reaching in and over to guide press webs over rollers through press units, across superstructure rollers to press folder based on specific press configuration

Stir ink, check viscosity and monitor ink feed functions to printing units before and during press run.

Clean press, pipe rollers, press cylinder blankets with cleaning solvents and wipes up any ink spills

Responsible for setting up and maintaining the operation of presses before and during press runs.

Expected to handle routine job tasks on a day to day basis, maintaining accuracy while meeting deadlines.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

Ability to follow all Company policies and procedures including but not limited to attendance standards.

Mechanical skill helpful

The ability to effectively communicate and interact personally with staff, other departments and other employees of the organization professionally

Ability to work in a team environment

Ability to read, comprehend and write simple instructions, short correspondences, and memos

Education & Experience

High School Diploma or GED

Press or printing experience preferred, but not required

job.title: Page Six Reporter (Tues-Sat)
job.description:
Job Description:


The New York Post delivers news, sports, pop culture and entertainment with unmatched speed, attitude and authority, reaching more than 90 million unique viewers each month. With a 225 year legacy and a fast moving digital first newsroom, the Post operates across print, digital, video, audio, app, television and commerce, and continues to define the city’s most talked about stories.

Page Six Digital is the modern evolution of the iconic gossip column, delivering the latest in celebrity news, entertainment, and pop culture with a bold, fast-paced digital edge. As the go-to destination for breaking stories, exclusive scoops, and viral moments, Page Six has grown far beyond its print roots to become a dynamic, multi-platform brand that reaches millions of readers daily across web, social, and video.

Page Six is looking for a bold, sharp, and pop culture-obsessed Reporter (Tues-Sat) who lives and breathes celebrity news. This is your chance to join the authority in entertainment gossip and help drive the conversations that everyone will be talking about tomorrow. You’ll pitch and write buzzy, can’t-miss stories daily with speed, accuracy, and unmistakable voice. We want someone who’s always one step ahead—plugged into social media trends, fluent in fan culture, and relentless in uncovering those juicy, under-the-radar scoops that make Page Six sizzle. If you thrive in a fast-paced newsroom, know your way around SEO and analytics, and can spot a viral moment before it breaks, we want to hear from you. Let’s make headlines.

Note: The schedule for this role is Tuesday-Friday 1-9pm EST, Saturday 10am-6pm EST.

Responsibilities: 

  • Pitch and write 5-6 celebrity and entertainment-based stories quickly and with clean copy daily

  • Proactively seek out and uncover under-the-radar stories that will resonate with the Page Six audience 

  • Have your finger on the pulse of what fans are talking about on social media and the ability to create content that fits their interests

  • Help expand Page Six’s nighttime news coverage by monitoring social media and using analytics tools (Google Analytics, Parse.ly, etc.) to achieve success

  • Be a self-starter and have the ability to think quickly on their feet and multitask in a fast-paced news environment

  • Have an understanding of SEO best practices and analytics and use that knowledge to help guide coverage 

Qualifications:

  • At least two years of major journalism experience

  • A deep understanding of and passion for all things celebrity and entertainment

  • Exceptional writing and reporting skills

  • Ability to write succinct, eye-catching headlines and clean, ready-to-publish content

  • Knowledge and understanding of SEO best practices 

  • Strong editorial judgment and communication skills

  • Familiarity with content management systems (Wordpress, in particular), photo editing software & web analytics tools

  • Flexibility in covering live pop culture events (i.e. Oscars, Golden Globes, etc.) and working outside traditional business hours when needed

Note: The New York Post adheres to an on-site work model. NYC-based candidates will be expected to report into the office 5 days per week. Also open to LA-based candidates.

Equal Opportunity Employer

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, protected veteran status, disability status or any other protected characteristic under applicable law. EEO/Disabled/Vets

Reasonable Accommodation

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities in our job application and/or interview process. If you need assistance or accommodation in completing your application or participating in an interview due to a disability, email us at humanresources@newscorp.com. Please put "Reasonable Accommodation" in the subject line and provide a brief description of the type of assistance you need. This inbox will not be monitored for application status updates.

Please refer to the privacy notice at the bottom of this page for submitting any data access, deletion, or other data subject rights requests, where permitted under your local laws and regulations.


Base Pay Range: -

We’re committed to offering competitive and flexible compensation to attract top talent. This pay range reflects our good faith estimate for the role and may vary based on a candidate’s experience, skills, location, and other relevant factors.


For bonus-eligible roles, targets are determined based on multiple considerations, including market benchmarks and individual contributions.


For benefits-eligible roles, we offer a comprehensive and competitive benefits package covering health, retirement, wellbeing, and more, along with optional benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees

job.title: Junior HR Business Partner (Remote)
job.description:
The Associated Press is an independent global news organization dedicated to factual reporting. Founded in 1846, AP today remains the most trusted source of fast, accurate, unbiased news in all formats and the essential provider of the technology and services vital to the news business. More than half the world's population sees AP journalism every day.

 

Location: Remote, U.S.

 

Why this role matters:

We are seeking a proactive and collaborative Junior HR Business Partner to support our HR Business Partner team in delivering a high-quality employee and manager experience across AP. Reporting to the HR Director, News, this role will serve as a key partner to HR Business Partners and business leaders, providing HR support on talent, organizational, and workforce matters.

 

What you will do:

Working closely with HRBPs, HR Operations, and other HR specialist teams, the Junior HR Business Partner will support a wide range of employee and manager needs across assigned client groups. This role will provide hands-on HRBP support on both routine activities and contribute to strategic initiatives led by HRBPs, while partnering directly with managers and employees to resolve issues, coordinate HR processes, and ensure effective delivery of HR services.

 

Key responsibilities

  • Serve as support to HRBPs on a variety of requests, providing guidance and support across a range of day-to-day HR topics and escalating more complex matters as appropriate.
  • Partner closely with HRBPs and HR Operations to support managers and employees and ensure smooth coordination and follow-through on requests and cases.
  • Support managers and HRBPs with employee and labor relations matters, including performance management, disciplinary processes, providing guidance within established policies and practices and escalating complex or higher risk matters as appropriate.
  • Help facilitate employee transfers, mobility-related processes, immigration, and other cross-functional HR activities as needed.
  • Partner with the Talent and HRIS teams to understand data as it relates to people and ensure HRBPs and HR specialist teams are connected on people data.
  • Contribute to HR projects, process improvements and operational initiatives that support team effectiveness and employee experience.
  • Help document and improve HR processes and ways of working in partnership with the HR Operations team.

 

Who you are:

This role is ideal for someone currently in an HR Adviser or Generalist role, with an interest in developing as an HR Business Partner in a fast-paced global environment. The successful candidate will have HR generalist experience supporting employees and managers across the U.S and other countries.

 

The Junior HRBP will support across the employee lifecycle, including talent acquisition, employee and labor relations, manager coaching, employee mobility and organisational change, while helping ensure HR policies practices are aligned with local employment requirements and business needs.

 

The successful candidate will be highly organized, solutions-oriented, collaborative, and comfortable managing a variety of operational, tactical and strategic support activities simultaneously.

 

The successful candidate will be

  • Highly organized with strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • A strong critical thinker who is comfortable evaluating complex situations, navigating ambiguity and adapting to changing priorities.
  • A collaborative and proactive team player who enjoys solving problems and working across teams.
  • A confident communicator with the ability to build strong working relationships with employees, managers, and HR stakeholders, and is comfortable partnering with senior stakeholders and managing up effectively.
  • Comfortable handling sensitive and confidential information with professionalism and discretion.
  • Adaptable and eager to learn across both HRBP and HR Operations disciplines.

 

Required:

  • Up to 3 years of HR experience in a fast-paced global environment.
  • Experience supporting managers and employees across day-to-day HR processes and inquiries.
  • Experience supporting employee relations processes, HR policies, and employee lifecycle. 
  • Experience applying HR policies and employment practices across multiple jurisdictions, including recognizing when local requirements or specialist guidance apply.
  • Experience working with HR systems, maintaining and analyzing employee data with accuracy, and using data to inform decision making.
  • Exceptional attention to detail with strong organizational and communication skills.
  • Ability to drive actions and initiatives through to completion and deliver agreed outcomes in a complex, multi-stakeholder environment.
  • Experience partnering across all HR functions and coordinating with multiple stakeholders.

 

What will set you apart:

  • Experience supporting employees and managers in a unionized environment, or an interest in developing experience in labor relations, preferred.
  • Knowledge of SAP and Success Factors preferred.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, particularly Excel, is preferred.

 

Why Join Us? 

  • A mission-driven, inclusive environment focused on both individual and collective success.
  • Opportunities for professional development to help you reach your career goals.
  • Access to tools, mentorship, and resources tailored to elevate your proficiency and contributions.

job.description:
Job Description:


Summer 2027 Bartley Fellowship - Arts Criticism Internship 

Job Description:

The Wall Street Journal's Arts in Review section is seeking aspiring journalists—juniors, seniors or recent graduates (within one year of graduation) with a strong editing background at their school newspapers or elsewhere—for a 10-week paid summer internship. The in-person internship is an opportunity to get hands-on experience working alongside some of the best opinion writers and editors in the world.

The internship—formally the Bartley Fellowship—honors the Journal’s former Opinion editor, Robert L. Bartley. Opportunities will be awarded to individuals interested in the arts who intend to pursue a career in journalism or cultural criticism.

The Arts intern is one of several fellows selected each year through an application process that is overseen by senior editors. Bartley Fellows are assigned to a department within the Opinion section—Arts in Review; Books; or Features (Op-Eds and Columns). The fellow will assist in producing Arts in Review’s content for the print and digital editions of the Journal—editing, fact-checking, liaising with writers, writing display copy, proofing, contributing to social media and digital production. Though this is not a writing fellowship, the Bartley fellow will be encouraged to produce a Masterpiece column, of which more below. They may also pitch articles or projects to editors elsewhere in the Opinion section.

Internships are paid, and generally take place during June, July and August, though start dates can be flexible. 

If you are interested in applying for the Opinion, Books or Arts in Review Bartley Fellowships, please submit separate applications for each position.


About Arts in Review 


Arts criticism is recognized at the Journal as an Editorial Page function, and as such operates under the umbrella of the Opinion section. Like the rest of the Opinion section, in our Arts reviews we believe in rendering clear, independent judgments that are as well argued as they are deeply informed.

In its Arts reviews, the Journal covers the full spectrum, from high art to TV, movies, theater and the many forms of popular music. Our approach is strictly art-for-art’s-sake: We review things because they are intrinsically interesting, not to fulfill a quota or make a political statement. We believe in the past and its traditions, but are keenly interested in the new—not in novelty for its own sake but in the ways those traditions are being extended and new ones invented. And we prize above all a lively, lucid prose style free from jargon of all kinds.


Guidelines and Application Deadline

Though a reporting and/or writing background is a plus, the fellowship is primarily an editing internship. Therefore applicants should have experience editing arts or arts-related copy for their college newspaper, literary magazine, or a comparable publication. Students from any discipline may apply, but preference will be granted to those concentrating in literature, history, a foreign language, classics, pre-law, music, theater, art history, studio art, architecture, philosophy, political science or archaeology—via coursework (though not necessarily a major) or sustained leisure-time activity.

An appreciation for both the Western and non-Western canons is desirable, as is an understanding of current issues in the arts. A demonstrated ability to multitask and meet daily deadlines is critical for success, as is attention to detail and a focus on accuracy. Applicants should be familiar with technology as it relates to journalism. Social media experience with a publication or brand would be a plus.

Applicants will be expected to demonstrate familiarity with our section’s content (student applicants without campus-wide access to the WSJ can purchase discounted subscriptions at https://www.wsj.com/studentoffer).

If you’d like to be considered, please submit the following in one single, complete PDF file:

  • A cover letter
  • Your résumé
  • Full text of your two best clips
  • Your response to the following prompt in no more than 800 words: Write a “Masterpiece” column. In these essays that appear every Saturday, a writer discusses a single work of art (painting, book, film, etc.) and explains why, in their view, it is of surpassing cultural significance. (Examples: https://www.wsj.com/news/types/masterpiece)

All materials must be received by Nov. 30, 2026. Only complete applications that include a cover letter, résumé and responses to the prompt will be considered. Please do not include any additional materials, such as transcripts, recommendation letters, etc. In order to be considered, you must be a U.S. citizen, or a holder of a green card or visa that will allow you to work in the United States. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis and we endeavor to make selections by the end of February. Only finalists will be contacted.


About Bob Bartley


Throughout his 30 years as The Wall Street Journal’s Editorial Page Editor, Bob Bartley inspired principled and original thinking that changed and shaped the society in which we live. He also devoted attention to teaching and motivating talented young people, many of whom have gone on to careers in journalism at the Journal and elsewhere. The Bartley Fellowships are consistent with that legacy.

Bob Bartley achieved many honors during his long tenure here, including a Pulitzer Prize and, shortly before his death in December 2003, the Presidential Medal of Freedom. In awarding that medal, President George W. Bush cited Bob as “one of the most influential journalists in American history.” The Robert L. Bartley Fellowships will help to perpetuate not only Bob’s memory but, above all, the principles and priorities to which he devoted his distinguished career.


About the Opinion Section


Following the American newspaper practice, the heads of News and Editorial report independently to the publisher of the Journal and CEO of Dow Jones, Almar Latour. The Editorial staff is responsible for the Opinion content published on WSJ.com, the editorial and op-ed pages of The Wall Street Journal in print, and criticism of books and the arts, which are recognized at the Journal as an Opinion function.

While The Wall Street Journal’s news pages are committed to informing our readers, our editorials are dedicated to advocating a consistent philosophy and positions that emanate from it. That philosophy can be summed up as “free markets, free people.” We have stood for these fundamental principles even in times—and places—when they were not considered fashionable. While specific issues differ in various parts of the world, we view those issues through a consistent lens everywhere; for example, while protectionism is more popular in some parts of the world than others, our publications around the world are committed uncompromisingly to free trade.

We believe in the individual, in his wisdom and his decency. We oppose all infringements on individual rights, whether they stem from attempts at private monopoly, labor union monopoly or from an overgrowing government. Our section is not easily pigeonholed or predictable. We resist the label “conservative,” in the sense of preserving the status quo, because we think it too confining, too devoid of the optimism inherent in trusting individual wisdom and decency.

It is also important to state clearly what our section does not represent. It is not partisan. Unlike many American publishers, we do not endorse political candidates, and from time to time we have important disagreements with all leading political figures. We view issues through the lens of our philosophy and let our readers decide which person or party best serves to protect market capitalism and self-government.

We believe that the ultimate function of opinion journalism is the same as the rest of the newspaper: to inform. But in opinion journalism we have the additional purpose of making an argument for a point of view. We often take sides on the major issues of politics and society, with a goal of moving policies or events in what we think is the best direction for the country and the world. Our experience over many years is that even those who disagree with us on particular issues—or even on broader philosophical grounds—nevertheless respect us for the clarity, consistency and eloquence with which we present our point of view. In stating our own views forcefully, we hope to raise and sharpen the level of debate and knowledge. And we hope that our editorials reflect not merely the passing whim of passing editors, but a body of thought shaped by a century of tradition.

We oppose all infringements on individual rights, whether they stem from attempts at private monopoly, labor union monopoly or from an overgrowing government. Our section is not easily pigeonholed or predictable. We resist the label “conservative,” in the sense of preserving the status quo, because we think it too confining, too devoid of the optimism inherent in trusting individual wisdom and decency.

It is also important to state clearly what our section does not represent. It is not partisan. Unlike many American publishers, we do not endorse political candidates, and from time to time we have important disagreements with all leading political figures. We view issues through the lens of our philosophy and let our readers decide which person or party best serves to protect market capitalism and self-government.

We believe that the ultimate function of opinion journalism is the same as the rest of the newspaper: to inform. But in opinion journalism we have the additional purpose of making an argument for a point of view. We often take sides on the major issues of politics and society, with a goal of moving policies or events in what we think is the best direction for the country and the world. Our experience over many years is that even those who disagree with us on particular issues—or even on broader philosophical grounds—nevertheless respect us for the clarity, consistency and eloquence with which we present our point of view. In stating our own views forcefully, we hope to raise and sharpen the level of debate and knowledge. And we hope that our editorials reflect not merely the passing whim of passing editors, but a body of thought shaped by a century of tradition.

You will oversee the editorial teams responsible for the assessment and publication of benchmark prices, assessments and market-moving news across global petrochemical and chemical markets from our PCW brand.

You ensure the integrity, quality, transparency, and market relevance of chemical price assessments while maintaining the highest ethical and methodological standards. You will lead a global team of price reporters and editors responsible for market coverage across key chemical value chains - including aromatics, olefins, plastics, polymers, syngas, methanol, feedstocks, and emerging chemical markets.

You will drive editorial excellence, benchmark innovation, and market engagement, while ensuring compliance with legal requirements and industry standards. You will partner closely with Product, Standards & Compliance, Risk, and other Editorial leaders to ensure Dow Jones Energy's chemicals assessments remain trusted, transparent, and indispensable to global commodity markets.

You will report to the SVP - Markets & Price Reporting.

About the Team:

Dow Jones Energy delivers trusted price transparency, benchmarks, analytics, news, and insights across the global energy, chemicals, metals, and fuel supply value chains. Our offerings support institutional investors, analysts, and traders navigating spot, wholesale, and retail markets, as well as emerging segments tied to the global energy transition.

Through authoritative data, real-time intelligence, and deep market expertise, Dow Jones Energy enables financial professionals to mitigate risk and make high-stakes commercial decisions in volatile, fast-evolving global markets.

You Will:

  • Lead and develop a global team of chemicals price reporters, editors, and market specialists, fostering a culture of editorial excellence, accountability, and collaboration

job.title: Principal Product Designer - Market Data
job.description:
Job Description:


About the Role:

As Principal Product Designer - Market Data, you will own the design strategy for our Market Data platform—the real-time quotes, charting, watchlists, screeners, and visualization systems that power how millions of people read and act on financial markets across The Wall Street Journal, Barron's, MarketWatch, and Investor's Business Daily. This is a senior individual-contributor role for someone who sets direction across our financial brands and is the go-to design expert for how Dow Jones presents market data.

Market Data connects across every one of our financial brands, and this role sets the design strategy that spans all of them. Your decisions will establish shared patterns—for quotes, charts, tables, portfolios, and alerts—that these brands build on. You will own the direction for how investors of every kind, from first-time savers to sophisticated professionals, interpret dense, fast-moving data and turn it into confident decisions, balancing the distinct needs of each brand against the consistency and quality users expect wherever they encounter our data.

And this reach won't stop at the consumer. Market and pricing data runs across much of Dow Jones—so your influence will extend well beyond the consumer brands into our professional and enterprise products, from Factiva and Dow Jones Risk & Compliance to Dow Jones Energy, wherever market data underpins the experience. Where data meets the broader product, you will be the design lead who makes it cohere.

This is a role of real influence and scope. You will shape strategy with senior leadership, resolve tension between individual brand priorities and platform consistency, define the market-data patterns that live in our Index Design System, and mentor senior designers across the financial brands. You will be the design authority for your domain—navigating ambiguity and setting the standard others in your area build on.

You will report to the VP of Product Design within the Design & Research organization.

About the Team:

Our Design & Research org brings together world-class designers and researchers with a unified purpose: to connect people to the news and information that matters most. We're the strategic force that transforms deep user understanding into exceptional product experiences across our entire portfolio—from The Wall Street Journal to Factiva.

Our integrated approach ensures that research insights directly shape design decisions, while design explorations reveal new research opportunities. Together, we're building coherent, accessible experiences that honor our 135-year legacy while pushing us boldly into the future. We're a globally distributed team spearheading a digital transformation at Dow Jones, newly staffed by industry leaders from Google, LinkedIn, The New York Times, and more. Through our combined expertise in design craft and research rigor, we ensure that millions of users can depend on our platforms for truth in a world full of noise.

You Will:

  • Own the design strategy for the Market Data platform across our financial brands—setting a coherent, multi-year direction for quotes, charting, watchlists, screeners, portfolios, and data visualization that spans The Wall Street Journal, Barron's, MarketWatch, and IBD, and connecting it to measurable outcomes like engagement, retention, and revenue

  • Shape strategy with senior leadership. Present your design direction for the Market Data platform to senior design, product, and business leaders—and to executives where the work warrants—building the partnerships that advance it across brands and making the case for how well-designed data experiences create competitive advantage

  • Solve the hard, ambiguous problems in your domain—developing new patterns, methods, and approaches for presenting complex financial information across multiple brands, and building a deep understanding of the problem space that lets you see opportunities ahead

  • Shape the market-data patterns in our Index Design System. Establish the charting, data-table, real-time, and visualization standards that become the norm across the financial brands—knowing when consistency serves the user and when a brand's audience warrants a tailored approach—and help adjacent teams adopt and evolve them

  • Extend your influence beyond our consumer brands into the wider portfolio—the professional and enterprise products, from Factiva and Risk & Compliance to Newswires and OPIS, where market and pricing data is just as central—so the experiences built on our data share the same clarity, rigor, and craft. Be the design lead wherever data shapes the product

  • Set a high bar for craft. Define what excellence looks like for dense, real-time financial information—typography, information density, motion, and the accessibility of complex tables and charts—and ensure consistent quality across the brands through design reviews and audits

  • Connect design to outcomes. Partner with Research and analytics to tie your decisions to engagement, retention, and subscription metrics, and help teams across the financial brands understand which measures matter for market-data experiences

  • Mentor and grow senior designers across the financial brands, shape a strong design culture, and strengthen the talent pipeline through the standards you set and the craft you share

You Have:

  • 10+ years of product design experience, including significant time owning complex, systems-level or platform work, with a track record of setting design direction that spans multiple products or brands

  • Deep expertise designing data-rich experiences—financial data, analytics, dashboards, data visualization, or other complex information display—where clarity, density, and trust matter as much as visual polish

  • A portfolio that demonstrates strategic impact across multiple products or brands: platform or design-system contributions, cross-team pattern-setting, and strong end-to-end craft on sophisticated products

  • A proven ability to influence senior stakeholders, translating design strategy into business terms and building alignment across teams whose priorities compete

  • Mastery of data visualization and information design—charting, tables, real-time data, progressive disclosure—and the judgment to know when complexity serves the user and when it gets in the way

  • Strong systems thinking and deep experience with design systems, including establishing patterns that other teams adopt and evolve

  • Excellence in Figma, with the ability to set standards for design communication, specifications, and documentation across teams

  • A deep command of design fundamentals and accessibility standards (WCAG), with particular fluency in making dense, complex data usable for everyone

  • A track record of mentoring designers and helping raise the craft and quality of the teams around you

  • Comfort operating in ambiguity—setting direction in your domain amid shifting priorities and emerging technology, and acting as the go-to expert others turn to

  • Bachelor's degree in Design, HCI, related field -OR- equivalent experience 

Nice to Have

  • Experience designing for financial services, investing, trading, or fintech products

  • Familiarity with real-time or streaming data systems and the constraints they place on design

  • Working knowledge of financial concepts—markets, instruments, portfolio construction—sufficient to partner deeply with domain experts

  • Background in news media, publishing, or other content-heavy products

  • Experience designing across a multi-brand portfolio

  • Experience contributing meaningfully to a design system

  • An external presence through speaking or writing on data visualization, information design, or design at scale

  • International or cross-cultural design experience

job.title: Executive Director - Intermediate Chemicals Market Research & Analysis
job.description:
Job Description:


About the Role:

As Executive Director - Intermediate Chemicals Market Research & Analysis, you will be a member of the research leadership team responsible for developing and stewarding intermediate chemicals market research and analysis. You will report to the Vice President of Research.

About the Team:

Dow Jones Energy delivers trusted price transparency, benchmarks, analytics, news, and insights across the global energy, chemicals, metals, and fuel supply value chains. Our offerings support institutional investors, analysts, and traders navigating spot, wholesale, and retail markets, as well as emerging segments tied to the global energy transition.

Through authoritative data, real-time intelligence, and deep market expertise, Dow Jones Energy enables financial professionals to mitigate risk and make high-stakes commercial decisions in volatile, fast-evolving global markets.

You Will:

  • Direct primary research focused on the global market coverage of intermediate chemicals; particularly acrylonitrile, oxides, styrenics, glycols, synthetic fibers, chlor-alkali and vinyls

  • Acts as a liaison between Dow Jones Energy & external suppliers

  • Oversee the price forecasting process and communicate key forecast messages internally and externally

  • Establish and maintain a reputation for intermediate chemicals coverage by overseeing and deploying subject matter experts to industry events, media opportunities, client engagements and internal functions

  • Build and maintain industry contact relationships across producers, consumers, traders, and the financial community

  • Ensure that the team follows Dow Jones Energy price discovery standards

  • Collaborate with sales personnel to identify new business opportunities for sales and consulting engagements

  • Coordinate market content for consulting projects and client development

  • Advise content leaders on research topics and ideas to improve existing weekly and monthly reports and strategic analyses

  • Develop market presentations and pursue opportunities to present information in client meetings and conferences

  • Actively market the portfolio of intermediate chemicals services

  • Contribute to Dow Jones Energy team dynamics to ensure consistent global coverage and analysis

  • Serve as a key stakeholder for marquee value chain events

You Have:

  • 15+ years’ chemical industry experience in one or more of these areas: acrylonitrile, oxides, styrenics, glycols, synthetic fibers, chlor-alkali or vinyls

  • Experience in managing 10+ direct reports & mentoring skip-level reports which includes highly experienced multi-disciplinary, market experts 

  • The ability to identify and articulate core/essential issues within complex problems and deliver insights and solutions

  • Experience managing ambiguity with minimal direction

job.title: Senior Investing & Funds Editor
job.description:
Job Description:


About the Team:

Since 1921, Barron's has delivered the need-to-know information for all those seeking to accumulate wealth, and provided a robust understanding of what propels the markets and business community. At the forefront, Barron’s is a catalyst for economic change with a powerful network of influential business leaders, financial advisors, institutional and affluent individual investors among its audience. Readers look to the publication for daily unparalleled financial information and expertise to drive results in our world and the markets.


About the Role:

Barron's is seeking a Senior Editor to spearhead and shape our coverage of ETFs, funds, and other topics across the investing landscape.

The editor must have in-depth knowledge of investing across asset classes, understand portfolio construction and asset allocation, and ensure our coverage provides highly actionable advice. Coverage will span stocks, ETFs, mutual funds, fixed income, alternatives, private assets, and portfolio strategy. The editor will guide writers in synthesizing complex investment research into clear takeaways for Barron's readers. This role involves editing timely articles to ensure voice and authority, but the successful applicant must also be able to conceptualize, assign, and polish longer, deeply reported features, Q&As, and analytical cover stories.


You Will:

  • Guide and Shape Coverage: Help writers use portfolio construction tools, risk metrics, and asset allocation strategies to develop original investing angles for individual investors and advisors.
  • Elevate Storytelling: Ensure writers accurately and clearly explain complex financial vehicles (including actively managed ETFs, target-date funds, and alternative strategies) in simple language, highlighting why they matter for a portfolio.
  • Manage the News Cycle: Assign, shape, and edit quick analytical takes and strong ideas off breaking market news, meeting urgent deadlines.
  • Maintain Industry Expertise: Stay deeply familiar with major asset managers, fund flows, index providers, and U.S. market trends.

You Have:

  • At least five years of experience working as an editor, reporter, or analyst covering asset management, funds, or retail investing, or experience in financial services with a demonstrated ability to edit clearly and concisely.
  • A strong understanding of asset allocation, fund mechanics, ETF structures, and portfolio theory.
  • Experience conceptualizing enterprise features or fund analysis.
  • Sharp, accurate deadline editing skills and the capability to deliver timely analysis—or an interesting angle—in clear and simple language.
  • A collaborative, diplomatic approach and confidence in making fast, well-thought-out decisions while remaining calm under pressure.

Interested candidates should send a resume, a cover letter, and no more than three clips (or before-and-after examples of edited pieces) in PDF form to the hiring team by applying through the link on this job posting.

job.title: Manager, Social & Emerging Platforms
job.description:
Job Description:


About The Team:

The Trust is the award-winning creative studio of The Wall Street Journal and Barron's Group, creating premium branded content and storytelling for some of the world's leading brands. We combine the journalistic excellence and authority of our publications with strategic creativity, data-driven insights and innovative content experiences to help clients connect with influential audiences.


About the Role:

The Manager, Social & Emerging Platforms is a strategic and creative thinker tasked with helping to drive the cross-functional vision, growth, and execution of emerging and evolving content formats including social, TV and LLM-optimized formats for Custom Content and Brand Advertising.

Evolving beyond core social channel management and creative vision, this role bridges creative direction, platform strategy, and commercial opportunity. You, with a new social team, will establish centralized ownership over the custom and brand social ecosystem—from pricing and product strategy to paid distribution and end-to-end creative direction. Additionally, this role acts as a primary cross-platform strategist, expanding storytelling initiatives into appropriate TV formats with social extensions as well as actively contributing to traditional video programming, host/talent engagements, and next-generation media consumption platforms.

Positioned with clear cross-departmental visibility, you will re-establish early-stage involvement in pre-sale strategic development, ensuring social and emerging platform strategies are baked into overarching campaign narratives rather than added downstream. You will also oversee dedicated execution resources across paid media and creative strategy, elevating the organization’s overall expertise and driving commercial revenue growth.

This role offers an early progression path toward creative leadership across the broader media organization and visibility with new teams, including TV. 


You Will:

  • Strategic Vision & Commercial Ownership
    • Centralize Social Strategy: Serve as the primary, authoritative voice of social as a cross-MMS function across both Custom Content and Brand Advertising.
    • Product & Pricing Strategy: Partner with Product Strategy to design, price, and package scalable social products, custom content offerings, and paid distribution models that reflect competitive publisher benchmarks.
    • Early-Stage Pre-Sale Ideation: Re-establish early seat-at-the-table involvement in high-value pre-sale pitch workflows, shaping core strategic frameworks and creative directions from inception.
    • Cross-Departmental Enablement: Develop internal education, standards, and training to enable sales, planning, and editorial teams, driving revenue growth and reducing execution friction.
  • Creative Direction & Platform Expansion
    • Omnichannel Creative Direction: Lead high-level creative direction for social-first campaigns while expanding traditional Creative Director duties across broader media formats where new platforms and social and LLM optimization are critical – expected to be a greater number of campaigns. 
    • Emerging Content Platforms: Continuously evaluate and test new platforms, content formats, and media consumption habits to keep the studio at the forefront of digital culture and audience behavior.
    • Paid & Organic Alignment: Oversee paid social strategies and organic content outputs, ensuring campaign creative aligns with platform-native behaviors and delivery algorithms.
  • Team Leadership & Resource Management
    • Team Supervision: Working with your manager, direct and manage dedicated execution resources, including Full-Time Paid Social Strategists and Social Writer, delegating day-to-day tactical output to focus on higher-level strategic expansion.
    • Workflow Optimization: Establish formalized team structures and operational workflows that eliminate organizational ambiguity and streamline production between internal creative, sales, and product teams.

You Have:

  • Experience: 7+ years of progressive experience in digital strategy, social media leadership, or creative strategy within a media publisher, agency, or content studio environment.
  • Strategic & Commercial Acumen: Proven track record of developing market-ready digital/social products, establishing pricing strategy, and shaping pre-sale pitches that win commercial business.
  • Creative Scope: Strong portfolio of creative direction spanning short-form social, native video, platform-first strategy, and cross-platform extensions (e.g., experiential, events, hosting).
  • Team Management: Experience delegating execution to direct reports or specialized strategists (paid and creative) while maintaining quality control and high-level client delivery.
  • Cross-Functional Influence: Ability to navigate complex, matrixed media organizations, build consensus across product/editorial/sales teams, and establish formal operational ownership.

Job Description:


Financial Translator - Spanish (Latin American) 

New York/ Hybrid based


Dow Jones Newswires is seeking two AI-literate translators fluent in Spanish and English to join its growing team of linguists and be a key player in ensuring accuracy while constantly monitoring the quality of our autotranslation model.

The successful candidate will assess and improve the autotranslation from English to Spanish of Dow Jones Newswires financial, business, and economic news.

    • Interacting with different stakeholders (Product, Editorial, customers, and partners)
