job.description:
About Gray Media:

Gray Media, or Gray, is a multimedia company headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia. The company is the nation's largest owner of top-rated local television stations and digital assets serving 113 television markets that collectively reach approximately 36 percent of US television households. The portfolio includes 77 markets with the top-rated television station and 100 markets with the first and/or second-highest-rated television station, as well as the largest Telemundo Affiliate group with 45 markets totaling nearly 1.5 million Hispanic TV Households. The company also owns Gray Digital Media, a full-service digital agency offering national and local clients digital marketing strategies with the most advanced digital products and services. Gray's additional media properties include video production companies Raycom Sports, Tupelo Media Group, and PowerNation Studios, and studio production facilities Assembly Atlanta and Third Rail Studios.

About WKTB (Telemundo Atlanta):

Telemundo Atlanta is a premier Spanish-language television station providing award-winning local news and programming. Telemundo Atlanta is available to the Atlanta DMA on a million-watt full-power over-the-air signal on channel 47.1. Telemundo Atlanta has received 61 Emmy® Awards since 2012, including the top honor of Station Excellence in 2013, 2014, 2016, and 2017, and News Excellence in 2017, 2018, and 2019. Telemundo Atlanta was nominated for Best Newscast and News Excellence in 2020. Telemundo Atlanta is the first Spanish-language television station to receive the coveted Overall Station Excellence recognition in Georgia. Telemundo Atlanta produces essential daily local news, which can also be accessed over our website www.telemundoatlanta.com and mobile application.

Job Summary/Description:

Telemundo Atlanta is seeking a dynamic, bilingual, news-driven journalist who is passionate about informing our local community and thrives in a fast-paced, digital-first newsroom. As our Digital Host / Producer, you’ll lead the production of original Spanish-language content for our digital platforms, engage viewers through live streams, and create standout segments that bring audiences coming back. You’ll solo-anchor from our OTT/TV studio and produce digital segments from start to finish, while contributing to daily newsroom operations and helping shape our multiplatform content strategy. If you’re ready to innovate, inform, and make an impact across screens, we want to hear from you.

Duties/Responsibilities include, but are not limited to: 

  • Produce and anchor multiple daily digital segments or shows for OTT/TV and social platforms in native Spanish.
    • Collaborate with show producers and anchors, assisting with repurposing news content.
    • Post and update local stories and content on web and social platforms.
    • Manage livestream scheduling across digital platforms.
  • Implement livestream best practices to grow and engage the audience.
  • Engage viewers on social media, including maintaining a consistent presence on Facebook Live and Instagram.
    • Build a broad working knowledge of the viewing area, including key people, places, events, and local personalities.
    • Research, gather, shoot, write, and edit stories for broadcast and online publication.
    • Participate in daily editorial meetings and fill in on other newscasts as needed.
    • Report live during breaking news and develop reliable sources of information.
    • Pitch and produce enterprise, hard-news, and research-driven stories under tight deadlines.
    • Apply strong news judgment to story selection and presentation; write clearly and conversationally in native Spanish.
    • Conduct interviews and deliver stories with confidence on camera.
    • Maintain professional and ethical conduct, contribute to a collaborative newsroom, and stay current on local and national news.

Qualifications/Requirements:

• High proficiency in spoken and written Spanish and English.
• At least one year experience of producing digital content.
• Experience with ENPS, Edius, Canva and Adobe preferred.
• BS/BA in journalism or communications preferred.
• Ability to shoot, write, and edit original stories for digital platforms.
• Familiarity with OTT procedures and operations, including platforms like FB and YouTube.
• Strong news judgment, interviewing skills, and on-camera presence.
• Able to work under pressure, meet daily deadlines, and adapt in a high-energy newsroom.
• Positive attitude and team player.
• Valid driver's license.

job.description:

We are the nation's largest owner of top-rated local television stations and digital assets serving 117 full-power television markets that collectively reach approximately 37% of US television households. Our additional media properties include video production companies Raycom Sports, Tupelo Media Group, and PowerNation Studios, and studio production facilities Assembly Atlanta and Third Rail Studios.

About WSAW:

WSAW is Wausau's first TV station, debuting 71 years ago in 1954. Together, WSAW/WZAW produce more than 30 hours of news each week. We work hard and celebrate our wins. In 2026, the news team was recognized as the Wisconsin Broadcasters Association "News Operation of the Year" and also the small-market "Station of the Year" (for coverage airing in 2025). Also in 2026, WSAW's podcast "Wisconsin Cold Cases: Who Killed Gerald Mork?" was honored with a Regional Edward R. Murrow Award. These are just a few examples of the honors WSAW has received in recent years.

North Central Wisconsin is also known as "Wisconsin's Basecamp." In Wausau, you will live and work where thousands of people come to vacation each year. Whether you're skiing down the slopes of Granite Peak, boating on Lake Du Bay, or enjoying Concerts on the Square or a show at The Grand Theater in downtown Wausau, there's something for everyone, and you will enjoy the community we serve. Wausau is also located within 3 hours or less of Minneapolis, Milwaukee, and Green Bay; and is just a two-hour drive from Madison, the state's capital city.

WSAW's viewing area covers 11 counties, including the cities of Stevens Point, Wisconsin Rapids, Marshfield, Rhinelander, and the summer retreat hotspot of Minocqua. WSAW is dedicated to serving the community and does so through several weeks-long campaigns such as Share Your Holidays and the annual Diaper Drive.

Job Summary/Description:

Have you ever wondered what it's like to be at the heart of a newsroom where digital isn't just an afterthought - it's the priority? WSAW is looking for a Digital Content Creator who can own the story from the first alert to the last update, ensuring our audience stays connected on every screen.

Duties/Responsibilities include, but are not limited to: 

- Own breaking news: Move with lightning speed to send push notifications and update web stories as news unfolds.
- Craft compelling narratives: Write and produce dynamic digital news content that stops the scroll and keeps our audience informed.
- Drive social engagement: Manage our social media presence by posting timely updates and creating content specifically for our digital communities.
- Manage the hub: Split your time between the assignment desk and content creation, helping decide what we cover and how we share it.
- Create multimedia assets: Produce video, photo galleries, and live streams that add depth and visual punch to our local reporting.
- Collaborate for impact: Work closely with crews and producers to ensure our digital voice is consistent, professional, and approachable.
- Lead the charge on digital-only newscast: WSAW produces 715 Live, the only current digital-only newscast in the market. The chosen applicant will produce and anchor the p.m. version of this show.

Qualifications/Requirements:

- College degree in Marketing, Journalism, Communications, or a related field.
- Previous experience in a professional newsroom environment is preferred, but we are willing to train the right candidate.
- Availability for weekend hours; willingness to work flexible shifts for breaking news, specialized coverage, or covering a colleague's PTO.
- A genuine desire to win, the ability to reflect on your work, and a willingness to apply feedback.
- Strong verbal and written communication skills with solid knowledge of AP Style *and writing conversationally for Broadcast.
- Ability to edit video in digital formats.
- Proficiency with Photoshop, Canva, or comparable software to create and edit graphics.
- Ability to work well under pressure and collaborate effectively with a diverse team.
- Strong understanding of journalistic principles and ethics.
- Ability to balance long- and short-term projects while consistently meeting daily deadlines.

job.description:

Working across these teams, the role will develop proactive strategies that strengthen key business relationships, advance league priorities, and engage consumer, business, and trade audiences. job.title: Sales and Marketing Specialist
job.description:
This Job Description May Cause Extreme Excitement and Career Growth 

At AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions, we believe a great workplace isn't just something we say — it's something you can feel when you join the team. Here, it's all about great collabs, ambition, and results but most importantly, we grow here, and we enjoy here.  We're searching for that special someone — a driven, talented individual to join our innovative media sales team. In this role, you'll engage with new and existing clients and show them how our innovative media solutions can amplify their brands and deliver measurable success. If you're energized by building relationships, closing deals, and making an impact, we'd love to hear from you. 


Sound like the right fit? Check out the checklist below and if it sounds like you, hit "Apply Now" and let's chat. 


Your Day-to-Day (aka the Playbook) 

Help Brands Thrive: 

Join our media sales team and play a pivotal role in helping brands and companies grow. By identifying new opportunities, building strong client relationships, and delivering impactful solutions, you'll showcase how our multi-media content platforms and digital assets can drive meaningful results for our partners. 


Your focus will be on helping clients achieve their goals, ensuring that every campaign is a success. When our clients win, we win—and we believe in celebrating those victories together! 

  

Make Connections: Embrace your powers of persuasion and make every handshake and meeting count! Every interaction is a chance to build a genuine connection and show clients how we can help them succeed. You're not just selling; you're building partnerships. You're helping businesses find the right audience in the right place at the right time. When we say One Partner, Endless Possibilities, we mean it! 

 

Be A Trusted Guide: In this role, you'll connect with clients on a human level, understand their unique needs, and craft tailored sales and marketing solutions that deliver results. As their trusted advisor, you'll help them navigate the ever-evolving marketing landscape, ensuring every step of the journey is planned with care and precision.  

 

Shake Things Up: Bring your creativity and fresh ideas to the table! We're looking for someone who challenges the status quo, embraces innovation, and finds new ways to connect with our audience. Your contributions will help elevate our brand and drive meaningful results for your clients.  

 

Join us and Conquer the Media Landscape: You'll be part of a dedicated team of A1 media sales professionals, committed to achieving market leadership. Together, we amplify our impact, deliver exceptional outcomes, and help our clients succeed in ways that truly matter. 

 

Identify Emerging Opportunities: It's about being able to see what others can't, anticipating market shifts, analyzing data and predicting the next big thing. Your insights will position our clients and AMP for long-term success.  

  

What We're Looking For 

Proven Sales Ability (or an Unstoppable Desire to Learn) 

Whether you're a seasoned sales professional or just getting started, we value your drive, energy, and passion for achieving results. 

 

Strong Communication Skills: You're a natural at building relationships and communicating effectively. Proficiency with digital tools and applications is a must. 

 

A Passion for helping Others: You're committed to understanding clients' needs, providing top-notch customer service and making a difference. You're not just selling a product; you're providing a solution.  


A Competitive Spirit: Do you get a little boost when you achieve a goal (especially if it was a tough one)? We love that for you (and us)!  We want someone who's driven to excel but also knows how to celebrate the victories (big and small) with their team. That drive makes you a valuable part of our organization.  


A Willingness to Grow: Do you thrive in environments where you're always learning something new? Excellent, you'll fit right in! The media world is constantly evolving, and the ability to learn, adapt, and embrace challenges in a fast-paced, digital-first environment is key.  

 

The Practical Stuff 

A valid driver's license, up-to-date insurance, and reliable transportation are necessary for connecting with clients in your community. 

 

Why Join AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions? / The Reasons You Should Hit "Apply Now" 

 

Serious Work, Seriously Cool People: Be part of a dynamic team that values creativity, collaboration, and fun! We are all for work that is rewarding.  

 

The Compensation Package: We offer a base salary, commission structure, and benefits package designed to support your success and well-being. Happy employees don't stage rebellions! ;) 

 

We Make a Real Difference (Not Just Talk About It): At AMP, we help local businesses thrive through advertising strategies that create tangible impacts. Our media sales specialist isn't just selling ads; they're the boots on the ground, making a real difference where it counts. (And yes, it feels pretty good.) 

 

Top-Notch Training and Support: We're not the kind of company that hires you and then disappears into the corporate abyss. We carefully select candidates for a cohort-based training program, where you'll join a group of sales professionals from all over the country. From onboarding to ongoing mentorship, we invest in your success with training programs that set you up for long-term growth. 

 

Career Growth Opportunities: We believe in investing in you. That's why you'll have access to training, mentorship, and career advancement opportunities to help you thrive. We are a leader in our industry, flexing our local charm and national muscle, providing you with options to amplify your career in your local market or join one of our AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions teams in another city.  

 

Comprehensive Media Education (We Are Your Power Source!): New to the industry? We've got you covered with training programs that turn curiosity into expertise.   

 

AMP is us. It's you. It isn't just a name; it's a mission. A promise to amplify our reach, amplify our innovation, and most importantly, amplify you. If you're ready to grow your career and help businesses achieve their goals, we'd love to hear from you.

job.description:

LEAD SOFTWARE ENGINEER — ROKU

 

Location: On-Site - New York / Los Angeles / San Francisco / Ft. Lauderdale


ABOUT THE ROLE

You'll own the technical direction of the Paramount+ Roku application — the platform, the patterns, the architecture. This is a hands-on leadership role where you write and review code and set the standard for a team of engineers shipping features to millions of viewers.

Roku's constraints — tight memory budgets, a single-threaded render loop, hardware spanning five years of device generations — are the environment you thrive in, not just tolerate. You know these constraints well enough to teach them, and you'll lead a team through them.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Set technical direction for the Paramount+ Roku application — choose the patterns, own the architecture, defend the decisions
• Build and maintain core framework components and features — this is a hands-on role where you ship code
• Lead a team of Roku engineers through code reviews, pair programming, and feedback that helps people grow
• Architect around Roku's constraints: memory limits, render-thread/task-thread boundaries, device performance tiers, and certification requirements
• Ship real-time personalization features — personalized recommendations, dynamic artwork, and ad engagement experiences — within Roku's memory and threading constraints
• Drive adoption of RSG 1.3 data transfer APIs, BrightScript Memory Monitor, and Perfetto tracing across the team
• Scope projects, identify risks before they become blockers, and keep the team shipping
• Coordinate with Product, Design, Backend Engineering, and DevOps/SRE to translate requirements into plans your team can execute
• Write architecture docs, RFCs, and component guides so decisions are visible and durable
• Maintain and improve CI/CD pipelines, testing infrastructure, and build tooling
• Design and run A/B tests, then act on the results
• Use AI development tools to move faster, and help the team adopt them


WHAT GOOD LOOKS LIKE

• Your team ships on time because you scoped the work correctly — not because anyone worked weekends
• Engineers on your team grow quarter over quarter. They take on harder problems this quarter than last. You can name what changed
• You open a 200-file BrightScript repo you've never seen and start making changes the same day — and you've given your team the docs and context to do the same
• You notice a memory spike on a Roku Express before QA files a ticket. You fix it, write up what happened, and turn it into a pattern the team follows
• You write architecture decisions down. Six months later, a new engineer reads one and understands why you chose what you chose
• You push back when a plan has gaps and suggest a better one — without making people feel small
• You treat the build pipeline, test coverage, and error monitoring like product features
• You make the people around you better at their jobs. They'd say so if asked


REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• 8+ years writing software
• 4+ years building Roku applications
• 2+ years leading a team or serving as a technical lead
• BS in Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent work experience
• Strong foundation in OOP, data structures, and algorithms — able to design systems and evaluate others' designs
• BrightScript and SceneGraph SDK, including RSG 1.3 — you can explain the tradeoffs between MoveIntoField, PostMessage, and CopyMessage without looking them up
• Deep command of the Roku threading model and where performance falls apart on low-end devices
• Roku frameworks and services: RAF, RMF, RokuPay
• Unit and integration testing on Roku — you've built test infrastructure, not just written tests
• RESTful API design, HTTP caching behavior, and CDN interaction
• Git and GitHub
• Strong technical writing — architecture docs and plans that people actually read and act on
• Active use of AI development tools (Copilot, Claude, Cursor, or similar) with concrete examples of how they've changed how you work


DESIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• BrighterScript and Roku community tooling (ropm, bslint, roku-debug)
• Other OTT platforms: Fire TV, Android TV, Apple TV, Samsung TV, LG webOS
• Observability tools: Conviva, New Relic, Datadog, Sentry
• Microservices and backend-for-frontend patterns
• Experience integrating personalization or recommendation systems into connected-device applications
• Experience with real-time or event-driven architectures on client platforms
• E2E testing for connected-device applications
• Docker and CI/CD tooling (Jenkins or similar)
• GraphQL
• Track record of introducing AI tools to a team — actual adoption, not just a demo
• You care about UX enough to push back on Product and Design when something isn't right
• You've worked across time zones without waiting for meetings to unblock yourself

job.description:

LEAD SOFTWARE ENGINEER — ROKU

 

Location: On-Site - New York / Los Angeles / San Francisco / Ft. Lauderdale


ABOUT THE ROLE

You'll own the technical direction of the Paramount+ Roku application — the platform, the patterns, the architecture. This is a hands-on leadership role where you write and review code and set the standard for a team of engineers shipping features to millions of viewers.

Roku's constraints — tight memory budgets, a single-threaded render loop, hardware spanning five years of device generations — are the environment you thrive in, not just tolerate. You know these constraints well enough to teach them, and you'll lead a team through them.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Set technical direction for the Paramount+ Roku application — choose the patterns, own the architecture, defend the decisions
• Build and maintain core framework components and features — this is a hands-on role where you ship code
• Lead a team of Roku engineers through code reviews, pair programming, and feedback that helps people grow• Architect around Roku's constraints: memory limits, render-thread/task-thread boundaries, device performance tiers, and certification requirements
• Ship real-time personalization features — personalized recommendations, dynamic artwork, and ad engagement experiences — within Roku's memory and threading constraints
• Drive adoption of RSG 1.3 data transfer APIs, BrightScript Memory Monitor, and Perfetto tracing across the team
• Scope projects, identify risks before they become blockers, and keep the team shipping
• Coordinate with Product, Design, Backend Engineering, and DevOps/SRE to translate requirements into plans your team can execute
• Write architecture docs, RFCs, and component guides so decisions are visible and durable
• Maintain and improve CI/CD pipelines, testing infrastructure, and build tooling
• Design and run A/B tests, then act on the results
• Use AI development tools to move faster, and help the team adopt them


WHAT GOOD LOOKS LIKE

• Your team ships on time because you scoped the work correctly — not because anyone worked weekends
• Engineers on your team grow quarter over quarter. They take on harder problems this quarter than last. You can name what changed
• You open a 200-file BrightScript repo you've never seen and start making changes the same day — and you've given your team the docs and context to do the same• You notice a memory spike on a Roku Express before QA files a ticket. You fix it, write up what happened, and turn it into a pattern the team follows
• You write architecture decisions down. Six months later, a new engineer reads one and understands why you chose what you chose
• You push back when a plan has gaps and suggest a better one — without making people feel small
• You treat the build pipeline, test coverage, and error monitoring like product features
• You make the people around you better at their jobs. They'd say so if asked


REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• 8+ years writing software
• 4+ years building Roku applications
• 2+ years leading a team or serving as a technical lead• BS in Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent work experience
• Strong foundation in OOP, data structures, and algorithms — able to design systems and evaluate others' designs
• BrightScript and SceneGraph SDK, including RSG 1.3 — you can explain the tradeoffs between MoveIntoField, PostMessage, and CopyMessage without looking them up
• Deep command of the Roku threading model and where performance falls apart on low-end devices
• Roku frameworks and services: RAF, RMF, RokuPay
• Unit and integration testing on Roku — you've built test infrastructure, not just written tests
• RESTful API design, HTTP caching behavior, and CDN interaction
• Git and GitHub
• Strong technical writing — architecture docs and plans that people actually read and act on
• Active use of AI development tools (Copilot, Claude, Cursor, or similar) with concrete examples of how they've changed how you work


DESIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• BrighterScript and Roku community tooling (ropm, bslint, roku-debug)
• Other OTT platforms: Fire TV, Android TV, Apple TV, Samsung TV, LG webOS
• Observability tools: Conviva, New Relic, Datadog, Sentry• Microservices and backend-for-frontend patterns
• Experience integrating personalization or recommendation systems into connected-device applications
• Experience with real-time or event-driven architectures on client platforms
• E2E testing for connected-device applications
• Docker and CI/CD tooling (Jenkins or similar)
• GraphQL
• Track record of introducing AI tools to a team — actual adoption, not just a demo
• You care about UX enough to push back on Product and Design when something isn't right
• You've worked across time zones without waiting for meetings to unblock yourself

job.description:
#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?
We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, we’ve got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is… YOU! Becoming a part of Paramount means joining a team of passionate people who not only recognize the power of content but also enjoy a touch of fun and uniqueness. Together, we co-create moments that matter – both for our audiences and our employees – and aim to leave a positive mark on culture.

 

 

CBS Sports Digital is looking for a Product Growth Manager to own growth on the CBS Sports app. You'll sit on the app product team and carry your own roadmap alongside feature work. The job is to make sure what we build gets found, adopted, and kept.
That means owning the parts of the product where growth actually happens: onboarding, activation, how users discover new features, and the store listing as a conversion surface. It also means owning the acquisition spend pointed at the app and the instrumentation that tells us whether any of it worked. You'll be measured on install volume, install quality, feature adoption, and retention.
You should be comfortable in a standup and comfortable in a spreadsheet. You think in funnels, you ship experiments, and you can tell the difference between a number that moved and a number that matters.


Responsibilities:
●    Own a growth roadmap for the CBS Sports app, scoped and prioritized alongside feature work.
●    Own onboarding, activation, and in-product feature discovery, from problem definition through shipped changes.

●    Own paid acquisition for the app, optimizing toward high-LTV users and aligning spend to the roadmap and the sports calendar.
●    Define the growth instrumentation and reporting the product team runs on. Monitor installs, adoption, engagement, retention, and funnel performance, and act on what you see.
●    Run experiments with clear hypotheses and readable results. Kill what doesn't work.
●    Sequence releases against tentpole windows so launches land when fan demand is highest.
●    Test new acquisition channels and fold the ones that work into a single growth approach.
●    Work with brand, creative, and lifecycle teams so what ships in-product and what runs outside it say the same thing.

●    5+ years in growth product management, product growth, or mobile growth.

●    Experience running A/B tests and making calls off the results.

KSDK-TV Saint Louis, the TEGNA-owned NBC affiliate in Saint Louis, is seeking a proven, results-driven Account Executive to grow new business and manage a book of advertising clients across one of the strongest cross-screen portfolios in the market. This is a seat for a closer who can walk into a business owner's office or an agency pitch, uncover what's really driving their marketing decisions, and build the multi-platform solution that wins the budget. 

You'll sell the full weight of TEGNA: the mass reach and trust of NBC broadcast television paired with the targeting and growth of streaming. On the linear side, you'll connect advertisers to the large, engaged local audiences that tune in to Saint Louis's trusted news and programming. On the streaming side, you’ll leverage Premion, TEGNA’s streaming and CTV advertising business, to deliver premium, brand-safe connected-TV inventory. Premion’s curated marketplace includes 125+ OTT and CTV publishers, offering the same premium environments national buyers demand. Layered with digital video, display, and content solutions, it's a cross-screen story few competitors can match and in your hands, a clear advantage in every pitch. 

We give experienced sellers the portfolio, the autonomy, and the support to build something significant. Top performers grow their books, their earnings, and their careers. 

Responsibilities: 

  • Drive new business. Build and maintain a strong pipeline of local and regional advertisers, connect with key decision-makers and create opportunities across broadcast TV, Premion streaming/CTV and digital.

  • Pitch with data. Build compelling, insight-driven proposals that show advertisers exactly how broadcast reach and connected-TV targeting combine to deliver ROI. 
  • Run your business. Manage pipeline, forecast accurately, and keep deals moving in CRM and partner with account, creative, and product teams to deliver campaigns that perform and retain.

job.title: Lead Data Scientist, Newsroom Analytics
job.description:
Job Description:


The Wall Street Journal is seeking a Lead Data Scientist, Newsroom Analytics to drive our newsroom's audience-data strategy. Reporting to the Senior Manager, Newsroom Data, you will be embedded in one of the world's most influential newsrooms, working directly with newsroom coverage, audience, and product strategy teams on the decisions that shape how news is reported, prioritized, and delivered to millions of readers. 


This is a highly autonomous and strategic role that demands both rigorous data science and sharp analytical instincts in equal measure. Working closely with editorial and audience leaders, you'll surface the right problems and own the full arc from solution design to adoption, building the metrics, models, and forecasts that teams rely on. This includes developing tools teams actually use, translating complex methodologies into clear recommendations, and consistently connecting your work to outcomes that matter: how readers discover, engage with, and return to WSJ journalism. Beyond your own output, you will serve as a technical anchor for the team, mentoring colleagues, establishing shared standards for analytical rigor, and proactively driving continuous improvements across our workflows. The ideal candidate seamlessly balances statistical rigor, strategic newsroom thinking, and a genuine investment in the people and practices around them.


This position will be based in our New York office.

You will:


  • Partner with our digital strategy, coverage and product teams to identify the highest-impact analytical opportunities, define the right questions, and shape the data science roadmap around problems that drive real newsroom outcomes.
  • Design and build predictive and explanatory models end-to-end, from feature engineering and validation through production, making principled tradeoffs between complexity and interpretability along the way.
  • Translate quantitative findings into clear, actionable recommendations for senior newsroom and business stakeholders, and partner with cross-functional teams to see those recommendations through to adoption.
  • Own the core metrics and measurement systems that newsroom teams rely on to evaluate performance and make editorial decisions,  ensuring they are accurate, well-documented, and trusted.
  • Apply rigorous statistical thinking to measure real-world editorial and audience impact, drawing on causal inference and observational methods alongside controlled experimentation to isolate what's actually driving outcomes. 
  • Mentor and develop junior data team members, establishing shared standards for rigorous, production-ready analysis and building the team's collective technical capability over time.


 

You have:

  • 5+ years of experience in data science, analytics, or applied machine learning, preferably in a media, publishing, or subscription-based environment.
  • Proven ability to own models end-to-end in a lean team setting, including scheduling, maintaining, and iterating on outputs using orchestration tools such as Airflow.
  • Strong proficiency in Python including feature engineering, model training, validation, and interpretation, with experience maintaining production-quality, reproducible code in Git.
  • Advanced SQL and hands-on experience with large-scale data warehouses (Snowflake/BigQuery) as well as ETL workflows/analytics engineering frameworks (dbt).
  • Experience applying causal inference and statistical methods to measure real-world outcomes from observational data.
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to frame quantitative findings as clear business or editorial recommendations for senior non-technical stakeholders, and a demonstrated ability to influence decisions without direct authority.
  • Experience building models that influence content strategy, audience development, or consumer retention.

Standout candidates will have strengths in one or more areas of the following:

  • Experience with NLP or text analysis methods, including topic modeling, classification, or entity extraction applied to content data.
  • Familiarity with off-platform attribution and audience measurement, specifically modeling the relationship between distributed content, platform referrals, and downstream subscription or engagement outcomes.
  • Experience leveraging AI to democratize data and enable faster time-to-insight.

To apply, please submit a resume and a cover letter explaining how your skills, experience and interests align with the expectations of the role by July 28th. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis, and we encourage early submission as the position may be filled before the deadline.


The Journal’s reporters, editors, developers, and audio and visual journalists create important and impactful stories, firmly rooted in fact and adhering to the highest ethical standards. We report without fear or bias, and we maintain a proper sense of perspective, detachment and objectivity in our reporting.

job.title: Social Video Editor
job.description:
Application Instructions

Please list all professional experience and explain any gaps in employment history. All of your application materials, which may include PDF files of work samples and/or links to audio, video, photography or graphics, must be uploaded to the field labeled Resume/Cover Letter/Work Samples to be considered for the position.


Join the future of news

We’re on a mission to deliver riveting storytelling for all of America. At The Washington Post, you’ll help reinvent news. Our work is driven by a deep investigative spirit and enhanced by innovation to bring audiences closer to the stories that matter most.


About Our Team


The Washington Post is powered by the passion and talent of our people. It takes all of us to reinvent news. Beyond our award-winning News and Opinions teams, we work across many departments, including Brand & Events, Communications, Customer Care, Engineering & Product, Finance, Human Resources, Legal, Marketing & Advertising, Print Operations, and Sales.


Why This Role Matters

 

The Washington Post is seeking a creative and versatile social video editor to help drive visual storytelling across our social platforms.


We’re looking for an editor who understands how journalism travels on social media — and how to shape it for audiences who expect immediacy, personality and clarity. This role will identify and create high-impact news video as well as work with Post journalists to create social-first video that resonates across Instagram, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, Snapchat, X and emerging platforms.


The ideal candidate is fluent in shooting and editing vertical video, deeply familiar with platform best practices and energized by the challenge of translating rigorous reporting into compelling short-form storytelling. This editor will be part of a team focused on producing high-impact video for both The Post’s owned-and-operated platforms and social ecosystems, helping grow reach, engagement and brand loyalty.


This position is based in our Washington, D.C., newsroom.


What Motivates You:

  • You are excited about meeting audiences where they are and experimenting with new storytelling formats.
  • You enjoy collaborating with reporters and helping them sharpen their on-camera voice.
  • You thrive in a fast-paced environment where speed and accuracy both matter.
  • You are energized by tracking performance and iterating to improve results.
  • You care deeply about journalistic standards, even in short-form and highly visual formats.

How You’ll Support the Mission:

  • Shoot and edit vertical video optimized for social viewing, ensuring strong hooks, pacing and clarity.
  • Partner with Post journalists to create personality-driven, social-first videos tailored for Instagram Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, Snapchat and other platforms, grounded in Post standards and social media policies.
  • Collaborate with editors, producers and designers across the newsroom to refine the look, voice and tone of social video.
  • Evaluate engagement metrics regularly, track performance and adapt production strategies to maximize audience growth and interaction.
  • Coach journalists on best practices for creating effective social-first video, including scripting, framing and delivery.
  • Write accurate scripts, headlines, captions and metadata that enhance discoverability and engagement.

The Skills and Experiences You Bring:

  • At least two years of experience in a professional newsroom.
  • At least three years of video editing experience.
  • Strong proficiency in Adobe Premiere and comfort managing the full social publishing pipeline.
  • Demonstrated speed and precision in video editing for deadline-driven environments.
  • Experience publishing to major social platforms and a deep understanding of vertical video best practices.
  • Strong news judgment, attention to detail and commitment to fact-checking and accuracy.
  • Ability to write clear, compelling scripts and social copy quickly.
  • Experience in audience engagement and working across multiple social platforms.
  • A demonstrated ability to use analytics to inform editorial and production decisions.
  • Experience producing video in the field, including operating camera equipment, lighting and audio setups.
  • A track record of creative and distinctive work on social media platforms.

Interested candidates should upload a résumé and a cover letter to our jobs portal. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis until the position is filled, but those received by Oct. 27 will be prioritized. The cover letter should be addressed to Managing Editor for Content Strategy Bryan Flaherty and Head of Off-Platform Strategy Keely Diven.

The salary range for this position is $82,600 - $123,800. The actual starting salary within this range will depend on individual skills, experience and qualifications as they relate to specific job requirements.

job.title: Manager, FP&A - Revenue & Growth
job.description:
Join the future of news

We’re on a mission to deliver riveting storytelling for all of America. At The Washington Post, you’ll help reinvent news. Our work is driven by a deep investigative spirit and enhanced by innovation to bring audiences closer to the stories that matter most.


About Our Team


The Washington Post is powered by the passion and talent of our people. It takes all of us to reinvent news. Beyond our award-winning News and Opinions teams, we work across many departments, including Brand & Events, Communications, Customer Care, Engineering & Product, Finance, Human Resources, Legal, Marketing & Advertising, Print Operations, and Sales.


Why This Role Matters

 

The Manager, FP&A – Revenue & Growth is a key finance business partner supporting The Washington Post’s B2C digital subscription, B2B revenue, and emerging growth initiatives. This role translates business performance, market dynamics, and operating decisions into clear financial insight that helps leaders invest wisely, manage risk, and build sustainable revenue.

Reporting within the FP&A organization, the Manager leads planning, forecasting, and performance analysis for assigned revenue businesses while developing financial talent and strengthening the tools, processes, and partnerships that support informed decision-making across the company.

 

What Motivates You

  • You are energized by helping mission-driven media organizations build durable, diversified revenue models.
  • You enjoy translating complex financial and operating data into clear insights that guide decisions.
  • You value collaborative partnership with leaders across Product, Marketing, Sales, Newsroom, Data Analytics & Insights, and Finance.
  • You are motivated by improving planning processes, models, and reporting so teams can act with greater clarity and confidence.
  • You take pride in developing financial talent and creating an inclusive, accountable team environment.

 

How You’ll Support the Mission

  • Lead annual budgets, quarterly forecasts, and long-range plans for assigned revenue streams, producing aligned financial plans that support enterprise priorities and growth goals.
  • Develop driver-based revenue models that connect pricing, volume, pipeline, customer behavior, and other operating metrics to reliable financial outcomes.
  • Analyze actual revenue performance against budget and forecast, identifying variance drivers, risks, opportunities, and outlook changes that enable timely leadership action.
  • Advise business leaders on operating performance, investment choices, and resource-allocation decisions, resulting in actionable recommendations grounded in financial and strategic analysis.
  • Evaluate new products, partnerships, pricing strategies, and growth initiatives through business cases, scenario analyses, and financial models, enabling informed decisions on investments and tradeoffs.
  • Partner with Marketing, Sales, Product, Newsroom, Data Analytics & Insights, and other teams to improve revenue performance and align business plans with financial objectives.
  • Incorporate relevant market, competitive, and industry trends into forecasts and planning, strengthening the organization’s ability to anticipate changes in the revenue environment.
  • Strengthen revenue reporting, forecasting, and planning processes through improved data quality, automation, and planning tools, increasing consistency, efficiency, and confidence in financial information.
  • Integrate monthly close results and performance-review insights into forecasts, ensuring leaders understand results and their implications for the forward outlook.
  • Manage and develop financial analyst(s) through clear priorities, coaching, and quality review, building stronger financial modeling, business acumen, and partnership capabilities.
  • Lead strategic analyses and ambiguous growth-related projects, structuring complex questions and communicating conclusions that advance executive decision-making.

 

The Skills and Experience You Bring

  • Six or more years of progressively responsible experience in financial planning and analysis, strategic finance, corporate finance, or a related discipline.
  • Experience supporting revenue-oriented, subscription, digital, consumer, B2B, or growth businesses; media-industry experience is valuable but not required.
  • Experience managing, coaching, or formally leading financial analysts and reviewing complex analytical work.
  • Strong financial modeling, forecasting, budgeting, and scenario-analysis skills, including the ability to connect operating drivers to financial results.
  • Ability to synthesize complex financial and business information into concise, practical recommendations for senior leaders.
  • Strong communication and relationship-building skills, with demonstrated success partnering across functions and levels of an organization.
  • Sound judgment, intellectual curiosity, and comfort navigating evolving priorities and incomplete information.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

 

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with financial planning and analysis platforms, such as Oracle, SAP, Planful, Adaptive Insights, or Anaplan.
  • Experience with data analytics and visualization tools, such as Tableau or Power BI.
  • Knowledge of digital media, consumer subscription, advertising, SaaS, or other recurring-revenue business models.
  • Familiarity with investment analysis, corporate development, partnerships, or mergers and acquisitions.
  • MBA, CFA, CPA, or comparable advanced finance credential.

job.title: Licensing Associate
job.description:
About ASCAP

The American Society of Composers, Authors and Publishers (ASCAP) is a membership association of more than one million songwriters, composers and music publishers, and represents some of the world’s most talented music creators. Founded and governed by songwriters, composers and publishers, it is the only performing rights organization in the U.S. that operates on a not-for-profit basis. ASCAP licenses a repertory of over 20 million musical works to hundreds of thousands of businesses that use music, including streaming services, cable television, radio and satellite radio and brick and mortar businesses such as retail stores, hotels, clubs, restaurants and bars. ASCAP collects the licensing fees; identifies, matches and processes trillions of performances every year; and returns nearly 90 cents of every dollar back to its members as royalties. The ASCAP blanket license offers an efficient solution for businesses to legally perform ASCAP music while respecting the right of songwriters and composers to be paid fairly. ASCAP puts music creators first, advocating for their rights and the value of music on Capitol Hill, driving innovation that moves the industry forward, building community and providing the resources and support that creators need to succeed in their careers. Learn more and stay in touch at www.ascap.com, on X and Instagram @ASCAP and on Facebook.

# # #

Job Overview:

The Licensing Associate is a sales professional who can effectively communicate the benefits of the ASCAP license, which allows music users to perform music legally under the requirements of the US Copyright Law. The Licensing Associate will identify and enter new prospective customers into the CRM database for follow-up, and contact prospective customers who operate restaurants, nightclubs, hotels, retail establishments, fitness facilities, and many other types of businesses. This position within the General Licensing department is a remote based position who will report to the Director, Regional Licensing.

Areas of Responsibility & Accountability:

  • Identify prospective new businesses, obtain information to assess a license according to their music factors, and business ownership, and input into the CRM database.
  • Call on prospective customers while adhering to the prescribed workflow as directed by the Regional Director and internal process.
  • Complete activity reports in Salesforce.com and attend training classes and all scheduled meetings.
  • Meet monthly revenue goals and productivity standards set forth by the General Licensing department, specific to the Licensing Associate, including but not limited to minimum prospecting calls and revenue generation.
  • Generate new business by selling performing rights licenses to music users.
  • Research and pursue new business prospects.

Qualifications & Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent preferred.
  • Inside sales with cold calling and lead generation experience preferred.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Excellent selling and negotiation skills.
  • Highly motivated and target driven.
  • Ability to work well with others in a collaborative, team environment.
  • Ability to work independently and proactively.
  • Ability to think analytically and take initiative.
  • Open to feedback and direction.
  • Time management and organizational skills with the ability to prioritize tasks within a high-volume workload.
  • MS Office and CRM proficiency.
  • Remote work experience preferred.

Compensation/Benefits:

Besides providing a unique and dynamic work environment, there are a few other reasons you should consider ASCAP in your career planning. We also offer generous benefit options that are comprehensive and provide the flexibility that most employees want and need. These health care and financial plan options include the following:

  • A choice of either network-only provider medical and dental plans or more flexible medical and dental plans where you can see providers in or out-of-network
  • Vision plan that offers both in and out-of-network provider options
  • 401(k) Plan that offers pre-tax, Roth, and an after-tax employee contribution option which includes a company match
  • An additional employer paid discretionary profit share contribution, regardless of your participation in the 401(k) Plan
  • Generous time-off policy
  • Health care and dependent care flexible spending accounts
  • Short-term disability insurance/salary continuation and long-term disability insurance
  • Company provided basic life and accidental death and dismemberment insurance
  • Employee gym discounts at select gyms
  • Commuter benefits
  • Voluntary pet health insurance
  • Voluntary auto and homeowner’s insurance
  • Voluntary employee, spouse, and dependent life insurance options
  • Voluntary ID protection Coverage

This summary is not complete and is subject to the terms of the underlying plan documents. job.title: IT Manager
job.description:
Sony Music Entertainment är ett av världens ledande musikbolag med drygt 5 000 medarbetare globalt. På Sony Music Sverige arbetar ca 80 medarbetare med att dagligen skapa, utveckla, marknadsföra och distribuera våra artisters musik ur vårt breda urval av svensk och internationell repertoar. Vår vision är att vara Sveriges bästa musikbolag och arbetsplats inom branschen, kända för vår innovation, kreativitet och framgång, präglat av mångfald och passion för musik.

Sammanfattning av rollen
Just nu söker vi en IT Manager till Sony Music Sverige. I rollen som IT Manager ansvarar du för att våra medarbetare har en stabil, säker och välfungerande digital arbetsmiljö. Rollen kombinerar verksamhetsnära och praktiskt IT-arbete med samordning av support, Microsoft 365, lokala system, externa leverantörer och vår globala IT-organisation. Du driver även förbättringar, dokumentation och uppföljning av IT- och säkerhetskrav. Rollen är baserad i Stockholm och innebär arbete från kontoret fem dagar i veckan.

Vad kommer du att göra?

  • Ansvara för att den lokala IT-miljön är stabil, säker och användarvänlig.
  • Leda och följa upp den dagliga IT-supporten, samt hantera eskaleringar och säkerställa att medarbetarna får rätt hjälp.
  • Ansvara för datorer, nätverk, mötesrum, IT-utrustning, konton och behörigheter.
  • Säkerställa välfungerande IT-processer vid onboarding/offboarding.
  • Förvalta Microsoft 365 och utvalda verksamhetskritiska system samt samordna frågor mellan verksamheten, globala IT-team, utvecklare och externa leverantörer.
  • Säkerställa att dokumentation, rutiner och behörighetshantering är aktuella och fungerar samt samordna återkommande kontroller och aktiviteter inom compliance och IT-säkerhet.
  • Följa upp kostnader, återkommande problem och förbättringsbehov samt driva relevanta åtgärder.

Vem är du?

  • Du har relevant erfarenhet av operativ IT, IT Operations, Digital Workplace, IT-förvaltning eller liknande ansvar och är bekväm med både praktiska och samordnande uppgifter.
  • Du har god kunskap om Microsoft 365, Windows och macOS samt erfarenhet av nätverk, klienthantering, mötesrum och AV.

job.title: Senior Product Manager, Data Platform - PDEGO
job.description:
About Sony Music Entertainment

At Sony Music Entertainment, we fuel the creative journey. We’ve played a pioneering role in music history, from the first-ever music label to the invention of the flat disc record. We’ve nurtured some of music’s most iconic artists and produced some of the most influential recordings of all time.

Today, we work in more than 70 countries, supporting a diverse roster of international superstars, developing and independent artists, and visionary creators. From our position at the intersection of music, entertainment, and technology, we bring imagination and expertise to the newest products and platforms, embrace new business models, employ breakthrough tools, and provide powerful insights that help our artists push creative boundaries and reach new audiences. In everything we do, we’re committed to artistic integrity, transparency, and entrepreneurship.

Sony Music Entertainment is a member of the Sony family of global companies.

Sony Music is looking for a Senior Product Manager, Data to join our talented product team in our London office and lead the development of a portfolio of shared data products.

Our products and teams work with data spanning streaming, fan engagement, social and creator activity, and commerce. As new datasets and requirements emerge, we need to understand what the data contains, establish what it means and make it useful beyond the team or product where it originated.

You will own the strategy, roadmap and delivery of a portfolio of shared data products. Working with business stakeholders, source-product owners and data engineering, you will turn business needs into clear requirements, deliver dependable datasets and establish definitions and relationships that can be reused across products.

What you’ll do:

  • Own the strategy and roadmap for a portfolio of shared data products, with a focus on developing new datasets to meet emerging business needs. Understand needs across teams, identify valuable opportunities and prioritise a portfolio of initiatives that supports artist teams and the wider business.
  • Turn business requests into well-defined data initiatives. Meet the people who produce and use the data, examine source datasets and establish the questions users need to answer, the information required and the measures of success.
  • Define reusable datasets with engineering. Agree on the records, fields, relationships, quality, freshness and access requirements needed for each use case you’re defining. Establish clear acceptance criteria and resolve tradeoffs with stakeholders and engineers.
  • Lead delivery and adoption. Maintain a prioritised backlog and work with engineering through implementation, validation, launch and ongoing improvement. Ensure the teams receiving the data can use it to meet the agreed need.
  • Steward shared definitions and data models. Work with domain experts and engineers to establish consistent definitions, identifiers, relationships and metrics. Develop the shared semantic layer through the initiatives you deliver, so concepts such as artists, tracks, markets, campaigns and audiences can be understood consistently across products.
  • Connect datasets to enable new capabilities. Identify where combining data creates value and lead the product work required, including opportunities to relate streaming performance to social activity, campaigns, fan engagement and commerce.
  • Make data discoverable and understandable. Ensure data products have clear documentation, usage examples and known limitations, helping analysts, data scientists and downstream product teams use them confidently.
  • Help develop and apply practical data standards. Partner with leadership, engineering and relevant specialists on quality, ownership, access, lineage and appropriate use. Translate these expectations into requirements for the data products you lead.
  • Agree responsibilities for ongoing use of the data products you deliver. Work with source-product owners and engineering teams to establish how source changes, maintenance, quality issues and communication with users will be handled for those initiatives.
  • Measure adoption and impact. Gather user feedback and evidence of usefulness, track whether the capabilities delivered meet their intended outcomes and use those findings to inform the roadmap.
  • Build stakeholder alignment. Explain priorities and investment decisions, communicate progress and translate technical considerations into clear business implications.

You will work closely with our existing Data Platform product and engineering teams, coordinating priorities and dependencies with the platform migration and operational roadmap. You will also partner with source-product PMs and the teams building on the shared data products you deliver.

Who you are:

  • You have a track record of leading data products or platform capabilities from discovery and strategy through delivery, adoption and ongoing improvement.
  • You can set a clear product direction and prioritise pragmatically, balancing business value, user needs, technical constraints and dependencies across teams
  • You are comfortable examining source data and working through detailed requirements with business experts, analysts and engineers..
  • You have experience turning fragmented data and business requirements into reusable datasets, shared capabilities or data products that support multiple use cases.
  • You have a strong understanding of modern data platforms, including Snowflake or comparable cloud data warehouses, and can work effectively with engineers on data ingestion, modelling, pipelines and downstream consumption.
  • You understand semantic layers and shared data definitions, and can work with business and technical partners to establish consistent meaning across products and domains.
  • You can make informed product decisions about data quality, freshness, ownership, access and lineage, with an understanding of privacy and appropriate data use.
  • You are comfortable working across product boundaries, clarifying responsibilities and influencing teams whose roadmaps and priorities may differ.
  • You have strong analytical and organisational skills, with the ability to translate complex problems into clear requirements, priorities and delivery plans.
  • You communicate effectively with technical teams, business stakeholders and executives, creating alignment around both the work and the outcomes it should deliver.
  • You have strong documentation skills and can make data products, definitions and decisions understandable to the teams that depend on them.
  • You focus on whether people can use and rely on the capabilities you deliver, with experience measuring adoption, usefulness and business impact.

Bonus Points:

  • Experience working in the music or entertainment industry, particularly with streaming, consumption or artist audience data.
  • Experience with fan engagement, social and creator analytics, marketing campaigns, D2C commerce or customer data platforms.
  • Experience connecting data across platforms through shared identifiers, entity relationships or audience segmentation.
  • Experience building data capabilities that support analytics, marketing intelligence or AI-powered products.
  • Experience with data catalogs, observability tools or business intelligence platforms such as Sigma.
  • Experience managing global or enterprise-scale data products, platform migrations or change management.

What we give you:

  • You join a vibrant global community with the opportunity to channel your passion every day.
  • A modern office environment designed for you, empowering you to bring your best.
  • Investment in your professional growth and development enabling you to thrive in our vibrant community.
  • The space to accelerate progress, positively disrupt and create what happens next.
  • We give you the platform to champion positive change, with the opportunity to contribute to our social impact, diversity, equity and inclusion initiatives.
  • We provide an excellent range of benefits like private medical cover, a generous pension scheme, life assurance, income protection, plus loads of music industry perks. There’s also time off over winter break.

Equal Opportunities

As an active part of a culturally and socially diverse society, Sony Music’s aim is that our workforce is diverse and inclusive. Sony Music is an equal opportunity employer and supports workforce diversity.

We employ, retain, promote and otherwise treat all employees and job applicants according to their merit, qualifications, competence and talent. We apply this policy without regard to any individual’s sex, race, religion, origin, age, sexual orientation, marital status, medical condition or disability.


Privacy Policy

Please click here to read our privacy policy before beginning the application process as you will need to agree to the terms of the policy before submitting your information. Please note that applicants must be at least 18 years of age

job.title: Manager, eCommerce Store Management
job.description:
At Warner Music Group, we’re a global collective of music makers and music lovers, tech innovators and inspired entrepreneurs, game-changing creatives and passionate team members. Here, we turn dreams into stardom and audiences into fans. We are guided by three core values that underpin everything we do across all our diverse businesses: 

  • Curiosity: We do our best work when we’re immersing ourselves in culture and breaking through barriers. Curiosity is the driving force behind creativity and ingenuity. It fuels innovation, and innovation is the key to our future. 

  • Collaboration: Making music and bringing it to the world is all about the power of originality amplified by teamwork. A great idea, like a great song, travels globally. We ignite passions and build connections across our diverse community of artists, songwriters, partners, and fans.

  • Commitment: We pursue excellence for our team and our talent. Everything in music starts with a leap into the unknown, and we’re committed to keeping the faith, acting with integrity, and delivering on our promises.

WMG is home to a wide range of artists, musicians, and songwriters that fuel our success. That is why we are committed to creating a work environment that actively values, appreciates, and respects everyone.  We encourage applications from people with a wide variety of backgrounds and experiences.

Consider a career at WMG and get the best of both worlds – an innovative global music company that retains the creative spirit of a nimble independent.
 

A little bit about our team:

WMX is Warner Music Group’s merchandise and e-commerce services division, focused on helping artists connect with fans through merchandise, physical music, touring, VIP ticketing, retail, licensing and direct-to-consumer experiences. We work at the intersection of creativity and commerce, partnering with artists, managers, and label teams to build thoughtful, high-quality products and experiences that fans care about, and marketing them to drive revenue and add value to our clients business. From artist stores and limited-edition vinyl to tour merchandise and global retail programs, we treat merch and physical products as meaningful extensions of an artist’s creative vision.


WMX combines the global scale of Warner Music Group with an entrepreneurial, hands-on approach. We value collaboration, ownership, and curiosity, and we’re building a forward-thinking team that’s excited to evolve how artists reach and engage their audiences.

 


Your Role:

As the e-Commerce Store Manager, you will serve as the liaison between our internal operations team, record labels, and artist management, acting as the ultimate anchor for our artist merchandise and music retail footprint. In partner will bridge the gap between an artist’s creative vision and flawless digital execution, managing the lifecycle of online storefronts for global brands. This role demands a highly organized, client-facing professional who thrives in a fast-paced environment where music, merchandise, and digital retail intersect. You will own the client relationship for e-commerce, guiding label leads and artist managers through master data requirements, international demand planning, Go-To-Market (GTM) deployments, and high-stakes approval loops.


Here you’ll get to:


GTM Campaign Strategy & Deployment

●       Partner directly with Artist & Label Services  to translate their GTM strategies into live, active digital retail experiences that are timed perfectly with music releases, tour announcements, and merchandise drops.

●       Manage client expectations and own the deployment pipeline to ensure all product launches and time-sensitive campaigns hit strict, unyielding dates.


Data Management & Client Onboarding

●       Serve as a  point of contact for labels regarding product metadata, pricing, and assets, ensuring their vision is accurately captured within one centralized Master Product Grid.

●       Consult with client teams on SKU configurations and submit all new storefront setup requests via Airtable to Operations, ensuring zero friction between the client's requests and our technical execution.


Global Demand Consultation

●       Collaborate proactively with the International teams on global stock volume needs for upcoming music and merchandise releases.

●       Provide data-driven insights to label partners, factoring cross-border demand and international market nuances directly into production planning to optimize global inventory and prevent stockouts.


Visual Merchandising & Sign-Off

●       Lead direct review sessions with Artist Managers and Label Leads, presenting dynamic thematic updates across digital storefronts to ensure visual merchandising perfectly aligns with the artist’s specific brand era and campaign aesthetics.

●       Shepherd storefront designs and product layouts through executive approval loops, actively managing feedback and securing explicit green lights from external stakeholders before pushing changes live.

 


About You:

●        3-5+ years of experience managing digital storefronts (such as Shopify) specifically within the music industry, entertainment, or artist merchandise sectors.

●        Advanced proficiency with Airtable and master data management; a proven track record of maintaining clean, complex data sets.

●        Strong project management skills with a demonstrated ability to pivot quickly and hit hard deadlines aligned with fast-moving music release cycles.

●         Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills, with the comfort and tact required to navigate approval loops involving managers, labels, and creative teams.


As the home to 10K Projects, Asylum, Atlantic Music Group, East West, FFRR, Fueled by Ramen, Nonesuch, Parlophone, Rhino, Roadrunner, Sire, Warner Records, Warner Classics, and several other of the world’s premier recording labels, Warner Music Group champions emerging artists and global superstars alike. And our renowned publishing company, Warner Chappell Music, represents genre-spanning songwriters and producers through a catalog of more than one million copyrights worldwide. Warner Music Group is also home to ADA, which supports the independent community, as well as artist services division WMX. In addition, WMG counts film and television storytelling powerhouse Warner Music Entertainment among its many brands.

Together, we are Warner Music Group: Independent Minds. Major Sound.

Love this job and want to apply?

Click the “Apply” link at the top of the page, or apply directly with your LinkedIn. Applying with LinkedIn will import all of the information you put in your profile, but will still allow you to upload a resume and cover letter.

 

Don’t be discouraged if you don’t hear from us right away. We’re taking our time to review all resumes, and to find the best people for WMG.

 

Thanks for your interest in working for WMG. We love it here, and think you will, too.
 

This position requires a minimum of 4 days per week in the office. We value in-office collaboration, which is essential for talent development and strong working relationships. #LI-Onsite Salary Range: $70,304 to $73,000 Annually Salary ranges are included for job postings where required by law. The pay range is subject to change at any time dependent on a variety of internal and external factors.

job.title: Senior Video Editor, Shows
job.description:
The mission of The New York Times is to seek the truth and help people understand the world. That means independent journalism is at the heart of all we do as a company. It’s why we have a world-renowned newsroom that sends journalists to report on the ground from nearly 160 countries. It’s why we focus deeply on how our readers will experience our journalism, from print to audio to a world-class digital and app destination. And it’s why our business strategy centers on making journalism so good that it’s worth paying for. 

The New York Times is looking for a Senior Video Editor who can help bring our shows portfolio to mobile, social and digital audiences through horizontal video podcasts and vertical video clips.

This is a post-production position to manage the editing of individual shows as well as clips. You have a refined understanding of editing techniques in multi-camera environments, a meticulous attention to detail, and are adept at working on complex edits autonomously and under deadline. You have an in-depth knowledge of Adobe systems.

You will work with producers, editors, journalists and other internal and external collaborators to lead the edit and publication of the Shows department's work. This role is for someone with a deep understanding of social video trends who takes an innovative and adaptive approach to video formats and techniques.

You will report to the the Post Production Supervisor.

This is an in-office position based in New York and includes regular attendance in the office four days each week. There may be some flexibility to work remotely per your departmental guidance.

  • Assist in defining style and techniques that give our videos a voice and make them stand out from the pack
  • Collaborate on optimizing a post production and archival workflow
  • Perform related work as assigned
  • Demonstrate support and understanding of our value of journalistic independence and a strong commitment to our mission to seek the truth and help people understand the world.

job.title: Client Coordinator
job.description:
Who we are

Semafor is a global news platform for an increasingly complex world in which consumers are overwhelmed by too many news sources and unsure what to trust. We are building Semafor to enable world-class journalists to deliver reporting and insights with rigor in journalistic forms that ensure a new level of transparency. Our editors and reporters distill the most important stories from all over in formats that uncover the forces shaping the stories, explain the interests behind polarizing narratives, and replenish the stock of shared facts. As a global platform, Semafor recognizes that smart people can disagree and that informed readers need to understand alternative points of view from competing centers of power and culture in a multi-polar world. Want to join us? Read on. 

About the Role

The Client Coordinator sits within Semafor’s Revenue Operations team and plays a central role in supporting sales, client partnerships, and integrated program delivery.

This role is the connective tissue between Sales, Marketing, Program Management, Events, and Ad Operations. The Client Coordinator supports the execution of integrated media programs by partnering with Sales and cross-functional teams to translate client goals into proposals and ensure seamless delivery across pre-sale functions. This role plays a critical part in maintaining organized workflows, clear communication, and a high-quality client experience across Semafor’s media and events portfolio.

This is an ideal role for a highly organized, detail-oriented individual who is excited to learn the media business end-to-end and grow into sales, client strategy, or revenue operations over time.

Key Responsibilities

Media Planning, Pre-Sale Strategy & Sales Support

  • Partner with Sales to support the development of integrated media programs and media plans across newsletters, digital products, custom content, and events.
  • Support pricing inputs, packaging, deal revisions, and rate guidance within established yield and inventory frameworks.
  • Coordinate proposal kick-offs, deal brief creation, internal feasibility checks, cross-functional inputs, and timeline management 
  • Support RFP responses and the creation of polished, visually engaging proposal decks.
  • Prepare for client meetings by compiling research, agendas, and supporting materials; capture notes and draft follow-ups to ensure clear next steps and accountability.

Client Communication & Relationship Support

  • Serve as a day-to-day point of contact for client coordination, ensuring timely communication and follow-through.
  • Build familiarity with client priorities, sensitivities, and goals to anticipate needs.
  • Coordinate with internal teams to ensure clarity on scope, deliverables, and timelines.

Post-Sale Transition & Program Coordination

  • Support smooth transitions from pre-sale into execution.
  • Maintain client-facing timelines and deliverable trackers.
  • Coordinate campaign launches across newsletters and digital media.
  • Support asset collection, ad specifications, proofs, and confirms in partnership with Ad Ops and Editorial.

Campaign Support, Performance & Optimization

  • Assist with mid-campaign check-ins and performance updates, including basic metric review and insight generation.
  • Help identify potential optimization, added-value, or upsell opportunities in collaboration with Sales.
  • Ensure a consistently high bar for client experience throughout the lifecycle of the program.

Revenue Operations & Internal Coordination

  • Maintain accurate documentation and updates in our CRM (boostr) and workflow tools.
  • Ensure opportunities, products, budgets, and deal details are up to date and accurate.
  • Support maintenance of rate cards, packaging menus, and go-to-market materials.
  • Contribute to process improvements that strengthen pre-sale workflows and cross-functional alignment.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • 2–4 years of experience in media, advertising, communications, client services, account coordination, or related commercial role. 
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Media, or a related field.
  • Exceptional organizational skills, attention to detail, judgement, and ability to manage multiple priorities.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with comfort interacting with clients.
  • Ability to synthesize concepts into actionable next steps.
  • Interest in media planning, integrated programs, and the business of journalism.
  • Ability to operate calmly under pressure and adapt in fast-moving environments.
  • Comfortable managing a high volume of fast-moving work and shifting priorities
  • High ethical standards and respect for diverse perspectives.
  • Comfort managing administrative details, timelines, and a T&E budget responsibly.
  • Boostr experience is a plus.

Additional Job Details

This position is based in New York, NY.

Comprehensive employee benefits: unlimited PTO, medical, dental, vision, short & long-term disability, flexible spending, health savings accounts, life insurance, 401(k), pre-Tax commuter benefits.

Salary Range: Pay is based on several factors including but not limited to education, work experience, certifications, etc. Base: $65,000 - $72,000 per year.
