job.title: Jr. Producer
job.description:
Who We Are

Translation is a well-established independent agency and thriving music business, built to help ambitious brands harness the power of culture to solve their biggest challenges. As a unique mix of experts in culture, technology, and storytelling, we are united by a passion to grow brands in ways that advertising alone can never do. 

We are an entrepreneurial business – not a traditional “ad agency.” That means we value resourcefulness and tenacity just as much as we value creativity and intelligence. We’re unapologetically ambitious, but we’re also a tight-knit crew. 

We are looking for a Junior Producer to join Translation!

What You'll Do

  • Produce great work.
  • Support larger campaigns under the guidance of a lead producer and/or manage small content projects independently with oversight from a manager, EP or group lead.
  • Problem solve with internal and external teams to get to the best work possible. 
  • Work closely with all departments and outside partners to execute assignments on time and on budget. 
  • Responsible for seeing a job through from its inception to final delivery and job wrap - whether as the supporting producer or lead producer.
  • Develop and manage production calendars - with the oversight of a manager or lead producer - and direct the logistical flow of a project from pre-production through post production.
  • Work with our in-house production arm, 16 Bars, for projects as needed.
  • Identify opportunities to work with our UnitedMasters artists on various projects.
  • Travel to and/or coordinate shoots for your own projects or as on the ground support for larger campaigns; including but not limited to managing pick up shoots or separate social / stills / B-units.
  • Track all job actuals, maintain the job jacket with precision, and final wrap + archive of all projects with acute attention to detail.
  • Performance of all necessary production duties, big and small, for projects as assigned.
  • Maintains knowledge of production trends and platforms to keep up with the ever changing world of “content and experiences.”
  • Seek opportunities for underrepresented creators both in the company and within the industry. 

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • An appetite for working on projects with ever increasing complexity as you gain more experience and skills. 
  • Consistency of gaining trust and respect by demonstrating sound critical-thinking skills and maintaining composure in stressful situations.
  • Strength in working with colleagues, clients and vendors at various levels and across functions. 
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills with the ability to communicate with all levels of team members or clients.. 
  • The ability to work under pressure with flexibility, agility, and a good sense of humor.
  • Well versed in managing budgets and deadlines of all types with accuracy and diplomacy.
  • Superb problem solving, organizational, and negotiation skills.
  • Flexible multi-tasker that can handle a multitude of different responsibilities at one time.
  • Demonstrate, evangelize and live the core values of the agency.
  • Incorporate the passion, excitement and experience of one’s MINOR in relevant ways that inform the quality and output of the company.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 2-4 years production experience 
  • After-hours work and overnight traveling to shoots or post sessions required                                                           

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working on projects with celebrities, athletes, musicians, influencers, etc. 
  • Experience with union and non-union crew productions, including both SAG and non-SAG talent. 
  • Passion and knowledge of latest industry trends (music, media, distribution, directors, film, tech, etc).

About UnitedMasters 

UnitedMasters has over 1.5 million artists on its platform and is growing rapidly. Brands like Diageo, Ally, and ESPN come to UnitedMasters to partner with these artists and play a role in moving culture forward. In the past year, UnitedMasters subscribers have grown rapidly. With $170M raised to date and valued at $550M, UnitedMasters is backed by Andreessen Horowitz, Apple, Alphabet (aka Google), and Disney amongst others. Over the last year, UnitedMasters artists have used our platform to land sync deals with major brands including the NBA, ESPN, Overtime Elite, Bose, Warner Brother Studios and in the NBA video game 2k. These deals give them additional money for their work and increase their exposure.

Individual pay rate decisions are based on a number of factors, including qualifications for the role, experience level, skillset, and balancing internal equity relative to peers at the company.  We expect the majority of the candidates who are offered roles at our company to fall healthily throughout the range based on these factors.

job.description:
ESPN West Palm Spring Internship

(West Palm Beach, Florida)

ESPN West Palm is currently recruiting college students for the Spring 2027 Semester. This is a part-time paid internship that will provide an excellent opportunity for students to learn more about sport marketing and media.   

The ideal candidate will be an organized self-starter who is interested in hands-on experience in the areas of new business development, promotional event marketing, and sports content creation. 

ESPN West Palm is a sports marketing entity with assets such as ESPN 106.3 FM and Deportes 760 AM. 

Daily Responsibilities of an Intern:

  • Take initiative to learn all aspects of the business, ideally becoming competent in marketing execution, the Good Karma Sports partner acquisition process and Good Karma’s content creation strategies and best practices
  • Assist with event planning, set-up and execution and event breakdown
  • Engage and interact with local partners and fans during events
  • Other assigned tasks
  • Be a Good Karma Sports ambassador by adhering to the Good Karma core values: Be Honest, Work Hard, Over Deliver, Listen, Teamwork and Follow Through. 

Hours and Pay

This internship is approximately 15–25 hours/week from late January to April/May 2027. Interns are paid $15.00 an hour and will gain experience in marketing, sales, and content.

Opportunity for Growth  

Teammates can continuously learn and grow within Good Karma Sports and are responsible for representing our story and core values inside and outside the workplace. Teammates are encouraged to take a proactive role in building relationships and seeking opportunities throughout the company.  

How to Apply  

Apply by submitting your resume to www.goodkarmasports.com/careers no later than October 23, 2026. All are encouraged to apply.  

About Good Karma Sports

Good Karma Sports is a sports media and marketing company that helps brands build meaningful connections with fans in and around the game. Combining national reach, regional expertise and deep local relationships, the company develops and executes multi-platform strategies across audio, podcasts, video, digital, social, talent, live experiences and premium sports partnerships. 

For nearly 30 years, Good Karma has paired sports-first expertise and trusted relationships with best-in-class execution to deliver results for brands, publishers, leagues, teams, communities and fans. Today, Good Karma Sports has more than 500 teammates across 12 offices nationwide and has been recognized as a Best Place to Work by Front Office Sports, Sports Business Journal and USA TODAY.

## 

Good Karma Sports is an Equal Opportunity Employer.  We consistently renew our commitment to creating and maintaining an inclusive workplace for all.  We foster integrity, respect within the workplace, and believe that the foundation of our success is our collective differences and diversity of thought.  We welcome all to help us continue to build a community that embodies and promotes diversity, inclusion, and belonging for all.

job.title: On-Air Morning Show Host - WDEZ
job.description:
Job Type Full-time Description


 

On-Air Morning Show Host - WDEZ

Wake up Central Wisconsin. Make someone’s day a little brighter.

 

Great radio is about more than playing the right songs. It’s about becoming part of someone’s routine, making them laugh on the way to work, and giving listeners a reason to keep coming back.


101.9 WDEZ, Central Wisconsin’s top-rated morning show, is looking for its next full-time on-air personality to keep the momentum going. At Midwest Communications, we believe in real, live, local radio. We want personalities who know how to connect with an audience, create compelling content, and bring a brand to life both on and off the air. We work hard, have fun, and love winning as a team.


Your Responsibilities:

  • Co-host WDEZ’s #1 Morning Show, live Monday through Friday from 6:00 AM to 10:00 AM. Bring the energy, personality, preparation, and creativity that keeps listeners coming back for more.
  • Extend the show’s personality across social media, digital platforms, and video content. Give listeners more ways to connect with the people and the stations they love.
  • Represent WDEZ at station events, live broadcasts, and community appearances. Build genuine relationships with listeners.
  • Work with local sponsors through endorsement opportunities and relationship-building that connect businesses with the audiences they want to reach.
  • Bring fresh ideas, collaborate with your team, and look for new ways to make WDEZ even more engaging, memorable and keep the brand growing. 

What We’re Looking For:

  • Be a natural communicator- know how to tell a story, entertain an audience, and make people feel like they’re part of the conversation. Whether your background is traditional radio or digital content creation, you know how to capture attention and keep it. And yes, you must bring the energy at 6:00 AM.
  • Have three or more years of experience in on-air broadcasting preferred. Audio/video presence and an established presence as a social media influencer are key. 
  • Be that relatable person that listeners can connect to; have a genuine appreciation for Country music, Midwest culture, and the communities we serve.
  • Have a drive to create great radio content, grow an audience, strengthen the brand, and be part of a team that takes pride in their work. 
  • You should enjoy collaborating, sharing ideas, and working with others to make the show better. 
  • Have a valid Wisconsin’s driver’s license, the ability to pass a motor vehicle check, and satisfactory background check.

Culture at Midwest Communications

At Midwest Communications, Inc., we’re invested in the longevity and satisfaction of our employees. As a privately owned, family-founded company, we expect our team members to take ownership of their work while also enjoying a laid-back, collaborative atmosphere where growth and creativity are encouraged. We operate as a tightly knit staff and getting along with your coworkers is non-negotiable given the collaborative nature of the role. We truly are a united team where every department works together to achieve a mutual goal. You’ll have the tools and support of an established media company, along with the autonomy to get your work done and make the role your own.

Compensation/Benefits 

  • A full-time position with an established and successful business.
  • Pay ranging from $35,000-$40,000 based on experience with full benefits.
    • Paid time off/holidays, health/dental/vision insurance, 401(k), flexible spending accounts, life insurance, and disability coverage. 
  • Opportunities to grow within Midwest Communications, Inc.

If this sounds like a role you would thrive in, don’t hesitate to apply today! 


Any additional documentation such as airchecks, audio/video samples, or cover letters can be sent to Talent and HR Coordinator, Lauryn Calkins, at lauryn.calkins@mwcradio.com. 


Midwest Communications, Inc. is proud to be an equal opportunity employer by choice.

  • Provide tools and communication that assist Department Heads with expense management.

  • Serve as liaison between the station and regional accounting team on reporting

  • Assist with forecasting and budgeting of revenues and operating expenses

Payroll

  • Prepare monthly payroll reports from ADP

Human Resources

  • Oversee onboarding and offboarding processes

  • Administer leave and workers' compensation programs

  • Support labor relations under union collective bargaining agreements

  • Accounts Payable & Expenses

  • Process and approve invoices

Qualifications

  • Strong ability to meet deadlines and manage multiple priorities

  • Highly detail-oriented and organized

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills

Experience

  • 5+ years of accounting/finance experience

  • Previous HR experience required; PHR/SPHR/SHRM-CP/SCP certification a plus

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Word, and PowerPoint

job.title: Broadcast Maintenance Technician
job.description:
WCVB-TV, the ABC affiliate in Boston, is seeking a full-time Broadcast Maintenance Technician to support the systems and facilities that keep our station on the air. WCVB Engineering supports Master Control, news, studios, production, cameras, transmission, station IT infrastructure, and building systems.

This position will maintain, troubleshoot, repair, install, and upgrade equipment across the station. The technician will support daily operations, planned projects, preventive maintenance, live news coverage, special events, and remote broadcasts. This position reports to the Assistant Chief Engineer and works closely with Engineering, IT, Master Control, News, Production, and other station teams.

 

Responsibilities

 

  • Maintain, troubleshoot, and repair broadcast production systems including field and studio cameras, audio, video, routing, monitoring, and signal distribution systems.
  • Support technical systems in Master Control, the newsroom, studios, control rooms, transmitter sites, and remote locations. 
  • Support station IT team and infrastructure in coordination with IT staff, including network-connected broadcast equipment, workstations, cabling, hardware, and software.
  • Perform preventive maintenance, system checks, reboots, equipment installs, cabling, testing, and documentation. 
  • Assist with station projects, system moves, equipment replacements, and new installations from prep through return to service. 
  • Provide technical support for live news, special events, and large scale multi cam remote broadcasts.
  • Work with vendors and service representatives during troubleshooting, repairs, upgrades, and installations. 

 

Systems and Technology

 

The technician will help support a wide range of systems, including Florical master control automation, Pixotope virtual production, Vinten/Videndum robotic camera systems, Sony studio and field cameras, Clear-Com, RTS and Unity intercom systems, TVU Networks mobile transmission systems, broadcast routers, signal distribution, monitoring, IP-based video and audio systems, and station computer, network, and cabling infrastructure.

Requirements

  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to work well in a high-performing team environment. 
  • Experience maintaining, troubleshooting, or repairing electronic, broadcast, production, computer, or networked equipment. 
  • Strong understanding of electronics, signal flow, computer systems, and IP networking. 
  • Ability to troubleshoot methodically, communicate clearly, document work, and work effectively across departments. 
  • Experience with broadcast video, audio, cameras, transmission systems, satellite communications, C-Band/Ku-Band systems, or IT infrastructure is valuable. 
  • Ability to lift and carry up to 50 pounds and work on ladders, rooftops, equipment areas, and confined spaces with proper safety procedures. 
  • Ability to work a flexible schedule, including evenings, weekends, holidays, and occasional off-site assignments as station operations require. 
  • Familiarity with Windows and Mac workstations and standard software applications. 
  • AutoCAD or Visio experience for system drawings and layouts is preferred. 
  • Technical education, SBE certification, military technical experience, or equivalent hands-on experience is valued. 

Salary

The estimated base salary range for this role is between $110,517 and $117,515. The actual base pay offered is dependent upon many factors, such as transferable skills, work experience, business needs, market demands and conditions, including geographic location where the work will be performed, and other factors permitted by law. We create world-class content, which we distribute across our portfolio of film, television, and streaming, and bring to life through our global theme park destinations, consumer products, and experiences. We own and operate leading entertainment and news brands, including NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo, and Peacock, our premium ad-supported streaming service. We produce and distribute premier filmed entertainment and programming through our powerhouse film and television studios, including Universal Pictures, DreamWorks Animation, and Focus Features, and the four global television studios under the Universal Studio Group banner, and operate industry-leading theme parks and experiences around the world through Universal Destinations & Experiences, including Universal Orlando Resort, home to Universal Epic Universe, and Universal Studios Hollywood. NBCUniversal is a subsidiary of Comcast Corporation. Visit www.nbcuniversal.com for more information.

Our impact is rooted in improving the communities where our employees, customers, and audiences live and work. We have a rich tradition of giving back and ensuring our employees have the opportunity to serve their communities. We champion an inclusive culture and strive to attract and develop a talented workforce to create and deliver a wide range of content reflecting our world.

Responsibilities

 

  • Research, develop, shoot, write, edit, produce, and present accurate and compelling news stories for broadcast, digital, streaming, and social platforms.
  • Generate original and enterprise story ideas relevant to the local community.
  • Develop and maintain strong sources and community contacts to produce exclusive and impactful reporting.
  • Cover breaking news and provide live reports, interviews, and updates from the field and studio.
  • Produce daily news packages, special reports, and enterprise stories while meeting tight deadlines.
  • Create original content for KTLM/Telemundo digital and social platforms.
  • Collaborate with producers, assignment editors, anchors, photographers, MMJs, and other newsroom teams.
  • Operate professional cameras, lighting, audio, editing, and live transmission equipment, including LiveU and/or Dejero.
  • Maintain assigned equipment and manage multiple assignments and deadlines.
  • Represent KTLM/Telemundo professionally at community and station events.
  • Maintain flexibility to work nights, weekends, holidays, and extended hours as needed in a 24/7 newsroom.
  • Adhere to NBCUniversal and Telemundo News Standards and Guidelines, including social media and professional conduct policies.

 

Basic Qualifications

 

  • Bachelor’s degree in journalism, Communications, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Minimum 2 years of experience as a reporter, MMJ, or journalist producing original news content.
  • Experience shooting, writing, editing, and producing news stories independently.
  • Strong Spanish-language skills, both written and verbal, and ability to communicate effectively in English.
  • Experience with professional video, editing, and newsroom systems.
  • Ability to work effectively under tight deadlines and during breaking news.
  • Must be willing to work flexible hours and be based in McAllen, Texas.
  • Must have unrestricted U.S. work authorization, be at least 18 years old, and possess a valid driver's license with an acceptable driving record.
  • External applicants must submit a resume/CV and current demo reel through NBCUniversal Careers.

Desired Characteristics

  • News judgment with a solid ethical decision process 
  • Highly competitive nature  
  • Ability to perform under tight time deadlines 
  • Able to respond quickly and accurately to breaking news with Live Cut-ins 
  • Able to “ad-lib” effortlessly in various types of situations 
  • Creative with unique story ideas for development 
  • Highly organized with strong attention to detail.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills with the ability to work independently or as part of a collaborative team.

job.title: Vice President, Product, Entertainment Experience
job.description:
NBCUniversal is one of the world's leading media and entertainment companies. We create world-class content, which we distribute across our portfolio of film, television, and streaming, and bring to life through our global theme park destinations, consumer products, and experiences. We own and operate leading entertainment and news brands, including NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo, and Peacock, our premium ad-supported streaming service. We produce and distribute premier filmed entertainment and programming through our powerhouse film and television studios, including Universal Pictures, DreamWorks Animation, and Focus Features, and the four global television studios under the Universal Studio Group banner, and operate industry-leading theme parks and experiences around the world through Universal Destinations & Experiences, including Universal Orlando Resort, home to Universal Epic Universe, and Universal Studios Hollywood. NBCUniversal is a subsidiary of Comcast Corporation. Visit www.nbcuniversal.com for more information.

Our impact is rooted in improving the communities where our employees, customers, and audiences live and work. We have a rich tradition of giving back and ensuring our employees have the opportunity to serve their communities. We champion an inclusive culture and strive to attract and develop a talented workforce to create and deliver a wide range of content reflecting our world.

The Vice President of Product, Entertainment and Sports Engagement will develop and champion a product vision within a bold set of strategic ambitions, and lead its execution from concept through customer impact across three interconnected areas that are central to reimagining streaming and how fandoms come to life for the next generation of fans:

  • Entertainment and Sports Experiences: Create differentiated experiences around live sports, TV, movies, franchises, and major cultural moments, working closely with Sports and the NBCUniversal Studio Group to Innovate across fandoms, interaction mechanics, and content formats to deepen engagement and deliver outstanding fan experiences.
  • Discovery and Browse Experience: Define how customers explore Peacock and decide what to watch or play across platforms. Creating simple, intuitive journeys that thoughtfully integrate capabilities from other product groups including Search, Personalization, Advertising and content metadata teams into a coherent customer experience.
  • Mobile Reimagined: Define a differentiated vision for mobile that revolutionizes how customers discover, watch, play, and participate on their phones. Develop compelling formats beyond traditional streaming, including games, podcasts, microdramas, short-form and vertical video, while bringing these experiences together into a coherent and intuitive product.

This is a senior leadership role that requires product judgement, organizational leadership, and the ability to turn ambitious ideas into customer-facing experiences and roadmaps that scale across platforms and teams.

We are looking for an experienced, versatile product leader who can take an ambitious strategic direction and turn it into a distinctive product vision with measurable outcomes, and develop a growing product team in a competitive consumer landscape. A successful candidate will bring creativity to look at problems in new ways, discipline in using experiments and proof of concepts to validate hypotheses, strong collaboration skills to get things done across a matrixed organization, including the wider NBCUniversal and Sky businesses, and excellent communication skills.

This role will lead a team of approximately 20 product managers, report to the SVP, Product and UX, and work across the organization to deliver measurable improvements in customer engagement, including frequency, watch time, discovery success, and participation in entertainment and sports experiences.

In this role, you will:

  • Create and champion a bold product vision that brings Peacock and NBCUniversal’s broader strategic ambitions to life for how customers engage with Peacock across all devices, including TV, mobile, web, and next-generation devices, through a mix of new features, enhancements, and innovation.
  • Grow and lead an experimentation portfolio that rapidly validates new content formats, interaction models, and engagement experiences through iterative testing.
  • Act as a senior thought partner to the SVP Product & UX on content innovation, portfolio prioritization, and executive stakeholder management, balancing immediate business priorities, foundational capabilities, and longer-term innovation.
  • Define how Search, Personalization, Ad Innovation, and emerging AI capabilities come together within the customer experience, partnering with the teams that own those capabilities to deliver simple, intuitive, and differentiated journeys.
  • Create coherence across discovery, mobile, playback and fan experiences, ensuring that individual initiatives contribute to a simple and connected customer experience.
  • Build, lead, and develop a high-performing organization of product leaders and managers, establishing a culture of clear accountability, strong decision-making, and alignment around a shared vision and measurable outcomes.
  • Help create an AI-forward product culture by establishing new ways of working that improve the speed, quality, and effectiveness of research, product definition, prototyping, experimentation, and decision-making.
  • Have a keen sense for good UX/design and the ability to make evidence-based decisions using consumer insights, product analytics, competitive and market analysis.
  • Translate complex ideas into clear, compelling executive presentations and prototypes that explain product vision and strategy.
  • Collaborate with product design, project management, merchandising, data, marketing, content, and strategy teams to develop holistic points of view and confidently make product decisions and deliver high quality products.
  • Build business cases for incremental product investment that drives innovation and measurable customer or business impact.
  • Build experiences and engagement capabilities that can scale across Peacock, Sky and global streaming platforms.
  • Minimum of 15 years of product strategy/management experience within the media or consumer technology space
  • Minimum of 8 years successfully leading a team of customer-centric product managers
  • Demonstrated ability to influence senior executives and align diverse stakeholders around a shared vision and outcome through collaboration, even without direct authority.
  • Experience managing a broad product portfolio and making investment and prioritization decisions across near-term delivery, foundational capabilities, and longer-term innovation.
  • Consumer-centric view with a proven track record of developing and acting on customer insights
  • Proven ability to be flexible and quickly adapt to changing priorities, with tight deadlines, balancing short-term progress with long-term thinking
  • Proven ability to hire, coach, and develop senior product leaders and build an organization that delivers through clear accountability and empowered decision-making.
  • Track record of successfully operating within a highly matrixed work environment, managing multiple stakeholders
  • Experience building products across multiple platforms (iOS, tvOS, Android, Roku, Amazon)
  • Ability and self-motivation to work effectively offsite and onsite and with global, multilingual teams
  • Strong analytics skills and a hypothesis-driven approach to problem solving, including significant experience with A/B testing and analytics
  • Exceptional verbal, written and interpersonal communication skills
  • BA/BS degree or equivalent practical experience

Hybrid: This position currently has a hybrid schedule, which requires contributing from the office a minimum of four days per week. The Company reserves the right to change in-office requirements at any time.

This position is eligible for company sponsored benefits, including medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k), paid leave, tuition reimbursement, and a variety of other discounts and perks. job.title: Broadcast Engineer Lead
job.description:
About TEGNA

TEGNA Inc. helps people thrive in their local communities by providing the trusted local news and services that matter most. With 64 television stations in 51 U.S. markets, TEGNA reaches more than 100 million people monthly across the web, mobile apps, streaming, and linear television. Together, we are building a sustainable future for local news.

 

WATN / WLMT TV seeks a Broadcast Engineer Lead to own the broadcast and IT systems behind our 24/7 news operation. Reporting to the Head of Technology as the station’s senior technical leader, you will set technical direction, lead major projects, and serve as the escalation point for engineering staff, with decision-making authority and no direct reports.

Responsibilities:

  • System Ownership: Ensure the reliability, scalability, and performance of key broadcast and IT systems.
  • Technical Direction: Set system architecture and engineering standards within corporate guidelines, and recommend technology roadmaps.
  • Project Leadership: Plan, design, and deliver local, capital, and corporate engineering projects.
  • Systems Integration: Design and approve integration of studios, control rooms, transmission, automation, and asset management systems.
  • Mentorship: Guide engineering staff, delegate routine work, and review work for quality.
  • Maintenance & Troubleshooting: Maintain servers, storage, and networks; resolve complex issues; support HVAC, UPS, and backup power.
  • Compliance: Ensure adherence to FCC, IT security, OSHA, and disaster recovery requirements.
  • Documentation: Maintain engineering standards, wiring documentation, and operating procedures.
  • Collaboration: Coordinate with corporate engineering, vendors, IT security, and station leadership.

Requirements:

  • Education & Experience: Bachelor's degree in engineering, IT, or related field (or equivalent experience) and 5+ years in broadcast operations or technology, including leading complex projects.
  • Technical Expertise: Hands-on experience with broadcast systems, networking, servers, and desktop support; satellite, microwave, and IP newsgathering knowledge preferred.

Benefits: 

TEGNA offers comprehensive benefits designed to safeguard the physical, mental and financial health of our employees and their families. TEGNA offers two medical plan options for full and part-time employees through Blue Cross Blue Shield of Texas, as well as access to dental and eye care coverage; fertility, surrogacy and adoption assistance; disability and life insurance.

Our 401(k) program offers full, part-time and temporary employees the opportunity to contribute 1% - 80% of their pay on a pre-tax basis to TEGNA’s 401(k). Contributions made up to the first 4% of pay are eligible for a 100% match from the company and are 100% vested from day one.

Regardless of participation in TEGNA medical plans, ALL employees and their eligible family members receive nine free virtual doctor’s appointments with a physician through Teladoc, and 12 free annual therapy sessions with a licensed clinician through Spring Health.

TEGNA offers a generous Paid Time Off (PTO) benefit as well as nine paid holidays per year. 

* Some jobs are covered by a collective bargaining agreement and thus some or all of the benefits described herein may not apply. For example, some newsroom bargaining unit employees receive health and retirement benefits under plans administered by the union.

EEO statement:

TEGNA Inc. is a proud equal opportunity employer. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer, hiring and developing individuals from diverse backgrounds and experiences to add to our collaborative culture. We value and consider applications from all qualified candidates without regard to actual or perceived race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, age, marital status, personal appearance, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, family responsibilities, disability, medical condition, enrollment in college or vocational school, political affiliation, military or veteran status, citizenship status, genetic information, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law. TEGNA will reasonably accommodate qualified individuals with disabilities in accordance with applicable law. If you are in need of an accommodation in order to submit your application, please email askhr@tegna.com

To all candidates: your personal information and online safety are important to us. Only TEGNA Recruiters or Hiring Managers will reach out to you regarding consideration of your application or background.  Communications with TEGNA employees will either come from a TEGNA email address with a domain of tegna.com or one of our affiliate station domains.  

Recruiters or Hiring Managers will never request payments, ask for financial account information or sensitive information such as social security numbers.

job.title: Associate Producer, Visual Content
job.description:
USA TODAY is seeking an Associate Producer, Visual Content to join its national photo and video team. This role combines content programming, AI-assisted video production, and visual storytelling through galleries and playlists. This role will be specifically focused on USA TODAY’s entertainment vertical and will play a critical role in identifying and covering red carpet moments, celebrity interviews, behind-the-scenes footage, and viral entertainment trends.

We're looking for a digital-first journalist who understands audience behavior, thrives in a fast-paced environment, and can create, optimize, and distribute visual content across platforms. This role will help drive audience growth, engagement, and revenue through strategic programming and scalable content production using AI-powered platforms and tools.

Responsibilities

Content Programming & Distribution

Program and optimize visual content across USA TODAY, Network sites, mobile apps, articles, playlists, galleries, and social platforms.

Serve as a centralized programming resource, making real-time editorial decisions to maximize audience engagement and content performance.

Monitor analytics using tools such as Parse.ly and Google Analytics to inform programming strategy.

Monitor real-time analytics and entertainment trends to identify visual opportunities and adjust content strategy accordingly.

Write compelling headlines, metadata, descriptions, and promotional copy optimized for SEO and audience growth.

Identify, source, and distribute the most relevant in-house, third-party, and publicly available content while ensuring editorial quality and rights compliance.

Manage automated and third-party video feeds, playlists, and related content experiences.

AI-Assisted Video Production

Serve as the national hub for AI-assisted video creation using platforms such as Stringr, Wochit, and future automation tools.

Produce high-volume short-form video content for breaking news, service journalism, entertainment, sports, obituaries, trending topics, and high-interest local stories.

Create vertical video optimized for platforms including TikTok, Instagram Reels, Facebook, and YouTube Shorts.

Repurpose automated and AI-generated content for owned and social platforms.

Fulfill newsroom video requests and support priority local markets and network editorial initiatives

Visual Curation

Create and curate entertainment photo galleries that capture the emotion, artistry, and defining moments of celebrities, events, and fan culture.

Program visual experiences into articles, section fronts, and promotional placements across the Network.

Source and manage visual assets from the USA TODAY Network, wire services, and approved third-party providers.

Editorial Collaboration

Maintain high standards for editorial quality, accuracy, and brand consistency.

Collaborate with local and national newsroom teams on coverage planning, major events, and visual storytelling opportunities.

Support the USA TODAY Network by answering questions, troubleshooting workflows, and sharing best practices.

Develop training materials and assist with newsroom education initiatives related to video production, programming, galleries, playlists, and AI-powered workflows.

What Success Looks Like

Consistent delivery of high-quality visual content across video, galleries, playlists, and promotional experiences.

Growth in audience engagement metrics, including views, watch time, click-through rates, article engagement, and content consumption.

Increased adoption of AI-assisted production workflows that improve newsroom efficiency while maintaining quality standards.

Strong content discoverability through strategic programming, SEO optimization, and effective distribution tactics.

Successful support of major news, sports, entertainment, lifestyle, and breaking news coverage initiatives.

Requirements

Bachelor's degree in journalism, communications, digital media or related field.

2-5 years of newsroom, digital media, content production, audience engagement, or visual storytelling experience for an entertainment news publisher or brand.

Experience programming content and producing video for digital platforms.

Strong understanding of SEO, audience development, analytics, and content optimization.

Experience with analytics tools such as Parse.ly and Google Analytics.

Excellent headline writing, editing, and communication skills.

Strong news judgment, organizational skills, and attention to detail.

Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.

Knowledge of AP Style.

Comfortable working independently in a remote environment.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with Stringr, Wochit, True Anthem, or similar platforms.

Experience creating photo galleries, playlists, and audience-focused visual experiences.

Familiarity with Adobe Premiere, Photoshop, Canva, or similar editing tools.

Experience using AI tools for content creation, automation, and audience optimization.

Knowledge of video rights management and content licensing.

Experience producing content for social and mobile-first platforms.

Who You Are

A digital-first storyteller with strong audience instincts.

Obsessed with celebrities, movies, music, Hollywood, red carpets, and trending moments.

Equal parts programmer, producer, and visual curator.

Passionate about analytics, optimization, and content performance.

Curious about AI and emerging newsroom technologies.

Organized, collaborative, adaptable, and comfortable working at scale.

Schedule

This role requires flexibility, including evenings, weekends, holidays, and breaking-news coverage as needed.

Application Instructions

Please submit a single document containing:

Resume (1-2 pages)

Cover letter explaining your experience and approach to the role

Five examples of work demonstrating video production, content programming, visual storytelling, galleries, playlists, or audience growth initiatives

It is important that these items be assembled into a single document and uploaded in PDF format. Completing these steps will ensure that your application receives the highest consideration.

  • Partner with Subject Matter Experts (SME) to resolve specific inquiries that require further research and knowledge.

Qualifications

A well-rounded team player that can work independently and in group settings on a day to day basis. Someone who is great at multitasking, meeting deadlines, and open to gaining more payroll experience.

 

Required:

  • 2+ years of Payroll or data processing work experience.
  • 2+ year of Workday experience.
  • 1+ year of customer service related work experience.
  • 1+ year of previous experience working with multiple unions, preferably in the media industry (specifically AFTRA, WGA, IBEW).
  • Previous experience with multi state payroll.
  • Previous experience with employee data or HRIS functions.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to meet strict deadlines.
  • Shows integrity, discretion, and sensitivity to confidential data.
  • Solution-oriented, organized, and highly attentive.
  • Ability to work in a fast paced and constantly changing environment.
  • Ability to research, interpret, and reconcile data.
  • Ability to keep stakeholders informed.

Your next big break is here!  Vista Radio is looking for an Account Executive to help grow our business in Olds, AB. The role supports the Olds market, working with our local brands including 104.5 The GOAT Rocks and 96.5 The Ranch in Olds.

The right candidate will be outgoing and ready to really dig into the community and be the face of the station around town.  In addition, you'll be joining the Vista team which prides itself on creating opportunity for advancement.  So, if you're ready to jump start your career, this is the place for you!

We are looking for a lifer, someone who gets us and wants to grow with us long-term 😉 We’re competitive, driven, and we support each other to win. This is not an easy role — it’s a high-energy, high-reward environment where resilience, consistency, and attitude matter. We have some pretty awesome ready-made sales for you, and lots of opportunity to build on that list with active and inactive clientele that are just waiting for you to come through their doors!

If you’re looking for a highly active sales position and someone who thrives on challenge, isn’t afraid of hearing “no,” and knows that success in sales is built through dedication to training, and pure old-fashioned hard work — we’re ready to talk to you.

About the Job:

Vista Radio has an immediate opening for an Account Executive, based in Olds, AB.

What you'll do

Creating and managing multi-platform marketing campaigns that integrate radio, digital, and social media to help clients achieve their goals

Supporting an existing client base by developing new campaigns, optimizing ongoing strategies, and uncovering new growth opportunities

Prospecting and cold calling to develop new business from unassigned accounts and fresh leads

Designing creative sales strategies and proposals tailored to client needs and business goals

Meeting and exceeding monthly and quarterly revenue targets

Managing your own account receivables to ensure timely billing and follow-up

What you Bring

Education in sales, marketing, business, or communications preferred and entrepreneurial backgrounds are welcomed

Sales experience is an asset; media sales experience is a bonus (we’ll train the right person!)

Comfortable working on a commission-based compensation structure

Self-starter with the ability to manage time, priorities, and deadlines independently

Excellent verbal, written, and presentation skills

Computer-savvy, especially with Microsoft Office or Google Suite tools

Strong organizational skills and attention to detail

Customer service-oriented with exceptional networking skills

Creative thinker with a knack for problem-solving and solution development

Ability to work well in a collaborative, fast-paced team environment

Must have a valid driver’s license and a reliable, fully insured vehicle

This is not a passive sales role. It’s for people who want to build something, push themselves, and grow quickly.

Have questions? Apply and start the conversation — we’d love to connect with you. Taking that first step is exactly the kind of drive we’re looking for.

Cumulus Media | Fresno is in search of a hard-working Part Time Remote Technician. If you are looking to get a foot in the door to the radio industry, have an outgoing personality and have a passion for radio, this is a great opportunity for you! You will be going out into the community to interact with listeners and promote our stations.

  • General maintenance of remote broadcast equipment including diagnosis of problems and minor internal repairs.

  • Ability to multi-task, handle time-sensitive deadlines, and work independently in remote locations.
  • Able to have a flexible schedule (including days, nights, weekends, and holidays)
  • May require lifting or moving up to 50 pounds.
  • Must be able to stand for extended periods of time.
  • May require working outdoors in all weather conditions.

USD $18.00 - USD $18.00 /Hr.

  • Focused, responsible and collaborative work environment with the ability, to ask “what if” and try innovative solutions

Job Summary/Description:

Are you the kind of person who is naturally curious about the world around you? KTTC in Rochester, MN, is looking for a high-energy Multimedia Journalist (MMJ) who is ready to start their career by making a real impact. We’re not just looking for an employee; we’re looking for a storyteller who is eager to share facts, seek the truth, and own the news cycle across every screen—from the TV in the living room to the phone in the palm of a viewer's hand.

Duties/Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:  

What You'll Do:

• Own the news cycle: Gather, shoot, and edit high-impact content for multiple platforms, ensuring our audience stays informed.
• Pitch with purpose: Come ready to the editorial meeting with researched ideas pitched through Microsoft Teams. You’ll have already made the calls and prearranged interviews to hit the ground running.
• Master the multi-platform: Write and adapt stories for different screens—from the morning news to quick social updates and deep-dive web articles.
• Report live from the scene: Be the first on the ground when news breaks, delivering authoritative and calm live reports that keep our viewers connected.
• Verify and validate: Gather and verify factual information through interviews, observation, and deep research—because accuracy is our foundation.
• Manage your time: Take charge of your daily workflow—from getting out the door for fresh video to editing your final masterpiece before the deadline hits.
• Stay agile: Update stories as they evolve and be ready to fill in on different shifts when the news demands it.

Why You'll Love It Here:

• A launchpad for your career: Join a young, energetic newsroom led by anchors with decades of experience who are eager to mentor the next generation of journalists.
• Growth every day: We believe feedback should happen in real time, not just during a yearly review. You’ll grow faster here than anywhere else.
• Innovation focus: KTTC is evolving on purpose—we’re serious about the future of media and want you to help shape it.
• Community impact: Tell stories that actually matter to the people of Rochester and the surrounding area.
• Supportive culture: We value scrappiness and digital innovation, but we also value our people. You’ll have the tools and the team to do your best work.

Qualifications/Requirements:

What You Bring:

• The mindset: Above all else, a relentless desire to learn, seek the truth, and share stories that matter.
• Strong writing chops: You craft scripts and articles that are tight, clear, and compelling (AP style is your best friend).
• Technical potential: While we can teach you to shoot and edit video, a familiarity with camera equipment and systems like ENPS or Edius is a great head start.
• Self-motivated hustle: The ability to work independently in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment without breaking a sweat.
• Versatility: You can manage multiple projects at once and pivot quickly when breaking news hits.
• A valid driver’s license: You’re ready to hit the road and go where the story takes you.
• Human qualities: Empathy for the stories you tell, urgency in how you tell them, and the flexibility to roll with the punches of a dayside shift.

Ready to start your journey and own the news cycle in Rochester? Let’s create something amazing together.

Sound like the right fit? Check out the checklist below and if it sounds like you, hit "Apply Now" and let's chat. 

 

Your Day-to-Day (aka the Playbook) 

o Help Us Thrive: Amplify our sales and marketing team efforts, by helping us to grow our customer base and enhance our brand presence in the market and providing day-to-day business support. o Campaign Development: Work with the sales and marketing team to design and implement campaigns that drive sales and amplify brand awareness across various multimedia platforms.


o Market Research: Conduct in-depth market research to understand trends, customer preferences, and competitor activities to amplify our sales strategies.

o Unleash Your Potential: Dive headfirst into the exciting world of media sales, where every interaction is an opportunity to make a lasting impression!


o Collaborate and Grow: Work closely with our focused media sales teams and other departments. Ensuring everyone is on the same page creates a cohesive approach to sales marketing, which is super important for overall success. Connect with internal and external clients, building relationships to understand their needs to provide support. Together, we'll amplify our impact and achieve remarkable results!


o Stay Ahead of the Curve: Keep your finger on the pulse of industry trends and competitive strategies to ensure we're always a step ahead in the marketplace.


What We're Looking For 

o Proven Business Support Ability (or an Unstoppable Desire to Learn): Whether you're a seasoned business support specialist or just getting started, we value your drive, energy, and passion for achieving results.  


o Strong Communication Skills:  You're a natural at building relationships and communicating effectively. Analytical thinking is important, as you'll be interpreting data and helping with making informed decisions. Proficiency with digital tools and applications is a must.  


o A Passion for helping Others: You are committed to collaborate with various people and departments, so being adaptable and open to working with others will help you thrive in this role to understanding our teams' needs, providing top-notch administrative and business support, and making a difference.

Why Join AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions? / The Reasons You Should Hit "Apply Now" 

o Serious Work, Seriously Cool People: Be part of a dynamic team that values creativity, collaboration, and fun! We are all for work that is rewarding.


o Attractive Rewards: Enjoy competitive compensation that rewards your hard work. Our people love our benefits package.


o We Make a Real Difference (Not Just Talk About It): At AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions, we help local businesses thrive through advertising strategies that create tangible impacts. Our media sales team isn't just selling ads; they're the boots on the ground, making a real difference where it counts. (And yes, it feels pretty good.)


o Career Growth Opportunities: We believe in investing in you. That's why you'll have access to training, mentorship, and career advancement opportunities to help you thrive. job.title: Billing Manager (Red Seat Ventures)
job.description:
Red Seat Ventures partners with the world's top creators across multiple genres to grow and monetize their content — through advertising, subscription, live events, and beyond. We take a multiplatform approach spanning podcasting, video, FAST, and more, backed by our own proprietary tech stack including Supercast (subscription) and Speakeasy (hosting, distribution, and monetization).

Named after Ted Williams' longest home run at Fenway Park, RSV was built with a simple mandate: swing for the fences. Today, we're the fastest-growing creator network, backed by Tubi Media Group and Fox Corporation.

POSITION OVERVIEW

Red Seat Ventures, a FOX Corporation company, is seeking a detail-oriented and highly collaborative Manager, Billing to support our Finance and Ad Sales organization. This role will manage billing-related workflows and support the broader end-to-end sales process, partnering closely with Account Executives, agencies, Finance, Operations, Traffic, and clients to ensure accurate invoicing, revenue integrity, and strong client relationships across platforms.

The Manager will bring prior experience in media billing, invoicing, advertising operations, or a related function and will help ensure that billing processes are accurate, timely, and continuously improving.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Maintain  the end-to-end sales and billing process by understanding and utilizing sales systems, tools, and procedures.
  • Partner with Sales, Operations, Traffic, Finance, and external customers to investigate invoice discrepancies, resolve issues, and support efficient billing processes.
  • Review campaign reports and airchecks to verify delivery against contracted IOs
  • Maintain and improve billing process documentation and standard operating procedures.
  • Identify trends, recurring issues, and process improvement opportunities that enhance billing accuracy, cash application efficiency, reporting, and internal controls.
  • Work closely with Revenue Operations and Accounting to review and advise on monthly customer invoice revisions and route for approvals as needed
  • Review all IOs to ensure alignment with approved media plans, pricing, and billing terms.
  • Submit, track, and resolve special billing requests.
  • Respond to Account Executive requests related to billing details.
  • Coordinate with internal finance and traffic teams, and agency personnel to ensure timely and accurate billing.
  • Work closely with client and agency contacts to address billing inquiries, manage expectations, and maintain strong relationships

ABOUT YOU

  • 4-6+ years of experience in media, advertising, billing, or sales operations and experience with billing discrepancy handling.
  • Bachelor’s degree preferred.
  • Experience with STBS, WideOrbit, Salesforce, Workday or similar ad sales/billing systems is a plus.
  • Experience using AI tools to improve efficiency, reporting, documentation and workflow automation preferred.
  • Strong analytical skills with exceptional attention to detail.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a deadline-driven environment.
  • Solutions-oriented, customer-service mindset with a focus on accuracy and revenue support.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong interpersonal skills; collaborative team player.
  • Proficiency in Google Suite and Microsoft Office

NBCUniversal is seeking a Lead Material Artist (World/Props) to define and drive world material systems for an ambitious interactive open-world experience. This role is responsible for ensuring that environment and prop materials achieve a high level of visual quality, consistency, and scalability across large and diverse environments, from high-end platforms to mobile. 

The Lead Material Artist (World/Props) will work closely with the Associate Art Director – City Environment, Technical Art, and cross-disciplinary teams to ensure materials are fully integrated within environment pipelines and rendering systems. The role involves leading and managing a team while defining scalable approaches for surfaces, tiling, modular shaders, and material libraries supporting production at multiple performance targets. 

Responsibilities 

  • Translate Art Direction into high-end world and prop materials that meet visual and technical requirements. 

  • Lead and manage the world material team, ensuring consistency and quality across assets. 

  • Define, maintain, and evolve scalable material pipelines, workflows, and best practices. 

  • Create and oversee surface materials, tiling systems, and modular shader approaches. 

  • Ensure consistency and scalability across environments, props, and large-scale worlds from high-end to mobile targets. 

  • Collaborate closely with Environment, Tech Art, and Lighting teams for proper integration. 

  • Ensure correct implementation within rendering, shading, and runtime systems. 

  • Act as a bridge between art, technical art, and pipeline development teams. 

RÉSUMÉ DU POSTE

NBCUniversal est à la recherche d’un ou d’une Artiste des matériaux Lead (Environnements/Accessoires) pour définir et piloter les systèmes de matériaux d’environnement dans le cadre d’une ambitieuse expérience interactive en monde ouvert. Ce poste est responsable de veiller à ce que les matériaux d’environnements et d’accessoires atteignent un niveau élevé de qualité visuelle, de cohérence et d’évolutivité dans des environnements vastes et diversifiés, des plateformes haut de gamme jusqu’aux appareils mobiles.

La personne titulaire du poste travaillera en étroite collaboration avec la personne associée à la direction artistique, Environnement urbain, l’équipe d’Art technique et des équipes multidisciplinaires afin de garantir l’intégration complète des matériaux aux pipelines d’environnement et aux systèmes de rendu. Le poste implique de diriger et gérer une équipe tout en définissant des approches évolutives pour les surfaces, les systèmes de textures répétitives (tiling), les shaders modulaires et les bibliothèques de matériaux soutenant la production pour plusieurs cibles de performance.

RESPONSABILITÉS

  • Traduire la direction artistique en matériaux d’environnements et d’accessoires haut de gamme répondant aux exigences visuelles et techniques.
  • Diriger et gérer l’équipe responsable des matériaux d’environnement afin d’assurer la cohérence et la qualité des actifs.
  • Définir, maintenir et faire évoluer des pipelines de matériaux évolutifs, des flux de travail et des meilleures pratiques.
  • Créer et superviser les matériaux de surface, les systèmes de textures répétitives (tiling) et les approches de shaders modulaires.
  • Assurer la cohérence et l’évolutivité des matériaux à travers les environnements, les accessoires et les mondes à grande échelle, des plateformes haut de gamme jusqu’aux appareils mobiles.
  • Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes Environnement, Art technique et Éclairage afin d’assurer une intégration adéquate.
  • Veiller à l’implantation correcte des matériaux dans les systèmes de rendu, d’ombrage et d’exécution.
  • Agir comme point de liaison entre les équipes artistiques, d’art technique et de développement des pipelines.

Basic Qualifications 

  • Extensive experience in AAA game development with a focus on environment material creation. 

  • Proven experience leading and managing a team of artists. 

  • Experience as a Lead on at least one shipped AAA title. 

  • Strong portfolio demonstrating high-quality world and prop materials. 

  • Strong understanding of PBR workflows, surface definition, and shader systems. 

  • Experience with real-time pipelines and multi-platform performance constraints. 

  • Experience working with modern game engines such as Unreal Engine. 

  • Excellent communication, leadership, and collaboration skills.

Role Overview 

The SVP, Head of Studio Data & Insights leads Universal Entertainment's data strategy, analytics and AI insights functions in Los Angeles. Reporting to the EVP, the role owns the teams - their people, priorities, standards and delivery - and provides the sustained executive presence and stakeholder leadership that drives adoption of the function's agenda within the rhythms of the studio. 

Mission 

Over the past six years, the data function has built a substantial insights platform and analytical capability; this role will embed these capabilities in how the studio makes decisions throughout the content lifecycle, and will lead and develop the LA organization that delivers them.  

Success in this role requires a leader who shapes strategy with a one-company mindset, inspires transformation and innovation, drives execution excellence, and builds inclusive, empowered teams that can adapt through change while modelling NBCUniversal’s values. 

Core Responsibilities 

  • Act as the EVP's senior partner in-region, operating with delegated authority within an agreed decision framework and serving as the function's voice in executive, fast-moving, and cross-functional forums where in-region presence and judgement are required. 
  • Provide leadership and direction for the Los Angeles-based data strategy and analytics organization, including teams focused on insights, analytics, and AI-enabled decision support. Partner closely with the LA-based SVPs and their teams to align priorities, support delivery across the portfolio, shape the operating plan, and foster a high standard of work and impact across the region. 
  • Identify, develop, and empower talent across the leadership bench. Raise the bar through hiring, coaching, and succession planning; build collaborative and inclusive teams; grow senior leaders who can own their areas independently; and establish clear rules on which decisions genuinely need escalation. 
  • Lead and deepen the function's senior stakeholder relationships across UE's departments, owning the strategic agenda, the value narrative, and the forward asks for each. This includes establishing a consistent rhythm of engagement with department leadership — from quarterly strategic reviews to proactive intelligence — so that each senior partner has a clear, current view of the value being delivered and the opportunities ahead. 
  • Represent the Los Angeles’ studio’s requirements into the global data & analytics platform roadmap. Work with the EVP and the UK-based data platform team to translate stakeholder needs into prioritised input on analytics platforms and the underlying data and AI capability — qualifying genuine capability gaps, making the case for what the studio needs, and setting clear expectations with stakeholders on what the platform delivers and when. 
  • Partner closely with Strategy and Research teams as the function's nearest neighbours, ensuring data, analytics and AI insight is combined with strategic and audience research rather than delivered in parallel — presenting a single, coherent evidence base to decision-makers and jointly shaping the questions worth answering. 
  • Drive adoption and embedding of central insights platforms and AI-enabled analyses across creative development, greenlight, marketing, and distribution for Universal Entertainment's Film and TV divisions. The emphasis is evangelism, mandate-building, and integration into existing decision processes and systems — and success is measured in how deeply the capability becomes part of how departments work. 
  • Own the evidence of impact. Establish how the function's contribution is tracked and articulated — where insight changed a decision, and what it was worth — and carry that case to UE and NBCU leadership, so the mandate is renewed on demonstrated value rather than goodwill. 
  • Orchestrate across the function's teams in and outside the region, convening workstreams into strategically aligned and coherent outputs, and ensuring stakeholders experience the function as a single, joined-up partner rather than a collection of individual projects. 
  • Drive and maintain strategic partnerships across NBCU with a one-company mindset, identifying opportunities for data and insights sharing, supporting central initiatives focused on growth and innovation. 
  • BA/BS required, MBA or JD preferred  
  • Forward-thinking, strategic, tactical and detail-oriented; proven ability to work across an organization at all levels with technical, creative, and executive team members   
  • Ability to work with confidential and sensitive information in a discrete manner   
  • Superior analytical, presentation and communication skills – written and verbal   
  • Ability to identify key priorities and execute on them   

Desired Characteristics 

  • A proven senior operator from a studio, streamer, network, or adjacent entertainment technology environment, with a demonstrated record of selling, embedding, and scaling data and analytics capabilities within creative, marketing, or distribution organizations — someone who has won adoption and mandate, not only delivered analysis.  
  • A track record of leading multidisciplinary data and analytics teams at scale — hiring and raising the bar, developing senior leaders who operate independently, and running a delivery organization against competing priorities in a large, matrixed environment. 
  • Established, trusting senior-level relationships with C-suite entertainment executives, with the presence and judgement to hold senior relationships independently and advance an agenda as their own, while operating as part of a tightly aligned leadership team.  
  • Sufficient technical and analytical fluency to represent the capability with honesty and precision — able to engage substantively on what the data teams can and cannot do. 
  • A robust understanding of how film and television studios operate across the content lifecycle — creative development, production, marketing, and distribution — and of where data and analytics genuinely change decisions within it.  
  • A values-led culture carrier as much as an operator: self-aware, empathetic, curious, and open-minded; someone who models and reinforces the team’s values — candour, collaboration, inclusion, curiosity, and pride in the craft — while empowering others to perform and setting the leadership standard expected across NBCUniversal. 
  • Comfortable leading in a matrixed, fast-moving environment through complexity, ambiguity, and industry change with the ability to stay decisive and solutions-focused while inspiring innovation, running experiments and pilots, and turning open questions into evidence rather than waiting for the picture to settle.

job.description:
Storytelling is, and will always be, the heart of what we do at Skydance.
Our vision is to build a thriving entertainment ecosystem where stories and worlds are imagined, brought to life and experienced. We create for every age and audience, anchored by the strength of our content and experiences and the depth of our connection with fans. We are creator-first, audience-focused, tech-forward, globally scaled.

 

Here, you’ll work with talented teams that move fast, think boldly and collaborate with purpose to deliver results. We aim high, champion the best ideas and win together, earning the trust of our employees, creators, partners and audiences every day.

 

If you’re energized by the opportunity to help build the next-generation global media and entertainment company powered by creativity and technology, we’d be thrilled to welcome you aboard. LET’S GO!

 

 

 

Overview:
CBS Sports is seeking a skilled, creative and highly organized Senior Editor to lead key aspects of its NFL coverage across CBSSports.com and CBS Sports platforms.The Senior Editor will play a central leadership role within the NFL editorial team, helping set the coverage strategy and oversee its execution across breaking news, live games, analysis, features, rankings, previews, reactions and enterprise storytelling. This role requires more than strong editing skills: We are looking for an ambitious editorial leader who can establish a clear vision, generate distinctive coverage ideas, manage and develop writers, and bring structure and accountability to a fast-moving newsroom operation. The NFL Draft will receive special attention in this role.
The ideal candidate has exceptional news judgment, deep NFL knowledge and a proven ability to make confident editorial decisions under pressure. This person should be equally comfortable directing coverage during a major breaking-news event, developing an ambitious long-term editorial franchise and coaching an individual writer toward stronger work. The Senior Editor will directly manage a team of writers, with responsibility for setting expectations, assigning coverage, providing regular feedback and supporting each employee’s professional development. They will also help establish team priorities, evaluate performance and foster a collaborative, creative and accountable culture. This position is based in New York and requires schedule flexibility, including nights, weekends and holidays as NFL games, news cycles and editorial needs warrant.


Responsibilities:
• Help define and execute the overall editorial strategy for CBS Sports’ NFL coverage across daily, seasonal and long-term priorities
• Directly manage, mentor and develop a team of writers, setting clear expectations and providing consistent editorial and performance feedback
• Lead regular one-on-one meetings, contribute to formal performance evaluations and create development plans that help employees grow
• Hold writers accountable for productivity, quality, collaboration, audience performance and established editorial standard
• Establish clear daily and long-term coverage priorities, delegate assignments appropriately and ensure deadlines and deliverables are met
• Generate and develop original coverage ideas, franchises and enterprise projects that distinguish CBS Sports in a competitive NFL media landscape
• Assign and edit breaking news, analysis, features, rankings, previews, reactions and other stories that meet CBS Sports’ editorial, legal and ethical standards
• Lead coverage surrounding NFL games, trades, injuries, coaching changes, free agency, the NFL Draft and other major league events
• Make decisive editorial calls during breaking news, live games and other high-volume coverage periods
• Work closely with writers to strengthen reporting, sharpen analysis, improve story structure and develop more compelling headlines and presentation
• Evaluate the strengths, opportunities and workloads of individual team members and deploy staff strategically across the coverage operation
• Identify gaps in coverage or team capabilities and recommend solutions, including new assignments, developmental opportunities and potential staffing needs
• Create efficient workflows and communication systems that keep writers aligned and the broader NFL operation organized
• Use audience insights, SEO principles and performance data to evaluate coverage, identify opportunities and inform future editorial decisions
• Coordinate with leaders across fantasy, betting, social, video, newsletters, programming and other editorial teams to develop cohesive, multiplatform coverage plans
• Balance immediate audience opportunities with original work designed to build authority and long-term loyalty for CBS Sports
• Represent the NFL team in broader editorial planning conversations and communicate priorities clearly to senior newsroom leadership
• Foster an environment that values creativity, urgency, accuracy, collaboration and continuous improvement

Basic Qualifications
• At least three years of professional experience in a digital editorial or newsroom environment
• Meaningful experience directly managing writers or editors, including setting goals, delivering feedback and evaluating performance
• A demonstrated record of leading editorial coverage and making high-level decisions during major news or live-event windows
• Exceptional editorial judgment and the ability to prioritize coverage in a fast-moving, high-pressure environment
• A proven ability to generate original ideas and turn them into successful stories, franchises or multiplatform coverage plans
• Excellent editing, headline-writing and story-packaging skills
• Strong organizational and operational skills, with the ability to manage people, deadlines and multiple concurrent workstreams
• Deep knowledge of the NFL, its teams and players, and the major issues and trends shaping the league
• A comprehensive understanding of the NFL calendar and news cycle, including games, roster movement, injuries, transactions, coaching changes, free agency and the NFL Draft
• Experience using SEO, audience analytics and other acquisition and engagement tools to inform editorial strategy
• Strong leadership, communication and relationship-management skills
• An undergraduate degree, preferably in journalism, communications or a related field
• Ability to work from New York
• Schedule flexibility, including nights, weekends and holidays as games, news developments and editorial shifts warrant


Additional Qualifications:
• A track record of improving employee performance and helping writers produce more ambitious, distinctive work
• Experience leading a team through organizational changes, evolving priorities or demanding coverage periods
• Experience developing major editorial franchises, special packages or enterprise projects
• Demonstrated success collaborating across editorial departments and platforms
• Familiarity with NFL Draft, fantasy football, sports betting, social media and emerging audience trends
• Experience working with content-management, analytics and editorial-planning systems
• Working knowledge of Photoshop or similar visual-editing tools


CBS Sports, a year-round leader in cross-platform sports coverage, broadcasts a portfolio of events on the CBS Television Network, including THE NFL ON CBS; college football, including the Big Ten ON CBS; college basketball, including the NCAA Division I Men's Basketball Championship; golf, including The Masters®, PGA Championship and PGA TOUR; soccer, including the UEFA Champions League and NWSL; and CBS SPORTS SPECTACULAR. 

In addition, the division includes CBS SPORTS NETWORK, the 24-hour cable home of CBS Sports which televises live sports programming throughout the year, including college football and basketball games, UEFA Champions League and Europa League action, Italy's Serie A matches, Concacaf national team competitions, as well as a full slate of original programming and studio coverage. 

CBS Sports also delivers an extensive lineup of global soccer coverage on Paramount+, including every UEFA club competition match, all Serie A matches as well as Concacaf national team competitions, and produces INSIDE THE NFL for Paramount+. CBS Sports Digital's multi-platform offerings include CBSSports.com and the CBS Sports apps for mobile and connected TV devices; the 24/7 streaming sports news network CBS Sports HQ; 247Sports; MaxPreps; CBS Sports fantasy games; and SportsLine.

job.description:
#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?


We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, we’ve got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is… YOU!
