job.description:
FOX is seeking a Senior Network Engineer to join our Fox Network Engineering and Architecture team in Los Angeles, supporting high-profile live sports productions across FOX Sports.  As a member of the team, you will collaborate closely with FOX Sports’ Engineering and Field Operations teams, designing, implementing, monitoring, and troubleshooting network transmission systems that deliver mission-critical video, audio, and data signals from venues to broadcast and digital platforms.

The ideal candidate brings expertise in networking and broadcast transmission technologies, a strong operational mindset, and the ability to perform under the demands of live event production. This is a hands-on, individual contributor role operating in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment aligned with live sports schedules, requiring flexibility for nights, weekends, and major events.

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Architect, deploy, and maintain transmission paths for live sports events, including fiber, satellite, IP-based transport (SMPTE ST 2110 / 2022), and bonded cellular solutions
  • Coordinate and manage contribution and distribution workflows between venues, broadcast centers, and cloud environments
  • Provide real-time operational support for live sports broadcasts, including rapid troubleshooting and escalation management
  • Collaborate with production, engineering, and third-party vendors to ensure seamless signal acquisition and delivery
  • Monitor network performance, signal integrity, latency, and redundancy across all transmission paths
  • Design and implement failover strategies and redundancy plans to ensure high availability during live events
  • Support integration of emerging technologies, including cloud-based workflows and remote production (REMI) models
  • Maintain documentation of transmission infrastructure, signal flows, and standard operating procedures
  • Participate in on-call rotation and provide support during nights, weekends, and major sporting events

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • 7+ years of experience in broadcast transmission, network engineering, or live production environments
  • Strong understanding of IP networking concepts, including BGP, OSPF, multicast (PIM, IGMP), QoS, VLANs, and STP
  • Familiarity with streaming and transport technologies, multicast distribution, and packetized video/audio workflows
  • Experience supporting or deploying systems using SMPTE ST 2110, SMPTE 2022, AES67, or Dante is a significant plus
  • Hands-on experience with network infrastructure (routers, switches, firewalls) in high-bandwidth environments
  • Proven ability to troubleshoot complex signal paths under time-sensitive conditions
  • Demonstrate ability to perform and analyze packet captures using tools like Wireshark or tcpdump.
  • Understanding of redundancy models, QoS, and network reliability principles
  • Knowledge and practical experience with Arista switches and EOS
  • Strong communication skills and ability to work cross-functionally with production and engineering teams

job.description:
JOB TITLE: Executive Producer of Investigations

Vibe: Driven, strategic, organized, and obsessed with high-impact journalism across every platform.

The Mission FOX6 Milwaukee is looking for a detail-oriented, creative, high-caliber journalist to lead our investigative team and our Contact 6 consumer advocacy unit. We need an Executive Producer who can manage major investigative projects, oversee our investigative podcast, and reimagine how deep-dive stories reach modern audiences on streaming, digital, and broadcast.

This isn't a role spent sitting in an office waiting for project updates. We need a hands-on leader who is in the middle of our daily news operation—working alongside reporters and producers every day to bring investigative thinking, public records digging, and relentless follow-up into our everyday coverage. You'll lead with curiosity, courage, accountability, and empathy while coaching journalists to move beyond traditional package formats, guiding the team through complex ethical calls, and lifting the investigative standards across the entire newsroom.

Clear communication is essential in this position. Beyond being organized, you must proactively connect employees across all departments so everyone clearly understands available elements, expectations, and deadlines needed to deliver a seamless, high-quality product. 

What You’ll Do

  • Lead and inspire seasoned investigative journalists to conceive, execute, and deliver multi-platform investigative projects and consumer advocacy coverage.
  • Work directly with daily news reporters and producers to bring an investigative lens, public records strategies, and deeper context into daily enterprise reporting.
  • Collaborate with news managers to build a high-trust newsroom culture through open communication and clear feedback.
  • Keep momentum going on major stories across all platforms.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor on complex journalistic ethics, legal vetting, public records requests, and investigative standards.
  • Work across departments to drive new strategies for distributing investigative work beyond packageable content.

What You Bring

  • Proven track record producing or managing investigative journalism, enterprise reporting, or long-form investigative units.
  • Sharp project management skills with the ability to juggle multiple initiatives, keep cross-department teams aligned, and keep long-term investigations on schedule while staying involved in daily newsroom needs.
  • Ability to coach journalists past standard TV package formats into dynamic visual storytelling built for modern audiences.
  • Clear strategy for distributing investigative work across streaming, digital video, podcast, and social media platforms.
  • Strong command of legal standards, FOIA/public records laws, libel law, and ethical newsgathering techniques.
  • Experience using modern newsroom production software, with the adaptability to quickly master our station's specific workflow tools.

You balance hands‑on development with mentorship, system ownership, and long‑term technical direction.

  • Lead the design and implementation of core Unreal Engine systems, frameworks, and engine‑level architecture.
  • Define and maintain engine standards for performance, stability, scalability, and maintainability within Unreal Engine.
  • Provide technical leadership and hands‑on development for complex engine features and cross‑cutting Unreal systems.
  • Collaborate with other engineering leads to ensure Unreal Engine systems support gameplay, tools, pipeline, and content workflows.
  • Mentor and support engine programmers through code reviews, technical guidance, and best‑practice Unreal development.

  • Support production by identifying technical risks, estimating scope, and planning Unreal Engine evolution across milestones.
  • Debug and resolve complex engine‑level issues involving multithreading, memory, platform integration, and Unreal system interactions.
  • Guide Unreal Engine upgrades, custom engine changes, and long‑term technology decisions.
  • Stay current with Unreal Engine advancements, engine architecture trends, and low‑level performance techniques.

Vous fournissez un leadership technique pour l’architecture moteur et les systèmes de bas niveau tout en collaborant étroitement avec les équipes Gameplay, Rendering, Tools, Pipeline et Production afin de garantir qu’Unreal Engine est étendu, optimisé et maintenu pour répondre aux besoins du projet. job.description:

NBCUniversal is one of the world's leading media and entertainment companies. We create world-class content, which we distribute across our portfolio of film, television, and streaming, and bring to life through our global theme park destinations, consumer products, and experiences. We own and operate leading entertainment and news brands, including NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo, and Peacock, our premium ad-supported streaming service. We produce and distribute premier filmed entertainment and programming through our powerhouse film and television studios, including Universal Pictures, DreamWorks Animation, and Focus Features, and the four global television studios under the Universal Studio Group banner, and operate industry-leading theme parks and experiences around the world through Universal Destinations & Experiences, including Universal Orlando Resort, home to Universal Epic Universe, and Universal Studios Hollywood. NBCUniversal is a subsidiary of Comcast Corporation. Visit www.nbcuniversal.com for more information.

Our impact is rooted in improving the communities where our employees, customers, and audiences live and work. We have a rich tradition of giving back and ensuring our employees have the opportunity to serve their communities. We champion an inclusive culture and strive to attract and develop a talented workforce to create and deliver a wide range of content reflecting our world.

We are seeking an ML Solutions Architect who brings broad software engineering expertise along with strong machine learning-adjacent experience. In this role, you will lead the high-level design of systems that integrate ML models into our broader product suite. You will act as a technical consultant, evaluating customer requirements and determining whether they can be addressed with off-the-shelf solutions or should be escalated as specialized research initiatives for our Deep Learning and Reinforcement Learning teams. 

This role is ideal for a systems-minded engineer who can translate product vision into scalable architecture, while balancing technical feasibility, performance, and maintainability. 

Nous sommes à la recherche d’un(e) architecte de solutions ML possédant une solide expertise générale en ingénierie logicielle ainsi qu’une bonne expérience connexe à l’apprentissage automatique. Dans ce rôle, vous serez responsable de la conception de haut niveau des systèmes qui intègrent les modèles ML à notre offre de produits. Vous agirez comme conseiller(ère) technique en évaluant les besoins des clients afin de déterminer s’ils peuvent être satisfaits à l’aide de solutions prêtes à l’emploi ou s’ils doivent être confiés à nos équipes spécialisées en apprentissage profond et en apprentissage par renforcement. 

Ce poste convient particulièrement à une personne ayant une vision systémique, capable de traduire une vision produit en une architecture évolutive, tout en conciliant faisabilité technique, performance et maintenabilité. 

Key Responsibilities 

  • System Integration & Coprocessing: Design and implement the software layers that allow ML models to interact with a real-time rendering engine. This includes managing data pre-processing and post-processing (coprocessing) to ensure high-performance execution. 

  • Technical Consulting: Evaluate incoming customer requirements to determine the optimal path forward. You will decide if a task can be solved using off-the-shelf tools or if it requires a deep-dive research project to be handed off to our Deep Learning or Reinforcement Learning engineers. 

  • Language-Agnostic Engineering: Build and maintain wrappers, APIs, and microservices that allow our ML stack to remain flexible and language-agnostic across different production environments. 

  • Cross-Functional Coordination: Act as the primary technical liaison between technical leadership, customers, and the core engineering team to spec out data and integration requirements. 

  • Modular Execution: Break down complex product visions into manageable architectural components, ensuring that ML components ship as part of a stable, scalable software product. 

Responsabilités principales 

  • Intégration de systèmes et coprocessing : Concevoir et mettre en œuvre les couches logicielles permettant aux modèles ML d’interagir avec un moteur de rendu en temps réel, y compris les composants de prétraitement et de post-traitement nécessaires à une exécution performante.  

  • Conseil technique : Évaluer les demandes clients et déterminer la meilleure approche à adopter, qu’il s’agisse d’outils disponibles sur le marché ou de projets de recherche spécialisés à confier aux équipes d’apprentissage profond ou d’apprentissage par renforcement.  

  • Ingénierie agnostique aux langages : Développer et maintenir des wrappers, API et microservices afin de garantir la flexibilité et l’interopérabilité de la pile ML dans différents environnements de production et langages de programmation.  

  • Collaboration interfonctionnelle : Agir comme principal point de contact technique entre la direction, les clients et les équipes d’ingénierie afin de définir les exigences d’intégration, de système et de données.  

  • Exécution modulaire : Décomposer des visions produit complexes en composantes architecturales claires afin de livrer des fonctionnalités ML au sein d’un produit logiciel stable et évolutif. 

Qualifications 

  • Education: Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field. 

  • Professional Experience: Proven experience as a Software Architect or Systems Engineer in a fast-paced environment. 

  • Industry Context: Prior experience in industries with complex multi-disciplinary teams such as robotics, smart grids, precision agriculture, game development, or aerospace. 

  • Technical Proficiency: 

  • Generalist Tooling: Fluency with Git, and the Unix shell, with a strong ability to work across multiple programming languages as needed (ideally including one or more of Python, C++, C#). 

  • Architectural Knowledge: Deep understanding of how to integrate ML models into production software (e.g., API design, message brokers, and containerization, compute and memory budgeting). 

  • ML Literacy: While you may not be training models daily, you must have enough ML-adjacent experience to understand model constraints, data requirements, and the "state of the art." 

  • Experience with fine-tuning and deploying models is a plus. 

  • Attributes: 

  • Strategic Decision-Making: Ability to perform "Build vs. Buy" analyses for ML components. 

  • Communication: Exceptional ability to translate high-level product vision into concrete engineering specs for both technical leadership and specialized engineers. 

  • Conscientiousness: High attention to detail regarding system stability and interoperability 

Qualifications 

  • Diplôme en informatique, en génie logiciel ou dans un domaine connexe.  

  • Expérience démontrée en tant qu’architecte logiciel, architecte de solutions ou ingénieur(e) système dans un environnement dynamique.  

  • Une expérience dans des secteurs multidisciplinaires tels que la robotique, les réseaux intelligents, l’agriculture de précision, le développement de jeux vidéo ou l’aérospatiale est fortement valorisée. 

  • Compétences techniques 

  • Outillage généraliste : Excellente maîtrise de Git et des environnements Unix, avec la capacité de travailler dans plusieurs langages de programmation selon les besoins, idéalement Python, C++ ou C#.  

  • Connaissances architecturales : Compréhension approfondie de l’intégration de modèles ML dans des logiciels de production, incluant la conception d’API, les courtiers de messages, la conteneurisation ainsi que la planification des ressources de calcul et de mémoire.  

  • Littératie ML : Expérience connexe suffisante en apprentissage automatique pour comprendre les contraintes des modèles, les besoins en données et l’état de l’art, même sans entraîner des modèles au quotidien.  

  • Atout : Une expérience en ajustement fin (fine-tuning) et en déploiement de modèles d’apprentissage automatique constitue un avantage important. 

  • Qualités recherchées 

  • Prise de décision stratégique : Capacité à réaliser des analyses pertinentes de type build vs. buy pour les composants et systèmes intégrant du ML.  

  • Communication : Excellente capacité à traduire une vision produit de haut niveau en spécifications d’ingénierie concrètes pour la direction et les équipes techniques spécialisées.  

  • Rigueur : Grande attention accordée à la stabilité des systèmes, à l’interopérabilité et à la maintenabilité à long terme.

  • Hybrid: This position currently has a hybrid schedule, which requires contributing from the office a minimum of four days per week. The Company reserves the right to change in-office requirements at any time.

NBCUniversal is seeking a Manager, Corporate Governance/Legal Affairs (Corporate Secretary) to support corporate governance, legal entity management, and compliance for its U.S. and Canadian subsidiaries.

This role sits within a high-impact Corporate Secretary team that serves as the central resource for legal entity formation, governance, and compliance across NBCUniversal’s global portfolio of businesses.

The ideal candidate will be a detail-oriented and collaborative professional who can manage a high volume of corporate governance activities, maintain data integrity across enterprise systems, and partner effectively with Legal, Tax, Finance, and external service providers.

This role is ideal for a strong corporate paralegal or governance professional looking to step into a broader, enterprise-facing position with meaningful ownership over legal entity operations and governance.

Here you can:

Corporate Governance & Secretarial Support

  • Provide corporate secretarial support for U.S. and Canadian entities, including:
    • Drafting secretary certificates and corporate certifications
    • Preparing written consents, resolutions, and governance documentation
  • Maintain corporate digital minute books, ensuring completeness and accuracy
  • Coordinate with outside counsel on governance matters relating to Canadian entities

Legal Entity Compliance & Filings

  • Prepare and file annual reports and other statutory filings to maintain entities in good standing
  • Track and manage compliance deadlines across a large portfolio of entities
  • Support regulatory filings and responses to governmental or compliance-related inquiries
  • Provide corporate support in connection with litigation, arbitration, and regulatory matters

Legal Entity Data & Systems

  • Manage and maintain the corporate legal entity database, the enterprise system of record for legal entity data
  • Ensure timely and accurate updates to ownership, governance, and structural data
  • Generate organizational charts and entity reports for internal stakeholders

Operations & Vendor Management

  • Oversee billing and invoicing for key corporate secretarial vendors in coordination with global counterparts

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Serve as a key resource to Legal and business teams on matters relating to:
    • Corporate governance
    • Legal entity structure
    • Execution of corporate actions
  • Support entity formations, restructurings, and dissolutions by coordinating required governance documentation
  • Assist with corporate documentation required by internal stakeholders and external regulators

Scope

  • Primary responsibility for NBCUniversal’s U.S. and Canadian legal entities
  • Works closely with global Corporate Secretary team members across Europe and other jurisdictions

Here you'll need:

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to own the CDP product domain within the Customer Experience Platform (CXP) Martech team. This is a high-ownership IC (Individual Contributor) role responsible for the Customer Data Platform (CDP) as a shared global platform: the identity and audience data layer that serves Peacock, SkyShowtime, and NOW.

You'll be the primary intake point for CDP-related requirements from MarTech local teams across all three propositions, own and prioritize the backlog, and drive delivery in close partnership with Engineering (platform instrumentation) and Decision Science (data pipelines and attributes). A core operating principle for this role: solutions must be designed globally first, scalable across all applications, not built for a single product.

In this role you will:
Stakeholder Intake & Prioritization

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for Peacock, SkyShowtime, and NOW MarTech and Marketing teams, owning all incoming CDP requests and proactively identifying data quality and data collection opportunities to scale our product customer lifecycle and marketing operation efforts.

  • Manage and prioritize the backlog, balancing urgency against platform impact and engineering capacity.
  • Keep documentation and roadmap status visible and current across all partners.

Platform Delivery & Cross-Functional Execution

  • Partner closely with Decision Science and Engineering teams to define business requirements for platform instrumentation (e.g., event schemas, platform events, and data capture), ensuring alignment with global standards and prioritizing delivery based on business needs.
  • Partner with Decision Science on pipeline requirements, new attribute builds, and feed delivery to make sure data flows correctly into downstream systems.
  • Own the coordination of delivery milestones, testing, and QA sign-off, acting as the connective tissue between marketing stakeholders and the technical teams who build and operate the platform.

What You Have

  • Ability to intake, synthesize, and prioritize requirements from multiple marketing stakeholders across competing products and timelines
  • A platform-first mindset — instinct to design solutions that are global and scalable across multiple products rather than solving for one at a time
  • Empathy for marketing and growth teams as your primary customers, with curiosity to uncover the underlying need behind every request
  • Strong business judgment to balance short-term delivery needs against longer-term platform health and scalability
  • Comfort operating in a matrixed environment, building alignment across engineering, data, and marketing stakeholders at various levels of seniority
  • Technical curiosity and fluency to engage meaningfully with engineering and data engineering teams without owning the platform directly
  • Flexibility to adapt quickly to shifting priorities across a global, multi-product organization
  • Self-motivation to manage multiple workstreams simultaneously with tight schedules
  • Enthusiasm to be positive, collaborative, and energetic in a fast-moving streaming environment
  • 5–8+ years of product management experience, with at least 3 years working within a CDP, data platform, or martech infrastructure environment in a requirements, product, or delivery coordination capacity
  • Working knowledge of one or more enterprise CDPs (mParticle, Segment, Adobe CJA, Tealium, or equivalent) sufficient to translate business needs into platform requirements and engage effectively with technical teams
  • Strong understanding of platform event schemas, identity resolution, audience segmentation, and data feed architecture
  • Proven ability to partner with engineering on instrumentation requirements and with data engineering teams on pipeline and attribute delivery
  • Familiarity with downstream activation tools (Braze, Branch, Adtech) and data warehouse environments (Snowflake) is a strong plus
  • Experience with Agile/SCRUM software development environments
  • Streaming, subscription, or B2C consumer product background preferred
  • BS/BA required; technical or data-adjacent background a plus
  • Must have the legal right to work in the United States

Hybrid: This position currently has a hybrid schedule, which requires contributing from the office a minimum of four days per week. The Company reserves the right to change in-office requirements at any time.

job.title: Executive Assistant, Marketing and Communications
job.description:
OVERVIEW

A thriving, mission-driven multimedia organization, NPR produces award-winning news, information, and music programming in partnership with hundreds of independent public radio stations across the nation. The NPR audience values information, creativity, curiosity, and social responsibility – and our employees do too. We are innovators and leaders in diverse fields, from journalism and digital media to IT and development. Every day, our employees and member stations touch the lives of millions worldwide. 

Across our organization, we’re building a workplace where collaboration is essential, diverse voices are heard, and inclusion is the key to our success. We are committed to doing the right thing in our journalism and in every role at NPR. This means that integrity, adherence to our ethical standards, and compliance with legal obligations are fundamental responsibilities for every employee at NPR.

Application Instructions

  • Application Deadline: Monday, October 26th, at 5:00 pm ET.
  • Submission Instructions: Please include a cover letter with your application. In your letter, detail a specific instance where you made a judgment call on behalf of your executive, including the circumstances and the ultimate outcome.

Intro to Position

The Executive Assistant, Marketing and Communications serves as the central operational backbone for senior leadership across NPR's Marketing and Communications divisions. In this role, you will provide high-level administrative partnership to departmental leaders, managing complex calendar logistics, coordinating cross-functional communications, and facilitating key stakeholder engagements across the NPR network.

Acting as a primary administrative liaison for the department, you will ensure seamless day-to-day operations while handling sensitive and confidential information with discretion, sound judgment, and precision.

Responsibilities

  • Manage complex, dynamic daily schedules and executive calendars, proactively resolving scheduling conflicts and aligning time allocations with division priorities.
  • Coordinate end-to-end travel arrangements and logistics for departmental leadership; assemble detailed itineraries and ensure timely reconciliation of expense reports and vendor invoices.
  • Prepare, organize, and proofread briefing materials, agendas, presentations, and background documentation for executive leadership meetings, NPR Board of Directors sessions, and Member station engagements.
  • Track and monitor division email correspondence and workflow queues; triage urgent inquiries, synthesize incoming requests, and route action items to appropriate team leads.
  • Orchestrate logistical planning for internal and external meetings, conferences, division retreats, and Network fly-ins, managing room reservations, audio/visual setup, and catering.
  • Record minutes, track deliverables, and maintain organized digital filing systems across Google Workspace and departmental directories.
  • Serve as the division's administrative point of contact, coordinating office supply inventory, facilities requests, and miscellaneous administrative questions.
  • Support departmental people operations, including scheduling onboarding sessions for new team members and assisting leadership with team retreats, culture initiatives and communications.

The above duties and responsibilities are not an exhaustive list of required responsibilities, duties and skills. Other duties may be assigned, and this job description can be modified at any time.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 3+ years of progressive administrative experience supporting senior-level leadership.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage complex scheduling, travel itineraries, and expense reporting with minimal supervision.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with proven proofreading accuracy and attention to detail.
  • Demonstrated track record of exercising strict confidentiality, discretion, and tact when handling sensitive leadership information.
  • Proven ability to organize, prioritize, and track multiple simultaneous administrative deliverables under firm deadlines.
  • Demonstrated commitment to supporting workplace diversity, equity, and inclusion initiatives. 

Preferred Qualifications

  • Professional experience supporting C-Suite executives.
  • Prior administrative experience within public media, journalism, broadcasting, or mission-driven nonprofit organizations.

Education Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and experience.

The employee will be required to be in the office at the Washington, D.C. location at least 2 days a week but is variable. The employee must also reside in an NPR-supported location based on the number of on-site days they choose.

Job Type

  • This is a full-time, non-exempt position.

Compensation

Hourly Rate: The U.S. based anticipated hourly rate for this opportunity is $36.06 - $38.46 per hour. The range displayed reflects the minimum and maximum hourly rate NPR expects to provide for new hires for the position across all US locations.

job.title: Machinist
job.description:
Job Description:



About the Team:

The Print Team supports the end-to-end lifecycle of Dow Jones’ print publications—including The Wall Street Journal, Barron’s, Investor’s Business Daily, and the New York Post.


Operating across ad intake, production workflows, plant operations, printing, packaging, single copy and amenity sales, Reprints and Licensing, and distribution; the team collaborates with internal cross-functional partners and external vendors, distributors, and the USPS to ensure quality, content freshness, safety, and cost efficiency from creation to final delivery.


About the Role

The Machinist/Mechanics provides competent and effective mechanic maintenance support to plant operations. The ability to perform work safely, meet the needs of operations, execute the maintenance program and comply with all safety codes is paramount. The Machinist/Mechanic must identify, troubleshoot and repair problems in mechanical systems that occur in production equipment. He/she must be able to run tests, isolate problems, remove/replace failed components, determine failure modes by studying worn components and perform other tasks as necessary. He/she also performs preventive maintenance and upgrades to mechanical systems.


 You Will:


  • Perform preventive maintenance on mechanical systems to include disassembly, cleaning, reassembly, and calibration. Acts on information obtained from operators in order to diagnose equipment problems.
  • Clean, lubricate, and adjust parts, equipment, and machinery. 
  • Disassemble machinery and equipment to remove parts and make repairs. Examine parts for defects such as breakage and excessive wear. Observe and test the operation of machinery and equipment in order to diagnose malfunctions, using voltmeters and other testing devices. Operate newly repaired machinery and equipment to verify the adequacy of repairs. Reassemble equipment after completion of inspections, testing, or repairs.
  • Repair and maintain the operating condition of industrial production machinery and equipment. 
  • Repair and replace broken or malfunctioning components of machinery and equipment.
  • Study blueprints and manufacturers' manuals to determine correct installation and operation of machinery.
  • Cut and weld metal to repair broken metal parts, fabricate new parts, and assemble new equipment. 
  • Test all repairs upon completion.
  • Record parts and materials used, and request new parts and materials as necessary.
  • Record repairs and maintenance performed. Sometimes repairs or modifications are performed when blueprints and manufacturers' specifications are unavailable or incomplete.
  • Knowledge of basic  mechanical, hydraulic, pneumatic, and electrical systems and safe machine  operation principles. Utilize safety and security practices and procedures following established rules and regulations and maintain a safe, clean, and secure work environment.
  • Communicate with management, mechanics, and equipment operators to advise them if there are any potential mechanical hazards. Execute the maintenance work schedule as provided by his/her supervisor. Proper execution of the work schedule will require strategic decisions to ensure the scheduled work will be completed within the period scheduled.
  • Keeps the Foreman informed of all issues which may affect the operational capability of the equipment.
  • Ensure the shop is maintained in a safe and orderly fashion.
  • Attend meetings and support continuous improvement initiatives. 
  • Maintain close contact with the Foreman, maintenance crew, the production supervisors and equipment operators. Keep the maintenance supervisor and/or manager properly informed on all abnormal or critical situations and seeks advice on matters outside of their knowledge or authority.
  • Perform other tasks and special assignments as requested by management.

You Have


  • High school degree or equivalent work experience. Some experience preferred. 
  • Experience as an industrial / commercial mechanic.
  • Ability to work under deadlines.
  • Willingness to work a rotating shift between 1st and 2nd shift with other team members. Some weekend work required.
  • Good math, mechanical, organizational, written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to stand for extended periods, bend, stoop & reach. Must be able to lift 35-pounds.
  • Welding experience.
  • Understand and follow all corporate and plant policies/practices. Keep accurate, useful and timely operational and maintenance records.  Work with the production manager to set equipment maintenance priorities. Must be professional, reliable & report to work on time.


Our Benefits


  • Comprehensive Healthcare Plans
  • Paid Time Off
  • Retirement Plans
  • Comprehensive Medical, Dental and Vision Insurance Plans
  • Education Benefits
  • Paid Maternity and Paternity Leave
  • Family Care Benefits
  • Commuter Transit Program

job.title: Information Security Analyst
job.description:
About ONErpm

ONErpm strives to establish its legacy as a global brand that makes an impact on the artistic community, the music business, and society as a whole. We are an inclusive company driven by innovation, music, and technology. We believe in mutual respect and recognize that different perspectives drive innovation, accelerate growth, and lead to more sustainable decisions and results.

If you join us, regardless of your location or position, we will support you in doing your best and reaching your full potential.

As a pioneering company, ONErpm has captured more than 20% of Brazil’s digital music market in less than 16 years. Today, we operate in Mexico, the United States, Colombia, Argentina, Peru, Chile, Jamaica, Spain, Nigeria, Vietnam, and many other countries.

As of May 2026, ONErpm has more than 46 offices across 32 countries, with a presence on nearly every continent.

Responsibilities

  • Security in Design: Integrate security requirements and perform threat modeling/project risk analyses in the early stages of system design and feature development (Security by Design)
  • Pipeline & Code Security (AppSec): Implement, operate, and maintain automated security tooling (SAST, DAST, SCA) in CI/CD pipelines; assist software engineers in remediating vulnerabilities using OWASP Top 10 guidelines and secure coding frameworks.
  • Cloud Security Posture: Evaluate, monitor, and improve the security posture of cloud infrastructure and technology environments based on recognized benchmarks such as CIS Controls and cloud security best practices.
  • Privacy & LGPD Compliance: Establish and manage operational workflows for data subject access requests (DSARs), maintain the continuous data mapping lifecycle, and evaluate privacy risks in new product features.
  • Penetration Testing Coordination: Coordinate regular external/internal pentesting procedures, including environment provisioning, scoping requirements between vendors and internal development teams, and managing remediation tracking.
  • Vendor & Third-Party Risk Management: Implement and oversee IT vendor security assessments to evaluate and mitigate the aggregate risks introduced by third-party tools, services, and partners.
  • Security Awareness & Culture: Plan and execute continuous security awareness programs, phishing simulations, and training sessions to build a proactive security mindset across the organization.
  • Incident Management & Root Cause Analysis: Monitor, respond to, and investigate information security and privacy incidents, analyzing root causes and implementing preventative controls.
  • Due Diligence & Audit Response: Conduct and respond to security and privacy due diligence assessments from customers, vendors, and regulatory auditors
  • Metrics & Indicators: Develop, track, and report Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) and Key Risk Indicators (KRIs) for Information Security and Privacy maturit
  • Compliance & Regulations: Ensure adherence to internal company policies, compliance regulations, industry standards, and workplace health and safety rules pertinent to the position.

Requirements

  • Higher Degree (Bachelor’s) in Information Security, Computer Science, Software Engineering, Systems Analysis, or related technology fields.
  • Desirable Certifications: CompTIA Security+, AWS/Azure Security Specialty, Certified AppSec Practitioner (CAP), EXIN Privacy & Data Protection (LGPD/GDPR), or ISO 27001 Lead Implementer/Auditor.
  • Proficiency in SAST, DAST, and SCA tools and their integration into CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Azure DevOps).
  • Solid understanding of the OWASP Top 10, CIS Controls, and cloud security architecture (AWS, GCP, or Azure).
  • In-depth knowledge of the General Data Protection Law (LGPD), data mapping, and DSAR management workflows.
  • Familiarity with third-party risk management (TPRM) frameworks and pentest scoping/vendor management.
  • Solid fundamentals in networking, protocols, identity and access management (IAM), and technology infrastructure.

Benefits

  • Health and Dental Insurance

  • Meal Allowance (Groceries)

  • Meal Allowance (Restaurants)

  • Life Insurance

  • TotalPass

  • Birthday Day Off

You will have a track record of creative problem solving and previous experience of working multiple busy digital marketing campaigns within a label, across a broad range of artists. You will primarily work alongside the Marketing and Audience Development Teams, artists, and artist managers, as well as, collaborating with various internal teams at Sony.

This is an exciting opportunity to impact how our artists are discovered and how they engage with fans around the world.

RCA UK is a flagship label for Sony Music with a roster that includes Bring Me The Horizon, Myles Smith, Tems and Jade, joining US superstars including Beyonce, Steve Lacey and SZA. Since 93’ is a sub-division of RCA.

We’re looking for people who want to do great things, make an impact, and aren’t afraid to roll their sleeves up and get stuck in.

STRATEGY & PROJECT MANAGEMENT

  • Leverage data to create tailored campaign strategies for artists' key platforms, ensuring engaging and consistent online communications for an 'always on' audience experience.

  • Deliver market-leading and creative campaigns from concept to execution across all areas of business to continually meet strategic goals.
  • Pitch & execute digital partner opportunities for artists.

job.description:
The mission of The New York Times is to seek the truth and help people understand the world. That means independent journalism is at the heart of all we do as a company. It’s why we have a world-renowned newsroom that sends journalists to report on the ground from nearly 160 countries. It’s why we focus deeply on how our readers will experience our journalism, from print to audio to a world-class digital and app destination. And it’s why our business strategy centers on making journalism so good that it’s worth paying for. 

About the Role

The New York Times advertising department's mission is to create work that helps brands make their mark in the world, and our canvas is the full breadth of The New York Times and its associated media platforms, including digital, mobile, audio, print, events and more.

The Director, Strategy will bring experience working cross-category and possess a passion for uncovering how different categories intersect with media and culture to spark inspiring creative ways-in and ideas. Strategy is a team sport, and you will be an expert collaborator with experience leading versatile teams, including creative, program management, sales, and planning, toward a common goal. Success within the advertising strategy team requires the ability to uncover human and cultural truths across multiple categories like finance, media, entertainment, healthcare, and consumer goods as well as a passion for big ideas expressed through media, a love of The New York Times, and a high standard for creating visual presentations.

  • Research, Insights, and Creative Brief Development: You are an expert at using proprietary tools, third-party resources and desk research to uncover meaningful insights, human truths and whitespace opportunities that will lead to a compelling way in for creative and media.

Although you will not be responsible for writing media plans, you are comfortable and expert in guiding internal teams as well as clients in making smart and creative media choices.
  • Client Deliverable Development: You are experienced in owning and creating client-ready visual proposals that are polished and inspiring.
  • Category Fluency: You are constantly learning and reading about macro trends in business and culture.

  • Manage 3-6 strategists across 2-3 Categories
  • Co-lead resourcing across the Strategy Team
  • Consult with Sales leadership to improve processes, practices and strategic deliverables
  • Engage with teams across the Ad Department to guide cross-functional solutions and innovations
  • Use research and data to articulate and support sales stories
  • Author and deliver creative briefs on sometimes-tight turnarounds
  • Create and guide others in the creation of powerful proposals with effective storytelling that responds to client needs and telegraphs the value of NYT media offerings
  • Develop a broad understanding of all New York Times assets
  • Lead and project manage across relevant departments (including Sales, Ad Product, T Brand Studio, Ad Operations, Research, Marketing, Events) to create integrated programs for clients
  • Develop, articulate and share innovative programs, partnerships, innovations and opportunities
  • Research, write, and guide others in the creation of content strategy briefs
  • Attend key sales calls to pitch advertising and media ideas to mid/senior-level executives
  • Manage internal senior team members, communicating proposal and program status to management
  • Educate and keep the Strategy team/department abreast of trends and what opportunities or challenges they might present for our business
  • Demonstrate support and understanding of our value of journalistic independence and a strong commitment to our mission to seek the truth and help people understand the world.
  • You will report to the Executive Strategy Director

  • 12+ years of cross-platform Advertising experience in brand and media strategy
  • Interest in managing high-volume categories
  • Experience working on RFPs
  • Experience working in collaborative sales and marketing processes, including working with sales teams or in a sales environment
  • An understanding of the current social, branded content, digital, audio and mobile media landscapes

job.title: Senior Counsel, Commercial
job.description:
The big picture: Axios is a digital media company focused on breaking news and invaluable insights across business, technology, politics, and media. We are hiring a Senior Counsel, Commercial to join our collaborative legal team and serve as a key legal partner to our revenue, product, and operations teams. 

Why it matters: This is a high-visibility, broad-scope role. You will independently counsel senior business leaders, own significant commercial matters end-to-end, and help shape practical solutions as Axios develops new products, partnerships, and growth opportunities.

Go deeper: We are looking for a pragmatic, self-directed attorney with strong commercial judgment who will: 

  • Commercial Transactions & Workflow
    • Draft, review, and negotiate a variety of commercial agreements, including advertising sales, sponsorships, events, customer subscriptions, content licensing, vendor, technology, and strategic agreements.
    • Own commercial legal intake and workflow: prioritize and delegate work, improve playbooks and templates, and help implement self-service tools and automation to handle volume efficiently.
  • Commercial, Product, Sales & Marketing Counseling
    • Provide practical, business-focused advice that balances legal risk with commercial objectives and helps teams reach workable solutions.
    • Advise on new products and features, sales and marketing initiatives, advertising and sponsorships, new revenue opportunities, and day-to-day business matters.
    • Identify legal implications across privacy, IP, regulatory, and operational issues.
    • Provide practical privacy and data-use counseling, including DPAs, privacy policy updates, and data-use questions, and exercise judgment about when specialized support is warranted.
    • Handle routine commercial disputes and other business issues and escalate significant or high-risk matters thoughtfully.
  • Legal Team Leadership
    • Scope and manage outside counsel efficiently and translate legal advice into clear, actionable recommendations for business leaders.
    • Stay current on legal developments relevant to digital media and technology 
    • Contribute to cross-functional and Legal team initiatives as needed. 

Worthy of your time: Ideal candidates will embody an entrepreneurial spirit and passion for Axios’ mission. This position requires the following:

  • 6+ years of relevant legal experience, including significant in-house commercial experience; law firm experience a plus.
  • Experience advising on product, sales, marketing, advertising, sponsorships, and digital media matters; digital media experience strongly preferred.
  • Strong contract drafting and negotiation skills, with a track record of independently leading sophisticated commercial transactions.
  • Broad issue-spotting skills and experience to identify and advise on legal and business risks beyond the contract.
  • Pragmatic risk assessment that balances legal protection with business agility and avoids over-lawyering.
  • Proven ability to operate independently, own matters end-to-end, and advise senior business leaders with sound judgment and confidence.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills and a collaborative, solution-oriented approach.
  • Ability to move quickly, prioritize competing demands, and communicate clearly and succinctly.
  • AI aptitude and comfort using AI-enabled tools and workflows to work more effectively.

We are backed by leading investors including Bond Capital, Menlo Ventures, Lightspeed Venture Partners, IVP, Forerunner, Union Square Ventures, Alkeon, Quiet, Matrix Partners, Schroders Capital and, NVentures (venture arm of NVIDIA). About the Role We’re looking for a Senior or Staff Infrastructure Security Engineer to secure the cloud that runs Suno. That covers our Kubernetes clusters, the GPU compute behind our AI workloads, and the network that connects them. You’ll report to our Security Lead, work closely with Platform Engineering, and partner with AppSec engineers and our Detection & Response team as they grow alongside you. This is a building job. You’ll write threat models, set hardened defaults, and create paved paths that engineers actually want to use. Some of the work is familiar cloud security. Some of it, like securing AI infrastructure, is new for everyone. Check out the Suno version of this role here: https://suno.com/s/Utj2JDlLzR4Dvs3p What You'll Do Build Suno’s infrastructure threat model across cloud, Kubernetes, GPU compute platforms, and networking, and use it with the Security Lead to decide where to focus first. Harden our EKS clusters, GPU compute environments, and infrastructure-as-code pipeline, including who can change infrastructure and how. Design paved paths and secure defaults, such as trusted base images, network segmentation, and scoped access, and ship the fixes yourself rather than handing off a list of findings. Define the infrastructure detections and alerts we need beyond out-of-the-box tooling, working with Detection & Response, and be the expert they call when those alerts fire. Partner with Platform Engineering and the broader engineering org to land changes in a fast-moving environment, and help shape a growing Security team. Protect the systems that let millions of people make music, so creative fulfillment can be part of everyone’s day. What You'll Need Must-Haves At least 7 years of experience in infrastructure security or adjacent fields. An engineering background building secure-by-default tooling and paved paths, not primarily running scans and reporting findings. Hands-on depth in cloud-native security (AWS preferred; GCP or Azure are fine), plus Kubernetes and container security, including image provenance and software supply chain security, or the ability to learn them quickly. Strong enough coding skills to build your own tooling and implement fixes without needing another engineer to carry them out. End-to-end ownership of security projects, with the comfort to build in a greenfield environment where structure is still taking shape. A collaborative working style and genuine interest in learning how to secure AI infrastructure. Nice-to-Haves Experience rolling out a cloud security posture management (CSPM) platform. Experience securing AI or GPU compute platforms, or serverless container environments. Experience building or maintaining the pipeline other engineers use to deploy infrastructure-as-code, such as plan/apply approvals, state management, or policy checks. job.title: US Legal Correspondent
job.description:
About us

The Financial Times is one of the world’s leading news organisations, globally recognised for its authority, integrity and accuracy, with a mission to deliver quality information and services worldwide.

At the FT, curiosity thrives and ambitious thinking is rewarded. Here, you’re given the chance to reach millions, create work that matters and deliver impartial journalism in a polarised world.

In our warm, collaborative culture, you’ll connect with a diverse community of experts who support your growth, career aspirations and wellbeing.

Your future at the FT will be filled with opportunities that challenge and inspire you. With no fixed path, you’ll discover new skills and forge a career that can take you anywhere.

Build a newsworthy career at the FT.

 

The role

The Financial Times is looking for an experienced journalist to join the New York bureau to cover law and the legal industry.

The beat has essentially two interlocking halves, one focusing on white collar crime and financial enforcement, and the other centered on the powerful law firms and larger-than-life characters operating in the world’s largest legal market.

The first half is rooted in the federal prosecutor’s offices in New York’s Southern and Eastern Districts, and the enforcement arms of the Securities and Exchange Commission and Commodity Futures Trading Commission. That means covering some of the US’s highest profile white collar cases – past examples include the investigations into First Brands’ Patrick James, Archegos’ Bill Hwang and FTX’s Sam Bankman-Fried. 

You will also collaborate directly with the US Justice correspondent and corporate beat reporters to cover top legal cases elsewhere in the country. That requires proficiency in developing relationships with both defence attorneys and prosecutors in New York and beyond.

Coverage of the legal industry means breaking news and writing about the top American lawyers and law firms who act as powerbrokers across business, finance and politics. Lawyers pop up as key donors and advisers on both sides of the political aisle and litigation – or the threat of it – is the constant companion of corporate activity, government regulation and the electoral process. 

The FT has been expanding its footprint in the US professional services sector at a time of significant change that is challenging the business models of the big law firms. Consolidation is accelerating, as are high-profile poaching raids. Private equity is eyeing a way into the profession. AI threatens to upend both training and billing norms, and some venerable firms are struggling while upstarts expand into new practice areas

 

Key responsibilities

  • Cover federal and New York authorities responsible for investigating and prosecuting financial and corporate malfeasance
  • Develop sources in the criminal defence bar and state and federal courts to break stories in core FT areas, including money laundering, insider trading and financial fraud
  • Work closely with Washington, London and corporate correspondents while cooperating within a distributed team to pursue big cases
  • Pick out unique angles on New York law firms and prominent lawyers for compelling reads on the legal community
  • Weekend shifts are required as part of the team rota

 

Who we are looking for

You will have a proven track record of breaking stories on news-heavy beats, and shown an ability to work well within a team. You will be expected to quickly parse complex legal documents and translate legal jargon to deliver clean copy and compelling narratives. Familiarity with the intricacies of international finance is preferred, given the frequently complicated cases brought by federal authorities.  

 

Please submit your application by the end of the day, Wednesday 28th October 2026

 

Salary range

A reasonable estimate of the salary range for this role is $90,000-$135,000p.a. To ensure pay fairness, the successful candidate will be offered a salary within the estimated salary range based on a number of considerations including but not limited to: skill set; experience and training; certifications; and other business and organisational needs.

This position is open to a broad pool of candidates, both internal and external. Where an external candidate is hired or a successful internal candidate is appointed to the role on terms covered by the collective bargaining agreement, they will be represented by the News Media Guild (NMG). Candidates appointed on other (i.e. foreign) employment terms, including certain internal transfers on assignments from other bureaux, may not be represented by the NMG.

 

The use of AI

Original reporting, great writing and intelligent commentary lie at the heart of FT journalism. Our readers trust us to produce quality journalism that is accurate, fair and insightful. This is why FT editorial staff do not by default use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to write articles or create other reader-facing content. For specific and pre-approved cases, AI can be harnessed for certain tasks, such as assisting data research for investigations.  

We expect applicants to the FT newsroom to refrain from using AI in their test submissions, and any written materials should be a genuine reflection of their own knowledge, skills and experiences. We encourage candidates only to employ AI as a tool to help with research and interview readiness for a role. 

Candidates should be aware that the use of AI throughout the application process is monitored to ensure a fair and transparent hiring process for all.

 

Our commitment to diversity, equity and inclusion 

We believe in the power of unique perspectives and want all voices in our organisation to be heard, respected and valued. A supportive workplace is one where employees feel they can be themselves and operate to their full potential. We are committed to removing barriers for everyone, with a focus on addressing those faced by underrepresented groups.

 

What’s in it for you? Our benefits

Our benefits vary by location but we are committed to providing best-in-class perks across all our offices. These include generous annual leave, medical cover, inclusive parental leave packages, subsidised gym memberships and opportunities to give back to the community. Full details of our benefits are available here.

FT Newsroom staff are expected to work onsite a minimum of three days per week, subject to role requirements and regular review. While flexible working requests will be considered, not all patterns are suitable for Editorial roles.

 

Accessibility

We are a disability confident employer and Valuable 500 signatory. 

Please let us know if you require any reasonable adjustments/personalisation as part of the application process or to enable you to attend an interview. If you would like to discuss your requirements or have any questions, email talent@ft.com and a member of our team will be happy to help. 

*LI-RS1

KQED is seeking a Content Analytics Lead to serve as a partner to our content teams, studying content performance data, developing insights into what works, what doesn’t, and why, and making data-driven recommendations. Working under the Executive Director of Insights & Growth, this person will be responsible for reporting and briefings to review performance across all of our platforms, with an emphasis on digital growth within priority content verticals.

We have a strong preference for candidates who can work hybrid three days a week in our San Francisco headquarters, but are open to considering a remote arrangement for candidates with an exceptionally strong track record of delivering performance insights to publishers. 

KQED envisions a public media organization with a culture that centers on human dignity, equity, and belonging. This will enable us to better serve and reflect the Bay Area through diverse and inclusive storytelling. 

We value the contributions of marginalized people in society — including Black, Indigenous, and all people of color,  people with disabilities, and LGBTQIA+ people — and we believe that these communities must be centered in the work we do, and we strongly encourage members of these communities to apply.

KQED Code of Ethics  https://www.kqed.org/about/code-ethics

The mission that drives us:

KQED provide citizens of Northern California with a community-supported alternative to commercial media.   We provide citizens with the knowledge they need to make informed decisions; convene community dialogue; bring the arts to everyone and engage audiences to share their stories. We help students and teachers thrive in 21st-century classrooms, and take people of all ages on journeys of exploration- exposing them to new people, places and ideas.

This role will work hybrid between working in KQED's newly renovated headquarters and working remotely. 

Essential Functions

  • Lead the design, build, and management of content analysis and reporting systems and procedures
  • Analyze content data, produce reports on content performance, and generate insights into what drives performance 
  • Meet regularly with content leaders to present insights and learn about their needs
  • Work with others to automate data collection and analysis where possible 
  • Respond to ad-hoc data and analysis requests from other departments
  • Other duties as assigned 

Qualifications

  • Demonstrable experience analyzing and reporting on content data, including social media, YouTube, and/or podcasts
  • Demonstrable experience delivering data-driven insights to content teams
  • Excellent LLM prompting skills and familiarity with agentic AI products (Cowork/ChatGPT Work, Codex/Claude Code, etc.)
  • Bonus points for meaningful data science experience (especially linear models, classification, clustering, time-series analysis, and seasonal decomposition)
  • Exceptional interpersonal and communication skills, and ability to communicate complex concepts to senior and non-analytical audiences 

Physical Demands

  • Ability to lift a minimum of fifteen (15) pounds;
  • Ability to exert maximum muscle force to lift, push, pull or carry;
  • Ability to use abdominal and lower back muscles over time without fatigue;
  • Ability to stand and/or sit for extended periods;
  • Ability to bend, stoop, stretch, twist, sit, and reach;
  • Fine motor skills;
  • Good visual and auditory acuity.

The physical demands described here represent those that an employee must meet to perform the essential functions of this job successfully.

This individual will serve as both a strategic business leader and hands-on automotive expert, responsible for driving revenue growth, developing automotive talent, expanding dealer relationships, and helping automotive marketing consultants maximize results for their clients. This role requires a leader who can successfully engage Dealer Principals, General Managers, marketing executives, and ownership groups while simultaneously coaching sales teams, identifying growth opportunities, recruiting top talent, and building a culture of accountability and performance. This is more than a sales leadership role. It is an opportunity to help shape the future of automotive advertising while leading one of the industry's most comprehensive audio and marketing platforms supported by exclusive automotive products, advanced attribution capabilities, proprietary audience targeting technologies, and industry-leading automotive research resources.

  • Develop and execute market growth plans that increase dealer count, share of wallet, and overall revenue.
  • Partner with local market leadership to maximize automotive performance across all iHeartMedia platforms.
  • Drive successful execution of automotive sales initiatives, promotions, contests, and strategic programs.
  • Analyze performance trends and implement corrective action plans when necessary.

Dealer & Industry Leadership

  • Build executive-level relationships with Dealer Principals, General Managers, Dealer Operators, Marketing Directors, agency leaders, and ownership groups.
  • Participate in high-level sales presentations and strategic client discussions.
  • Serve as the automotive subject matter expert for Florida markets and help create and deliver innovative dealership marketing strategies that drive measurable business outcomes.

  • Build a culture of accountability, activity, continuous learning, and revenue growth.
  • Provide ongoing coaching through ride-alongs, pipeline reviews, presentation coaching, and business planning sessions.
  • Identify and develop future automotive leaders while supporting succession planning and long-term talent development.

Strategic Planning & Execution

  • Collaborate with automotive leadership, Market Presidents, Directors of Sales, and regional leadership teams.
  • Utilize proprietary automotive research, shopper insights, dealer intelligence, and performance analytics to identify growth opportunities and develop market-specific automotive growth plans.
  • Ensure consistent utilization of CRM systems, reporting standards, forecasting tools, and revenue management processes.
  • Drive adoption of automotive products, platforms, tools, and best practices.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Partner with automotive strategy, product, operations, analytics, creative, and campaign teams to deliver exceptional client outcomes.
  • Help identify opportunities for new products, process improvements, and automotive innovations.
  • Act as a voice of the dealer and seller throughout the organization.

What You'll Get

  • The opportunity to lead within one of the country’s largest dedicated automotive advertising organizations, with access to exclusive automotive products, proprietary advertising solutions, industry-leading research resources, and advanced attribution tools.
  • The role offers significant career growth and leadership opportunities, along with a competitive compensation package that includes base salary, incentive compensation, and performance-based earnings.
  • You’ll also be eligible for President’s Club and leadership recognition programs, as well as comprehensive medical, dental, vision, 401(k), paid time off, company holidays, wellness resources, and employee assistance programs.

Automotive Industry Experience

  • Deep understanding of dealership operations, automotive retail trends, fixed operations, customer acquisition, inventory challenges, and market share growth.
  • Demonstrated success building relationships with Dealer Principals, ownership groups, and executive-level automotive decision-makers.

Leadership Experience

  • Proven track record recruiting, developing, coaching, and retaining top sales talent. Experience leading geographically dispersed sales teams.
  • Strong performance management, accountability, and coaching skills.
  • Ability to inspire teams while maintaining high standards and measurable expectations.

Business Development & Strategy

job.title: Sr. Product Designer
job.description:
#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?
We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, we’ve got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is… YOU! Becoming a part of Paramount means joining a team of passionate people who not only recognize the power of content but also enjoy a touch of fun and uniqueness. Together, we co-create moments that matter – both for our audiences and our employees – and aim to leave a positive mark on culture.

 

 

 

Discipline: Design | Team Model: Embedded on a cross-functional CBS Sports App squad

Location: New York, NY

 

The Mission

CBS Sports is the digital stadium for millions of fans. We hold the rights to the biggest moments in sports—NFL, UEFA Champions League, March Madness, the Masters, and UFC. We aren't just a scoreboard; we’re a massive content engine of fantasy leagues, live video, and deep journalism. We’re looking for a Lead Product Designer to join a small, cross-functional squad that operates with the speed of a startup and the scale of a legacy giant.

 

The Role: Build and Own

You won’t just work on a product; you’ll own the design outcomes from first framing through ship. We believe in a builder culture where designers aren't waiting for handoffs or research gates. You will:

  • Own the Project: Take full responsibility for your product squad’s design outcomes. You lead the direction from initial concept to the final shipped experience.

  • Build Constantly: Prototype early and often. We use AI tools (like Cursor or Claude) to visualize ideas and test interactions before they hit engineering, letting us move faster than ever.

  • Lead with Visual Craft: We need designers who bring energy, taste, and dynamic design sensibilities. Whether it’s motion that obeys physics or layouts that capture the intensity of game day, your work should set the bar for the squad.

job.title: Cash Operations Expert
job.description:
#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?
We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, we’ve got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is… YOU! Becoming a part of Paramount means joining a team of passionate people who not only recognize the power of content but also enjoy a touch of fun and uniqueness. Together, we co-create moments that matter – both for our audiences and our employees – and aim to leave a positive mark on culture.

About the Role

Money moves our business—and you’ll be the one keeping it aligned.

As our Cash Operations Expert, you will play a pivotal role in ensuring the accuracy, timeliness, and integrity of Cash and Cash Equivalents across Skydance (Previously Paramount). If you’re a sharp, process-minded finance professional who thrives on turning complex ledger data into seamless automation and trusted business partnerships, this is the place to make a measurable impact.

What You’ll Do

This is a high-visibility, dynamic role with a blend of core cash accounting, cross-functional collaboration, and continuous process optimization.

  • Master the Ledgers: Drive the day-to-day management, standard journal entry preparation, and monthly reconciliation of all Cash and Cash Equivalent accounts.

  • Connect the Dots: Serve as a trusted finance partner providing hands-on accounting support across Treasury, Procure-to-Pay (P2P), Order-to-Cash (O2C), Payroll and Production Finance teams.

  • Lead Stakeholder Alignment: Facilitate monthly touchpoints with key global stakeholders to keep cash operations synchronized and transparent.

  • Maintain Gold-Standard Controls: Ensure internal policies, procedures, and SOX compliance framework controls are robust, active, and audit-ready.

  • Own Audit Operations: Partner directly with external auditors during annual reviews, managing information requests and technical inquiries.

  • Drive Automation & Efficiency: Bring a continuous improvement mindset—modifying rules, automating cash clearing processes, and standardizing workflows as activities migrate into our Global Business Services (GBS) model.

  • Mentor & Champion Projects: Guide, educate, and train junior team members while actively participating in broader finance transformation projects.

What You’ll Bring to the Team

Basic Qualifications

  • Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Accounting or Finance.

  • Experience: 4+ years of post-qualification accounting experience across a broad range of finance functions.

  • Technical Mastery: Solid grounding in US GAAP and/or IFRS, paired with a clear understanding of general accounting principles to form sound business opinions.

  • Process Leadership: A proven track record of identifying inefficiencies, proposing practical solutions, and contributing significantly to process improvement projects.

  • Language & Tech: Strong Business English fluency (B2/C1 level) and proficiency across MS Office tools (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio, SharePoint, MS Project, Outlook).

  • Work Ethic: Highly organized, proactive, and resilient—with the ability to prioritize effectively, take initiative, and deliver against tight deadlines.

Additional Mindset & Qualities

  • Ownership & Analytical Mindset: Highly structured thinker who takes pride in owning tasks, leveraging problem-solving skills, and applying analytical insights to support business decisions.

  • Effective Communicator: Confident presenter, open communicator, and persuasive partner who can translate big-picture vision into actionable daily plans.

  • Role Model & Mentor: A mature, positive professional with a can-do attitude who fosters a culture of learning, collaboration, and DE&I advocacy.

  • Risk & Control Awareness: Sharp eyes for process controls, risk mitigation, and compliance.

Why Skydance (Previously Paramount)?

You’ll be joining a creative, global media powerhouse where your analytical skills help protect and propel the business forward. We value innovative thinkers who aren't afraid to challenge current processes and build smarter ways of working.

TEGNA Inc. helps people thrive in their local communities by providing the trusted local news and services that matter most. With 64 television stations in 51 U.S. markets, TEGNA reaches more than 100 million people monthly across the web, mobile apps, streaming, and linear television. Together, we are building a sustainable future for local news.

 

We are seeking a highly motivated and results-driven technology or digital media sales account executive to join our team. This role is responsible for driving revenue growth through the sale of digital and television media solutions, including streaming and broadcast television, digital advertising, and content partnerships. The ideal candidate will have a proven track record in digital sales, business development with a deep understanding of media and marketing trends, and the ability to build and maintain strong client relationships. This role requires a strategic approach to identifying opportunities, pitching solutions, and delivering measurable results for clients.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Sales & Revenue Generation: Drive sales by identifying and securing new business opportunities across multiple digital channels, including streaming, online video and display, and content marketing solutions.
  • Client Relationship Management: Develop and nurture long-term relationships with clients, ensuring their marketing needs are met and identifying areas for upselling and cross-selling additional services.
  • Consultative Selling: Provide consultative solutions to clients by understanding their business goals, analyzing market trends, and recommending tailored marketing strategies that drive results.
  • Market Research & Lead Generation: Research industry trends and competitor offerings to develop a robust pipeline of prospective clients and stay ahead of market shifts.
  • Proposal Development & Pitching: Craft compelling sales presentations and proposals that showcase the value of our media offerings, using data and insights to communicate potential ROI.
  • Campaign Management & Optimization: Collaborate with internal teams to ensure successful campaign execution, monitoring performance, and optimizing for maximum effectiveness and client satisfaction.
  • Reporting & Analytics: Regularly review and report on sales targets, campaign performance, and key metrics to clients and internal stakeholders.
  • Collaboration: Work closely with the account management, and product teams to align on campaign strategies, creative assets, and ad placements that meet clients’ needs.
  • Performance Management: Strategically use CRM and prospecting tools to manage and achieve quotas as it pertains to activity metrics and revenue goals.

  • Proven track record of meeting or exceeding sales targets in a competitive environment
  • Strong understanding of digital marketing channels and industry trends, including programmatic, streaming media, display, video, social, and content marketing
