job.title: Director, Acquisition Marketing (LATAM)
job.description:
OVERVIEW OF THE COMPANY

Fox Corporation

Under the FOX banner, we produce and distribute content through some of the world’s leading and most valued brands, including: FOX News Media, FOX Sports, FOX Entertainment, FOX Television Stations and Tubi Media Group. We empower a diverse range of creators to imagine and develop culturally significant content, while building an organization that thrives on creative ideas, operational expertise and strategic thinking.

JOB DESCRIPTION

The FOX direct-to-consumer (DTC) platform is a new, forward-looking initiative within Tubi Media Group that brings FOX’s unparalleled content portfolio—news, sports, and entertainment—directly to consumers via an innovative subscription streaming service.


Driven by a highly experienced leadership team with extensive backgrounds at the intersections of media, technology, streaming, and content—and built with the full support of Fox Corporation—this venture combines entrepreneurial energy with deep media expertise.


Our vision is to create a unified, modern viewing experience that puts the consumer first—seamlessly integrating live and on-demand content across platforms.


At the intersection of cutting-edge technology and trusted storytelling, this is an opportunity to shape the future of streaming at one of the most pivotal moments in media. We’re assembling a world-class team to deliver on that vision—and we’re just getting started.


ABOUT THE ROLE

We are seeking a strategic, results-driven Director, Acquisition Marketing (LATAM) to lead FOX One's subscriber acquisition strategy and paid media investment across Latin America. As FOX One expands its international footprint, this leader will play a critical role in developing and scaling regional growth strategies, driving efficient subscriber acquisition, and establishing a strong market presence across LATAM.


Reporting to the Senior Director, Acquisition Marketing, this role will serve as the primary strategic lead for LATAM acquisition marketing, overseeing multi-million-dollar media investments, agency partnerships, and regional campaign performance. The Director will collaborate closely with U.S.-based leadership and international marketing teams while providing dotted-line leadership to LATAM-based team members.


The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in performance marketing, international media strategy, and incrementality-based measurement, along with the ability to balance short-term subscriber growth objectives with long-term brand development. This individual will be instrumental in shaping FOX One's regional acquisition roadmap, identifying opportunities to scale investment, and building a sustainable, data-driven growth engine across Latin America.


A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Own and lead FOX One's subscriber acquisition strategy across LATAM, developing regional growth plans that align with global business objectives, subscriber targets, and market expansion priorities.
  • Manage and optimize multi-million-dollar paid media budgets across LATAM markets, driving investment decisions, resource allocation, and acquisition efficiency to maximize subscriber growth and return on marketing investment.
  • Provide strategic oversight of integrated paid media campaigns across paid social, paid search, Youtube, display, and connected TV (CTV), ensuring effective planning, execution, and optimization across markets.
  • Serve as the acquisition lead for LATAM, partnering with the U.S.-based leadership and regional stakeholders to translate global growth strategies into locally relevant marketing initiatives.
  • Establish and advance incrementality-based measurement frameworks, including geo-lift studies, marketing mix modeling (MMM), and holdout/control testing, to evaluate media effectiveness and inform investment decisions.
  • Lead and develop strategic relationships with media, creative, and measurement agency partners, establishing performance expectations, accountability, and opportunities for innovation.
  • Provide dotted-line leadership and strategic direction to LATAM-based team members, fostering collaboration, accountability, and alignment across regional and global teams.
  • Own regional acquisition performance reporting, including CPA/CPS, subscriber growth, campaign pacing, and marketing efficiency, delivering actionable insights and strategic recommendations to senior leadership.
  • Partner with measurement, analytics, creative, product, and international marketing teams to develop integrated go-to-market strategies that support FOX One's regional launches and ongoing growth.
  • Identify emerging market opportunities, evolving consumer behaviors, and competitive dynamics to inform regional acquisition strategies and long-term investment planning.
  • Drive continuous improvement in regional marketing operations, establishing scalable processes, testing frameworks, and best practices that support FOX One's international expansion.
  • Travel throughout LATAM markets as needed to strengthen strategic partnerships, support market launches, and deepen understanding of local market dynamics.

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • Typically, 10+ years of progressive experience in performance marketing, subscriber acquisition, growth marketing, or digital media, including significant experience leading acquisition strategies and large-scale paid media investments.
  • Professional-level fluency in Spanish, including the ability to participate in business meetings.
  • Extensive experience overseeing multi-million-dollar paid media budgets and driving investment decisions across paid social, paid search, online video (OLV), display, and/or connected TV (CTV).
  • Proven ability to lead and manage external media agency partners, establish strategic priorities, and drive accountability for performance and execution.
  • Deep expertise in incrementality-based measurement, including geo-lift studies, marketing mix modeling (MMM), holdout/control testing, and other advanced marketing effectiveness frameworks.
  • Strong strategic and analytical capabilities, with the ability to translate complex performance data into actionable business recommendations and investment decisions.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders, navigate cross-functional organizations, and align regional execution with broader business priorities.
  • Experience providing leadership, mentorship, or strategic direction to cross-functional or geographically distributed teams.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and relationship management skills, with the ability to operate effectively across multiple markets and time zones.

JOB DESCRIPTION

As a Senior Payroll Tax Analyst, you will be responsible for payroll tax reporting, compliance, liabilities, and the filing of associated employment tax returns for multiple FEINS in multiple states.  You will also ensure the integrity of employee wage and tax data reported on employees’ Form W-2.

You will drive efficiencies through creative problem-solving and analysis as you work with large volumes of complex data to draw conclusions that identify process improvements and automations, improving accurate and timely tax payments and filings.


A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Ensure the accuracy, timeliness, and completeness of all monthly, quarterly, and annual tax filings, amendments, and reporting including employee W-2s and W-2c’s
  • Reconcile all tax and wage amounts for multiple legal entities monthly, quarterly, and annually between the payroll system and third-party tax service including reconciliation of W-2s to payroll tax reports and the quarterly 941 returns to W-2 totals. Research and correct any discrepancies
  • Analyze payroll tax issues and provide recommendations for solutions relating, but not limited to employee mobility, reciprocal taxation, stock taxation and reporting, inpats and expats, employer-provided fringe benefits and local taxation
  • Review and reconcile all daily tax and wage amounts submitted to third-party tax services and research any discrepancies and handle accordingly
  • Perform monthly, quarterly, and annual reconciliations of gross earnings to taxable wages to validate accuracy of taxable wages
  • Submit tax notices and facilitate resolutions in coordination with third-party tax vendors timely to avoid penalties and interest; research and determine the root cause, and work with the appropriate parties to take action to prevent future issues
  • Provide excellent customer service in researching and responding to payroll tax-related inquiries from employees, agencies, and other internal/external parties
  • Research all W-2 correction inquiries, complete and submit all W-2c’s for review and approval, and distribute W-2c through appropriate channel
  • Review all Workday tax updates and test accordingly, and communicate key changes to the Payroll team and HR as necessary
  • Partner with the Payroll team to ensure state and local taxes are set up correctly for employees, particularly for employees who live and work in different states
  • Maintain unemployment tax rates and communicate changes to third-party tax services
  • Apply and register for new state SUI and withholding tax accounts for new locations, FEINS, as needed
  • Prepare various tax returns and reporting not filed by third-party tax services, including other required government reporting
  • Review third-party sick pay and ensure appropriate reporting
  • Collaborate with the Manager to enhance, streamline, and document payroll tax processes
  • Maintain knowledge of federal, state, and local tax regulations, including taxation of fringe benefits, by studying existing and new legislation and ensure compliance and advise management on needed actions


WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • Bachelor’s degree or the equivalent combination of experience and education
  • FPC or CPP certification strongly preferred
  • 5+ years of relevant work experience servicing a large volume of employees (including a remote workforce) in a multi-state, multi-entity organization
  • Comprehensive knowledge of federal, multi-state, and local wage and hour and tax regulations
  • Strong working knowledge of taxation of fringe benefits and long-term equity incentive instruments (RSUs, NQ Stock Options, etc.)
  • High level of accuracy and attention to detail with high service orientation, integrity, discretion, and ownership of work with the ability to work independently
  • Ability to work through ambiguity, be self-motivated, and piece together facts and data necessary to identify issues, propose resolutions, make decisions, and operationalize necessary changes to improve taxes and service delivery
  • Ability to prioritize and multitask in a fast-paced environment
  • Intermediate to advanced analytical skillset, including the use of Excel V-Lookup and Pivot Tables and/or other tools
  • Excellent interpersonal, oral, and written communication skills
  • Able to handle confidential information and issues effectively and without breach of confidentiality


NICE TO HAVE, BUT NOT A DEALBREAKER

  • Experience with Workday and ADP systems
  • Experience with inpats and expats

job.title: Evening Anchor
job.description:
We are looking for a unicorn.  We need someone who can anchor our evening newscasts, produce those newscasts, create content for our digital platforms and CTV streaming channel, and mentor our young staff of reporters.  As news teams get small, staff members are having to take on additional responsibilities.  Those Jack-of-All-Trades will be the journalists that carry our industry into the future.  It will make you more valuable to all future employers. We’re an aggressive news organization that owns breaking news in the local market.

That’s the hard part. What’s in it for you?  You’ll be living and working in one of the most beautiful places in the country.  People pay thousands of dollars a week to vacation here in Panama City, Florida.  The people who live here are friendly, welcoming and hospitable. If you get involved in the community, they will embrace you as one of their own.  You’ll be working with a young, energetic staff of reporters, most fresh out of college and working in their first newsroom. There are also seasoned veterans on the staff who make up the core leadership of the newsroom.

The station signed on in October 1973, has been an ABC affiliate since 1982, a CW affiliate since 2024, and we’ve been part of the Nexstar Nation since 2014.

job.title: Manager, Global Consumer Insights & Research
job.description:
The NFL's Marketing Strategy, Planning & Insights team serves as a center of excellence for the League, shaping how the NFL grows fans, strengthens the brand, and drives engagement across the U.S. and international markets. The team brings together consumer insights, audience strategy, business planning, initiative-level strategy, and performance measurement to ground decisions in fan understanding, market dynamics, and business priorities. Partnering across business functions and key stakeholders (e.g., the 32 NFL Clubs, partners), the team delivers actionable insights, strategic guidance, and planning frameworks that inform both long-term strategy and day-to-day decisions.

Within this team, Consumer Insights designs and conducts primary research, integrates syndicated and first-party data, and delivers actionable insights across global fan development, brand health, media, live events, marketing effectiveness, partnerships, social responsibility, and player-related priorities.

The Manager, Global Strategic Insights supports research development, analysis, and insights generation to inform global fan development and business growth. The role conducts and synthesizes primary research, syndicated sources, first-party data, and market intelligence to ensure Leaguewide decision-making is grounded in a fan-first perspective.

Responsibilities

Global Fandom Intelligence

job.title: Career Consultant
job.description:
Join a team of proud, passionate, and caring people that together share their diverse talents and backgrounds to serve our members and grow the game of golf. Being at the PGA of America means you are supported, respected, and appreciated for your contributions.

The Career Consultant for this role supports South Florida Section and must reside in this section.


RESPONSIBILITIES (Specific areas of responsibility include but are not limited to):


Service to PGA Professionals:

  • Provide insightful and meaningful career counseling and career coaching to PGA Professionals throughout their career life cycle from job search and membership to retirement.

  • Assist PGA Professionals in gathering and utilizing information from PGA and industry data resources.
  • Promote the benefits of the PGA Compensation Survey and other related Association surveys.
  • Promote and generate participation in PGA Player Development programs and strategies and document the value it brings to facilities and PGA Members.

Service to Employers:

  • Provide exceptional hiring services and resources, and assistance to employers to enhance relationships with industry stakeholders. Services and resources include PGA ExecuSearch, hiring process planning, resume review, interview planning, compensation and benefit packages, correspondence, and PGA preferred background check provider.
  • Provide compensation reports within department guidelines.
  • Market the value of PGA Professionals to non-PGA facilities and the industry.
  • Assist in creating awareness of PGA Player Development strategies and programming.

Service to PGA Sections:

  • Manage and maintain relationships with Section leadership, staff, and Section Education and Employment Committees.
  • Partner with Sections to develop employment strategies, and deliver employment presentations and education seminars to industry employers and organizations.
  • Support Section and Chapter membership meetings, Board meetings and special events as needed.
  • Communicate with Section Executive Directors and leadership quarterly (at a minimum) and provide golf industry updates on Employment.
  • Attend Section tournaments/events to cultivate relationships, foster goodwill, and support PGA Section staff.

Association/Departmental Responsibilities:

  • Assist in the development and improvement of PGA Career Services programs, projects, systems, publications and information.
  • Assist in the marketing and promotion of Association and PGA Career Services programs and initiatives.
  • Engage in proactive outreach and collaborate with other Career Consultants to identify candidates for available opportunities.
  • Provide support as needed to non-industry candidates and search support for nontraditional PGA Member roles such as General Managers, Golf Course Superintendents, etc.
  • Provide editorial content and articles for Section newsletters, PGA magazine, and other industry publications.

Contributions to the Game and Business of Golf:

Talent Development

  • Educate and inform the marketplace about the impact PGA Professionals have on the community, golf business, and local economy.
  • Provide field support and collaborate with PGA of America Diversity and Inclusion efforts.
  • Active participant in PGA of America recruiting efforts as needed.

Allied Associations & Partners

  • Establish effective working relationships with the Amateur body, including state and local golf associations. 
  • Engage with local chapters of GCSAA, CMAA, and NGCOA. 
  • Assist department leaders in improving working relationships with golf management companies.

Golfer Development

  • Participate in player development programs hosted by PGA Professionals, working in conjunction with fellow field staff.
  • Attend community/Section programs providing instruction or programming targeting new and existing golfers as available.

SHARED VALUES: 

Embody the organization's shared values and help ensure the organization's values-based culture thrives by proactively identifying and addressing any shared values, challenges and opportunities you are experiencing.


SUPERVISION:

No supervisory responsibilities.  


FINANCIAL RESPONSIBILITY:

No financial responsibilities.


EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Bachelor’s degree: (B.A.) or equivalent in Business Administration, Human Resources, Professional Golf Management (Executive Management preferred) or related field.
  • Five (5) years of experience in golf operations or golf industry management/leadership.
  • Employment/club relations experience, career counseling and Human Resources management training preferred.
  • PGA Member preferred.

SKILLS, KNOWLEDGE AND ABILITIES:


Job Knowledge/Technology: Must have knowledge of the golf industry and/or golf facility operations, employment and/or recruiting. Knowledge of the PGA of America and Section operations are preferred. Must have knowledge of managing multiple priorities, in a multi-functional work environment. Demonstrated leadership skills and a proven ability to motivate and manage professionals to achieve results. Skilled in customer service and/or sales. Must have a thorough knowledge of administrative principles and procedures with the ability to lead various projects and programs. A knowledge of the organizational functions of a business operation. Must possess a high degree of trust and confidentiality. Basic fluency in artificial intelligence (AI) tools and concepts. This includes using AI to enhance business operations and drive innovation, enabling us to better serve our Members and stakeholders. Working knowledge of Gmail, Google Drive, Google Sheets, and Google Docs.

job.title: Master Control Hub Maintenance Tech
job.description:
Are you a broadcast technology expert who thrives on solving complex problems and keeping critical systems running at their best? Scripps is looking for a seasoned technical professional to join our Master Control Hub team in Indianapolis, Indiana. In this pivotal role, you'll serve as the go-to technical expert supporting Scripps television broadcasting entities across the country, leveraging deep knowledge of computers, IP networks, and master control operations to troubleshoot, diagnose, and implement solutions that keep our stations on air. The Scripps Master Control Hub is the backbone of centralized, remote control and monitoring of commercial and programming sources for Scripps stations, and your work will directly shape its performance and reliability.


WHAT YOU'LL DO:


  • Serve as liaison to the IT group for Master Control.
  • Report to the master control hub manager but consult with Scripps local station engineering directors and other senior leadership, including the senior director of Scripps engineering.
  • Install, maintain, and repair critical broadcasting components to ensure all systems are functioning at peak efficiency.
  • Troubleshoot and repair a variety of issues with broadcast and IT equipment.
  • Rely on extensive knowledge and professional discretion to perform efficiently and successfully.
  • Make recommendations for products and service enhancements.
  • Significant technical ingenuity and flexibility are expected.
  • Collaborate with technology suppliers regarding set-up, upgrades, enhancements, troubleshooting, and issue resolution.
  • Program/customize master control software functionality.
  • Track and assist master control users with desktop computer and server issues.
  • When resolving open issues, seek multiple perspectives, gather more information when necessary, close or escalate issues, and monitor resolution so that hub operation is optimized.
  • Work with the hub leadership team to address operational issues and facilitate decision-making with regard to technical matters.
  • Provide input and make recommendations to assist in disaster recovery and system planning.
  • Other duties as assigned.
  • May require working overtime, holidays, and weekends with short notice when necessary.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:


  • Associate's degree in a related discipline or equivalent years of experience preferred
  • Generally, 5+ years of experience in related field preferred

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:


  • Very strong analysis and problem-solving skills: The ability to assess a situation, seek multiple perspectives, gather information, and identify key issues is critically important in this role
  • Solid knowledge of computer hardware, software, LAN environment, configuration, and operation
  • A very high sense of responsibility and urgency regarding corrective action and customer service

WHERE YOU'LL LIVE, WORK, AND PLAY:


Indianapolis is a world-class city that punches well above its weight in sports, culture, and livability. Known as the "Racing Capital of the World," it is home to the iconic Indianapolis Motor Speedway and the legendary Indy 500, one of the most celebrated motorsports events on the planet. The city is also a major hub for professional sports, boasting the NFL's Indianapolis Colts and the NBA's Indiana Pacers, along with a well-earned reputation as one of America's premier hosts for NCAA championships, the Big Ten Championship Game, and other marquee sporting events.


Beyond the excitement of game day, Indianapolis offers a rich cultural landscape that surprises and delights. The Children's Museum of Indianapolis, the largest of its kind in the world, sits alongside gems like the Eiteljorg Museum, the Indiana State Museum, and the stunning Newfields campus, home to the Indianapolis Museum of Art and a beloved outdoor art and nature park. The city's vibrant neighborhoods, from the galleries and restaurants along Massachusetts Avenue to the eclectic energy of Fountain Square and Broad Ripple, give residents a thriving local food, arts, and nightlife scene to explore.


For outdoor enthusiasts, Indianapolis delivers with Eagle Creek Park, one of the largest municipal parks in the United States, offering boating, hiking, birdwatching, and sailing year-round. White River State Park sits right in the heart of downtown, connecting you to green space, the Indianapolis Zoo and the scenic Central Canal Walk. Add a cost of living that remains well below the national average for a major metro, and you'll quickly discover that Indianapolis is a genuinely great place to plant roots, grow a career, and enjoy everything a thriving Midwestern city has to offer.

job.description:
Are you a proven media sales leader ready to inspire a high-performing team and make a measurable impact in your market? KTVH is looking for a Local Sales Manager who will champion the growth of local businesses through innovative, multi-platform advertising solutions. From broadcast television to Over The Top (OTT) video, SEO/SEM, social media, digital display and email targeting, you'll guide a talented team of Account Executives in connecting clients with the audiences that matter most — all while driving the station's revenue forward and developing the next generation of Scripps sales talent.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Collaborate with DOS and other sales managers and departments to accomplish the objectives of the station.
  • Organize, direct and manage the execution and performance of a team of local sales Account Executives.
  • Negotiate ratings, rates and budgets.
  • Develop new business for station utilizing and maximizing all station platforms including but not limited to broadcast, digital and mobile.
  • Develop working knowledge of Scripps Sales Process (SSP) and coach Account Executives regarding SSP in the field.
  • Utilize SSP, resources and tools provided to build effective sales strategies.
  • Collaborate with the Director of Sales and Sales Managers to train, develop and motivate the local sales team so that revenue goals are achieved.
  • Collaborate with the Director of Sales and Sales Managers to foster career growth and development of the local sales team so that a pipeline of talent for future Scripps sales management openings is ready.
  • Maintain positive working relationships with outside vendors.
  • Interface with traffic systems and personnel to ensure efficient management of airtime inventory.
  • Oversee accounts receivable and credit policies.
  • Develop and implement pricing and packaging to fill needs of both client and station.
  • Know the strengths and weaknesses of the competing stations, other advertising mediums and position the station accordingly.
  • Effectively forecast sales revenue and manage department expenses so that financial goals are achieved.
  • Other duties as assigned.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:

  • Bachelor's degree in business or related field or equivalent experience preferred
  • Generally, 7+ years proven success in media sales
  • Experience in agency and direct strategic account management, broadcast inventory and digital/video capabilities required
  • Valid driver's license, good driving record, and ability to provide proof of insurance with the company required insurance limits.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

  • Demonstrated aptitude for informal leadership and mentoring; fosters open dialogue, empowers others, addresses conflict quickly and directly
  • Strong coaching and feedback skills
  • Strong ability to motivate others toward team goals
  • Able to foster an environment that enables creative and innovative thinking
  • Strong influencing, selling and upselling skills
  • Effective teamwork and collaboration skills
  • Very strong analysis and data interpretation - able to help others translate needs and research data into sound marketing proposals
  • Exceptional verbal and written communication skills
  • Outstanding presentation abilities (in person/virtual, small/large groups, all levels)
  • Strong time management and organization skills
  • Proficient with Microsoft Office (Word, Excel and PowerPoint)
  • Working knowledge of Google Office (Sheets, Docs, Slides) and virtual conferencing platforms (E.g. Skype, WebEx, Zoom or MS Teams etc.)
  • Proven ability to manage multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment
  • May require some travel

WHERE YOU'LL LIVE, WORK, AND PLAY:

Live in the center of adventure. Helena is the capital of Montana and is centrally located near the continental divide and at the halfway point between two of America's premier national parks: Yellowstone and Glacier. The city's history lies in the search for gold in the west. Prospectors descended on Last Chance Gulch in the mid-1800s and struck gold, transforming a small camp into a frontier town. You will find history across the city. Tour the quiet mansion district's leafed streets in the summer, walk the beautiful campus of Carroll College, or stop at the stately Capitol building to visit the summer farmer's market. If you want to stretch your legs a bit, hop on your mountain bike after work and hit one of Mount Helena's many trails. The Mount Helena city park encompasses an entire mountain and is just minutes from the television station and downtown. Helena is surrounded by the Lewis and Clark National Forest. The forest is home to some of the best hunting, fishing and outdoor recreation opportunities in the state. Blue ribbon trout fisheries that include the mighty Missouri River and the Little Blackfoot are less than an hour's drive from downtown. In the winter, there are ample trails for cross-country or downhill skiing at Great Divide, which is famous for being the first Montana ski hill to open and the last to close each season.Montana_Station_Location_Sections.md

job.title: Senior Payroll Tax Analyst
job.description:
As a Senior Payroll Tax Analyst, you will be responsible for payroll tax reporting, compliance, liabilities, and the filing of associated employment tax returns for multiple FEINS in multiple states.  You will also ensure the integrity of employee wage and tax data reported on employees’ Form W-2.

You will drive efficiencies through creative problem-solving and analysis as you work with large volumes of complex data to draw conclusions that identify process improvements and automations, improving accurate and timely tax payments and filings.


A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Ensure the accuracy, timeliness, and completeness of all monthly, quarterly, and annual tax filings, amendments, and reporting including employee W-2s and W-2c’s
  • Reconcile all tax and wage amounts for multiple legal entities monthly, quarterly, and annually between the payroll system and third-party tax service including reconciliation of W-2s to payroll tax reports and the quarterly 941 returns to W-2 totals. Research and correct any discrepancies
  • Analyze payroll tax issues and provide recommendations for solutions relating, but not limited to employee mobility, reciprocal taxation, stock taxation and reporting, inpats and expats, employer-provided fringe benefits and local taxation
  • Review and reconcile all daily tax and wage amounts submitted to third-party tax services and research any discrepancies and handle accordingly
  • Perform monthly, quarterly, and annual reconciliations of gross earnings to taxable wages to validate accuracy of taxable wages
  • Submit tax notices and facilitate resolutions in coordination with third-party tax vendors timely to avoid penalties and interest; research and determine the root cause, and work with the appropriate parties to take action to prevent future issues
  • Provide excellent customer service in researching and responding to payroll tax-related inquiries from employees, agencies, and other internal/external parties
  • Research all W-2 correction inquiries, complete and submit all W-2c’s for review and approval, and distribute W-2c through appropriate channel
  • Review all Workday tax updates and test accordingly, and communicate key changes to the Payroll team and HR as necessary
  • Partner with the Payroll team to ensure state and local taxes are set up correctly for employees, particularly for employees who live and work in different states
  • Maintain unemployment tax rates and communicate changes to third-party tax services
  • Apply and register for new state SUI and withholding tax accounts for new locations, FEINS, as needed
  • Prepare various tax returns and reporting not filed by third-party tax services, including other required government reporting
  • Review third-party sick pay and ensure appropriate reporting
  • Collaborate with the Manager to enhance, streamline, and document payroll tax processes
  • Maintain knowledge of federal, state, and local tax regulations, including taxation of fringe benefits, by studying existing and new legislation and ensure compliance and advise management on needed actions


WHAT YOU WILL NEED

Office Administrator – "Public Notice Advisor"

Location: Green Bay, WI – Green Bay Press-GazetteSchedule: Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–5:00 PMPay: $15.73/hourWork Arrangement: In-office – off N. Broadway

Looking for a Monday–Friday Job With a More Consistent Routine?

If you've built strong people skills in retail, restaurants, hospitality, customer service, call centers, or another fast-paced environment, you may already have many of the skills you need to succeed in an office.

LocaliQ/USA TODAY is hiring an Office Administrator – Public Notices to join our Green Bay team. This is a great opportunity to take the skills you've developed in a customer-facing environment and put them to work in a Monday–Friday office setting while learning new administrative and computer-based skills along the way.

You'll work with customers and internal teams, process information, manage deadlines, and help ensure important public notices are handled accurately and on time.

What You'll Be Doing

Your day will include a variety of administrative and customer-focused responsibilities, such as:

Assisting customers and sales representatives with public notice questions

Handling incoming phone calls and emails

Entering and updating information in computer systems

Reviewing notices and proofs to ensure information is accurate

Processing public notices and advertisements

Managing deadlines and keeping work moving on schedule

Partnering with internal teams to answer questions and resolve issues

Learning and using new systems and processes through hands-on training

You don't have to know everything coming in the door. Reliability, attention to detail, organization, and a willingness to learn are what matter most.

What We're Looking For

You don't need a long administrative background or a resume filled with office experience.

We're looking for someone who:

Is dependable and follows through on their work

Enjoys working with and helping others

Is comfortable working with computers and learning new systems

Has strong attention to detail

Can prioritize and stay organized throughout the day

Communicates clearly and professionally

Is willing to learn new processes and responsibilities

Cares about getting the details right

Experience in retail, restaurants, hospitality, call centers, reception, customer service, or other fast-paced, people-focused environments can be a great fit for this role.

Previous office or public-notice experience is not required. We'll provide training on our systems, processes, and responsibilities.

And if you don't have notary experience, that's okay too — we can assist with becoming a notary if needed.

Build Your Office Experience

This could be a great next step if you're ready to move from an unpredictable customer-facing environment into a steady Monday–Friday office role.

You'll have the opportunity to build experience in administration, customer service, computer systems, and office operations while working alongside a supportive team.

You'll also have access to:

Health, Dental & Vision coverage

401(k) with company match

Paid Time Off

Company holidays

Training and development opportunities

A supportive team environment

If you're ready for a consistent Monday–Friday schedule and an opportunity to build your office skills, apply today. We'd love to meet you.

The hourly rate for this role will range between $15.00 and $16.00. Variable incentive compensation, including commissions, is not reflected in these figures and based on the role, may be applicable. Exact compensation may vary based on skills, experience, education level, location, and union representation, if applicable

job.title: Prinicipal Multi Media Designer - Creative Stategy & Enablement
job.description:
designIQ is a full-service creative, design, and pre-media group supporting internal and external partners across print, digital, social, video, branding, campaign creative, imaging, and ad production services.

Our work ranges from high-volume production to agency-level creative solutions. That includes print and digital advertising, social media creative, short-form video, logos, brand identity systems, company stationery, branded materials, direct mail, billboards, packaging, product design, glossy and newsprint products, campaign assets, and custom creative solutions.

We’re looking for a senior creative leader who can operate beyond execution. This person will serve as creative counsel to the Sr. Director of Creative Operations, support sales and partner conversations, help shape creative standards, and assist with training and enablement across the creative operation.

This role is ideal for someone who can think like an agency creative, work like a production expert, communicate like a client-facing partner, and help move a large creative operation forward.

Role Summary:

The Principal Multimedia Designer, Creative Strategy & Enablement is a highly experienced creative professional responsible for supporting elevated creative work, client-facing creative conversations, internal training, sales enablement, and quality improvement across designIQ.

This role sits at the intersection of creative strategy, multimedia design, production excellence, client consultation, and operational enablement. The person in this position should be able to understand a business need, translate it into a creative approach, guide others toward stronger work, and produce high-quality creative when needed.

The role will regularly partner with the Sr. Director of Creative Operations to help shape creative direction, review strategic opportunities, support new business conversations, advise on creative capabilities, and strengthen the overall quality and consistency of designIQ’s work.

This person may attend internal meetings, external partner meetings, sales calls, discovery calls, client-facing creative discussions, and training sessions. They should be comfortable speaking with sales teams, customers, creative teams, production teams, leadership, and external partners.

The ideal candidate brings agency-level design experience, strong multimedia capability, polished communication skills, and the ability to teach, coach, and influence without needing direct authority in every situation.

Key Responsibilities:

Serve as creative counsel and strategic design partner to the Sr. Director of Creative Operations.

Support sales calls, discovery calls, partner meetings, and client-facing conversations where creative expertise is needed.

Help translate client goals, sales objectives, and business challenges into clear creative recommendations.

Provide creative direction and guidance on complex, high-value, or strategically important work.

Create, review, or advise on agency-level creative across print, digital, social, video, branding, direct mail, billboards, packaging, product design, glossy publications, newsprint products, and campaign-based deliverables.

Assist in shaping creative approaches for new business opportunities, partner onboarding, premium creative services, and custom creative requests.

Help determine whether a creative request belongs in standard production, premium creative, Studio-level work, or a custom scope.

Support the development of creative briefs, intake standards, client discovery questions, and creative readiness requirements.

Join internal planning meetings to represent creative quality, design feasibility, production needs, and client experience.

Partner with sales and customer-facing teams to explain design recommendations, creative limitations, available solutions, and best-fit options.

Present and explain creative work, design direction, and creative recommendations to internal and external stakeholders.

Create polished finished creative when needed, especially for strategic work, sample work, pitch support, training examples, or high-priority client needs.

Assist with creative training across the operation, including design fundamentals, multimedia best practices, AI-assisted workflows, social creative, video, brand consistency, production standards, and quality expectations.

Help develop training materials, creative playbooks, design examples, before-and-after reviews, checklists, templates, and quality standards.

Mentor designers and creative team members by providing thoughtful feedback, coaching, and design guidance.

Review creative work for concept, execution, accuracy, visual hierarchy, brand alignment, production readiness, and overall effectiveness.

Help identify quality gaps, workflow issues, training needs, and recurring creative weaknesses across the operation.

Use AI-assisted creative tools to improve ideation, versioning, image exploration, workflow efficiency, and scalable creative output.

Guide responsible use of AI across creative work, making sure final output remains accurate, brand-safe, original, legally appropriate, and professionally finished.

Stay current on design trends, digital advertising trends, social media formats, video trends, AI tools, print production practices, and evolving client expectations.

Support the creation of scalable templates, design systems, campaign frameworks, and repeatable creative solutions.

Design with performance in mind, including audience behavior, offer clarity, mobile-first composition, visual hooks, readability, and conversion-focused calls to action.

Apply accessibility-minded design practices, including legibility, contrast, hierarchy, mobile readability, and inclusive digital design principles.

Serve as a trusted creative voice in conversations about workflow, staffing, capabilities, quality, training, AI adoption, and creative operations strategy.

Required Qualifications:

Portfolio required. Portfolio must show advanced creative work across multiple media types and demonstrate strong design thinking.

Significant professional experience in multimedia design, graphic design, advertising, agency creative, publishing, brand design, digital media, or a related creative field.

Proven ability to create and guide agency-level creative across print, digital, social, video, branding, and campaign-based work.

Experience creating or directing logos, brand identity systems, corporate stationery, branded collateral, direct mail, billboards, packaging, product-related creative, glossy publications, newsprint products, digital campaigns, and social media assets.

Strong understanding of design fundamentals, including typography, layout, hierarchy, color, composition, branding, messaging, visual storytelling, and production accuracy.

Ability to create polished finished work with limited direction.

Ability to evaluate incomplete briefs, identify missing information, and still move work forward with sound creative judgment.

Strong client-facing communication skills.

Ability to interact confidently with internal teams, external customers, sales leaders, creative teams, production stakeholders, and senior leadership.

Ability to explain creative decisions clearly to non-design audiences.

Sell with a Competitive Edge

Dow Jones Energy delivers trusted price transparency, benchmarks, analytics, news, and insights across the global energy, chemicals, metals, and fuel supply value chains. job.title: Manager, Direct to Consumer Operations- MNRK (NYC or Nashville)
job.description:
MNRK Music Group is looking for a Manager, Direct to Consumer Operations to join our team. Reporting to the VP, Direct to Consumer, this role leads the management and optimization of MNRK's direct-to-consumer business across e-commerce storefronts, product launches, merchandising, inventory, and fulfillment operations.


The ideal candidate combines strong e-commerce expertise with operational excellence, using data-driven insights to enhance customer experience, drive revenue growth, and support successful physical and digital product releases. As a key cross-functional partner, this individual will collaborate with marketing, retail, production, and external vendors to deliver a seamless consumer journey from product launch through delivery. The successful candidate will thrive in a fast-paced environment, balancing strategy and execution while helping shape the continued growth of MNRK's direct-to-consumer business and fan experience. Candidates should be based in either New York or Tennessee; consideration will also be given to highly qualified candidates outside of these areas.

 


What You Will Be Doing:

  • Own and optimize the direct-to-consumer storefront experience across e-commerce platforms, marketplaces, and social commerce channels, ensuring a seamless customer journey and strong conversion performance.
  • Manage digital merchandising, product catalog updates, pricing, promotions, and launch execution to maximize visibility, engagement, and revenue.
  • Monitor storefront performance and customer behavior, leveraging analytics, testing, and reporting to identify opportunities for optimization and growth.
  • Partner with marketing teams to support email, retention, paid media, and promotional initiatives that drive traffic and sales across DTC channels.
  • Lead inventory planning and coordination with fulfillment partners, ensuring product availability, accurate inventory visibility, and efficient order fulfillment.
  • Oversee physical product operations for vinyl, CDs, and other formats by coordinating production timelines, vendor relationships, and release schedules in partnership with internal stakeholders and external manufacturing partners.
  • Partner cross-functionally with marketing, retail, finance, operations, and external vendors to execute product launches, improve operational processes, and support continued growth of the DTC business.


What Makes You Qualified:

  • 5+ years of experience in direct-to-consumer operations, e-commerce, digital merchandising, or related functions, preferably within music, entertainment, media, or consumer products.
  • Proven experience managing e-commerce storefronts, product launches, merchandising, and customer experience initiatives.
  • Strong analytical skills with experience using performance data and reporting tools to drive business decisions and revenue growth.
  • Experience with Shopify, Shopify Plus, or similar e-commerce platforms, including marketplace and fulfillment integrations.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects and product launches simultaneously while maintaining strong attention to detail.
  • Experience working cross-functionally with marketing, operations, finance, retail, and external vendor partners.
  • Knowledge of inventory planning, fulfillment operations, and physical product supply chains.
  • Excellent communication, organization, and project management skills with the ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment.


What Would Be Music to Our Ears:

  • Music industry, entertainment, or media experience.
  • Experience with Klaviyo or similar CRM and retention marketing platforms.
  • Familiarity with paid media channels, including Meta and Google.
  • Knowledge of physical music production, distribution, and fulfillment processes.
  • Experience with Luminate reporting, chart strategy, or related music industry tools.
  • Passion for physical music and the independent music landscape.



MNRK Music is a global music company that includes several historic and groundbreaking record labels including Dualtone Records, Last Gang Records, and deep catalog repertoire. We are committed to fostering creativity, diversity, and innovation in the music industry.


This is a hybrid role that will require you to commute to our New York City or Nashville office a minimum of three days a week.

job.title: Senior Software Engineer, Permissions Platform - PDEGO
job.description:
Sony Music’s Product, Design, Engineering and Global Operations (PDEGO) team is looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our Permissions Platform team in our King’s Cross London office.

As a Senior Engineer, you’ll collaborate with the team lead to shape the technical direction and delivery of products that empower artists and record labels around the world. You’ll combine hands-on engineering with technical leadership, working closely with Product, Design, and Engineering partners to turn complex needs into reliable, scalable solutions. You’ll build performant scalable solutions, collaborate with other engineers, and help your team deliver meaningful outcomes for our users.

What you'll do:

● Collaborate on the technical design and delivery of products within a cross-functional team, connecting engineering decisions to user needs and business priorities.
● Develop across our technology stack, writing clean, tested, maintainable code and setting a high standard for engineering quality.
● Balance scalability, reliability, security, and performance with pragmatic delivery.
● Partner closely with Product and Design to understand requirements, assess trade-offs, and break complex initiatives into clear, achievable milestones.
● Participate in technical design discussions and code reviews, communicating decisions clearly and building alignment within your team.
● Drive improvements to testing, observability, deployment practices, and operational reliability.
● Share knowledge and contribute to a collaborative culture of continuous learning and technical ownership.

Who you are:

● You bring 8+ years of software engineering experience.
● You have a strong track record of building and delivering full-stack web applications; we use TypeScript, React, GraphQL, and Python.
● You have experience designing microservices and APIs, with a strong understanding of REST, HTTP, OAuth, and related standards.
● You bring strong knowledge of AWS cloud technologies and experience building and operating reliable production services.
● You understand how to improve application performance, page load times, and reliability.
● You champion automated testing, including unit and integration tests, and practical engineering standards that help teams deliver confidently.
● You communicate clearly with technical and non-technical partners, explaining complex ideas and helping teams make informed decisions.
● You’re comfortable working in an agile, product-led environment, navigating ambiguity, and balancing longer-term technical goals with immediate priorities.
● You enjoy mentoring others and creating an environment where engineers can contribute ideas, take ownership, and grow.

What we give you:

● A competitive salary and bonus scheme.
● Music perks, including free vinyl, gig tickets, live shows in our office, and opportunities to skip the queue at major UK festivals.
● An office environment with breathwork, yoga, and Pilates classes; monthly craft sessions, including perfume making, pottery, and sushi rolling; pub quizzes; and album and single launches.
● An on-site restaurant for breakfast and lunch, plus on-site baristas across two floors.

● Entertainment and dining discounts through Tastecard, NightKey, and Gourmet Society.
● Opportunities to contribute to Sony Music’s Social Justice Fund.
● An inclusive, collaborative, global community where you can help fuel the creative journey.
● A modern office environment designed to support productivity, creativity, and teamwork.
● A generous pension scheme, life assurance, and income protection.
● Investment in your professional growth and development.

About Us:

At Sony Music Entertainment, we fuel the creative journey. We’ve played a pioneering role in music history, from the first-ever music label to the invention of the flat disc record. We’ve nurtured some of music’s most iconic artists and produced some of the most influential recordings of all time.

Today, we work in more than 70 countries, supporting a diverse roster of international superstars, developing and independent artists, and visionary creators. From our position at the intersection of music, entertainment, and technology, we bring imagination and expertise to the newest products and platforms, embrace new business models, employ breakthrough tools, and provide powerful insights that help our artists push creative boundaries and reach new audiences. In everything we do, we’re committed to artistic integrity, transparency, and entrepreneurship.

Sony Music Entertainment is a member of the Sony family of global companies.

job.title: Tax Manager
job.description:
We’re looking for an experienced Tax Manager to help lead BMI’s corporate tax compliance, provision, reporting and planning activities. This hands-on role offers broad exposure across domestic income tax, federal, state, local and international tax matters, as well as information reporting and unclaimed property.

You’ll own key tax workstreams, review work prepared by others, partner closely with teams across Finance and Accounting, and serve as a trusted resource on evolving tax requirements. You’ll also have the opportunity to improve how the function operates through stronger processes, automation and technology.

This role is a great fit for someone who is hands-on, and enjoys both the technical side of tax and the opportunity to build more efficient, scalable ways of working.

What You’ll Do

Lead federal, state and local tax compliance, including income and franchise, sales and use, property, gross receipts and other applicable taxes.

Prepare and review tax returns, workpapers, payments and quarterly estimated payments, ensuring accuracy, timeliness and appropriate documentation.

Review transactional tax work prepared by other team members and provide guidance and feedback to support accurate and compliant filings.

Monitor multi-state nexus and registration requirements and coordinate new state tax registrations as BMI’s business activity expands.

Research evolving tax laws and technical issues, assess their impact on BMI, and document recommendations and tax positions.

Respond to and resolve notices and correspondence from federal, state and local taxing authorities.

Support quarterly and annual income tax provision activities under ASC 740, including deferred tax analysis and effective tax rate reconciliations.

Identify and help implement tax planning opportunities that appropriately manage tax liability and risk.

Support tax matters related to mergers, acquisitions, entity formations, dissolutions and other corporate restructuring activities, as needed.

Partner with Accounts Payable and Royalty Accounting on information reporting, including Forms 1099, 1042 and 1042-S, foreign-payee withholding, and W-9/W-8 documentation.

Manage BMI’s unclaimed property compliance program, including state filings, required due diligence and outreach, and recordkeeping.

Support international tax and reporting requirements, including FBAR and other applicable foreign information returns, Pillar II reporting, withholding tax and transfer pricing matters.

Partner with the International Controller to support statutory financial reporting requirements for international subsidiaries, as needed.

Coordinate relationships with outside tax advisors, consultants and tax technology vendors, including oversight of engagements and related budgets.

Lead process improvement and automation initiatives that make tax and accounting processes more efficient, accurate and scalable.

Develop and maintain tax policies, procedures and controls that reflect current regulatory requirements and internal controls.

Serve as a project lead for departmental initiatives and special projects.

What We’re Looking For

Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance or a related field.

5–7 years of progressive corporate tax experience, with proven experience in domestic income tax.

Strong knowledge of federal, state and local tax requirements, with demonstrated ability to research complex tax matters and translate findings into practical recommendations.

Experience preparing and/or reviewing tax returns and supporting tax compliance processes.

Strong analytical, organizational and project management skills, with the ability to independently manage multiple deadlines and shifting priorities.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex tax matters clearly to non-tax audiences.

A high degree of integrity, discretion and sound judgment when handling sensitive financial information.

Preferred Qualifications and Experience

CPA license.

Master’s degree in Taxation.

Public accounting experience.

International tax experience.

Multi-state franchise, sales and use, and property tax compliance experience.

Experience with Oracle EBS or a similar ERP platform.

Why BMI

Music matters, and so does the work behind it. At BMI, you’ll be part of an organization that helps connect music creators to the compensation they’ve earned while working alongside teams that support the business behind the music.

As Tax Manager, you’ll have the opportunity to make an impact beyond traditional compliance. You’ll help strengthen processes, introduce greater efficiency through technology and automation, and support an organization navigating an increasingly complex domestic and international tax environment.

job.title: Morning Reporter-Producer
job.description:
Morning Reporter-Producer

Help Keep Pittsburgh’s Public Media Strong

Pittsburgh Community Broadcasting Corporation (PCBC), home to 90.5 WESA and 91.3 WYEP, is seeking a skilled and motivated person to join the 90.5 WESA newsroom as our Morning Reporter-Producer.

This position offers an exciting opportunity to help shape the news Pittsburgh wakes up to each morning. We’re looking for someone who works well in a collaborative newsroom, thrives under daily deadlines, and is eager to contribute to the stories that inform and connect the Pittsburgh community.

This position is primarily based in our Pittsburgh office, with flexibility for remote work when job responsibilities and organization needs allow.

Report, write, and produce daily news content.

Collaborate with the Morning Edition host and newsroom to develop newscast rundowns, coordinate coverage, and prepare a timeline for engaging content.

Produce live and recorded interviews, including research topics, preparing hosts and guests, and editing audio for broadcast.

Edit and update news stories to ensure accuracy and adhere to journalistic standards.

Gather audio and reporting materials to support daily coverage and breaking news.

Contribute to additional newsroom projects, which may include feature reporting, podcast production, social media, and station events.

Bachelor’s degree in journalism or a related field, or an equivalent combination of experience and training.

At least one year of professional experience in reporting, radio, or audio production.

Strong writing, storytelling, and digital audio editing skills.

Sound editorial judgment and a commitment to accurate, fair, balanced, and ethical journalism.

Ability to manage competing priorities, meet tight deadlines, and thrive in a fast-paced newsroom environment.

An understanding of the NPR audience and news style.

Pittsburgh Community Broadcasting is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating and maintaining an inclusive, equitable, diverse workplace where all employees feel welcomed, respected, and empowered to succeed.

We value flexibility and understand that supporting work-life balance helps our employees bring their best selves to work every day.

We provide competitive salaries in an affordable city. The minimum compensation for this position is $52,020, commensurate with experience and ability. Our full-time exempt employees also get access to an extensive benefits package, including a 403(b)-retirement plan with 6% company match, medical, dental and vision, three weeks of vacation, sick time, 10 company holidays and 12 weeks of paid new parent leave. You will support the Measurement team within The New York Times Advertising. You will turn campaign results into applicable findings for clients by using first- and third-party campaign metrics. You will become knowledgeable about the sales process and serve as a team liaison with advertising agencies and clients as well as with internal groups.

job.title: Manager, Payments and Fraud Analytics - AEG
job.description:
AXS connects fans with the artists and teams they love. Each year we sell millions of tickets to thousands of incredible events – from concerts and festivals to sports and theater – at some of the most iconic venues in the world. Since our founding in 2011, we’ve consistently pushed the industry forward and improved experiences for fans, making it easier than ever to discover events, find the perfect seats, and enjoy unforgettable live entertainment, and we continue to lead the evolution of our industry today.

We’re passionate about improving the fan experience and providing game-changing solutions for our clients, and we’re always looking for smart, motivated people to help make it happen. Bring your enthusiasm, your big ideas, and your desire to team up with some of the best and brightest in technology and entertainment.  

 

 

The Role

AXS is seeking a Manager, Payments and Fraud to lead macro-level analytics for AXS payment performance and fraud risk. The role uses advanced SQL, data visualization, and payments expertise to identify opportunities to increase authorization and conversion, reduce processing costs, prevent material fraud and chargeback losses, and improve payment reliability across markets, channels, and providers. Unlike transaction-review roles that make accept-or-decline decisions on individual orders, this position analyzes portfolio trends and converts findings into business, product, routing, and risk recommendations. The manager partners with Visa, Mastercard, American Express, ACI, Braintree, Stripe, and internal Product, Engineering, Finance, Operations, and Fraud Prevention teams. The role initially leads through expertise and cross-functional influence and is expected to assume direct people-management responsibility as the analytics team grows.

 

What Will You Do?

  • Lead deep-dive analysis of payment authorization, decline, conversion, routing, settlement, and processing-cost data; identify material trends and quantify opportunities by market, issuer, network, gateway, payment method, and customer segment.
  • Analyze fraud, chargeback, dispute, and loss data at the portfolio level; identify emerging patterns and control gaps, size financial exposure, and recommend changes to fraud strategies, rules, tools, and operating processes.
  • Build and maintain trusted KPI definitions, SQL analyses, dashboards, and executive reporting for payment performance, fraud, chargebacks, costs, and customer impact; establish data-quality controls and clear measurement methods.
  • Develop business cases and lead cross-functional optimization initiatives, experiments, and post-implementation measurement for payment routing, authorization uplift, fraud controls, payment methods, tokenization, 3DS, and cross-border performance.
  • Monitor high-volume on-sales and material payment or fraud events; perform root-cause analysis, coordinate stakeholders, and translate incidents into corrective actions and longer-term improvements.

job.title: DIGITAL CONTENT NEWS PRODUCER - WECT
job.description:
About Gray Media:

Today, we are a growing multimedia company headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia. We are the nation's largest owner of top-rated local television stations and digital assets serving 117 full-power television markets that collectively reach approximately 37% of US television households. The portfolio includes 80 markets with the top-rated television station and 100 markets with the first and/or second highest-rated television station in average all-day ratings across 116 of such markets that were measured by Nielsen in 2025. We also own the largest Telemundo Affiliate group with 46 markets and Gray Digital Media, a full-service digital agency offering national and local clients digital marketing strategies with the most advanced digital products and services. Our additional media properties include video production companies Raycom Sports, Tupelo Media Group, and PowerNation Studios, as well as studio production facilities Assembly Atlanta and Third Rail Studios.

About WECT:

WECT has been informing and entertaining viewers in southeastern North Carolina for 72 years. Live where others vacation! We’re in the rapidly growing Wilmington market, serving New Hanover, Brunswick, Columbus, Pender, and Bladen Counties that make up the beautiful coastal Cape Fear Region. WECT is the dominant broadcast station in the market with the most accessible local news on our broadcast, digital, and streaming platforms.

Job Summary/Description:

Are you obsessed with digital storytelling? Do you thrive when you're not just breaking news, but breaking barriers on streaming and social platforms? WECT is looking for a Digital Content Producer who’s ready to own the screen on our digital platforms.

Duties/Responsibilities will include (but not be limited to) the following:

- Assist in WECT’s digital efforts by creating, curating, and showcasing content with strong editorial, journalistic, organizational, and communication skills.
- Write accurate, concise, AP-style stories for WECT digital, covering a wide range of topics.
- Produce and edit video and photo content for digital platforms; create video playlists, social clips, and photo galleries to enhance coverage.
- Collaborate daily with news managers, producers, reporters, photographers, and the weather team to identify content needs and determine the most effective digital delivery.
-Publish stories and multimedia using the station’s Content Management System; be willing to learn and follow SEO best practices to maximize web traffic and discovery.

job.title: WLKY - Chief Engineer
job.description:
WLKY, the CBS affiliate in Louisville KY is seeking a Chief Engineer to lead the technical operation and continued modernization of a television station. Reporting to the General Manager, this role is a member of the station leadership team and is accountable for the reliability, safety, compliance, and performance of the systems and facilities that support broadcast, news, production, transmission, and digital distribution. The Chief Engineer partners across the station and with Hearst Television teams to keep service dependable today and plan for what comes next. The right candidate will be a proven leader with the ability to motivate teams and build a culture of excellence.

What You’ll Do

Engineering Leadership

  • Lead, coach, and develop the station’s engineering team, including staffing, scheduling, performance feedback, technical training, and on-call coverage.
  • Set priorities and service standards for engineering work, build strong working relationships across departments, and communicate technical issues and their operational impact clearly.
  • Partner with the General Manager and station leaders to align technology plans with local journalism, production, business needs, and Hearst Television standards.

 

Broadcast and Facility Operations

  • Oversee the reliability, maintenance, troubleshooting, and lifecycle planning of broadcast, newsroom, production, automation, master control, media storage, network, streaming, and transmission systems.
  • Maintain station transmission and RF facilities, studios, control rooms, remote production equipment, and critical infrastructure such as generators, UPS, and HVAC systems supporting technical operations.
  • Provide engineering leadership during live programming, breaking news, severe weather, outages, and other urgent events; coordinate response, recovery, and follow-up.

 

Compliance, Safety, and Resilience

  • Ensure required FCC, EAS, and other applicable regulatory and industry obligations are met, with accurate records, scheduled testing, inspections, and timely corrective action.
  • Maintain preventive maintenance, equipment inventory, technical documentation, safety practices, emergency preparedness, backup power, and disaster recovery plans.
  • Coordinate with Hearst Television and enterprise IT partners on cybersecurity, network resilience, access practices, and business continuity for station systems.

 

Planning and Modernization

  • Develop and manage operating and capital budgets, equipment replacement plans, vendor relationships, service contracts, and engineering projects from proposal through implementation.
  • Evaluate and implement improvements to IP-based workflows, automation, cloud or hybrid services, streaming, and other emerging technologies while protecting reliable on-air operations.
  • Use approved AI tools, where appropriate, to support technical research, summarize logs or documentation, identify workflow improvement opportunities, and organize maintenance or project information; verify outputs before use and follow company requirements for confidential, employee, and operational data.
  • Review significant technical incidents, identify root causes, document corrective actions, and apply lessons learned to improve reliability.

 

What You’ll Need

  • At least 7 years of progressively responsible experience in television broadcast engineering, media technology, or a closely related technical field, including experience leading or supervising technical staff.
  • Working knowledge of television broadcast systems, RF transmission, studio and newsroom technologies, automation, IP-based media workflows, and applicable FCC and EAS requirements.
  • Experience planning technical projects, managing budgets and vendors, prioritizing equipment lifecycle needs, and coordinating work across departments.
  • Ability to troubleshoot complex systems, make sound decisions under deadline pressure, and explain technical issues to both technical and non-technical colleagues.
  • Ability to provide support during live operations and occasional nights, weekends, holidays, or emergencies as station needs require.
  • Education, training, or experience in broadcast engineering, electrical engineering, information technology, electronics, or a related field. Hearst Television will consider a college degree, trade school diploma, professional certificates, military training, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Experience with broadcast automation, IP video and audio, streaming, cloud or hybrid media systems, cybersecurity practices, emergency planning, and relevant certifications such as SBE is valued.
  • Related military experience will be considered.

 

Values in Action

At Hearst Television we tell stories every day. Stories about people of all backgrounds, perspectives, and identities. That’s why, behind the scenes, we believe in being an organization that fosters collaboration and open communication, ensuring that the content we create is authentic, accurate, and connected to the communities we serve.

 

Benefits

Hearst's benefit programs are modern, flexible and designed to focus on you. As a Hearst employee, you and your spouse or partner or dependents would have access to the following benefits.

• Medical | Dental | Vision

• 401(k) matching

• Emotional Wellness Support

• Paid Time Off

• Paid Parental Leave

• LGBTQ+ Health Services

• Additional benefits to meet your and your family's needs

job.title: Sales and Marketing Specialist
job.description:
This Job Description May Cause Extreme Excitement and Career Growth 

At AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions, we believe a great workplace isn't just something we say — it's something you can feel when you join the team. Here, it's all about great collabs, ambition, and results but most importantly, we grow here, and we enjoy here.  We're searching for that special someone — a driven, talented individual to join our innovative media sales team. In this role, you'll engage with new and existing clients and show them how our innovative media solutions can amplify their brands and deliver measurable success. If you're energized by building relationships, closing deals, and making an impact, we'd love to hear from you. 

Sound like the right fit? Check out the checklist below and if it sounds like you, hit "Apply Now" and let's chat. 

Your Day-to-Day (aka the Playbook) 

Help Brands Thrive: 

Join our media sales team and play a pivotal role in helping brands and companies grow. By identifying new opportunities, building strong client relationships, and delivering impactful solutions, you'll showcase how our multi-media content platforms and digital assets can drive meaningful results for our partners. 

Your focus will be on helping clients achieve their goals, ensuring that every campaign is a success. When our clients win, we win—and we believe in celebrating those victories together! 

Make Connections: Embrace your powers of persuasion and make every handshake and meeting count! Every interaction is a chance to build a genuine connection and show clients how we can help them succeed. You're not just selling; you're building partnerships. You're helping businesses find the right audience in the right place at the right time. When we say One Partner, Endless Possibilities, we mean it! 

Be A Trusted Guide: In this role, you'll connect with clients on a human level, understand their unique needs, and craft tailored sales and marketing solutions that deliver results. As their trusted advisor, you'll help them navigate the ever-evolving marketing landscape, ensuring every step of the journey is planned with care and precision.  

Shake Things Up: Bring your creativity and fresh ideas to the table! We're looking for someone who challenges the status quo, embraces innovation, and finds new ways to connect with our audience. Your contributions will help elevate our brand and drive meaningful results for your clients.  

Join us and Conquer the Media Landscape: You'll be part of a dedicated team of A1 media sales professionals, committed to achieving market leadership. Together, we amplify our impact, deliver exceptional outcomes, and help our clients succeed in ways that truly matter. 

Identify Emerging Opportunities: It's about being able to see what others can't, anticipating market shifts, analyzing data and predicting the next big thing. Your insights will position our clients and AMP for long-term success.  

What We're Looking For 

Proven Sales Ability (or an Unstoppable Desire to Learn) 

Whether you're a seasoned sales professional or just getting started, we value your drive, energy, and passion for achieving results. 

Strong Communication Skills: You're a natural at building relationships and communicating effectively. Proficiency with digital tools and applications is a must. 

A Passion for helping Others: You're committed to understanding clients' needs, providing top-notch customer service and making a difference. You're not just selling a product; you're providing a solution.  

A Competitive Spirit: Do you get a little boost when you achieve a goal (especially if it was a tough one)? We love that for you (and us)!  We want someone who's driven to excel but also knows how to celebrate the victories (big and small) with their team. That drive makes you a valuable part of our organization.  

A Willingness to Grow: Do you thrive in environments where you're always learning something new? Excellent, you'll fit right in! The media world is constantly evolving, and the ability to learn, adapt, and embrace challenges in a fast-paced, digital-first environment is key.  

The Practical Stuff 

A valid driver's license, up-to-date insurance, and reliable transportation are necessary for connecting with clients in your community. 

Why Join AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions? / The Reasons You Should Hit "Apply Now" 

Serious Work, Seriously Cool People: Be part of a dynamic team that values creativity, collaboration, and fun! We are all for work that is rewarding.  

The Compensation Package: We offer a commission structure and benefits package designed to support your success and well-being. Happy employees don't stage rebellions! ;) 

We Make a Real Difference (Not Just Talk About It): At AMP, we help local businesses thrive through advertising strategies that create tangible impacts. Our media sales specialist isn't just selling ads; they're the boots on the ground, making a real difference where it counts. (And yes, it feels pretty good.) 

Top-Notch Training and Support: We're not the kind of company that hires you and then disappears into the corporate abyss. We carefully select candidates for a cohort-based training program, where you'll join a group of sales professionals from all over the country. From onboarding to ongoing mentorship, we invest in your success with training programs that set you up for long-term growth. 

Career Growth Opportunities: We believe in investing in you. That's why you'll have access to training, mentorship, and career advancement opportunities to help you thrive. We are a leader in our industry, flexing our local charm and national muscle, providing you with options to amplify your career in your local market or join one of our AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions teams in another city.  

Comprehensive Media Education (We Are Your Power Source!): New to the industry? We've got you covered with training programs that turn curiosity into expertise.   

AMP is us. It's you. It isn't just a name; it's a mission. A promise to amplify our reach, amplify our innovation, and most importantly, amplify you. If you're ready to grow your career and help businesses achieve their goals, we'd love to hear from you.
