job.title: AI Solutions Engineer
job.description:
The AI Solutions Engineer is a key role within the AI team that partners with business teams to turn real operational challenges into practical AI-enabled solutions. This person combines strong business curiosity, consultative problem-solving, and hands-on AI capability in designing, building, testing, and improving sophisticated AI agents and workflows.

They will help teams identify where AI can create meaningful value, translate needs into clear solution designs, and build usable prototypes and production-ready solutions in collaboration with business stakeholders and technical partners.

This position is on-site in Hunt Valley, MD. Candidates must be local or willing to commute.

Key Responsibilities

Partner with the business

  • Partner with business units to understand their goals, processes, pain points, and opportunities for improvement.
  • Participate in discovery sessions that translate ambiguous business problems into well-defined AI solution requirements.
  • Collaborate with the broader AI team to shape solution designs, provide practical feedback on feasibility and user needs, and help prioritize the AI opportunity pipeline based on business value, complexity, risk, and strategic alignment.
  • Work with data, technology, security, legal, and risk partners to ensure solutions are reliable, responsible, and appropriate for the business context.

Build and integrate

  • Design, build, and iterate AI agents, copilots, automations, and workflow integrations using modern AI platforms and tools.
  • Develop agent instructions, tools, knowledge sources, guardrails, and human-review workflows.
  • Create prototypes that demonstrate value quickly, then help evolve successful concepts into durable solutions.

Test and improve

  • Define success metrics and evaluation approaches before build, so each solution has a clear bar for what good looks like.
  • Test AI solutions for accuracy, usefulness, safety, consistency, and user experience; continuously improve them based on feedback and performance data.
  • Monitor solutions in production for adoption and accuracy drift; retire or rework anything that no longer meets its success bar.

Enable and share

  • Explain AI capabilities, limitations, tradeoffs, and recommended practices in clear, non-technical language.
  • Build adoption through training, documentation, office hours, and hands-on support for business users.
  • Stay current on AI tools, agent patterns, governance practices, and emerging opportunities; bring relevant ideas back to the organization.

 

Required Qualifications

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience building AI agents, copilots, or automations using generative AI platforms, APIs, low-code tools, or development frameworks, including work with structured and unstructured data, knowledge bases, and retrieval-augmented generation.
  • 5-7+ years experience solving business problems through process improvement, consulting, business analysis, operations, or a similar role, with demonstrated ability to work with non-technical stakeholders and build trust across business functions
  • Hands-on experience building AI agents, copilots, or automations using generative AI platforms, APIs, low-code tools, or development frameworks, including work with structured and unstructured data, knowledge bases, and retrieval-augmented generation.
  • Experience solving business problems through process improvement, consulting, business analysis, operations, or a similar role, with demonstrated ability to work with non-technical stakeholders and build trust across business functions.
  • Basic programming or scripting capability, such as Python, JavaScript, SQL, or API integration, with experience in workflow automation, systems integration, or service design.
  • Experience evaluating AI systems (test cases, quality measurement, prompt iteration, monitoring) and applying responsible AI practices (privacy, security, model risk, change management).
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to make technical topics understandable and actionable.
  • Sound judgment about when AI is appropriate versus a simpler solution, and comfort experimenting, learning quickly, and moving concepts to usable solutions.

 

Preferred Qualifications

  • Ability to translate business requirements into solution designs, user journeys, and measurable success criteria.
  • Product management experience, including working with product roadmaps and stakeholder prioritization.
  • Media or broadcast industry experience, including familiarity with newsroom, sales, or traffic operations, or systems such as WideOrbit or OSI.
  • Experience with modern agent frameworks and evaluation tooling, such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, OpenAI Agents SDK, Model Context Protocol, LangSmith, or Braintrust.
  • Data analysis and enterprise data platform experience, such as Snowflake, Power BI, or dbt, and SQL beyond basics.
  • Prior experience on an internal AI enablement, digital transformation, or innovation team.

 

What Success Looks Like

The AI Solutions Engineer is a constructive, trusted contributor to the broader AI team, bringing business-unit insight into solution design and helping the organization focus its AI investment on the highest-value opportunities. Within the first year, the AI Solutions Engineer will have delivered several solutions that improve productivity, quality, speed, or customer and employee experience. They will be known as a practical business partner who can turn AI potential into responsible, measurable results.

Core Competencies

Senior Web Software Engineer (New York / Los Angeles / San Francisco / Ft. Lauderdale)


In This Role You’ll:


Paramount is seeking a Senior Software Engineer to join the Web Architecture team, responsible for building and maintaining the foundational frontend platform that powers Paramount+ and other supported brands. In this role, you’ll serve as a technical authority across frontend teams by defining patterns, reviewing architectural decisions, and helping teams navigate complex challenges. The position involves designing, extending, and evolving a shared framework in a fast-paced, collaborative environment that values agility, innovation, and high technical standards.


We are seeking an engineer who can work independently in large codebases, write clear and maintainable code, and balance correctness, performance, and user impact. The ideal candidate contributes beyond their immediate team, communicates tradeoffs effectively, advocates sound architecture with pragmatism, and documents decisions through scalable, asynchronous channels. CI/CD, observability, and code quality are treated as core responsibilities, not afterthoughts.


Responsibilities:


● Build and maintain Next.js micro-frontend applications orchestrated via Module Federation which powers Paramount+ and Pluto.tv Web applications

Overview:


The Pluto TV Content Operations team intakes, prepares, and publishes every title on our streaming service. We are a global team, based in the US, South America, and Europe. Each year we support twelve regional instances and tens of thousands of assets for hundreds of partners!

 

We are seeking a Director, Content Operations to guide our US content workflows and team. This role is a true team leader! You will be based in the United States. You will build a skilled, accountable team that keeps growing. You will also be our main voice with partners and teams.

 

You will own the US content pipeline: partner onboarding, ingestion, QC, metadata, packaging, and publishing. Every title ships on schedule, to spec, and at the highest quality! You will also scale the team wisely: developing talent, refining processes, and managing capacity. That way we handle more volume at the same quality and speed.

 

Operational excellence is the standard you set and keep. That means a pipeline that runs smoothly at scale, partners who get clear guidance, and a team energized by finding better ways to work. The ideal candidate pairs a talent for growing people with deep technical skill. You love to invent and automate, using cloud tools and data to build operations that scale.

 

You will work closely with Content Partnerships, Programming, Product, Marketing, and Pluto TV Streaming Operations. You will keep improving the Pluto TV viewer experience. You will also align with our International Content Operations leads in Europe and South America. That keeps global standards, best practices, and one way of working.

Content Delivery & Operational Workflow Leadership

 

  • Oversee the U.S. content operations production workflow, including onboarding, asset delivery, QC, metadata, artwork, closed captions, audio, ad-break structure, and final publishing.

  • Participate in global operations meetings and task forces supporting Paramount’s shared streaming infrastructure. 

 

Operational Analytics & KPI’s 

 

  • Track KPIs for output, quality, pace, and partner trust.
  • Build forecasts, budget plans, and staffing plans, and help fix supply chain gaps.

Technology, Tooling & Systems Expertise 

 

  • Maintain proficiency with MAM/CMS tools, cloud-based infrastructures and delivery systems, and automated ingestion workflows (S3, FTP, API, JSON/XML/MRSS feed ingestion). 
  • Partner with Content Systems Product and Engineering to define features that enhance Pluto TV’s content supply chain, automation capabilities, and operational observability. 
  • Ensure operational requirements are represented in tooling roadmaps and platform updates.

Compliance & Standards 

 

  • Follow FCC and platform rules for captions, access, and children's content.
  • Keep up with U.S. and global content rules, ad limits, and ratings.

  • Experience in managing content compliance elements (Closed Captions & Audio Description) and regional regulatory 
    requirements. 
  • Experience with JSON schema’s, XML and Content Metadata formats. 
  • Expertise in operational documentation, workflow design, and project management. 
  • Experience managing vendors, negotiating rates, and evaluating performance. 
  • Proficiency in MS Office, Google Workspace, and industry-standard media operations tools. 
  • Exceptional communication, problem-solving, and organizational skills. 

 

Additional Qualifications:

 

  • Bachelor’s degree in TV/Film, Media Operations, Digital Production, or related field. 
  • Experience in FAST, AVOD, SVOD, or other streaming environments.

The Senior Vice President, Finance Innovation is a newly created, high-visibility leadership role responsible for reimagining how the Finance organization operates through the application of artificial intelligence and agentic automation. This role will identify, champion, and implement AI-driven opportunities across the Finance function, with a particular focus on building agentic workflows and AI systems capable of autonomously executing multi-step financial processes with human oversight, across Accounting, Forecasting & FP&A, Treasury, Tax, and operational finance areas unique to a media and entertainment enterprise, including Production Finance and Participations & Residuals. This leader will serve as the bridge between Finance, Technology, and Data/AI teams, translating complex financial processes into scalable, intelligent automation while maintaining rigorous controls, auditability, and compliance standards appropriate for a large public company. The successful candidate will combine deep finance domain expertise with a strong point of view on emerging AI capabilities, and the organizational influence to drive adoption across a broad and often decentralized finance ecosystem. As Finance advances its Fusion systems integration, this leader will be a key voice in shaping how that effort intersects with Finance's broader innovation and automation agenda.  

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

  • Define and lead the enterprise Finance Innovation strategy and multi-year roadmap for AI and agentic workflow adoption across all Finance sub-functions.
  • Partner with the CFO organization and Finance leadership to identify, prioritize, and business-case AI opportunities based on value creation, risk profile, and feasibility. 
  • Build and maintain a prioritized pipeline of use cases spanning close and consolidation, reconciliations, forecasting and variance analysis, cash and liquidity management, tax provision and compliance, and production finance/participations & residuals calculations and reporting.
  • Stay ahead of the external AI and finance-technology landscape (agentic frameworks, LLM-based finance copilots, RPA-to-agentic evolution) and translate relevant developments into actionable internal opportunities.
  • Partner with Product, Technology, Data & Analytics, and external delivery partners on agentic workflow and AI-tool initiatives as the Finance domain voice, defining use cases, finance requirements, and success criteria, and providing continuous feedback through design, build, and deployment. Product and Technology direct solution design, engineering, and production deployment; this role ensures what gets built reflects finance process reality and business need.
  • Own finance-side accountability across the delivery lifecycle: opportunity identification and prioritization, requirements definition, controls and change management within Finance, driving adoption, and validating realized value while Product and Technology own solution design, build, and rollout execution.
  • Specify the finance control requirements agentic systems must meet: human-in-the-loop oversight, exception handling, and escalation, and validate that the frameworks Product and Technology implement keep those systems within Finance's risk, controls, and SOX/regulatory boundaries. 
  • Convene Internal Audit, SOX, and Compliance to define the control and documentation standards AI-driven finance processes must satisfy, and carry those requirements into the Product and Technology build so solutions meet public-company standards.
  • Partner closely with the EVP of Integration on systems integration work related to Fusion, ensuring Finance requirements, controls, and adoption considerations are represented as Fusion capabilities are integrated into Finance systems and processes.
  • Accounting & Close: Identify opportunities for agentic automation in journal entries, reconciliations, close checklists, and financial reporting. 
  • Forecasting & FP&A: Champion AI-augmented forecasting, scenario modeling, and variance analysis to improve speed and accuracy of business planning.
  • Treasury: Explore agentic support for cash positioning, liquidity forecasting, bank reconciliations, and risk monitoring.
  • Tax: Identify AI applications in tax provision, compliance documentation, and regulatory research and monitoring. 
  • Production Finance: Drive automation of production cost tracking, budget-to-actual analysis, and studio/content cost reporting specific to media production.
  • Participations & Residuals: Champion agentic solutions for the complex, high-volume calculations, contract interpretation, and reporting inherent to participations and residuals processing. 
  • Serve as a visible champion and educator for AI adoption, building Finance-wide fluency and comfort with agentic tools through training, communication, and hands-on enablement.
  • Develop governance structures, including an AI use-case intake process and a Finance Innovation council or working group with representation across Finance sub-functions.
  • Partner with HR and Finance leadership to evolve talent, role design, and ways of working as agentic workflows shift the nature of finance work.
  • Manage change resistance thoughtfully, ensuring adoption is durable and supported by the broader finance organization rather than imposed top-down. Stakeholder Management & Reporting
  • Regularly report progress, value delivered, and roadmap updates to executive leadership, including the CFO and relevant Audit/Risk committees as appropriate.
  • Build strong relationships with Technology, Data/AI, Legal, business-unit finance leaders, and the EVP of Integration to ensure alignment and shared ownership of innovation initiatives, including Fusion-related systems integration work. 
  • Represent the company's Finance Innovation agenda in relevant internal forums and, where appropriate, external industry settings.

 

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, or related field required; MBA, CPA, or equivalent advanced credential preferred.
  • 15+ years of progressive finance, accounting, or FP&A experience, ideally within a large, complex, public media, entertainment, or content organization. 
  • Demonstrated track record leading finance transformation, process automation, or technology-enabled change initiatives at scale. 
  • Hands-on familiarity with AI/ML concepts, generative AI, and agentic or RPA-based automation, and how they apply to financial processes; direct experience implementing such tools strongly preferred.
  • Experience with production finance and/or participations and residuals processes is a plus given the specialized nature of these areas in media and entertainment.
  • Prior exposure to SOX controls, internal audit requirements, and the governance considerations of deploying automation in a public-company financial environment. 

 

Additional Qualifications:

  • Strong finance and accounting fundamentals combined with genuine curiosity about, and fluency in, emerging AI capabilities.
  • Executive presence and the ability to influence senior stakeholders across Finance, Technology, and business units without direct authority over all of them.
  • Proven ability to translate technical AI/automation concepts into business terms finance professionals can act on, and vice versa.
  • Strong program and change management skills, with comfort operating in ambiguity and building new organizational muscle from scratch.
  • Sound judgment regarding risk, controls, and the appropriate pace and boundaries of automation in regulated financial processes.

job.description:
#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?
We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, we’ve got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is… YOU! Becoming a part of Paramount means joining a team of passionate people who not only recognize the power of content but also enjoy a touch of fun and uniqueness. Director, Product Management (CBS Sports Web)
Location: Nashville, TN / New York, NY / Los Angeles, CA Type: Full-Time, On-Site Org: CBS Sports Digital, Product, Design & Engineering


#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?
We've got the brands, we've got the stars, we've got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet. Now all we're missing is
YOU. Becoming a part of Paramount means joining a team of passionate people who not only recognize the power of content but also
enjoy a touch of fun and uniqueness. Together we co-create moments that matter, both for our audiences and our employees, and aim to
leave a positive mark on culture.


Overview
Own the product direction for one of the largest sports sites on the internet. CBSSports.com is the front door to CBS Sports for tens of millions of fans. It is where scores, live gametrackers, news, fantasy, and betting come together during the biggest moments in sports: the NFL, March Madness, The Masters, college football, Champions League, and more. This role owns the product strategy for the full web experience. You will lead a small PM team, work directly with design and engineering leads across squads, and stay close to the work. This is a player-coach role. You set the direction, and you're in the details.


Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

  • Set product strategy for CBSSports.com and translate it into clear priorities teams can act on. Own the web plan. Decide what we're building, sequence the work, balance risk, track outcomes, and make the hard calls on what to
    continue, change, or stop.
  • Treat web as the reach and discovery engine for CBS Sports. Grow organic and direct traffic, sharpen high-intent surfaces like
    gametrackers and scores, and turn anonymous visitors into registered users.
  • Own the role web plays in the broader portfolio: growing registered users at scale and converting web audiences into sticky products
    like the CBS Sports App.
  • Prototype to think. We build working prototypes to remove ambiguity, test ideas with real fans, and learn before we commit. You'll use
    tools like Claude and Cursor to make concepts tangible, iterate on what you learn, and arrive at a better strategy because you've held
    the thing in your hand.
  • Coach and develop 1 to 2 PMs through structured feedback, calibration, and deliberate growth planning.
  • Partner with design and engineering directors on cross-squad alignment, delivery cadence, and how we evolve our process.
  • Partner with editorial to make web the place where great storytelling and great product meet.
  • Represent product to executive leadership. Turn fan behavior, competitive dynamics, and product performance into a clear narrative that builds trust.

 

How We Build (The Builder Culture)
We've moved past feature factories, PRDs, and slow-motion handoffs. We work in small, cross-functional squads with fixed timeboxes, clear ownership, and a focus on outcomes over output. When we need to figure out whether an idea works, we build a prototype and put
it in front of fans. The goal is not a finished feature. It's removing ambiguity fast enough to make better decisions. AI is how we make this possible. PMs prototype in code using tools like Claude and Cursor. Not to ship production features, but to make
ideas tangible, test them with users, and learn before we commit. Designers do the same. Engineers ship with AI as a pair programmer. We build internal tools with prompts when a workflow can be automated. This is the operating expectation, and as a Director, you'll
model it and push what's possible further. The result is that we move faster than our size suggests. Small teams, short cycles, real signals from real fans, and the autonomy to act on what you learn without waiting for permission. 

 

What success looks like:

  • The web product strategy is coherent.
  • People across the organization understand what we're building, why, and what we're choosing not
    to do. 
  • Web reliably grows reach, grows registered users, and feeds the rest of the portfolio.
  • The funnel from anonymous visitor to registered user to sticky-product user gets measurably stronger.
  • High-intent surfaces like gametrackers and scores get sharper and convert better, especially during tentpole events when traffic peaks. Ideas are tested before they're committed.
  • Teams prototype, learn from fans, and start building with real clarity.
  • Fewer false starts, less rework.
    PMs on your team grow their craft visibly and operate with stronger judgment over time.
  • Prioritization decisions are defensible, tied to measurable fan impact, and adjusted when the signal says so.
  • Stakeholders trust your perspective because you bring receipts, not just opinions.


Basic Qualifications

  • 10+ years in product, with meaningful time in a leadership role. Consumer web at scale, ideally high-traffic and real-time. You've owned the strategy, shipped against it, and developed other PMs.


Additional Qualifications

job.description:

TEGNA is looking for a Director, Product Marketing to lead go-to-market strategy and messaging for our linear and streaming TV and advertising business, with a strong focus on Premion, TEGNA's streaming ad platform (DSP). This role reports directly to the VP of B2B and Integrated Marketing and sits at the intersection of Product, Sales, and Marketing. The Director will translate platform capabilities into clear, compelling positioning that helps our sales teams win and grow streaming advertising revenue — and will build and lead a small product marketing team. They will identify and translate the needs of our key customer segments, mid-sized to large SMBs and the agencies that serve them, as well as our publisher partners, to the larger organization.

This is a high-visibility leadership role for someone energized by the pace of the CTV/streaming market who wants to shape how TEGNA tells its story to agencies and advertisers — and who is ready to develop talent alongside doing the work.

Key Responsibilities 

Product and Sales Collaboration

  • Partner deeply with Product to translate CTV/streaming and Premion DSP capabilities into positioning, messaging, and sales-ready narratives
  • Act as the voice of the customer in product conversations, advocating for solutions and features that deliver the most value to advertisers and agencies
  • Build strong working relationships across product, sales, customer success and other key stakeholders to stay ahead of roadmap changes and market shifts

Messaging and Positioning 

  • Own product marketing messaging for Premion and TEGNA's broader CTV/streaming offering, ensuring consistency with TEGNA's brand pillars and current terminology
  • Develop clear, differentiated positioning against competitors in the CTV/streaming ad tech space
  • Translate complex product and data capabilities — outcomes-based buying, first-party data, audience targeting — into messaging that resonates with agencies and advertisers

Sales Enablement 

  • Design, create and oversee sales enablement assets — pitch decks, one-pagers, talking points, objection-handling guides, case studies — that equip the sales organization to grow streaming advertising revenue
  • Partner with sales leadership to identify enablement gaps and prioritize asset development accordingly
  • Train and support sales teams on new product launches, features, and positioning updates

Revenue Growth and Market Focus 

  • Support pipeline growth for streaming advertising by arming sales with the right tools at the right moments in the sales cycle
  • Build messaging and enablement tailored to local and regional agency buyers, a key and growing segment for TEGNA
  • Partner with Marketing Strategy and Insights on packaging, upfront kits, and go-to-market campaigns tied to CTV/streaming priorities

Team Leadership 

  • Manage and develop a Product Marketing Analyst, setting clear priorities, providing regular coaching, and building their capability over time
  • Model strong cross-functional partnership and help the broader B2B Marketing team understand and use product positioning effectively
  • Build scalable processes for asset management, messaging governance, and sales enablement delivery

Qualifications 

  • 10+ years in product marketing, with meaningful experience in digital content, CTV, or streaming media (ad tech, media company, or streaming platform background preferred)
  • Demonstrated leadership experience — prior people management preferred, but strong mentorship and cross-functional leadership also considered
  • Proven track record building messaging and positioning for advertising or media products, ideally in a DSP, ad platform, or programmatic environment
  • Demonstrated success partnering cross-functionally with Product and Sales, including building sales enablement materials that directly drove revenue
  • Experience working with or selling to local and regional agencies is a strong plus
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, able to translate technical/product complexity into clear, persuasive messaging for both internal and external audiences
  • Comfortable operating in a fast-changing, ambiguous market and adapting messaging as the competitive and product landscape shifts
  • Bachelor's degree required; MBA a plus but not required

Location and Reporting 

  • New York City or Washington, D.C. metro area preferred but not required; hybrid work model
  • Reports directly to the VP of B2B and Integrated Marketing
  • Manages: Product Marketing Analyst
  • Some travel expected for sales meetings, agency visits, and industry events #LI-MS1

job.title: Local Government and Growth Reporter-Omaha, NE
job.description:
Local Government and Growth Reporter-Omaha, NE

The Omaha World-Herald, a Lee Enterprises publication, is looking for a self-starter who likes to dig into local government, growth and development. Like writing about trash and potholes? Motivated to find the truth behind misspent funds? Wondering about the impact of data centers on public power rates? Ever ask where recycled materials get used? We’re your kind of place.This beat isn’t about sitting through gavel-to-gavel meetings to write a story. It’s about accountability, infrastructure and the pocketbook issues that shape life across the Omaha area. You will track how local officials spend taxpayer dollars, examine planning and zoning decisions and massive infrastructure projects. You'll follow paper trails to explain why decisions were made and how those decisions impact people in the community.What You’ll Do: Break enterprise and watchdog stories. We'll have you use public records, campaign finance filings, contracts and municipal budgets to find waste, policy shifts, and systemic issues before other outlets notice them.You'll also cover growth and infrastructure investments, report on the forces reshaping the region — from commercial development and residential expansion to data center energy demands, water resources, transit and public works. And we want our reporters to translate public policy for people. We hunt for stories that impact residents, neighborhoods and businesses. We also love someone who understands the value of short-form video in reaching our audiences where they are.

Why Join Us?

Lee Enterprises offers competitive wages in a dynamic, interesting work environment with career growth opportunities.  We offer an extensive benefit program that can be personalized to your needs. Our benefit program includes medical, dental, vision, short and long-term disability, company provided life insurance and supplemental life insurance. In addition, we offer a 401K retirement plan with company match.  We also offer generous paid time off to allow flexibility to balance personal life and work.  This includes paid parental leave for new parents.

Lee Enterprises is a leading provider of local news and information and a major subscription and advertising platform, with daily and weekly newspapers and rapidly expanding digital products serving 114 markets across 25 states. Our core commitment is to provide valuable, intensely local news and information to the communities we serve.

Lee Enterprises is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We respect and celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

job.title: Business Analyst (Year in Industry)
job.description:
The Global Business Development & Digital Strategy team, split evenly between New York and London, focuses on executing and renewing revenue-generating commercial deals monetizing Sony Music’s vast catalogue with a broad range of companies globally, from major streaming partners such as Spotify, Amazon, Apple, YouTube and TikTok to the next generation of music and technology start-ups. You will join an international team of data-savvy negotiators and business analysts, who operate on the front lines with strong work ethic and genuine team spirit. If you're a penultimate-year undergraduate looking for a placement year, this is an opportunity to spend 12 months at the centre of the global music industry's digital transformation.
 
During your Year in Industry as Business Analyst, you will be trained and exposed to digital distribution deal structures and strategies. You will gain an understanding of how music copyrights are licensed, of the general structure of our industry, and of how commercial agreements with global and multi-territory digital partners are negotiated and executed. You will grow your ability to summarise complex thoughts, crystallise situations and potential options, isolate action points and communicate them effectively in writing to stakeholders. What makes this role unusual is the level of exposure. You'll have the opportunity to work directly with analysts, dealmakers and senior leaders in London and New York, gaining insight into commercial decision-making that most students only encounter years into their careers.
 
You will prepare and maintain benchmarking analysis tools and contribute to ad hoc projects including researching markets and business opportunities, documenting and comparing commercial agreements, building revenue forecasts and conducting in depth business analysis while working closely with negotiators and senior business analysts. You will establish yourself as a point of contact for queries relating to these areas by forging strong relationships across the business and with external contacts.

Please note: This application form cannot be saved part-way through. We recommend preparing your answers in a separate document and then copying them into the form when you’re ready to submit. If you have any reasonable adjustment requests, please reach out to recruitment.support@sonymusic.com.

What you'll do:

  • You have a strong interest in media, entertainment, technology and digital business, and enjoy understanding how innovation creates new opportunities, changes consumer behaviour and transforms industries. A passion for music is a plus.
  • You are excited by the potential of AI and emerging technologies and interested in how they can be applied to solve business problems, improve decision-making and create concrete opportunities for growth.

You have strong Excel and PowerPoint skills, an interest in data visualisation tools such as Sigma, Power BI, Tableau or Alteryx, and some exposure to quantitative analysis, financial modelling or data-driven problem solving. job.title: Engineering Manager - Ads
job.description:
About SoundCloud

What's next in music happens on SoundCloud first. As the world’s largest open audio platform, SoundCloud is powered by a connected community of creators, listeners, and curators who share, discover, and influence what’s new, now, and next in music and audio.

We are looking for an Engineering Manager to lead our Ads ML (Machine Learning) team within the Growth, Revenue and Commerce group, and to take SoundCloud's ad delivery into the machine learning era.

Advertising is one of SoundCloud's core revenue streams. It earns money directly, and it is also one of the main ways free listeners discover and move to a paid subscription. That revenue pays creators on our platform, covers content costs, and keeps SoundCloud a healthy, independent company. Getting ad delivery right matters to listeners, artists, and the business.

Our team builds the systems that decide which ads SoundCloud listeners hear and see, how many, and when. We're replacing fixed rules with ML: contextual bandits and predictive models (churn risk, subscription propensity, user LTV) that set ad load for each listener in real time. The goal is more ad revenue without hurting retention, and you'll decide how far and how fast we get there.

This is a hybrid leadership role with a strong hands-on component. You'll lead a team of four backend and ML engineers, contribute directly to the codebase, and own the technical direction of machine learning driven ad delivery. You'll work closely with client engineers, data analysts, and product, and report to the Director of Engineering in a flat structure.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Own the ML roadmap for ad delivery. Take personalised ad serving (contextual bandits, churn and subscription-propensity models) from experiment to production across markets, and decide what the team builds next.
  • Own the production ML stack behind ad decisions: online model serving, real-time bandit decisioning, feature pipelines, and model evaluation and monitoring.
  • Build a rigorous experimentation practice for ML: offline and online evaluation, A/B test design, guardrail metrics, and clear ship-or-hold decisions on ad load and user LTV.
  • Own the backend ad delivery services that turn model decisions into the ads served on iOS, Android and web.
  • Partner with client engineers, data analysts and product on the roadmap, balancing revenue, retention and ad inventory.
  • Grow the team's ML depth through hiring, mentorship and career development, and manage performance effectively.

Background & Experience:

  • 2+ years of engineering management experience.
  • 5+ years as a backend software developer. You're comfortable writing code, discussing trade-offs and taking part in system design.
  • Hands-on experience building and running ML systems in production: model serving, real-time decisioning, feature pipelines, and monitoring for model drift and data quality.
  • Solid grasp of applied ML for decision-making (bandits, ranking, recommendation or propensity models), deep enough to challenge modelling choices and trade-offs with the team.
  • Strong experiment design skills, including statistical rigour and the trade-off between short-term revenue and long-term retention.
  • Experience managing engineers, including coaching, feedback and performance development.
  • Clear communication with technical and non-technical stakeholders, including explaining ML trade-offs in business terms.

Bonus Points

  • Experience in ad tech, ad serving or large-scale experimentation on a large consumer platform.
  • Contextual or multi-armed bandits, reinforcement learning or uplift modelling in production.
  • ML platform tooling: feature stores, model registries and workflow
  • User LTV, churn or subscription-propensity modelling.
  • Ad standards and integrations: VAST, programmatic demand (SSPs and DSPs), frequency capping.
  • Audio or video advertising.
  • Scala or another JVM language, and Python for ML work.

If you're excited about bringing machine learning to ad delivery at scale, leading a team, and shaping how millions of listeners experience ads on SoundCloud, we'd love to hear from you.

About us:

  • We are a multinational company with offices in the US (New York and Los Angeles), Germany (Berlin), and the UK (London)

  • We provide a flexible work culture that offers the opportunity to collaborate and connect in person at our offices as well as accommodating work from home

  • We are deeply committed to ensuring diversity, equity and inclusion at all levels of our organization and fostering a community where everyone’s voice, perspective and experience is respected and heard.

  • We believe a strong team is made by investing in employees through mentorship, workshops and enrichment opportunities

Benefits:

  • Interested in a gym membership, photography course or book? We have a Creativity and Wellness benefit!

  • Employee Equity Plan

  • Generous professional development allowance

  • Flexible vacation and public holiday policy where you can take up to 35 days of PTO annually

  • Various snacks, goodies, and 2 free lunches weekly when at the office

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion at SoundCloud

SoundCloud is for everyone. Diversity and open expression are fundamental to our organization; they help us lead what’s next in music by understanding and empowering our creators and fans, no matter their identity. We acknowledge the challenges in the music industry, and strive to influence an inclusive culture where everyone can contribute respectfully and thrive, especially the historically marginalized communities that many of our creators, fans and SoundClouders identify with. We are dedicated to creating an inclusive environment at SoundCloud for everyone, regardless of gender identity, sexual orientation, race, ethnicity, migration background, national origin, age, disability status, or care-giver status.

At SoundCloud you can find your community or elevate your allyship by joining a Diversity Resource Group. Diversity Resource Groups are employee-organized groups focused on supporting and promoting the interests of a particular underrepresented community in order to build a more inclusive culture at SoundCloud. Anyone can join, whether you share the identity or strive to be an ally.

job.title: Education Officer
job.description:
The Guardian Foundation is a charitable body whose purpose is to promote global press freedom and access to liberal journalism. Our vision is a world where people have access to reliable information from a diverse range of sources, strengthening their ability to hold power to account.

Through our news and media literacy programmes, we empower children and young people with the critical skills they need to navigate and engage with news in an informed way.

Our news and media literacy programmes, NewsWise (for primary students) and Behind the Headlines (for secondary, further, and higher education), equip young people with the skills to critically analyse news, engage with journalism, and navigate an increasingly complex media landscape.
 

The Guardian Foundation is now looking for an Education Officer for a 12 month fixed term contract to work across The Guardian Foundation’s news and media literacy programmes, delivering high-quality workshops and developing engaging educational resources. 

 

This is a part time role, 3 days per week on Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday each week. Hours are typically 8am - 4pm on workshop delivery days, and 9:30am - 5:30pm on non-delivery days, with 2 days per week required in office. 

 

About the Role

 

  • Deliver engaging news and media literacy workshops to primary and secondary students (Key Stages 2 - 5) both in-person and online. Workshops are delivered in various settings: in primary and secondary schools, in our Education Centre in the Guardian’s office, and in informal settings (eg. libraries), including occasional travel where required.
  • Lead and support the development and updating of high quality learning resources and schemes of work for teachers and students across Key Stage 2 - 5
  • Adapt sessions and resources to different age groups and educational needs, ensuring accessibility and inclusion.
  • Translate workshop content into scalable formats (e.g. lesson plans, classroom activities, digital and printable resources)
  • Maintain and develop relationships with schools, universities, teachers, and community groups.

 

About You

This is not a prescriptive list, and we do not expect applicants to meet every item outlined below. We believe that this role would suit someone looking to build on their existing experiences and skills, whilst also having an understanding of their personal and professional development goals.

 

  • Qualified teacher status (QTS), with at least 2 years' experience delivering high quality educational sessions to young people. 
  • Ability to adapt teaching and delivery across a range of age groups (eg. KS2 - 5 and / or post-16 learners).
  • Experience developing and designing high-quality educational resources or curriculum materials.
  • Good understanding of the UK curricula and current education priorities.
  • An interest in news and current affairs, with an understanding of the importance of news and media literacy.
  • Willingness and ability to travel occasionally within London and across the UK to support programme delivery and training, including occasional overnight stays.

 

The salary band for this fixed term contract is £21,000-22,2000 based on 3 days per week (£35,000-37,000 full time equivalent).

 

This post is subject to an enhanced Disclosure and Barring Service (DBS) check. The Guardian Foundation is committed to safeguarding the children and adults at risk with whom it works. The successful candidate will be expected to adhere to our policy and code of conduct. 

 

We value and respect all differences (seen and unseen) in all people at The Guardian Foundation. We aspire to have inclusive working experiences and an environment that reflects the audience we serve, where our people have equal access to career development opportunities, their voices are heard and can contribute to our future. The Guardian Foundation actively encourages applications from candidates underrepresented within the media and not-for-profit sectors. 

 

How to Apply

 

To apply, please upload your latest CV and a cover letter which outlines why you’d love to take on this role, and why you’re a great match for what we’re looking for. A cover letter is required for your application. 

 

We appreciate the time taken to prepare each application we receive. We do not use AI-assisted technology to review applications; every application is reviewed by a member of our recruitment team.

 

The closing date for applications is 10am on Monday 2nd November 2026. 

Interviews are expected to take place at our Kings Cross office w/c 16th November 2026.

 All roles at the Guardian are open for everybody to apply. It is important to us that you feel supported and comfortable throughout your recruitment process, in order to perform your best. Please let us know if there are any changes we could make to help your application, this includes providing documents in accessible formats or personalising the process to better support your needs. Please contact Anna Vipers on anna.vipers@theguardian.com to discuss further so we can work with you to support you through your application.

Benefits at the The Guardian Foundation

 You'll have six weeks of annual leave per year (plus bank holidays) with the option to purchase an additional 5 days. Our pension scheme is generous; if you contribute 5% then we will contribute 8-12% (depending on your age). We believe in giving back, which is why employees are given 2 volunteering days annually and the option of payroll giving. Season ticket loans are also available.

You are entitled to life cover, income protection, and eye tests. You can also opt in to dental insurance.

We have enhanced maternity, paternity, adoption and shared parental leave policies in place. We also support our employees by offering an IVF, menopause, baby loss, and trans equality policy.

job.title: Audience Development Executive- Fixed term Contract
job.description:
About us

The Financial Times is one of the world’s leading news organisations, globally recognised for its authority, integrity and accuracy, with a mission to deliver quality information and services worldwide.

At the FT, curiosity thrives and ambitious thinking is rewarded. Here, you’re given the chance to reach millions, create work that matters and deliver impartial journalism in a polarised world.

In our warm, collaborative culture, you’ll connect with a diverse community of experts who support your growth, career aspirations and wellbeing.

Your future at the FT will be filled with opportunities that challenge and inspire you. With no fixed path, you’ll discover new skills and forge a career that can take you anywhere.

Build a newsworthy career at the FT.

Our commitment to diversity, equity and inclusion

We believe in the power of unique perspectives and want all voices in our organisation to be heard, respected and valued. A supportive workplace is one where employees feel they can be themselves and operate to their full potential. We are committed to removing barriers for everyone, with a focus on addressing those faced by underrepresented groups.

The role 

FT Live is the global conferences and events division of the Financial Times Group. We deliver more than 200 events a year, including large-scale global summits, bespoke client forums, and digital conferences. Our events convene world-class speakers and bring together senior executives, policymakers, and thought leaders across industries and geographies.

The Audience Development Executive plays a crucial role in driving delegate acquisition and audience engagement for high-impact B2B events. Based in Manila, this role supports the FT Live marketing team by researching, qualifying, and managing delegate leads, contributing directly to the success of our client-sponsored and FT-branded events.

Working under the supervision of the Audience Development Manager, the Executive will be responsible for researching and building prospect lists, conducting outreach, and ensuring data accuracy in line with campaign briefs. 

This is an exciting opportunity for a detail-oriented, curious, and proactive individual looking to gain experience in international events and audience marketing. This role is instrumental in identifying new leads for FT Live events and supporting the broader data acquisition strategy. Working from detailed marketing briefs, the Executive will conduct targeted research, build lead lists in a templated format, and collaborate with the Data team to upload and process records.

Key responsibilities

Audience Research & Acquisition

  • Create high-quality lead lists based on event-specific briefs (e.g. job title, industry, location, and company).
  • Use LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Cognism, web research, databases, and other tools to identify prospects.
  • Collaborate with marketing managers and project leads to define and expand on target profiles.
  • Conduct independent company, sector and market research to identify relevant organisations and decision-makers beyond initial campaign wishlists.

Audience Outreach

  • Craft and send personalised LinkedIn InMails and emails to potential delegates.
  • Support delegate invitation campaigns by managing email follow-ups and tracking responses and identifying opportunities for further engagement.

Data Management

  • Perform data audits, clean-ups, and deduplication to maintain high data quality.
  • Support audience data checks to assess the size, relevance and feasibility of potential audiences for prospective events.
  • Collaborate with the Data and Delegate Services teams to ensure leads are uploaded, segmented, and handled in accordance with FT’s compliance protocols, including GDPR and consent regulations.

Campaign Support

  • Track responses and lead engagement through internal systems and campaign dashboards.
  • Contribute to post-campaign analysis, highlighting the impact of research activity and identifying relevant audience insights and learnings.
  • Monitor the status of leads and support the audience development manager in adjusting strategies as needed.
  • Provide ad hoc reporting and analysis as requested.
  • Manage research across multiple campaigns and priorities, adapting to changing deadlines during busy periods.

Cross-functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with event marketers, project managers, sales, and operations to ensure alignment on delegate recruitment goals and expanded event presence.
  • Attend internal briefing meetings and proactively share research findings, audience trends and potential targeting opportunities.

Required skills and experience 

  • Open to fresh graduates with a Bachelor's degree in any four-year course
  • Curiosity and willingness to learn about different industries, companies, markets and business topics.
  • Experience of working with and manipulating large sets of data.
  • Strong research and analytical skills, with the ability to find, assess and organise information from multiple sources.
  • Must be proactive and be able to operate with limited supervision from line manager.
  • A team player, who is a strong, confident communicator and collaborator.
  • Ability to think creatively, ask questions and test ideas.
  • Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
  • Resourceful approach to research and willingness to explore different sources and methods when information is difficult to find.

Desirable experience 

  • Prior experience in audience research, lead generation, or delegate acquisition.
  • Knowledge of GDPR (and similar), impact on Marketing and Communications globally.
  • Microsoft Excel Proficiency: Confident using Excel to manage, clean, and analyse lead data (e.g. using filters, pivot tables, and formulas).
  • CRM Experience: Familiarity with Salesforce (or similar CRM systems) for logging, managing, and tracking lead data in alignment with audience development campaigns.
  • Familiarity with AI-powered research tools or data visualisation platforms.
  • Knowledge of Cognism or other B2B contact data platforms for sourcing and verifying leads.
  • Familiarity with collaboration tools like Slack, Monday.com, or other similar tools for task tracking and internal communications.
  • Previous experience working within a global or internationally distributed team.

Working Hours:

  • Flexibility to work UK business hours is required. Occasional out-of-hours support may be needed during key campaign periods.

What’s in it for you? Our benefits

Our benefits vary by location but we are committed to providing best-in-class perks across all our offices. These include generous annual leave, medical cover, inclusive parental leave packages, subsidised gym memberships and opportunities to give back to the community. Full details of our benefits are available here.

We’ve embraced a 50% hybrid working model (averaging two to three days onsite) that fosters trust and remote adaptability while encouraging in-person camaraderie and peer learning. Additionally, we are open to accommodating specific flexible working pattern requests for all roles where feasible.

Accessibility

We are a disability confident employer and Valuable 500 signatory.

Please let us know if you require any reasonable adjustments/personalisation as part of the application process or to enable you to attend an interview. If you would like to discuss your requirements or have any questions, email talent@ft.com and a member of our team will be happy to help.

Further information

At the FT, we embrace innovation and the use of technology and appreciate that individuals may leverage AI tools as part of their job application process. Whilst we are happy for you to use AI to assist with your application, it is essential that all information provided is authentic and accurately represents your skills, experience, and qualifications.

Candidates should be aware that the use of AI throughout the application process may be monitored to ensure a fair and transparent hiring process for all.

Please beware of fraudulent job postings and offers claiming to be from the Financial Times. All legitimate opportunities will direct you to apply through the official Financial Times careers site, and the FT will never ask for financial information, payments, or referrals to third parties during the hiring process. If you have any concerns about the legitimacy of a job posting or suspect any scam activity, please contact talent@ft.com. 

Interested in the FT but don’t see the right role yet? Join our Talent Community to receive exclusive updates, featured jobs, and insights into working at the FT.

job.title: Equity & Belonging Specialist
job.description:
Title: Equity & Belonging Specialist

Schedule Format - Location: Hybrid - San Francisco

Pay Information: $69,000 - $72,000

Entry -Level Position 


Position Summary:

Reporting to the Director, Organizational Equity & Belonging, the Equity & Belonging Specialist is an entry level position that supports the implementation of KQED's equitable excellence strategy by coordinating DEI initiatives that foster belonging, curiosity, and inclusive engagement across the organization. Through project coordination, content development, facilitation, and operational support, the Specialist helps translate strategic direction into consistent, high-quality execution.

Working collaboratively with internal stakeholders, the Specialist supports DEI-related learning experiences, Employee Belonging Groups (EBGs), GUIDE Council initiatives, heritage month programming, and departmental operations. The role also maintains resources, coordinates logistics, tracks program outcomes, and serves as a trusted partner in ensuring DEI initiatives are organized, accessible, and effectively delivered in alignment with the strategic direction established by the Director.
KQED envisions a public media organization with a culture that centers on human dignity, equity, and belonging. This will enable us to better serve and reflect the Bay Area through diverse and inclusive storytelling. 

We value the contributions of marginalized people in society — including Black, Indigenous, and all people of color,  people with disabilities, and LGBTQIA+ people — and we believe that these communities must be centered in the work we do, and we strongly encourage members of these communities to apply.

KQED Code of Ethics  https://www.kqed.org/about/code-ethics
The mission that drives us:

KQED provide citizens of Northern California with a community-supported alternative to commercial media.   We provide citizens with the knowledge they need to make informed decisions; convene community dialogue; bring the arts to everyone and engage audiences to share their stories. We help students and teachers thrive in 21st-century classrooms, and take people of all ages on journeys of exploration- exposing them to new people, places and ideas.

This role will work hybrid between working in KQED's newly renovated headquarters and working remotely.

 

Essential Functions: The Equity & Belonging Specialist may assist with one or more of the following:

  • DEI Learning Support & Facilitation (40%)

    • Develop presentation decks, facilitator guides, participant resources, interactive activities, surveys, and other educational collateral that support DEI-related learning initiatives based on the curriculum strategy and learning objectives established by the Director.
    • Facilitate foundational DEI learning experiences and educational sessions for staff, creating engaging and inclusive learning environments.
    • Coordinate scheduling, invitations, room and virtual meeting logistics, materials, and resource repositories that support DEI educational programming.
    • Distribute post-session surveys, track attendance and participation, and compile data and insights that support evaluation and continuous improvement of DEI initiatives.

  • Heritage Month Content & Engagement Support (35%)

    • Coordinate the operational workflow for heritage month initiatives by managing content movement and communication between Creative, Product, and other internal stakeholders.
    • Draft introductory copy and supporting content for heritage month collections based on established content frameworks and organizational standards.
    • Audit, organize, and maintain multimedia content libraries that showcase KQED programming and storytelling across heritage month collections.
    • Provide logistical and administrative support for GUIDE Council-led heritage month events and cultural engagement activities, including scheduling, room setup, catering coordination, RSVP tracking, vendor support, and event execution.

  • Employee Belonging Group (EBG) Support (20%)

    • Support the onboarding of new EBG leaders by providing guidance on the EBG Guidebook, governance resources, templates, organizational processes, and operating expectations.
    • Serve as a liaison for EBG leaders by connecting them with appropriate internal partners, coordinating communications, and helping navigate organizational resources and procedures.
    • Maintain EBG documentation, resource libraries, budget tracking tools, and program records to support effective governance and long-term sustainability.

  • Administrative & Operational Support (5%)

    • Partner with internal stakeholders to maintain departmental calendars and coordinate scheduling that supports effective participation across DEI initiatives.
    • Maintain the department's internal knowledge base, ensuring DEI resources, templates, guidance documents, and reference materials remain current and accessible.
    • Provide general administrative and operational support for departmental initiatives, reporting, communications, and resource management
  • Perform other related duties as assigned in support of DEI programs and organizational needs.

job.title: NABET On-Call Brand and Motion Graphics Designer / Designer 2
job.description:
Title: On-Call Brand and Motion Graphics Designer / Designer 2

Schedule Format - Location: Hybrid - San Francisco

Pay Information: Hourly Rate: $39.00 - $56.00


KQED is one of the largest and most respected nonprofits in Northern California — a 70+ year institution that generations of Bay Area residents have turned to for news, culture, and community. And yet the most exciting chapter in KQED's story is still ahead. As audience behaviors shift and competition for attention intensifies, building deeper connections with new and younger audiences isn't just a marketing goal — it's an organizational imperative, and brand is at the center of how we will get there.

The KQED Creative department plays a vital role in bringing this vision to life. As a member of our team, the On-Call Brand and Motion Graphics Designer will help shape and evolve KQED’s visual identity, developing cohesive brand systems and compelling motion graphics that connect with audiences across platforms. The ideal candidate is a multidisciplinary designer with strong expertise in brand identity systems and motion design, capable of translating strategic and creative concepts into engaging visual experiences across video, digital, social, print, environmental, and emerging platforms. The successful candidate will bring creative versatility, thoughtful collaboration, and a shared commitment to KQED’s mission of making a difference in the communities we serve.
 

KQED envisions a public media organization with a culture that centers on human dignity, equity, and belonging. This will enable us to better serve and reflect the Bay Area through diverse and inclusive storytelling. 

We value the contributions of marginalized people in society — including Black, Indigenous, and all people of color,  people with disabilities, and LGBTQIA+ people — and we believe that these communities must be centered in the work we do, and we strongly encourage members of these communities to apply.

KQED Code of Ethics  https://www.kqed.org/about/code-ethics

The mission that drives us:

KQED provide citizens of Northern California with a community-supported alternative to commercial media.   We provide citizens with the knowledge they need to make informed decisions; convene community dialogue; bring the arts to everyone and engage audiences to share their stories. We help students and teachers thrive in 21st-century classrooms, and take people of all ages on journeys of exploration- exposing them to new people, places and ideas.

This role will work hybrid between working in KQED's newly renovated headquarters and working remotely. 

Essential Functions

  • Understand, interpret, and apply KQED brand guidelines while completing projects according to established benchmarks and deadlines.
  • Develop and extend cohesive visual brand systems and identities for KQED programs, campaigns, initiatives, and sub-brands, translating creative direction into typography, color, graphic language, imagery, iconography, layout, logos, and other identity elements.
  • Apply and scale brand systems across digital, social, video, print, environmental, presentation, and promotional platforms, ensuring consistency while adapting the visual language to different audience experiences.
  • Translate visual brand systems into motion, conceptualizing and producing animated typography, title sequences, logo animations, transitions, lower thirds, information graphics, explainers, social video graphics, and video packaging that establish consistent brand behavior across platforms.
  • Develop reusable motion templates, toolkits, illustrations, infographics, and other graphic assets that enable consistent execution while supporting storytelling and audience engagement.
  • Design and animate using Adobe Creative Suite, with particular expertise in Illustrator, Photoshop, InDesign, After Effects and Premiere.
  • Collaborate with the Creative Director, Art Director, designers, producers, editors, and cross-functional stakeholders to develop and execute creative concepts.
  • Present and articulate design thinking and synthesize creative feedback and translate it into thoughtful design refinements while maintaining the integrity of the overall system.
  • Manage multiple assignments and production timelines within an on-call environment while maintaining a high standard of craft and attention to detail.

Candidate qualifications

  • Minimum 3–5 years of professional design experience, with demonstrated expertise in both brand identity/system development and motion design.
  • Bachelor’s degree in visual design, graphic design, motion design, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Strong conceptual and visual-design skills, with the ability to translate strategy, ideas, and storytelling into cohesive brand systems that extend across multiple applications and platforms.
  • Advanced motion-design skills with a strong understanding of timing, pacing, typography, composition, hierarchy, and storytelling through motion.
  • Strong typography, layout, information-design, and production skills across video, digital, social, and print, including working knowledge of print production and pre-press preparation.
  • Ability to move fluidly between concept development and hands-on production, managing multiple projects from concept through final delivery within limited timeframes.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, including the ability to articulate design decisions, receive and synthesize creative direction and stakeholder feedback, and work effectively with creative leadership, designers, producers, editors, stakeholders, and internal clients.
  • Advanced proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite, particularly After Effects, Illustrator, Photoshop, and InDesign, with experience working in 3D environments or integrating 3D elements into motion design.
  • The successful candidate will be required to join NABET Local 51.

Portfolio + Reel Requirements

  • Brand identity and visual-system work demonstrating process and iteration—from initial exploration through a cohesive identity system and its application across multiple touchpoints.
  • Motion and motion-branding work demonstrating how visual identities translate into movement, including examples of motion typography, animation, transitions, information graphics, and/or video packaging.
  • Strong typography, visual hierarchy, layout, and composition skills across digital, motion, and print applications.
  • Clear identification of the candidate’s individual role and contribution to collaborative projects.

Knowledge/Experience Desired

  • Experience creating motion identity guidelines, animation principles, reusable motion templates, or toolkits that extend brand systems across platforms.
  • Experience designing for social and short-form video platforms and adapting creative systems for evolving audience and platform needs.
  • Additional craft capabilities such as hand-rendered/vector illustration and Cinema 4D, Blender, or other 3D design and animation tools.
  • Familiarity with accessibility and inclusive design principles, as well as emerging creative technologies and workflows, including generative and AI-assisted design tools.

Physical Demands:

  • Ability to lift a minimum of fifteen (15) pounds;
  • Ability to exert maximum muscle force to lift, push, pull or carry;
  • Ability to use abdominal and lower back muscles over time without fatigue;
  • Ability to stand and/or sit for extended periods;
  • Ability to bend, stoop, stretch, twist, sit, and reach;
  • Fine motor skills;
  • Good visual and auditory acuity.

The physical demands described here represent those that an employee must meet to perform the essential functions of this job successfully.

 

NOTE: This job description is not intended to be all-inclusive. Employees may be required to perform other related duties as necessary to meet the ongoing needs of this organization.

job.description:
Position Summary

Beasley Media Group is seeking a dynamic, results-oriented Market Manager to lead the strategic, operational, and financial performance of a local media market. The Market Manager serves as the senior leader responsible for driving revenue growth, cultivating a high-performance culture, and maximizing the impact of Beasley Media Group's audio, digital, event, and marketing solutions.  This is a confidential leadership opportunity.

The ideal candidate is a strong business leader with a proven track record of revenue generation, team development, and market influence. This individual will inspire cross-functional teams while ensuring alignment with company objectives and delivering exceptional results for advertisers, listeners, and community partners.

Key Responsibilities

Leadership & Market Strategy

  • Lead all aspects of market operations, including sales, programming, digital, promotions, engineering, and business administration.
  • Develop and execute strategic plans to achieve market revenue, profitability, and audience growth objectives.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement.
  • Build strong relationships with local business leaders, community organizations, and key stakeholders.
  • Represent Beasley Media Group within the market and at industry events.

Revenue Growth

  • Drive revenue performance across broadcast, digital, event, and integrated marketing platforms.
  • Collaborate with sales leadership to establish and achieve aggressive revenue goals.
  • Identify new business opportunities and emerging revenue streams.
  • Review sales pipelines, forecasting, and market performance metrics to ensure consistent growth.

Talent Development

Operational Excellence

Qualifications

Required

Why Join Beasley Media Group?

At Beasley Media Group, you'll have the opportunity to lead a talented team, shape the future of local media, and make a meaningful impact in the communities we serve. We offer a collaborative culture, entrepreneurial environment, competitive compensation, and opportunities for professional growth.

The position will remain open until filled.

Beasley Media Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer and values diversity in the workplace.

job.title: Agile Project Manager / Release Train Engineer (T & I) (Telework/Hybrid)
job.description:
Position Title:

Agile Project Manager / Release Train Engineer (T & I) (Telework/Hybrid)

Status of Employment:

Permanent

Position Language Requirement:

English, French

Language Skills:

English (Reading - C - Advanced), English (Speaking - C - Advanced), English (Writing - B - Intermediate), French (Reading - C - Advanced), French (Speaking - C - Advanced), French (Writing - B - Intermediate)

Work at CBC/Radio-Canada

At CBC/Radio-Canada, we create content that informs, entertains and connects Canadians on multiple platforms. Our successes and accomplishments are driven by embodying and upholding values, which include creativity, integrity, inclusiveness and relevance. 
 
Do you think you have the ability and drive to keep up with this exciting, ever-changing industry? Whether it be in front of the camera, on air, online or behind the scenes, you would be joining a team that thrives on making connections and telling stories that are important to Canadians.

Unposting Date:

2026-10-30 11:59 PM

Behind the scenes, but ahead of the curve: help us develop the next-generation public service media organization.

 

Technology & Infrastructure (T&I) is the backbone and the future-forward arm of CBC/Radio-Canada. Our purpose is to constantly innovate to evolve and maintain the Corporation’s technology and infrastructure. We are the people that make stuff work. We make connections between media content, systems, people and places. We are the space in between.

 

A place with purpose. CBC/Radio-Canada has always been a highly regarded pioneer of media technology — not just in Canada but around the world. Today, we are transforming ourselves into a modern and agile public service media organization. Technology is the driving force, and we are the team making it happen.

 

This is a hybrid position with a mix of in-office and remote work. Work arrangements will be discussed with hiring managers per departmental guidelines.

 

Your role

 

As a Senior Agile Project Manager / Release Train Engineer (APM/RTE) within the T&I Value Management and Delivery Office, you serve as a program-level orchestrator and pivotal bridge between agile product delivery and traditional enterprise governance.  Assigned to a high-impact product family, you will operate within a SAFe-inspired agile bubble; while navigating fixed financial, legal, and operational parameters of a public broadcasting environment.

 

This is an intensive matrix leadership position. You will work across multiple teams, departments, and corporate functions where you do not possess direct line-management or hierarchical organizational authority. Success requires exceptional lateral leadership, emotional intelligence, and the ability to influence peers, product leaders, corporate partners, and external technology vendors toward shared program outcomes.

 

Foundational Leadership Competencies

 

Beyond technical agile process knowledge, you possess foundational capabilities that enable effective execution in a complex matrix enterprise:

  • Influencing Without Authority & Lateral Leadership: proven ability to align cross-functional peers, Product Owners, Solution Architects, and non-agile business partners behind program objectives without formal line-management authority. Mastery in negotiation, active listening, and building voluntary consensus across matrixed boundaries.
  • Emotional Intelligence (EQ) & Political Acumen: high self-awareness, diplomacy, and emotional control when navigating political dynamics, competing stakeholder priorities, or resistance to change.  Ability to de-escalate friction calmly and turn interpersonal misalignment into constructive problem-solving.
  • Trust-Building & Program Evangelism: ability to act as an energetic cheerleader and trusted advisor who builds psychological safety and enthusiasm within delivery teams, while simultaneously instilling confidence, credibility, and rigor among executive sponsors and traditional corporate functions.
  • Resilience & Comfort with Ambiguity: high tolerance for ambiguity, fluid priorities, and non-standard operating environments. Ability to remain composed under pressure, balancing the discipline of traditional corporate controls with the responsiveness of agile delivery.
  • Pragmatic Tailoring & Systems Thinking: pragmatic, flexible and solution-oriented mindset that balances adherence to core frameworks with fit-for-purpose execution.  Able to tailor day-to-day practices and propose refinements while adhering to core structures to drive business value.
  • Presentation Skills & Audience Adaptability: highly comfortable and effective presenting in English and in French to varying audiences, including key business partners, at different levels, tailoring messaging and presentation to the audience and objectives.

Primary Duties and Responsibilities

  • Scaled Agile Cadence & Program-Level Orchestration: Lead and facilitate core program-level ceremonies, including Pre-Quarterly Alignment, Quarterly Alignment (PI Planning equivalent), Program Demos (including major vendor demos like Dalet), Program Syncs, Orchestration Syncs, and Product Discovery & Architecture Syncs.
  • Dependency, Risk & Impediment Resolution: Identify, map, and resolve cross-team dependencies and systemic program impediments alongside Scrum Masters, while maintaining an active program risk register with strategic escalation paths.
  • Strategic Alignment & Governance Compliance: Ensure product family backlogs and quarterly objectives remain strictly aligned with Technology & Infrastructure (T&I) strategic goals and corporate governance standards.
  • Tooling Infrastructure & Delivery Visibility: Oversee and maintain program-level Jira and Confluence workspace structures to ensure full delivery transparency across backlogs, epics, and features.
  • Financial Stewardship & Budget Oversight: Maintain financial guardrails, including financial updates in partnership with Product Directors and POs to satisfy corporate finance requirements.
  • Operational Model Execution: Partner with the Transformation Lead to operationalize, run, and sustain the scaled agile delivery cadence across all product family teams.
  • Change Mobilization & Bilingual Enablement: Support cross-departmental change mobilization while enabling seamless bilingual (English/French) communication across distributed product hubs in Montreal and Toronto.
  • Vendor & Partner Governance: Co-manage strategic software supplier delivery alongside Product leadership, aligning vendor specifications, contractual milestones, and delivery cadences with internal backlogs & roadmaps.
  • Performance Metrics & Value Realization: Develop and maintain dashboards to track flow metrics, delivery velocity, and business value realization to drive continuous program improvement.
  • Agile Culture & Bureaucracy Reduction: Embody a servant-leadership posture ('Facilitator vs. Controller'), fostering transparency, team autonomy, and the principle that 'People own the process' while actively streamlining administrative overhead.
  • Multi-Tier Reporting Cadences: Drive structured reporting across four executive cadences: Weekly operational updates, Bi-weekly leadership syncs, Monthly performance reviews, and Quarterly reporting to Governance Committees and the Board of Directors.

 

We are looking for a candidate with the following:

  • Professional Experience: 7+ years of experience in project/program delivery, with at least 3 years in a Senior Agile, Scaled Agile (RTE or equivalent), or Hybrid leadership role managing complex, multi-team initiatives.
  • Scaled Agile Facilitation: experience facilitating PI Planning / Quarterly Alignment, multi-team demos, and Program Syncs within SAFe or hybrid scaled agile delivery environments.
  • Vendor Governance: Proven success co-managing strategic third-party vendor contracts, integration milestones, and delivery cadences.
  • Financial & Governance: Experience interfacing with corporate Finance and Executive Governance, translating agile delivery metrics into traditional financial and risk reports.
  • Tooling Expertise: proficiency in Jira, Confluence, Power BI, Google Suite is a Strong Asset
  • Linguistic: bilingual (English/French).
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, Business Administration, or equivalent practical experience and training.

 

Some travel may be required.

Candidates may be subject to skills and knowledge testing.
 

We thank all applicants for their interest, but only candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.

As part of our recruitment process, candidates who advance to the next

step will be asked to complete a background check. This includes:  

  • A mandatory Criminal record check.
