CBC News is designing new ways for Canadians to understand and navigate their finances, helping them make sense of a myriad of complex economic realities through expanded financial and consumer storytelling. 

To help audiences discover that content when they want it, on their platform of choice, we’re hiring a Senior Coordinating Producer to join the CBC Audience Growth team. This is an opportunity to help shape and grow a new destination for practical, news-you-can-use financial journalism.


In this role, you’ll sit right where editorial meets audience growth, collaborating with content teams across CBC News, Entertainment and Sports to make CBC a top destination for financial journalism and related content. 


You play a critical role in identifying new audiences, and advising on the best strategies and tactics to reach them across CBC digital properties, FAST channels, CBC Gem, CBC linear channels, as well as on third-party platforms including Youtube and Tik Tok. You understand how to move people beyond discoverability and into loyal audiences who actively engage with our content, whether subscribing to newsletters, engaging with content and sharing videos. You search for opportunities to reflect a broad range of perspectives and voices in the content we share. 


You are passionate about using audience insights to inform journalism decisions, capable of analyzing reach and engagement time and adjusting your tactics to ensure the best audience experience. You have knowledge of digital products, and our owned and operated, and third party platforms.

You are future-focused, open to experimenting with new technologies, audio/visual formats and content to meet changing audience needs. 


You’re a collaborator, able to work with everyone from  front-line journalists and program leaders, to colleagues across CBC genres to optimize CBC’s best digital, social, and broadcast journalism into one easy-to-find audience experience.

  • Help manage push alerts, newsletters, YouTube and TikTok packaging, alongside and as a part of the CBC News Audience Growth team. 
  • Play a key role in planning and live event plans for major financial and money-related journalism. As required, verify user-generated content to ensure accuracy.
  • Coordinate work with business unit content teams currently based in Calgary and Toronto, as well as audio syndication, current affairs and podcasting to ensure a smooth workflow between platforms.
  • Aggregate, showcase and promote financial, business and consumer content from CBC News, CBC Entertainment and CBC Sports.
  • Use data and analytics to shape our headlines, thumbnails, and rollout plans.
  • Guide, coach and support colleagues on best-of-practices and through change as required, across local and network newsrooms.

  • At least seven (7) years of recent experience in a large digital news environment,

  • Advanced knowledge of social platforms, including YouTube, Tik Tok, Snapchat and WhatsApp, including their algorithms and community features.

  • Strong visualization skills, including experience in using graphics, charts and explainers to distill complex financial data into easily digestible and actionable content.

Overview

The Board Operator is responsible for maintaining quality on-air levels and flow of programs as well as reacting efficiently in the case of automation failure. This is accomplished by monitoring our systems to ensure that everything you hear on-air gets played on time, smoothly, and without any glitches. This role will watch overnight news to alert our listeners in specific markets of any danger in times of crisis. This position is the vanguard of all audio platforms.

 

What will you do?

  • Monitor and make adjustments as needed to the Zetta systems while they are in automation if abnormalities occur.
  • Keeps the Automation systems on time as it relates to top of the hour, breaks and running of ID’s.
  • Maintains on-air programming in the event of Zetta system failure.
  • Answers the studio phone lines, responding to listeners’ questions regarding the station, songs, and requests of information
  • Maintains on-air programming in the event of Zeta System failure
  • Maintains clean and safe studio by dusting and wiping down counters and equipment as needed.
  • Loads voice tracks.
  • Enters the top of the hour hooks, newscast and news bites.
  • Runs the studio board for newscast with a live news person.
  • Runs an EAS Test as needed.
  • Recovers missing voice tracks.

 

What are we looking for?

  • High School Diploma Preferred
  • Knowledge of equipment used for sound/audio or production of on-air material.
  • Radio production background is a plus.
  • Proven ability to work through multiple, simultaneous problems in a systematic, logical manner.
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently; meeting performance expectations / ministry goals.
  • Strong computer skills and the ability to learn new technologies quickly
  • Good written and verbal communication skills.
  • Flexible availability with the ability to work various shifts hours (day, evening, weekends, and overnight)

 

What can we offer you?

  • Industry leading Medical, Dental & Vision coverage
  • Short/long term disability and life insurance
  • Robust 401K with company match
  • Parental leave with Baby Bonding pay
  • Generous PTO, holiday and sick pay
  • Unique company culture that includes exclusive access to concerts, movie premieres, media industry events, and more
  • Leadership and Career Development Programs including free access to LinkedIn Learning platform

Educational Media Foundation (EMF) is a nonprofit, multi-platform media company on a mission to draw people closer to Christ. Founded in 1982 in Santa Rosa, CA, with a single radio station, EMF today owns and operates the nation's two largest Christian music radio networks (K-LOVE and Air1) with over 1,000 broadcast signals across all 50 states and beyond, streaming audio reaching around the world, and a growing family of media ministries including podcasts, books, films, concerts, and events. EMF employs nearly 500 team members between its offices in Nashville, TN, Rocklin, CA, and field locations around the country. We hire first for ministry alignment and a shared commitment to our faith, mission, vision, and values. We then seek talented professionals who can use their God-given gifts, skills, and experience to serve with excellence.

 

If you love Jesus and are called to be part of a ministry that places Christ at the center of everything we do, we invite you to explore this opportunity. If your heart aligns with our mission and you possess the knowledge, skills, and abilities needed for the role, please keep reading.

 

To succeed as a Donor Services Specialist you will:

  • Be extremely detail oriented, organized, thorough, and efficient.
  • Have a high work ethic and desire to help others on your team.
  • Thrive in an environment of over-the-top customer service by being highly relational and consistently empathetic.
  • Truly desire to pick up the phone and take inbound as well as make outbound calls to donors. (90% of your day is on the phone)
  • Be comfortable and satisfied, sitting 6+ hours a day.
  • Be flexible moving between computer and manual processes.
  • Be social, relational, caring, with others, but we do have a lot to accomplish, so able to balance that with getting to the work at hand.
  • Can identify potential capacity in a donor for increased engagement opportunities.
  • Have excellent verbal and written skills (ability to write in our brand voice).
  • Be experienced in MS Office Products and ability to quickly learn new systems.
  • Be donor passionate, donor centric

 

Experience and Expertise:

  • Bachelor’s Degree, or combination of education/training with relevant experience.
  • Minimum 2 years of customer service, administrative support, or donor-facing experience preferred.
  • Experience with CRM or database systems highly desirable.
  • Strong organizational abilities, with the capacity to manage multiple priorities.
  • Demonstrated ability to maintain accuracy and attention to detail in processing information, managing records, and completing tasks in a fast-paced environment.
  • Ability to work independently while maintaining alignment with team goals and protocols.
  • Sound judgment in handling confidential information and discerning sensitive donor matters.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills with the ability to develop sincere business/Ministry relationships.
  • Demonstrated ability to represent Ministry professionally and maintain listener confidentiality.

 

What we can offer you:

  • Industry leading Medical, Dental & Vision coverage
  • Short/long term disability and life insurance
  • Robust 401K with company match
  • Parental leave with Baby Bonding pay
  • Generous PTO, holiday and sick pay
  • Unique company culture that includes exclusive access to concerts, movie premieres, media industry events, and more

About Us

 

K-LOVE is a nonprofit, multi-platform media company on a mission to draw people closer to Christ. Effectively and efficiently route and answer questions not requiring CRO’s attention or time.

  • Create engaging and informative presentations utilizing multimedia and technical tools.
  • Serve as the primary administrative resource for the CRO including, but not limited to development of correspondences of both confidential and non-confidential matters, email and voicemail communication and other general administrative functions as needed. In addition, helping to book meetings, coordinate schedules, and handle a variety of meeting logistics, as well as book travel for CRO or their personnel as requested.  Complete expense reports, tracking and turning in receipts, as well as code and process invoices for payments.
  • Maintain/stock the Engagement Group supply cabinet; update the Engagement Group staff phone list and Christmas card list; and maintain the Engagement Group mailboxes.
  • Make travel arrangements including reservations for air, car, and hotel for the Engagement Group.
  • Assume responsibility coordinating Engagement Group purchases with the Finance Purchasing Specialist. Where appropriate, create purchase requisitions and ensure proper coding and processing of vendor invoices.  Assure us cost-effective measures are being taken with all purchases.

  • Manage Engagement Group training calendar, team portal and key IT files. Coordinate content contribution and at times create content as well.
  • Organize and maintain records, receipts, and purchase orders in line with Finance policies and procedures.
  • Independently troubleshoot and manage administrative issues that arise (such as timecard questions; meeting logistics and schedules) making decisions, following through to resolution, and ensuring the Engagement Group managers are informed along the way.

Work with Engagement Group managers on discrepancies and budget concerns. Regularly keep Engagement Group managers informed of status and budget through regular meetings and reporting.
  • Facilitate and compile Engagement Group artifacts for annual financial audit.
  • Work often requires a flexible schedule, especially during Pledge Drive (evening, early morning, and weekend hours required).
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

job.title: Outside Sales Account Executive
job.description:
iHeartMedia Markets

                                                                             

Current employees and contingent workers click here to apply and search by the Job Posting Title.

                                                                             

The audio revolution is here – and iHeart is leading it!  iHeartMedia, the number one audio company in America, reaches 90% of Americans every month -- a monthly audience that’s twice the size of any other audio company – almost three times the size of the largest TV network – and almost 4 times the size of the largest ad-supported music streaming service. 

Because we reach almost every community in America, we’re committed to providing a range of programming that reflects the diversity of the many communities we serve – and our company reflects that same kind of diversity.  Our company values stress collaboration, curiosity, welcoming dissent, accepting mistakes in the pursuit of new ideas, and respect for everyone.


Only one company in America has the #1 position in everything audio: iHeartMedia!


If you’re excited about this role but don’t feel your experience aligns perfectly with the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway.  At iHeartMedia we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace and are looking for teammates passionate about what we do!

                                                                             

What We Need:

This role is for a true hunter. We're looking for someone who enjoys opening doors, creating relationships from scratch, and building new business. You'll have the backing of the strongest audio portfolio in America, including broadcast radio, podcasts, streaming, events, and talent partnerships. If you're motivated by competition, uncapped earnings, and the opportunity to build a book of business, we'd love to meet you.

Looking for a new challenge? Join us as an Account Executive and leverage your proven goal-driven mindset, fast-paced work ethic, and exceptional client service skills. The ideal candidate is ready to hit the ground running and will successfully take advantage of all iHeart’s platforms to exceed their clients’ expectations.

                                                                             

What You'll Do:

As an Account Executive at iHeart, you'll be responsible for building and growing a book of business by identifying, developing, and closing new revenue opportunities. Through in-person prospecting, networking, research, and consistent daily outreach, you'll open doors with local businesses and introduce them to iHeart's powerful portfolio of broadcast, podcast, streaming, event, and talent solutions. You'll partner with internal teams to develop strategic marketing recommendations and deliver compelling, data-driven presentations that help clients grow while driving revenue for your market.

                                                                             

What You'll Need:

  • You should be self-motivated (a very “go-getter” attitude!), have excellent relationship-building and problem-solving skills, and communicate persuasively. When people describe you, goal-oriented, expert negotiator and proactive should be at the top of the list.  
  • You should be able to plan and multi-task in a fast-paced environment.  
  • Comfortable with cold-calling and initiating outreach to prospective clients as part of lead generation efforts.
  • A valid driver's license, auto insurance, and a High School Diploma (College Degree preferred) are required.  
  • You should also be skilled in Salesforce, Microsoft Office and social networking platforms.  
  • Strong problem-solving skills; by exercising these skills, you help business grow to the fullest potential.
  • Digital/Media Sales experience are a plus but not required. 
  • The natural ability to organize and prioritize day-to-day depending on where the biggest priorities may be
  • Additional nice-to-haves include experience managing complex, multi-platform campaigns, analytics experience, iHeart and/or audio advertising background, and are well-connected in the market.  

What you’ll get  

  • You'll have the opportunity for uncapped commission, and the ability to grow business across all categories on a local, regional, and national level no matter where you live
  • A 7-week onboarding program to immerse you in the suite of tools and products available to you 
  • The potential to be recognized in our annual iHeartMedia CEO’s Club and iHeartMedia President’s Club programs 
  • Access to competitive benefits including paid vacation and sick time, paid company holidays, a Spirit day to encourage the opportunity to more easily volunteer in their communities, company-paid mental health and financial education resources, 401(k) matching, learning and development resources, and career navigation support.
  • Access to additional perks include pet (they’re part of the family!), disaster, and legal insurance, student loan refinancing, and discounts on merchandise, tickets to events, and more.
  • The support of fellow team members invested in your success.

Envision your first 30 days  

  • Week 1: Complete our onboarding journey for a deep understanding of our company, job-specific trainings and spend time with your team. 
  • Week 2: Spend more time with your manager to ensure you are aligned on work and communication styles, priorities, and any other expectations. 
  • Week 3: Start “owning” your role and leaning into the real day-to-day, of course with your manager’s support and advocacy! 
  • Week 4: Prioritize a 30-day check-in to see what else you might need to be most successful in your new role.  


 

Interested in learning more about iHeart and our platforms? Visit us at www.iHeartMedia.com to learn more about our company, www.iHeartRadio.com to access all your favorite music, radio, and podcasts, and download the free iHeartRadio app!  

                                                                             

What You'll Bring:

  • Respect for others and a strong belief that others should do this in return

  • General understanding of business principles and sales environment

  • Interest in developing knowledge of business operations and sales concepts and techniques

  • Individual accountability and understanding of when to seek guidance

  • Skills managing assigned projects to completion

  • Understanding to resolve problems using established guidelines and professional judgement

  • Ability to communicate information about iHeart products in a digestible manner and to apply active listening skills to validate understanding of customer needs

  • Understanding of impact of your own decisions

  • Goal orientation and the ability to focus and prioritize

                                                                             

Location:

Charlotte, NC: 2100 South Tryon Suite 300 CLT, 28203

                                                                             

Position Type:                                                                                             

Regular

                                                                             

Time Type:

Full time

                                                                                 

Pay Type:

Salaried

                                                                                 

Benefits:

iHeartMedia’s benefits offering is flexible and offers a variety of choices to meet the diverse needs of our changing workforce, including the following:

  • Employer sponsored medical, dental and vision with a variety of coverage options

  • Company provided and supplemental life insurance

  • Paid vacation and sick time

  • Paid company holidays

  • A Spirit day to encourage and allow our employees to more easily volunteer in their community

  • A 401K plan

  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP) at no cost – services include telephonic counseling sessions, consultation on legal and financial matters, emotional well-being, family and caregiving

  • ​A range of additional voluntary programs, such as spending accounts, student loan refinancing, accident insurance and more!

                                                                             

We are accepting applications for this role on an ongoing basis.


The Company is an equal opportunity employer and will not tolerate discrimination in employment on the basis of race, color, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, religion, disability, ethnicity, national origin, marital status, protected veteran status, genetic information, or any other legally protected classification or status.


Non-Compete will be required for certain positions and as allowed by law.


Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.


Click Here to learn about the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance .

job.description:
Location: GA-Atlanta

Job Title:  Systems Analyst II

 

Position Overview

The Digital Customer Support (DCS) Systems Analyst II provides Tier 2 technical and operational support for Cox Media Group's business-critical applications and digital platforms. This role focuses on troubleshooting, incident resolution, application administration, and maintaining reliable services for internal customers.

 

The ideal candidate is a customer-focused problem solver with strong technical, analytical, and communication skills. The position includes participation in an after-hours on-call rotation.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Provide Tier 2 support for enterprise applications, SaaS platforms, and associated integrations.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve application incidents and service requests escalated through the Service Desk.
  • Support CMG's Content Management Systems (CMS) and WideOrbit revenue platform, including troubleshooting, user provisioning, and account management.
  • Participate in on-call support, major incident response, and technical escalations.
  • Support and cross-train on Change Management and Critical Problem Management processes to ensure team-wide coverage, operational continuity, and backup support when needed
  • Collaborate with vendors, application owners, and other IT teams to resolve technical issues.
  • Maintain support documentation, troubleshooting procedures, and knowledge base articles.
  • Identify opportunities to improve processes, reduce recurring incidents, and enhance customer satisfaction.
  • Support and cross-train on Change Management and Critical Problem Management processes to ensure team-wide coverage, operational continuity, and backup support when needed.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 4+ years of experience in technical support, application support, or IT operations.
  • Experience troubleshooting enterprise applications and SaaS platforms.
  • Familiarity with IT service management tools such as ServiceNow or Jira.
  • Understanding of Incident, Problem, and Change management processes.
  • Experience with user provisioning, account administration, and application troubleshooting.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
  • Ability to prioritize multiple issues and work effectively across technical teams.
  • Experience supporting Windows, macOS, and mobile platforms.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Technical degree or equivalent relevant experience.
  • Experience supporting CMS, WideOrbit, or other digital media applications.
  • Familiarity with ITIL practices and application monitoring tools.
  • Experience with automation, application integrations, or process improvement.

About Cox Media Group 

CMG Media Corporation (d/b/a Cox Media Group) is an industry-leading media company with unparalleled brands, award-winning content, and exceptional team members. CMG provides valuable local and national journalism and entertainment content to the people and communities it serves. The company's businesses encompass 17 high-quality, market-leading television brands in 9 markets; 45 top-performing radio stations delivering multiple genres of content in 9 markets; and numerous streaming and digital platforms. CMG's TV portfolio includes multiple primary affiliates of ABC, CBS, FOX, NBC, Telemundo and MyNetworkTV, as well as several valuable news and independent stations. For more information about CMG, visit www.coxmediagroup.com

job.description:
Radio Host / Multimedia Content Creator & Brand Influencer – Dubuque

*This is a full-time, in-office opportunity. *

 

Be the Voice, Face, Writer, Content and Community Influencer of Your Community:

Are you a creative personality with a passion for radio, digital storytelling, video content creation, and building community relationships? At Townsquare Media Group, we’re looking for a Radio Host / Multimedia Content Creator & Brand Influencer who can dominate the airwaves, create compelling local written content online, produce engaging video across platforms, and partner with local businesses as a trusted endorser and influencer.

This is a full-time, in-office role, working closely with a collaborative and fun local team. We’re searching for a true 360-degree multimedia talent with initiative—someone who thrives on radio, creates video content consistently, writes articles that demand attention, commands a room in person, and creates business opportunities with confidence. If you see yourself as a local influencer who can authentically connect, create content, endorse brands and generate revenue, this role was built for you.

 

Why Townsquare Media?

Townsquare is a media, entertainment, and digital marketing solutions company dedicated to serving small and mid-sized markets across the U.S. We own and operate 354 radio stations and more than 400 local websites across 74 markets—including trusted Dubuque stations.

We combine the power of local media with best-in-class digital solutions to help businesses grow—offering everything from broadcast and digital advertising to SEO, web design, and programmatic marketing.

 

What You’ll Do:

As a Radio Host / Digital Content Writer, you’ll play a key role in shaping the daily sound and digital presence of KLYV, KXGE, WJOD, WDBQ-AM, WDBQ-FM. You’ll engage audiences across on-air, online, social, and in the community by:

  • Hosting live, engaging on-air shows Monday through Friday
  • Preparing daily show content that entertains, informs, and connects with the target audience
  • Creating and publishing a minimum of two original local articles per day for the station website and mobile app
  • Writing and scheduling engaging posts across social platforms including Facebook and others
  • Connecting with listeners through interviews, live appearances, remotes, and community events
  • Representing the station at promotions, live broadcasts, and special programming initiatives
  • Producing commercials and assisting with market-wide programming and content needs
  • Championing the station brand “on the streets” by building authentic community relationships
  • Collaborating with on-air, digital, production, and sales teams to support integrated content initiatives
  • Creating and publishing original video content regularly, including social-first short-form video (Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts) and longer-form segments that grow your personal on-screen brand
  • Prospecting and developing endorsement and influencer partnerships with local businesses, pitching yourself as a trusted community voice who can authentically promote products and services across on-air, video, and social platforms
  • Participating in person in high-visibility community events, client meetings, and business functions as a station ambassador who builds relationships that translate into revenue

 

What You’ll Bring:

  • Proven, active track record creating original written digital content AND video content across social platforms (show us your pages)
  • Strong on-air presence AND on-camera comfort, with the ability to connect authentically with listeners and viewers across every platform
  • Knowledge of basic FCC rules and regulations
  • Solid understanding of current events and various formats
  • Strong verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills
  • Comfort multitasking, meeting deadlines, and working in a fast-paced environment
  • Ability to operate control boards, remote broadcast equipment, and related production tools
  • Willingness to quickly learn and become proficient in NexGen and Adobe Audition
  • Exceptional public speaking, presentation, and networking skills with the confidence to walk into a business, build a relationship, and close an endorsement deal
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to prioritize effectively
  • Active video creator with a current, maintained presence on at least one short-form video platform (TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts) and demonstrated comfort on camera
  • Entrepreneurial, sales-minded instincts: you think about your personal brand as a business, proactively seek out partnership and endorsement opportunities, and are motivated by revenue tied to your influence
  • Experience with or strong interest in influencer marketing, brand endorsements, or sponsored content creation, including the ability to pitch yourself compellingly to local advertisers
  • High School Diploma (required)
  • Valid driver's license, auto insurance, and vehicle (required)

 

What’s In It for You?

We offer a supportive environment where talent is developed and growth is encouraged:

  • Competitive salary + bonus program + endorsement revenue opportunities (your influence = your upside)
  • 3 weeks PTO + 9 paid holidays
  • Medical, Dental, Vision, and Pet Insurance
  • 401(k) Retirement Plan
  • Company-provided laptop
  • Casual, high-energy work environment
  • Opportunities for upward mobility within a growing media organization
  • Company discounts
  • Volunteer Time Off—give back to your community
  • And much more…

 

Ready to Own Your Market? Apply Today!

job.description:
About Gray Media:

Today, we are a growing multimedia company headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia. We are the nation's largest owner of top-rated local television stations and digital assets serving 117 full-power television markets that collectively reach approximately 37% of US television households. KOLO-TV isn't just a station; it's a multi-platform powerhouse deeply woven into the fabric of Reno and Northern Nevada. As home to ABC, Telemundo, MeTV, The CW, and the Silver State Sports & Entertainment Network, we're here to inform, entertain, and connect our community across every screen.

Are you a digital-first strategist who knows how to turn a "maybe" into a "yes"? We’re looking for a Multi-Media Sales Manager at KOLO-TV who can lead our sales team to digital and new business success while ensuring our multi-platform presence is the sharpest in the Reno market.

  • Work closely with editors to support content for NFL RedZone
  • Responsible for watching a game and producing multiple highlights for NFL RedZone halftime fill segments

job.title: Pricing, Planning & Inventory Manager
job.description:
Are you a strategic thinker who thrives on maximizing revenue through data-driven insights? Scripps Networks is seeking a Pricing, Planning, and Inventory Manager who will lead the strategic optimization of all ad sales inventory, architect deal approval processes and systems, and drive revenue growth through advanced analytics and strategic leadership. This is your opportunity to shape business strategy at one of the nation's leading media companies.
 

WHAT YOU'LL DO:


  • Lead strategic initiatives to maximize inventory value and revenue, guiding traffic, sales, and planning teams on prioritization for all revenue streams including cash, Audience Deficiency Unit (ADU), and Direct Response.
  • Collaborate on the development of and implement strategies for mitigating liability and risk, driving cross-functional alignment to ensure revenue goals and operational excellence.
  • Serve as authority on Wide Orbit Sales & P&I functionalities, setting process workflows, testing and managing Wide Orbit or other leading software solution system enhancements and documentation to drive efficiency.
  • Conceptualize advanced analytical tools and models for the sales support team, mentor Sales Assistants and Planners on inventory maximization and strategic flighting.
  • Deliver strategic insights and recommendations to senior management based on comprehensive analysis (inventory, Direct Response (DR) rates, liability, etc.) to shape revenue forecasting, pricing, and long-term budgeting strategies.
  • Build and oversee the creation, compilation, and dissemination of all Sales rate cards and associated analysis.
  • Manage post-analysis reports Management Science Associates, Inc. (MSA).
  • Participate in training and development for sales assistants and planners, establishing best practices and fostering a culture of analytical excellence.
  • Identify revenue optimization opportunities, presenting business cases to leadership and directing their implementation.
     

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:


  • BS/BA in related discipline preferred or equivalent years of experience
  • Generally, 8+ years of experience in related field preferred
     

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:


  • Deep understanding of advertising and media sales industry, specifically linear TV media planning and inventory management
  • Advanced Excel proficiency and experience with Ad Sales systems
  • Experience working with sales teams and cross-functional partners
  • Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
  • Detail oriented with ability to meet deadlines
     

WHERE YOU'LL LIVE, WORK, AND PLAY:


New York City is the epicenter of media, culture, and innovation. As the nation's largest city, NYC offers unparalleled professional opportunities alongside world-class dining, arts, entertainment, and nightlife. From Broadway shows to cutting-edge museums, iconic landmarks to hidden neighborhood gems, the city provides endless ways to explore and be inspired.


The five boroughs offer diverse communities and lifestyles, whether you prefer the energy of Manhattan, the creative spirit of Brooklyn, the cultural richness of Queens, the green spaces of the Bronx, or the waterfront charm of Staten Island. With an extensive public transportation system, you can navigate the city without a car while enjoying access to beaches, parks, and weekend getaways to the Hamptons, Hudson Valley, or beyond.


New York City is where ambitious professionals come to make their mark, surrounded by the best talent in every industry and a vibrant community that never stops moving forward.

job.title: Account Executive, KERO
job.description:
We are looking for a driven, creative sales professional who loves helping local businesses grow? KERO in Bakersfield, California is looking for an Account Executive, Local who will be a true partner to the business community — connecting clients to the audiences that matter most through a powerful, multi-platform suite of advertising solutions. From broadcast television to Over The Top (OTT) video, search strategies, social media, digital display, and e-mail targeting, you'll craft customized campaigns that deliver real results and real return on investment. If you're energized by building relationships, closing deals, and making a measurable difference for the businesses in your community, this is your opportunity to shine.


WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Sell advertising solutions to local and regional businesses and advertising agencies.
  • Apply the Scripps Sales Process (SSP) to analyze current and prospective customer needs and apply customized advertising solutions that provide return on their investment.
  • In addition to television commercial airtime sales, facilitate the customer's ability to take advantage of the full array of digital marketing options available.
  • Independently prospect, secure appointments, perform needs analysis, develop customized solutions, present and close sales to develop and maintain new business from traditional and non-traditional advertisers.
  • Use ratings data, qualitative information and market trends to negotiate program ratings and advertising rates with advertising agencies in order to maximize revenue as well as develop custom solutions for new advertisers.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor with new and existing clients, provide best-in-class customer service, grow accounts, and gain additional business from referrals.
  • Perform client services, including but not limited to media avail negotiations, presentation preparation delivery and execution, copy writing, credit applications and collection of revenue due.
  • Effectively and proactively manage a sales funnel by way of Customer Relationship Management (CRM) systems, monitoring and achieving key performance indicators and expected activity levels.
  • Contribute to the creative development of campaigns though client communication and needs analysis, storyboard and concept creation, and assistance in production aspects.
  • Build and maintain strong client relationships, which may include entertaining prospective and existing clients.
  • Perform routine administrative functions of a media salesperson including makegood resolution, continuous update of CRM system with activity, account information and pending revenue, and communication with sales leadership regarding the status of accounts.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:

  • BS/BA in related discipline preferred or equivalent years of experience
  • Generally 2+ years of proven sales success preferred
  • Experience in strategic account management, broadcast ratings and digital execution preferred
  • Valid driver's license, good driving record, and ability to provide proof of insurance with the company required insurance limits.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

  • Highly self-motivated and goal focused
  • Highly creative and innovative thinker
  • Strong influencing, selling and upselling skills
  • Effective teamwork and collaboration skills
  • Very strong analysis and data interpretation - able to translate needs and research data into sound marketing proposals
  • Exceptional verbal and written communication skills
  • Outstanding presentation abilities (in person/virtual, small/large groups, all levels)
  • Strong time management and organizational skills
  • Proficient with Microsoft Office (Word, Excel and PowerPoint)
  • Working knowledge of Google Office (Sheets, Docs, Slides) and virtual conferencing platforms (E.g. Skype, WebEx, Zoom or MS Teams etc.)

WHAT WE'LL OFFER:

  • Uncapped sales commission
  • Monthly allowance for mileage and cell phone
  • Extensive Scripps Sales Process training
  • A career path to grow your professional experiences
  • Full medical, dental and vision benefits, as well as certain other health and wellness benefits
  • Retirement savings plan with company match
  • Other key company benefits include disability accident insurance, life insurance, ID protection, pet discount program, and employee assistance program. More details about timing and conditions of benefits eligibility and other plan terms and conditions will be provided upon hire.

WHERE YOU'LL LIVE, WORK, AND PLAY:

Bakersfield is California's ninth-largest city and a place with a character all its own — rooted in agriculture, energy, and a deep musical heritage that gave birth to the Bakersfield Sound, a twangy, West Coast alternative to Nashville country that produced legends like Buck Owens and Merle Haggard. The city is home to the Kern County Museum, a vibrant arts scene, and a calendar full of festivals and community events that reflect its proud, hardworking spirit.

Surrounded by stunning natural landscapes, Bakersfield sits at the southern end of the San Joaquin Valley with easy access to some of California's most spectacular outdoor destinations. The nearby Kern River offers whitewater rafting and scenic hiking, while Lake Isabella is a favorite for boating, fishing, and camping. The southern Sierra Nevada mountains are just a short drive away, putting world-class skiing at Mammoth Mountain and the towering peaks of Sequoia National Park well within weekend reach.

With a lower cost of living than most California metros, Bakersfield gives residents the ability to stretch their dollar further while enjoying a warm climate, a growing restaurant and craft brewery scene, and a close-knit community that takes pride in its roots. The city is well-connected via Highway 99 and is within a two-hour drive of both Los Angeles and the Central Coast — making it an ideal home base for those who want California living without California prices.

job.title: Senior Producer, Editorial Video, Amazing America
job.description:
Sinclair, Inc. is seeking a highly creative and experienced Senior Producer, Editorial Video to join Amazing America, our digital-first lifestyle brand that spotlights what makes America amazing. Our mission is to celebrate our country’s unique culture, adventurous spirit, and extraordinary stories hiding in ordinary places. Through entertaining, informative, and personality-driven storytelling, we inspire audiences to explore the country, experience its traditions, and connect with the people who make it special.

As a senior member of our creative production team, this individual will play a key role in developing original editorial concepts, building repeatable content franchises, identifying and cultivating on-camera talent, and establishing a distinctive visual and storytelling style across our platforms.

This is a hands-on creative position requiring strong editorial instincts, exceptional storytelling skills, and the technical ability to execute productions from concept through delivery.

The Senior Producer will work across short-form vertical video, mid-length digital programming, and longer-form original series distributed across Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Facebook, and other digital platforms.

The successful candidate will understand how to balance journalistic curiosity with entertaining storytelling, creating content that is informative, visually compelling, authentic, and optimized for digital audiences.

Responsibilities

Ideation & Development

  • Develop and pitch original editorial video concepts, standalone stories, repeatable formats, and recurring series that align with Amazing America’s brand identity and audience development objectives.
  • Monitor assigned geographic markets to identify interesting events, unique destinations, regional traditions, and fascinating personalities that define our country’s culture
  • Create comprehensive pitches that clearly articulate the editorial premise, audience hook, narrative structure, visual approach, production requirements, editing strategy, and intended distribution.
  • Identify opportunities to connect individual stories to larger seasonal initiatives, editorial campaigns, and brand programming priorities.

Writing & Research

  • Lead research and story development for approved projects, ensuring accuracy, originality, and a compelling narrative approach.
  • Develop creative treatments, scripts, outlines, interview questions, and production plans for a wide range of digital video formats.
  • Source archival photographs, video footage, historical materials, and supplemental B-roll to support editorial storytelling.
  • Work collaboratively with on-camera talent to develop scripts and storytelling approaches that complement their individual personalities and presentation styles.

Production

  • Serve as lead producer and creative director for original video productions in studio and field environments.
  • Direct hosts, creators, interview subjects, and other on-camera talent to deliver authentic, engaging performances to deliver compelling, character-driven storytelling.
  • Independently shoot high-quality video using DSLR/mirrorless cameras, DJI Osmo cameras, smartphones, and other professional production equipment.
  • Manage creative decision-making during field productions, adapting to changing circumstances and recognizing opportunities for spontaneous storytelling.
  • Travel as needed to produce original content in markets throughout the United States.

Post-Production

  • Lead the editorial and creative execution of post-production, ensuring finished content meets Amazing America’s storytelling and visual standards.
  • Independently edit original video content using Adobe Premiere Pro.
  • Provide creative direction, feedback, and editorial notes to internal or freelance editors when projects require additional post-production support.
  • Shape compelling narratives through pacing, interview selection, music, sound design, archival footage, graphics, and visual sequencing.
  • Utilize Adobe Photoshop and other Adobe Creative Suite applications to create or enhance graphics, static social content, and visual storytelling elements.
  • Develop platform-specific edits that reflect the distinct audience behaviors and storytelling conventions of TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, and Facebook.
  • Maintain consistency in visual style, tone, and production quality across Amazing America’s content portfolio.

 

Basic Qualifications

  • 5-7+ years of professional experience developing, producing, shooting, and editing editorial or entertainment-focused digital video content.
  • Strong editorial judgment and an ability to identify stories and characters that resonate with digital audiences.
  • Exceptional research, writing, and narrative storytelling skills.
  • Hands-on experience directing studio and field productions.
  • Advanced proficiency operating DSLR/mirrorless cameras, DJI Osmo cameras, smartphones, and associated production equipment.
  • Advanced proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro and working knowledge of Adobe Photoshop and the broader Adobe Creative Suite.
  • Deep understanding of short-form and longer-form digital video storytelling across Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, and Facebook.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently manage multiple projects while meeting creative, editorial, and production deadlines.
  • Excellent organizational, communication, and collaborative skills.
  • Ability to work both independently and as part of a cross-functional creative team.
  • Willingness and ability to travel for productions.

 

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience producing lifestyle, travel, food, culture, entertainment, adventure, or human-interest programming.
  • Experience developing successful social-first content franchises and recurring editorial series.
  • Background in digital journalism, documentary production, or character-driven nonfiction storytelling.
  • Experience working across both premium digital productions and fast-turnaround social content.

 

The base salary compensation range for this role is $90,000 to $120,000. In addition, this role may be eligible for a discretionary quarterly bonus which would be awarded based on individual and company performance.   • Expert-level knowledge of SMPTE ST 2110 IP video infrastructure, including uncompressed video (ST 2110-20), audio (ST 2110-30), and ancillary data (ST 2110-40) flows, with solid comprehension of PTP-based timing and synchronization

  • End-to-end signal chain troubleshooting across IP, SDI, LTC, L-Band, and ASI signals, with a structured methodology for isolating issues across network, device, and workflow layers

Playout & Monitoring

Color, HDR & Satellite

Cloud & General

job.description:
Job Title

Senior Product Manager, Privacy Platform

Job Description

About The Position | Major goals and objectives and location requirements 

 

As People Inc. expands and scales its product offerings, maintaining user trust is foundational to our growth. We are looking for a Senior Product Manager – Data Privacy, Trust & Platform to lead the product strategy, platform capabilities, and user experiences that power data privacy, consent, and user trust across our ecosystem.


In this role, you will bridge the gap between business strategy, legal requirements, and engineering execution, serving as the platform owner for backend data pipelines and compliance automation, and the functional strategist defining user-facing consent controls and preference touch points.

 

Hybrid 3x a week- (New York, NY) 

In-office Expectations: This position is hybrid in-office, with the ability to work remotely for up to 2 days per week.

 

About The Team:

At People Inc., reader trust is essential. This team builds the critical platform infrastructure and defines the user-facing privacy logic that ensures data rights are honored seamlessly for our readers, operationally efficient for internal teams, and fully compliant across global regulations.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:


  • Product Strategy & Leadership: Define and execute a comprehensive product roadmap for user trust, data privacy, and consent management. Serve as the strategic bridge aligning Legal, Engineering, Product, and Revenue leadership around complex trade-offs.
  • Platform Architecture & Data Systems: Partner with engineering teams to design and scale backend data infrastructure, event tracking, and automated compliance pipelines that streamline operations and eliminate manual drag.
  • Agile Team Leadership & Day-to-Day Execution: Lead and run the dedicated engineering scrum team on a day-to-day basis owning sprint planning, backlog prioritization, refinement, discovery and continuous delivery of platform capabilities.
  • User Experience & Product Taste: Lead the functional strategy and design logic for user-facing privacy controls, consent touch points, and account preferences across web and mobile applications ensuring they build brand trust without introducing unnecessary user friction.
  • Cross-Functional Alignment & Revenue Safety: Balance competing business priorities by negotiating clear trade-offs between regulatory risk, user conversion, and ad revenue/analytics sustainability.
  • Internal Tools: Build operational tools and capabilities for internal stakeholders (Legal, Support, Operations) to audit data lineage, monitor compliance metrics, and ensure operational efficiency.

QUALIFICATIONS & REQUIREMENTS:


  • 5+ years of Product Management experience owning software roadmaps, driving strategy, and shipping technical products end-to-end.
  • Demonstrated track record of managing up and driving alignment across product leadership, legal, revenue, and technical stakeholders.
  • Strong technical and systems acumen: Comfortable working with backend data platforms, event tracking, APIs, and data routing infrastructure.
  • User-centric mindset: Passion for building intuitive, high-quality user experiences that simplify complex privacy choices for consumers.
  • Cross-functional leadership: Proven ability to define functional requirements and strategy for neighboring engineering, design, and growth teams.

PREFERRED BACKGROUNDS & TARGET ENVIRONMENTS:


  • Experience in digital media, digital publishing, subscription services, high-scale consumer apps, or B2B data infrastructure balancing subscription growth, user accounts, and revenue sustainability.
  • Background in Data Platform, Growth Infrastructure, Core Platform, Data Governance, or Monetization Systems.
  • Exposure to environments like digital subscription media (The New York Times, Vox Media, Spotify), consumer apps (Airbnb, Uber, Calm, Duolingo), or data platform architectures (Twilio Segment, Snowflake).
  • General understanding of privacy frameworks and how user consent choices impact analytics, ad targeting, and revenue.

People Inc. is looking for an Associate Director of Research & Insights to lead our research strategy for our Beauty, Style, & Entertainment verticals  (Core endemic portfolio: People, Entertainment Weekly, Instyle, Byrdie). job.title: Government and politics editor
job.description:
IndyStar, part of the USA TODAY Network, has an immediate opening for a watchdog-minded, politically savvy journalist who can lead a team of reporters in a competitive, newsy market.

This is a key newsroom role, particularly following the 2026 midterm elections and heading into the start of the Indiana legislative session. Meanwhile, a highly competitive mayoral election has already kicked off ahead of next year's election.

This government and politics editor will work with reporters on the front end as well as the back to shape the full range of politics and government coverage, from breaking news to contextualized enterprise to investigative and watchdog journalism only IndyStar delivers.

The editor will put audience at the center of our coverage, asking with every story what do residents of Central Indiana want and need to know about their governments. They will embrace change and experimentation, learning from failures and pivoting quickly. And they will recognize the value of urgency and scoops.

The successful candidate will have political reporting experience, a keen editing eye and sharp news judgment — someone who is a team player and self-directed, passionate and compassionate, someone who finds success in the success of others.

People skills are as important as journalism skills in this role. Our government and politics editor will be part of a small but mighty team of news editors who rely on each other daily. You will lead your team with empathy while also challenging them to do their best work — whether they're interns still in college, our most experienced staffers or somewhere in between.

IndyStar is the winner of three Pulitzer Prizes, most recently in 2021. You’ll work with and learn from some of journalism’s best while living in a vibrant and diverse city in the heart of the Midwest.

Our mission is clear: IndyStar informs, empowers and inspires the people of Central Indiana with our journalism. We deliver journalism that is essential to the communities we serve with urgency. We are a people-centered newsroom that’s obsessed with thoughtful experimentation and developing our next generation of industry leaders.

If you’re up to the challenge of moving us forward, read on for job requirements and information on how to share your qualifications and best work.

Key responsibilities:

Manage a team of news reporters, including reporters covering Indianapolis city hall, Hamilton County, the Indiana Statehouse and our federal delegation

Lead and provide coverage of national or statewide interest for the USA TODAY Network

Mentor reporters on source-building, interviewing and public records

Meet our audience where they are by using different story formats, video and other visuals to convey information

Use metrics and our internal metrics experts to guide your team's approach to stories

Handle other editing duties as needed, including evening and weekend editor rotations

Requirements:

At least five years of journalism experience, including experience in political reporting or editing

Proven proficiency in applying analytics to content strategy

Strong communication and collaboration skills

Comfort in deadline-driven environment

Exceptional planning and organizational skills

Social-media and SEO knowledge

Strong line-editing skills

Strong people-management skills

Strong problem-solving skills

Experience with public records and data journalism

Command of media law and principles of ethical conduct

Bachelor's degree

Employment is contingent on passing a post-offer pre-employment background check.

We are eager to learn more about you and what you will add to an already-great newsroom. When you apply, don’t limit your upload to a resume; show us what you’ve done. To do so, put together a single document file that includes the following, in this order:

Your resume – one to two pages.

A cover letter that outlines how you would approach the job.

Links to 3 online samples of your work. Show us what you’ve produced or had a hand in that best reflects what you can do in your desired role.

job.title: Kentucky Men's Basketball Insider
job.description:
Covering Kentucky basketball for the Lexington Herald-Leader is a high-impact, high-visibility assignment at the heart of college sports journalism. This is not a traditional beat: you’ll be the go-to source for Big Blue Nation, breaking news and delivering in-depth, personality-driven coverage of the winningest program in men’s college basketball history. You’ll dig into the stories behind the box score—NIL, recruiting, the transfer portal and the business of the UK brand—while also capturing the culture, personalities and community impact that make Kentucky basketball a year-round obsession.

You’ll work across formats, from rapid-turn breaking news to explanatory video, and connect with fans on every platform, from TikTok to live events. AI and automation will help you focus on what matters most: building sources, breaking stories and delivering journalism that sets the agenda for Kentucky sports. You’ll also pitch in on major events like the Kentucky Derby, keeping your reporting fresh and relevant all year.

What sets this role apart:

  • Own one of the most competitive and vital beats in college sports
  • Combine relentless reporting with digital storytelling and audience engagement
  • Use AI and automation to free up time for deeper journalism—never to replace your voice or judgment
  • Reach fans wherever they are, with vertical video, social media and in-person events
  • Be part of a collaborative, supportive newsroom that values experimentation and continuous learning

What you’ll bring:

  • A college degree in journalism or equivalent experience
  • 3-5 years of reporting experience, ideally in highly competitive environments
  • Strong writing skills, excellent news judgment and the ability to spot stories that matter
  • Relentless reporting drive and a commitment to accuracy and ethics
  • Experience building sources and using public records
  • Comfort working nights, weekends and traveling for coverage
  • Skill in shooting and appearing on video, plus a strong grasp of vertical and social-first formats
  • Familiarity with Facebook, X, TikTok, Instagram and emerging platforms
  • Experience with AI tools and/or a willingness to experiment in that space
  • A collaborative approach and eagerness to learn and adapt
  • Reliable transportation, valid driver’s license and vehicle insurance
  • Residency in Lexington-Fayette County

If you’re ready to set the pace for Kentucky basketball coverage and thrive in a digital-first, audience-obsessed environment, we want to hear from you.

To apply, please submit a resume, work samples and a one-page cover letter explaining how you would approach the job.

job.title: Assistant Video Editor
job.description:
WHAT YOU'LL DO

Vox Media is looking for an Assistant Video Editor to join a growing post-production team within the branded content division for Vox and New York Magazine. This role is built for an editor early in their career who is sharp with turnkey and templated formats, comfortable owning quick-turn social cuts independently, and eager to grow into larger, more complex projects under supervision. You'll also work closely with the Post-Production Supervisor to set up and organize projects for external editors, making you a key connective piece between in-house editing and the freelance bench.

 

Editing and Craft

  • Edit turnkey and templated content such as cutdowns, recaps, and repeatable social formats for various platforms
  • Cut quick-turn social edits independently, following established templates and house style
  • Take on larger or more complex edits with guidance from the Post-Production Supervisor and Creative Directors, building toward independent ownership of bigger projects over time
  • Add basic music and sound design to elevate templated pieces
  • Apply light color and LUTs following house presets

Project Setup and Coordination

  • Partner with the Post-Production Supervisor to set up and organize projects for external/freelance editors such as bins, sequences, and file structure, following in-house SOPs
  • Create stringouts for Editors and Creative Directors per project
  • Prep and organize incoming footage, dailies, and assets ahead of handoff to external editors
  • Support project wrap-out and archiving, keeping files clean and organized across both in-house and external-editor projects

 

Workflow and Technical

  • Work in Adobe Premiere, including Team Projects and Productions, following house SOPs for project, bin, sequence, and track structure
  • Support turnovers to color and sound mix during finishing on larger projects
  • Work flexibly across a remote and hybrid workflow, including shipping/receiving drives and cloud sync as needed

 

Collaboration and Delivery

  • Share cuts via Frame.io and address internal notes accurately, flagging concerns proactively
  • Maintain clear communication with producers, the Post-Production Supervisor, and external editors
  • Learn from and support senior editors on shared projects, with room to grow into more senior editing responsibility over time

WHO YOU ARE

  • 2-3 years of experience editing in a digital, social, or branded content environment
  • Comfortable and fast with templated, repeatable edit formats, with a desire to grow into more complex, independent work
  • Working knowledge of Adobe Premiere; familiarity with team projects/Productions is a plus
  • Comprehensive knowledge of technical specifications for distribution across all digital platforms
  • Organized and detail-oriented - comfortable managing file structure and project setup, not just cutting

job.title: Commerce Analyst
job.description:
Commerce Analyst

You'll be the primary point of contact for ecommerce data questions and analysis, translating numbers into clear stories and recommendations for editors, business development, and social teams. This is a role with a lot of autonomy — you'll help own the analysis of specific brands and verticals, structure your own day-to-day, and bring a level-headed approach to a fast-moving media environment.

This is a full-time, benefits-eligible position with an initial five month term, with the possibility of extension based on performance and business need.

What you'll do

  • Present in-depth analyses of ecommerce performance that go beyond reporting what happened, to explain the bigger trends behind it
  • Translate data into plain language for non-data stakeholders, and make clear recommendations to editorial, business development, and social teams
  • Identify growth opportunities and design tests to act on them
  • Own solving problems as they come up — looking for ways to automate or use tools and data rather than patch things manually
  • Support the business with regular reporting, dashboards, and insights, and keep them well-maintained over the course of the engagement
  • Lead ad-hoc analysis for major commerce moments during the contract window (Black Friday, Cyber Monday, holiday season, and into Q1)
  • Help set up reporting and processes that can hand off cleanly at the end of the term

What we're looking for

Skills

  • Strong analytical ability, with a track record of synthesizing data into concepts non-data people can act on
  • Strong understanding of affiliate ecommerce 
  • Hands-on experience with Google Analytics and Big Query
  • Proficiency in Excel; experience with Google Sheets a plus
  • Experience with a data visualization tool — Looker, Google Data Studio (Looker Studio), or Tableau
  • Understanding of statistical concepts
  • Understanding of LLM’s and how they relate to retail/affiliate marketing

Experience

  • 4+ year working in an analytical role
  • Background at an ecommerce company, media company, or tech company preferred — we're open to other paths that show the same analytical muscle
  • Titles like Analyst are typical, but we care more about the work than the title
  • Comfortable hitting the ground running — this is a short-term engagement over our highest-volume season

Nice to haves

  • Experience with BigQuery or another SQL-based analytics tool
  • Search experience — SEO, SEMRush or a competitor tool, Search Console
  • Paid social experience
  • Experience with an affiliate or retail brand business
  • Experience with LLM analytics 

Education

  • No formal degree required. We've worked successfully with people who didn't go to college — what matters is that you're analytical and get results.

job.title: Head of Social, Vulture
job.description:
THE ROLE

Social media is a linchpin of Vulture’s editorial operation — it’s an essential component of everything we produce and the businesses that support those efforts. We’re looking for a Head of Social to oversee that department. This person and their team will collaborate on all the work that Vulture produces and promotes, including articles, video, podcasts, games, and live events. The ideal candidate is a strategic thinker and lover of culture who is as comfortable in a creative brainstorming session as they are poring over editorial analytics. The job is fast-paced and often involves juggling multiple projects, so strong prioritization and communication skills are vital. 

This is a permanent, full-time position. This job is benefits-eligible. We pride ourselves in providing comprehensive benefits to support all of our employees wherever they are in life.

This role is located in our New York City office.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Determine the most effective ways to reflect Vulture’s sensibility, tone, and perspective across key platforms. 
  • Create and publish engaging content. 
  • Establish the necessary social strategies and tactics to help Vulture meet goals relating to audience reach and engagement, subscription conversion, sponsorship fulfillment, and brand-building. 
  • Monitor social performance and use data-driven insights to refine tactics and influence editorial decisions.
  • Manage the social team: create a clear agenda, set priorities, provide coaching. 
  • Introduce clear, efficient processes for working with the rest of the editorial teams. 
  • Pitch new social franchises: videos, columns, rubrics, or just one-off delights. 
  • Work with the Vulture features team and New York culture editors on plans for capturing behind-the-scenes content and subsequent story and package rollouts. 
  • Work with the news team on live-event coverage including red carpets, parties, premieres, award shows, and Vulture-led experiences. This occasionally involves night and weekend work.

job.description:
WHAT YOU’LL DO

Vox Media is looking for a Motion Design Lead, who is both a highly-skilled motion designer and an experienced leader, responsible for conceptualizing and executing motion designs across platforms to create industry-leading branded content for New York Magazine and Vox. The Motion Design Lead is a “player/coach” and has extensive experience creating story-driven content for digital platforms, as well as providing motion design leadership. This role is accountable to the art director and creative director on a project level, and the Head of Branded Content at a high level.

  • Push the level of design our team is known for, partnering with Art Directors and Creative Directors to raise quality expectations and sharpen Vox Media’s visual voice and aesthetic
  • Design and execute motion for a range of advertising clients and internal projects ranging from custom long- and short-form video, to social content — from concept through delivery

  • Provide leadership and creative direction to freelance motion designers, cultivating and growing Vox Media’s network of creative collaborators: designers, animators, and 3D artists
  • Craft and initiate new visual products in partnership with other creative leads, translating what’s next in motion into what’s next for Vox Media
  • Own the team’s motion design and animation best practices, establishing and evolving our standards, workflows, and techniques that keep the team aligned and working at its highest level
  • Develop and maintain brand guidelines for motion and animation, ensuring Vox Media’s visual voice and aesthetic stay consistent and elevated across every deliverable

  • Contribute hands-on where needed, and route the right work to the right people based on individual expertise within our bench of freelance artists

job.title: Network & Systems Engineer
job.description:
THE ROLE

Vox Media is looking for a Network & Systems Engineer to own the design, operation, and evolution of our enterprise office network, studios, and production facilities. This is a hands-on engineering role on a small, high-trust infrastructure team — you will be the person who owns the network end to end.

You will be a primary technical owner of our enterprise network environment, with particular responsibility for our current Juniper infrastructure with Cato Networks providing SASE/SD-WAN and secure remote access. Because we operate as a lean infrastructure team, we're looking for someone who is comfortable working beyond traditional networking boundaries. 

The right person will be equally comfortable troubleshooting a complex routing or switching issue, planning a network migration, supporting server or cloud infrastructure, and partnering with Media & Production Technology, Service Desk, and other technical teams to solve cross-functional problems.

This is a permanent, full-time position. This job is benefits-eligible. We pride ourselves in providing comprehensive benefits to support all of our employees wherever they are in life.

This role is located in our New York City office.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

As our Network & Systems Engineer on a lean infrastructure team, you'll own networking end to end while contributing across systems, cloud, and identity infrastructure when needed. Your responsibilities will include:

  • Design, configure, maintain, and troubleshoot Vox Media's enterprise network across offices, data centers, cloud environments, and remote connectivity
  • Serve as the senior technical resource for our Juniper networking environment, including configuration, troubleshooting, upgrades, and lifecycle management
  • Administer our Cato Networks SASE platform, including SD-WAN connectivity, secure remote access, and associated security policy
  • Help define the future direction of Vox Media's network architecture, including evaluating and potentially migrating infrastructure to platforms such as Cisco and Meraki
  • Design and support LAN, WAN, wireless, and internet connectivity across multiple locations
  • Configure and manage VLANs, routing, switching, STP, ACLs, NAT, DHCP, DNS, and related network services, supporting routing protocols such as BGP and OSPF where applicable
  • Troubleshoot complex Layer 2 and Layer 3 issues, including packet-level analysis and root-cause investigation of difficult network and application connectivity problems
  • Monitor network availability, performance, capacity, and reliability, and proactively address emerging issues
  • Plan and execute network hardware upgrades, migrations, maintenance, and office infrastructure projects — including studio, conference room, and event connectivity — while minimizing business disruption
  • Manage ISP, circuit, and network hardware vendor relationships, including escalations, renewals, and capacity planning
  • Support and troubleshoot server, virtualization, cloud, identity, and enterprise infrastructure, assisting with systems administration across environments such as AWS, VMware, and Windows and/or Linux
  • Support enterprise identity and authentication technologies such as SSO and identity providers, and partner with IT operations on endpoint management (Mac and Windows MDM) and SaaS platform administration
  • Help administer monitoring, logging, configuration management, backup, and infrastructure management platforms
  • Participate in an on-call rotation for infrastructure incidents and perform root-cause analysis across networking, systems, and cloud environments
  • Develop repeatable processes and automation — using scripting, APIs, or infrastructure-as-code tools — that reduce manual administration and improve reliability
  • Assist with hands-on service desk support as needed, particularly for onsite requirements, including hardware and software troubleshooting, employee onboarding/offboarding, and resolution of support tickets to maintain operational continuity.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

Must-haves:

  • 6+ years of professional experience in network engineering and infrastructure engineering
  • Strong hands-on production experience with Juniper networking technologies and Junos
  • Relevant networking certifications such as JNCIA/JNCIS/JNCIP, CCNA, or CCNP
  • Hands-on production experience with Cisco and/or Meraki, and the judgment to evaluate platforms on technical merit rather than familiarity
  • Deep understanding of enterprise TCP/IP networking, including designing, configuring, and troubleshooting Layer 2/Layer 3 switching, routing, wireless, and network connectivity
  • Systematic troubleshooting skills, including diagnosing complex network and application connectivity problems using monitoring, logging, packet capture, and performance-analysis tools
  • Experience planning and executing network upgrades or migrations with minimal business disruption
  • AWS networking experience, including VPCs, routing, VPNs, and cloud connectivity
  • Systems administration or broader infrastructure engineering experience alongside networking
  • Ability to independently own technical projects from design through implementation and ongoing operations, with the documentation and communication skills to bring others along
  • Ability to work onsite up to 5 days per week in Lower Manhattan(Financial District) and to be onsite for after-hours escalations and scheduled maintenance windows

Nice-to-haves:

  • Experience with SASE/SSE platforms such as Cato Networks, Zscaler, or Palo Alto Prisma Access
  • Experience migrating between networking vendors or architectures
  • Experience with Juniper Mist
  • Enterprise wireless design and troubleshooting experience
  • Experience with firewall and network-security platforms
  • Experience with VMware or other virtualization platforms
  • Infrastructure automation with Python, Ansible, Terraform, or similar
  • Familiarity with identity platforms such as Okta and enterprise SaaS infrastructure
  • Media, broadcast, or production environment experience

job.title: Senior Editor, Vox
job.description:
Vox is seeking an experienced editor to help oversee its distinctive coverage of policy in a changing America. This editor will lead a team of multiplatform journalists who explore and explain the world of policy and ideas for Vox’s wide-ranging and curious audience, in a variety of formats including text, podcasts, and video. 

Vox’s coverage is dedicated to original reporting and analysis on issues, personalities, and movements that help people truly understand what’s at stake. We cover policy with a strong grounding in the news, but an eye toward the future and delivering smart solutions.

We’re looking for a dynamic, creative team member who can help Vox grow and adapt in a fast-changing political news landscape – and a pivotal moment in the national conversation. The editor should be eager to manage Vox’s coverage with urgency and ambition. They should also be highly collaborative and excited to work across Vox’s multimedia newsroom, finding creative ways for journalists to contribute to Vox’s signature podcast and video franchises, as well as its growing portfolio of newsletters. 

We’re looking for a leader who closely tracks the news, staying on top of major storylines and nimbly finding ways for Vox to offer distinctive coverage in a busy space. This editor should be able to find smart, original ways into major storylines — and guide reporters to uncovering fresh issues to bring to public attention. They should have a gift for finding points of intersection between American political currents and big-picture areas like technology, religion, and social policy. 

The ideal candidate should have a clear track record of managing journalists to deliver sharp, original angles that cut through the conversation, publishing original pieces on crisp deadlines, while also creating space for longer, more ambitious articles that help shape the public conversation. This position will be based in Washington, D.C. or New York, and report to the executive editor. 

This is a permanent, full-time position. This job is benefits-eligible. We pride ourselves in providing comprehensive benefits to support all of our employees wherever they are in life.

This is a hybrid position based in the Washington, D.C. or New York office, and reports to the executive editor. 

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Manage and lead a team of 4-5 reporters to conceive, assign, and edit pieces rooted in reporting and research. These include both fast analysis off the news and longer-horizon features — all driven by Vox’s commitment to explanation, solutions, new ideas, and improving people’s’ lives.
  • Guide Vox’s coverage of big policy topics with a clear hand and vision, staying on top of the news to find fresh angles
  • Collaborate closely with Vox’s editorial director for politics, as well as other Vox editors across multiple platforms, to deliver a rich and compelling political report.
  • Shape stories and broader coverage plans to ensure they are rigorous, compelling, and aligned with Vox’s editorial strategy and audience goals. You should be able to spot when a piece needs a sharper argument, a stronger evidence base, or a fundamentally different frame. You should also be able to see how each beat fits into Vox’s overall coverage, and identify ways to collaborate, prevent overlap, and build on our strengths.
  • Collaborate with other teams across the newsroom to help develop and sharpen your reporters’ stories in other platforms, including audio, video, and social video.
  • Work closely with colleagues in policy and politics, the executive editor, and the managing editor for audience and membership to ensure our editorial approach connects to Vox’s broader strategy in the membership era.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

  • 5 years’ experience editing
  • While experience with audio and video production is not necessary, the candidate should have an understanding of the politics and policy podcast and video landscape
  • Strong leadership, management, communication, and editing skills
  • Excellent news judgment and a demonstrated ability to bring analysis and sharp angles to news stories
  • Analytical rigor. We want an editor with the ability to pressure-test arguments and take opposing ones seriously. We want an editor who can confidently edit pieces that explain ideas and/or stake out intellectual claims, and who is eager to assign and edit pieces that embrace nuance and complicate narratives without sacrificing clarity. 
  • Passion for Vox’s mission of serving the audience and making complex concepts accessible through explanatory journalism
