job.title: Senior Experiential Strategist
job.description:
We’re seeking a creative, collaborative thinker to shape the experiential strategy for editorial events and custom brand activations across the New York Magazine portfolio. This is a creative-led role for someone who has their finger on the pulse of live experiences, culture, and emerging trends, and can translate those insights into smart, distinctive ideas. The role also requires strong practical expertise — from scoping event budgets and understanding production considerations to managing multiple projects, priorities, and deadlines with organization and ease.

Sitting within the Brand Marketing Strategy and Experiential teams, this is an ideal role for someone who’s passionate about events and creative storytelling, and excited to bring their experience to a fast-paced media company.

What You’ll Do:

  • Drive the creative positioning and go-to-market strategy for experiential offerings across New York Magazine, The Cut, Vulture, and The Strategist
  • Develop creative concepts for marquee multi-sponsor tentpole events, editorial activations, and custom branded experiences
  • Lead experiential thinking for RFPs and proactive pitches, using research, cultural trends, and visual storytelling to develop compelling concepts and proposals
  • Write pitch concepts with clarity, originality, and strategic intent, delivering standout creative copy that brings ideas to life and ladders back to client objectives
  • Lead deck development for proactive pitches to advertisers tied to priority experiential IP
  • Develop detailed event budgets and timelines, and assess production considerations to ensure concepts are both creatively compelling and feasible
  • Present experiential offerings and ideas to the Advertising organization and in client meetings, bringing concepts to life with clarity and confidence

  • Attend key events and production walk-throughs as needed to gain firsthand insight into what works in practice — using those learnings to strengthen future concepts and inform strategic direction
  • Conduct competitive and cultural research to identify emerging opportunities, building a central point of view and a working archive of event moodboards, references, and industry innovation
  • Collaborate across Marketing, Editorial, Sales, and Experiential to shape strategy, provide informed recommendations, and develop ideas that are aligned with business objectives and brought effectively to life
  • Contribute to day-to-day team operations, organization, meeting preparation, and other needs as they arise

What You’ll Bring:

  • 3-5  years of experience in experiential marketing, event production, or creative strategy (agency, media, or brand side)
  • Outstanding writing and visual communication skills, with expertise in building pitch decks in Google Slides
  • Solid understanding of event pricing, preliminary budgeting, and vendor quote management

  • Deep curiosity about live experiences, pop culture, and emerging trends

job.title: Senior Recruiter
job.description:
THE ROLE

Vox Media is looking for a Senior Recruiter to own full-cycle hiring for editorial (New York Magazine & Vox), podcast (Vox Media Podcast Network), revenue, and operations roles across the company. 

This is a role for someone who has run full-cycle recruiting before, is comfortable being a trusted advisor to hiring managers (including senior ones), and genuinely enjoys the craft of matching talented people to the right opportunity, especially in a media environment where roles and needs can shift quickly.

Candidates should be fans of New York Magazine, Vox, and our podcast network.

This is a permanent, full-time position. This job is benefits-eligible. We pride ourselves in providing comprehensive benefits to support all of our employees wherever they are in life.

This job is located in our New York City office.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Manage full-cycle recruiting — intake, sourcing, screening, interview coordination, offer, and close — for a portfolio of roles spanning editorial, podcast/audio, revenue, and operations functions.
  • Partner with hiring managers and senior leaders to scope open roles, build hiring plans, and act as a strategic advisor throughout the search.
  • Build and maintain proactive, representative talent pipelines through sourcing, referrals, and passive-candidate outreach, rather than relying solely on inbound applications.
  • Deliver a high-touch candidate experience that reflects well on Vox Media — timely communication, clear expectations, and thoughtful follow-through.
  • Structure and run consistent, bias-aware interview processes, including writing job scorecards and coaching interviewers on effective, legally sound interviewing.
  • Manage multiple concurrent searches with competing timelines, keeping hiring managers and candidates aligned without dropping the details.
  • Own offer strategy and negotiation in partnership with People leadership, balancing candidate expectations with internal equity and approved compensation bands.
  • Track and report on pipeline health, time-to-fill, and other recruiting metrics, and use that data to flag risks and recommend adjustments.
  • Stay current on the media, journalism, and podcasting talent landscape, and bring market insight back to hiring teams.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

  • A passion for the art of talent acquisition — aka you love what you do.
  • You're a genuine fan of our brands and shows — and you actually consume them.
  • 6+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience (strong preference for in-house) — you have a strong track record for closing candidates.
    • Specifically, experience recruiting editorial, creative, and audio/podcast talent.
  • You strive for a positive candidate experience — each open role builds on your ability to grow the talent network.
  • Strong sourcing skills — you don't wait for the perfect candidate to apply; you go find them.
  • Stakeholder management is second nature for you — you feel confident advising and pushing back constructively on hiring managers, including senior leaders.
  • You know that diverse slates alone don't move the needle — you build hiring processes that are equitable by design, from first outreach to final offer.
  • Excellent organizational skills — you can run a busy, varied req load without letting candidates or hiring managers fall through the cracks.

job.description:
Criminal Productions is looking for a temporary full-time Podcast Video & Social Media Producer to join our team. 

As a Podcast Video & Social Producer you will be responsible for creating video and social content for our digital platforms. This will range from producing long-form video interviews to short-form social media video clips. You will also create additional social content including image assets, stories/reels, and caption copy. You will work closely with the podcast producers and the podcast marketing team to reflect Criminal Productions’ voice, spirit, and brand.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Produce longform video content for Criminal’s YouTube channel from start to finish (coordinating recording, making initial editorial cuts and decisions, working with a video editor on drafts, and publishing a final version)
  • Produce shortform video content for Criminal’s YouTube shorts channel, as well as social media platforms - translating podcast moments into compelling visual stories
  • Upload archival Criminal podcast episodes to YouTube
  • Create compelling thumbnails, titles and copy for YouTube videos (including shorts) 
  • Coordinate and collaborate with show producers to create a social media plan around promoting new episodes across all of our podcasts, as well as upcoming events, important initiatives, and more
  • Develop and produce engaging social content for each Criminal Productions show— including image assets, GIFs, stories/reels, motion graphics, video cut-downs of episodes, and platform-specific variants
  • Optimize content for platform performance (length, format, captioning, hashtags, thumbnails, CTAs) and stay current with algorithm changes and emerging formats
  • Track performance metrics (views, reach, engagement, follower growth, click-throughs to episode/subscribe) and feed insights back into creative strategy
  • Maintain an archive of assets and templates, and iterate efficiency in production workflows

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

  • Demonstrated ability to produce both longform and shortform video content, especially for talk-based or interview-driven formats
  • Excellent storytelling instincts; knowing which moments to spotlight that hook viewers, evoke emotion or insight, and prompt engagement or action
  • Strong understanding of social platforms and their nuances: Instagram (feed, stories, reels), TikTok, YouTube Shorts, Facebook - including what drives performance, how users engage, and what makes shows grow
  • A collaborative, consultative working style and the ability to plug into existing teams to help elevate their visual presence.
  • Solid skills in editing short-form video tools (e.g., Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, After Effects) and comfort with static image design (Photoshop, Illustrator, Canva) and motion graphic templates
  • Ability to manage multiple projects/shows simultaneously, prioritize under tight deadlines, and collaborate closely with teammates
  • Attentiveness to performance metrics and a willingness to adjust accordingly
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Experience working in podcast media or editorial-driven media brands
  • Familiarity with audio editing or podcast production workflows a plus  

WHO WE ARE

Criminal Productions is the home of the podcast Criminal - as well as the podcasts This is Love, Phoebe Reads a Mystery, and their newest podcast: Please Continue with Phoebe and Lauren. 

Criminal is one of the most-listened to podcasts in the United States, and has been called “the thinking person’s true crime podcast.” Founded in 2014, Criminal has been praised by the ACLU of New York, The New York Times, Entertainment Weekly, and by the former Prime Minister of New Zealand, Jacinda Ardern. 

In 2018, the Criminal team launched This is Love. Time Magazine says, “The podcast tries to decode the mystery of how our romances, obsessions, and relationships drive us. Listening to it can feel like a contact high.” Phoebe Reads a Mystery features Criminal and This is Love host Phoebe Judge reading some of her favorite books in the public domain - from Sherlock Holmes to Little Women. 

Please Continue is our newest venture - an “unserious” chat show featuring Phoebe Judge and Criminal co-creator Lauren Spohrer in conversation about everything from offbeat crime stories to Costco shopping tips. One listener called their dynamic “comedy gold.” 

Criminal Productions is part of Vox Media. As a community of journalists and storytellers, business professionals, creators, and technologists, we believe it is a moral and business imperative to amplify voices: to cultivate diversity, equity, and inclusion throughout our organization and media. This applies to our candidates, our teams, our storytelling, our creative work, and our platforms, products, and partnerships.

job.title: Senior Financial Accountant
job.description:
Join the future of news

We’re on a mission to deliver riveting storytelling for all of America. At The Washington Post, you’ll help reinvent news. Our work is driven by a deep investigative spirit and enhanced by innovation to bring audiences closer to the stories that matter most.


About Our Team


The Washington Post is powered by the passion and talent of our people. It takes all of us to reinvent news. Beyond our award-winning News and Opinions teams, we work across many departments, including Brand & Events, Communications, Customer Care, Engineering & Product, Finance, Human Resources, Legal, Marketing & Advertising, Print Operations, and Sales.


Why This Role Matters

 

The Washington Post’s Finance Department is seeking an experienced Senior Accountant to join our Financial Accounting and Reporting team. This role is pivotal in ensuring the integrity of financial data that enables our leaders to make informed, strategic decisions. You will thrive here if you are adaptable to evolving business priorities, curious about the bigger picture, and eager to apply your accounting expertise to enhance processes and deliver high-quality results.
 

What Motivates You

  • You take pride in producing accurate, high-quality financial information that supports strategic decision-making.

  • You have a keen eye for detail and maintain efficiency without sacrificing accuracy.

  • You adapt quickly to shifting priorities and balance speed with precision in your daily work.

  • You enjoy applying your technical accounting knowledge to complex scenarios, researching new guidance, and finding practical solutions.

  • You are energized by opportunities to improve processes, introduce automation, and drive innovation.

  • You appreciate working independently while providing timely updates, managing competing priorities, and collaborating with stakeholders across the organization.

How You'll Support the Mission

  • Execute general ledger accounting functions, including journal entries, month-end and year-end close activities, and preparation of accurate financial statements.

  • Conduct detailed variance analyses for income statement and balance sheet accounts, identifying trends and insights for leadership.

  • Interpret and apply GAAP accounting standards in collaboration with Financial Accounting management, ensuring compliance and accuracy.

  • Develop and maintain clear, up-to-date process documentation for accounting procedures, outlining both task execution and business purpose.

  • Identify opportunities for automation, recommend innovative process improvements to enhance efficiency and accuracy, and utilize tools to build automations for your areas of responsibility.

  • Prepare documentation for annual financial statements, tax and compliance filings, and audit requirements.

  • Support interim and year-end audit cycles by providing timely, accurate data to internal and external auditors.

  • Lead or contribute to special projects, analyses, and ad hoc reporting requests.

  • Deliver excellent service to internal and external stakeholders, fostering collaborative relationships across departments.

The Skills and Experience You Bring

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting.

  • At least 3 years of progressive experience in accounting or auditing.

  • Proven expertise in general ledger operations and financial reporting.

  • Proficient with data analytics platforms and data visualization tools (e.g., Alteryx, Power BI)

  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills (VLOOKUP, pivot tables, Power Pivot).

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills to prepare, present, and collaborate effectively.

  • Ability to prepare and analyze complex financial statements.

  • Demonstrated problem-solving skills with attention to detail and follow-through.

  • Strong time management skills with the ability to balance multiple priorities.

Preferred Qualifications

  • CPA or CA designation or CPA candidate.

  • Experience with Oracle, Hyperion Smartview, BlackLine, Salesforce, Bloomberg Tax and Accounting Fixed Assets, LeaseQuery, SAP, and Asana.

 

Collaboration makes us stronger. That’s why our offices are designed with open layouts, modern technology, and easy access to transportation. With certain exceptions for newsgathering and business travel, we work on-site five days a week.

Compensation and Benefits

Wherever you are in your life or career, The Washington Post offers comprehensive and inclusive benefits for every step of your journey:

  • Competitive medical, dental and vision coverage

  • Company-paid pension and 401(k) match

  • Three weeks of vacation and up to three weeks of paid sick leave

  • Nine paid holidays and two personal days

  • 20 weeks paid parental leave for any new parent

  • Robust mental health resources

  • Backup care and caregiver concierge services

  • Gender affirming services

  • Pet insurance

  • Free Post digital subscription

  • Leadership and career development programs

Benefits may vary based on the job, full-time or part-time schedule, location, and collectively bargained status.

The salary range for this position is:

$85,100 - $127,700 Annual

The actual salary within this range will depend on individual skills, experience, and qualifications as they relate to specific job requirements. This position may be eligible for a bonus or incentive program, and a member of the Talent Acquisition team will discuss bonus payment terms and conditions during the interview process.

job.title: VP, Creative Membership
job.description:
About ASCAP

The American Society of Composers, Authors and Publishers (ASCAP) is a membership association of more than one million songwriters, composers and music publishers, and represents some of the world’s most talented music creators. Founded and governed by songwriters, composers and publishers, it is the only performing rights organization in the U.S. that operates on a not-for-profit basis. ASCAP licenses a repertory of over 20 million musical works to hundreds of thousands of businesses that use music, including streaming services, cable television, radio and satellite radio and brick and mortar businesses such as retail stores, hotels, clubs, restaurants and bars. ASCAP collects the licensing fees; identifies, matches and processes trillions of performances every year; and returns nearly 90 cents of every dollar back to its members as royalties. The ASCAP blanket license offers an efficient solution for businesses to legally perform ASCAP music while respecting the right of songwriters and composers to be paid fairly. ASCAP puts music creators first, advocating for their rights and the value of music on Capitol Hill, driving innovation that moves the industry forward, building community and providing the resources and support that creators need to succeed in their careers. Learn more and stay in touch at www.ascap.com, on X and Instagram @ASCAP and on Facebook.

# # #

Job overview:

The VP, Creative Membership is responsible for championing, supporting and advocating on behalf of ASCAP’s diverse community of creators in the West Coast market. They will serve as a key point of contact for high profile members, developing member outreach initiatives, recruiting and retaining West Coast creative talent, and building and maintaining a deep network of relationships across labels, publishers, lawyers, managers and other industry stakeholders in order to increase value of the ASCAP repertory. The West Coast Membership department is directly responsible for outreach to some of ASCAP’s most prominent and successful West Coast -based members.

This position is based in our Los Angeles office and will report to the EVP, Head of Creative Membership located in the New York office. This position is subject to ASCAP’s in-office policy.

Areas of Responsibility & Accountability:

  • Establish, cultivate, and maintain deep, trusted relationships with our diverse community of songwriters, composers and producers in the West Coast market to protect, strengthen, and grow the value of the ASCAP repertory.
  • Serve as the primary ASCAP point of contact for assigned high-profile creator members and their key representatives, providing high-touch service and resolving complex membership, catalog and distribution inquiries with diplomacy.
  • Proactively escalate highly sensitive or complex issues to the relevant internal subject matter experts and ASCAP executive leadership to ensure swift, white-glove resolution.
  • Act as a brand ambassador and strategic voice for ASCAP at industry panels, conferences, award shows, and high-profile events to drive market awareness of ASCAP’s creator-first mission and value proposition.
  • Foster relationships between ASCAP members and the broader music ecosystem by maintaining relationships with publishers, artists, record labels, licensees, lawyers, managers, agents and trade organizations.
  • Partner with the Marketing & Communications team to plan, curate, and host high-impact member events and recognition initiatives.
  • Develop a deep, authoritative understanding of ASCAP’s Survey and Distribution System and ASCAP membership policies and procedures, to confidently guide members through membership- and distribution-related inquiries.
  • Translate market analysis and industry trends into visually engaging and compelling presentations (including advanced PowerPoint collateral), with the versatility to confidently pitch, present, and align both small, high-profile talent teams and large organizational audiences around the ASCAP value proposition.
  • Analyze critical market share data and deliver strategic recommendations to key internal stakeholders and executive leadership.
  • Provide strategic leadership, coaching, and career development for direct reports; and oversee, inspire, and manage the day-to-day operations of the Membership team in the West Coast office.
  • Collaborate seamlessly across the ASCAP Creative Membership team to share best practices, align regional goals, and unify strategies.
  • Work cross-functionally with internal departments to continually expand and refine ASCAP services, including career development, member benefits, education, and advocacy programs.
  • Other duties and special projects as assigned.

Qualifications & Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in Music Business, Business Administration, Communications, Marketing, or a related field. MBA or JD preferred.
  • 10+ years of progressive, leadership-level experience in the music industry.
  • A deep, well-established network of high-level relationships spanning licensing, songwriting, music publishing, and record labels specifically within the West Coast market and broader music industry.
  • Proven experience managing, mentoring, and developing diverse teams of direct reports at varying career stages.
  • Demonstrated ability to operate highly autonomously, navigate ambiguous environments, and communicate with exceptional clarity and diplomacy with ASCAP executive leadership.
  • Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office, with a proven track record of designing highly influential, executive-level PowerPoint presentations that distill complex strategies into compelling visual narratives for senior leadership.
  • Advanced analytical capabilities, with an ability to evaluate complex market trends, track competitor landscapes, and translate raw data into actionable strategic insights.
  • A discerning instinct for songwriter and composer talent (an “ear” for music) and a proven track record of identifying, onboarding, and nurturing high-potential creators toward long-term career success.
  • Excellent organizational, and time-management skills, with a track record of delivering flawless executive-level work under tight deadlines and during high-volume periods.
  • Ability and willingness to attend Nashville and other music industry events, including on the weekends and in the evenings, with ability to travel for meetings and events as needed.
  • Comprehensive understanding of music publishing, copyright law, and performance rights dynamics on a global scale.
  • A passionate, authentic advocate for ASCAP’s core values, including transparency, fairness, a future-forward outlook, and putting creators first.
  • Ability to comply with ASCAP’s current in-office policy (subject to change).

Compensation/Benefits:

Besides providing a unique and dynamic work environment, there are a few other reasons you should consider ASCAP in your career planning. We also offer generous benefit options that are comprehensive and provide the flexibility that most employees want and need. These health care and financial plan options include the following:

  • A choice of either network-only provider medical and dental plans or more flexible medical and dental plans where you can see providers in or out-of-network
  • Vision plan that offers both in and out-of-network provider options
  • 401(k) Plan that offers pre-tax, Roth, and an after-tax employee contribution option which includes a company match
  • An additional employer paid discretionary profit share contribution, regardless of your participation in the 401(k) Plan
  • Generous time-off policy
  • Health care and dependent care flexible spending accounts
  • Short-term disability insurance/salary continuation and long-term disability insurance
  • Company provided basic life and accidental death and dismemberment insurance
  • Employee gym discounts at select gyms
  • Commuter benefits
  • Voluntary pet health insurance
  • Voluntary auto and homeowner’s insurance
  • Voluntary employee, spouse, and dependent life insurance options
  • Voluntary ID protection Coverage

The above summary of the current benefits is subject to the terms and conditions of the benefit plan documents. This summary is not complete and is subject to the terms of the underlying plan documents. Please note that ASCAP reserves the right to amend or otherwise revise or terminate, at any time and in its sole discretion, its benefit plans, programs, and policies.

The anticipated base salary range for this position is $160,000 to $180,000 and will be determined on an individualized basis depending on several factors that are unique to each candidate including geographic location (due to differences in the cost of labor), skills, education and prior relevant experience.

Please be aware that ASCAP is not a nut-free or other allergen-free workplace.

ASCAP is an equal opportunity employer. All ASCAP employment decisions are made on the basis of individual qualifications and performance and not on the basis of race, national origin, ethnicity, sex, age, marital status, sexual orientation or preference, gender identity, genetic information, disability, handicap, color, creed, religion, veteran status, or any characteristic protected by applicable federal, state or local laws.

job.title: Analyst, Marketing Financial Planning
job.description:
About Sony Music Entertainment

At Sony Music Entertainment, we fuel the creative journey. We’ve played a pioneering role in music history, from the first-ever music label to the invention of the flat disc record. We’ve nurtured some of music’s most iconic artists and produced some of the most influential recordings of all time.

Today, we work in more than 70 countries, supporting a diverse roster of international superstars, developing and independent artists, and visionary creators. From our position at the intersection of music, entertainment, and technology, we bring imagination and expertise to the newest products and platforms, embrace new business models, employ breakthrough tools, and provide powerful insights that help our artists push creative boundaries and reach new audiences. In everything we do, we’re committed to artistic integrity, transparency, and entrepreneurship.

Sony Music Entertainment is a member of the Sony family of global companies.

We are seeking a detail-oriented, analytical, and music-passionate Analyst to join our centralized finance team supporting the Sony Music US Front Line Label Group, which includes Columbia Records, RCA Records, Epic Records, Arista Records, Sony Music Nashville, Provident Entertainment, and Ultra Records.

Reporting to the Associate Director of Marketing Financial Planning, this position will support the planning, tracking, and analysis of marketing expenses across artist campaigns for assigned labels. The Analyst will work closely with finance, marketing, and media teams to help maintain accurate budgets, process purchase orders, reconcile expenses, and provide visibility into campaign spending. The ideal candidate is organized, curious, comfortable working with financial data, and able to manage multiple priorities in a collaborative environment.

What you'll do:

  • Budgeting and Forecasting: Assist with maintaining artist marketing budgets that support release strategies and commercial plans. Update marketing budgets in the company’s planning system and help ensure information remains accurate as campaign plans change. Support the monthly forecast process by gathering campaign updates and entering revised spending assumptions.
  • Purchase Order Administration: Coordinate with label teams to create and submit marketing-related purchase orders in line with approved campaign budgets and internal requirements. Work with Accounts Payable and label partners to research discrepancies and support timely vendor payments.
  • Expense Reconciliation and Analysis: Complete monthly and quarterly reconciliations of marketing expenses. Support the preparation of accruals and journal entries. Review spending activity, identify potential variances, and share findings with the manager. Assist with reviewing marketing recoupment calculations and tracking third-party sponsorships, invoices, and payments.
  • Financial Reporting and Spend Visibility: Maintain marketing expense reports and dashboards that provide visibility into actual spending and remaining budgets by artist, project, and campaign. Assist with tracking contractual marketing commitments across artists, projects, spending categories, and release phases.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work with marketing, media, promotion, and finance teams across assigned labels to gather information and resolve questions. Participate in marketing financial planning meetings and provide updates on budgets, spending, and purchase orders.
  • Compliance and Process Support: Help ensure marketing expenses are supported by the appropriate documentation and follow company finance policies, approval requirements, and established controls. Assist with audit requests and support updates to budgeting, reporting, and purchase order processes.
  • Special Projects: Assist with campaign analyses, vendor comparisons, label-wide marketing expense reviews, and other projects as assigned.

Who you are:

  • You have a Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
  • You have up to two years of experience in accounting, financial planning and analysis, corporate finance, or a related area. Internship or entry-level experience in music, entertainment, or media is a plus.
  • You are proficient in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, and are comfortable learning new systems and applications.
  • Experience with SAP, Power BI, Tableau, or other financial reporting tools is a plus, but not required.
  • You have strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with close attention to detail and accuracy.
  • You communicate clearly and professionally and are comfortable working with colleagues across different teams and levels.
  • You are organized, able to manage multiple assignments, and comfortable adjusting to changing priorities and deadlines.
  • You are collaborative, curious, and willing to ask questions and learn.
  • You take ownership of your work, follow through on commitments, and raise issues when additional guidance is needed.
 

What we give you:

  • You join an inclusive, collaborative and global community where you have the opportunity to channel your passion every day  
  • A modern office environment designed to foster productivity, creativity, and teamwork empowering you to bring your best 
  • An attractive and comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, life & disability coverage, and 401K + employer matching 
  • Voluntary benefits like company-paid identity theft protection and resources for pets, mental health and meditation resources, industry-leading fertility coverage, fully paid leave for childbirth or bonding, fully paid leave for caregivers, programs for loved ones with developmental disabilities and neurodiversity, subsidized back-up child and elder care, and reimbursement for adoption, surrogacy, tuition, and student loans 
  • Investment in your professional growth and development enabling you to thrive in our vibrant community.  
  • The space to accelerate progress, positively disrupt, and create what happens next  
  • Time off for a winter recess

Sony Music is committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all persons regardless of age, disability, national origin, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity or expression, pregnancy, veteran or military status, marital and civil partnership/union status, alienage or citizenship status, creed, genetic information or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

job.title: Manager, Marketing Strategy, Mexico - The Orchard
job.description:
About The Orchard

The Orchard is a leading full-service music distribution company operating in 50+ markets worldwide. The Orchard empowers creators and businesses to grow and evolve in the dynamic, global music industry. We specialize in being Artist focused, blending industry expertise and technology, leveraging data to drive success, and providing streamlined digital and physical solutions. The Orchard’s comprehensive artist & label services offerings include marketing, sync licensing, premium video services, transparent data analysis, advertising, rights management, radio promotion, D2C, and more.

The Orchard focuses on providing a comfortable, social, and engaging environment to encourage productivity and creativity.

We are looking for a Marketing Strategy Manager to support the development and execution of digital marketing campaigns for artists, labels, releases, catalog, tours, and other priority projects.

This role will work across digital strategy, social media, audience development, first-party data, CRM, campaign analytics, and fan engagement. We are looking for someone who is curious about music and digital culture, comfortable working with data, and able to turn trends and campaign results into useful recommendations.

What you'll do:

  • Support the development and execution of integrated digital marketing strategies across social media, streaming platforms, CRM, websites, paid media, and fan engagement initiatives.
  • Stay up to date on social media, music, creator, and cultural trends, identifying relevant opportunities for artists and campaigns.
  • Support first-party data acquisition and audience development initiatives, including fan registration, pre-save campaigns, audience segmentation, and other fan engagement activations.
  • Build, test, and send newsletters and targeted email communications to help strengthen ongoing fan relationships.
  • Review analytics across TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, streaming, CRM, websites, and paid media to identify trends, learnings, and opportunities.
  • Translate campaign performance and audience insights into clear recommendations for ongoing and future campaigns.
  • Build and customize basic template-based landing pages, including forms, buttons, links, redirects, and basic HTML/CSS adjustments.
  • Contribute to campaign recaps, reporting, and recommendations for artists, labels, and internal stakeholders.

Who you are:

  • 3-5 years of experience in digital marketing, preferably within music, entertainment, media, or a related field.
  • Good understanding of platforms such as TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, and streaming services.
  • Strong interest in social media trends, music, pop culture, and fan behavior.
  • Comfortable reviewing digital platform analytics and identifying basic performance trends.
  • Ability to turn data and campaign learnings into clear, practical recommendations.
  • Familiarity with email marketing, audience segmentation, CRM, or first-party data collection.
  • Strong organizational and communication skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects at the same time.
  • High attention to detail and a hands-on approach to campaign execution.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in the music or entertainment industry.
  • Familiarity with streaming analytics.
  • Experience with audience development or fan engagement campaigns.
  • Comfortable working with template-based landing pages and basic HTML/CSS. Advanced web development experience is not required.

What we give you:

  • An opportunity to influence music on a global stage.
  • A modern, diverse and creative work environment.
  • An investment in your learning & development.
  • A comprehensive and attractive benefits package including healthcare coverage, voluntary benefits, and family resources.

Français:
Amazon Music est un service de divertissement audio immersif qui connecte les fans, les artistes et les créateurs. Des playlists personnalisées aux podcasts exclusifs, en passant par la diffusion de concerts en direct et les produits dérivés des artistes, Amazon Music innove à l’intersection entre musique et culture. Nous proposons des expériences adaptées à tous les auditeurs grâce à nos différentes offres: les membres Prime bénéficient d'un accès sans publicité à l'ensemble du catalogue musical en mode aléatoire, ainsi qu'aux meilleurs podcasts sans publicité, le tout inclus dans leur abonnement; les clients peuvent opter pour Amazon Music Unlimited afin d'accéder en illimité et à la demande à 100 millions de titres, dont des millions en HD, Ultra HD et audio spatial ; enfin, chacun peut écouter de la musique gratuitement en téléchargeant l'application Amazon Music ou via des appareils compatibles avec Alexa. Rejoignez-nous pour contribuer à façonner la manière dont Amazon Music interagit avec les fans, les artistes et les créateurs à l'échelle mondiale.

Nous recherchons un(e) Responsable de programme (Program Manager) maîtrisant le français (langue maternelle ou niveau C2). Vous intégrerez notre équipe International Product, responsable de l'expérience client dans les nombreux pays où Amazon Music est présent. Vous contribuerez à améliorer le quotidien de nos clients francophones et à définir les exigences linguistiques pour les nouvelles fonctionnalités d'Amazon Music qui améliorent leur expérience musicale. Vos missions consisteront notamment à analyser et résoudre les problèmes rencontrés par les clients, à identifier les lacunes de l'expérience client (CX) via des audits de parcours et des workshops, à fournir un support produit et créer des rapports personnalisés pour les parties prenantes internes et externes, ainsi qu'à accompagner nos équipes mondiales Produit et QA (Assurance Qualité) pour tester l'expérience locale des nouvelles fonctionnalités. Nous recherchons une personne à l'aise avec les données et les produits technologiques pour prendre des décisions et proposer des améliorations de l'expérience client, et qui s'épanouit dans un environnement dynamique et en évolution rapide.

English:
Amazon Music is an immersive audio entertainment service that deepens connections between fans, artists, and creators. From personalized music playlists to exclusive podcasts, concert livestreams to artist merch, Amazon Music is innovating at some of the most exciting intersections of music and culture. We offer experiences that serve all listeners with our different tiers of service: Prime members get access to all the music ad-free in shuffle mode, and top ad-free podcasts, included with their membership; customers can upgrade to Amazon Music Unlimited for unlimited, on-demand access to 100 million songs, including millions in HD, Ultra HD, and spatial audio; and anyone can listen for free by downloading the Amazon Music app or via Alexa-enabled devices. Join us for the opportunity to influence how Amazon Music engages fans, artists, and creators on a global scale.

We are looking for a Program Manager with native / C2 level proficiency in French. You will be part of our International Product Team that owns the customer experience in our vast number of Amazon Music supported countries around the world. You will help us improve the day-to-day experience of our French speaking customers and define language-specific requirements for new Amazon Music features that make it easier for customers to fall in love with music. Your focus will be to analyze and fix current customer issues, identify CX gaps by conducting walk-the-store and workshops, provide product support to and create customized reports for internal and external stakeholders, and support our global Product and QA teams to test the local experience of brand-new features. We're looking for someone who is comfortable working with data and technology products in order to make decisions and suggest improvements to the CX, and thrives in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.

Key job responsibilities
Français:
- Connaissance client : Vous adorez vous mettre à la place des clients, et êtes curieux(se) d'explorer les différentes manières dont ils consomment la musique. Vous tirez des enseignements des retours clients, des données d'utilisation et d'études externes, et alimentez la réflexion de nos chefs de produit grâce à des analyses ponctuelles ou des rapports hebdomadaires/mensuels sur l’expérience client.

- Gestion des problèmes : Vous gérez simultanément de nombreuses demandes ponctuelles, tout en priorisant et en résolvant les lacunes de l'expérience client, qu'elles soient internes ou externes. Vous simplifiez des problèmes complexes, produisez des rapports personnalisés grâce à votre capacité à analyser les données, et communiquez efficacement avec les chefs de produit ainsi qu'avec les parties prenantes internes et externes.

- Soutien au lancement de fonctionnalités : Vous incarnez la voix locale du client pour les nouvelles expériences Amazon Music. Vous collaborez étroitement avec les équipes mondiales d'assurance qualité (QA) pour comprendre et vérifier l'expérience client locale. Vous communiquez vos conclusions de manière précise et orientée vers les solutions, tout en sachant trouver le juste équilibre entre rapidité d'exécution et obsession du client.

- Soutien éditorial : Vous travaillez avec les équipes éditoriales, de programmation de contenu et de relations avec les labels pour garantir une expérience produit optimale lors de nos campagnes marketing et artistiques. Vous conseillez sur l'expérience visée, puis définissez et mettez en œuvre des solutions créatives pour ravir nos clients.

- Benchmarking : Vous êtes l'expert(e) concernant l'expérience client du streaming musical local. Vous comparez notre produit à ceux d'autres fournisseurs internes et externes, et utilisez vos conclusions pour formuler des recommandations à nos chefs de produit.
- Gestion des parties prenantes: Vous collaborez avec un large éventail d'interlocuteurs clés, notamment les chefs de produit locaux et mondiaux, le service client, les ingénieurs QA, le marketing, la programmation de contenu et les équipes chargées des relations
avec les artistes et les labels.
- Gestion des processus : Vous travaillez en étroite collaboration avec d'autres chefs de programme et membres de l'équipe à l'élaboration de protocoles et de processus pour les mécanismes existants et futurs. Vous évaluez en permanence les outils et processus de collecte de données et proposez des solutions pour garantir leur efficacité, leur qualité et leur évolutivité.

- Adoption de l'IA : Vous identifiez des opportunités d'utiliser des outils d'IA pour optimiser et automatiser des processus tels que l'analyse de l'expérience client, le reporting et le tri des problèmes, réduisant ainsi la charge de travail manuel tout en étendant la couverture géographique. Vous restez à l'affût des capacités émergentes de l'IA et formulez des recommandations concrètes pour améliorer l'efficacité de l'équipe grâce à ces technologies.

English
- Customer Insights: You live and breathe customer insights, and are curious to explore the differences in how customers consume music. You derive insights from customer feedback, usage data, and external research, and provide input to our product managers through ad-hoc analyses or weekly/monthly CX reporting.

- Issue Management: You manage numerous ad hoc requests concurrently, and prioritize and resolve internal and external customer experience gaps. You simplify complex issues, provide customized reporting with the ability to understand and analyze data, and effectively communicate to product managers, internal and external stakeholders.

- Feature Launch Support: You are the local voice of the customer for new Amazon Music experiences. You work closely with global QA to understand and verify the local CX. You communicate findings in a precise and solution oriented manner and are able to walk the fine line between speed and customer obsession.

- Editorial support: You work with editorial, content programming and label relations to enable a great product CX for our artist and marketing campaigns. You consult on the desired experience, and define and execute creative solutions to delight our customers. Benchmarking: You are the subject matter expert for the local music streaming CX. You benchmark our product against other internal and external providers, and use your findings to make recommendations to our product managers.

- Stakeholder Management: You work with a broad set of key stakeholders including local and global product managers, customer service, quality assurance engineers, marketing, content programming and artist/label relations.

- Process Management: You partner closely with other Program Managers and team members on protocol/process development for existing and future mechanisms. You continuously evaluate data collection tools and processes and offer solutions to ensure they are efficient, high quality and scalable.

- AI Adoption: You identify opportunities to apply AI tools and automation to streamline processes such as CX analysis, reporting, and issue triage — reducing manual effort while scaling coverage across territories. You stay curious about emerging AI capabilities and bring practical recommendations for where they can improve team efficiency.

Basic Qualifications

- Expérience en gestion de programmes ou de projets / Experience in program or project management
- Maîtrise du français et de l'anglais (oral et écrit) au niveau C2 ou supérieur / Speak, write, and read fluently in French and English at C2 level or above
- Expérience dans la facilitation de la collaboration interne entre différentes équipes / Experience driving internal cross-team collaboration

Preferred Qualifications

- Connaissance d’outils d'IA généralistes / Knowledge of general AI tools
- Expérience dans des tâches ou projets analytiques impliquant le traitement de données / Experience in analytical tasks or projects, working with data
- Expérience dans la définition et la mise en œuvre des exigences d'un programme / Experience defining and executing program requirements
- Capacité avérée à travailler en autonomie au sein d'une équipe répartie géographiquement, en collaborant efficacement avec des parties prenantes situées sur différents sites et fuseaux horaires / Demonstrated ability to work autonomously within a distributed team, collaborating effectively with stakeholders across multiple locations and time zones
- Expérience de travail avec des technologies et des produits numériques / Experience working with technology and digital products

Description

We are seeking an ambitious Technical Program Manager to join our Metrics and Data Platform team at Amazon Music. The Metrics and Data Platform team plays a central role in enabling Amazon Music's business decisions and software development by processing billions of streaming events and delivering the behavioral and operational metrics that teams across Music, Prime, and Retail depend on every day. We maintain a scalable and robust data platform to support Amazon Music's business operations and growth, and collaborate closely with data producers and data consumers to accelerate innovation using data.

As a Technical Program Manager, you will own and drive multiple high-impact programs across Amazon Music. You will start by owning and curating Amazon Music's data model, serving as the central steward of how the business represents customer behaviors as data concepts. You will standardize key concepts across teams, simplify our event model to make it more intuitive and valuable, and grow the event model over time so it keeps pace with an evolving business. A major part of this work is building GenAI tooling to automate the curation and evolution of the event model, reducing manual effort and helping the platform scale. From this foundation, you will grow to take on additional high-impact programs across Amazon Music, driving org-wide priorities as they emerge. A successful candidate will be customer obsessed, highly analytical, adept at managing multiple complex programs simultaneously across a data-heavy organization, and energized by the opportunity to shape how an entire organization defines and uses its data.

Key job responsibilities
- Owning and curating Amazon Music's behavioral data model, serving as the central steward for how core data concepts are defined and represented across the business
- Standardizing key data concepts across teams, driving alignment between data producers and consumers so that shared concepts are defined consistently and unambiguously
- Consulting on the design of high-quality instrumentation specifications for new products and features
- Simplifying the event model to make it more intuitive, reducing complexity and redundancy so teams can find and trust the data they need
- Evolving the event model with the business, partnering with data producers and consumers to enhance and grow coverage as new products, features, and use cases emerge
- Building GenAI tooling to automate the curation of the event model, including improved attribution, automated validation, automated instrumentation specification generation, and reduced manual overhead in maintaining the model
- Leading cross-org programs with central Amazon teams, including driving technical alignment and program execution with teams outside of Music (e.g., AWS, Devices, Stores), navigating ambiguity where business and architectural strategies are not clearly defined, and building consensus across organizations with competing priorities
- Collaborating with cross-functional stakeholders, including engineers, product managers, business analysts, and senior leadership, to align on priorities and drive program execution
- Writing effective narratives and presenting program updates, risks, and recommendations to senior leadership
- Proactively identifying risks and removing blockers to keep programs on track
- Defining and managing program roadmaps, milestones, and goals in partnership with engineering and product stakeholders
- Identifying strategic opportunities for the Metrics and Data Platform team to expand its impact and influence across Amazon Music as part of annual planning

Amazon Music is an immersive audio entertainment service that deepens connections between fans, artists, and creators. From personalized music playlists to exclusive podcasts, concert livestreams to artist merch, Amazon Music is innovating at some of the most exciting intersections of music and culture. Join us for the opportunity to influence how Amazon Music engages fans, artists, and creators on a global scale. Learn more at https://www.amazon.com/music.

- 5+ years of technical product or program management experience
- 3+ years of software development experience
- 5+ years of technical program management working directly with software engineering teams experience
- Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules
- Experience building and evaluating system-level technical design
- Experience developing and executing/delivering product and technical roadmaps
- Experience leading highly technical programs involving infrastructure, complex systems, systems engineering

Preferred Qualifications

- 5+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience
- Excellence in verbal and written communication with peers and senior leaders
- Experience managing large, complex, cross-functional programs from concept to launch
- Experience driving technology decisions and strategy related to a product
- Experience identifying and mitigating program risks and removing execution blockers
- Experience with iterative, agile development methodologies
- Experience with data modeling or feature/product instrumentation
- Experience with big data technologies such as Spark, EMR, Redshift, S3, Airflow, or Kinesis
- Experience with AWS services (Lambda, Redshift, Kinesis, SQS, SNS)

job.description:
Position Title: Sr. Director, Data Strategy & Operations Department: Business Intelligence Group Corporate Area: Digital & Marketing Status: Regular, Full time Exempt Manager Title: VP, Business Intelligence

Position Overview

The Sr. Director, Data Strategy & Operations leads the data function within PBS Business Intelligence, owning how PBS collects, governs, and delivers audience and content performance data. The role directs Nielsen Operations, digital analytics implementation, and the Domo business intelligence platform, ensuring that internal stakeholders, member stations, and producers work from data that is accurate, consistent, and available when they need it. job.title: Client Systems Specialist
job.description:
The Client Systems Specialist’s primary responsibility is to provide responsive customer service, technical support, and troubleshooting for approximately 100 AccuWeather TV customers. This role supports the department’s 24/7 customer service coverage, helping customers maintain reliable operation of their AccuWeather software, hardware, and data services. The position requires proactive customer communication, advanced troubleshooting, and coordination with internal teams to resolve issues promptly. Occasional travel is required for product demonstrations, system installations, customer training, and trade shows. 

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES
• Serve as a primary technical support resource for AccuWeather TV customers, providing timely, professional assistance by phone, email, and remote support.
• Participate in the department’s 24/7 support coverage and assigned on-call schedule, including evenings, weekends, and holidays.
• Monitor customer support calls, emails, and requests; prioritize issues based on urgency, impact on customer operations, and departmental guidelines.
• Troubleshoot and resolve software, hardware, system configuration, and data issues, with particular attention to problems affecting on-air operations.
• Take ownership of assigned support issues from initial response through resolution, keeping customers informed of progress and next steps.
• Document customer issues, troubleshooting steps, resolutions, and follow-up actions to support consistent service and knowledge sharing.
• Escalate complex or unresolved issues to management and developers, providing clear details to support timely resolution.
• Communicate with sales and account management teams about ongoing customer issues, support needs, and customer satisfaction.
• Provide proactive customer guidance to help prevent recurring problems and improve system reliability.
• Maintain proficiency and required certifications on all AccuWeather TV graphics systems.
• Maintain a working understanding of AccuWeather and other meteorological data to effectively support customers and meteorologists.
• Test new software versions using current customer configurations and coordinate customer upgrades following release.
• Provide remote customer training on system operation, new features, and troubleshooting procedures.
• Occasionally travel to customer sites to install and configure systems, verify proper operation, and provide training.
• Support sales efforts by demonstrating AccuWeather TV products remotely and, as needed, at customer sites and trade shows.
• Identify customer needs for upgrades, additional systems, or training, and communicate those opportunities to the appropriate sales or account management team.
• Provide technical training, guidance, and mentorship to new staff and sales team members.
• Coordinate support coverage with the team during travel and other scheduled activities.
• Perform other duties as assigned.

BACKGROUND AND QUALIFICATIONS
• At least one year of professional experience supporting PC or Mac computers, software, or hardware required. Relevant education or extensive technical training may be considered in place of employment experience.
• Strong customer service skills, including the ability to remain calm, responsive, and professional when customers experience urgent technical issues.
• Ability to troubleshoot software and hardware problems, prioritize competing requests, and follow issues through to resolution.
• Ability to communicate technical information clearly to customers and colleagues with varying levels of technical knowledge.
• Ability to read and interpret instructions, technical documentation, procedural and policy manuals, and customer communications.
• Strong organizational skills and attention to detail when documenting issues, coordinating follow-up, and maintaining customer records.
• Ability to work independently while collaborating with support staff, sales, management, and developers.
• Availability to participate in assigned 24/7 on-call coverage, including evenings, weekends, and holidays.
• Ability and willingness to travel occasionally for demonstrations, installations, training, and trade shows.
• Experience with broadcast systems, graphics systems, or meteorological data preferred.

Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform these functions. The position requires extended periods of work at a computer workstation using a keyboard and mouse, as well as frequent communication by phone and video conference. The employee may occasionally be required to stand, walk, and lift or move equipment weighing up to 25 pounds during installations, demonstrations, or training. Specific vision abilities include color vision, close vision, and the ability to adjust focus.

Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform these functions. Work is primarily performed in an office or remote support setting, with occasional work at customer stations and trade shows. job.title: Digital Content & Engagement Intern – Forecasting and Communications
job.description:
AccuWeather is seeking a highly creative, curious, and deeply collaborative Digital Content & Engagement Intern – Forecasting and Communications, to work directly with AccuWeather forecasters and the Writing Committee to further elevate the detail, clarity, precision, and distinctiveness of the language used to describe forecasts for our users. This role is designed for a graduate student or an individual with equivalent writing experience who brings fresh thinking about how complex weather information can be expressed in ways that are more detailed, precise, clear, engaging, and scientifically sound.

Embedded closely with Forecast Operations, this position will learn from meteorologists, participate in the forecast-writing process, and help develop new approaches, terminology, and descriptive frameworks that make AccuWeather forecasts more informative and better than what is available from any other source. The emphasis is on improving the consumer forecast experience - not traditional public relations - by helping forecasters communicate what the weather will be, what the impact will be, how it will evolve, what it may look like, and what details matter most to people making decisions. This includes a laser focus on developing stronger displays, greater artistry, and more effective visual communications that amplify the advantages of AccuWeather forecasts and content.

The Digital Content & Engagement Intern – Forecasting and Communications will serve as a bridge between meteorological expertise and exceptional consumer-facing writing, helping AccuWeather deliver forecast descriptions with greater depth, nuance, consistency, and usefulness while preserving the scientific accuracy and authority at the core of the AccuWeather brand.

 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Forecast Language, Detail & Description:

  • Work side-by-side with forecasters to craft and refine accurate, detailed, consumer-focused descriptions of daily weather, changing conditions, major storms, seasonal patterns, and forecast developments.
    • Elevate forecast language beyond basic conditions by identifying the most useful details, nuances, timing, impacts, transitions, and sensory descriptions that help users better understand what to expect. Use bold, catchy and descriptive language.
    • Translate complex meteorological concepts into clearer, more detailed, consumer-friendly language without sacrificing scientific meaning, accuracy, or appropriate expressions of forecast confidence.
    • Develop new descriptive approaches, vocabulary, sentence structures, and frameworks that make AccuWeather forecasts more distinctive, informative, and useful than competing forecast experiences.
    • Help establish consistent terminology for recurring weather patterns while preserving enough flexibility for forecasters to communicate the unique character and details of each forecast.

 

Forecaster & Writing Committee Collaboration:

  • Embed with AccuWeather forecasters to understand how forecasts are created, where language choices can add value, and how writing can better communicate meteorological insight to users.
    • Work closely with the AccuWeather Writing Committee to test, evaluate, and introduce new approaches to forecast writing and description.
    • Bring an outside writing perspective to established forecast workflows, asking thoughtful questions and proposing new ways of thinking, writing, and working.
  • Challenge conventional approaches to forecast description and explore new ways to communicate weather that provide users with greater detail, context, understanding, and value.
    • Gather feedback from meteorologists and other stakeholders, iterate on language, and help turn successful approaches into practical writing guidance and repeatable standards.
    • Support a collaborative environment in which meteorological expertise and strong writing work together to create a richer forecast experience.

 

Consumer Forecast Experience & Innovation:

  • Review forecast descriptions across AccuWeather consumer experiences and identify opportunities to add specificity, context, clarity, and useful detail.
    • Develop and test language that helps users better understand the timing, intensity, duration, variability, uncertainty, and real-world impacts of weather events.
  • Explore new ways to make routine forecasts more useful, engaging, descriptive, and impactful, bringing the same level of creativity and attention to detail to both high-impact weather coverage and everyday conditions such as temperature, wind, precipitation, cloud cover, humidity, visibility, and changing conditions.
    • Help ensure forecast descriptions are clear and effective across digital platforms while retaining the depth and detail that distinguish AccuWeather.
    • Contribute ideas that reinforce AccuWeather’s Superior Accuracy™ through the quality, precision, and usefulness of the forecast language itself.

 

Writing Standards & Continuous Improvement:

  • Help evolve AccuWeather’s authoritative, trustworthy, detailed, and forward-looking forecast voice.
    • Identify new ways to describe weather phenomena that are vivid, memorable, consumer-relevant, and scientifically sound.
    • Contribute to forecast-writing standards, terminology guidelines, examples, and best practices used by forecasters and content teams.
    • Study how forecast language performs in practice and recommend improvements based on clarity, usefulness, consistency, and differentiation.
    • Encourage experimentation and fresh thinking while respecting operational requirements, meteorological accuracy, and established review processes.
    • Perform other duties as assigned.

QUALIFICATIONS

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Communications, Writing, or a closely related writing-intensive field is required.
    • Current graduate student in communications, writing, journalism, English, creative writing, technical writing, or a related discipline, or equivalent advanced or professional writing experience.
    • Exceptional command of written language, including tone, clarity, precision, descriptive detail, structure, and audience awareness.
    • Demonstrated ability to take complex or technical information and make it clear, specific, useful, and engaging for a broad audience.
    • Strong collaborative skills and genuine interest in working closely with meteorologists, subject-matter experts, and a writing committee.
    • Intellectual curiosity and willingness to learn meteorological concepts and forecast workflows.
    • Ability to receive expert feedback, revise quickly, and improve language through an iterative process.

 

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Interest in or familiarity with meteorology, weather forecasting, climate, environmental science, science communication, or technical writing.
    • Experience developing descriptive language, style guidance, editorial standards, or writing frameworks.
    • Experience collaborating directly with technical or scientific subject-matter experts.
    • Portfolio examples demonstrating precise, vivid, explanatory, or detail-rich writing.

 

Skills & Competencies:

  • Creative thinking grounded in accuracy, precision, and credibility.
    • Exceptional descriptive and explanatory writing.
    • Ability to identify and elevate the details that matter most to users.
    • Strong editing, revision, and language-development skills.
    • Curiosity about weather and willingness to learn from forecasters.
    • Collaborative, workshop-oriented approach to writing.
    • Ability to develop practical writing standards while continuing to experiment with new approaches.
    • Excellent organizational and time management skills.
    • Ability to work effectively both independently and as part of an embedded team.

 

About AccuWeather

AccuWeather, recognized and documented as the most accurate and most used source of weather forecasts and warnings in the world, has saved over 12,000 lives, prevented injury to over 100,000 people, and saved companies tens of billions of dollars through better planning and decision-making.

A billion people around the world rely on AccuWeather’s proven Superior Accuracy™ across our consumer digital platforms. AccuWeather.com is the #1 weather destination and one of the top 100 most-visited websites in the world, and our award-winning AccuWeather app delivers detailed real-time forecasts to tens of millions of smartphones.

AccuWeather forecasts also appear on digital signage, in 700 newspapers, are heard on over 400 radio stations, and viewed on 100 television stations. The AccuWeather Network and AccuWeather NOW® reach an audience of over 225 million on cable and streaming platforms including DirecTV, Charter Communications - Spectrum, Verizon, Samsung, Vizio, Philo, Frndly TV, Comcast’s Xfinity X1 and Xfinity Stream, Roku, Xumo, Rockbot, LG, and Amazon Freevee.

AccuWeather For Business serves more than half of the Fortune 500 companies and thousands of other businesses and government agencies globally.

Dr. Joel Myers, Founder and Executive Chairman, established AccuWeather in 1962 and is considered the “father of modern commercial meteorology.” Myers is a visionary entrepreneur and has been called “the most accurate man in weather” by The New York Times. He has been recognized in Entrepreneur Magazine’s Encyclopedia of Entrepreneurs as one of the greatest entrepreneurs in American history.  Myers received the American Meteorological Society’s 2018 Award for Outstanding Contributions to the Advancement of Applied Meteorology and the National Weather Association’s 2017 Lifetime Achievement Award, in addition to numerous other accolades.

job.title: Data Architect I
job.description:
Want to lead the technical design behind modernizing AccuWeather For Business — the platform that delivers AccuWeather’s data and services to more than half of the Fortune 500? We are looking for a Data Architect I who combines strong platform design expertise with the judgment to assess legacy infrastructure and design an implementable, cloud-native architecture; someone who wants to own the technical direction of a critical modernization initiative without compromising the reliability enterprise clients depend on. Reporting directly to the Data Architect II overseeing AccuWeather’s data architecture function, this position will assess the legacy, on-premises infrastructure behind AccuWeather For Business and design the cloud-native architecture that will support its future. You will produce architecture and modernization design documents — including current-state assessments, target-state designs, transition and sequencing plans, and technical specifications — and work alongside engineering teams to implement key components of the architecture, while maintaining the reliability of the backend data systems that support critical data delivery services.

You will demonstrate high-level knowledge across cloud platforms and legacy enterprise systems, independently resolve complex architecture and modernization challenges, and collaborate closely with the Data Architect II and engineering teams. Your work will help modernize the technology foundation behind AccuWeather For Business, creating a more scalable, resilient, and cloud-native platform while maintaining the reliability expected by the Fortune 500 companies that depend on it.

We are open to hiring candidates to work from our global headquarters in State College, PA, USA, or remotely.

 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

· Assess the legacy, on-premises infrastructure behind AccuWeather For Business, documenting current-state architecture, system dependencies, data flows, and technical debt to inform modernization priorities.

· Design the cloud-native architecture, producing architecture designs, technical specifications, and other documentation needed to guide implementation.

· Own the architectural direction for the modernization effort, ensuring a cohesive approach across the platform rather than individual services or components.

· Develop a roadmap and sequencing plan that provides a practical path from the current environment to the cloud-native architecture while minimizing disruption to enterprise clients.

· Design backend data systems to maintain continuity of critical data delivery services throughout the transition.

· Partner with engineering and data teams to validate and implement architecture designs, ensuring solutions are secure, scalable, performant, and maintainable.

· Contribute hands-on to the implementation of architecture designs, including developing and modifying code, data models, schemas, and supporting data platform components.

· Estimate data consumption, capacity, and infrastructure requirements, incorporating cloud infrastructure costs into architecture decisions and trade-offs.

· Identify and document architectural and operational risks associated with modernizing a customer-facing production platform, and design appropriate mitigation strategies.

· Ensure the cloud-native architecture addresses performance, security, scalability, resiliency, recoverability, compliance, and data residency requirements.

· Understand system scheduling, integrations, and dependencies across the platform and incorporate them into planning and sequencing.

· Serve as a technical point of contact for questions and decisions related to the modernization effort’s architectural direction.

 

QUALIFICATIONS

· Required Qualifications:

o BA/BS in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, with 5+ years of experience in data or enterprise architecture, or MS with 3+ years of experience.

o High-level knowledge of cloud platforms (e.g., Microsoft Azure) and cloud-native architecture.

o Demonstrated experience assessing legacy, on-premises systems and designing modern, cloud-native architectures.

job.description:

This role owns the company's legal risk, commercial contracting, IP, privacy, and litigation strategy, and is responsible for modernizing the legal functions, including through the adoption of AI-enabled tools and workflows to deliver faster, leaner, and more scalable legal support to the business.

The position is located on-site at AccuWeather's Headquarters in State College, PA  

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Legal Operations & AI-Driven Efficiency

  • Champion the adoption of AI legal tools (contract lifecycle management, legal research, drafting assistance) to cut cycle time, reduce outside counsel spend, and scale the legal team's output.

  • Redesign commercial contracting and other legal workflows for speed, consistency, and measurable efficiency gains.
  • Structure and manage the internal legal team and legal support staff; manage outside counsel relationships and budget for cost-effective coverage.

  • Advise on financing activity, including business and legal-entity structuring.
  • Advise on content delivery and distribution issues across broadcast, cable, and OTT platforms.

  • Act as subject-matter expert on consumer data privacy for a digital media company with a global user base, and monitor emerging privacy, cybersecurity, and AI regulation for business impact.
  • Partner with Security and IT on cybersecurity risk, vendor data-processing terms, and incident response.
  • Ensure company-wide compliance with applicable domestic and international laws and standards.

Litigation, IP & Risk

  • Direct litigation strategy and outside counsel on matters filed by or against the company; approve settlements.
  • Protect the company's intellectual property portfolio, trademarks, copyrights, patents, and trade secrets — including strategy for complex IP litigation.
  • Oversee contract enforcement and delinquency collections.

  • Serve as key advisor to the CEO and Board of Directors on corporate governance, risk, and major transactions.
  • Participate in defining corporate policies, procedures, and programs, and advise on their legal implications.

QUALIFICATIONS

Required

job.title: Senior Producer, Reporter Video
job.description:
The mission of The New York Times is to seek the truth and help people understand the world. That means independent journalism is at the heart of all we do as a company. It’s why we have a world-renowned newsroom that sends journalists to report on the ground from nearly 160 countries. It’s why we focus deeply on how our readers will experience our journalism, from print to audio to a world-class digital and app destination. And it’s why our business strategy centers on making journalism so good that it’s worth paying for. 

The New York Times is continuing to expand its video journalism, identifying compelling visual stories across the depth and breadth of our reporting. We showcase the expertise of Times journalists on camera, share urgent news updates, produce on-the-ground reporting, and pioneer Visual Investigations.

The Video department is looking for a Senior Producer to work on the multi-disciplinary Reporter Video team of video journalists who create powerful videos featuring the expertise of our world-class journalists. Based in London, this role will focus on covering breaking news and major international developments in short-form video, producing a mix of quick-turnaround videos, explanatory and analysis pieces, as well as major enterprise and investigations. 

The Senior Producer will report to a London supervisor and work with the rest of the Reporter Video team in New York and other video hubs, becoming the key manager of the department’s content during the hours that London acts as the main Times hub. 

We are looking for a strong leader who is eager to motivate, inspire teams and innovate. Attention to detail, impeccable organization and effective communication with reporters and editors in the International Desk are a must.

You should also be an excellent storyteller with an eye for visual short-form digital formats, able to work autonomously to identify critical stories outside the U.S. and make sound, quick editorial decisions on world news. You will be expected to produce engaging stories through original reporting, on-the-ground filming, motion graphics and studio-based recordings.

You must have deep experience reporting on stories from Europe, the Middle East and Africa, including managing teams in conflict zones, devising security plans and making risk assessments.

This is a hybrid position based in London and includes regular attendance in the office four days each week.

Responsibilities will include:

  • Drive innovative Reporter Video delivering on a range of formats.

  • Build and strengthen relations with colleagues on the International Desk, including mentorship of reporters, photographers and fellow editors on the reporter video storytelling format.

  • Lead story development and story edits.

  • Review, assign and provide feedback on productions.

  • Support and guide script writing and visual approaches for effective short-form video.

  • Oversee production across multiple projects.

  • Guide interviews and shoots as needed, both in studio and field.

  • Foster experiments with new video approaches and editorial strategies.

  • Manage video journalists and video editors in the newsroom and field.

  • Demonstrate support and understanding of our value of journalistic independence and a strong commitment to our mission to seek the truth and help people understand the world.

  • This role reports to the Supervising Producer in London.

Basic Requirements:

  • Proven experience producing digital news videos.

  • Experience managing video journalists, also during field deployments, including in hostile environments and involving risk assessments.

  • Broad and in depth experience in digital or broadcast news.

  • Proven track record managing direct reports.

  • Demonstrated deep command of a variety of video sources, including wire services, UGC, archival footage, motion graphics, and original footage.

Preferred Requirements:

  • Excellent writing, editing and communication skills.

  • Expert knowledge of current events with advanced-level experience covering breaking news stories in the U.S. and internationally. 

  • Experience working collaboratively with members of a multidisciplinary team.

  • Experience overseeing shoots and interviewing experts on camera.

  • Familiar with digital storytelling formats.

  • Understanding of mainstream and emerging social channels

  • Flexibility to work extended hours.

REQ-020816
