job.title: Lead Site Reliability Engineer
job.description:
Who We Are

UnitedMasters 

UnitedMasters is building a marketplace that connects artists, brands and fans - empowering artists to earn and grow. UnitedMasters has taken the bold step of building a music distribution service that, radically, puts artists first - disrupting the legacy music business by letting up-and-coming artists distribute their music directly to fans through streaming services while maintaining ownership of their master recording rights and up to 100% of royalties. Through the combination of UnitedMasters' music distribution platform and its deep ties to brands, UnitedMasters enables independent artists and change-makers to grow and earn unlike any other platform.

The UnitedMasters team is made up of musicians, marketers, engineers, and storytellers with backgrounds from YouTube, SoundCloud, Pandora, Facebook, Uber, Dropbox, Complex, VICE, and more. We work hand in hand with the award-winning creative teams that forge those innovative partnerships at Translation (our in-house creative advertising agency).

The Role

You'll partner with platform, data, QA, and product engineers across the organization, owning the intersection of reliability and security: the tooling, monitoring, alerting, emergency response, and systems design the whole org depends on.

A defining part of the role is building how we protect our systems going forward. We're investing in agentic, AI-driven security pipelines that continuously detect, triage, and help remediate vulnerabilities across our codebase and infrastructure — and you'll lead the design and stewardship of that capability.

Above all, though, this is a coaching and consulting role. We're looking for a strong listener, patient collaborator, thoughtful architect, and skilled builder — someone who identifies needs in reliability and security and empowers peer developers to improve them.

What You'll Do

  • Partner with platform, data, QA, and product teams to understand their automation, infrastructure, monitoring, and security needs.
  • Build tooling and processes that solve the problems those conversations surface.
  • Build and maintain an agentic vulnerability detection and mitigation pipeline that will scan, triage, and propose fixes, with human-in-the-loop guardrails.
  • Embed security into the development lifecycle, including threat modeling, supp ly-chain hygiene, secrets management, secure-by-default patterns.
  • Lead security and reliability incident response as first-class operational concerns.
  • Define company-level SLAs, SLOs, and Error Budgets, and help teams set their own.
  • Steer system design toward shared tooling and decisions that ensure reliability, scalability, security, and maintainability.
  • Join the on-call rotation as a peer to spot process gaps and coach on response.
  • Act as a senior escalation for infrastructure and security issues, helping resolve them while coaching teams to handle the next.
  • Own our AWS infrastructure and set the long-term strategy for our reliability and security posture, balancing scalability and cost.

Who You Are 

  • Senior-to-staff experience as an SRE, platform, or infrastructure engineer, owning production reliability at scale.
  • Hands-on application and/or infrastructure security experience; enough to lead the security conversation without a separate security team in the room.
  • Practical experience building with LLMs and agentic systems. You've shipped something real and understand their failure modes and where human oversight is non-negotiable.
  • Strong software engineering fundamentals. You build tools and systems, not just configure them.
  • A coaching instinct: you measure impact by how much you raise the teams around you.

Our Values

  • We Get on the Plane — Entrepreneurial spirit means fully committing to the journey not just having the idea.
  • We Expect Challenge + Respect — We constantly challenge each other and the work to reach excellence, always with respect.
  • We Are Defined by Our Resilience — We stay resourceful, fail fast, keep getting better, and never quit on our mission or our team.
  • We Pursue Answers Before the Question Has to Be Asked — We understand our customers so well that we anticipate what they need before they ask.
  • We Run Towards Darkness — We have the courage to work through uncertainty rather than settling for an easier, inferior plan.
  • We Know What We Don't Know — We bring confidence in what we do know, and honesty about what we don't.

Compensation

Salary Hiring Range: $195,000 - $240,000

Our salary ranges are designed to be competitive for companies of our size and within our industry and represent just one part of our overall rewards package. We also offer company-sponsored medical, dental, and vision plans, a 401(k) with company match, and, depending on the role and individual circumstances, additional compensation opportunities such as bonuses and stock options.

Individual pay rate decisions are based on a number of factors, including qualifications for the role, experience level, skillset, and balancing internal equity relative to peers at the company. We expect the majority of the candidates who are offered roles at our company to fall healthily throughout the range based on these factors.

The range above is for the expectations as laid out in the job description, however we are often open to a wide variety of profiles, and recognize that the person we hire may be less experienced (or more senior) than this job description as posted. If that ends up being the case, the updated salary range will be communicated with you as a candidate.

The salary range above is for NY/CA. As a company, we have a location-based strategy, which means the salary range could be lower or higher than this if the role is hired in another location.

About UnitedMasters, Inc.

UnitedMasters Inc. represents the creative solutions company, Translation, and the leading software and services platform for independent creators, UnitedMasters. UnitedMasters enables ownership, exposure, and new paths for financial return for independent creators, while Translation helps brands leverage the power of contemporary culture to achieve transformational growth. Combined, UnitedMasters, Inc. is the world's leading marketplace for cultural capital, connecting independent artists and brands to realize a future in which all creators own their future. Backed by Alphabet, Andreessen Horowitz, and Apple, UnitedMasters, Inc. is reimagining how brands and artists come together to tell their stories, build profitable growth, and push culture forward.

Equal Opportunity & Accommodation

UnitedMasters is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We seek to bring together diverse ideas, experiences, skill sets, perspectives, backgrounds and identities to drive innovative solutions. We commit to promoting a welcoming environment where inclusion and belonging are held as a shared responsibility.

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

Phishing Scam Warning

PHISHING SCAM WARNING: UnitedMasters is among several companies recently made aware of a phishing scam involving con artists posing as hiring managers recruiting via email, text and social media. The imposters are creating misleading email accounts, conducting remote “interviews,” and making fake job offers in order to collect personal and financial information from unsuspecting individuals. Please be aware that no job offers will be made from UnitedMasters without a formal interview process. Additionally, UnitedMasters will not ask you to purchase equipment or supplies as part of your onboarding process. If you have any questions, please reach out to TA@unitedmasters.com.

job.title: Senior Enterprise Security Engineer
job.description:
SoundCloud empowers artists and fans to connect and share through music. Founded in 2007, SoundCloud is an artist-first platform empowering artists to build and grow their careers by providing them with the most progressive tools, services, and resources. With over 400+ million tracks from 40 million artists, the future of music is SoundCloud.

SoundCloud is looking for a Senior Enterprise Security Engineer to join our Security team. In this role, you will own the security of the infrastructure and cloud environments our employees rely on to build delightful experiences for creators and fans, spanning endpoint, identity, cloud, and third-party risk.

You will act as a key technical lead across our modern security stack: driving incident response, securing enterprise AI systems, hardening multi-cloud architecture, and automating threat detection. If you have a deep passion for security, a builder mindset, and a desire to shape a secure environment for a fast-scaling platform, this role is for you.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead security incident response: identifying, investigating, and remediating infrastructure incidents and endpoint anomalies
  • Own and evolve security for internal workplace, on-premises, and cloud environments (AWS, GCP)
  • Administer and harden Google Workspace and Context-Aware Access policies as a lead administrator
  • Manage and optimize our endpoint security stack, including SentinelOne EDR and device management via JAMF (macOS) and Intune (Windows/Linux)
  • Manage the security of our AI Inference, Agents, and Agentic Tooling
  • Drive our Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM) program, working closely with Legal and Privacy to assess vendor security posture
  • Operate and tune Google SecOps (Chronicle SIEM) for threat detection, log correlation, and investigation workflows
  • Manage security awareness and phishing simulation programs
  • Partner with our IT team and NYC-based executives to ensure the security of our key employees.
  • Coordinate penetration testing and vulnerability assessments across infrastructure and applications
  • Promote security best practices through collaborative engagement with engineering and product teams
  • Identify and implement automation opportunities across security operations and integrations
  • Stay current with threat intelligence, security vendors, and evolving industry standards

Experience and Background:

  • 6+ years of hands-on experience in security engineering or a combined software engineering/security role
  • Broad understanding of the evolving cyber threat landscape, emerging attack vectors, and industry security trends
  • Deep proficiency with Google Workspace administration, including security settings, audit logging, and DLP controls
  • Practical experience with SentinelOne or equivalent EDR platforms
  • Hands-on experience with JAMF Pro (macOS fleet management) and Microsoft Intune (cross-platform MDM)
  • Working knowledge of Google SecOps / Chronicle SIEM — building parsers, detection rules, and dashboards
  • Experience running or contributing to a Third-Party Risk Management program
  • Strong cloud security background in AWS and/or GCP — IAM, security groups, audit trails, and config compliance
  • Familiarity with GitHub security features (GitHub Actions, secret scanning, dependency review, branch protections)
  • Proficiency in either Python, Ruby, or Go for security automation and tooling. Don’t worry, you’ll have an LLM to help with the others!

job.title: Data Governance Analyst
job.description:
Job Summary:


Data Governance Analyst (Live Nation Worldwide, Inc.; Beverly Hills, CA): Implement and maintain Data Governance frameworks (DAMA-DMBOK), policies, and procedures aligned with company Data Strategy. Deliver governance activities across assigned data domains ensuring consistency, oversight, and compliance. Participate in committee meetings, conduct impact assessments for proposed changes to data structures, policies and processes, and monitor the effectiveness of the Data Governance program to enhance the Governance maturity model. Create and maintain enterprise metadata repositories including data dictionaries, tags, and data lineage documentation. Monitor metadata quality standards ensuring accuracy and completeness across all data assets. Identify, classify, and maintain CDEs with appropriate governance controls. Develop and enforce Data Standards, naming conventions, and data quality validation rules. Partner with Data Engineering to integrate quality checks into ETL/ELT pipelines. Perform data profiling, root cause analysis, and track remediation of quality issues and modeling gaps. Use cloud and AI technologies to build multi-agent architectures that generate automated data dictionaries by analyzing Confluence, GitLab, YAML pipelines, and Unity Catalog. Evaluate and refine AI-generated metadata through SME collaboration ensuring accuracy and relevance. Develop prompt engineering strategies and optimize agent workflows for documentation quality. Monitor effectiveness of AI-assisted processes and research emerging AI/ML technologies for governance. Document AI governance processes, agent configurations, and best practices. Partner with Data Engineering, Analytics, Platform, Legal, Compliance, and Security teams to enhance governance processes and ensure regulatory compliance. Facilitate data governance working groups and domain-specific forums. Provide training, onboarding, and guidance on governance tools, standards, and processes. Develop user-friendly documentation, self-service resources, and training materials. Respond to governance inquiries within SLAs, provide consulting support, and advocate for data management best practices. Support data classification, sensitivity labeling, and access control initiatives. Document data handling procedures, retention policies, and escalate potential privacy risks. Track and report governance metrics: metadata completeness, data quality scores, standard adoption, CDE coverage. Prepare dashboards, status reports, and KPI insights to demonstrate governance value. Research governance technologies, methodologies, and industry trends through conferences and professional networks. Research data governance technologies, methodologies, and industry trends through conferences, training, and professional networks. job.description:
Title: Visuals Producer, Social Video

Schedule Format -Hybrid - San Francisco

Pay Information: $94,860 - $112,469



KQED is looking for a visuals producer who can make videos and graphics for our news social channels including Instagram, YouTube and TikTok. You’ll work directly with our social video producer and be part of the news department’s audience engagement team. You will also work with our award-winning photographers and reporters in the newsroom.

We’re looking for someone with a mix of experience in visual journalism, graphic design, and social media who can take our journalism and tell stories visually for Instagram, YouTube and TikTok. 

Show us how you can make the news informative and engaging, and how you think about bringing journalism and essential resources to new audiences on social media.

Visuals Producer, Social Video ADDENDUM

The Social Video-Visuals Producer is a visual journalist who has sharp skills creating videos on social platforms, such as Instagram, TikTok and YouTube Shorts. This producer thrives on turning news stories into memorable vertical videos, while working with journalists in a collaborative process. 

The Social Video-Visuals Producer creates videos from start to finish – ideating, scripting, shooting, editing and publishing – and is highly collaborative with newsroom colleagues in order to tell these stories. You love the Bay Area, enjoy telling our unique stories and are as enthusiastic about working in the field as you are of executing great edits. 

Journalism ethics is a must, so you must know how to gather news – both with reporters and on your own – and tell stories on social platforms in a fair and accurate manner. 
 

KQED envisions a public media organization with a culture that centers on human dignity, equity, and belonging. This will enable us to better serve and reflect the Bay Area through diverse and inclusive storytelling. 

We value the contributions of marginalized people in society — including Black, Indigenous, and all people of color,  people with disabilities, and LGBTQIA+ people — and we believe that these communities must be centered in the work we do, and we strongly encourage members of these communities to apply.

KQED Code of Ethics  https://www.kqed.org/about/code-ethics

The mission that drives us:

KQED provide citizens of Northern California with a community-supported alternative to commercial media.   We provide citizens with the knowledge they need to make informed decisions; convene community dialogue; bring the arts to everyone and engage audiences to share their stories. We help students and teachers thrive in 21st-century classrooms, and take people of all ages on journeys of exploration- exposing them to new people, places and ideas.

This role will work hybrid between working in KQED's newly renovated headquarters and working remotely. 

Essential functions: 
  • Planning and shooting video coverage of events in the Bay Area
  • Creating short form social videos on news and feature stories in the Bay Area
  • Strategizing new forms of visual content that will bring KQED reporting to a wider audience
  • Designing graphics for social platforms (such as Instagram, TikTok and YouTube) that provide valuable information and resources to communities in the Bay Area
  • Keeping aware of news photo shoots, posting photo carousels, and writing captions for Instagram
  • Work with reporters to create and execute a visual social strategy for their stories

Knowledge/Experience Required:
  • Excellent communication and writing skills; ability to write quickly and accurately, with an understanding of tone and style across platforms
  • Familiarity with graphic design, Canva, Photoshop, Premiere, Adobe, Google Drive, Slack
  • Experience editing photos for news publications.
  • Experience taking a story and writing succinct scripts for social media
  • Experience writing text and captions for social media posts
  • Some video editing experience
  • Advanced knowledge of YouTube, Instagram, and TikTok
  • Knowledge and interest in current events
  • Writes text with correct spelling, grammar and punctuation 
  • Ability to meet deadlines and goals while working under pressure
  • Ability to stay organized and prioritize tasks when working on multiple projects at once 
  • Interest and knowledge in Bay Area news with a focus on local communities 
  • Checks work before publication and maintains adherence to facts
  • Adherence to copyright laws; understanding of media licensing agreements 
  • Clear communication with colleagues 
  • Ability to stay focused, organized, communicative and proactive — you’ll be working with a number of journalists or staffers across the organization, potentially dealing with several different editors
  • Minimum of five years’ experience as Producer or Field Producer in media, preferably public media or through other informal institutions.
  • Published examples of digital video production and/or other forms of digital storytelling
  • Ability to work collaboratively and cooperatively with the KQED News team—strong interpersonal and communications skills preferred 
  • Proven ability to edit, with limited supervision, short format engagement videos or longer-form documentary style segments. Attention to detail and experience in fact checking preferred.
  • Proficient at utilizing the entire Adobe Creative Suite with an emphasis on Premiere Pro, After Effects, Audition, Photoshop and Illustrator
  • Ability to independently problem-solve and adapt quickly to news cycles, formats and styles. 
  • Experience troubleshooting edit issues, transcoding media, performing minor color correcting and media archiving.
  • Proven ability to engage in high-level writing, research, or production on original and creative topics for story development.  Ability to write or co-write short format texts with factual integrity that move, surprise, dazzle and engage. 
  • Proven ability to set up, light, record audio and shoot video for short format style segments in quick turnaround situations.
  • Experience with a wide range of cameras, lenses and related equipment.
  • Experience with social media and web distribution.
  • Knowledge of basic journalistic editorial principles, ethics and standards.
  • A passion for producing digital media and demonstrable experience covering the Bay Area.
  • Demonstrable collaboration skills and experience cultivating sources and partnerships.
  • Ability to represent KQED to the broader Bay Area community, other institutions, and the general public.

Knowledge/Experience Desired:
  • A compelling visual style and personal voice.
  • Expertise in making digital videos.
  • Expertise in social media.
  • Expertise as a still photographer.
  • Experienced with web publishing and CMS systems (WordPress preferred).
  • B.A./B.S. degree.

Recommended Skills:
  • Familiarity with After Effects
  • Experience creating infographics or data visualizations
  • Comfortable being on camera

job.title: Director of Facilities & Stadium Operations
job.description:
POSITION OVERVIEW 

The Director of Facilities & Stadium Operations is responsible for the overall maintenance, safety, cleanliness, and operational readiness of Durham Bulls Athletic Park. This position leads the Stadium Operations Department, including full-time staff, seasonal employees, contractors, and vendors, and ensures the facility meets all regulatory, safety, and event-related requirements. The Director manages budgets, oversees capital improvement projects, maintains infrastructure and equipment, and collaborates across departments to support a best-in-class experience for players, coaches, fans, partners, and all ballpark stakeholders.
 
DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES 

Facility Operations & Maintenance 

  • Lead and oversee the day-to-day operations of the stadium, including event setup and breakdown, general cleaning, facility appearance, and routine maintenance.
  • Manage repairs, custodial services, HVAC systems, field and grounds maintenance (in coordination with Field Operations), and overall facility readiness.
  • Establish, implement, and maintain stadium-wide general, regular, and preventive maintenance schedules for both in-season and off-season periods.
  • Ensure all mechanical, electrical, plumbing, and infrastructure systems operate safely and effectively.

 

 

Safety, Compliance & Procedures 

  • Develop, maintain, and update all facility policies and procedures, including the Emergency Action Plan and Standard Operating Procedures.
  • Ensure compliance with all applicable federal, state, MiLB/MLB, and local regulations related to health, safety, building operations, and security.
  • Coordinate emergency preparedness and response activities in collaboration with contracted security staff and local authorities.
  • Maintain accurate records of inspections, permits, safety reports, and compliance documentation.

Event Operations 

  • Collaborate with the Events Department to plan and prepare the stadium for baseball games, special events, concerts, and community activities.
  • Oversee event-day operations including seating bowl hosts, housekeeping, parking/transportation operations, security and Wool E. World.
  • Ensure all stadium spaces, equipment, and operational areas are properly staffed, prepared, and functioning for each event.

Capital Projects & Vendor Management 

  • Lead planning, budgeting, and execution of capital improvement projects related to the stadium.
  • Oversee vendor and contractor relationships including, but not limited to, housekeeping, pest control, fire alarm/suppression, elevator services, waste management, and general maintenance service agreements.
  • Ensure work performed by contractors meets quality standards, timelines, and budgetary constraints.

Budgeting & Administration 

  • Develop, manage, and adhere to the annual operating budget for stadium operations.
  • Track expenditures, forecast needs, and manage purchasing supplies, equipment, and services.
  • Maintain detailed event and project records throughout the year to produce an Annual Summary and Strategic Plan outlining achievements, challenges, and goals for the upcoming year.

Leadership & Staff Management 

  • Recruit, hire, train, schedule, and supervise full-time, part-time, and seasonal Stadium Operations staff.
  • Provide leadership that promotes a culture of safety, professionalism, and operational excellence.
  • Ensure staff are properly trained in emergency procedures, customer service, and stadium policies.

Technology & Systems 

  • Utilize and maintain Building Management Systems (BMS) and Computerized Maintenance Management Systems (CMMS) for effective tracking and management of facility operations.
  • Monitor stadium technology systems as related to operations, including lighting controls, HVAC automation, and work-order systems.

 

QUALIFICATION REQUIREMENTS 

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, project management, facilities management, sports management, or a related field; and at least five (5) years of facilities, grounds, or construction experience at a management level; or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Minimum of 5 years of facilities and grounds maintenance or construction experience, preferably connected to sports venues, live entertainment, or large public facilities.
  • Minimum of 3 years in a managerial or supervisory role.
  • Demonstrated experience in event operations, project management, and vendor/contractor oversight.
  • Meticulous, process-driven self-starter with strong attention to detail and the ability to understand, follow, and improve operational workflows.
  • Experience with Building Management Systems (BMS) and/or Computerized Maintenance Management Systems (CMMS) preferred.
  • HVAC or HVAC/R Certification a plus.
  • Electrical license a plus.
  • Strong understanding of safety regulations, emergency planning, and compliance standards.
  • Excellent communication, leadership, problem-solving, and organizational skills.

job.title: Production Support Specialist (36)- 2nd Shift
job.description:
FIND OUT WHAT IT IS LIKE TO BE A PART OF HALLMARK SUPPLY CHAIN

JOB OVERVIEW

You’ll be at the heart of our production center, helping millions of customers across the world enjoy Hallmark products. You will have a variety of duties that support the production process in numerous ways. You’ll be cross-trained across multiple departments by a support team of trainers and supervisors to help you learn every step of the way!


SALARY AND SHIFT DETAILS

  • Your starting pay will be between $19.80 - $22.65 depending on your shift.
  • This position is a full-time, 5-day work week position in the 2nd shift from 3:30pm - 11:30pm, Monday through Friday.
    Don’t see a shift that works for you? We still encourage you to apply! We’ll work with you to find a shift that fits your lifestyle and gives you the flexibility you need.

The Production Support Specialist in Lawrence has a variety of duties that support production in numerous ways.  Prepares greeting card stock for the Cutter to cut.  Jogs, skids and moves stock to the cutter.  Carries stock to skids and moves finished skids into the outgoing area.  Responsible for complete make-ready, run, monitoring and maintenance.  Removes die cut cards from full sheets either using a hammer or by using an Automatic Card Extractor (ACE).  Performs make-readies on the ACE and prepares rails/bars and press set-up.  Responsible for quality sampling and stacking cards onto skids according to register, blockouts, salvage and spoilage.  Determines when adhesive will be mixed and when test will be performed on the mixture.  Responsible for ensuring that the ingredients are in the area for mixing the adhesive.  Assists the Webtron press operator with press set up and changeover, make-readies, machine adjustments and routine preventative maintenance procedures.  Responsible for supporting the production areas by ordering the correct stock, moving components in and out of the areas, inputting information on the computer system, and maintaining a clean, safe, work environment. 

Positively participates in performance dialogues and other team problem-solving activities.  Sets up and operates a Gem/Cello machine, wholesale sealer, accumulator and shrink tunnel which shrinks poly film around wholesale unit of specialty items and/or operates a lift truck and keeps track of stock in the OAI.  Performs all paperwork assigned involved in moving stock, either into or out of the department.  Packs finished goods on a packaging line.  Identifies potential problems, and shows willingness to proactively work on problem resolution and alternative solutions to traditional methods of operation.  Flexibility is key as the incumbent will be expected to move to different work assignments as needed.

Important things to know:

  • Position may be in several departments and incumbent will be expected to learn and perform multiple assignments within this job classification.

  • In the production areas there is some noise. Hearing protection is provided by Hallmark.
  • Overtime is available and will be covered during the interview process.

In this position you will:

  • Perform make-ready duties on the Gem/Cello machines, ACE press and Webtron presses.  Set up wholesale sealer and pack product into shipping containers.  Mix adhesives and assure the proper ingredients and quantities are available in the area. 
  • Execute Quality System including preflight, sampling plan and the removal of salvage/spoilage.  Perform quality and/or adhesive test and report results in a timely manner.  Plan and maintain the workflow through the department in accordance with work schedule.  Order and deliver stock, cartons, and other components needed for production to the work area. 
  • Achieve and continually improve specified production including production goals, throughput, etc. during training.  Participate in performance dialogues and team problem-solving activities.  .
  • Complete regular press maintenance and cleaning, including TPM’s.  Move skids of stock into and away from the press, including completion of related paperwork.  Transport and handle hazardous waste material in accordance with all Federal, State, and Local regulations.  Be certified to operate power lift equipment and skid inverting machine. 
  • Demonstrate the flexibility and teamwork to positively influence how goals are accomplished within shorter periods of time.  Effectively communicate information to the next shift to ensure consistency and continuous operation. 
  • Utilize good safety practices.

 

YOUR AREAS OF KNOWLEDGE AND EXPERTISE

Basic Qualifications

  • You’re at least 18 years of age
  • You have the ability to grip and push/pull lifts of stock 2”-3.5” thick, 80-120 times per hour
  • You have the ability to lift 20-30 lb stacks of stock, 60-80 times per hour, with frequent lifting throughout the shift of 40-60 lbs.
  • You have the ability to constantly stand, walk, twist, bend, and reach above shoulder level
  • You have the ability to constantly use repetitive hand/wrist motion and perform fine motor skills

Preferred Qualifications

  • High school diploma, GED, or equivalent
  • Strong communication- and problem-solving skills

WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING AT HALLMARK

We want to help you be your best – at work and at home, now and in the future. It’s why providing benefits to support you and your family’s well-being is one of the most important investments Hallmark makes.

  • Your Health: Medical, vision, and dental plans; Specialized plan option for people with type 2 diabetes; Short-term and long-term disability coverage; Life and accident insurance
  • Your Well-Being: On-site registered nurses who provide health consultations and optional seasonal vaccinations. Health rewards program (earn up to $400 per year).
  • Your finances: A 401(k) with a 4% company match vested from day one. Health savings (HSA) or Flexible spending (FSA) accounts.
  • Your life: During your first year, you’ll receive 18 days (144 hours) of PTO and 10 paid holidays. Paid parental leave, adoption assistance, and comprehensive fertility benefits for eligible employees.
  • Your work environment: Climate-controlled and safety-first environment; On-site café that offers hot and cold meals; On-site Hallmark store where you can shop Hallmark products for 50%-75% off; Inclusive environment and a relaxed dress code, with a few safety rules to follow (close-toed shoes are required). Whether you have purple hair or express yourself through body art, we want you to bring your whole self to work.
  •  Your career: A career with Hallmark can take you anywhere. Our career paths are shaped by your talents and ambitions. Whether you want to take the next step up in a role you know and love or are looking to move into an entirely new area or location. We can help you do just that.

Now’s your chance to embrace a future with Hallmark—just follow the instructions below to apply. 

You must show how you meet the basic qualifications in a resume or document you upload, or by completing the work experience and education application fields. Accepted file types are DOCX and PDF.  

In compliance with the Immigration Reform and Control Act of 1986, Hallmark Cards, Inc. and its subsidiary companies will hire only individuals lawfully authorized to work in the United States. Hallmark does not generally provide sponsorship for employment. 

Employment by Hallmark is contingent upon the signing of the Employment Agreement, signing of an agreement to arbitrate in connection with the Hallmark Dispute Resolution Program, completing Form I-9 Employment Eligibility Verification, passing the urinalysis drug screen, education verification and satisfactory reference and background checks. 

Hallmark is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, pregnancy, national origin, physical or mental disability, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, or any other legally-protected status. Principals only please. 

HALLMARK – Because Connecting With Each Other Has Never Been More Important 

For more than a century, Hallmark has been bringing people together and improving the relationships that matter most. That’s why millions of people all over the world connect with the Hallmark brand. It has always been a mission so much bigger than any one of us who work here.

Today, we need empathetic learners, strategic thinkers, and enthusiastic visionaries with diverse experiences and skills to help us create the rest of Hallmark’s second century as we shift to a more digitally savvy, unified approach that combines the best of brick-and-mortar retail with the efficiency of dot-com spaces. Help us imagine what our next hundred years could look like! 

When you join Hallmark, we will go out of our way to make you feel like part of the team. In the day-to-day, we’ll make the best use of the skills and talents you already have. We’ll also give you leadership opportunities and show you multiple potential pathways to future success. 

Our culture of care for our consumers and for one another shows in the way we embrace different backgrounds, identities, and working styles, deliberately seeking out ways to be more inclusive both internally among our work groups and externally through the things we make and sell to our retail partners and consumers. We believe that a broadly inclusive, equitable approach is also our best path to future success. We’re seeking out those who can bring a fresh perspective to our business and would love your input as someone new to our team! We can only change and grow when we intentionally include new perspectives–like yours.

FIND OUT WHAT IT IS LIKE TO BE A PART OF HALLMARK SUPPLY CHAIN

The Maintenance Mechanic position reports through the Maintenance Department within the Lawrence Production Center.  Individuals in this department provide the necessary skills to install and maintain the production equipment in support of manufacturing.    

 

The Maintenance Mechanic in Lawrence is full time 40 hours a week, Monday - Friday 7:30am - 3:30pm

  • Competitive hourly rate - $26-$38 based on experience

 

The Maintenance Mechanic demonstrates a broad range of mechanical and troubleshooting skills by having the ability to repair equipment that ranges from simplistic (i.e. batch counter) to complex (i.e. troubleshooting PLC/Ladder logic programming).  Specialists install machinery and equipment to be used in production or related process by assembling, leveling, and securing the equipment. Specialists are also responsible for making the necessary electrical, compressed air, gas, and water connections.  They dismantle machinery as required, transport, reassemble, and make new connections when either moving from one location to another or disposing of equipment.  Specialists repair and maintain machinery/equipment to keep in compliance with safety, blueprints, and manufacturer specifications. Maintenance Specialists install/troubleshoot/repair electrical wiring, replace belts, fabricate parts, read schematics, and troubleshoot Programmable Logic Controllers (PLC), etc.  They also may be asked to modify existing equipment or designs and build new machines to improve capacity, quality, safety, or cost.  Specialists instruct operators and Operations Supervisors in the operation of new or modified equipment and work with them until they can satisfactorily and safely operate the equipment.  They often transport and handle hazardous waste material in-accordance-with all Federal, State, and Local regulations. They positively participate in performance dialogue and other team problem-solving activities, identify potential problems, and show willingness to proactively work on problem resolution and alternative solutions to traditional methods of operation.  Specialists must take the initiative to help problem solve and drive performance initiatives.  Flexibility is key as the incumbent will be expected to move to different work areas as needed.

job.title: Privacy Governance Administrator (remote)
job.description:
WHO WE ARE AND WHAT WE DO

The Consumer Marketing Analytics team provides powerful consulting along with key reporting and insightful analyses to the Hallmark Brand business. We focus on using data to understand our consumers, leveraging a vast number of sources to our advantage. We focus on complete storytelling to form an understanding of what has happened and use trends and analysis to drive future decisions. We are looking for motivated individuals who love exploring data to uncover hidden trends and developing new experiments to help meet our consumers where they are, with the right message, at the right time, and ultimately drive the business forward.

 

WHAT YOU’LL DO & HOW IT SHAPES OUR SUCCESS

The Privacy Governance Administrator serves as a key steward of Hallmark's privacy program across Hallmark Media and Hallmark Product & Retail, helping ensure privacy principles are embedded into business operations, technology decisions, and data practices. This role provides governance, oversight, and operational leadership across the privacy landscape, partnering closely with Legal, Information Security, Information Technology, Procurement, Data & Analytics, and business leaders to ensure personal data is managed responsibly, ethically, and in compliance with applicable laws and company policies.

You will drive the execution of critical privacy processes, including Data Subject Access Requests (DSARs), data inventories, and data mapping, privacy impact assessments, vendor privacy reviews, and ongoing privacy governance activities. Acting as a trusted advisor to business teams, you will apply sound judgment and risk-based decision making to help teams navigate complex privacy requirements while balancing business objectives, customer expectations, and regulatory obligations.

Success in this role requires strong discernment, attention to detail, and the ability to influence outcomes across a diverse stakeholder landscape. The ideal candidate excels at translating privacy requirements into practical business solutions, identifying and mitigating risk, and fostering accountability for responsible data practices throughout the organization. This role is ideal for someone who is passionate about shaping how privacy is operationalized at scale, connecting people, processes, and technology to strengthen trust, enable innovation, and advance Hallmark's commitment to protecting consumer data.

 

What You'll Do:

Lead Privacy Risk, Compliance & Assessment Activities:

  • Lead Privacy Assessments (PAs), Privacy Impact Assessments (PIAs), and other privacy reviews for products, technologies, vendors, and business processes.
  • Serve as a key privacy stakeholder in third-party risk management activities, partnering with Legal, Procurement, and Information Security.
  • Maintain oversight of privacy risks, remediation plans, and compliance obligations across the enterprise.
  • Monitor evolving privacy laws and regulations, translating requirements into actionable business guidance and operational controls.
  • Lead the coordination of audits, regulatory inquiries, and compliance reviews, driving timely remediation and ensuring identified privacy risks are addressed effectively.

 

Own Privacy Governance & Program Operations:

  • Drive the execution, governance, and continuous improvement of Hallmark's enterprise privacy program.
  • Partner across Legal, Information Security, Information Technology, Procurement, Marketing, Product, Media, Data & Analytics, and other business functions to embed privacy into business operations.
  • Lead Privacy Council operations, including governance decisions, action planning, and accountability tracking.
  • Maintain privacy policies, standards, procedures, operating practices, and governance documentation.
  • Develop privacy scorecards, metrics, and executive reporting that provide visibility into program health, risks, and performance.

 

Steward Data Governance & Privacy Transparency:

  • Govern records of processing activities, data inventories, data maps, and related privacy documentation within OneTrust.
  • Partner with business leaders, application owners, and data stewards to maintain an accurate understanding of how personal information is collected, used, shared, retained, and protected.
  • Ensure privacy records, controls, and governance processes evolve as new products, technologies, vendors, and business capabilities are introduced.

 

Own Data Subject Rights Operations:

  • Administer and continuously improve Hallmark's Data Subject Access Request (DSAR) and consumer rights processes.
  • Direct cross-functional efforts to identify, validate, collect, and deliver responsive information within regulatory timeframes.
  • Monitor volumes, trends, performance metrics, and compliance obligations to ensure a scalable and effective consumer rights program.

 

Advance Privacy Awareness & Incident Response:

  • Promote privacy awareness and responsible data stewardship throughout the organization.
  • Develop practical guidance and communications that help teams make informed privacy decisions.
  • Support the governance, investigation, documentation, and remediation of privacy incidents and data breaches.

 

Success in this role requires leadership through influence, strong judgment, and the ability to drive outcomes across a highly matrixed organization.

 

You will:

  • Exercise sound judgment and a risk-based approach when evaluating privacy issues and business decisions.
  • Build trusted partnerships across Legal, Security, Technology, Analytics, and business teams.
  • Drive accountability and execution across cross-functional initiatives.
  • Communicate complex privacy requirements in clear, practical business terms.
  • Balance regulatory obligations, business objectives, and consumer trust. Continuously identify opportunities to strengthen privacy controls, governance processes, and operational effectiveness.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

The following are required to be considered for this role: 

  • Bachelor's degree or 4 years of professional work experience. 
  • At least 10 years of experience in data, analytics, data management, data governance, information management, compliance, risk management, or related disciplines.
  • At least 3 years of experience supporting or leading data privacy, compliance, privacy governance, privacy-by-design, data governance, or regulatory initiatives.
  • Experience managing projects or programs, including developing action plans, coordinating work across multiple stakeholders, tracking deliverables, and meeting established deadlines.
  • Experience leading cross-functional governance, compliance, operational, or transformation initiatives that require driving accountability, managing remediation activities, and influencing outcomes across multiple stakeholder groups.
  • Experience documenting and analyzing data flows, system integrations, records of processing activities (ROPA), data maps, and the lifecycle of personal information across business processes and technology systems.
  • Ability to translate legal, regulatory, and policy requirements into practical business actions, operational controls, and process improvements.
  • Experience analyzing data, managing projects and priorities, resolving complex issues, and communicating with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

 

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

Your resume will stand out if you have the following:

  • Bachelor's degree in Data Analytics, Information Systems, Computer Science, Business Analytics, Management Information Systems, or a related data, technology, or business discipline.
  • Experience with OneTrust, including Data Mapping, Data Subject Rights (DSAR), Assessment Automation, and related privacy governance modules.
  • Experience supporting Privacy Impact Assessments (PIAs), Privacy Assessments (PAs), vendor privacy reviews, privacy-by-design initiatives, or enterprise compliance programs.
  • Professional privacy certifications such as CIPP/US, CIPM, CIPT, or equivalent.
  • Experience with privacy governance frameworks, records of processing activities, data inventories, consent management, or enterprise data governance programs.
  • Experience working with modern data platforms and ecosystems, including cloud data platforms, customer data platforms (CDPs), data warehouses, or data governance technologies.
  • Familiarity with privacy and governance technologies such as OneTrust, TrustArc, BigID, Collibra, Alation, or related platforms.
  • Experience in retail, consumer products, media, entertainment, subscription businesses, or other data-intensive and consumer-focused industries.

ADDITIONAL DETAILS

  • This is a U.S.-based remote role.* We’re committed to creating a connected, collaborative culture, no matter where you are. You’ll have access to virtual tools, team support, and opportunities to engage and grow with us. *Due to state-specific benefits regulations, Hallmark cannot consider candidates for remote positions who reside in Alaska, Hawaii, or Puerto Rico, or any country outside of the United States. If based in Kansas City, this position offers a hybrid work arrangement, giving you the best of both worlds: collaborating in person at Hallmark Headquarters in Kansas City, MO and enjoying the flexibility of working remotely. Some meetings required in-person, many can be remote.
  • The salary range for this role is $104k - $130k. Final compensation varies based on several factors
  • This role is eligible for Hallmark’s Annual Incentive Plan. More information will be shared during the interview process.
  • Hallmark is committed to recognizing and rewarding performance. Employees are eligible for annual merit-based increases, aligned with individual and company performance.
  • In alignment with our culture of care, Hallmark offers a competitive benefits package, including medical, dental and vision plans, paid time off, 401K with company match, and profit-sharing.

job.title: Customer Service Representative - Halls KC Concierge (On-call)
job.description:
WHO WE ARE:

Crown Center, one of the nation’s first mixed-use redevelopments, is an 85-acre complex that welcomes more than five million visitors each year. A subsidiary of Hallmark Cards, Crown Center is a ‘city within a city’ – combining hotel, office, retail, residential and entertainment land uses within its boundaries.

Halls KC provides the ultimate in trend-setting design, exclusive brands, and superior customer service. Our beautiful, 60,000 square foot store is located on the third level of the Crown Center shops in the heart of Kansas City. Halls KC offers shopping experiences in a fresh and exciting environment, taking an active role in Crown Center’s goal of creating a vibrant central city. 

 

WHAT WE DO AND HOW WE DO IT:

The On-call Customer Service Representative (Halls Concierge) is the first point of contact for Halls customers, delivering an exceptional shopping experience at Halls KC – a luxury retail store. This role requires a passion for customer satisfaction, strong communication skills, and the ability to manage multiple tasks with precision and professionalism. The On-call Customer Service Representative (Halls Concierge) is responsible for cash handling, gift wrapping, stocking supplies in Hall Concierge, and performs other responsibilities as required by management.

 

IN THIS ROLE YOU WILL:

Provide exceptional customer service with a focus on creating memorable experiences and ensuring customer satisfaction. Exhibit empathy, patience, and a positive attitude when addressing customer needs or concerns. Uphold Halls’ brand image and demonstrate a passion for our customers in every interaction. Answer incoming phone calls, transfer calls appropriately, and assist with inquiries in a courteous and professional manner.

Collaborate effectively with team members, demonstrating a positive team player attitude within the department and the entire store. Perform gift wrapping and gift boxing services to maintain Halls’ high standards of presentation. Multitask in a fast-paced environment while maintaining attention to detail. Cash management and cash handling accurately and responsibly. Maintain and stock supplies in the concierge area to ensure readiness and efficiency. Keep the customer service area clean, organized, and visually appealing.

All Halls employees are responsible for protecting company assets by following established policies and procedures.

 

Now’s your chance to embrace a future with Hallmark—just follow the instructions below to apply.

job.title: 2027 Summer Internship- Creative (eGreetings)
job.description:
ABOUT HALLMARK’S INTERNSHIP PROGRAM  

We're looking for curious, creative, and consumer-focused interns who are passionate about storytelling, trends, culture, creativity, and human connection. 

 

 eGreetings Creative Intern 

This internship focuses on the future of digital connection through animated, interactive, and video-based greeting experiences. Interns will research consumer trends, explore emerging digital behaviors, and develop concepts that help Hallmark engage younger and new consumers through innovative digital greetings experiences. Interns will partner with creative, digital, and media teams to develop concepts, storyboards, and recommendations that could influence future product development 

What you'll do: 

  • Research consumer behaviors, creative trends, and digital connection experiences.  
  • Explore opportunities for animated, video-based, and interactive greetings.  
  • Partner with Digital Greetings, Media Studio, and Creative teams to understand current capabilities and future opportunities.  
  • Develop innovative concepts focused on personalization, interactivity, and social sharing.  
  • Create storyboards, visual concepts, and creative recommendations.  
  • Gather feedback from cross-functional partners and refine concepts based on insights.  
  • Present digital greeting concepts and recommendations to business and creative leaders. 

 

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS 

The following are required to be considered for this role: 

  • Pursuing a bachelor's degree in Digital Media, Graphic Design, Animation, Motion Design, User Experience (UX), Interactive Media, Creative Technology, Film/Video Production, or a related field
  • A graduation date of December 2027, May 2028, December 2028, May 2029, December 2029, or May 2030 

 

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS 

Your resume and application will stand out if you are: 

  • Demonstrated interest in digital content, creative storytelling, emerging media, interactive experiences, or consumer engagement
  • Passionate about how people connect and communicate through digital platforms, social media, video, gaming, or emerging technologies
  • Familiarity with social, cultural, and consumer trends relevant to Gen Z and Gen Alpha audiences
  • Skilled at generating creative ideas and translating them into visual concepts, storyboards, mockups, presentations, or prototypes
  • Familiar with content creation tools, design software, video editing, animation, or other digital creative platforms
  • Comfortable collaborating across creative and business disciplines and incorporating feedback into evolving concepts
  • Experience through coursework, publications, student organizations, freelance work, or personal creative projects is a plus

  

ADDITIONAL DETAILS 

  • A portfolio is required for this position. Your portfolio should be compiled into one PDF document that is no larger than 5 MB. If your portfolio file size is above the 5MB limit, you can submit a one-page overview of your work (see example). You can also submit a link to a personal portfolio website to supplement your uploaded portfolio. Applicants who do not upload a portfolio or one-page overview will not be considered.
  • Our internship program is 12 weeks long, starting in late May and ending in early August.

job.title: Donor Advisor I
job.description:
Description

Job Summary

The Donor Advisor I (DA1) cultivates and stewards a portfolio of about 600-800 donors with mid-major gift capacity for all Hope Media Group brands. The DA I follows a scalable stewardship plan for individual donors. The DA I may create Individual Donor Plans (IDPs) for a small segment to match donors’ passions and interests with brands, projects, and initiatives at Hope Media Group. They will support donor communications and impact reporting; gift solicitations with individual donors, foundations, and corporations – all while nurturing a life of generosity in each donor. The DA I is attentive to donor’s spiritual needs. The DA I prays with donors as needed.


Essential Functions

Portfolio Stewardship:

  • Engages, shepherds, and solicits a portfolio of qualified mid-level donors in support of all Hope Media Group brands and programs
  • Builds and stewards relationships with portfolio donors
  • Creates, maintains, and updates complete donor data in CRM 
  • Engages with donors with phone calls, handwritten notes, personal emails, and texts to identify specific donor HMG brand interest(s) and to build connection to other HMG brands
  • Promptly and professionally responds to and resolves donor requests and inquiries 
  • Provides ongoing spiritual care to portfolio, including praying with donors on phone calls and in-person as appropriate
  • Works with Executive Director, Donor Experience and leadership team members to coordinate meetings with major donors if needed
  • Seeks and creates opportunities to deepen donor experiences with Hope Media Group brands
  • Inspires donors during experiences such as group tours of Hope Media Group campus and studios
  • Occasionally attends events such as breakfasts, galas, sports competitions, rodeos, vision trips, and pre-concert dinners to engage with donors as needed (requires early mornings, some evenings and some weekends.)

Demonstrated Faith: 

  • Committed to a personal relationship with Jesus Christ
  • Grounded spiritually and biblically literate
  • Comfortable praying for co-workers in team meetings, leading spoken prayer, and participating in ministry prayer meetings and Bible studies
  • Live Christian principles defined by the ministry’s Statement of Faith & Biblical Beliefs
  • Participate in on-air fundraisers and prays for donors as needed
  • Passion for leveraging the HMG’s media platforms for evangelism and discipleship
  • Exhibit a strong moral character
  • Active member of a Bible believing local church


Non-Essential Functions

  • Other responsibilities as assigned to support the mission of HMG


Requirements

Education:

  • Bachelor’s Degree preferred, but not required if has customer service experience

Experience:

  • Minimum of 2 years of experience in development/fundraising for non-profit organizations or customer service experience 

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:

  • Demonstrated understanding of fundraising, principles, methods, and practices; and the ability to develop successful donor relationships through cultivation and stewardship
  • Demonstrated experience in developing and executing strategy 
  • Prioritizes and task-switches with a fluctuating workload and competing priorities
  • Organizes and manages time with frequent interruptions
  • Attention to detail regarding writing, data entry and numerical accuracy, with a focus on data analysis and data integrity 
  • Listens and quickly picks up on verbal/tonal cues
  • Clearly communicates both verbally and in writing with constituents and corporate partners by telephone, letter, e-mail, and in person
  • Takes initiative, works independently, and collaborates with team members
  • Ministry minded person who learns quickly from the trainings and offers suggestions for improvement when needed
  • Shows initiative and consistently hungers for continuous improvement
  • Discerns and elicits the interests and concerns of others, meeting needs and discovering ways to improve engagement with donors
  • Natural ability to quickly build rapport and trust with ministry stakeholders
  • Able to process analytically and think strategically regarding managing a portfolio of donors and upgrading gifts.
  • Skilled at positioning a funding offer and making the ask 
  • Demonstrates strong moral, ethical and relational skills
  • Desires and shows willingness to pray for others
  • Sound understanding of the theology of fundraising and fundraising ethics
  • Bilingual in English/Spanish a plus
  • Proficiency using Microsoft Word, Excel & Teams. Ability to be trained on Virtuous CRM 

Supervisory Responsibilities:

  • None

  • Local travel as needed

  • Occasional as event planner/participant.

job.title: Technical Product Manager, Content Systems Automation
job.description:
#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?
We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, we’ve got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is… YOU! Becoming a part of Paramount means joining a team of passionate people who not only recognize the power of content but also enjoy a touch of fun and uniqueness. Together, we co-create moments that matter – both for our audiences and our employees – and aim to leave a positive mark on culture.

 

Overview:

 

As a member of the Paramount+ Content Systems Product team, you will help shape the automation strategy for our tools and systems. These are the systems that power our global streaming experiences. What an exciting place to be! Your mission is to learn the manual, hands-on challenges of our partner teams. Then you build the right solutions to solve the right problems at the right time.

 

You will play a key role in keeping Paramount+ running efficiently. We are growing to millions of new subscribers around the world! This team cares about solving problems and improving workflows for the people we work with each day. Together, we build forward-looking tools that scale right along with our business.

 

Responsibilities:

 

  • Operational Excellence: Partner with Video and Content Operations to learn where the gaps are in our content supply chain. Then turn those needs into a clear automation plan we can act on.
  • Systems Mapping: Map how our content systems connect from end to end - data flows, handoffs, and dependencies. Then use that picture to find where and how to automate.
  • Process Automation: Guide the product development of our Content Systems. This includes rights, title, and media asset management. Your sharp focus: automate manual, high-touch workflows!
  • AI & Innovation: Find and roll out AI-driven solutions that help our operations teams work more effectively. Think automated metadata extraction, AI-assisted QC, and auto-created localized assets!
  • Technical Documentation: Share a clear vision for technical work. Write up scope, use cases, workflows, and sequence diagrams.
  • Agile Execution: Lead scrum team activities such as grooming, planning, and setting priorities. That way, our development teams always have what they need to succeed.
  • Stakeholder Alignment: Bring partners in product, tech, and operations together on delivery scope. Then get set for exciting global launches!

 

Basic Qualifications:

 

  • Experience: 2-4 years in software product management. You know how to put business value first and weigh trade-offs.
  • Systems Thinking: Ability to map and visualize how complex, interconnected systems work together end-to-end - understanding not just individual tools but the relationships between them - in order to identify where and how to automate across the workflow.
  • Automation Mindset: A proven passion for building workflow tools. You want them to be a "joy to use" for internal teams!
  • Technical Depth: Deep comfort with complex technical workflow systems. Engineering experience or a background in AI/ML is a big plus.
  • Domain Knowledge: A strong interest in the streaming media world and the content supply chain.
  • Collaboration: You build caring, trusting relationships across teams. This helps product work run smoothly, even in a complex space.
  • Agile Expertise: Lots of hands-on Agile experience. You also have excellent communication skills.

 

 

Paramount Skydance Corporation (NASDAQ: PSKY) is a leading global media and entertainment company that creates premium content and experiences for audiences worldwide. Driven by iconic studios, networks and streaming services, Paramount's portfolio of consumer brands includes CBS, Showtime Networks, Paramount Pictures, Nickelodeon, MTV, Comedy Central, BET, Paramount+, and Pluto TV, among others. Paramount delivers the largest share of the U.S. television audience and boasts one of the industry's most important and extensive libraries of TV and film titles. In addition to offering innovative streaming services and digital video products, the company provides powerful capabilities in production, distribution and advertising solutions.

 

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION

 

Hiring Salary Range: $98,000.00 - 115,000.00. 

 

The hiring salary range for this position applies to New York City, California, Colorado, Washington state, and most other geographies. Starting pay for the successful applicant depends on a variety of job-related factors, including but not limited to geographic location, market demands, experience, training, and education.  The benefits available for this position include medical, dental, vision, 401(k) plan, life insurance coverage, disability benefits, tuition assistance program and PTO or, if applicable,  as otherwise dictated by the appropriate Collective Bargaining Agreement. This position is bonus eligible.  

 

What We Offer:
  • Attractive compensation and comprehensive benefits packages. Check out our full list of benefits here: https://www.paramount.com/careers/benefits
  • Generous paid time off.
  • An exciting and fulfilling opportunity to be part of one of Paramount’s most dynamic teams.
  • Opportunities for both on-site and virtual engagement events.
  • Unique opportunities to make meaningful connections and build a vibrant community, both inside and outside the workplace.
  • Explore life at Paramount: https://www.paramount.com/careers/life-at-paramount

 

Paramount is an equal opportunity employer (EOE) including disability/vet.

 

At Paramount, the spirit of inclusion feeds into everything that we do, on-screen and off. From the programming and movies we create to employee benefits/programs and social impact outreach initiatives, we believe that opportunity, access, resources and rewards should be available to and for the benefit of all. If you’re energized by the opportunity to help build the next-generation global media and entertainment company powered by creativity and technology, we’d be thrilled to welcome you aboard. LET’S GO!

 

 

Location: San Francisco – Onsite

 

About This Role

Welcome to Paramount Streaming — the team behind Paramount+, home to a mountain of entertainment for audiences around the globe. We bring together iconic brands, compelling content, and technology to deliver streaming experiences to millions of viewers.

We’re hiring a Lead Software Engineer on the AI Engagement Engine team. This is a senior individual contributor role with no direct reports. You’ll build native Apple experiences that support content discovery and personalization within the Paramount+ and Pluto TV applications, integrating real-time personalization signals across key touchpoints.

You’ll partner with backend, ML, data, product, and platform teams to deliver reliable, scalable experiences across iOS and tvOS. You’ll own complex technical problems, contribute to client architecture, and work with existing technical leadership to strengthen engineering standards.

AI fluency is a core requirement for this role. We’re looking for someone who uses AI coding assistants and agents daily and understands how to work effectively with context, tools, Model Context Protocol (MCP), and agent harnesses. You should be comfortable explaining your workflows, evaluating AI-generated output, and recognizing when human review is needed.

 

Responsibilities

Technical Leadership

  • Contribute to decisions on architecture, frameworks, and tooling for iOS and tvOS applications in partnership with team leads and senior peers.

  • Evaluate new technologies and adopt approaches that improve engineering quality and productivity.

  • Explain technical decisions and trade-offs clearly.

Application Development

  • Design, build, debug, and ship native iOS and tvOS features.

  • Improve performance, reliability, and accessibility across the app experience.

  • Build client experiences for personalization and recommendations in partnership with ML and backend teams.

  • Integrate APIs and personalization signals into responsive, data-driven interfaces.

AI-Assisted Engineering

  • Use AI coding assistants and agents such as Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, or equivalent tools daily to design, write, review, test, and refactor code.

  • Use MCP integrations to connect AI tools with relevant engineering tools and data sources, with appropriate access controls.

  • Work with agent harnesses to manage context, instructions, tool execution, and human review.

  • Validate AI-generated code through review and testing, investigate failures, and recognize when a different approach is needed.

  • Share useful workflows, skills, plugins, and lessons learned with teammates.

Mentorship and Collaboration

  • Help improve code quality through code reviews, design reviews, and pairing.

Ownership and Delivery

  • Own features and technical problems from requirements through delivery and follow-up.

  • Manage concurrent priorities, surface risks early, and help the team deliver predictably.

  • Contribute to improvements in engineering practices, documentation, and shared standards.

 

Skills

Apple Platform Expertise

  • Strong programming skills in Swift.

  • In-depth knowledge of iOS and tvOS, and proficiency in Xcode.

  • Strong fundamentals in memory management, concurrency, animations, and performance profiling.

  • Experience designing interfaces across size classes and device families.

  • Experience consuming RESTful APIs and integrating with backend services.

AI Fluency, MCP, and Agent Harnesses

  • Practical experience using AI coding assistants and agents in day-to-day engineering work.

  • Working understanding of inference, context windows, tool use, and the capabilities and limitations of AI coding tools.

  • Familiarity with MCP, including connecting AI tools to external tools and data sources, configuring integrations, and managing permissions.

  • Understanding of agent harnesses, including how they manage context, instructions, tool execution, and human review.

  • Ability to explain practical workflows using MCP integrations and agent harnesses, including how you troubleshoot failures and validate results.

  • Working familiarity with skills and plugins, how they extend AI coding tools, and when to use an existing one.

  • Ability to write and refine prompts and context, critically evaluate AI-generated output, and validate generated code.

  • Familiarity with how LLM- or ML-powered product features are built.

  • Sound judgment around privacy, intellectual property, attribution, and responsible AI use.

Architecture and Experimentation

  • Strong problem-solving and architectural skills at the app and module level.

  • Experience with A/B testing, feature flagging, and client-side experimentation, including experiment assignment, holdout groups, and measuring impact.

  • Experience integrating ad-serving products into Apple applications, including ad surfaces, impression tracking, and collaboration with ad tech teams.

  • Working familiarity with ML-driven product features, including API contracts, client-side signals, and distinguishing between data, model, and rendering issues.

Leadership and Communication

  • Clear written and verbal communication with technical and non-technical colleagues.

  • Ability to mentor and support others without requiring a reporting relationship.

  • A collaborative approach to technical decisions, feedback, and problem-solving.

Basic Qualifications

  • 7+ years of Apple platform development experience, or equivalent senior-level depth.

  • Hands-on experience using Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations and agent harnesses in engineering workflows, including validating outputs and troubleshooting failures.

  • Experience as a key contributor to at least one publicly released native iPhone application.

  • Experience working with Agile development processes.

  • Demonstrable, current use of AI coding tools and agents in your day-to-day engineering workflow, and the ability to explain how they work to others.

  • BS/BA degree in a technical field such as Computer Science, or equivalent experience.

Bonus Skills (Nice to Have)

  • Experience building or extending MCP integrations or agent harnesses.
