job.title: Senior Manager, IT Operations
job.description: About Suno We're building the world's first creative entertainment platform, where the entire world can feel the joy and fulfillment of making music. Music is for everyone: Our users include everyone from grandmothers creating songs for their loved ones, to Grammy winners using Suno Studio, our power tool, to make the most popular hits in the world. Building the future of entertainment requires ambition. The pace is fast, the problems are hard, and the work demands ownership and intensity. For the right people, it’s incredibly rewarding: a chance to shape a new medium, work with a small team that cares deeply about quality, make music, drink too much coffee, and build something that millions of people use to express themselves in ways that were never before possible. Suno is the fastest growing consumer entertainment company and the leader in AI music. We are backed by leading investors including Bond Capital, Menlo Ventures, Lightspeed Venture Partners, IVP, Forerunner, Union Square Ventures, Alkeon, Quiet, Matrix Partners, Schroders Capital and, NVentures (venture arm of NVIDIA). About the Role Lead the team that keeps Suno Corporate IT Systems running. As Manager, IT Operations, you'll lead our IT Engineers and build our IT Service Desk. Your team owns IT operations across our four US offices — Cambridge, New York, San Francisco, and Los Angeles — including identity and access management, endpoint management, collaboration software, office A/V, office networking, and Tailscale. Your success will be measured through the impact of your team. You'll establish clear ownership over operational areas, ensure top-notch service that your colleagues trust, and your team will leverage AI and Automation to scale efficiently. You'll partner closely with Operations, People, Finance, Security, and Engineering, and you'll be the senior IT presence on the West Coast. Listen to the song we made about it: https://suno.com/s/0fzLoGLLVcxm3uBA What Your Team Owns Identity and access management — Okta, SSO and SCIM coverage, joiner / mover / leaver automation via our IGA platform, access reviews, and ad hoc access requests. Endpoint management — the Mac fleet in MDM, zero-touch enrollment, OS and patch compliance, device trust, and endpoint security in partnership with our EDR/MDR providers. Collaboration software — Google Workspace, Slack, Notion, and the broader SaaS portfolio: configuration, hardening, licensing, and lifecycle. Office A/V — conference rooms, videoconferencing, and event spaces. Corporate Networking — wired, wireless, and WAN across four sites, including design for buildouts and expansions with outside experts where it makes sense. Tailscale — our zero-trust network layer: ACL policy, device posture, access to internal tools and infrastructure, and the day-to-day administration in collaboration with Engineering IT service delivery — the service desk, AI IT Service Management platform, SLAs, escalation paths, knowledge base, and the Tier 0 partnership with office managers. What You'll Do Manage the IT Engineers — set expectations against our role standards, give direct feedback, run 1:1s and performance conversations, and grow people on the IC track. Manage against outcomes and impact, not tenure and activities. Build the IT Help Desk — define the service model (what the desk handles, what escalates to engineering, what office managers cover at Tier 0), write the job profiles, our our service desk team. Own operational outcomes — the team's quarterly plan across the areas above, clear ownership of each area by a named engineer, and honest status reporting to the Senior Manager of IT and leadership. Run change well — size changes by scope, impact, and reversibility; make sure the team communicates before changes land and can roll them back after; bring in the right partners early and avoid surprises. Scale service as Suno scales — runbooks and knowledge articles good enough for AI-powered self-service to actually deflect; automate what the team has handled twice; absorb headcount growth without proportional growth in tickets or effort. Manage vendors and partners — MSPs, network and A/V integrators, EDR/MDR providers, and SaaS vendors; hold them to results and know when to bring work in-house. Lead IT for the West Coast — own IT for the SF office directly, oversee LA coverage, and partner with Facilities on buildouts, moves, and expansions. What You'll Need Must-Haves 10+ years in IT, including 3+ years managing IT engineers, a help desk, or an IT operations team at a high-growth company. You've built a support function, not just inherited one — you can discuss service model, SLAs, staffing, and deflection you put in place and what changed because of it. Working knowledge across the stack your team owns — identity (Okta or equivalent, SCIM, IGA), Apple-first endpoint management, Google Workspace and Slack administration, office networking and A/V, and zero-trust networking (Tailscale or comparable) — deep enough to set priorities, review your team's work credibly, and ask the right questions, without needing to be the best engineer in the room. Strong people leadership — you've hired, coached, given hard feedback, and managed performance, including for people in other offices and time zones. Clear written communication — you need to be able to communicate clearly and concisely for executive, business, and technical audiences. Judgment under growth — you can tell a one-way door from a two-way door, move fast on the reversible, and slow down on the consequential. Nice-to-Haves Hands-on background with Okta, SCIM provisioning, and IGA tooling (Lumos, SailPoint, Saviynt, or comparable). Modern Apple MDM (Iru, Jamf, Jumpcloud) and endpoint security partnerships (CrowdStrike, SentinelOne, Expel, or similar). Tailscale or another zero-trust network layer in production — ACL design, device posture, SSO integration. ITSM design experience — intake, categorization, SLAs, and reporting from scratch; AI-powered self-service a plus. Experience running IT through a multi-office expansion — new sites, floor expansions, and the integrators and vendors that come with them. Experience as an early IT leader at a company that grew from hundreds to a thousand employees. Work Location Policy This role is expected to work from the San Francisco Suno office 5 days a week, per Suno's company policy. Full-time employees will receive competitive equity packages, and comprehensive benefits. The actual base salary offered may vary depending on location, skills, qualifications, and experience. Additional Notes Applicants must be eligible to work in the US. Willingness to travel (up to 25%) to lead team members and support offices across Suno locations, with a deliberate cadence in Cambridge and NYC during the first six months. We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital or family status, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other legally protected basis under provincial, federal, state, and local laws, regulations, or ordinances. job.title: Advertising Operations Associate
job.description:
Job Description:

POLITICO’s mission from the very beginning was to win the audience. We dedicate ourselves to providing accurate, non-partisan, impactful information to the right people at the right time so that they can act with confidence and speed.


POLITICO is in search of an Advertising Operations Specialist who will work closely with the Media Business team to ensure successful activation and fulfillment of advertising campaigns. The ideal candidate will be agile and work well in a fast-paced environment. 


Who You Are:

  • A detail-driven problem solver who thrives in fast-paced, deadline-oriented environments.
  • A collaborative communicator with a knack for translating data into actionable insights.
  • A tech-savvy professional fluent in ad operations tools, creative platforms, and web languages.
  • A dependable team player who takes initiative and embraces leadership opportunities.
  • A strategic thinker who values integrity, innovation, and contributing to a mission-driven culture.

What You’ll Do:

  • Work closely with Media Business to ensure successful activation and fulfillment of advertising campaigns
  • QA advertising assets and troubleshoot any technical and performance issues
  • Launch, monitor and optimize digital campaigns using the ad server
  • Analyze performance of advertising campaigns and products
  • Contribute to product performance benchmarks and insights using multiple data sources and visualization tools
  • Maintain runsheets, campaign pacing and inventory forecasting reports
  • Liaise with Design team to insure placement of print advertising
  • Assist with evaluation, implementation and administration of ad tech platforms

What You’ll Need:

  • 0-1 years of experience
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Strong attention to detail
  • Ability to be dependable when working on a team
  • Experience analyzing data to extract meaningful, actionable insights
  • Experience using Google’s advertising platforms or comparable ad serving platforms
  • Experience using Adobe Creative Suite, Microsoft Excel
  • Familiarity with web languages (HTML, Javascript, etc.)
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, deadline driven environment
  • Ready to take on leadership opportunities and become Subject Matter Experts in our platforms

COMPENSATION: $50,000 Annual Base. This position is eligible for commission. The final salary offered will be based on factors including relevant experience, skills, and qualifications.


We value our people. Click here for more on what we offer and what it’s like to work for POLITICO. 


Let’s keep in touch. You can view our list of open positions here and email us careers@politico.com. We hope to see your application soon! 


About Us. 

POLITICO illuminates the forces shaping global power. Since 2007, we have delivered intelligence that anticipates tomorrow's headlines, not reports on yesterday's news. As politics has increasingly become the defining force of our era, our work has never been more vital. 


Cabinet secretaries and Ministers start their mornings with our analysis. CEOs shape strategy around our reporting. Advocacy leaders rely on our insights to move policy. We deliver the straightforward facts and clear-eyed analysis they need to navigate the most complex political landscape of our lifetimes. 


Our 1,100+ publishing professionals across the world's key democratic capitals—Washington, Brussels, London, Paris, Berlin, Sacramento, and New York—form the world's premier politics and policy newsroom. We tell the story of how power really works by explaining who wields it and how they plan to exercise it, connecting dots others miss and delivering scoops from sources others don't even know exist. 


Innovation has always been a core tenet of our story. At launch, we bet that depth would trump scale, that talent would trump traffic, and that politics would become central to modern life. In 2011, we made another bet and launched POLITICO Pro to help decision-makers understand the business of government, transforming both how they shape government action and the business of journalism itself. 


These bets have made POLITICO the most successful digital news startup of its generation and the indispensable resource for leaders who shape the future. Today, we are a rarity in media: a growing, profitable, and sustainable news organization. 


POLITICO is a subsidiary of Axel Springer SE, a family-owned transatlantic media company headquartered in Berlin and New York. Axel Springer is dedicated to shaping the future of journalism in the free world, believing that a free and informed society is essential to democracy. The company’s guiding principles - first articulated as  The Essentials by founder Axel Springer in the aftermath of World War II - remain a cornerstone of the company’s foundation today. Learn more about Axel Springer.

job.description:
Support Operations Analyst


Job Description

Thomson Reuters is seeking a Support Operations Analyst to join the Customer Service & Support Operations team in Manila, Philippines (PHL-Taguig). This individual contributor role (TR5 level) reports to the Senior Manager, Support Operations. You will be the delivery and sustainment layer for the OE Support Operations portfolio. You will handle ad hoc reporting and analysis, manage projects that automate processes and reports, and keep the Power BI, Power Apps, and Power Automate estate accurate and available. Leaders and over 800 contact center agents rely on this estate every day across the Tax, Legal, and Corporate product groups. Working with the Power Platform Solutions Developers who build these solutions, you will own the project management that helps them land, from requirements through adoption, and you will remain accountable for their accuracy once they are live.


Key Responsibilities

  • Deliver accurate, timely ad hoc reporting and analysis for Operations, Workforce Management, Quality, Training, and CS&S leadership, including requests that arrive outside the planned roadmap.
  • Own project management for process and report automation initiatives, covering requirements, stakeholder alignment, user testing, launch, adoption, and on-track delivery.
  • Sustain the accuracy, availability, and governance of the Power BI, Power Apps, and Power Automate estate so that reported data stays trusted.
  • Build and maintain a single, defensible source of truth across CS&S data sources, including Salesforce, Genesys, LiveHelp, Aspect, and Snowflake.
  • Produce contact driver, handle time, quality, customer experience, and workforce analytics, and turn them into written recommendations that state the insight, the implication, and the recommended action.
  • Monitor dataset refreshes and flow failures, resolve escalations the same day where operations require it, and act as secondary owner for automation and reporting assets built by the Power Platform Solutions Developers.
  • Apply Generative AI and automation tools to speed up documentation, analysis, and reporting, and validate AI-assisted output against operational reality before it is used.

Required Qualifications

  • Four or more years of experience in business analysis, operational reporting, or workforce management analytics within a contact center or shared services environment.
  • Hands-on Power BI development experience, including data modeling, DAX, semantic models, and report publication.
  • Working knowledge of Power Apps, Power Automate, and Dataverse, sufficient to maintain, troubleshoot, and enhance existing solutions.
  • Advanced Excel skills, including Power Query.
  • Familiarity with contact center and WFM platforms such as Genesys, Aspect/Alvaria, and Salesforce, and with their underlying reporting data.
  • Project management discipline, including requirements definition, stakeholder management, user testing, and structured status reporting.
  • Strong written communication skills, with the ability to brief leaders clearly, lead with the bottom line, and raise risks early.
  • Comfort working across competing priorities, where planned project work and unplanned operational requests run at the same time.

Preferred Qualifications

  • SQL and Snowflake experience.
  • Exposure to process improvement methodology such as DMAIC or Lean Six Sigma.
  • Demonstrated use of Generative AI tools in a real operational or analytical workflow.
  • Experience building or maintaining Copilot Studio agents or AI-assisted process documentation.

job.title: Senior Backend Developer
job.description:
Join our team at the Guardian and be a part of a diverse and inclusive global organisation that delivers fearless, investigative journalism and holds power to account. Our team of award-winning journalists, cutting-edge commercial professionals and industry-leading digital experts are committed to making a difference and represent a wide range of backgrounds and perspectives. We offer a challenging and exciting environment for career development, with a focus on training, growth and fostering an inclusive culture.

 

We are now looking for a Senior Backend Software Developer to join our Apps Experience team on a 12 month fixed contract. 

 

You could be building the products that showcase our progressive and independent journalism, crafting the tools that journalists use to write their stories, developing the services that allow those stories to be distributed across the globe, or safeguarding our financial future.

 

About the role

  • You’ll mostly be programming in Scala and Typescript, running in AWS, but we use the tool that best fits the problem.
  • You’ll be working in a cross-functional team, which is empowered to rapidly iterate and release new features.
  • You won’t be coding in isolation - our culture is strongly collaborative, whether pair programming with other developers or working closely with editorial and commercial colleagues.
  • Sometimes deciding what code to write is as hard as writing the code itself. As an engineer you’ll be involved in product decisions as well as technical ones.
  • You have a strong interest in growing your skills even further.

 

Much of our code is openly available on GitHub, and some of our projects are widely used throughout the Open Source community. Many of our developers regularly attend and present at conferences. Please visit our Guardian Developers site and the Guardian Developer blog for more information about working in the Digital Development team.

 

About you

  • As a full stack engineer, you’ll be equally willing to dive into a purely functional and composable Scala back-end, or a complex Typescript front-end.
  • You inspire the people you work with, and are inspired by them in return.
  • You contribute to the direction of your team's products
  • You are passionate about spreading engineering best practice beyond your immediate team.
  • You are excited by the opportunity to shape the future of digital journalism.
  • Your interests go beyond just your team’s objectives; you are curious about where the organisation is moving as a whole.
  • You have a strong interest in growing your skills.
  • You can make reasoned choices regarding what technologies to use and when to use them.
  • We believe diversity of people, backgrounds, experience and ideas helps us to build better products and achieve more. We welcome applicants who have taken traditional and non-traditional career paths into software development.

 

We actively encourage applications from groups traditionally underrepresented in the UK media

 

Our engineers and developers operate in a hybrid environment working 1 day a week from our offices in Kings Cross and 4 days a week remotely.

 

We strive for transparency in remuneration.  The salary for new Senior Developers at the Guardian is £72,000 per year.

 

We value and respect all differences (seen and unseen) in all people. We aspire to have inclusive working experiences and an environment that reflects the audience we serve, where our people have equal access to career development opportunities, their voices are heard and can contribute to our future. We actively encourage applications from people of all backgrounds. Many of our staff work flexibly and we will consider all requests for flexible working arrangements.

 

How to apply

Please upload your CV and covering letter as one document. You should also highlight the extent to which your skills/experience meets the requirements of the role and your motivation behind applying.

 

Our interview process involves two stages: a face to face interview and a pairing test. We may offer a remote pairing test for candidates who would have to travel a long distance to our office in London, however you will have to arrange to come to our office for the face to face interview.

 

The closing date for applications is Friday 30th October 2026.

 

All roles at the Guardian are open for everybody to apply. It is important to us that you feel supported and comfortable throughout your recruitment process, in order to perform your best. job.title: Database Engineer II
job.description:
AXS connects fans with the artists and teams they love. Each year we sell millions of tickets to thousands of incredible events – from concerts and festivals to sports and theater – at some of the most iconic venues in the world. Since our founding in 2011, we’ve consistently pushed the industry forward and improved experiences for fans, making it easier than ever to discover events, find the perfect seats, and enjoy unforgettable live entertainment, and we continue to lead the evolution of our industry today.

We’re passionate about improving the fan experience and providing game-changing solutions for our clients, and we’re always looking for smart, motivated people to help make it happen. Bring your enthusiasm, your big ideas, and your desire to team up with some of the best and brightest in technology and entertainment.  

The Role

 

AXS actively seeking a Database Engineer to provide quality, scalable data solutions for AXS products. The candidate will be expected to collaborate to design and then develop, implement, and optimize critical databases, processes and reports to achieve business goals and support the development and data platform teams.

 

Key Responsibilities:

  • Design, implement, and maintain relational and NoSQL databases (Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, Aurora, MongoDB, etc.).
  • Integrate database deployments into CI/CD pipelines to enable automated schema migrations, rollback, and testing.
  • Develop and manage infrastructure as code (IaC) for database provisioning (Terraform, CloudFormation, Ansible).
  • Implement monitoring, alerting, and logging solutions to ensure database performance, health, and security.
  • Optimize database queries, indexes, and execution plans to improve performance and reduce costs.
  • Manage high availability, replication, backup, and disaster recovery strategies.
  • Collaborate with developers, SREs, and DevOps engineers to ensure smooth and secure application-to-database integration.
  • Enforce security best practices, including encryption, key management (AWS KMS/CMK), access control, and compliance with data regulations.
  • Automate routine operational tasks to improve efficiency and reduce manual intervention.
  • Troubleshoot complex production issues and drive root cause analysis.
 

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience).
  • 5+ years of experience as a Database Engineer / DBA with at least 3+ years in a DevOps/Cloud environment.
  • Proficiency with PostgreSQL, Oracle, SQL Server,  Aurora (at least one deeply, others working knowledge).
  • Experience with CI/CD tools (Liqbase,  GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, etc.).
  • Hands-on experience with IaC (Terraform, CloudFormation).
  • Expertise in cloud platforms (AWS preferred, Azure/GCP a plus).
  • Solid understanding of database security, encryption, and auditing.
  • Solid understand on Kafka cluster. 
  • Strong troubleshooting and performance tuning skills

 

 

Pay Scale: $100,000-$120,000

Bonus: This position is eligible for a bonus under the current bonus plan requirements. 

Benefits: Full-time: We offer a comprehensive benefits package that includes: medical, dental and vision insurance, paid holidays, vacation and sick time, company paid basic life insurance, voluntary life insurance, parental leave, 401k Plan (with a current employer match of 3%), flexible spending and health savings account options, and wellness offerings. Currently, full time employees are eligible for these benefits on the first day of employment.

 

 

*Employer does not offer work visa sponsorship for this position.

*There will be an in-person onsite component as part of our interview process.

 

 

What’s in it for You?

  • Extraordinary People – we’re not kidding!
  • Meaningful Mission– Helping revolutionize an industry and deliver better experiences for fans and clients around the world.
  • Development and Learning – Opportunities for learning and leveling up through training and education reimbursement.
  • Community & Belonging – A range of Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) that foster connection, inclusion, and professional growth. Access to meaningful volunteer opportunities and community engagement programs to make a positive impact beyond the workplace.

 

More about AXS

 

AXS, a subsidiary of AEG, sells millions of tickets each year for 1600+ premier venues, sports teams, and event organizers across North America, Europe, Asia, Australia and New Zealand. Headquartered in Downtown Los Angeles, California, AXS employs more than 900 professionals in multiple locations worldwide. In each location you’ll find a team of dedicated, diverse employees (we’ve dubbed ourselves “Fanatix”) who create groundbreaking products and services in a fun, fast-paced environment. 

To learn more about our culture and values, visit: https://solutions.axs.com/careers/

For more than 20 years, AEG has played a pivotal role in transforming sports and live entertainment. Annually, we host more than 160 million guests, promote more than 10,000 shows and present more than 22,000 events around the world. We are committed to innovation, artistry, and community, and leverage the power of our 300+ venues, leading sports franchises, marquee music brands, integrated entertainment districts, premier ticketing platform and global sponsorship activations, to create memorable moments that give the world reason to cheer.

Our business is interwoven with the human mind and heart, and we strive to build a diverse and inclusive company that reflects the artists, athletes, and fans that we host; reach beyond traditional boundaries to support the communities in which we operate; and minimize our impact on the environment by adopting sustainable practices throughout our business operations.

THE JOB

We are seeking a Sustainability Analyst to be a core contributor to Live Nation’s sustainability programs. This role delivers high-quality, accurate sustainability data that informs our strategy, supports audits, and gives the business insights help manage costs, reduce risk, and make informed operational decisions. The analyst manages recurring reporting cycles, works proactively with teams across our global markets, and helps improve how we collect and use data. The ideal candidate combines strong analytical skills with initiative, clear communication, and a passion for sustainability.

 

 

WHAT THIS ROLE WILL DO

 

Data Management and Quality Assurance – 35%

  • Collect, organize, and maintain environmental, operational, and financial data (e.g. energy, waste, and water usage, utility costs and invoices, venue and event activity) from multiple sources.
  • Conduct quality checks to ensure data integrity and accuracy, including reconciling usage data against invoices and financial records.
  • Support the audit process by preparing data summaries, responding to auditor requests, and maintaining documentation.

Analytics and Reporting – 25%

  • Develop and manage Tableau dashboards for internal and external stakeholders.
  • Analyze trends in usage, cost, and operational performance to identify savings opportunities and areas for improvement.
  • Assist in preparing presentations, reports, and sustainability communications, translating data into clear takeaways for non-technical audiences.

Project Management – 15%

  • Manage timelines and deliverables for recurring data cycles, including annual reporting, audit, and regional data collection.
  • Coordinate inputs across regional contacts, venues, and internal teams, tracking progress and following up to keep work on schedule.
  • Lead improvement projects from scoping through rollout, such as onboarding new data sources or launching new dashboards.

Stakeholder Engagement – 15%

  • Proactively engage stakeholders (operations, sustainability, finance, and regional teams) on a regular basis to understand their business needs and to confirm that our data, dashboards, and reporting are delivering against them.
  • Serve as a point of contact for regional teams on data requests, guidance, and troubleshooting.
  • Actively participate in team and cross-functional meetings, contributing ideas, sharing updates, and raising issues early.

Process Improvement – 10%

  • Maintain and continuously improve Live Nation's sustainability data platform and data management systems.
  • Partner with internal finance and fintech teams to streamline data workflows, enhance automation, and improve integration between financial, operational, and environmental data.

 

WHAT THIS PERSON WILL BRING

 

  • Demonstrated experience managing, analyzing, and quality-checking data from multiple sources, with strong attention to detail.
  • Ability to read and interpret utility invoices (electricity, gas, water, waste), including usage, units, rates, and billing periods.
  • Working knowledge of greenhouse gas accounting, including Scope 1, 2, and 3 emissions, emission factors, and unit conversions.
  • Proficiency in Excel (lookups, pivot tables, data cleaning, reconciliation) and proficiency in Tableau or a similar data visualization tool.
  • Experience improving data processes, such as standardizing collection templates, streamlining workflows, or supporting automation.
  • Proven ability to manage projects and competing deadlines.
  • A proactive approach to working with stakeholders: comfortable reaching out, asking questions, and contributing in meetings.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including explaining data to non-technical audiences.
  • Ability to work cross-functionally in a creative, fast-paced, global environment.
  • Preferred: Familiarity with environmental reporting standards and frameworks (e.g. GHG Protocol, CDP, CSRD), and experience supporting a third-party audit or assurance process.

SD Concerts is seeking an experienced and highly motivated Human Resources Manager to lead the day-to-day Human Resources function for the company in Santo Domingo, Dominican Republic.

The Human Resources Manager will serve as a trusted partner to SD Concerts leadership and employees, with responsibility for the full employee lifecycle and the effective delivery of HR programs and practices across the organization. job.description:
Who we are:

Burson, part of WPP, is the global communications leader built to create value for clients through reputation. With highly specialized teams, industry-leading technologies and breakthrough creative, we help brands and businesses redefine reputation as a competitive advantage so they can lead today and into the future. When you work at Burson, you are part of a global community of lifelong learners who thrive at the edge of innovation.

WPP (LSE/NYSE: WPP) is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com 

For more information visit bursonglobal.com and follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

More about the role:

Burson, is looking to hire an Acoount Director to join our Brands, Sports & Entertainment client servicing team for Gurugram location. As an Account Director at Burson, you are responsible for playing a greater role in managing and leading teams with revenue targets, contributing to the company’s performance by managing client relationships and integrated communication (IC) programs, satisfying, and delighting clients, generating new business, and developing strong teams. You are required to support our corporate strategy and your practice or office to help ensure superior client service, a winning culture and profitability.

The Brands, Sports & Entertainment practice comprises a team of specialised communications professionals that delivers integrated campaigns across FMCG, Lifestyle and luxury brands, Hospitality, F&B, Retail, Entertainment & Sports, the team builds brands that enhance reputation, create culture and influence consumer behavior.

 

What you'll do:

Client Service:

  • Oversee a significant portfolio of clients and demonstrate the ability to profitably grow clients and build long term relationships.
  • Be a knowledge leader and trusted advisor for clients and their go-to source for insights critical to their business; understand the trends and issues that impact brands, including media, business, political and cultural.
  • Provide strategic counsel to clients and resolve major concerns in order to achieve outstanding results with a long-term perspective.
  • Manage and motivate account teams to deliver superior client service and creative groundbreaking plans and concepts by ensuring they are equipped with the right resources, tools, and training.
  • Timely Decision Making – The ability to identify a problem and find solutions. Makes decisions in a timely manner, using available information and under tight deadlines.
  • Own high-level media relationships that result in strategic media outcomes.
  • Be a source of creative ideas and effectively use Burson’s proprietary tools Creative Studio, BAV, Decipher and other businesses under the Burson umbrella (i.e. PSB, Axicom, etc.) to build brands and nail client objective.
  • Partner with the digital team and other network resources at the beginning of an engagement to ensure a truly organic and cohesive digital strategy.
  • AI Integration: Champion the strategic use of Generative AI tools across all communication programs to enhance planning, ideation, content creation, and operational efficiency.
  • Stay updated on social media trends and build relationships with key influencers and community contacts to optimize channels.

Business Development:

  • Proactively identify opportunities for organic growth with existing clients and keep up with client and market changes that could lead to new business opportunities.
  • Lead our new business development process by actively developing business contacts through professional activities and network with professional contacts as a means of exchanging ideas and opening new client opportunities.
  • Introduce existing clients to Burson offices in other geographies to contribute to the regional/global growth of the company.

Talent Management:

  • Coach, mentor, and delegate responsibilities to junior staff; support team members and managers who want to expand their roles and responsibilities.
  • Foster teamwork and build morale and motivation within account teams ensuring that good performance and efforts are recognized.
  • Create an inclusive and welcoming environment that engage all individuals without bias and demonstrate flexibility in a changing work environment.
  • Take an active interest in the career development of team members and help them identify development needs, acquire new skills, and grow within the organization.
  • Provide continuous constructive feedback- not just during performance reviews- to develop the next generation of client leaders.
  • Play a leading role in learning and development programs and staff retention initiatives; conduct training programs and continually look for ways to engage top performers through career and learning opportunities so they remain engaged with the company for the foreseeable future.

Financial Management:

  • Play a significant role in managing revenue targets.
  • Act as a conduit between finance and the client servicing team to ensure that accounts are profitably managed; understand the reason for over and under servicing.
  • Follow agency procedures for client budgets, budget tracking, contract approval and billing rates. • Prepare and manage annual budgets and forecast of projected income.
  • Understand client contracts and take responsibility to draw up detailed scopes of work.
  • Play an active role in developing business plans to increase market share and profits.
  • Create and execute a practice plan that supports our corporate strategic plan.

 

Experience that contributes to success:

  • Postgraduate degree in any discipline, or a professional qualification in public relations or marketing communications.
  • 8–10 years of experience in media relations, content management, and strategic communications, with extensive experience managing diverse clients across FMCG, Food & Beverage, Lifestyle, Hospitality, Travel, and other sectors.
  • You must possess a strong familiarity with how Generative AI tools are used across communications programmes, especially in planning, research, ideation, content creation, and daily operations to drive relevance and efficiency.
  • Strong track record of driving agency growth through new business development, identifying opportunities, and leading end-to-end proposal and pitch processes.

You belong at Burson:

Our vision is for Burson to be the leading ‘academy company’ for creative communications professionals and emerging leaders. We provide a dynamic environment where ambitious colleagues come to elevate their skills, expand their networks, and ultimately, produce the best solutions for today’s leading brands. Our commitment to your growth is reflected in our robust benefits and people programs, which include professional development opportunities, mentorship programs with industry leaders, a vibrant and inclusive company culture fostering collaboration and innovation and packages designed to reward and retain top talent. We invest in our people because we believe their success is our success.

At Burson, we’re an agency of learn-it-alls. We recognize that the things we do best, creativity and communications, require a level of nuanced understanding. That’s why it’s imperative for us to hire extraordinarily talented people of all backgrounds and identities. Without that we can’t do the essential work of inspiring bold ideas, fostering constructive dialogue, cultivating meaningful experiences, and driving innovation and creativity for our partners. Your unique point of view—your talent—is what makes you a #BursonPerson, and it’s how we deliver exceptional results for our clients, together.

We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.

Qui sommes-nous:

Burson, leader mondial de la communication, a pour mission de créer de la valeur pour ses clients par la gestion de leur réputation. Grâce à notre expertise, nos technologies de pointe, nos solutions d'intelligence artificielle et notre créativité, nous anticipons les risques en temps réel, identifions les insights générateurs de préférence et d'engagement, et accompagnons la transformation et la réussite de nos clients. Nous réinventons la réputation pour en faire un véritable atout concurrentiel. Burson est le gardien de votre réputation, le partenaire qui vous guide dans un environnement complexe.

En rejoignant Burson, vous intégrez une communauté mondiale d'experts à la pointe de l'innovation.

Burson fait partie du groupe WPP (LSE/NYSE : WPP), spécialiste de la transformation créative. Pour en savoir plus, rendez-vous sur bursonglobal.com et suivez-nous sur LinkedIn et Instagram.

En savoir plus sur le rôle:

En tant que Directeur / Directrice de clientèle Influence & Social Media, vous pilotez la relation client-agence et êtes le manager quotidien d'équipes pluridisciplinaires. À l'écoute des objectifs et priorités de vos clients, vous identifiez leurs besoins et définissez les plans d'action stratégiques correspondants.

Vos missions détaillées

  1. Stratégie et relation client :
  • Stratégie & Déploiement : Concevoir, piloter et exécuter les stratégies de campagnes d'Influence et de Social Media.
  • Conseil stratégique : Apporter un conseil proactif et structuré aux clients sur leurs enjeux de réputation digitale.
  • Rédaction & Contenus : Rédiger des recommandations stratégiques, plans annuels, pitchs, recommandations d'influenceurs, briefs créatifs, éléments de langage/Q&A, etc.
  • Relations Médias & Influence : Mener et orienter les actions de partenariat, de portage et d'engagement auprès des créateurs de contenu, influenceurs clés, médias et leaders d'opinion.
  • Gestion des opportunités et risques : Identifier proactivement les opportunités de développement de compte ainsi que les risques potentiels, et réagir avec rapidité et pertinence.
  • Data & Insights : Exploiter les données, analytics social media et insights d'audience pour optimiser la performance des campagnes et étayer vos recommandations.
  1. Développement et pilotage commercial :
  • Performance financière : Assurer le suivi des indicateurs financiers (rentabilité, marge, suivi budgétaire, gestion des dépassements d'honoraires et encours) de vos dossiers
  • Développement commercial : Détecter les opportunités de croissance chez les clients existants et participer activement à l'élaboration de propositions commerciales pour de nouveaux prospects.
  • Pilotage budgétaire : Élaborer et gérer avec précision des budgets de campagnes complexes (honoraires, budgets d'influence, production).
  • Présentation : Démontrer une excellente aisance à l'oral pour présenter et valoriser l'ensemble des expertises et services de l'agence.

Profil recherché : Ce dont vous avez besoin pour réussir

  • Expérience : 6 à 8 ans d'expérience en agence PR / Influence / Social Media.
  • Expertise métier : Maîtrise approfondie des écosystèmes d'influence, des réseaux sociaux, des relations publics et des stratégies de contenu. Vous appréciez tout autant les sujets corporate que les lancements de produits.
  • Expertise sectorielle : la connaissance du secteur de la santé est un plus.
  • Relation client : Capacités relationnelles et de gestion de compte
  • Compétences analytiques & financières
  • Leadership : Capacités d'écoute, d'encadrement et de transmission.

Ce Que Nous Vous Offrons :

  1. Un environnement stimulant : Intégrez une agence reconnue mondialement, au cœur des stratégies de communication des plus grandes marques.

  2. Un encadrement de qualité : Vous serez accompagné(e) par des experts passionnés qui vous transmettront leur savoir-faire, avec des points réguliers et un feedback constructif pour vous aider à progresser.

  3. Une expérience professionnalisante : Développez des compétences clés et construisez une carrière solide dans un secteur en constante évolution.

  4. Une culture d’entreprise forte : Rejoignez une équipe dynamique et collaborative.

  5. Des avantages attractifs :

  • Télétravail possible (2 jours/semaine).

  • Forfait mobilité mensuel de 45,40 euros (carte Swile) pour transports publics ou mobilités durables.

  • Accès à nos deux restaurants d’entreprise du Campus.

  • 14 jours de RTT par an

  • Accès aux avantages du Comité d’Entreprise (cinéma, chèques cadeaux, remboursements sportifs…).

Votre place est chez Burson :

Notre vision est de faire de Burson la référence en matière de formation pour les professionnels de la communication créative et les leaders de demain. Nous offrons un environnement de travail stimulant où les collaborateurs motivés et ambitieux peuvent développer leurs compétences, étendre leur réseau et élaborer des stratégies innovantes pour les plus grandes marques. Notre engagement envers le développement de nos talents se traduit par des opportunités de formation, des programmes de mentorat avec des leaders du secteur, et une culture d'entreprise stimulante et inclusive qui encourage la collaboration et l'innovation. Nous avons également mis en place des programmes de reconnaissance et de fidélisation pour nos meilleurs talents. Nous investissons dans nos collaborateurs car nous sommes convaincus que leur réussite est aussi la nôtre.

Chez Burson, nous sommes une agence d'apprenants permanents. Nous savons que l'excellence en créativité et en communication exige une compréhension fine et nuancée. C'est pourquoi nous recherchons des collaborateurs talentueux de tous horizons et de toutes cultures. Ces talents sont essentiels pour concevoir des idées audacieuses, favoriser un dialogue constructif, créer des expériences enrichissantes et stimuler l'innovation pour nos clients. Profile Summary:

The Corporate Brand & Technology Director is a strategic, entrepreneurial, and bilingual (Spanish/English) leader in corporate communications, public relations, and reputation management at Burson. This position serves as the primary driver of the client-agency relationship for the firm's largest accounts, spanning strategic communications, PR, digital communications, and influencer marketing across the consumer, technology, and innovation sectors.
The role is responsible for developing integrated strategies based on the PESO model, leading multidisciplinary teams, managing the financial health and profitability of assigned accounts, and providing high-level consultative counsel (C-Suite Counsel) to leaders in the technology, consumer, and corporate brand sectors. The ability to leverage insights, data analytics, and Artificial Intelligence tools to strengthen Data Storytelling is also considered a desirable advantage that brings differentiated value to the position.

Key Responsibilities:

A. Strategic, Business, and Account Management Capabilities

  • Senior consulting and C-Suite counsel: Develop the strategy, design, and execution of annual public relations and strategic communications programs. Serve as the day-to-day strategic partner to C-level executives, providing thoughtful, high-impact counsel aligned with their business priorities.
  • Client-agency relationship leadership: Guide agency teams toward sustained account success. Proactively anticipate both stated and unstated client needs, identify communication gaps, assess reputational risks, and implement immediate action plans.
  • Business development and intrapreneurship: Apply a growth mindset by proactively identifying expansion opportunities within existing client relationships and leading the development and presentation of creative, strategic proposals to win new business.
  • Financial accountability and profitability: Develop and manage budgets with a high degree of accuracy. Support the tracking of key financial indicators, manage profit margins, prevent over-servicing, and address budget variances or issues in a timely manner.
  • Inspirational leadership and mentorship: Lead, motivate, and develop agency talent. Inspire high performance through strengths-based feedback, ongoing coaching, active listening, and the promotion of a diverse and inclusive culture.

B. Corporate Brand, Consumer, Digital, Influencer Marketing, and Technology & Innovation Strategy

  • Corporate, consumer, and brand strategy: Design and implement multichannel communication strategies focused on building and protecting corporate reputation, while positioning consumer brands through compelling, high-value narratives.
  • Digital, social media, and influencer marketing strategy: Guide the integration of cross-channel digital campaigns and ensure a consistent brand presence across social media and digital platforms. Lead influencer, content creator, and digital opinion leader strategy and management, overseeing the full process from strategic selection through measurement of partnership impact.
  • Technology ecosystem expertise: Bring a strong understanding of technology business models (B2B, B2C, B2B2C) and key trends such as Generative Artificial Intelligence (GenAI), Cloud Computing, Cybersecurity, SaaS, and Digital Transformation. Distill highly technical concepts into clear, engaging, and persuasive narratives for mainstream media, consumer audiences, investors, and key spokespeople.
  • Launches, annual plans, and the PESO model: Design and implement strategic communication plans, executive positioning programs (Thought Leadership), and launch campaigns for technology innovation and consumer products and services, integrating paid (Paid), earned (Earned), shared (Social), and owned (Owned) channels.
  • Media relations and reputation crisis management: Lead positioning and relationship-building with journalists, editors, and key local, national, and international media across consumer, business, lifestyle, and technology sectors. Provide decisive, strategic leadership during crises, contingencies, or reputational risks affecting clients in the technology and corporate sectors.

C. Preferred Data & Intelligence Capabilities (Valued but Not Required)

  • Data-informed counsel: Preferred ability to use data, metrics, and competitive analysis to inform strategic decision-making and strengthen campaign narratives.
  • Analytics and monitoring tools: Preferred familiarity or experience with social monitoring and listening platforms (Brandwatch, Meltwater, Talkwalker) and data visualization/dashboard tools (Power BI).
  • Artificial intelligence applications: Preferred understanding of the strategic use of generative AI tools and cognitive platforms to optimize communications workflows and landscape analysis.
  • Visualization and insights: Ability to translate complex communications data and metrics into clear, visual presentations that demonstrate return on investment (ROI) for the client.

Profile Requirements:

  • Professional experience: A minimum of 12 years of experience in public relations, communications agencies, or corporate communications functions, managing Corporate Brand, Consumer, Digital Strategy, and/or Technology & Innovation accounts.
  • Team leadership: At least 5 years of direct experience managing, developing, and mentoring multidisciplinary teams.
  • Languages: Full professional proficiency in Spanish and English (C1/C2 spoken and written), with a demonstrated ability to engage effectively with clients, executives, and global networks.
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree or equivalent university qualification in Communications, Public Relations, Journalism, Marketing, or a related field.
  • Preferred studies/certifications: Courses or certifications in Digital Strategy, Influencer Marketing, Analytics, Data Storytelling, or AI-powered productivity tools.
  • Core interpersonal skills: Exceptional client relationship management, strategic thinking, analytical problem-solving, inspirational leadership, resilience, and adaptability in dynamic environments.

This is an exceptional opportunity for a senior industry leader and growth driver to build and lead Burson's UK Influence & Social Centre of Excellence - the central hub for our EMEA region and one of three global hubs alongside the US and Singapore. Sitting on the UK Strategic Leadership Group, you will execute our regional and global strategy to realise ambitious commercial growth over the next three years.

In this role, you will hold P&L accountability for the capability, shape our go-to-market Total Influence proposition across all practices, advise senior clients, and lead high-profile integrated pitches. Working within a multi-disciplinary ecosystem (creative, strategy, data, and intelligence), you will put in place the operating model, toolsets, and measurement frameworks that enable the UK market to deliver client work disruptively, consistently, compliantly, and at scale.

Reporting to the UK CEO with a matrix link to the EMEA Head of Influence & Social, you will partner closely with practice leaders and WPP network counterparts across three core pillars:

  • Commercialise & Grow (establishing the UK Centre of Excellence, high-priority new business, thought leadership, award-winning creative output)
  • Enable & Operationalise (total Influence model rollout, practice upskilling, platform partnerships, AI & tech stack integration)
  • Transform & Innovate (WPP network integration, sector-tailored offers, modernised measurement, market horizon scanning)

What you'll do:

  • Build and lead the UK Influence & Social Centre of Excellence - our EMEA hub - developing the operational plan, strategy, and team structure to drive 3-year growth ambitions.
  • Lead high-priority new business pitches and organic growth opportunities across UK practices and EMEA markets, establishing Burson's Total Influence proposition in the market.
  • Drive agency elevation and thought leadership, curating best-in-class social and influencer campaigns, marketing assets, and credentials to showcase industry-leading creative output.
  • Implement the Total Influence operating model across the UK, capturing feedback, tracking adoption, and continuously refining cross-practice delivery workflows.
  • Upskill practice teams on cultural trends, influencer strategies, and AI capabilities, leveraging both Burson's proprietary AI suite and WPP Open tools.
  • Manage strategic relationships with key social platforms (TikTok, Meta) and core tech stack partners (CreatorIQ) to keep Burson ahead of emerging feature developments.
  • Collaborate with sector leads (Healthcare, Corporate, Brand, Tech, Sports) to create tailored Total Influence offers that unlock growth across all client practices.
  • Transform influencer measurement and strategy in partnership with Insights & Intelligence, leveraging WPP network opportunities and horizon scanning to capture unique whitespace.

Experience that contributes to success:

  • Proven senior leadership in an influence and social role within a major agency or enterprise, with a track record of driving significant revenue growth and breakthrough creative work.
  • Deep expertise in influencer marketing strategy, platform dynamics (TikTok, Meta, CreatorIQ), cultural trends, and UK regulatory compliance.
  • Strong commercial mindset with a history of leading and winning high-priority new business pitches, expanding organic accounts, and articulating commercial value to clients.
  • Demonstrated capability building and inspiring high-performing teams, establishing scalable operating models, clear workflows, and a culture of accountability.
  • Strategic platform & tech savvy, including hands-on experience integrating AI tools, creator platforms, CRM strategies, and modernised measurement frameworks.
  • Exceptional cross-practice collaboration, with experience partnering across multidisciplinary teams (creative, strategy, data) and C-suite stakeholders.
  • Strong executive presence and client advisory skills, with the ability to build trusted C-suite relationships and guide clients through complex social transformation.
  • Network & stakeholder management experience within large agency networks (e.g., WPP), leveraging cross-border opportunities and regional hub dynamics.

More about the role:

The team is looking to recruit an Account Manager to work across a portfolio of leading global technology clients, spanning industry heavyweights and innovators such as Adobe, Qualcomm, Dell Technologies, Canon, and other brands operating at the intersection of technology, creativity, entertainment, devices, and everyday consumer experiences. 

The role involves taking on a trusted, consultative position for key client contacts, leading the execution of integrated communication strategies, and driving daily account operations across consumer technology launches, product storytelling, media and influencer engagement, reviews programmes, events, and always-on reputation-building activity.

What you'll do:

  • Client Relationship Management: Serving as the primary day-to-day contact for mid-level clients, leading regular status touchpoints, ensuring proactive upward communication, and anticipating client needs. 
  • Technology Storytelling: Distilling complex technologies, products, platforms, propositions, and launches into sharp narratives tailored for business, trade, vertical, national, consumer technology, lifestyle, creator, and influencer audiences. 
  • Workstream Ownership: Driving key deliverables and campaign workstreams from inception to completion, ensuring projects are delivered on strategy, on schedule, and to the highest quality standard. 
  • Media, Reviews, Analyst, Creator & Content Creation: Leading daily engagement across business, automotive trade, tech trade, vertical, tier-1, consumer technology, lifestyle, creator, and influencer media. Supporting product reviews and seeding programmes, analyst and stakeholder activity, launch moments, press events, and the development of high-impact materials including press releases, pitches, briefing notes, messaging, Q&As, blog content, and executive thought leadership. 
  • Strategic Planning & Account Growth: Contributing actively planning sessions, product launch strategies, executive visibility programmes, thought leadership campaigns, cultural moments, content proposals, and organic growth opportunities for existing accounts. 
  • Data-Driven Insights: Partnering with intelligence analysts and strategists to evaluate campaign data and deliver actionable insights and recommendations to clients. 

Experience that contributes to success:

  • Automotive PR Experience: Experience supporting automotive communications is required, ideally with a focus on automotive technology, connected vehicles, mobility, in-car innovation, or related technology-driven campaigns. 
  • B2B Technology Experience: Prior experience in B2B technology, enterprise communications, device/product, or integrated technology communications OR a background in another fast-moving technology sector with a keen curiosity and passion to immerse yourself in the technology space. 
  • Technical Curiosity: A fast-learning mindset with the ability to get up to speed quickly on new technologies, product features, device ecosystems, enterprise use cases, market trends, customer behaviours, and the broader innovation themes shaping business and enterprise audiences. 
  • Media, Analyst & Creator Instincts: A proven track record in B2B/trade media relations with an understanding of what makes a strong technology story for automotive trade, business, tech trade, vertical, national, broadcast, online, analyst and influencer audiences. 
  • Independence & Professional Confidence: The self-assurance to advise mid-level clients independently and represent the agency with authority.

Burson is seeking an experienced and talented Sr. Motion & Film Creative to join our dynamic Craft team. In this role, you will work closely with creatives and producers across the wider Creative team in post-production, editing video content, generating motion graphics, and managing edits across a wide variety of clients and brands. 

As a 'go-to' expert for motion and film, you have a keen eye for motion design, a desire to deliver the highest standard of work, and the ability to lead projects creatively, from treatment development and client presentations to reviewing and directing other editors’ work. You will also partner with Creative Operations and Production leads to streamline post-production workflows, manage media platforms, and help push our creative execution into bold, unexpected places.

  • Video Editing & Motion Design: Edit high-quality video content (social assets, brand films, interviews, anthem films, sizzle reels, etc.) and create dynamic animated titles and motion graphics for publication across multiple devices and channels. 
  • End-to-End Creative Involvement: Participate in all stages of the creative process—from interpreting briefs and developing storyboards and treatments to delivering rough cuts and polished final products. 
  • On-Set & Content Capture: Direct on-set and/or capture dynamic content using a run-and-gun shooting style alongside producers or art directors (preferred). 
  • Quality & Spec Standards: Address internal and client edits throughout the approval process, delivering final assets to exact technical specifications. 
  • Post-Production Operations & Asset Management 
  • Process & Workflow Spearheading: Partner with Creative Operations and Production leads to develop robust post-production processes (file structures, spec sheets for editors, taxonomy, and project forecasting). 
  • Media & Lifecycle Management: Oversee project assets from ingest through archiving, maintaining proper file structures allowing for future edits and seamless platform exports. 
  • Platform Ownership: Manage Burson Vimeo and Frame.io accounts, as well as the agency showreel, ensuring content is continuously kept up to date. 
  • Leadership & Creative Consultation 
  • Subject Matter Expertise: Serve as the team’s ‘go-to’ for best practices, strategic consultation, and sense-checking for all things motion and film. 
  • Creative Guidance: Review and direct other editors’ work under the guidance of creative leadership to push work in bold, culturally relevant directions. 
  • Client Presentation: Confidently present creative treatments and motion concepts to clients and internal stakeholders.

  • 6–8+ years of relevant experience in post-production, editing, and motion design in an agency or production environment (a background in film production, media management, or animation is a plus). 
  • Software Mastery: Highly skilled across the entire Adobe Creative Suite, specifically Adobe Premiere Pro and After Effects. Proficient in PowerPoint for developing compelling treatments and storyboards. 
  • Strong Reel/Portfolio: Demonstrates a sophisticated aesthetic, technical excellence, and high-end video editing and motion graphics across social content, commercial work, and brand campaigns. 
  • Social & Digital Savvy: Possesses a strong awareness of current trends across digital media and social channels, with a passion for branded storytelling. 
  • Strategic & Operational Mindset: Ability to organize post-production workflows, manage media lifecycle/archives, and establish spec sheets and taxonomies. 
  • Collaboration & Leadership: A team-first spirit with the confidence to direct other editors, present to clients, and collaborate effectively with producers, art directors, and cross-functional teams. 
  • Agile Problem-Solver: Calm under pressure, highly detail-oriented, and resourceful in fast-paced environments with tight deadlines. 
  • Self-Motivated Learner: Curious, entrepreneurial, and open-minded—always eager to embrace new technologies, tools, and methods of working.

Real Chemistry is looking for a New Business Lead to join our growing team!

Real Chemistry seeks an accomplished and strategically minded Head of New Business to lead the agency’s growth function and drive best-in-class business development for 21GRAMS. In this role, you will establish and refine new business processes, develop a high-performing growth team, and serve as a trusted strategic partner to senior leadership, directly impacting pipeline development, win rates, and revenue growth.

This position is integral to 21GRAMS, part of Real Chemistry, a healthcare advertising and communications firm dedicated to making healthcare more human through innovative, client-centered work conducted with integrity and excellence. You will lead all aspects of new business development, from opportunity identification through pitch execution. You will ensure every team member involved in the pitch process has a seamless, organized experience, fostering collaboration, efficiency and confidence at every stage.

New Business Process Development

  • Establish, refine, and enforce new business processes and standards across the agency
  • Create repeatable frameworks for how opportunities are evaluated, pursued, and executed

Growth Team Leadership

  • Lead and develop a high-performing new business team
  • Ensure every team member involved in the pitch process has a seamless, organized, and collaborative experience

Pipeline Management

  • Identify and qualify new business opportunities 
  • Manage the full pipeline from initial opportunity through close

Pitch Leadership

  • Lead and support pitch efforts across the agency and with Real Chemistry Partners

Strategic Partnership with Senior Leadership

  • Serve as a trusted strategic partner to agency leadership on all growth matters

New Client Onboarding

  • Help own the end-to-end onboarding process for all newly won clients 
  • Ensure day-to-day account teams are fully equipped with the insights, context, and resources needed to service each brand from day one 
  • Bridge the gap between winning the business and delivering exceptional work

  • 12+ years of new business, account management, or project management experience in a healthcare advertising setting
  • Minimum 5+ years in a leadership or supervisory capacity managing high-performing, cross-functional teams in high-pressure environments

  • Strong written and verbal communication with ability to adapt messages for diverse audiences
  • Strategic thinking and sound judgment, with demonstrated ability to solve complex problems, make decisions under uncertainty, and balance competing priorities

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Deep expertise in pharmaceutical advertising and healthcare communications, particularly with experience in oncology, rare disease, specialty pharmaceuticals, or other complex therapeutic areas
  • Demonstrated results from process improvement initiatives with measurable impact on efficiency gains, cost reduction, or quality improvement
  • Client relationship management experience at a senior level, including presenting to pharmaceutical and biotech executives

CORE COMPETENCIES & ATTRIBUTES

Professional Competencies

  • Strategic Business Leadership: Setting vision and direction; aligning operations with business objectives; thinking beyond immediate execution to organizational capability building
  • Process Excellence: Designing, implementing, and continuously improving standardized processes and workflows that scale across new business
  • Stakeholder Management: Building and maintaining effective relationships with executives, clients, cross-functional partners, and team members; navigating competing interests
  • Organizational Development: Building high-performing teams, developing talent, creating culture, and leading organizational change

Required Leadership Attributes

  • Change-Positive, Growth-Oriented

You actively seek smarter, faster, and more effective ways to operate. You are not threatened by AI, innovation, new tools, or new ways of working—you're energized by them. You challenge legacy thinking thoughtfully, experiment with confidence, and view change as an advantage rather than a disruption. You don't defend the status quo because "it works"; you see every process, system, and methodology as a candidate for improvement. You are quick to spot opportunities to expand how we operate collectively and you bring others along on that journey. You stay current with emerging PM tools and methodologies because you're genuinely curious about better ways forward, not because compliance requires it.

  • Commercially and Market Aware

You operate beyond internal agency mechanics and understand the bigger picture. You know your clients' business contexts, therapeutic landscapes, and commercial realities well enough to make informed decisions, ask smarter questions, and connect execution to real-world impact. You don't need to be a medical expert, but you are an industry-savvy operator who understands pharma economics, launch timelines, competitive dynamics, and patient access challenges. You ask "why does this matter commercially?" and "what does success look like for the client?" regularly. This commercial acumen informs how you scope projects, allocate resources, and prioritize decisions. You help your team see beyond deliverables to outcomes.

  • Confident Driver of Progress

You embrace being a driver, not just a facilitator or administrator. You create momentum, push for clarity and decisions when you see ambiguity, hold teams accountable constructively without micromanaging, and move work forward even when information is imperfect or circumstances are complicated. You don't wait for consensus to take action; you make smart calls and bring people along. You recognize that indecision is a decision, and you're willing to take that on. You drive toward clear wins and celebrate progress, which energizes your teams and builds confidence across the organization.

  • Steward of Team Balance and Performance

You actively shape the health of the system, not just the output. You recognize burnout early—in individuals and in teams—and you recalibrate workload, expectations, or resources proactively before people break. You also recognize underperformance with equal clarity and you raise the bar constructively, providing support and accountability. You design operating rhythms, sprint cycles, and governance structures that support both sustainable, high performance and uncompromising standards. You understand that how people feel about their work is as important as what they produce, and that sustainable excellence requires both.

  • Ownership Mindset and Creative Agency

You do not wait for permission to elevate the work. You bring forward ideas on how to operate better, propose smarter ways of organizing projects, design stronger plans, and take responsibility for improving outcomes beyond your assigned scope. You see gaps and fill them. You spot inefficiencies and fix them. You don't assume "that's someone else's problem"—you own the enterprise. This doesn't mean doing everything yourself; it means taking initiative to identify what needs to change and driving toward solutions. Your ownership extends to your team's success, your clients' outcomes, and the health of the broader organization.

  • Strong Judgment and Prioritization Instincts

You consistently make good calls under pressure and constraint. You distinguish signal from noise in a sea of competing demands. You make smart trade-offs between speed, quality, and risk with sound instinct—not by formula. You prioritize effectively, recognizing what matters most and what can wait. You have good instincts about people, situations, and strategic priorities, and you trust those instincts while remaining open to new information. When you have to move fast, you do. When you need to be deliberate, you are. You know the difference, and you rarely get it wrong.

  • Courage and Comfort with Productive Discomfort

You are willing to push when it's uncomfortable and challenge constructively when you see a better path. You hold tension without smoothing it away prematurely; you recognize that some of the best solutions come from sitting with uncomfortable questions rather than resolving them quickly. You make difficult calls when needed—hard conversations, tough decisions, unpopular stands—with confidence rather than approval-seeking. You bring backup (data, reasoning, alternatives) to every discussion. You operate with the confidence of someone who takes responsibility for their decisions and is willing to defend them, but you're also genuinely open to being wrong and course-correcting when new information warrants it.

  • Maintain CI/CD pipelines for ROOM42's primary hosting environments (WP Engine, Pantheon, Acquia, Netlify/Vercel for JAMstack); make deployments repeatable and low-risk 

  • Manage staging, UAT, and production environment configurations; provision and document access for all ROOM42 developers 

  • Identify and implement automation opportunities across the DevOps lifecycle — from scaffolding new projects to post-deploy validation 

 

AI-Augmented Design-to-Code Pipeline: 

  • Operate Figma MCP server integration to accelerate design handoff — extracting tokens, components, and layout specs directly into code-ready outputs; eliminating manual interpretation cycles 

  • Leverage AI code generation tools (GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor AI) as daily build accelerators — not novelties — across front-end, back-end, and configuration work 

  • Define and document ROOM42's AI-augmented build workflows for each deliverable type so the approach scales beyond a single practitioner 

  • Stay ahead of emerging agentic tooling (MCP servers, AI browser agents, generative UI frameworks) and evaluate when adoption creates genuine delivery leverage 

 

QA and Test Automation: 

  • Implement AI-assisted QA automation across ROOM42 project types — visual regression testing, accessibility scanning, cross-browser checks, and functional testing pipelines 

  • Establish a QA automation baseline for repeatable deliverable types (CMS sites, kiosk apps, email builds) so that human QA effort concentrates on edge cases and client-specific requirements 

  • Triage technical defects surfaced by QA — classify root cause, assign or resolve remediation, verify fix integrity before re-advancing to UAT  

Standards, Mentorship, and Team Health: 

  • Define and maintain ROOM42's technical standards across deliverable types — coding conventions, repo structure, accessibility requirements, security baselines, deployment protocols 

  •  Conduct code reviews for all ROOM42 developers before deliverables advance to QA; enforce standards consistently and use reviews as teaching moments 

  • Partner with RC's VP of Technology on standards alignment, tooling strategy, and team architecture as the practice scales 

  • Lead technical onboarding for new ROOM42 hires — tool access, standards orientation, and first-week productivity within two weeks of start date 

  • Serve as primary technical escalation point when blockers threaten delivery; resolve environment, integration, and access issues within 24 hours of identification 

 

Technical Delivery: 

  • Partner with Producers and TDMs on SOW scoping — translate creative and functional requirements into accurate technical estimates for hours, stack decisions, and phased rollout 

  • Own the technical delivery lifecycle for key ROOM42 engagement from kickoff through post-launch, work with technical delivery managers to ensure timeline integrity, milestone readiness, and handoff completeness 

  • Maintain a live view of technical progress across all active projects; proactively flag risks to Delivery Managers before they surface in status calls 

  • Drive milestone gates: work closely with QA lead to ensure that what moves from development to QA to UAT to production is actually ready — not optimistically ready 

  • Manage technical dependencies across concurrent projects (shared environments, overlapping APIs, licensing constraints) and surface conflicts before they collide 

  • Own technical documentation throughout each engagement: architecture decisions, environment setup, API integration specs, deployment runbooks — so no knowledge lives only in one person's head 

  • Participate in client-facing conversations where technical credibility matters — scoping sessions, risk discussions, demo walkthroughs — presenting clearly and without jargon 

 

Quality Outcomes: 

  • Define 'done' for every deliverable type — not just 'it works' but that it is performant, accessible, secure, cross-browser validated, and visually faithful to approved design 

  • Own quality accountability end-to-end: if something ships broken, looks wrong, or fails an MLR technical review, this role is accountable for the root cause and the remediation 

  • Work with QA lead to establish and maintain a ROOM42 quality checklist for each deliverable type — covering functional, visual, performance, accessibility, and security checks — so quality is structural, not ad hoc 

  • Review developer output not only for code correctness but for UX implementation fidelity: does the built experience actually look and behave like the approved design? 

  • Lead post-launch quality reviews on major engagements; document defect patterns and translate them into upstream process improvements 

  • Champion performance as a quality dimension: page load, animation smoothness, kiosk responsiveness, and interactive load times are quality metrics, not afterthoughts 

  • Maintain zero tolerance for preventable defects reaching client UAT — own the internal quality bar so clients aren't the ones finding the obvious problems 

 

Design Eye, UX/UI Partnership, and Creative Collaboration: 

  • Speak UX fluently — understand information architecture, user flows, interaction patterns, and content hierarchy well enough to actively contribute to UX decisions, not just receive them 

  • Evaluate wireframes and prototypes through both a user experience lens and a technical feasibility lens simultaneously: identify where a flow creates friction before it's built, and where a design pattern creates technical debt before it ships 

  • Read a Figma file not just for spec values but for design intent — understand what the designer was solving for and protect that intent through every build decision, especially when specs have gaps or edge cases aren't covered 

  • Catch UX implementation drift before QA does: spot when a multi-step interaction is off-sequence, a loading state is missing, an error condition is unhandled, or a mobile breakpoint breaks the intended user journey 

  • Catch visual implementation drift with the same discipline: notice when padding is off, a typeface is rendering incorrectly, a hover state feels wrong, or a component is pixel-perfect in isolation but contextually broken in the live layout 

  • Participating actively in UX and design reviews as a technical partner — able to say 'that interaction pattern will feel laggy on kiosk hardware' or 'here's how we can get the same UX outcome with a lighter implementation' or 'this flow needs an empty state that the design doesn't account for' 

  • Understand foundational UX/UI principles — user task flow design, progressive disclosure, feedback and affordance, responsive and adaptive layout, motion and timing — well enough to make confident decisions when the design file doesn't cover every scenario 

  • Bridge the gap between design and engineering vocabulary; translate UX intent and creative direction into precise technical implementation notes that developers can execute without ambiguity or interpretation risk 

  • Push back constructively when a UX or design spec is technically infeasible at the required timeline or budget — and always bring an alternative that preserves the experience intent, not just a 'no' 

  • Appreciate that in healthcare and pharma, the human story being told is someone's life — and that the quality of the experience we build, how it feels to use, how clearly it communicates, how gracefully it handles errors, is not separate from the mission 

 

This position is a perfect fit for you if:

What you should have:
