  • Demonstrable full-stack proficiency — not a generalist who dabbles; someone who can build, review, and unblock at every layer 

  • A genuine design eye with UX/UI depth: able to evaluate user flows and interaction patterns for experience quality, read a Figma file for intent, catch UX and visual implementation drift, and make confident decisions at the design-code boundary without designer supervision 

  • Technical delivery experience: has owned milestone tracking, risk communication, and deployment readiness across concurrent projects — not just individual coding output

job.description:
At Real Chemistry, making the world a healthier place isn’t just an aspiration—it’s our everyday reality. Discover your purpose. Embrace innovation. Experience #LifeatRealChem.

AI Business Partner - Activation

Role Overview

The AI Business Partner translates business priorities into practical AI solutions that improve how work gets done. Sitting at the intersection of business strategy, domain expertise, and applied AI, this role identifies high-value opportunities, builds working prototypes and pilots, and partners cross-functionally to scale successful solutions.

This Partner will be aligned to Activation, a portfolio that spans media, social, content, creator/influencer/Starpower, and omnichannel. The work will vary across these areas and will be conducted in partnership with the designated business and discipline leads. Discipline leaders own business strategy, workflow priorities, functional requirements, stakeholder alignment and adoption within their respective capabilities. The Activation AI Business Partner brings applied AI and technical expertise to assess feasibility, prototype solutions, support operationalization and scale validated capabilities across Activation. The right person is comfortable moving between distinct disciplines with different maturity levels, tooling and ways of working, and can sequence where to focus first.

This role is ideal for someone who can move fluidly from ambiguity to action — working with stakeholders to define problems, rapidly testing ideas using modern generative AI tools, and helping the organization adopt AI in ways that are useful, responsible, and aligned with business needs.

Key Responsibilities

AI Opportunity Identification & Prioritization

  • Partner with business and discipline leaders to identify high-value opportunities to apply generative AI across workflows, deliverables, and business processes.
  • Translate business priorities, functional requirements and user needs defined with discipline leaders into clearly scoped AI use cases, pilots, and solution concepts.
  • Assess opportunities based on business value, technical feasibility, user needs, adoption potential, scalability and risk.
  • Partner with discipline leaders  to prioritize opportunities within individual capabilities and help sequence initiatives  across the broader Activation portfolio.
  • Maintain visibility across the Activation AI opportunity pipeline to identify shared needs, reusable components, dependencies and opportunities for cross-discipline scale

 

Prototyping & Solution Development

  • Build and iterate on working prototypes, pilots, and lightweight AI-enabled tools in response to business priorities and functional requirements established with business and discipline leads using modern development environments, LLM APIs, agentic workflows, and related technologies.
  • Design prompts, workflows, and tool interactions that guide AI behavior toward accurate, useful, and contextually relevant outcomes.
  • Test solutions quickly with representative users and discipline subject matter experts, incorporate user feedback, and refine prototypes based on real-world usage and evolving requirements.
  • Move ideas from concept to demonstrable value, balancing speed, practicality, technical feasibility, quality and responsible AI requirements.
  • Provide technical consultation during discovery to help discipline leaders distinguish between workflow, process, data, platform and AI-related needs

 

Cross-Functional Delivery & Scaling

  • Own the technical progression of validated concepts from discovery through prototype, pilot, handoff and scaling, in partnership with the appropriate teams (i.e., platform, data, security, governance teams, etc.)
  • Partner closely with AI technical teams, engineering, product, and business stakeholders to transition validated prototypes into scalable, production-ready solutions where appropriate.
  • Define technical requirements, solution dependencies, integration considerations and implementation paths in partnership with technical specialists.
  • Identify when an opportunity should be addressed through an existing enterprise capability, workflow redesign, vendor solution, configurable agent, lightweight prototype, or production-grade build.
  • Work with business and discipline leads to align on priorities, solution design, success metrics, rollout approach and post-launch ownership.

 

Adoption, Enablement & Change Management

  • Partner with discipline leaders to support successful adoption of AI solutions through solution-specific guidance, training, onboarding materials, and usage playbooks.
  • Communicate AI concepts, capabilities, and limitations in clear, accessible language for non-technical audiences.
  • Equip discipline leaders and subject matter experts with reusable materials they can adapt for role-specific training, change management, and workflow adoption.
  • Capture adoption feedback, usage barriers, and technical issues and translate them into product or solution improvements.
  • Help build AI fluency across the organization by enabling teams to use tools responsibly and effectively in their day-to-day work.
  • Foster a culture of experimentation, continuous learning, and practical innovation.

 

Governance, Quality & Responsible AI

  • Help ensure AI solutions are designed and applied in ways that are responsible, compliant, and appropriate for a regulated healthcare communications environment.
  • Incorporate considerations related to privacy, safety, quality, transparency, and human oversight into solution design and rollout.
  • Partner with relevant stakeholders to align AI use with organizational standards, governance expectations, and evolving best practices.
  • Promote thoughtful experimentation while maintaining appropriate safeguards and quality controls.

 

Domain Expertise Application

  • Apply working knowledge strong understanding of healthcare communications, including advertising, activation, communications, and medical domains, to shape relevant and impactful AI solutions.
  • Apply working knowledge of and demonstrate fluency in paid media, social, and influencer marketing — including the platforms, buying and measurement mechanics, and campaign workflows that drive day-to-day execution.
  • Partner with designated discipline leaders and subject matter experts for deep functional expertise, strategic judgement, workflow validation and quality assessment.
  • Understand how agency Activation teams operate, including campaign cycles, reporting cadences, client and platform dependencies, and where handoffs create friction.
  • Ensure solutions reflect real-world workflows, stakeholder needs, and the nuances of regulated client environments.
  • Translate domain knowledge into practical requirements that improve usability, relevance, and business fit.

 

Qualifications

  • Experience in AI innovation, product, or a related area.
  • Demonstrated experience in media, social, influencer, or adtech — agency-side, platform-side, or in an ad tech product/analytics role. This background is a priority for this position; the technical dynamics of media are difficult to learn quickly on the job.
  • Hands-on experience building, testing, and iterating on generative AI workflows, prototypes, copilots, agents, or similar solutions.
  • Proficiency with LLM APIs, prompting strategies, AI-assisted development environments, and modern tools used to prototype AI-enabled workflows.
  • Strong ability to translate ambiguous business needs into practical, testable AI use cases and solution concepts.
  • Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills, with a proven ability to influence and collaborate effectively across technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Strong problem-solving, prioritization, and execution skills in fast-moving, ambiguous environments.
  • Ability to evaluate solutions through the lens of usefulness, risk, quality, and business impact.

 

Skills and Competencies

  • Paid Media; Social Media; Influencer Marketing; Campaign Operations; Media Measurement & Analytics
  • Agentic Workflows; AI - Artificial Intelligence; Large Language Models (LLMs); Machine Learning
  • Coding; Programming Languages; Software Engineering
  • Product Demonstration; Technical Troubleshooting
  • Implementation Management; Solution Delivery; Solution Design
  • Client Relationship Management; Problem Analysis; Workflow Analysis

 

This position is crucial in driving the execution of AI strategies at Real Chemistry, ensuring that AI initiatives are not only innovative but also practical, effective, and aligned with real-world needs. The chosen candidate will play a pivotal role in enhancing the organization's capabilities and fostering a culture of AI-driven innovation and continuous improvement.

Real Chemistry is seeking an AI Transformation Analyst to help reimagine how our business runs. You will join our transformation team, working alongside ambitious, supportive, and hard-working colleagues who always seek to do things better, faster, and smarter.

As an AI Transformation Analyst, you will play a pivotal role in mapping how work gets done today and designing how it should get done in an AI-enabled future. Starting with our General & Administrative (G&A) functions, including finance, accounting, operations, resource management, marketing, legal, and internal communications, you will document current-state processes and operating models, design future-state alternatives, and help bring them to life across several AI transformation initiatives. You will also build the business case for each opportunity and prioritize initiatives based on the value they deliver. You will look holistically across people, processes, systems, and vendors to determine what should be automated or redesigned and which solution best fits each need, from a reusable AI skill to an end-to-end Copilot Cowork workflow or a coordinated team of AI agents. This position reports to the Vice President, Strategy and Revenue Analytics.

This is a hybrid role, based in any of our US offices—including New York City, Boston, Chicago, Carmel, or San Francisco—or remotely within the US, depending on team and business needs.

What you'll do:

  • Map current-state processes: Lead process discovery with G&A stakeholders across finance, accounting, operations, resource management, marketing, legal, internal communications, and more to document how work gets done today, including handoffs, systems, data flows, vendors, pain points, and the time and cost behind each step.
  • Design future-state operating models: Translate current-state findings into practical future-state designs that rethink roles, responsibilities, governance, and ways of working, rather than simply digitizing today's processes.
  • Identify and prioritize automation opportunities: Assess where AI and automation can eliminate, streamline, or augment manual work, build business cases that size the impact, and shape a prioritized transformation roadmap.
  • Match the right solution to the problem: Determine the right fit for each need, whether a reusable AI skill, a Copilot Cowork workflow, a coordinated swarm of AI agents, an enhancement to an existing system, or a process change with no new technology at all, and partner with technical teams to pilot and scale solutions.
  • Get more from current automations: Inventory and assess the automations and tools already in place, identify gaps and redundancies, and recommend how to extract more value from existing investments.
  • Rethink sourcing and vendors: Analyze what we outsource versus perform in-house, assess vendor fit and cost, and determine where AI enablement means outsourced work should instead be automated or brought in-house.
  • Drive change and adoption: Partner with function leaders to plan and execute transitions, including change management, training, communications, and success measures that make new ways of working stick.
  • Advise leadership: Develop clear, executive-ready materials, including process maps, operating model blueprints, business cases, and roadmaps, and communicate findings and recommendations with clarity and confidence.

 

This position is a perfect fit for you if you:

Delivery

  • Derive insights and create PowerPoint stories from secondary claims data that address client needs/questions, with comfort delivering presentations to internal teams or brand/analytics teams within external organizations

Business Development

The Director also proactively identifies and qualifies leads, supporting teams across the agency to develop, assess, and solution for multiple qualified opportunities at any given time. The Director understands unique client business problems and translates solutions into sales support materials and development of sales-related presentations. Responsibilities include:

  • Identify client opportunities proactively, and work with Managing Principal and sales team to qualify and pursue sales leads
  • Support the Managing Principal and Sales Lead in developing sales materials for identified opportunities
  • Design and develop strategies and methodologies to deliver against client needs, and translate into compelling sales and pitch materials

  • You are highly organized self-starter, able to work independently and under tight deadlines.

What you should have:

  • 10+ years of relevant experience using real-world data to develop and implement cross-functional solutions in large organizations
  • Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree strongly preferred (MBA, MPH, PhD, PharmD, MD, MS, or equivalent) in economics, epidemiology, public health, biostatistics, health services research, business, marketing, communications, or related discipline.

  • Strong project/program leadership experience, including managing teams on complex, multi-workstream engagements and ensuring scientific and editorial quality.
  • Excellent writing, editing, and executive communication skills; ability to craft clear narratives from technical analyses.

At Real Chemistry, making the world a healthier place isn’t just an aspiration—it’s our everyday reality. Discover your purpose. Embrace innovation. Experience #LifeatRealChem.

Director, Technical Product Operations

Role Summary

Real Chemistry is seeking a hands-on Director, Technical Product Operations to own the end-to-end management, operation, and security of our flagship client-facing SaaS products.  These platforms are hosted in Amazon Web Services (AWS), delivered to clients as a commercial product, engineered to be SOC 2 compliant, and increasingly powered by AI-enabled features.

This is a working leadership role — not a purely strategic one. The successful candidate is a technically credible, roll-up-your-sleeves operator who has personally implemented and run a product on AWS infrastructure, and who can lead a team while remaining directly engaged in architecture, deployment, security, and production support. You will be the single point of accountability for platform availability, performance, security posture, and the fully-supported client experience.

What you'll do:

Platform Ownership & AWS Operations

  • Own the full lifecycle of the client-facing SaaS products hosted on AWS — from infrastructure design and deployment through ongoing operation, optimization, and support.
  • Architect, implement, and maintain scalable, resilient AWS environments (compute, storage, networking, databases, backups) with clear separation across development, staging, and production.
  • Lead high-availability and disaster-recovery (HA/DR) design, including backup, failover, and recovery procedures, to meet client and contractual uptime commitments.
  • Manage infrastructure-as-code (e.g., Terraform), CI/CD pipelines, and controlled promotion paths between environments.
  • Own observability — metrics, logging, tracing, and alerting — and drive continuous improvement of platform performance and cost efficiency (FinOps).

Security, Compliance & SOC 2

  • Maintain and continuously mature the platform's security posture, ensuring controls are designed, implemented, evidenced, and audit-ready.
  • Own SOC 2 compliance for the platform — partnering with Information Security and external auditors to sustain Type I and progress toward Type II attestation.
  • Enforce least-privilege identity and access management (AWS IAM), encryption in transit and at rest, secrets management, and tamper-evident audit logging.
  • Coordinate third-party penetration testing, vulnerability management, and remediation within defined risk timelines.
  • Ensure client-facing security, data-handling, and confidentiality requirements are met and clearly documented for client assurance.

AI-Enabled Product Features

  • Support the secure integration and operation of AI/ML and LLM-enabled features within the product, including approved AI providers, usage boundaries, and cost guardrails.
  • Partner with engineering and data teams to productionize AI capabilities with appropriate data classification, DLP, and human-in-the-loop controls where required.

Support, Reliability & Client Experience

  • Ensure the product is fully supported — establishing SLAs, incident response playbooks, on-call coverage, and runbooks for production systems.
  • Serve as senior escalation point for platform incidents, driving rapid resolution and transparent client communication.
  • Own change management, release governance, and post-incident reviews to continuously improve reliability.

Leadership & Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Lead, and mentor the external IT / platform engineering team, setting technical standards and delivery discipline.
  • Partner closely with Information Security, Product, and Client-facing teams to align platform capabilities with commercial and client needs.
  • Communicate platform health, risk, and roadmap clearly to both technical teams and executive / C-suite stakeholders.
  • Manage relationships with key vendors and third parties (AWS and supporting services).

Required Qualifications

  • Hands-on track record — the candidate must be a practitioner who has personally implemented and operated a product on AWS infrastructure, not solely a manager of others who do.
  • Demonstrated experience implementing a product on AWS (compute, networking, databases, IAM, IaC) from build through production operation.
  • 7+ years in IT / platform engineering / cloud operations, including 3+ years operating production workloads in AWS.
  • Prior leadership or people-management experience, ideally leading external IT, DevOps, SRE, or platform engineering functions.
  • Strong working knowledge of SOC 2 (and adjacent frameworks) and the practical implementation of the underlying controls.
  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform), CI/CD pipelines, and cloud security best practices (least-privilege IAM, secrets management, logging/audit).
  • Proven ownership of production reliability — SLAs, incident response, on-call, and HA/DR.
  • Excellent communication skills — equally comfortable with hands-on technical teams and C-suite stakeholders.

 

What you should have:

  • Experience delivering a client-facing / commercial SaaS product (multi-tenant, externally sold).
  • Experience productionizing AI / LLM-enabled features and governing AI usage, data handling, and cost.
  • Familiarity with regulated or enterprise-client environments (HIPAA-adjacent, GDPR, GxP).
  • Experience with containerization/orchestration (ECS/Fargate, EKS), AWS Lambda, and observability tooling.
  • Relevant certifications (AWS Solutions Architect / DevOps / Security, CISSP, CCSP).
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or equivalent practical experience.

 

Pay Range: $200,000-$235,000

  • Engage with every opportunity to establish an awareness of developments, innovations, and trends 
  • Seek opportunities to reflect these in project work and flags ideas to teams

  • You are proactive, driven, and resourceful with strong prioritization skills and a desire to dive into the data.
  • You are highly organised self-starter, able to work independently and under tight deadlines.

  • Experience in medical writing, ideally in an agency setting 
  • Understanding of GPP and ICMJE compliance as it relates to the development of publications 
  • Relevant degree (minimum of Masters, PhD preferred) PhD) in a science subject 
  • Possesses a solid scientific background and able to learn new therapeutic areas quickly and demonstrate this knowledge

  • Demonstrate strong organisational, analytical, and interpersonal communication skills

  • Professional presence, performs with a sense of urgency and with a client service orientation

  • High energy, able to effectively operate in fast-paced, growing and evolving environment

Real Chemistry is looking for a Project Manager to join our growing Medical Affairs team!

Projects may include slide decks, print projects, congress materials, advisory board materials, scientific communications, and smaller digital initiatives. This role serves as a main point of contact across internal and external teams, partnering closely with Account, Scientific/Medical, Editorial, Creative, Studio, Print Production, User Experience, Technology, and Quality Assurance partners to keep work on time, on budget, and aligned to client expectations.

Whether it’s bringing in the right resources at the right time, aligning priorities with the account team, or identifying bottlenecks and proposing solutions early, no two days are the same.

  • Clearly communicate expectations to internal teams and vendors to support the efficient flow of work throughout the agency. 
  • Partner with key agency teams to ensure projects stay on track and agreed-upon milestones are met, including Account, Scientific/Medical, Editorial, Creative, Studio, Print Production, Strategic Planning, Information UX, Technology, and Programming teams.

  • Help create service or departmental standard operating procedures 
  • Route deliverables to appropriate core team members for review and signoff via the electronic project routing system.

  • Coordinate project deliverables from concept through delivery, ensuring the appropriate internal departments, reviews, approvals, and handoffs are engaged at each stage.

Real Chemistry is looking for an experienced Senior Analyst (Omnichannel Analytics) to help us build and scale our business intelligence practice for our media and omnichannel clients through advanced analytics, insights, and attribution modeling. We are looking for someone with hands-on-keyboard experience crafting analyses that answer clients’ key business questions about media performance. Reporting to the Director, Beyond Insights, this position will be client facing, with the opportunity to speak to ongoing deliverables and work with cross-functional media, strategy, and technology teams. You will get to use a new set of data partners to seamlessly integrate media and channel data flowing from partners into Tableau dashboards and ultimately client-facing performance reports.

Primary Responsibilities 

  • Build, manage, and deliver time-based performance reporting for media and omnichannel campaigns (weekly, monthly, quarterly, and annual reporting) 
  • Integrate media, channel, and partner data sources into Tableau dashboards and client-facing performance reports 
  • Conduct data exploration, cleaning, analysis, visualization, and mining across structured media and marketing data sources 
  • Develop quantitative analyses, predictive models, and attribution approaches that explain how media programs are performing and where to optimize 
  • Craft analyses and insights that answer clients’ key business questions, and present findings directly to client and internal stakeholders 
  • Partner with media, strategy, data engineering, and marketing technology teams on measurement methodology and campaign execution 

Qualifications 

  • Bachelor’s or advanced degree in Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, Business, Finance, Economics, Marketing, or a related field 
  • 5+ years of experience in business intelligence/advanced analytics/data analytics working closely with data 
  • Pharmaceutical media and marketing experience, with hands-on exposure to HCP and/or consumer omnichannel campaigns 
  • Experience with statistical and general-purpose programming languages for data analysis, including the development of algorithms leveraging SQL, R or Python 
  • Experience working with relational databases and with Snowflake or Databricks 
  • Experience with visualization tools/packages such as Tableau or PowerBI, and with creating dashboards 
  • Experience with reporting in media tools like Google Campaign Manager, Doubleclick Campaign Manager and Adobe Experience Manager 
  • Experience building reports in Google Slides or Microsoft PowerPoint for presentations to senior clients externally or to senior internal stakeholders 
  • Formal training/education in quantitative/data analysis, and an understanding of causal inference 
  • Understanding of visual information design principles 
  • Knowledge of agile principles/project management and experience with agile tools and methodologies 

The Ideal Candidate 

  • Creative. You are energized by turning messy, multi-source media data into clear answers to real business questions. You love asking questions and pushing hard to find answers 
  • Customer first. You enjoy client-facing work and can explain your analysis and its implications to a non-technical audience 
  • A collaborator. You thrive in cross-functional teams and are comfortable working across Media, Analytics, Strategy, and Technology partners 
  • A culture carrier. You embody Real Chemistry’s values of Best Together, Impact Obsessed, Excellence Expected, Evolve Always, and Accountability with an “I.”

Job Summary:  

Real Chemistry is looking for a Senior Manager, Integrated Intelligence join our growing team!   

Real Chemistry Analytics enables smarter decision-making through the power of data, advanced analytics, artificial intelligence, and actionable insights. Our teams help clients understand audience behavior, measure performance, uncover growth opportunities, and optimize business outcomes across the healthcare ecosystem. By combining healthcare expertise with data science, measurement, and strategic consulting, we help clients transform complex information into meaningful actions that drive impact for brands, healthcare professionals, and patients.  

In this role, you will help turn data from a range of sources into meaningful insights and clear, strategic narratives from both quantitative and qualitative data. You will work in partnership with senior leads and cross-functional teams to deliver standard and custom analyses across integrated communications and business questions.  

Curiosity and a willingness to think outside the box are a must, as we are often tasked with answering age-old communications and marketing questions in a new way. 

This role can be remote within the United States or based in any of our U.S. office locations, including New York City, Boston, Chicago, Lambertville, NJ, San Francisco, or Carmel, IN.  

Who you are:   

  • You have a passion for telling stories fueled by data and insights   
  • You’re innovative and want to bring value and new ideas to everything you do   
  • You have a moderate understanding of (or willingness to learn) the healthcare/pharmaceutical space   
  • You thrive in an environment that requires constant learning and adaptation   
  • You are reliable, organized, and conscientious  
  • You work well independently, but also enjoy collaborative work assignments   
  • You get the importance of staying on top of the details and believe in exceeding expectations   

What you’ll do:  

  • Manage and support day-to-day analytics and intelligence workstreams across client accounts, remaining actively involved in the research, data analysis, and development of deliverables. 
  • Assist in the development of integrated analyses that connect multiple data sources and translate findings into clear insights, implications, strategic recommendations, and cohesive narratives. 
  • Conduct quantitative and qualitative analysis across social, digital, search, media, audience, competitive, and customer data to uncover meaningful trends and opportunities. 
  • Build and refine keyword-based queries, Boolean searches, data pulls, and analytical frameworks, while guiding junior team members in their development and application. 
  • Aggregate, clean, organize, interpret, and quality-check data, particularly for complex, ambiguous, or high-priority assignments. 
  • Help synthesize research into clear strategic narratives that guide client communications and engagement strategies. 
  • Manage and contribute directly to recurring and ad hoc reporting, as well as audience, influencer, competitive, landscape, and measurement assessments. 
  • Contribute to KPI frameworks, success metrics, benchmarks, and measurement plans. 
  • Partner with account, strategy, activation, data visualization, and data science teams to deliver integrated solutions, and present findings and recommendations to internal and external audiences. 
  • Aid in the management of project timelines, deliverable expectations, and day-to-day coordination while reviewing work, coaching junior team members, and stepping into the details when needed. 
  • Contribute to methodology development, process improvements, proprietary tools, new-business efforts, and capability-building initiatives across the Integrated Intelligence team. 

What you’ll bring:   

  • 4+ years of experience in one or more of the following areas: marketing analytics, communications analytics, social listening, digital analytics, audience research, strategic planning, search analytics, primary or syndicated research, or healthcare/pharmaceutical marketing. Agency experience strongly preferred, given the specific client mix for this role. 
  • Deep understanding and experience with social media listening, including comfort working with data across social platforms and familiarity with platforms such as Brandwatch, Quid, Meltwater or Muck Rack.  
  • Familiarity with cross-channel measurement reporting and analytics, including KPI tracking, performance benchmarks, audience engagement, digital behavior, and communications outcomes. 
  • Project management experience, including handling timelines and expectations for multiple deliverables. 
  • Experience developing reporting deliverables, landscape analyses, performance readouts, or insight-driven presentations.  
  • Experience with multi-modal research approaches, using novel data sets and triangulating across methodologies to deliver impact. 
  • A passion for telling stories motivated by data and insights, bringing creativity to analytics, and merging art and science, qual and quant.  
  • Experience using generative AI tools such as ChatGPT, Gemini, and Copilot.

At Real Chemistry, making the world a healthier place isn’t just an aspiration—it’s our everyday reality. Our drive to transform healthcare is informed by our blend of deep scientific expertise, human-centred creativity, and AI-driven insights, fostering a unique environment where innovation thrives and our people are impact-obsessed. As a global agency, we provide a full suite of services across healthcare communications and marketing to our clients, including top players in the pharmaceutical and biotech industries.

Our #LifeatRealChem culture is rooted in our people—we believe we are best together and are committed to excellence for both our clients and colleagues. Whether you're a seasoned professional or just starting your career, if you share our passion for healthcare and connection, we invite you to explore our opportunities.

Discover your purpose. Embrace innovation. Experience #LifeatRealChem.

Position Summary:

The Senior Medical Writer serves as an integral part of the Real Chemistry Medical Communications division in developing scientific content in support of a variety of omnichannel medical communication tactics, as assigned to particular therapeutic areas and client brands. The Senior Medical Writer must have the ability to analyze and interpret complex scientific data and translate these into compelling and relevant clinical communications and commercial/medical messages. The Senior Medical Writer collaborates closely with the Medical Director and cross-functional teammates in the development and execution of scientific strategies and tactics. 

This is a hybrid role, based in any of our US offices—including New York City, Boston, Chicago, Carmel, Lambertville, or San Francisco—or remotely within the US, depending on team and business needs. This role requires working eastern US hours.

What you'll do:

  • Develop core deliverables (eg, PowerPoint slides, manuscripts, video scripts, executive summaries) and ancillary materials (eg, participant handouts, moderator guides) for medical communication projects, including promotional/medical presentations, advisory board meetings, product theaters as well as various educational videos and digital solutions
  • Perform and analyze literature searches and scientific research regarding clinical data and key scientific information for content development projects to meet client needs for relevant, up-to-date, evidenced-based, and accurate medical communication content
  • Collaborate with the Medical Director, in partnership with Creative and Client Services, on medical storytelling, drawing upon client insights, landscape intelligence, and relevant evidence-based medical literature to provide informed and relevant strategic recommendations
  • Partner with Presentation and Graphic Designers on various illustrations, animations, and creative applications of medical and scientific information
  • As assigned, develop relationships and collaborate closely with clients and key opinion leaders to develop scientific content and execute medical communication strategy to communicate complex scientific information to medical professionals 
  • Conduct quality checks on all content-related materials, including annotated deliverables, to ensure scientific integrity and accuracy, and support Veeva submissions of all medical communication deliverables for client medical/legal/regulatory reviews by highlighting all relevant references and creating detailed reference notes
  • Support project management within the cross-functional team by effectively communicating and aligning with Account and Project Managers, and actively participating in all internal and client meetings
  • Train and mentor more junior medical writers under the guidance of the Medical Director
  • Maintain full compliance with legal, regulatory, and corporate requirements as well as all applicable US laws and regulations
  • Perform any other duties as reasonably assigned; duties and responsibilities may be removed, modified, or added by leadership at any time as business or operations warrant 

Working Conditions:

  • Work Schedule/Hours: This position requires occasional nonstandard work hours in accordance with project needs, deadlines, deliverables, and urgent client requests    
  • Business Travel: This position requires moderate overnight/weekend travel (up to 20%) based upon client geography
  • This position has no direct reports and does not perform supervisory tasks 

What you should have: 

  • Advanced degree (eg, MD, PhD, PharmD, MPH, MS) in a healthcare-related field required 
  • Minimum of 3-5 years of experience in medical education, scientific research, or clinical practice/insights preferred, or 2-3 years of experience in medical education in a pharmaceutical company or medical communications agency required, with experience in promotional/medical communication to healthcare professionals preferred
  • Experience with medical, legal, and regulatory reviews preferred
  • Expert verbal and written communication skills in the field of medical science 
  • Intermediate ability to analyze the scientific relevance, validity, and credibility of the published medical literature
  • Intermediate level of conceptual and functional understanding of modern digital marketing practices and the applications of artificial intelligence technology 

Core Competencies:

Whether acting in a promotional or nonpromotional nature, we serve as envoys for our clients’ messages, a resource for their customers, and stewards of the money they invest with us. As such, Real Chemistry holds employees to a high standard when it comes to communication, culture, and collaboration, specifically: 

  • Model corporate values—Best Together, Impact-Obsessed, Excellence Expected, Evolve Always, and Accountability With an “I”—in interactions with colleagues, clients, vendors, and HCPs as well as exercise impeccable professionalism and sound judgement when representing the agency
  • Demonstrate strong work efficiency by managing time, meeting deadlines, and achieving billability expectations
  • Display excellent interpersonal and communication skills as well as a high level of emotional intelligence, as demonstrated by advanced verbal, writing, and presentation skills as well as a strong ability to influence and impact others through meaningful and persuasive delivery
  • Exhibit advanced teaming and collaboration skills, including proactively communicating changes, completing tasks as assigned and on agreed timeline, adapting to changes provided by the team, and seeking opportunities to help other teammates
  • Apply the knowledge and skills necessary to deliver high-quality work, as exhibited by strong accuracy, problem solving, quality management, and client-centric behaviors 

Pay Range: $90,000-100,000
This is the pay range the Company believes it will pay for this position at the time of this posting.  Consistent with applicable law, compensation will be determined based on job-related, non-discriminatory factors including but not limited to work experience, skills, certifications, and geographical location. The Company reserves the right to modify this pay range at any time.

Senior Strategist 

21GRAMS | Strategy | London 

Job Summary 

Real Chemistry is looking for a Senior Strategist to join the growing 21GRAMS Strategy team in London. This is an opportunity to support high-profile global accounts within one of healthcare advertising’s most creative agencies, working alongside award-winning creative, strategy and client teams. 

You will combine strong research and analytical foundations with creative strategic thinking. You will explore markets, audiences and competitors, turn insights into clear strategic recommendations, and help shape work that resonates with clients and their audiences. The role will mainly support senior strategists while offering strong scope to learn, collaborate internationally and progress as the team continues to grow. 

What you’ll do 

  • Conduct primary and desk research to build a clear understanding of markets, sectors, audiences and behaviours. 
  • Develop consumer and stakeholder insights that help shape creative and brand strategy. 
  • Carry out category and competitor analysis, identifying the most relevant opportunities and challenges. 
  • Support senior strategy colleagues across global account work, strategic projects and client deliverables. 
  • Contribute to creative briefs, strategic narratives and presentations, making complex findings clear and engaging. 
  • Work closely with Creative, Client Services, Medical Education and wider cross-functional teams. 
  • Support new business pitches through research, insight development and strategic thinking. 
  • Present thinking confidently to internal teams and, as experience grows, to clients. 
  • Manage multiple priorities and deadlines in a fast-moving agency environment. 

This position is a perfect fit for you if 

  • You are curious, creative and commercially aware, with a genuine interest in understanding people and what drives them. 
  • You are a clear and engaging communicator who enjoys presenting ideas and contributing to discussion. 
  • You bring positive energy, ambition and a desire to develop within strategy. 
  • You can balance detailed research with the ability to step back, identify the key insight and tell a compelling story. 
  • You are collaborative, proactive and comfortable working across different disciplines and with colleagues in other markets. 
  • You are adaptable, organised and able to deliver high-quality work against deadlines. 
  • Our Company values - Best Together, Impact-Obsessed, Excellence Expected, Evolve Always and Accountability with an “I” - really speak to you. 

What you should have 

  • Approximately 3-5 years of strategy, planning, research or insight experience within an agency environment. 
  • Experience in healthcare advertising is welcome, but candidates from traditional consumer or AOR advertising agencies who are interested in moving into healthcare will also be considered. 
  • A strong foundation in market research, desk research, audience insight and competitor or category analysis. 
  • Experience working across more than one client, category, sector or therapy area. 
  • An understanding of how agency teams operate, including fast-paced delivery and changing priorities. 
  • Experience supporting new business pitches is useful but not essential. 
  • Strong storytelling and presentation skills, with the ability to distil information into clear, persuasive recommendations. 
  • A collaborative mindset and the potential to grow into greater strategic ownership over time.

Discover your purpose. Embrace innovation. Experience #LifeatRealChem.

The Role:  

We're looking for a senior social-first content creator who lives and breathes digital culture and knows exactly what stops the scroll. You'll create platform-native content that connects brand goals with real-world healthcare impact, blending creativity, strategy, and what audiences are actually engaging with right now. You will sit and be embedded on the social media team. 

This is your chance to make health feel less clinical and more human, using your design chops, storytelling instincts, and cultural fluency to create scroll-worthy work that performs. Think: TikTok edits that explain the science and get shared. Instagram carousels that inform without boring. And LinkedIn posts that even non-HCPs want to save.  

This is a hybrid role, based in any of our US offices—including New York City, Boston, Chicago, Carmel, or San Francisco—or remotely within the US, depending on team and business needs. This role will primarily support East Coast working hours; candidates based in other time zones may be considered if they are comfortable working East Coast hours.

What You’ll Do: 

  • Develop platform-native content concepts and creative approaches tailored to how audiences consume content across TikTok, Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube Shorts, and emerging social platforms
  • Turn complex (sometimes science-y) info into clean, creative stories that hit for both consumers and professionals  
  • Serve as a social-first creative expert, advising internal teams on content formats, creator trends, editing styles, platform best practices, and evolving audience behaviors
  • Collaborate with social strategy to develop concepts and formats that break through  
  • Identify emerging trends, content formats, and cultural moments to inform timely, relevant social content
  • Contribute to new business and pitch work with agile social-by-design creative that shows what we’re capable ofour social-first approach to content

This position is a perfect fit for you if: 

  • Our Company values, Best Together, Impact Obsessed, Excellence Expected, Evolve Always, and Accountability with an "I", genuinely resonate with how you work and lead. 
  • You demonstrate the Real Chemistry Can mindset by approaching challenges with optimism, accountability, creativity, and a solutions-oriented attitude, always looking for ways to make a meaningful impact for our clients, colleagues, and communities. 
  • You are adaptable, resilient, and comfortable adjusting your scope, responsibilities, and priorities in a fast-paced, evolving environment. As our business grows and changes, so do we.  
  • You are proactive, driven, and resourceful, with strong prioritization skills, intellectual curiosity, and a desire to leverage data to inform decisions and drive outcomes.

job.title: Technical Project Manager
job.description:
At Real Chemistry, making the world a healthier place isn’t just an aspiration—it’s our everyday reality. Our drive to transform healthcare is informed by our blend of deep scientific expertise, human-centred creativity, and AI-driven insights, fostering a unique environment where innovation thrives and our people are impact-obsessed. As a global agency, we provide a full suite of services across healthcare communications and marketing to our clients, including top players in the pharmaceutical and biotech industries.

Our #LifeatRealChem culture is rooted in our people—we believe we are best together and are committed to excellence for both our clients and colleagues. Whether you're a seasoned professional or just starting your career, if you share our passion for healthcare and connection, we invite you to explore our opportunities.

Discover your purpose. Embrace innovation. Experience #LifeatRealChem.

Real Chemistry Media

Real Chemistry Media is transforming how medical and healthcare marketers engage healthcare professionals (HCPs) and consumers through data, technology, and omnichannel innovation. Real Chemistry Media's product and technology teams sit at the heart of this meaningful work by building tools that increase impact. In support of our mission to help life-changing medicines and therapies reach their full market potential, we are building an enterprise platform for omnichannel orchestration in healthcare marketing.

Our technology enables healthcare organizations to design, deploy, and optimize HCP journeys through a scalable, self-service product that connects to their existing marketing and data systems. The platform is live with early users and on track with rapid growth milestones, so the decisions made over the next year will be influential in shaping the product's future.

We are hiring a Technical Project Manager to run delivery across the platform. Reporting to the VP, Product, you will be the person who knows where every workstream stands and what needs to happen for the team to be unblocked. This role covers software delivery for a product team, including sprints, releases, and dependencies across teams. The team is small and we're building a lot, so there are a lot of opportunities for ownership and influence.

What You'll Do:

  • Run the delivery plan for the platform, including coordinating milestones and the dependencies between teams.

  • Own Agile ceremonies and keep sprints, backlogs, and release schedules up to date and easy to access.

  • Coordinate delivery across internal teams and external partners, keeping commitments and handoffs clear on both sides.

  • Track blockers and scope changes early and drive decisions with the right people in the room.

  • Manage release coordination across environments and teams.

  • Give leadership and stakeholders a clear, current picture of status and timelines.

  • Build the delivery process as the team scales, knowing when to adjust so it can be followed by all.

 

This position is a perfect fit for you if:

  • You are adaptable, resilient, and OK with adjusting your scope, responsibilities, and focus as we grow. When things change, so do we. We’re always evolving.
  • You are proactive, driven, and resourceful with strong prioritization skills and a desire to dive into the data.
  • You are highly organized self-starter, able to work independently and under tight deadlines.

What You Should Have:

  • 4+ years managing software delivery for product or engineering teams, in B2B or enterprise software.

  • Experience coordinating one program across multiple external vendors or partners and several internal teams.

  • Strong Agile fluency, including running ceremonies, managing backlogs, and adapting the process to the team rather than the reverse.

  • Enough technical depth to follow conversations about APIs, data pipelines, environments, and releases, and to ask the question that surfaces a risk.

  • Skill at turning an ambiguous set of workstreams into a plan people can act on.

  • Experience managing dependencies and timelines across teams you do not manage.

  • Fluency with delivery and tracking tools such as Jira, Asana, GitHub, or Linear, including keeping them accurate as a source of truth.

  • Ability to communicate status and tradeoffs clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Bonus points for martech, adtech, orchestration tooling, or healthcare experience.

 

Pay Range: $90,000-$100,000

job.title: Account Director, Financial Practice
job.description:
Opportunity

Account Directors produce high quality advisory documents demonstrating a deep understanding of clients and issues. You will be regularly providing advice and analysis to clients, and developing an advisory voice informed by research, experience and awareness of market trends and events. You will manage some key workstreams as well as guiding executives and assistants on the account.

As an Account Director, you will also begin to develop a network and build relationships with clients, media, advisers, Brunswick colleagues and other stakeholders. You will work to develop your media-handling skills and have a good understanding of Brunswick’s different sectors and specialist offers and how to connect them with clients as part of our one firm offering.

About the Role

  • Drive execution on client accounts within the Financial Practice team, managing workflow and key elements e.g. including press releases, investor presentations, shareholder, employee and customer communications, Q&As and other materials
  • Advise our listed clients across a range of issues and communications disciplines, with the support of Directors/Partners, and drawing on independent experience and insights.
  • Understand complex sector issues e.g. M&A, IPO, shareholder activism, crisis communications and the attitude of media, the financial community, politicians/regulators, NGOs and other stakeholder groups.
  • Manage complex media and financial stakeholder interactions, using advanced knowledge of media and other stakeholder landscapes.
  • Play a key role in team management and dynamics, including supporting smooth team transitions, and serving as a day-to-day mentor to junior team members.
  • Play an active role in drafting new business proposals and letters of engagement, including participating in pitch meetings.
  • Foster a network of analyst, advisors, journalist and media stakeholder contacts and relationships, proactively building a network to identify new business prospects and media contacts.
  • Together with Partners and Directors, proactively drive the strategic growth of Brunswick’s Financial Practice offer to clients.

What We’re Looking For

  • 3 – 6 years of relevant experience either working in an advisory role within financial practice, or consulting experience advising clients with a financial focus
  • An understanding of the interplay between corporates, the financial community, the regulatory arena and social stakeholders.
  • An understanding of the disclosure obligations of listed companies, as well as M&A and IPO processes and workstreams, a plus
  • A strong sense of corporate positioning, and how to develop strategies that can translate into programs with real sustained impact.
  • Knowledge of the financial media landscape, with experience in media-handling, major announcements, earnings calls and capital markets days
  • Ability to operate effectively in an entrepreneurial, fast-paced environment.
  • A strong verbal and written communicator with high EQ levels and an engaging presentation style.
  • A global perspective and able to thrive in an international businesses or organizations.
  • Credible and compelling with senior business leaders.
  • A balance of creative and analytical thinking, bringing rigor, accuracy, and attention to detail.
  • Proven project and/or program management experience.
  • A natural team-worker who prefers to work in a collegiate way.

Why Join Us

Whether you are joining a client facing team, a core services team, or starting out on your professional career journey, joining Brunswick unlocks a range of  employee benefits to support your financial future, health and wellness, family and community and continuous professional development.

About Brunswick

Brunswick is a global advisory firm. We help companies tackle high-stakes issues, navigate complex stakeholder relationships, and deliver high-impact outcomes. 

Our clients value our ability to anticipate, shape, and respond to the key players and forces in the financial and investment arena, regulatory and geopolitical universe, NGO community, workforce and beyond. They rely on us for deep experience, fresh perspectives and original thinking. So, in Brunswick you will find an exceptional range of experience and talent with a rich mix of backgrounds. From the beginning, we have prioritized attracting, developing, and retaining the best professionals in the industry, united by a culture of inclusivity, excellence, and intellectual curiosity.

Founded in 1987 in London, the firm has organically grown to 27 offices in 18 countries across the Americas, Europe, Middle East, Africa, Asia and Australia. We operate as a “one-firm firm” with no individual profit centers. This allows us to assemble fully integrated, bespoke teams for each client, able to draw on the full resources of Brunswick anywhere in the world.

job.title: AI Enablement Consultant
job.description:
AI Enablement Consultant

Opportunity

Brunswick is recruiting for an AI Enablement Consultant to join our pioneering AI Lab.

Brunswick’s AI Lab serves as the firm’s central hub for AI innovation. The Lab researches, builds and maintains cutting-edge AI solutions, while partnering with client teams to provide advanced technical expertise on complex mandates.

As AI adoption accelerates across the firm, the Lab plays a critical role in ensuring Brunswick remains at the forefront of AI-enabled advisory work and equipping our teams with the tools, skills and confidence to deliver differentiated value to clients.

This role is focused on enabling people across the firm to use AI tools confidently, effectively and responsibly. It combines training delivery, content creation, tool evaluation, hands-on support, and close engagement with teams to embed AI into day-to-day workflows. 

The successful candidate will work closely with Partners, Directors and teams globally to drive adoption and ensure AI tools deliver tangible business value.

About the Role 

Your day-to-day responsibilities will include:

Leading adoption, embedding and providing user support 

  • Embed within teams for defined periods to help them integrate AI tools into live client work.
  • Identify barriers to adoption and work with the AI Lab to address them.
  • Track recurring issues and feedback themes to inform training, documentation and product improvements.
  • Give input into the overall AI adoption plan.
  • Act as first-line support for AI tools, answering user queries and troubleshooting common issues.
  • Provide practical guidance on effective prompting and workflow integration.

Adoption and training 

  • Design and deliver structured AI training programmes, including: 
    • In-person workshops and office sessions 
    • Virtual training sessions 
    • Written guidance and internal communications 
    • Recorded training videos 
  • Create clear, practical materials that translate technical capabilities into relevant business use cases, presented in language that will resonate with different audiences. 
  • Drive internal adoption campaigns to increase awareness, confidence and usage of approved AI tools. 
  • Travel to Brunswick offices to deliver training and support local AI embedding efforts. 

Tool Evaluation and Selection 

  • Support the evaluation of emerging AI tools, including hands-on testing and business relevance assessment.
  • Gather structured feedback from users to inform tool selection, prioritization, and business needs.
  • Provide input into decisions on tool rollout, retirement, and optimization.
  • Stay current with developments across the generative AI landscape (e.g. ChatGPT, GPTs, Claude and related tools) and assess their relevance to the firm.

What We're Looking For

The successful candidate will combine strong communication skills, curiosity about both business and technology, and the ability to operate effectively in ambiguous environments. They will be comfortable moving between strategic conversations with senior stakeholders and hands-on practical support with end users. Standout candidates demonstrate:

  • Practical experience using generative AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, GPTs, Claude) in a professional setting with a strong understanding of where they add value and where they don’t.
  • Exceptional written communication skills and able to translate complex ideas into clear, concise, actionable guidance that people can immediately apply.
  • Strong presentation skills, including developing high-quality PowerPoint materials and delivering engaging sessions to senior audiences.
  • Confidence working with senior stakeholders, with the ability to flex your style and messaging depending on the audience.
  • Experience evaluating digital tools or technology solutions, with sound judgement about business impact, risks, and practical implementation.
  • A natural ability to bring structure to ambiguity and turning broad business challenges into practical workflows, tools, and guidance.
  • Comfortable working independently, taking ownership, and rolling up your sleeves to get things done in fast-moving environments.
  • High emotional intelligence and genuine curiosity about how people and teams work, and how to help them work better.
  • Willingness to travel internationally to deliver training and embed within teams when needed.
  • Previous experience in learning and development is highly desirable.
  • Experience in professional services or advisory environments would be advantageous.

job.title: Company Secretary
job.description:
Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced, fully qualified Company Secretary to join our Finance and Tax team and support Brunswick’s international operations.

This is a senior role at the heart of Brunswick’s governance framework, providing trusted advice to the Board of Directors and senior leadership. The Company Secretary will lead our corporate governance and regulatory compliance activities, ensuring Brunswick maintains high standards of governance and meets its obligations under the UK Corporate Governance Code and Companies Act 2006.

Reporting to the Head of International Tax, the role will work closely with the Group Financial Controller and other senior colleagues across the firm, providing thoughtful, pragmatic guidance on governance and corporate matters.

We are open to considering part-time or flexible working arrangements for the right candidate.

About the Role

Your key responsibilities will include:

Board and governance

  • Support the effective operation of the Board, including preparing agendas and papers, drafting minutes, tracking actions and ensuring appropriate follow-up.
  • Act as a key point of contact for executive and non-executive directors on governance matters.
  • Manage the forward calendar and terms of reference for the Board and its committees.
  • Ensure the Board operates in accordance with the Articles of Association, shareholder arrangements, the Companies Act 2006 and other relevant governance and regulatory requirements.
  • Keep the Board and senior colleagues informed of relevant developments in corporate governance and regulation.

Committee support

  • Provide company secretarial support to the Audit & Risk Committee.
  • Attend committee meetings and prepare accurate and timely minutes.
  • Track actions and support appropriate follow-up.

Shareholder matters

  • Maintain the shareholder register and oversee quarterly updates presented to the Board.
  • Prepare and coordinate communications and documentation for shareholders.
  • Work with the Head of International Tax to support partners on shareholder and share-related matters.

Annual General Meeting

  • Manage the end-to-end delivery of the Annual General Meeting.
  • Prepare notices and supporting documentation.
  • Coordinate communications with shareholders.
  • Manage meeting arrangements and prepare minutes.

Share buy-backs

  • Coordinate the documentation and approvals associated with share buy-backs.
  • Manage relevant filing and record-keeping requirements.

Corporate documentation and records

  • Draft resolutions, letters and other corporate documentation for entities and transactions across the Group.
  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date statutory books and corporate records for the Group’s subsidiaries using Diligent.
  • Maintain authorised signatory records.
  • Own and maintain the Group structure chart.

Statutory filings and compliance

job.title: Researcher, Analysis & Research Center
job.description:
Opportunity

Brunswick Group is seeking a Researcher to join our Analysis and Research Center (ARC) team. Based out of Brunswick’s Dallas office, the Researcher will be part of the global ARC team to support fundamental research activities for our client facing teams within the U.S. as part of a global resource as needed.  

About the Role

Duties and Responsibilities

  • Devise, conduct and present high quality, thorough and thoughtful research using a wide range of tools including FactSet, Factiva, LSEG, Mergermarket and other specialist sources
  • Provide concise and compelling outputs, succinctly drawing out and articulating key messages and themes 
  • Promote and make use of internal AI tools for research outputs
  • Design and explain research methodologies to address complex client and business challenges  
  • Competitive analyses and benchmarking of (prospective) clients and peer groups 
  • Qualitative and quantitative analysis of traditional and social media 
  • Review and summarize takeaways from complex, technical documents such as analyst reports, regulatory filings and legal complaints 
  • Query research databases to extract relevant information into reports and actionable datasets 
  • Data analysis, including charting and other visualizations 
  • Track and analyze critical issues and trends across Brunswick’s sector and practice areas; proactively scan and analyze sector news and key developments 
  • Advise colleagues and requesters on research resources and tool availability, usage, copyright issues and source attribution 
  • Support new business efforts by helping team members prepare for pitches and proposals 
  • When required, work with teams to understand content needs and provide guidance on what is available in the market and the process for any new content requests 
  • Liaise with vendors to ensure they work with the L&D team to deliver relevant training sessions. Provide occasional (post training) ad-hoc product run throughs as needed with individuals 
  • Demonstrate strong curiosity and awareness of current and relevant global issues and horizon trends (including how these may impact clients), sharing appropriately. Works closely with global colleagues to bring new ideas and approach
  • Work with and build relationships with client teams across the firm as appropriate, anticipating and understanding requester needs, maximizing efficiencies and adding value wherever possible

What We're Looking For

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • 1+ years working in a research or related role, ideally in a fast-paced, confidential, client-driven professional services environment

job.title: Transfer Pricing Manager
job.description:
Opportunity

We are looking for a Transfer Pricing Manager to join our Finance and Tax team and support Brunswick’s international operations.

The Transfer Pricing Manager will be responsible for managing and developing Brunswick’s global transfer pricing framework, ensuring that our intercompany arrangements are appropriately designed, documented and implemented across the Group.

Reporting to the Head of International Tax, and working closely with colleagues across Tax, Finance and the wider business, the role will combine technical transfer pricing expertise with hands-on practical implementation. The successful candidate will help Brunswick manage transfer pricing risk, meet its compliance obligations across multiple jurisdictions and ensure that policies remain appropriate as the Group evolves.

This is an opportunity to take ownership of a key area of international tax within a global professional services organisation and to work with senior stakeholders across Brunswick’s international network.

About the Role

Your key responsibilities will include:

  • Manage Brunswick’s global transfer pricing policies and ensure they remain aligned with the Group’s operating model and relevant international tax requirements.
  • Lead the preparation and maintenance of transfer pricing documentation, including Master File, Local Files and supporting analyses.
  • Coordinate transfer pricing compliance requirements across Brunswick’s international jurisdictions, working with local Finance teams and external advisers, where appropriate.
  • Review and support the implementation of intercompany arrangements, including management and service charges, cost allocations and other cross-border transactions.
  • Monitor the financial outcomes of transfer pricing policies and identify where adjustments or further analysis may be required.
  • Provide transfer pricing advice in relation to changes in the business, including new entities, changes to operating models and cross-border activities.
  • Support responses to transfer pricing enquiries, audits and requests from tax authorities.
  • Monitor developments in OECD guidance and relevant local transfer pricing legislation and assess their implications for Brunswick.
  • Work with local advisors on developments within non-OECD countries.
  • Partner with Finance, Legal and other stakeholders to ensure intercompany agreements, policies and operational processes are appropriately aligned.
  • Manage relationships with external transfer pricing advisers and coordinate specialist support where required.
  • Identify opportunities to improve transfer pricing processes, controls, data and documentation.
  • Support wider international tax projects and Group Tax priorities as required.
  • Prepare transfer pricing calculations across the Group in accordance with the Group’s transfer pricing policies. Manage and take ownership of the associated invoicing process, from calculation through to the accurate recording of invoices.
  • Work with local finance managers in jurisdictions outside the OECD framework to review transfer pricing calculations and ensure they are appropriately applied.
  • Prepare supporting calculations and analysis for the Group’s management charge for both statutory and management accounting purposes, ensuring consistency with the Group’s transfer pricing policies.
  • Work with local finance managers to prepare transfer pricing sales and purchase estimates to support the Group’s financial forecasting and planning processes.

  • Experience working with intercompany service arrangements and cost allocation methodologies.

job.description:

The Role

Are you soon to be a Finance or Accounting graduate looking to accelerate your career in a dynamic, entrepreneurial, and fast-growing business environment?

The Finance Associate Program is a two-year rotational program designed to develop future finance and business leaders through hands-on experience across Order to Cash, Procurement to Payment, Revenue Recognition & Commercial Finance, and FP&A. Participants will gain broad exposure to financial operations, commercial decision-making, and strategic planning while working closely with Finance leaders, Partners, and consultants across the region.

The program offers unique regional exposure across Hong Kong, Singapore, and China, enabling Associates to develop a deep understanding of the financial and commercial dynamics of a leading professional services business. Associates will gain first-hand experience in a high-growth, fast-paced environment backed by a leading global private equity investor, providing exposure to business transformation, performance management, operational excellence, and value creation initiatives.

Designed for high-potential Finance and Accounting graduates, the program combines training, mentorship, and real-world business experience to accelerate professional development. High-performing Associates may be considered for direct placement into high-impact Finance roles, including FP&A, Commercial Finance, Revenue Management, and Business Finance, or opportunities to transition into client-facing consulting teams, creating an accelerated pathway to leadership within the firm.

 

Key Responsibilities

Responsibilities will vary by rotation and may include:

Order to Cash

  • Support the end-to-end billing and accounts receivable process, ensuring invoices are issued accurately and on time.
  • Review client contracts, engagement terms and billing arrangements to support appropriate financial treatment.
  • Monitor receivables, unbilled revenue and work-in-progress balances, highlighting risks and following up with relevant stakeholders.
  • Partner with consultants and client teams to resolve billing queries and support timely collections.
  • Prepare reports and analysis on billing performance, cash collection and working capital.

Procurement to Payment

  • Support the processing and review of vendor invoices, employee expenses and payment requests.
  • Assist with vendor onboarding and help maintain accurate supplier records.
  • Review expenditure against internal policies, approval requirements and supporting documentation.
  • Work with internal stakeholders and external vendors to resolve payment-related queries.
  • Identify opportunities to improve procurement, expense and payment processes.

Revenue Recognition and Commercial Finance

  • Review contracts and engagement documentation to support accurate revenue recognition in accordance with applicable accounting policies.
  • Assist with project setup, revenue forecasting, fee tracking and engagement financial management.
  • Analyse project performance, including revenue, costs, utilisation, margins and profitability.
  • Work with Finance colleagues and client-facing teams to identify financial risks and support informed commercial decisions.
  • Support month-end closing activities, reconciliations and management reporting.

Financial Planning and Analysis

  • Assist with annual budgeting, periodic forecasting and longer-term financial planning.
  • Analyse actual performance against budget and forecast, identifying key drivers, risks and opportunities.
  • Prepare financial reports, dashboards and presentations for senior management.
  • Support business cases, scenario modelling and commercial analysis for strategic initiatives.
  • Translate financial data into clear and practical insights for business stakeholders.

Finance Transformation and Regional Projects

  • Contribute to process improvement, systems implementation and finance transformation initiatives.
  • Support the standardisation of finance processes and reporting across Hong Kong, Singapore and Mainland China.
  • Use data and technology to improve reporting quality, operational efficiency and decision-making.
  • Participate in cross-functional projects relating to business growth, performance improvement and operational excellence.
  • Take ownership of assigned workstreams and deliver accurate, timely and practical outcomes.

 

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance or Accounting
  • Fresh graduates are welcome
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills
  • Strong Excel and data analysis capabilities
  • High attention to detail and commitment to accuracy
  • Self-motivated, intellectually curious, and eager to learn
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment where priorities evolve quickly
  • Demonstrates a growth mindset, adaptability, resilience, and strong sense of ownership
  • Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to collaborate effectively with Partners, consultants, and cross-functional teams
  • Desire to build a long-term career in finance and business leadership

 

Why Join Us?

  • Structured rotational experience across key finance functions in a leading global strategic leadership advisory firm
  • Regional exposure across Hong Kong, Singapore, and China
  • Direct exposure to senior Finance leaders, Partners, and consultants
  • Opportunities to develop strong commercial acumen and business partnering skills
  • Hands-on experience with real business impact from day one
  • Participation in finance transformation and value creation initiatives
  • Potential placement into high-impact Finance leadership roles or consulting teams upon successful completion of the program
  • Launch your career through a program designed to develop the next generation of finance and business leaders in a high-growth, entrepreneurial, and globally connected environment.
