  • Foster collaboration among internal stakeholders to create integrated client solutions.
  • Support internal alignment on priority growth opportunities.

Relationship Building

  • Establish and maintain relationships with prospective clients and industry contacts.
  • Represent Stagwell at client meetings, industry events, and networking opportunities.
  • Help strengthen relationships with existing clients to uncover expansion opportunities.
  • Act as a trusted partner to agency leadership teams throughout the growth process.

Growth Operations & Execution

  • Track and manage opportunity progression within growth reporting processes.
  • Help maintain pipeline visibility and support forecasting activities.
  • Identify opportunities to improve growth processes, collaboration, and execution.
  • Contribute to the ongoing evolution of the North America Growth organization.

Qualifications

  • 6+ years of experience in business development, growth, partnerships, account growth, sales, consulting, or related commercial roles.
  • Experience within marketing, media, technology, agency, consulting, or adjacent industries.
  • Demonstrated ability to build relationships and generate business opportunities.
  • Strong communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Experience working across multiple teams and managing competing priorities.
  • Commercially minded with strong problem-solving abilities.
  • Highly organized and comfortable operating in fast-paced environments.
  • Ability to influence without direct authority.
  • Collaborative, proactive, and self-motivated.
  • Passion for helping organizations grow and win new business.

Compensation

In order to comply with equal pay and salary transparency laws in various locations, we believe the target range of base compensation in New York City for this role is $125,000 - $145,000. Actual compensation is influenced by a wide array of factors including but not limited to skill set, level of experience, and location. 

 

In addition to medical, dental and vision coverage, we offer a generous PTO plan, 401k program, comprehensive family planning benefits (including paid parental leave), tuition reimbursement, and pre-tax commuter benefits. Benefits/perks may vary depending on the nature of your employment with Stagwell and the location where you work.

job.title: Director, Client Strategy
job.description:

The Knowledge Machine, part of The Marketing Cloud, Stagwell's centralized AI-powered technology and marketing intelligence organization, is seeking a senior client strategy leader to help some of the world's most recognized brands transform intelligence into action.

The successful candidate will manage a portfolio of strategic enterprise relationships, partnering closely with client executives, analytics teams, researchers, and product leaders to help organizations anticipate emerging issues, identify opportunities, mitigate risk, and maximize the value of The Knowledge Machine's communications intelligence platform. 

More than a traditional account leader, this individual will serve as a trusted counselor to senior stakeholders, helping clients understand not only what is happening, but why it matters, what may happen next, and how to respond with confidence. This is an opportunity to operate at the intersection of strategic advisory, communications intelligence, AI-powered technology, and enterprise relationship growth within one of Stagwell's fastest-growing technology businesses.

  • Strong ability to synthesize research, analytics, and insights into clear strategic recommendations. 
  • Outstanding executive communication, presentation, and facilitation skills. 
  • Proven ability to influence stakeholders and navigate complex client organizations. 
  • Strong commercial acumen with a track record of client retention and expansion. 

 

Preferred Background

job.title: Global Investment Director

Overview

Stagwell Media Platform (SMP) is seeking an ambitious, commercially astute, and entrepreneurial Global Investment Director to build and lead a next-generation global investment function. This is a unique opportunity to create a critical capability from the ground up, shaping the tools, processes, governance, and ways of working that support global investment, pricing, productivity, and trading initiatives across multiple markets.

The successful candidate will be responsible for leading complex multi-market new business pricing exercises, driving productivity programs for existing clients, and developing scalable investment frameworks that enable better commercial outcomes across the organisation. This role combines strategic leadership with hands-on delivery and requires someone equally comfortable building sophisticated pricing models, designing global processes, influencing senior stakeholders, and supporting commercial negotiations with media partners.

The ideal candidate will have a proven track record of creating and launching new products, capabilities or processes, alongside a passion for innovation, automation, and AI-enabled transformation of media investment practices.

Global New Business Pricing & Commercial Leadership

  • Create scalable global tools, templates, frameworks, and knowledge repositories.
  • Establish investment excellence standards and best practices across markets.
  • Drive adoption and change management across regional and local teams.

AI, Innovation & Process Modernisation

Trading & Strategic Partnership Support

Stakeholder Management

Behind the scenes, but ahead of the curve: help us develop the next-generation public service media organization.

 

Technology & Infrastructure (T&I) is the backbone and the future-forward arm of CBC/Radio-Canada. Our purpose is to constantly innovate to evolve and maintain the Corporation’s technology and infrastructure. We are the people that make stuff work. We make connections between media content, systems, people and places. We are the space in between.

 

A place with purpose. CBC/Radio-Canada has always been a highly regarded pioneer of media technology — not just in Canada but around the world. Today, we are transforming ourselves into a modern and agile public service media organization. Technology is the driving force, and we are the team making it happen.

 

This is a hybrid role with a mix of in-office and remote work. Work arrangements will be discussed with hiring managers per departmental guidelines.

 

The Opportunity

 

CBC/Radio-Canada operates one of the world’s leading technology infrastructures and one of the largest private networks, which distributes its content and services exclusively across the country. CBC/Radio-Canada is looking for a hands-on, detail design oriented Engineering Project Lead to join our Engineering team, to both lead and take part in projects focused on deploying technology. This is a full time permanent position, and the successful incumbent would be based in Toronto, working primarily on local projects, with eventual and occasional travel to various other sites nationally.

 

What’s in it for you?

 

Challenges. We spend our days solving problems on an unbelievable scale. Media systems workflows are highly specialized and complicated; updating, installing and supporting technologies that are organization-wide and that impact broadcasting content is a time-sensitive, complex technical feat. And that’s just the beginning.

 

You will be our IT subject matter specialist for projects. You will mainly work on improving and deploying our infrastructure for data management, cloud-based data and applications and  containerization. You will also participate in infrastructure automation projects, complemented with security and resilience activities for the infrastructure.

 

Additionally, you will manage project deliverables and activities, from proposal and procurement to design, implementation, testing and handover, in accordance with CBC/Radio-Canada and industry standards as well as current federal and provincial regulations.

 

Perks you can look forward to:

  • Four weeks of vacation per year.
  • Work from home opportunities.
  • Competitive total rewards package.
  • Opportunities to work with cutting edge technology.
  • Opportunities for continued learning and professional development - including access to e-learning services, customized courses and certification opportunities.
  • Opportunities to become a member of our Employee Resource Groups.
  • A creative and dynamic work environment, where your ideas and contributions can be heard, valued and respected.
  • A supportive management team committed to upholding the highest standards of diversity and inclusivity.

 

As our new Engineering Project Lead you will:

  • Create concept designs for review with our business partners.
  • Design in detail, innovative, practical solutions to complex problems.
  • Regularly meet with stakeholders to determine requirements and solutions.
  • Create and track the schedules and budgets; monitoring progress.
  • Prepare schematic, layout drawings and installation instructions.
  • Oversee the procurement from writing proposals to evaluating tender responses.    
  • Responsible for the implementation phase.
  • Verify system performance and ensure that identified deficiencies are rectified
  • Prepare documentation for ongoing operation and maintenance of facilities.

 

What You Bring:

  • Minimum of 5 years experience in design and implementation of various IT infrastructure.
  • Knowledge : platforms for virtualization, containers, storage and cloud, basic scripting.
  • Hands on experience : large-scale system design and deployment of critical IT infrastructure and security systems, installation and configuration of servers and virtual machines.
  • Hands on experience : tools for infrastructure as code (IaC) like Terraform, CloudFormation or Ansible - an asset.
  • Hands on experience : Installation of OpenShift and Advanced Cluster Manager On Premise.
  • Hands on experience : Installation and configuration of Kubernetes distribution.
  • Basic knowledge : principles and best practices for infrastructure security - an asset.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Applied Science or Engineering, or a Diploma In Applied Science and Technology.
  • Experience in Project Management is preferred, specifically with the Agile approach.
  • Membership, or eligibility to become a member, of the provincial Engineering Association (PEO, OIQ, … etc) is mandatory.
  • Strong and influential verbal and written communication skills in English and French considered a strong asset.
  • Strong analytical skills, with an innate ability to think through complex issues and design innovative solutions, as well as digging further into issues, removing roadblocks and presenting solutions for immediate and long term.
  • Ability to build and maintain strong relationships with peers, partners, clients, management, and external vendors, in addition to being able to effectively translate technical requirements to non technical business needs.
  • Ability to work efficiently on a number of projects at different stages with multiple priorities, never losing sight of the details.
  • Ability to adapt to new tools and technologies quickly, all while staying up to date with industry best practices.
  • Ability to travel to different CBC locations to oversee different phases of projects.

Position Summary


The Manager, Strategic Workforce Planning is responsible for operationalizing and scaling the organization’s workforce planning strategy. This role bridges the gap between high-level strategic planning and tactical execution, ensuring the organization has the right talent, capabilities, and capacity to meet its transformation objectives. The Manager will lead a team of specialists to analyze workforce data, model future talent requirements, and partner with business leaders and HR partners to deliver actionable, data-driven workforce strategies that foster organizational agility and sustainability.


Key Responsibilities:

Strategic Workforce Planning & Governance


  • Oversee the implementation of enterprise-wide workforce planning frameworks, tools, and methodologies.
  • Lead complex business-unit workforce planning exercises, translating organizational priorities into actionable 1-to-3-year human capital requirements.
  • Develop and maintain workforce forecasts, succession risk analyses, and talent scenarios to proactively address capability gaps.
  • Standardize planning processes across business units to ensure consistency, scalability, and alignment with enterprise goals.

Data Analysis & Labour Market Intelligence


  • Direct the collection and synthesis of workforce analytics (e.g., attrition, turnover, demographic shifts) and external labour market intelligence.
  • Translate complex data sets into executive-level dashboards and strategic recommendations that influence talent investment and location strategies.
  • Monitor technological disruptions and emerging skills trends to ensure workforce plans remain forward-looking and relevant.

Team Leadership & Stakeholder Management


  • Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing team of workforce planning specialists, fostering a consultative and analytical mindset.
  • Serve as a key advisor to business unit leaders and HR Business Partners, facilitating workforce planning sessions and guiding them through talent strategy implementation.
  • Collaborate across the HR Centre of Expertise—including Talent Acquisition, L&D, and Total Rewards—to integrate workforce planning with broader talent lifecycle initiatives.

Inclusion, Sustainability & Change Management


  • Ensure all workforce strategies proactively embed Equity, Diversity, Inclusion, and Accessibility (IDEA) principles.
  • Lead change management initiatives related to workforce modernization, helping the organization transition toward more data-informed, proactive talent decision-making.
  • Establish and monitor Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) to track progress against workforce goals and report on organizational readiness.

Qualifications:

Education


  • University degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Industrial Relations, Organizational Development, or a related field.

Experience


  • 7–10 years of progressive experience in Human Resources, with a significant focus on strategic workforce planning, people analytics, or organizational effectiveness.
  • Proven experience in a leadership or managerial capacity, with a track record of building teams and developing staff.
  • Demonstrated success in managing complex projects and collaborating with diverse senior-level stakeholders.
  • Experience working in unionized, public sector, media, or large complex organizations is considered an asset.

Knowledge & Competencies


  • Expertise in workforce planning methodologies, forecasting models, and HRIS/analytics tools (e.g., Workday, Power BI, Excel).
  • Strong understanding of labour market trends, talent management principles, and employment legislation.
  • Exceptional analytical skills with the ability to synthesize complex qualitative and quantitative information.
  • Strong change management, communication, and storytelling capabilities.
  • Ability to balance long-term strategic thinking with immediate operational execution.

Leadership Competencies


  • Strategic mindset: Attains strategic goals by systematically reflecting on priorities and objectives to be pursued along with consequences
  • Persuasive communication: Helps people shift toward a different perspective in a collaborative and positive manner
  • Accountability:  Recognizes, takes ownership, and engages in course correction of decisions and subsequent actions
  • Critical thinking: Engages in reflective thinking and challenges one’s personal assumptions in light of new arguments and verifiable information
  • Empathy: Acknowledges and appreciates others’ feelings, perspectives, and aspirations on the basis of their experience

What Success Looks Like in This Role:


  • Workforce planning practices are standardized, integrated, and actively used by business units to inform decision-making.
  • The organization maintains a clear pipeline of talent for critical roles, with identified risks proactively mitigated.
  • Leaders at all levels have improved visibility into workforce gaps and are equipped with data-driven options to close them.
  • Workforce strategies are demonstrably aligned with both business goals and organizational commitments to inclusion and sustainability.

#26-1339

Minneapolis/St. Paul, Minnesota, United States

Business Unit

KSTP-FM

Employee Classification

Full Time Regular

About Us

Hubbard Radio-Twin Cities is a full-service media company with legendary radio stations and cutting-edge digital solutions. We serve the Greater Minneapolis-Saint Paul community and offer a menu of marketing services including radio, full-service digital, influencer marketing, creative services, custom content, podcasts and events. At Hubbard, we're looking for the best people in local media to help build dominant brands that connect consumers and advertisers to build better businesses and communities. We succeed by always doing the right thing with focus, urgency, and passion.

Job Overview

The Promotions Coordinator/Social Media Strategist serves as the primary liaison for contest winners, manages prize fulfillment, coordinates station events, and works closely with programming, sales, and promotional partners to ensure flawless execution of station campaigns and experiences. The role also provides support for the station's digital and social media strategy by analyzing audience engagement, evaluating campaign performance, identifying opportunities for growth, and helping shape content strategies that strengthen listener connection and brand impact.

The ideal candidate is highly organized, detail-oriented, customer-service focused, and thrives in a fast-paced environment with multiple deadlines and moving pieces.

Job Responsibilities

Contest & Promotion Management

Coordinate and execute all on-air and online contests and giveaways.

Manage winner selection, verification, paperwork collection, and prize fulfillment.

Process contest-related documentation, including tax forms and check requests.

Track winner paperwork and ensure compliance with station, legal, and accounting requirements.

Maintain accurate records of prize inventory and distribution.

Monitor and respond to promotions email and phone lines.

Event Coordination

Execute station events, appearances, and promotional activations.

Coordinate event staffing, logistics, and communication with sales, talent, and street team.

Create event materials, schedules, and briefing sheets.

Maintain event supplies, promotional inventory, and station vehicles.

Attend and support station events, including nights, weekends, and holidays as needed.

Digital Marketing & Social Media Strategy

Create a station social media strategy for KS95. Provide actionable recommendations to enhance station/brand content performance, audience growth, engagement, and campaign effectiveness.

Assist with content planning and social media calendars, ensuring consistent and strategic messaging across platforms.

Coach and direct the team on best practices in social media posting by platforms.

Analyze social media, digital marketing, and audience engagement performance to identify trends, successes, opportunities, and areas for improvement.

Help execute sponsor and client deliverables across social media platforms.

Assist in promoting station events, contests, and community initiatives.

Stay informed on emerging social media trends across platform changes, algorithm updates, digital marketing best practices, and new advertising opportunities across TikTok, Facebook, Instagram, and YouTube.

Qualifications

Required

Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Public Relations, Event Management, or related field preferred; equivalent experience considered.

Strong understanding of major social media platforms, including Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, YouTube, and emerging digital channels.

Experience using analytics and reporting tools such as Meta Business Suite, Google Analytics, Google Ads, or similar platforms.

Ability to analyze audience, social media, and promotional campaign data; identify what is driving engagement and results; and make strategic recommendations for future content, campaigns, and marketing initiatives.

Strong organizational and project management skills.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously.

Strong customer service and relationship-building abilities.

Ability to work flexible hours, including evenings, weekends, and Holidays.

Preferred

Experience in radio, media, entertainment, promotions, marketing, or event coordination.

Familiarity with WordPress, VPromo, Asana, Audience, and Canva

Experience with contesting, prize fulfillment, and event logistics.

Responsible for generating new advertising revenue through proactive outbound prospecting, developing relationships with prospective advertisers, conducting discovery meetings, presenting customized iHeartMedia advertising solutions, managing sales opportunities through the full sales cycle, and consistently achieving established sales activity and revenue goals. job.title: Multi-Media Advertising Account Executive
job.description:
Company Overview

Cumulus Media is an audio-first media company delivering premium content to a quarter billion people every month — wherever and whenever they want it. Cumulus Media engages listeners with high-quality local programming through 377 owned-and-operated radio stations across 84 markets; delivers nationally-syndicated sports, news, talk, and entertainment programming from iconic brands including the NFL, the NCAA, the Masters, US Soccer, and AP News, across more than 7,800 affiliated stations through Westwood One, a leading national audio network; and inspires listeners through the Cumulus Podcast Network, an established and influential platform for original podcasts that are smart, entertaining, and thought-provoking. Cumulus Media provides advertisers with personal connections, local impact and national reach through broadcast and on-demand digital, mobile, social, and voice-activated platforms, as well as integrated digital marketing services, powerful influencers, full-service audio solutions, industry-leading research and insights, and live event experiences. For more information visit www.cumulusmedia.com.

 

 

CUMULUS MEDIA | York-Lancaster, PA Our local stations in the York-Lancaster, PA area include I-105 Pennsylvania’s Country Leader (WIOV-FM), 96.1 SOX The Susquehanna Valley’s Greatest Hits (WSOX-FM) WARM 103.3 80s-90s-NOW (WARM-FM) and NEWSTALK 93.9 & 910 WSBA-AM.  Cumulus Digital is our portfolio of Digital Advertising Products for Local Businesses. 


Position Overview

The Multi-Media Advertising Account Executive successfully manages relationships with dozens of local and regional businesses, protects and grows the revenue base, identifies and creates new business opportunities with existing and new clients; provides marketing solutions to help customers achieve their business goals; strategically plans and implements initiatives to meet personal, company and corporate directives, recognizes that achieving budgeted revenue targets is the minimum expectation of performance. The right individual will invest in personal professional development, understanding technology, marketing and the full suite of company products and services.


Key Responsibilities & Qualifications

Key Responsibilities:

  • Able to create and identify client business needs by gaining a deep understanding of their goals, objectives and processes as well as their external environment including key market and consumer trends to proactively develop customized marketing solutions to meet client objectives
  • Deliver and Develop effective and informed marketing solutions via multi-platform, integrated sales presentations identifying Cumulus broadcast, digital, and event tactics to foster brand loyalty and deliver results for the client
  • Ability to negotiate and close business that drives revenue results and fosters long term client relationships, regardless of medium or platform
  • Commitment to having a proficient understanding of the Cumulus Media assets and resources and a desire to constantly learn and grow your product knowledge thus staying relevant and current with industry advertising opportunities for your clients
  • Represent the full suite of products and services as marketing solutions to new and existing clientele. This includes station digital assets, internet-based marketing, social media, streaming, events and specialized programming
  • Ability to appropriately manage time to optimize revenue opportunities, client interaction, implementation and fulfillment of successful sales agreements. Individual must be able to assist in the development of creative messaging, regardless of platform
  • Excel at prospecting and aggressively seeking new clientele by networking, cold calling, canvassing, referrals or other means to maintain a full pipeline of sales prospects at all times
  • Follow all station and corporate procedures for preparing orders, resolving billing issues, submitting regular reports regarding sales, pipeline lists, forecasts and competitive analysis
  • Collaborate, create, and capitalize on opportunities to best represent our brand while working to help your clients achieve success


Qualifications:

  • 1-3 years of sales experience required; with background in broadcast, media or digital advertising sales highly preferred.

  • Bachelor's degree in business, marketing or related field preferred, but not required.

  • Valid driver's license required. Driving is an essential function of this position because regular travel is required to perform key job duties, including meeting with clients & prospects, as well as attending business-related events.

  • Passion for developing new business relationships in an outside sales role, including preparing and presenting sales opportunities and post-sale successes to clients/potential clients.

  • Strong understanding of lead generation and ability to connect with viable prospects.

  • Comprehension of sales metrics in order to fill a sales funnel and maintain a constant pipeline of new business.

  • Excellent communication skills.

  • Self-motivating and entrepreneurial spirit; with a positive and friendly attitude and willingness to collaborate.

  • High energy and passion for sales.

  • Flexible, creative and curious.

  • Digitally savvy - proficient in Microsoft Office suite, social networking platforms and CRM tools highly preferred.


Pay Range

USD $4,000.00 - USD $4,000.00 /Mo.

job.title: Radio Host / Multimedia Content Creator & Brand Influencer - KSII
job.description:
Radio Host / Multimedia Content Creator & Brand Influencer – KSII

*This is a full-time, in-office opportunity. *

 

Be the Voice, Face, Writer, Content and Community Influencer of Your Community:

Are you a creative personality with a passion for radio, digital storytelling, video content creation, and building community relationships? At Townsquare Media Group, we’re looking for a Radio Host / Multimedia Content Creator & Brand Influencer who can dominate the airwaves, create compelling local written content online, produce engaging video across platforms, and partner with local businesses as a trusted endorser and influencer.

This is a full-time, in-office role, working closely with a collaborative and fun local team. We’re searching for a true 360-degree multimedia talent with initiative—someone who thrives on radio, creates video content consistently, writes articles that demand attention, commands a room in person, and creates business opportunities with confidence. If you see yourself as a local influencer who can authentically connect, create content, endorse brands and generate revenue, this role was built for you.

 

Why Townsquare Media?

Townsquare is a media, entertainment, and digital marketing solutions company dedicated to serving small and mid-sized markets across the U.S. We own and operate 354 radio stations and more than 400 local websites across 74 markets—including trusted El Paso stations.

We combine the power of local media with best-in-class digital solutions to help businesses grow—offering everything from broadcast and digital advertising to SEO, web design, and programmatic marketing.

 

What You’ll Do:

As a Radio Host / Digital Content Writer, you’ll play a key role in shaping the daily sound and digital presence of STATION LETTERS. You’ll engage audiences across on-air, online, social, and in the community by:

  • Hosting live, engaging on-air shows Monday through Friday
  • Preparing daily show content that entertains, informs, and connects with the target audience
  • Creating and publishing a minimum of two original local articles per day for the station website and mobile app
  • Writing and scheduling engaging posts across social platforms including Facebook and others
  • Connecting with listeners through interviews, live appearances, remotes, and community events
  • Representing the station at promotions, live broadcasts, and special programming initiatives
  • Producing commercials and assisting with market-wide programming and content needs
  • Championing the station brand “on the streets” by building authentic community relationships
  • Collaborating with on-air, digital, production, and sales teams to support integrated content initiatives
  • Creating and publishing original video content regularly, including social-first short-form video (Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts) and longer-form segments that grow your personal on-screen brand
  • Prospecting and developing endorsement and influencer partnerships with local businesses, pitching yourself as a trusted community voice who can authentically promote products and services across on-air, video, and social platforms
  • Participating in person in high-visibility community events, client meetings, and business functions as a station ambassador who builds relationships that translate into revenue

 

What You’ll Bring:

  • Proven, active track record creating original written digital content AND video content across social platforms (show us your pages)
  • Strong on-air presence AND on-camera comfort, with the ability to connect authentically with listeners and viewers across every platform
  • Knowledge of basic FCC rules and regulations
  • Solid understanding of current events and various formats
  • Strong verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills
  • Comfort multitasking, meeting deadlines, and working in a fast-paced environment
  • Ability to operate control boards, remote broadcast equipment, and related production tools
  • Willingness to quickly learn and become proficient in NexGen and Adobe Audition
  • Exceptional public speaking, presentation, and networking skills with the confidence to walk into a business, build a relationship, and close an endorsement deal
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to prioritize effectively
  • Active video creator with a current, maintained presence on at least one short-form video platform (TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts) and demonstrated comfort on camera
  • Entrepreneurial, sales-minded instincts: you think about your personal brand as a business, proactively seek out partnership and endorsement opportunities, and are motivated by revenue tied to your influence
  • Experience with or strong interest in influencer marketing, brand endorsements, or sponsored content creation, including the ability to pitch yourself compellingly to local advertisers
  • High School Diploma (required)
  • Valid driver's license, auto insurance, and vehicle (required)

 

What’s In It for You?

We offer a supportive environment where talent is developed and growth is encouraged:

  • Competitive salary + bonus program + endorsement revenue opportunities (your influence = your upside)
  • 3 weeks PTO + 9 paid holidays
  • Medical, Dental, Vision, and Pet Insurance
  • 401(k) Retirement Plan
  • Company-provided laptop
  • Casual, high-energy work environment
  • Opportunities for upward mobility within a growing media organization
  • Company discounts
  • Volunteer Time Off—give back to your community
  • And much more…

 

Ready to Own Your Market? Apply Today!

job.title: Manager, Talent Management
job.description:
Position Summary

The Manager, Talent Management, is responsible for building and maintaining the organization's talent architecture, development infrastructure and HR communications strategy.

This role serves as the enterprise owner of talent processes, learning and development systems, performance management architecture, Continuity Planning infrastructure, compliance training and HR communications.

The Manager establishes the frameworks, systems, tools and resources that enable HR Business Partners and leaders to effectively develop, manage and retain talent within their businesses.

This role also provides strategic oversight of recruiting processes and partners closely with the Recruitment Consultant to deliver enterprise recruiting capability.

Key Responsibilities

Talent Acquisition

  • Own the enterprise recruiting framework,processes and standards. 
  • Establish recruiting practices,toolsand metrics.
  • Partner with the Recruitment Consultant on sourcing, recruiting execution and hard-to-fill positions.
  • Support workforce planning and recruitingstrategy.
  • Oversee employer brand and candidate experience. 
  • Coordinate recruiting campaigns, job fairs and community/HBCU recruiting partnerships. 
  • Partner with the Sports HRBP on seasonal and high-volume recruiting needs. 
  • Develop recruiting analytics and reporting. 
  • Identify opportunities to improve recruiting technology and processes. 

Talent Development

  • Own the enterprise talent development framework. 
  • Develop and maintain career development resources and programs. 
  • Partner with HRBPs to identify development needs and translate them into enterprise learning solutions. 
  • Support leadership development,architecture and programming.
  • Establish development resources for managers and employees. 
  • Connect learning opportunities to talent review and development planning.
  • Support enterprise skills development and emerging capability initiatives. 

Performance Management

Own the architecture; HRBPs deliver it in the businesses.

  • Own the enterprise performance management framework,process and calendar. 
  • Maintain performance management tools,templates and resources.
  • Develop manager training and enablement. 
  • Support calibration methodology and tools. 
  • Maintain performance management systems and processes. 
  • Analyze performance trends and recommend improvements. 
  • Partner with HRBPs on business implementation and manager support. 

Continuity Planning / Succession

Own the architecture; HRBPs facilitate business talent conversations.

  • Own the enterprise Continuity Planning framework and process. 
  • Develop tools for critical role identification, talent assessment and successor readiness.
  • Maintain the annual talent review/continuity calendar. 
  • Build development planning resources connected to succession needs. 
  • Maintain enterprise reporting and tracking. 
  • Partner with HRBPs to ensure consistent application across businesses. 
  • Support enterprise-level talent discussions led by the VP HR. 

Learning & LMS

  • Own the enterprise LMS and learning framework. 
  • Coordinate required and compliance training. 
  • Develop learning pathways and resources. 
  • Track participation and completion. 
  • Evaluate learning effectiveness. 
  • Partner with HRBPs to identify business-specific learning needs. 
  • Support manager and leadership development programs. 

Compliance

  • Coordinate enterprise HR compliance training and tracking. 
  • Maintain compliance training calendars. 
  • Partner with the Director, HR Operations and Legal/HR Specialist on compliance requirements. 
  • Support audits and documentation. 
  • Develop employee and manager communications related to compliance requirements. 
  • Monitor completion and escalate gaps. 


Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree required.
  • SHRM or HRCI certification preferred.
  • 5+ years of progressive HR, talent, learning,recruiting or communications experience.
  • Demonstrated experience designing HR programs and processes. 
  • Strong project management skills. 
  • Experience with HR technology/LMS platforms. 
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to translate strategy into practical tools and programs. 
  • Experience working across multiple business units preferred.

Benefits: 

  • Competitive salary based on experience.
  • Benefits package including:
    1. Comprehensive health insurance plan options
    2. Vision and Dental Insurance
    3. Company sponsored life insurance
    4. Numerous voluntary benefit options – legal plans, pet insurance, discounted home and auto and more!
    5. 401K with company match
    6. Generous paid time off
    7. 9 paid company holidays
  • Opportunities for professional development and career growth.

job.title: Coordinator, Channel Operations (FAST)
job.description:
Tennis Channel is seeking a highly organized, proactive, and detail-oriented Coordinator, Channel Operations to support the 24/7/365 operational execution and day-of-air integrity of our expanding portfolio of FAST (Free Ad-Supported Streaming Television) channels, including Tennis Channel 2 and PickleballTV.

Reporting directly to the Manager, FAST Channel Operations, this role serves as an essential operational point of contact responsible for daily playlist preparation, live tournament tracking, metadata accuracy, advertising cue-point verification, and transmission quality control. Because professional tennis operates across global time zones, this position requires full flexibility to work non-traditional hours—including dedicated overnights, early mornings, weekends, and holidays aligned with international tournament coverage.

The ideal candidate thrives in a high-tempo live sports broadcast environment, possesses sharp technical and editorial problem-solving skills, and demonstrates meticulous attention to detail under tight live-to-air deadlines.

This role is onsite and located in Santa Monica, CA.

 

  • Hours & Shift Structure: 24/7/365 operations coverage. This is a full-time position working dedicated overnight and early-morning shifts, including weekends and holidays, aligned with live tournament windows across worldwide time zones (ATP/WTA global tours, Grand Slams, PPA pickleball).

  •  

In this role you will...

Execute Channel Scheduling & Playout

  • Under the direction of the Manager, build, review, maintain, and release accurate daily and multi-day channel playlists utilizing cloud-based playout systems (e.g., Amagi) and traffic schedules.

  • Coordinate playlist timing and media elements for live matches, studio wrap shows, encore telecasts, original programming, and promotional priority blocks.

  • Monitor live-event tournament dynamics—including weather interruptions, match overruns, court assignments, and join-in-progress (JIP) scenarios—and make real-time playlist and log adjustments to maintain schedule integrity.

  • Execute day-of-air programming adjustments and hot-swaps in response to breaking live tournament coverage across domestic and international time zones.

  •  

Monitor Channels & Maintain Quality Control

  • Perform active eyes-on-glass monitoring across linear FAST feeds and OTT distribution platforms (e.g., Samsung TV Plus, Roku Channel, Amazon Prime Video, Pluto TV) to ensure uninterrupted playback, audio/video synchronization, pristine picture quality, and compliant closed captioning.

  • Inspect, verify, and quality-check SCTE-35 advertising markers, program segment breaks, and commercial cue points to support monetization accuracy and viewer retention.

  • Conduct pre-air QC on playlists, media files, secondary graphics events, and promotional assets prior to scheduled transmission.

  •  

Manage Asset Ingest, Metadata & Partner Coordination

  • Track the intake, processing, segmentation, and technical validation of file-based video assets, confirming media readiness ahead of transmission deadlines.

  • Enter and audit rich program metadata, including titles, synopses, episode numbers, ratings, territorial restrictions, and Electronic Program Guide (EPG) schedules across distribution endpoints.

  • Act as the operational floor contact during live match windows, proactively logging incidents, triaging playout anomalies, and escalating technical issues to Broadcast Operations, Engineering, Playout Vendors, and Platform Support.

  • Adhere to contractual rights windows, territorial blackout rules, and network Standards & Practices guidelines.

  • Handle Operational Administration & Provide Shift Coverage

  • Maintain accurate operational shift logs, discrepancy reports, incident tickets, and daily run sheets.

  • Deliver structured, comprehensive handoffs between operational shifts to ensure continuity across tournament coverage cycles.

  • Follow and uphold standard operating procedures (SOPs) for live event execution, emergency filler routing, and ad-break contingencies.

  •  

Required Qualifications

  • Experience: Minimum 2 years of operational experience in FAST, live streaming, broadcast playout, master control, traffic, or digital media operations.

  •  

  • Shift Availability: Ability to work dedicated overnight and early-morning shifts, weekends, and holidays in a 24/7/365 live sports environment, matching the global tennis calendar.

  •  

  • Technical Proficiency: Hands-on experience working with cloud-based playout automation platforms (e.g., Amagi CLOUDPORT or similar), broadcast CMS, or traffic scheduling systems.

  •  

  • Live Operations Aptitude: Demonstrated experience handling live sports or breaking events, with the ability to calculate runtimes, adjust join-in-progress segments, and navigate delay scenarios under tight deadlines.

  •  

  • Digital Video & Metadata: Familiarity with broadcast video file specifications, closed captioning formats (608/708, WebVTT), SCTE-35 cue markers, EPG delivery, and content segmentation.

  •  

  • Communication & Composure: Strong verbal and written communication skills; proven ability to collaborate effectively across technical, editorial, and commercial teams while maintaining composure during high-pressure live broadcast situations.

  •  

  • Computer Skills: Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, Teams, SharePoint/OneDrive) and broadcast collaboration tools.

  •  

Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior direct operational experience with Amagi cloud playout and scheduling workflows.

  • Prior experience supporting 24/7 live-sports FAST channels or AVOD services across major CTV aggregators.

  • Familiarity with major distribution delivery endpoints (Roku, Samsung TV Plus, Amazon Prime Video, Fubo, Apple, etc.).

  • Working knowledge of professional tennis (ATP/WTA tours, tournament structures, time-zone shifts) and pickleball (PPA).

About Tennis Channel

Tennis Channel is the only multiplatform destination dedicated solely to tennis year-round. Together, the Tennis Channel flagship network, Tennis Channel 2, and the Tennis Channel app (tennischannel.com) deliver the most accessible and concentrated single-sport coverage anywhere. As the exclusive U.S. home of the ATP Tour and WTA Tour, Tennis Channel features live coverage of every Masters 1000 tournament — including Indian Wells, the Miami Open, Madrid, Rome, Cincinnati, and more — alongside live studio programming including its premier series, TC Live. Tennis Channel 2, a free FAST channel available in over 100 million homes, brings fans matches from across the globe at every level of the game. You are a hands-on technical leader who designs platforms, not just pipelines. You are equally comfortable writing production code, defending an architecture in a design review, pairing with a junior engineer on a tricky problem, and explaining trade-offs to executives.

You bring:

  • Expert-level knowledge of Google Cloud Platform data services, especially BigQuery, Pub/Sub, Dataflow (Apache Beam), Cloud Composer, and Cloud Storage
  • Deep experience designing real-time and event-driven architectures with exactly-once semantics, late-arriving data, and schema evolution
  • Mastery of Python and SQL, and data transformation frameworks such as dbt
  • A track record of setting technical direction for a platform used by many teams, and seeing it through multi-quarter delivery

·       Experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools such as Pulumi or Terraform

·       Excellent problem-solving skills with the ability to design scalable and efficient solutions

Data Platform Architecture, Development & Technical Strategy

·       Own assigned pipelines end to end, from design and development through testing, deployment, and production support

Cross-Functional Collaboration

·       Partner with Product Managers, Data Scientists, Analysts, and Engineering teams to understand business requirements and translate them into technical solutions

·       Collaborate with stakeholders to identify opportunities for process improvements and operational efficiencies

Performance & Optimization

·       Optimize data storage, processing, and orchestration for performance, scalability, and cost efficiency, including BigQuery query and storage costs

·       Monitor, troubleshoot, and resolve data pipeline and platform issues, and contribute to incident reviews

·       Implement best practices for data governance, observability, testing, and CI/CD

  • Lead incident response for severe data incidents, run blameless postmortems, and drive systemic fixes

Leadership & Team Contribution

·       Mentor and support junior data engineers through technical guidance, code reviews, and knowledge sharing

·       Contribute to architectural decisions and engineering best practices

·       Participate in technical interviews and help grow a high-performing data engineering team

  • Evaluate and drive adoption of emerging technologies, including AI-assisted engineering workflows and LLM-enabled data tooling, while maintaining strong quality and security standards

You Have (Qualifications & Experience)

Required Experience & Skills

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical field, or equivalent experience
  • 12+ years of experience in Data Engineering, Data Warehousing, or Big Data environments
  • 2+ years in a Tech-lead role setting technical direction across teams
  • Demonstrated experience mentoring and developing junior and mid-level engineers
  • Proven track record designing and running real-time data platforms in production at high volume, for example billions of events per day
  • Expert-level experience with GCP: BigQuery, Pub/Sub, Dataflow (Apache Beam), Cloud Composer (Airflow), and Cloud Storage; AWS experience will also be considered
  • Expert-level Python and SQL, and production experience with dbt
  • Deep knowledge of stream processing concepts: event time vs. processing time, windowing, watermarks, exactly-once delivery, and backpressure; Kafka, Flink, or Spark
  • Expert understanding of data modeling for analytics, including dimensional modeling, event modeling, and lakehouse table formats such as Apache Iceberg
  • Strong experience with Infrastructure as Code (Pulumi or Terraform), CI/CD, and automated testing for data pipelines
  • Demonstrated ownership of data reliability: SLOs, data observability, incident management, and postmortems
  • Demonstrated success reducing cloud data platform cost at scale
  • Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills, including design documents and communication with technical and executive audiences

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in subscription, streaming video (OTT), media, or sports organizations, including playback quality, engagement, and ad-supported (AVOD) data
  • Experience supporting ML and data science workloads: feature pipelines, real-time features, recommendation and personalization data
  • Experience with data contracts, schema registries, and data catalog or lineage tools

ELIGIBILITY REQUIREMENTS

job.description:
About TEGNA

TEGNA Inc. helps people thrive in their local communities by providing the trusted local news and services that matter most. With 64 television stations in 51 U.S. markets, TEGNA reaches more than 100 million people monthly across the web, mobile apps, streaming, and linear television. Together, we are building a sustainable future for local news.

 

Executive Producer, Mornings

WUSA9, the TEGNA-owned CBS affiliate in Washington, DC, is seeking an executive producer to oversee our talented team of producers, reporters and anchors for our morning show. The perfect candidate will possess prior TV leadership experience, is committed to delivering best-in-class content to our audiences on all platforms, and a desire to mentor and offer regular feedback to the team. Our team strives for growth, and we seek a leader who shares this ambition. As the executive producer, you will work closely with producers to create captivating shows and explore new methods of presenting audience-focused content that aligns with the needs of our community on both broadcast and digital platforms.

Responsibilities:

● Collaborate and execute long-term newsroom strategy

● Train, develop, and coach the newsroom team with a focus on mentoring content creators across all platforms

● Oversee the daily editorial process

● Oversee the on-air execution and provide coaching and showcasing techniques

● Review, approve scripts, and provide writing/copy editing to rundowns to ensure accuracy and quality

● Source and recruit top-notch journalists

● Participate in coordinating all aspects of coverage, from breaking news to enterprise story production and specials

● Ensure the news coverage meets our brand, policies, values, and FCC rules

● Work with newsroom management to meet audience goals and further develop our local brand


Skills and Experience Required:

● Bachelor’s degree in journalism or related field

● 7-10 years’ experience as a news producer and newsroom leader

● Positive track record of quality journalism, high integrity, and ethical decision-making

● Passion for growing journalists and fostering a creative, positive, and collaborative newsroom

● Ability to calmly handle live, breaking news, and changing events

● Strong organization, planning skills and the ability to work under constant time-sensitive deadlines

● Knowledge of AP ENPS, Edius, photojournalism, video editing, and content management systems a plus

● Understanding of copyright law, music rights and basic journalism legal principals.

● Well versed in online metrics such as Google Analytics, Social News Desk, Facebook Insights, YouTube Analytics, etc.

● Working knowledge of Content Management Systems, Basic HTML, AP style and live-stream technology

● Strong understanding of all social media platforms and how they contribute to overall success

● Keen interest in emerging digital trends and evolving consumption habits

● Familiarity with the Washington DC region is a plus

In this role, you’ll work at the intersection of digital marketing and one of the most trusted media networks in the country—helping businesses connect with customers across the full marketing funnel.

2+ years of B2B sales experience with success in new business development, account growth, or business development roles

Prefer marketing experience in the Real Estate Vertical including brokerage firms, developers, high end luxury real estate and more.

Ability to run a full-cycle, consultative sales process—from discovery through proposal, negotiation, and close.

Strong prospecting skills across phone, email, social, networking, and relationship-based outreach.

Experience using CRM and sales tools with disciplined pipeline management and follow-up.

Comfort learning and discussing digital marketing solutions such as search, social, display, and video (direct experience is a plus, not required).

Excellent communication skills, business curiosity, and the ability to build credibility with diverse clients and stakeholders, influencing decisions through clear data-driven recommendations.

Proficiency with CRM, Microsoft Office Suite, and AI tools such as Microsoft Copilot and Perplexity.

Valid driver’s license and vehicle insurance

Who Thrives Here

High performers in this role are resilient, self-motivated, strategic and creative minded and competitive, with a strong drive to outperform and continuously take on greater impact. They are coachable and highly self-directed, comfortable initiating outreach, staying organized, asking thoughtful questions, and using data and tools to work efficiently. Energized by real-time results, they handle rejection well and maintain full ownership of their performance and trajectory.

Benefits

We believe high performance should be recognized and supported through compensation, development, and real opportunity to grow your skills.

Competitive base salary + Uncapped commission opportunity

401(k) with company match

Career progression opportunities

Flexibility and autonomy in a hybrid/remote work environment

High-performance culture with recognition, incentives, and more.

Comprehensive health, dental & vision coverage options and more

Unlimited MTO time off, including paid holidays

Structured onboarding to get you ramped fast

Ongoing coaching from experienced leaders

Access to industry-leading tools, resources, and marketing expertise

job.title: Director, Marketing Operations – Email & Digital Subscriptions
job.description:
Director, Marketing Operations at Hearst Newspapers

About the Role

Hearst Newspapers is looking for a strategic and hands-on Director of Marketing Operations to lead the technology, processes, and team supporting our digital subscription marketing business.

Reporting to the VP of Digital Subscriptions, this role leads a team of four and serves as the operational bridge between Marketing, Product, Engineering, Business Intelligence, Editorial, Finance, and Customer Service.

A major focus of the role is email and newsletter optimization- ensuring our customer communications, lifecycle programs, audience segmentation, personalization, and marketing automation are effective, scalable, and continuously improving.

This person will also help manage and evolve the MarTech ecosystem supporting our digital subscriber journey, from audience and customer data through website experiences, offers, checkout, and ongoing subscriber communications.

This is not primarily a campaign execution, Sales Operations, Ad Operations, or project management role. We’re looking for someone who understands the technology behind modern marketing and can translate business needs into scalable solutions.

What You’ll Do

* Lead and develop a team of four Marketing Operations professionals.
* Own and continuously improve the technology and operational processes supporting email, newsletters, lifecycle marketing, CRM/CDP, and marketing automation.
* Partner with Marketing and Editorial to improve the performance, personalization, segmentation, and effectiveness of email and newsletter programs.
* Work closely with Product and Engineering to translate marketing needs into technical requirements and deliver new capabilities.
* Help oversee the technology supporting the digital customer journey, including websites, audience data, personalization, subscription offers, and customer communications.
* Diagnose and troubleshoot issues across platforms, data flows, integrations, campaigns, and customer experiences.
* Establish effective intake, prioritization, QA, governance, and release processes across multiple Hearst newspaper markets.
* Identify opportunities to use AI and automation to reduce manual work, improve efficiency, and enable Marketing teams to do more.
* Evaluate vendors and technology solutions and help ensure the MarTech ecosystem is scalable and well integrated.
* Build strong relationships across Marketing, Product, Engineering, BI, Editorial, Finance, and Customer Service.
* Create processes and capabilities that can scale consistently across Hearst Newspapers’ markets while still supporting local needs.

What We’re Looking For

Required:

* Significant experience in Marketing Operations, preferably leading a Marketing Operations function or team.
* Deep, hands-on experience with email and/or newsletter operations, including segmentation, lifecycle communications, personalization, QA, testing, and optimization.
* Strong knowledge of MarTech platforms, marketing automation, CRM/CDP, and customer data.
* Experience partnering closely with Product and Engineering to build or improve marketing capabilities.
* Strong understanding of how data moves across marketing systems and the ability to troubleshoot issues and identify root causes.
* Experience managing and prioritizing competing requests across multiple stakeholders or business units.
* Proven people leadership experience.
* Strong business judgment and the ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear business decisions.
* Experience using AI and automation to improve marketing processes and team efficiency.

Preferred:

* Experience in media, publishing, subscriptions, or consumer marketing.
* Experience supporting multiple brands, markets, or decentralized organizations.
* Experience with website/digital customer experiences, personalization, subscription offers, or checkout.
* Experience with platforms such as BlueConic, Sailthru, Salesforce, or comparable MarTech solutions.
* Familiarity with SQL, APIs, data integrations, or data activation.
* Experience evaluating vendors and implementing new marketing capabilities.

The Person We’re Looking For

You’re someone who enjoys figuring out how things work and how to make them work better.

You don’t simply take a request and pass it along to Engineering. You ask questions, understand the underlying business and technical problem, identify the right solution, and bring the right teams together to make it happen.

You’re comfortable moving between marketing strategy, technology, data, and operations, and you know when to get into the details and when to step back and lead.

You’re curious about AI, constantly looking for ways to eliminate manual work, and comfortable operating in a complex, multi-market organization where priorities don’t always align.

 

Our Benefits: At Hearst Newspapers we not only support our employees through personal and professional development, but we also believe in promoting each individual’s physical, financial and emotional wellbeing (and that of their family).  Our industry-leading benefits include:

job.title: Senior Audience Producer
job.description:
Senior Audience Producer

Hearst Connecticut Media Group is looking for an innovative, collaborative Senior Audience Producer to help guide ambitious journalism through audience insights, thoughtful optimization and responsible use of AI. Working alongside editors and reporters, this role will help drive engagement, subscriptions and return visits across CT Insider’s digital platforms, newsletters, social media, audio and print.

This is a digital newsroom audience role - not a television or live-news producing position. We are looking for a journalist who understands digital audiences, analytics, content optimization and audience strategy, and who can work closely with reporters and editors to help journalism reach and resonate with more readers.

Senior Audience Producers will embed with key newsroom topic teams, which may include data, state politics, investigations, education, business, real estate, high school sports and UConn sports. This is an opportunity to innovate, experiment and help strengthen the reach and impact of journalism that matters to Connecticut communities.

 

About the Team

Hearst Connecticut Media Group (HCMG) is a collection of the state’s most important news properties, providing local, watchdog and investigative reporting that impacts communities across Connecticut.

HCMG includes close to 170 journalists working at 10 daily newspapers – Connecticut Post, Greenwich Time, Journal Inquirer, The Middletown Press, The New Haven Register, The News-Times, The Norwalk Hour, Record-Journal, Republican-American and Stamford Advocate – 13 weekly newspapers, Connecticut Magazine and multiple websites.

HCMG expanded further in 2021 with the launch of Connecticut’s No. 1 statewide news source, CTInsider.com, covering everything from sports and politics to breaking news stories and compelling features about Connecticut residents and businesses.

 

Key Responsibilities

* Collaborate with editors, reporters, photographers and audience team members to ensure journalism engages, retains and converts local readers into subscribers.

* Analyze and interpret audience metrics, translating insights into clear recommendations that inform short- and long-term coverage decisions.

* Optimize journalism across websites, social media, newsletters and search to expand reach and deepen audience engagement.

* Use topic-area knowledge and audience insights to identify story opportunities and develop recurring content series and annual special projects.

* Guide responsible and relevant use of AI and other emerging tools to improve newsroom workflows and audience outcomes.

* Communicate across departments during breaking and planned news events to alert audiences to key developments across platforms.

* Support topic teams in planning and executing audience strategies that encourage return visits and subscriber growth.

* Lead or contribute to livestreams and podcasts that engage and retain audiences, where applicable.

 

Qualifications

* Strong editorial judgment and experience working in a deadline-driven digital news or journalism environment.

* Demonstrated understanding of digital audience development, engagement and content optimization.

* Ability to optimize stories for websites, social media, newsletters and search.

* Strong comfort with analyzing and interpreting metrics and communicating what the data means.

* Experience editing short- and mid-form video, photos and audio using tools such as Canva, Photoshop or Premiere.

* Excellent writing, editing and verbal communication skills.

* A quick, organized and technically capable problem solver who consistently meets deadlines.

* Strong organizational and detail-oriented skills, with the ability to effectively manage multiple priorities.

* Flexibility to work nights and weekends for breaking news and special content opportunities.

* Collaborative approach and curiosity about audience behavior, journalism and emerging technology.

 

Preferred qualifications

* Knowledge of topic area in sports

* Experience planning and running livestreams and podcasts that engage and retain viewers.

* Experience using analytics to shape editorial strategy and coverage decisions.

* Experience developing strategic plans or audience-focused digital initiatives.

 

Please note: This role is not a television producer, live-news producer or broadcast production position. Candidates whose experience is primarily focused on producing television newscasts, live broadcasts or broadcast control-room operations are not the target profile for this position.

 

Compensation & Benefits

The reasonable estimate for this role, if hired in Connecticut, is $56,000 - $66,000 base. A final decision on the successful candidate’s starting salary will be based on a number of permissible, non-discriminatory factors, including but not limited to skills and experience, training, certifications and education.

We are proud to offer generous health and wellness benefits, competitive paid time off, financial programs like 401k matching and tuition assistance, and additional perks like company matching for charitable donations.

This hybrid position (3 days / week) based in Norwalk, Connecticut, and is not eligible for remote candidates. 

Hearst is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

job.title: Staff Software Engineer, New York Magazine
job.description:
Staff Software Engineer, New York Magazine

Vox Media Group LLC

Vox Media Group LLC is seeking a Staff Software Engineer to help shape the technology behind New York Magazine’s journalism and consumer subscriptions business. Your primary focus will be the websites, publishing platform, and subscription experiences supporting New York, The Cut, Vulture, Intelligencer, The Strategist, Grub Street, and Curbed. You’ll also contribute to the NYMag mobile apps for iOS and Android.

As a hands-on technical engineering leader, you’ll help editors publish compelling stories, readers discover journalism they value, and subscribers get the most from their relationship with our brands. Your work will span editorial experiences and the subscriber journey, from registration and purchase through onboarding, account management, and ongoing engagement.

You’ll partner with product, design, editorial, and consumer revenue teams to guide technical decisions and deliver improvements across web and mobile. You’ll also help advance our responsible use of AI and agentic workflows to increase delivery speed, expand engineering capacity, and improve efficiency.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Lead complex engineering initiatives. Translate product and business needs into technical plans, align collaborators around architectural decisions, and guide projects from discovery through delivery and operation.
  • Build and improve consumer subscription experiences. Develop subscription offers, checkout flows, promotions, gifting, onboarding, and account management features that support acquisition, conversion, and retention.
  • Strengthen subscriber identity and access. Improve the integrations connecting authentication, payments, subscription status, and content entitlements so readers can reliably access what they’ve purchased across web and mobile.
  • Support experimentation and growth. Partner with consumer revenue, product, and analytics teams to improve paywalls, registration experiences, and subscription journeys through reliable experiments and measurable results.
  • Evolve our publishing platform. Build reusable components, editorial tools, and reader experiences that support the distinct needs of our brands and make publishing easier.
  • Contribute to the NYMag mobile app. Partner with mobile engineers on reading experiences, content discovery, and subscriber features. Design APIs and content models that support consistent experiences across platforms.
  • Guide incremental modernization. Identify architectural risks and technical debt, improve developer workflows, and balance near-term delivery with the long-term maintainability of an established platform.
  • Improve quality and reliability. Investigate production issues, strengthen automated testing and observability, and address performance, accessibility, and security across publishing and subscription workflows.
  • Champion responsible AI use. Develop and refine AI-assisted and agentic workflows for implementation, testing, debugging, review, and documentation. Protect sensitive information, validate generated changes, and maintain accountability for the resulting software.
  • Help the team succeed. Mentor engineers, lead constructive code and design reviews, document important decisions, and establish shared practices that improve the team’s effectiveness.

We’re looking for someone who brings:

  • Deep JavaScript expertise and substantial experience building and operating production web applications and Node.js services.
  • A track record of leading complex technical initiatives across systems or teams, with impact beyond their individual contributions.
  • Strong frontend fundamentals, including HTML, CSS, accessibility, browser behavior, and application performance, alongside experience with frameworks such as Vue or React.
  • Experience designing APIs, data models, and integrations, including reliable handling of authentication, authorization, and transactional workflows.
  • Sound judgment when evolving mature codebases, including knowing when to extend existing patterns and when to introduce new approaches.
  • Strong debugging and testing skills, with experience diagnosing problems across application, service, and data boundaries.
  • The ability to connect engineering decisions to reader experience and business outcomes, including subscription conversion, engagement, and retention.
  • Experience using AI development tools responsibly, including providing useful context, evaluating generated output, and recognizing when human review and decision-making are essential.
  • Clear communication, collaborative technical leadership, and the ability to contribute to a TypeScript and React Native codebase.

Additional experience that would be valuable includes:

  • Consumer subscriptions, digital media, ecommerce, or other businesses built around recurring customer relationships.
  • Paywalls, payment platforms, subscription billing integrations, identity systems, or entitlement management.
  • Experimentation platforms, conversion analytics, and customer lifecycle experiences.
  • React Native, Expo, or shipping applications for iOS and Android.
  • Content management systems, editorial workflows, PostgreSQL, Redis, or Elasticsearch.
  • Building reusable AI workflows, agent tooling, or automation that improves engineering productivity.

Our web platform uses Node.js, Express, Clay CMS, Vue, and Handlebars. Our mobile app uses TypeScript, React Native, and Expo. You’ll work across these technologies and the services connecting content, customer accounts, and subscriptions.

We value curiosity, trust, respect, and clear communication. We’re looking for someone who enjoys sharing knowledge, learning from colleagues, and helping the whole team succeed. We encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn’t match every technology listed.

PAY TRANSPARENCY

The salary range listed below represents the minimum and maximum base pay for this position at the time of this posting. Final salary offered to the candidate selected for the position will be based on factors including but not limited to the candidate's skills and experience.

Pay Range$160,000—$220,000 USD

Vox Media is committed to building an inclusive environment where everyone can show up as their authentic selves and create their best work. We recognize that great stories, platforms, products and services come from people with all manner of backgrounds and experiences. We recognize that our commitments require ongoing work and sustained attention, as well as adaptation to new insights and best practices.
