With approximately one-third of all global media spend flowing through WPP, our platform operates at the core of this massive network-deeply integrated and adopted by the largest supply-side partners in the AdTech industry. Operating at our scale presents unique engineering challenges. Our edge services currently handle over 60,000 classification requests per second, while our contextual classification pipelines process 10,000 requests per second. With operations spanning the US, UK, and ongoing expansion into EMEA and APAC, our infrastructure continuously interacts with up to 98% of the population in our active markets. We are an engineering-led team focused on building robust, scalable, and highly reliable systems.

 

WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

We are looking for a Lead Software Engineer who thrives on owning backend systems end to end — architecture, delivery, and the people who build them. You care more about sound software design, reliable APIs, and clear ownership than about any single framework or language.

You are comfortable setting technical direction for a squad, mentoring engineers, and turning product roadmap into shippable, versioned contracts. Hands-on when it matters, you design and operate services, partner integrations, and orchestration components in production — authentication, retries, idempotency, rate limiting, and the operational discipline that keeps live systems healthy. You are likely highly proficient in a backend language such as Python, Go, or Java/Kotlin, and experienced with cloud platforms, containers/Kubernetes, CI/CD, and production observability. Interest in infrastructure as code (e.g. Terraform), durable workflows, and AI coding assistants is a plus when it helps the team ship faster without lowering the quality bar.

Beyond the technical craft, you are a strong communicator who can explain trade-offs to engineers, Product, and non-technical stakeholders, and align sibling teams on interfaces. You take ownership of reliability and technical debt for the systems your squad runs, escalate blockers early with clear options, and are motivated by growing both the platform and the engineers who build it.

 

WHY ARE WE HIRING We are at a critical inflection point in our growth and need to scale our engineering team to tackle an expanding set of complex challenges. As the digital ecosystem evolves, we are actively developing and releasing a new catalog of privacy-preserving data products. These solutions are designed to scale advanced targeting capabilities while remaining uncompromising on our promise to protect user privacy.

To support this product evolution, our infrastructure is undergoing massive global expansion. By the end of this year, we will be fully operational across the rest of the EMEA and APAC regions. Concurrently, we are deepening our integrations to support even more of the largest supply-side partners in the AdTech industry. We are hiring because we need strong engineering talent to help us architect for this next order of magnitude in scale-ensuring our systems remain resilient, performant, and compliant as our global footprint and feature set rapidly expand.

 

WHAT YOU WILL DO:

· Lead an engineering squad: set technical direction, prioritize delivery, run design and code reviews, and grow engineers through mentoring and clear ownership.

· Own the architecture and health of activation and orchestration services — API, databases, partner gateways, internal integrations, MCP and agentic integrations.

· Partner with Product and sibling teams to turn roadmap phases into shippable, versioned contracts — not ad hoc

integrations.

· Drive API integration engineering: authentication, rate limiting, idempotency, retries, partial-update patterns, and runbooks as partner APIs evolve.

· Establish and uphold production standards — CI/CD, testing, observability, auditability, and safe release practices.

· Keep an end-to-end overview of how data flow through activation — what is live, what is in progress, and where dependencies or technical debt block the next phase.

· Contribute hands-on where it matters: critical paths, new gateways, framework foundations (e.g. tool registry, workflow runtime, guardrails hooks).

· Identify and address technical debt deliberately; balance speed with reliability for systems that support live campaigns.

· Share knowledge in design reviews, stand-ups, and cross-team forums; escalate blockers early with clear options.

· Stay curious about agentic orchestration, durable workflows, and AI coding assistants to improve how the team designs and ships software.

 

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

· Strong communication — you explain trade-offs to engineers, product, and non-technical stakeholders and align multiple teams on interfaces.

· 6+ years in software engineering with 2+ years leading engineers or owning a significant technical area (team lead, staff, or equivalent).

· Proven delivery of backend and API-centric systems in production — services, integrations, or platforms at meaningful scale.

· Solid experience building and operating REST/HTTP APIs and event- or workflow-driven systems (durable state, async jobs, or orchestration).

· Comfort owning third-party integrations — auth, errors, versioning, operational monitoring, and partner-driven change.

· Strong proficiency in at least one backend language (e.g. Python, Go, or Java/Kotlin) and sound software design (patterns, testing, code review).

· Experience with CI/CD, Git, and testing — unit, integration, and boundary/contract tests where APIs matter.

· Experience with cloud platforms (GCP, AWS, or Azure) and deploying services with containers and Kubernetes.

· Familiarity with infrastructure as code (e.g. Terraform) and production observability (metrics, logs, tracing).

· A track record of technical debt and reliability ownership — incidents, postmortems, and systemic fixes, not one-off firefighting.

· Interest in leveraging AI coding assistants and prompt engineering to improve team productivity without lowering the production bar.

 

NICE TO HAVE

About WPP Open Intelligence

The Activation team is the engineering arm of WPP Open Intelligence. We build the foundational data infrastructure and high-performance edge services that support WPP’s activation capabilities.

Approximately one-third of global media spend flows through WPP, and our platform is deeply integrated with major supply-side partners across the AdTech industry. At our current scale, our edge services handle more than 60,000 classification requests per second, while our contextual classification pipelines process approximately 10,000 requests per second.

With operations across the US and UK and planned expansion across EMEA and APAC, our infrastructure operates at significant global scale. We are an engineering-led team focused on building robust, scalable, highly reliable systems.

Why We’re Hiring

We are expanding our engineering team to support the next stage of growth and a new catalog of privacy-preserving data products. These products are designed to scale advanced targeting capabilities while protecting user privacy.

Our infrastructure is expanding globally, and we are deepening integrations with leading supply-side partners in the AdTech industry. We are looking for engineers who can help us design for the next order of magnitude while keeping our systems resilient, performant, observable, and compliant.

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will own reliable backend services and API integrations in production. You will help drive solutions from design through delivery, raising the quality of both the systems we build and the way we operate them.

You will work across partner API clients, internal APIs, workflow steps, orchestration components, and the interfaces between Open Intelligence and activation systems. We value strong software engineering fundamentals—including clean design, testable code, and sound operational practices—over allegiance to any particular framework.

  • Design, develop, and review backend services and API integrations to a high engineering standard.
  • Own and evolve orchestration and gateway components, including workflow steps, partner API clients, internal service APIs, and activation interfaces.
  • Partner with Product, lead engineers, and teams across audience, data, and performance to turn requirements into durable production services.
  • Build robust integrations with authentication, rate limiting, idempotency, retries, partial-update patterns, versioning, clear error handling, and operational runbooks.
  • Establish and maintain production standards for CI/CD, unit and integration testing, API contract testing, observability, auditability, and safe releases.
  • Maintain an end-to-end view of the activation flows you support, identifying dependencies, incidents, and technical debt and proposing sequenced improvements.
  • Contribute hands-on to critical foundations such as gateways, tool registries, workflow runtimes, and guardrails hooks; mentor colleagues through design reviews, code reviews, and pairing.

You will collaborate closely with Product, lead engineers, and sibling teams across audience, data, and performance. You will contribute to an engineering-led environment where teams communicate trade-offs clearly, share ownership of end-to-end flows, and work together to improve reliability over time.

  • A track record of delivering and operating backend services, integrations, or platforms in production at meaningful scale.
  • Strong proficiency in at least one backend language, such as Python, Go, or Java/Kotlin; Python is preferred.
  • Experience designing and operating REST/HTTP APIs and event- or workflow-driven systems, such as asynchronous jobs, queues, durable state, or orchestration.
  • Experience owning third-party and internal integrations, including authentication, error handling, versioning, monitoring, and partner-driven change.

  • Experience with cloud platforms, containers, Kubernetes, infrastructure as code such as Terraform, and production observability through metrics, logs, or tracing.

WPP is undertaking a major transformation of its enterprise Service Management capability, replacing its existing ServiceNow platform with a modern, AI-enabled service management platform that will establish a simpler, more standardised, and scalable global operating model. The current environment has evolved over many years and now requires a structured re-platforming programme to remove legacy complexity, reduce fragmentation, improve governance, and align more closely with industry best practice. 

This role will own the platform that underpins service management across Technology Operations and the wider Enterprise Technology team along with Finance, HR, and other corporate functions, making it a strategically important platform. Working with senior stakeholders and strategic implementation partners, you will define and deliver the future service management capability, ensuring the platform, operating model, governance, and service management processes support a modern, scalable, AI-enabled enterprise. 

The successful candidate will bring deep expertise in Enterprise Service Management and ITIL, with the judgement to apply industry best practice pragmatically rather than dogmatically. You will understand how to leverage the best elements of ITIL and modern service management frameworks to design efficient, automated, and user-centric services that improve employee experience, simplify operations, and provide a scalable foundation for WPP’s future. 

What you'll be doing:

  • Lead the end-to-end transformation of WPP’s Service Management Platform across strategy, design, delivery, migration, rollout and adoption. 
  • Define and execute a comprehensive transformation plan aligned to WPP’s Technology Operations strategy, including a clean rebuild approach that prioritises standard platform capabilities and reduces customisation. 
  • Remove legacy complexity, duplication, fragmented processes and technical debt while establishing a single, coherent global operating model for service management. 
  • Design and deliver an AI-enabled service model incorporating virtual agents, conversational interfaces, automation-first workflows, self-service, intelligent routing and future agentic automation capabilities. 
  • Define and implement a new governance model, including global standards, controls, design principles, ownership structures, decision forums and design authority mechanisms. 
  • Lead delivery in partnership with Kyndryl as the operational delivery partner and the Service Management Platform vendor as the platform expertise and best-practice partner. 
  • Coordinate internal Enterprise Technology teams, delivery partners, platform specialists and senior stakeholders, creating clear accountability across all workstreams and delivery teams. 
  • Oversee redesign, rebuild, migration, testing, rollout, transition and adoption, managing risks, dependencies, issues and decisions through strong programme governance. 
  • Engage senior stakeholders across Enterprise Technology and the wider Group, providing clear updates on progress, risks, decisions and areas requiring executive steer. 
  • Ensure the transformation delivers measurable improvements in service quality, operational efficiency, user experience, scalability, governance and operational resilience. 

What you'll need:

Essential 

  • Significant experience leading large-scale technology transformation programmes in complex, global organisations. 
  • Strong understanding of enterprise service management, IT service management, service desk operations, and global support models. 
  • Proven experience delivering platform transformation, rebuild, migration, or major operating model change. 
  • Demonstrable ability to simplify complex legacy environments and move towards standardised, best-practice platform capabilities. 
  • Experience defining and implementing governance models, design principles, global standards, and operating controls. 
  • Strong delivery leadership, with the ability to manage complex plans, dependencies, risks, issues, decisions, and stakeholders. 
  • Experience working with strategic partners, managed service providers, platform vendors, and internal technology teams. 
  • Strong senior stakeholder management skills, including the ability to influence at CIO, executive, and cross-functional leadership level. 
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to present complex transformation activity clearly and concisely.
  • Strong commercial and operational judgement, with the ability to balance speed, standardisation, risk, cost, and business impact. 
  • Experience leading globally distributed teams and delivery activity across multiple regions. 

Desirable 

  • Experience implementing AI-enabled service management capabilities, including virtual agents, workflow automation, self-service, intelligent routing, and autonomous service operations. 
  • Experience with large-scale service desk transformation or managed service transition.

job.description:

Our people are the key to our success. We're committed to fostering a culture of creativity, belonging and continuous learning, attracting and developing the brightest talent, and providing exciting career opportunities that help our people grow. 
 
For more information, visit WPP.com.
 

The Role 

You are a hands-on strategist who can turn a brand problem into social work people would choose to spend time with. You find the audience behavior that matters, give social a clear job and build a plan the team can make. 

You own strategy workstreams across client brands, from always-on content to campaigns and creator work. You work with the Social Strategy Lead and with creative, account, media, production and analytics teams. You lead client conversations on your assignments and help junior strategists improve through direct feedback. 

You know the platforms from the inside, but you can also zoom out to the brand idea and the wider customer journey. You understand how organic content and paid social move people from discovery to action, and can explain why a plan should perform. 

What You Will Lead 

Social Strategy and Planning 

  • Turn business and brand briefs into audience insight, a clear social role and useful creative briefs.
  • Build always-on and campaign plans with distinct jobs for channels such as Instagram (Meta), TikTok, X, LINE and YouTube, where relevant.
  • Give organic, paid, owned and earned work distinct roles across the funnel, with creators and communities where they serve the idea.
  • Stay involved from strategy through content planning and production so the idea survives execution.

Performance, Data, and AI 

  • Use social listening, platform data and client research to find opportunities and test assumptions.
  • Lead paid social planning for your assignments: objectives, audiences, placements, budget split, creative variants and test design.
  • Work with media and analytics teams to read performance, improve creative and targeting, and make clear recommendations on spend.
  • Set KPIs for each stage of the funnel, with a baseline and a learning goal. Know when reach, engagement, traffic, conversion or cost per result matters.
  • Build agentic workflows with AI and WPP.open that turn client briefs, audience signals and performance data into strategic choices, then carry those choices into creative briefs, channel plans, content guidance and next tests, with human review.

Content and Channels 

  • Partner with creatives to shape platform-native ideas, hooks and formats that work in feeds and paid placements.
  • Write channel guidance and examples that make the strategy useful to creators and production teams.
  • Apply a current understanding of Japanese audience behavior and platform conventions.
  • Define the role of creators and influencers in the plan and how their contribution will be judged.

Client Leadership and Teamwork 

  • Lead the strategy and paid social planning workstream for assigned projects, present your thinking and handle client feedback clearly.
  • Work with account, creative, media, creator and analytics partners to make one coherent plan.
  • Mentor junior strategists through briefs, reviews and specific feedback on their work.
  • Keep decisions, deadlines and handovers clear when several projects are moving at once.

What You Bring 

Experience 

  • Strong social strategy experience across brands, with independent ownership of campaigns or always-on programs.
  • Work that shows the path from insight and brief to live content and what it achieved.
  • Experience leading paid social and performance marketing plans, with a working knowledge of how campaigns are set up, bought, optimized and measured across the funnel.
  • Working knowledge of major social platforms in Japan, organic social and creator partnerships.
  • Ability to connect brand strategy and the wider customer journey to the work social can do best.
  • Confidence presenting recommendations to clients and working across disciplines.

Craft 

  • Sharp at finding the useful insight, writing a single-minded brief and making a clear deck.
  • Able to guide content ideas without flattening what makes them native to a platform.
  • Comfortable with listening, analytics and paid platform results, and able to turn a report into the next action.
  • An instinct for building useful agentic workflows, with the judgment to check and improve their output.

Mindset 

  • Close to social culture without chasing every trend.
  • Collaborative, practical and open to challenge.
  • Calm under pressure and comfortable moving between strategy and detail.
  • Generous with junior teammates and accountable for your own work.

Language Requirements 

Able to work effectively with Japanese and English-speaking teams and clients.

Purpose:

The Social Strategy Lead plays a senior leadership role across social strategy and intelligence within WPP Content Studio Japan.

This person helps shape how social is understood, planned, measured, and evolved across Content Studio clients, including BAT, Nestle, and future WPP Japan clients.

This is not an executional planner role, but a leadership role for someone who can set direction, read culture, interpret platform signals, guide strategy teams, and help clients understand what brands should do on social and why.

The role sits at the intersection of social strategy, culture, data, platform behavior, creator ecosystems, AI-enabled workflows, and measurable business impact.

The Social Strategy Lead works closely with the Content Studio Lead, who owns business and account leadership. Together, they ensure the studio delivers work that is strategically sharp, creatively strong, operationally realistic, and commercially valuable.

What Success Looks Like

  • WPP Content Studio Japan has a clear, credible, and differentiated social POV.
  • Every client has a clear social strategy across always-on, campaign, creator, paid, organic, owned, and earned.
  • Social listening and performance data turn into real creative and business decisions.
  • Teams stop reacting to trends blindly and start using signals intelligently.
  • Clients see WPP Content Studio as a senior social strategy partner, not just a content delivery team.
  • AI and WPP.open become practical tools inside strategy, insight, ideation, reporting, and learning loops.
  • Social work becomes more platform-native, culturally relevant, measurable, and easier to scale.

Key Responsibilities

  1. Social Strategy Leadership
  • Lead social strategy initiatives across key WPP Content Studio Japan clients.
  • Set clear platform roles across Meta, TikTok, X, LINE, YouTube, emerging channels, and client-specific ecosystems.
  • Connect organic, paid, owned, earned, creator, and community activity into one clear strategic system.
  • Translate business goals into social priorities, content principles, channel roles, and measurement frameworks.
  • Ensure always-on and campaign work ladder up to a clear brand and business objective.
  • Act as the senior social strategy POV across key client conversations and internal decision-making.
  1. Social Intelligence, Culture, and Listening
  • Lead the studio’s social intelligence and listening capability.
  • Turn social signals into actionable insight, not trend noise.
  • Oversee how teams read audience behavior, platform shifts, category conversations, creator movements, and cultural tensions.
  • Build repeatable intelligence outputs for clients and internal teams.
  • Use social data to identify opportunity spaces, risk areas, content territories, creator angles, and community behaviors.
  • Ensure Japan-first cultural nuance is embedded into social strategy, especially for regulated or sensitive categories.
  1. Platform and Content Direction
  • Guide teams on what works natively across different platforms and why.
  • Define format strategy by platform, audience, behavior, and objective.
  • Shape recommendations around hooks, storytelling, creator formats, community mechanics, captions, social commerce, search behavior, and shareability.
  • Partner with creative teams to push ideas beyond generic calendars and campaign cut-downs.
  • Ensure content is designed for the feed, the algorithm, the audience, and the brand.
  1. Creator and Community Strategy
  • Define the strategic role of creators across client work.
  • Guide creator archetypes, casting logic, briefing angles, collaboration models, and success metrics.
  • Partner with casting, PR, media, and account teams to ensure creator work is more than talent selection.
  • Build community-aware thinking into social plans, including conversation drivers, UGC mechanics, participation loops, and earned potential.
  • Help clients understand when to use creators, when not to, and how to measure value beyond reach.
  1. Measurement, Reporting, and PDCA
  • Define KPI frameworks across organic, paid, creator, campaign, and always-on content.
  • Ensure reporting answers what worked, what failed, why, and what to do next.
  • Partner with analytics and media teams to connect performance data with creative decisions.
  • Establish learning loops that improve briefs, formats, creative rules, posting rhythm, and content investment.
  • Push the studio away from passive reporting and toward active optimization.
  1. AI and WPP.open Enablement
  • Use AI and WPP.open to improve strategy quality, speed, and scale.
  • Help design AI-enabled workflows for insight mining, persona development, content territory building, platform adaptation, reporting, and post-campaign learning.
  • Partner with the Chief Content Architect to codify useful agentic workflows.
  • Set clear human review points so AI supports judgment but does not replace it.
  • Help strategy teams build better prompts, better frameworks, and better decision systems.
  1. Client and Stakeholder Leadership
  • Join senior client conversations as the social strategy lead.
  • Present social POVs clearly and confidently to clients, regional teams, and internal leadership.
  • Help clients navigate platform changes without hype or panic.
  • Translate complex social behavior into simple business-facing recommendations.
  • Support new business and organic growth by showing how WPP Content Studio can lead modern social thinking.
  1. Team Leadership and Standards
  • The Social Strategy Lead works closely with strategy and planning talent across WPP Content Studio Japan to elevate strategic quality and collaboration.
  • This includes close collaboration with social strategists, content planners, social analysts, and related strategic roles across client teams.
  • The role is responsible for setting the standard of strategic thinking across the studio, ensuring that every planner and strategist works from a shared understanding of social behavior, platform roles, audience insight, creator ecosystems, and performance learning.
  • The Social Strategy Lead is accountable for developing the strategy team’s capability, reviewing strategic outputs, mentoring talent, and ensuring planners and strategists are proactive, culturally sharp, data-aware, and able to guide both clients and creative teams with confidence.
  • Create clear ways of working between strategy, creative, media, analytics, account, and production teams.
  • Build a culture of curiosity, speed, accountability, and practical excellence.

What This Role Is Not

  • Not a community manager.
  • Not a content calendar operator.
  • Not just a trend hunter.
  • Not a reporting-only role.
  • Not responsible for running the business alone.
  • Not the person who fixes every executional issue.

This person sets the social direction and ensures the studio acts intelligently.

Skills and Experience Required

  • +5 tears of strong senior experience in social, digital or content strategy, or platform-led brand strategy.
  • Proven ability to lead strategy across multiple brands or business units.
  • Deep understanding of Japan social behavior and major platforms.
  • Strong knowledge of Instagram, TikTok, X, LINE, YouTube, creator ecosystems, paid/organic dynamics, and emerging formats.
  • Hands-on experience with social listening, performance reporting, audience insight, and cultural analysis.
  • Ability to connect data, culture, platform behavior, brand goals, and creative ideas.
  • Confident client-facing presence with senior stakeholders.
  • Experience leading or mentoring strategy, planning, intelligence, or content teams.
  • Comfortable using AI tools, prompt systems, WPP.open, and automation to strengthen strategy work.
  • Strong deck, storytelling, presentation, and simplification skills.

Personal Attributes

  • Clear, calm, and decisive.
  • Culturally curious and platform-native.
  • Strategic but practical.
  • Strong enough to challenge weak thinking.
  • Collaborative without being passive.
  • Comfortable leading through influence.
  • Able to simplify complexity for clients and teams.
  • Obsessed with making the work sharper, not just faster.

  • English: Business fluent.

This role sits at the intersection of business problem-solving, human insight, cultural relevance, and creative excellence. You’ll be expected to turn messy business challenges into sharp strategic opportunities, unlock human truths that inspire standout creative work, and architect brand ecosystems that travel across channels, touchpoints, and markets.

You won’t just write decks. You’ll shape brands, influence clients, sharpen the work, raise the bar for the agency, and help build ideas that can genuinely move culture, shift perception, and drive growth.

What You’ll Do

Lead Brand Strategy

  • Develop brand strategies that create meaningful differentiation and unlock growth.
  • Define or refine brand positioning, value proposition, brand architecture, and narrative territory.
  • Help clients navigate brand transformation, portfolio shifts, innovation pipelines, and relaunches.
  • Partner with clients on both long-term brand platform thinking and immediate commercial opportunities.
  • Translate global strategy into locally resonant brand direction, and vice versa.

Drive Creative Strategy

  • Unearth insights, tensions, and cultural signals that fuel powerful creative platforms.
  • Write inspiring, brutally clear creative briefs that give teams a springboard, not a straitjacket.
  • Shape the strategic spine of campaigns, platforms, activations, launches, and content ecosystems.
  • Collaborate closely with creatives to push ideas from “interesting” to “inevitable.”
  • Interrogate the work and make it sharper, simpler, more relevant, and more effective.

Design Integrated Communications

  • Architect holistic communication systems across Paid, Owned, Earned, Shared, Retail, Social, PR, Influencer, CRM, and Commerce.
  • Build communication strategies grounded in consumer journey thinking and channel role clarity.
  • Ensure brand building and demand generation work together — not against each other.
  • Connect upstream strategic thinking to downstream execution across every consumer touchpoint.
  • Help brands show up consistently, distinctively, and contextually across the full ecosystem.

Bring Human, Cultural, and Commercial Insight

  • Decode consumer behavior, category dynamics, competitive landscapes, and shifting cultural contexts.
  • Leverage qualitative and quantitative research, social listening, desk research, trend mapping, and brand data.
  • Turn data into perspective, perspective into strategy, and strategy into work people actually care about.
  • Identify whitespace opportunities and growth territories across audiences, occasions, channels, and propositions.
  • Keep one eye on the market and the other on where culture is heading next.

Lead Clients and Influence the Business

  • Act as a trusted strategic partner to senior client stakeholders, including brand leads, CMOs, and regional/global teams.
  • Lead strategic conversations with confidence, clarity, and authority.
  • Frame the problem, shape the opportunity, and sell the thinking.
  • Play a central role in pitches, new business opportunities, and agency growth.
  • Drive alignment across local, regional, and global stakeholders — often with competing agendas.

Raise the Bar Internally

  • Lead, mentor, and inspire strategists at different levels.
  • Champion strategic rigor without killing creative possibility.
  • Elevate the quality of briefs, presentations, narratives, and thinking across the agency.
  • Collaborate seamlessly with creative, account, production, media, PR, social, and data teams.
  • Contribute to the agency’s intellectual capital, point of view, and strategic reputation in the market.

 

What We’re Looking For

Experience

  • 8–12+ years of experience in strategy / planning / brand consulting / creative agency planning / marketing strategy.
  • Strong track record in brand strategy, communications strategy, and creative development.
  • Meaningful experience working on FMCG brands and an understanding of the category’s pace, complexity, and commercial realities.
  • Experience working with multinational clients and/or Japan-origin global brands.
  • Comfortable operating across local, regional, and global business contexts.
  • Proven ability to lead senior client relationships and high-stakes strategic conversations.
  • Experience leading pitches, major proposals, or transformative strategy projects.

Core Strategic Capabilities

  • Ability to identify the real problem behind the brief.
  • Strong brand thinking — positioning, architecture, proposition, portfolio logic.
  • Sharp creative strategy instincts and the ability to unlock inspiring creative springboards.
  • Deep understanding of integrated communications and channel orchestration.
  • Strong grasp of human insight development, audience definition, and behavioral understanding.
  • Ability to connect business ambition, brand ambition, and communications ambition into one clear strategic story.
  • Strong analytical skills, but equally strong intuition and judgment.

Creative Agency DNA

  • You know the difference between a “solid strategy” and a strategy that makes creatives want to make something brilliant.
  • You can distill complexity into a sharp thought that unlocks the room.
  • You understand that effectiveness and originality are not opposing forces.
  • You’re fluent in the realities of making work — not just talking about it.
  • You know how to push for better work without becoming precious, vague, or academic.

Leadership & Collaboration

  • Strong team leadership, coaching, and mentoring capability.
  • Skilled at cross-functional collaboration in fast-moving, high-pressure environments.
  • Confident presenter and persuasive storyteller.
  • Able to influence without relying on hierarchy.
  • Calm under pressure, comfortable with ambiguity, and energized by complexity.

job.description:
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. 

We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. 
 
We work with the world's most valuable brands and have global reach across 100+ markets, with deep local expertise.
 
Our people are the key to our success. We're committed to fostering a culture of creativity, belonging and continuous learning, attracting and developing the brightest talent, and providing exciting career opportunities that help our people grow. 
 
For more information, visit WPP.com.
 

About WPP

WPP is the creative transformation company. Through One WPP and the Elevate28 transformation agenda, we are building a simpler, more integrated, agile and AI-powered enterprise. WPP’s Performance & Culture Center of Excellence brings together the capabilities that help our people, teams and organisation perform, grow and thrive. Within it, Enterprise Effectiveness aligns WPP’s organisation, workforce and teams around its strategic priorities and enables the change required to deliver them.

About the Role

The Workforce Intelligence & Analytics Manager is a contract role that will build the evidence base for the workforce and organisation decisions that matter most to WPP. This role will turn fragmented people, organisation and business data into clear insight, forward-looking scenarios and practical recommendations that help leaders decide where to invest, how to shape the workforce and how to organise for performance.

Reporting to the Global Head of Enterprise Effectiveness, you will support the wider Performance & Culture Center of Excellence while working closely with business, People & Culture, Finance, Data and Technology partners. You will establish a trusted workforce-intelligence capability that supports strategic workforce planning and informs priority organisation, workforce, team and people decisions across Enterprise Effectiveness and the wider Performance & Culture Center of Excellence. This is not a traditional reporting role. It combines strategic analytics, internal consulting and leadership of a four-person data and reporting team based in India. You will be expected to work through ambiguity, connect disparate data and systems, and progressively turn fragmented analytics into a more integrated, trusted and usable capability. As a contract appointment, the initial focus will be to establish the core workforce-intelligence approach, strengthen the India-based team and deliver insight against WPP’s highest-priority workforce and organisation questions.

Why This Role Matters

WPP’s transformation requires faster, better choices about work, skills, capacity, organisation and investment. Those choices cannot be made from disconnected dashboards or backward-looking metrics alone. In this role, you will create a more integrated view of the workforce, translate evidence into choices and trade-offs, and help leaders anticipate the implications of AI, changing client demand and new ways of working. The work will directly shape how WPP builds the capabilities, capacity and organisation required for Elevate28.

What You’ll Do

Build a trusted workforce intelligence capability

  • Working with the Global Head of Enterprise Effectiveness, shape and build an enterprise workforce-intelligence approach that connects people, organisation and business data to the decisions leaders need to make.
  • Define a focused set of workforce and organisational measures, dashboards and decision-support tools, moving reporting from activity and headcount toward capacity, capability, cost, productivity, risk and value.
  • Partner with data owners and technology teams to map fragmented data and systems, define analytical requirements, and strengthen data definitions, quality, accessibility and responsible use, while being clear about limitations and the strength of the evidence.
  • Establish repeatable analytical standards, governance and quality controls so insight is trusted, comparable and usable across WPP.
  • Apply AI and automation to improve how workforce data is integrated, analysed and translated into decision support, while maintaining appropriate human judgement, transparency and responsible-use standards.

Enable strategic workforce planning

  • Help business and People & Culture leaders translate strategy, growth priorities and choices about how work is organised into workforce demand, capability and capacity requirements.
  • Build scenarios that show the implications of different choices, including developing, hiring, accessing external capability, automating, augmenting, redeploying and exiting work or roles.
  • Assess the current workforce and future talent supply, including critical skills, capacity, cost, location and role mix, highlighting gaps, risks and investment priorities.
  • Connect workforce planning to business and financial planning cycles so decisions are timely, owned and grounded in common assumptions.

Deliver forward-looking insight and decision support

  • Use statistical analysis, forecasting and scenario modelling to identify emerging workforce and organisational risks, opportunities and patterns.
  • Bring structure to ambiguous business questions, identify what can be answered with available data, test hypotheses and distinguish meaningful signals from correlation or noise.
  • Turn analysis into clear choices, trade-offs and recommendations for senior leaders, including the consequences of action and inaction.
  • Develop concise executive narratives and visualisations that make complex findings understandable without oversimplifying them.

Strengthen organisation and transformation decisions

  • Provide analytical support for organisation design, organisational health, inclusion and impact, talent development, team effectiveness and change priorities across Performance and Culture.
  • Create baselines and evaluate whether organisation and workforce interventions are improving the intended outcomes.
  • Combine quantitative evidence with qualitative insight to explain not only what is happening, but why it matters and where targeted action is needed.
  • Identify enterprise patterns across businesses, markets and functions and convert them into practical recommendations for leaders and Enterprise Effectiveness partners.

Scale tools, capability and adoption

  • Build practical tools, templates and self-service products that improve the quality and consistency of workforce decisions.
  • Coach People & Culture and business partners to interpret workforce insight, challenge assumptions and use scenarios in decision-making.
  • Create a clear intake and prioritisation approach that focuses analytical capacity on the highest-value enterprise questions.
  • Continuously improve the offer through user feedback, adoption evidence and emerging practice in workforce analytics, AI and organisational science.
  • Lead and develop a four-person data and reporting team based in India, setting clear priorities, strengthening analytical and consulting capability, and shifting delivery from fragmented reporting toward higher-value workforce intelligence and decision support.
Minimum Qualifications
  • Relevant experience applying data and analytics in finance, commercial, operational or other business settings, together with experience in people analytics, workforce intelligence or strategic workforce planning.
  • Experience translating business questions into analytical approaches, workforce scenarios and decision-ready recommendations.
  • Strong capability in data analysis, forecasting, modelling and visualisation, using appropriate business intelligence or analytical tools.
  • Proven experience working through ambiguity and improving a fragmented data and analytics environment by connecting disparate sources and systems, strengthening definitions and quality, and establishing practical governance, privacy and ethical standards.
  • Ability to communicate complex findings clearly and influence senior stakeholders in a complex organisation.
  • AI fluency, including a practical understanding of how AI and automation can improve analytics, workforce planning and decision support, and how they may reshape work, skills, roles and workforce requirements.
  • Experience leading and developing an analytics or reporting team, including setting priorities, assuring quality and building capability across locations.
  • A degree in a relevant discipline or equivalent practical experience.
Preferred Experience
  • Experience applying financial, commercial or operational analysis to workforce investment, capacity, productivity or organisation decisions.
  • Experience in a complex global, matrixed or multi-business organisation, ideally supporting enterprise transformation or significant workforce change.
  • Proficiency with relevant business intelligence, data-visualisation or analytical tools, which may include Power BI, Tableau, SQL, Python or R.
  • Postgraduate study or relevant professional qualifications in analytics, finance, strategic workforce planning or a related field.
What Success Looks Like
  • A clear enterprise workforce-intelligence proposition focused on the workforce and organisation decisions most critical to One WPP and Elevate28.
  • A more integrated and trusted data foundation, with common definitions, practical governance and decision-support tools that connect workforce, organisation, business and financial insight.
  • Workforce plans, scenarios and recommendations that materially improve decisions about skills, capacity, location, cost, AI and automation, technology and workforce shape.
  • Stronger adoption of workforce insight by business and People & Culture leaders, with greater confidence in what the data can and cannot support.
  • A focused, capable India-based team that delivers consistent reporting while building higher-value workforce intelligence and decision-support capability.

Individual compensation varies based on job-related factors, including location, business needs, level of responsibility, experience, and qualifications. We offer a competitive benefits package, go to https://mybenefits.wpp.com/public/welcome for more details. 

.$125,000—$295,000 USD

For more information, visit WPP.com.
 

Overview

WPP Media Japan is revolutionizing the advertising industry through the power of data and artificial intelligence. At WPP Media, our vision for the Influencer Solutions team (GOAT) is to become the leading data-driven influencer consultancy.

Purpose of Role

The Head of Influencer Solutions is a senior leadership role responsible for the strategic direction, commercial success, and operational excellence of the agency's influencer marketing practice in Japan. This role combines strategic thought leadership with senior client stewardship, leading a multi-disciplinary team across account management, strategy, and campaign delivery to drive significant growth and establish the agency as the leading influencer solutions partner in the market. The Head of Influencer Solutions is accountable for financial ownership, team development, and defining the future of influencer marketing for our clients and the agency.

Key Responsibilities

The below are the key responsibilities for this role:

Strategic Leadership & Vision

  • Define and execute the long-term strategic vision for the influencer solutions practice in Japan, setting clear objectives for growth, innovation, and market positioning.
  • Lead all strategic thinking for the agency's top-tier influencer clients and most critical new business pitches, acting as the senior strategic voice and trusted advisor.
  • Translate complex client business problems into clear, powerful strategic platforms that solve real business challenges through influencer marketing.
  • Champion innovative approaches to influencer marketing, pushing the agency and its clients beyond conventional thinking to leverage emerging platforms, creator trends, and cultural movements.
  • Act as a thought leader both internally and externally, representing the agency at industry events, contributing to market discourse, and elevating the agency's reputation.

Client Leadership & Growth

  • Act as the senior strategic lead and trusted advisor across a portfolio of the agency's most important influencer marketing clients.
  • Build and nurture strong, influential relationships with C-suite and senior decision-makers, positioning yourself as an indispensable strategic partner.
  • Lead long-term strategic account planning, including annual planning sessions and quarterly business reviews, ensuring the agency's services are deeply aligned with clients' core business objectives.
  • Work closely with other WPP agencies on strategic planning and allocation across accounts, driving integrated solutions and maximizing value across the WPP network.
  • Lead all major commercial negotiations, including contract renewals, new service proposals, and multi-year partnership agreements.

Commercial Ownership & P&L Management

  • Take full ownership of the P&L for the influencer solutions practice, including revenue targets, forecasting, profitability, and resource allocation.
  • Develop and execute ambitious growth strategies to drive significant year-on-year revenue growth across existing clients and new business.
  • Identify and convert opportunities for deep strategic partnerships, multi-service integration, and expansion into new verticals and client categories.
  • Oversee pricing strategies, margin management, and commercial negotiations to ensure sustainable and profitable growth.
  • Lead new business development efforts, directing the team in winning major pitches and expanding the agency's client portfolio.

Team Leadership & Development

  • Lead, mentor, and develop a multi-disciplinary team across account management, strategy, and campaign delivery functions, fostering a culture of excellence, accountability, innovation, and collaboration.
  • Set clear performance expectations and manage the career development and growth of all team members, ensuring high levels of motivation, retention, and effectiveness.
  • Build and scale the team in line with business growth, recruiting top talent and ensuring the right capabilities are in place to meet client and market demands.
  • Act as the senior escalation point for complex client challenges, commercial issues, and executional risks, providing expert guidance and decisive leadership.
  • Create a high-performance culture that attracts and retains the best talent in the influencer marketing industry.

Operational Excellence & Innovation

  • Oversee the end-to-end quality of all deliverables across the influencer solutions practice, from strategic planning to campaign execution and reporting.
  • Define and implement best practices, processes, and workflows that drive efficiency, quality, and profitability across all client work.
  • Drive innovation in methodologies, tools, and technologies, ensuring the agency remains at the forefront of the evolving influencer marketing landscape.
  • Ensure the team consistently delivers insightful, data-driven results that demonstrate clear ROI and business impact for clients.
  • Stay at the forefront of platform changes, cultural trends, regulatory developments, and market dynamics in Japan and globally.

Cross-Functional & Network Collaboration

  • Partner with senior leadership across all agency functions and WPP network agencies to ensure seamless integration and delivery of best-in-class solutions.
  • Represent the influencer solutions practice at the highest level in key client meetings, new business pitches, and strategic planning sessions.
  • Build and maintain senior-level relationships with key platform partners (Meta, Google, TikTok, LINE, etc.), talent agencies, and industry bodies in Japan.
  • Collaborate with regional and global influencer leads across the WPP network to share best practices and drive innovation.

Performance Requirements

  • Achieving and exceeding annual revenue growth and profitability targets for the influencer solutions practice.
  • Maintaining high client satisfaction, retention, and expansion across the portfolio of key accounts.
  • Successful leadership, development, and retention of a high-performing, multi-disciplinary team.
  • A high win-rate on new business pitches and demonstrable growth in the agency's market share.
  • Consistent delivery of high-quality, innovative, and effective strategic work that drives measurable business results for clients.
  • Strong reputation and visibility as a thought leader in the Japanese influencer marketing industry.

Skills and Competencies

  • Proven, extensive experience in a senior leadership role within influencer marketing, social media, or digital marketing, ideally within an agency environment in Japan or APAC.
  • A strong track record of building, leading, and scaling successful teams across multiple functions (account management, strategy, campaign delivery).
  • Exceptional strategic thinking and commercial acumen, with demonstrated success in driving significant revenue growth and managing P&L.
  • Outstanding leadership and mentoring capabilities, with the ability to inspire and develop diverse teams.
  • Deep expertise in influencer marketing across all major platforms, with a strong understanding of the Japanese social media landscape, creator economy, and cultural nuances.
  • Proven ability to build and maintain trusted C-suite level relationships with major clients and senior stakeholders.
  • Expert-level communication and presentation skills in both Japanese and English, with the ability to command a room and articulate complex strategies with clarity.
  • Strong collaborative skills and experience working across matrix organizations and agency networks (WPP experience highly valued).
  • A proactive, entrepreneurial mindset with a passion for innovation and growth.


About WPP Media:

At WPP Media, we are Open, Optimistic, and Extraordinary. 

  • Open. We cultivate trust by taking ownership and accountability, and we empathetically and intelligently balance people and client experience in everything we do. 
  • Optimistic. We mobilize the enterprise, driving our vision forward, and we champion growth and career development so we can all thrive. 
  • Extraordinary. We harness our shared capabilities to inspire transformational creativity, and lead collectively to deliver a seamless client and colleague experience.

WPP Media is WPP’s media investment group and the world’s leading media investment company with a mission to shape the next era of media where advertising works better for people. Through its global agencies Mindshare, Wavemaker, EssenceMediacom, and mSix&Partners, and cross-channel performance (MMD), data (Choreograph) and investment solutions, WPP Media leverages a unique combination of global scale, expertise, and innovation to generate sustained value for clients wherever they do business.

  • Contribute to quarterly planning reviews, business updates, and strategic proposals. 
  • Test, learn, and share media innovations, new advertising tactics, and best practices with local, regional, and global teams.

  • Become fully operational on the required platforms, tools, and planning workflows. 
  • Build strong relationships with key stakeholders and begin contributing to local planning and campaign management. 
  • Demonstrate ownership of day-to-day planning activities and campaign coordination. 

In six months: 

  • Independently manage local campaign planning and execution across assigned markets or business areas. 
  • Deliver strategic recommendations and performance insights that positively impact campaign outcomes. 
  • Confidently lead client discussions on planning, reporting, and optimization. 
  • Demonstrate ownership of billing, reporting, and operational processes related to campaign execution. 

In twelve months: 

  • Lead strategic input into quarterly and annual planning proposals. 
  • Take a stronger leadership role in local planning, driving best practices and consistency across campaigns. 
  • Identify, test, and recommend new media tactics and optimization approaches. 
  • Actively share learnings and insights with regional and global teams, contributing to broader business growth. 
  • Mentor junior team members and help raise the overall capability of the local planning function. 

Requirements: 

  • Bachelor’s degree required. 
  • Business-level English and native-level Japanese. 
  • 5+ years of experience in digital media planning, integrated media, and/or ad operations. 
  • Strong understanding of media strategy, campaign planning, trafficking processes, and performance reporting.

  • Proven ability to manage multiple stakeholders and communicate effectively across functions and seniority levels. 
  • Highly organized, self-motivated, and able to manage time and priorities effectively. 
  • Quick learner with a proactive mindset and willingness to adopt new tools and technologies.

We blur work and play, and you get all the perks of a global company. You will get to work with a dynamic group of entrepreneurs, collaborating across time zones to make a difference in the way the world experiences media. We love what we do, and we think you will too.

Purpose of the role 

The Senior Analyst, Purchase to Pay (PTP), is part of a team responsible for performing day to day tasks within the Purchase to Pay (PTP) function covering Accounts Payable, Travel & Expense and Payment, as well as Month End Closing process and some other specific accounting activities related to the stream. The Senior Analyst will be required to handle activities for any of the subfunctions within the PTP function as assigned by the PTP manager.

Key responsibilities include accurate and timely recording and payment of vendor invoices, statutory payments, employees claim and intercompany transactions in accordance to the defined SLAs/KPIs while adhering to Company policies and procedures as well as relevant legal and statutory requirements.

Job Description 

Accounts Payable (AP) & Invoice Processing:

Receive and scan vendor invoice/vendor billing files and supporting documents  Check all invoices for proper documentation, attach the invoice to the AP System and submit for payment accordingly. Ensure invoices are processed in line with WPP Policies, SOX requirements, Standard Operating Procedure (SOP). Process invoices, credit memos and debit memos in a timely and accurate manner according to SLA / KPI set by management and agreed with WPP Operating Companies (OpCo) Ensures that all invoices assigned are properly accounted for at the end of each business day. Respond to vendor inquiries. Follow up with vendor and respective OpCo to resolve all discrepancies in a timely manner Verifies vendor accounts by reconciling monthly statements and related transactions. Perform reconciliations of vendor statements, research and address discrepancies as appropriate. Review reconciliation and supporting documentation for purchases made by Company Settled Credit Card and revert to OpCo on queries Properly book and upload all intercompany transactions Work with PTP Leaders on Account Analysis to clear Aged AP and Net Debit Balance (NDB)

Payments Processing:

Generate proposed payment selection file or be the reviewer of proposed payment selection file in accordance with agreed timetable.  Submit the payment selection file to the OpCo in line with the agreed timetable or be generater of payment confirmation file in accordance with agreed timetable, base on proposed payment selection approved. Review, request amendments where applicable, and submit to approvers to authorise payment aligned to the agreed timetablet or be the reviewer the amendments and regenerate payment confirmation. Transact payment to bank in accordance with the country/OpCo banking functionality Responsible for the following tasks related to payments: Act as main contact with bank regarding payments queries. Process Time and Expense (T&E) related payment. Process and post cheque and wire remittance deposits to the appropriate bank account and invoices, ensuring reconciliation of the batch. Ensures payment is made to vendors in accordance to Company Policy and SOX Guidelines Work with Master Data Team to set up new vendors in the system or updating existing vendor details. Ensure correct e-mail contact details of payment beneficiary are recorded in master data Generate remittance advice Work with Record to Report (RTR) on all payment transactions on bank reconciliations, resolve reconciling items and escalate to the OpCo any unreconciled/aged items for resolution/confirmation of treatment

Generate aging reports, identify critical issues and drive resolution independently Accountable and responsible for the quality, accuracy and timely delivery of scope assigned in accordance to the SLAs/KPIs defined with management and agreed with OpCo Handle high complexity issues with minimal guidance from Team Lead / Manager. Perform account reconciliations and journal entries at month end close. Issue reports on a monthly basis and assist Manager to drive achievement of KPI and SOX requirements on periodic report and review. Drive month end close activities and help Manager to coach junior team members. Process back up reports for data storage/archiving. Proactively identify, propose and implement continuous improvement opportunities in existing processes within the team.  Lead Continuous Projects, workshops and trainings for the PTP team and across the SSC as PTP subject matter expert Comply to internal and external regulations and procedures, that should be in line with the company policies, standard operating procedures, and/or Target Operating Model (TOM) Guide new and existing team members through proper knowledge transfer; sharing of resource, knowledge and experience and best practice thereby ensuring quality is maintained through any staff transition.

Basic knowledge of fundamental accounting concepts, practices, and procedures Having shared service centre experience is preferred Knowledge of SOX Compliance norms relating to the process Experience in using ERP system is an added advantage

CBC North in Kuujjuaq is looking for an Announcer/Operator. Reporting to the Managing Editor, the Announcer/Operator is responsible for finding, researching, preparing and presenting interviews, packaged items, continuity and news stories, and hosting and operating radio programs in Inuktitut and English. The work will include preparing Inuktitut versions of program material for use on radio and television programs.

Function:

Performs a variety of tasks associated with the preparation, production and presentation of programs and program material – for example, announcing, hosting, versioning between English and Inuktitut, writing and operating production equipment. Work is governed by CBC program and journalistic policies and practices but is performed in the unique broadcasting environment of the community station where limited resources dictate the need for versatility, cooperation and teamwork. job.title: Coordonnateur(-trice) des médias sociaux – Marketing général
job.description:
Corus est une force motrice de l'industrie des médias, avec un portefeuille diversifié de marques reconnues qui divertissent et informent les auditoires par le biais de récits exceptionnels et de contenu captivant, touchant chaque jour des millions de personnes à travers le monde entier.

Notre culture et notre équipe sont ce qui fait de nous, noUS.

Nous sommes passionnés par le désir de tisser des liens avec le monde qui nous entoure : nous voulons exprimer, échanger et faire partie de la vie des gens. Notre culture primée est l'expression de qui nous sommes, ce que nous faisons et comment nous prospérons. Nos valeurs représentent notre culture en action. Elles décrivent notre manière d'atteindre nos objectifs, de travailler ensemble, de nous engager avec nos partenaires et d'interagir avec nos collectivités. Chez Corus, nous Gagnons ensemble, Pensons différemment, Faisons avancer les choses, Apprenons chaque jour, et Démontrons notre bienveillance.

Prêt à vous joindre à noUS?

Envie de découvrir les coulisses de la télé? Tu cherches une équipe chaleureuse et un nouveau défi? Corus Média recherche une personne créative et organisée pour propulser la présence numérique de nos chaînes spécialisées francophones : Vivéo, Historia, Séries Plus et Télétoon la nuit.

Tu orchestreras le calendrier éditorial, tu créeras des contenus visuels et vidéo accrocheurs, tu déploieras des campagnes payantes et tu géreras nos chaînes YouTube, en étroite collaboration avec nos équipes et nos partenaires de production.

Ta mission : faire briller nos marques en ligne, engager nos communautés et mettre en valeur nos productions grâce à des contenus créatifs et performants.

Pour accomplir cette mission, il te faudra faire preuve de créativité, d’organisation, de proactivité et avoir un vif intérêt pour la télé québécoise et les tendances numériques. Nous cherchons une personne passionnée et capable de jongler plusieurs projets à la fois sur qui l’équipe peut compter!

Tes responsabilités

Stratégie et planification

• Contribuer à l’élaboration de la stratégie numérique et sociale de nos marques, puis la déployer.

• Concevoir le calendrier éditorial et en assurer le suivi, de la production à la diffusion.

• Repérer les tendances émergentes et proposer des concepts novateurs pour maximiser notre portée.

• Collaborer avec l’équipe des communications pour les trousses de presse numériques, les partenariats, les concours et tous les autres projets spéciaux.

• Travailler en synergie avec la responsable du service à l’auditoire pour la gestion de communauté.

• Conseiller les équipes internes sur les meilleures pratiques et les outils numériques.

Création et gestion de contenu

• Piloter tout le cycle de production en collaboration avec l'équipe créative : idéation, création visuelle, montage vidéo (publications, Reels, Stories, etc.) et diffusion.

• Gérer et optimiser les chaînes YouTube de nos marques, y compris leur référencement (SEO).

• Collaborer avec les équipes de production pour repérer les occasions de captation de contenu et coordonner le crosspostage.

• Appliquer les meilleures pratiques d’accessibilité numérique (sous-titres, formats adaptés, lisibilité).

Publicité numérique et analyse de performance

• Paramétrer, programmer et optimiser des campagnes payantes sur Meta Ads et Google Ads.

• Mesurer la performance (organique et payant), puis présenter résultats et recommandations.

Ce que nous cherchons

• Études en communications, marketing numérique, médias sociaux ou domaine connexe.

• Au moins 2 ans d’expérience en gestion de médias sociaux, création de contenu et placement publicitaire numérique.

• Excellentes compétences rédactionnelles en français.

• Maîtrise de ensemble des outils de Meta et de Google Ads (paramétrage, ciblage, suivi).

job.title: Account Executive
job.description:
Company Overview

Cumulus Media is an audio-first media company delivering premium content to a quarter billion people every month — wherever and whenever they want it. Cumulus Media engages listeners with high-quality local programming through 377 owned-and-operated radio stations across 84 markets; delivers nationally-syndicated sports, news, talk, and entertainment programming from iconic brands including the NFL, the NCAA, the Masters, US Soccer, and AP News, across more than 7,800 affiliated stations through Westwood One, a leading national audio network; and inspires listeners through the Cumulus Podcast Network, an established and influential platform for original podcasts that are smart, entertaining, and thought-provoking. Cumulus Media provides advertisers with personal connections, local impact and national reach through broadcast and on-demand digital, mobile, social, and voice-activated platforms, as well as integrated digital marketing services, powerful influencers, full-service audio solutions, industry-leading research and insights, and live event experiences. For more information visit www.cumulusmedia.com.


Position Overview

The Account Executive successfully manages relationships with dozens of local and regional businesses, protects and grows the revenue base, identifies and creates new business opportunities with existing and new clients; provides marketing solutions to help customers achieve their business goals; strategically plans and implements initiatives to meet personal, company and corporate directives, recognizes that achieving budgeted revenue targets is the minimum expectation of performance. The right individual will invest in personal professional development, understanding technology, marketing and the full suite of company products and services.


Key Responsibilities & Qualifications

Key Responsibilities:

  • Able to create and identify client business needs by gaining a deep understanding of their goals, objectives and processes as well as their external environment including key market and consumer trends to proactively develop customized marketing solutions to meet client objectives
  • Deliver and Develop effective and informed marketing solutions via multi-platform, integrated sales presentations identifying Cumulus broadcast, digital, and event tactics to foster brand loyalty and deliver results for the client
  • Ability to negotiate and close business that drives revenue results and fosters long term client relationships, regardless of medium or platform
  • Commitment to having a proficient understanding of the Cumulus Media assets and resources and a desire to constantly learn and grow your product knowledge thus staying relevant and current with industry advertising opportunities for your clients
  • Represent the full suite of products and services as marketing solutions to new and existing clientele. This includes station digital assets, internet-based marketing, social media, streaming, events and specialized programming
  • Ability to appropriately manage time to optimize revenue opportunities, client interaction, implementation and fulfillment of successful sales agreements. Individual must be able to assist in the development of creative messaging, regardless of platform
  • Excel at prospecting and aggressively seeking new clientele by networking, cold calling, canvassing, referrals or other means to maintain a full pipeline of sales prospects at all times
  • Follow all station and corporate procedures for preparing orders, resolving billing issues, submitting regular reports regarding sales, pipeline lists, forecasts and competitive analysis
  • Collaborate, create, and capitalize on opportunities to best represent our brand while working to help your clients achieve success


Qualifications:

  • Proficient in Microsoft Office suite, social networking platforms and CRM tools
  • Excellent communication skills
  • Passion for developing new business relationships in an outside sales role
  • Enjoy presenting to clients of sales opportunities and post-sale successes
  • Strong understanding of lead generation and ability to connect with viable prospects
  • Comprehension of sales metrics in order to fill a sales funnel and maintain a constant pipeline of new business
  • Self-motivating and entrepreneurial spirit
  • Positive and friendly with a willingness to collaborate
  • High energy and passion for sales
  • Flexible, creative and curious
  • Digitally savvy
  • 3+ years in Media Sales background preferred
  • Bachelor's degree in business, Marketing or related field is preferred

Pay Range

The monthly pay range listed above reflects your guaranteed income during your first year, with additional opportunities to earn commissions
What We Offer

  • Competitive Pay
  • Focused, responsible and collaborative work environment with the ability, to ask “what if” and try innovative solutions
  • Medical, Dental & Vision Insurance coverage
  • 401K with company match
  • Paid Vacation, Sick & Holiday time off
  • Parental leave time off benefits, life insurance, disability insurance, wellness, and an employee referral bonus program

 

For immediate consideration, please visit https://jobs.cumulusmedia.com/jobs
For more information about Cumulus Media, visit our website at: https://www.cumulusmedia.com/

 

 

 


EEO Statement

CUMULUS MEDIA is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer (EOE).

job.title: Systems Engineer
job.description:
OVERVIEW OF THE COMPANY

Fox News Media

FOX News Media operates the FOX News Channel (FNC), FOX Business Network (FBN), FOX News Digital, FOX News Audio, FOX News Books, the direct-to-consumer digital streaming services FOX Nation and FOX News International and the newly announced platform FOX Weather. Currently the number one network in all of cable, FNC has also been the most watched television news channel for 20 consecutive years, while FBN currently ranks among the top business channels on cable. Owned by FOX Corporation, FOX News Media reaches 200 million people each month.

JOB DESCRIPTION

The Systems Engineer is an individual contributor on the Digital Newsroom (DNR) Systems Administration team responsible for the engineering, automation, and operational reliability of the Dalet media-asset-management platform and related production systems in New York and Washington, DC. This backfill position replaces a retiring engineer and restores capacity for scripting, proactive monitoring, data migration, and frontline production support across NY and DC.


The Systems Engineer works closely with editorial, media desk, library, and operations teams, partners with Dalet support and internal engineering groups on Mimir, Pyramid, and Project Fresh Start initiatives, and contributes to the team's transition from reactive ticket handling to automated detection and remediation. Success requires strong Dalet platform knowledge, disciplined scripting in PowerShell and Bash, and dependable ownership through completion — including weekends and live production windows.


A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITES:

  • Dalet Platform Engineering & Administration
    • Administer and troubleshoot the Dalet MAM environment in NY and DC — including Dalet Admin Tool configuration, BPM workflows, proxy generation, WebSpace, Wowza load balancers, workflow servers, and ingest/recording components (Brio).
    • Resolve escalated production issues: proxy-not-generating failures, media sync problems, ZID-to-DCID transfer errors, mount failures, TRINT workflow disruption, and slug/metadata special-character recording failures.
    • Configure Dalet Admin Tool settings and BPM rules to prevent recurring operational failures (e.g., illegal-character handling, recording-stuck conditions).
    • Support restricted-folder lifecycle, asset restore/purge requests, and media-desk coordination for NY and DC editorial workflows.
    • Partner with Dalet iCare/support on complex escalations; document root cause and remediation in ServiceNow (DNRNYD) and Confluence.
  • Monitoring, Scripting & Automation
    • Develop, maintain, and extend production monitoring and remediation scripts (PowerShell and Bash) covering recurring Dalet failure modes — Brio recording stuck, MDS/MDD agent health, AuditTrail freshness, BPM thresholds, NetXchange agents, WebSpace/Wowza restarts, send-to-NEXIO catchers, EDL agent errors, and DST offset checks.
    • Tie monitoring automation to tracked DNRNYD tickets with documented thresholds, alert logic, and remediation steps.
    • Contribute to the team's proactive monitoring posture and eventual integration with broader observability initiatives (e.g., Grafana).
    • Apply Python and modern tooling to extend operational automation where practical.
  • Mimir, Migrations & Platform Programs
    • Support Object Store-to-Mimir image and metadata migration work — including XML mappings, JSON watch-folder definitions, VOS re-tagging, shared-asset import logic, and batch validation.
    • Execute and validate large-scale content and metadata migrations (e.g., transcript backfill, person/non-person image regeneration) with minimal production impact.
    • Participate in Mimir Phase 2 and Pyramid platform testing — TestRail case authoring, post-upgrade retesting in DEV and PROD, and permissions/workflow validation with platform owners.
    • Support Project Fresh Start and Dalet upgrade activities (MFP testing, MS-SQL maintenance, version upgrades) as assigned.
  • Production Pipelines & Linux Administration
    • Own or support recurring production delivery workflows — including the Fox News Sunday Hulu unified-delivery package (format updates, captioning conversions, container changes, illegal-character handling, and external QA coordination).
    • Administer Linux systems supporting Dalet and related DNR infrastructure in NY and DC.
    • Perform MS-SQL queries and data tasks tied to Dalet metadata, migration, and reporting workflows.
    • Transform and validate XML metadata for ingest, migration, and platform-integration use cases.
  • Operations, Documentation & Collaboration
    • Provide frontline and weekend production support for NY and DC Dalet users — editors, media desk, library, and operations teams.
    • Respond to ServiceNow incidents and requests; maintain clear written documentation in Confluence for systems, scripts, and troubleshooting procedures.
    • Collaborate with peer DNR engineers (Mimir, Pyramid, ingest, editing platform) and BMT teams on cross-platform initiatives.
    • Participate in on-call and weekend coverage rotation aligned to live news production schedules.
    • Work a flexible schedule including evenings, weekends, and maintenance windows as required.

WHAT YOU WILL NEED:

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 3–5+ years of systems engineering, Linux administration, or broadcast/media platform support experience.
  • Hands-on experience with Dalet Galaxy / Dalet Plus or comparable MAM platforms strongly preferred.
  • Proficiency in PowerShell and Bash scripting; ability to build and maintain production monitoring automation.
  • Working knowledge of Linux administration, MS-SQL, XML/metadata workflows, and basic networking.
  • Experience supporting live production or newsroom editorial environments.
  • Strong troubleshooting skills, attention to detail, and ownership through completion.
  • Clear written and verbal communication; comfortable partnering with vendors, editorial staff, and engineering teams.
