job.title: Manager, Revenue Partnerships
job.description:
OVERVIEW OF THE COMPANY

Fox Corporation

Under the FOX banner, we produce and distribute content through some of the world’s leading and most valued brands, including: FOX News Media, FOX Sports, FOX Entertainment, FOX Television Stations and Tubi Media Group. We empower a diverse range of creators to imagine and develop culturally significant content, while building an organization that thrives on creative ideas, operational expertise and strategic thinking.

JOB DESCRIPTION

Red Seat Ventures partners with the world's top creators across multiple genres to grow and monetize their content — through advertising, subscription, live events, and beyond. We take a multiplatform approach spanning podcasting, video, FAST, and more, backed by our own proprietary tech stack including Supercast (subscription) and Speakeasy (hosting, distribution, and monetization).


Named after Ted Williams' longest home run at Fenway Park, RSV was built with a simple mandate: swing for the fences. Today, we're the fastest-growing creator network, backed by Tubi Media Group and Fox Corporation.


ROLE SUMMARY

We are seeking a Manager Revenue Partnerships dedicated exclusively to our rapidly expanding Podcast & Audio Creator portfolio. In this role, you will sit at the intersection of podcast ad sales, revenue partnerships, and creator monetization. You will be responsible for transforming client marketing objectives into multi-platform podcast sponsorships. Acting as the strategic backbone for our sales executives, you will carve out and bring innovative ideas to the table that unlock custom budget across holding company agencies.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Podcast Strategy & Sponsorship Packaging

  • Custom Proposals: Architect both proactive and reactive custom campaigns tailored to brand objectives using our entire podcast audio and video ecosystem.
  • Inventory Packaging: Creatively package podcast inventory; including pre-roll, mid-roll, post-roll, and personal endorsements integrations around spiked interest periods throughout the year.
  • Multi-Platform Extensions: Integrate and build audio sponsorships with digital video (YouTube), social media extensions, events and distribution across streaming platforms.
  • Executive Storytelling: Build high-impact, visually compelling pitch presentations that are client-facing and best in class.

Sales Enablement & Monetization Growth

  • Marketing Support: Reporting directly to Revenue Partnerships, partner directly with Creator Partnerships, Sales Leadership and Account Executives to build narratives that support both creator’s initiatives and brand initiatives.
  • Market Intelligence: Work with Sales Research and Sales Marketing to monitor digital audio trends, creator economics, and competitive pricing benchmarks to maximize revenue per client.
  • Proactive Pitching: Turn proactive marketplace concepts into scalable, category-specific sales materials to unlock new brand budgets.
  • Creator Liaison: Collaborate with internal show producers and top talent to ensure revenue initiatives are met and brand integrations feel organic and brand-safe.
  • GTM Strategy and Framework: Coordinate cross-functionally with multiple teams to establish service level agreements, product minimums and streamline a process for GTM strategy for each show in the portfolio.

job.description:

At AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions, we believe a great workplace isn't just something we say — it's something you can feel when you join the team. Here, it's all about great collabs, ambition, and results but most importantly, we grow here, and we enjoy here.  We're searching for that special someone — a driven, talented individual to join our innovative media sales and marketing solutions team. In this role, you'll engage with new and existing clients and show them how our innovative media solutions can amplify their brands and deliver measurable success. Sound like the right fit? Check out the checklist below and if it sounds like you, hit "Apply Now" and let's chat. 

 

Your Day-to-Day (aka the Playbook)

o Results-Driven: Amplify our media sales efforts by leading the sales team to implement local sales and marketing strategies to attract, grow and retain business, showcase opportunities and deliver results across our multi-media content platforms and digital assets.

 

o Strategic Planning: You'll develop and implement innovative sales and marketing strategies that will amplify our sales performance. You'll be the mastermind behind tactics that not only meet but exceed our sales goals.

 

o Team Development:  Leading, mentoring, and inspiring a team of sales professionals is no small feat! Your ability to motivate and enhance their skills will be crucial in driving performance and achieving success together.

 

o Market Analysis: Dive deep into market trends, data, and customer needs. By understanding what drives our clients, you'll identify new opportunities for expansion and growth, ensuring we stay ahead of the competition.

 

o Authentic Relationships: Building strong, lasting relationships with key clients and stakeholders is crucial. You'll be the driving force behind our brand, amplifying customer satisfaction and loyalty through excellent service.

 

What We're Looking For 

o Proven Sales Ability: We're looking for someone with experience as a Sales Director or other sales management and leadership roles, ideally in a media-related industry. We value your drive, energy, and passion for achieving results. 

 

o High-Impact: A passion for achieving sales goals, amplifying growth and a results-driven mindset will set you apart. We want someone who's excited to push boundaries in a digital first environment and make an impact.

 

o Analytical Mindset: Strong analytical skills to assess market data and trends. Your insights will help guide our sales and marketing strategies.

 

o Strong Communication Skills:  You're a natural at building relationships, negotiating and communicating effectively. Proficiency with digital tools and applications is a must. 

 

o A Passion for Leading Others: You should be able to inspire your team, amplify their strengths while guiding them toward our collective goals, foster a collaborative environment and make a difference.

 

o A Willingness to Grow:  Do you thrive in unified environments? The media world is constantly evolving, and the ability to learn, adapt, and embrace challenges in a fast-paced, digital-first environment is key.

 

The Practical Stuff 

o A valid driver's license, up-to-date insurance, and reliable transportation are necessary for connecting with clients in your community. 

 

Why Join AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions? / The Reasons You Should Hit "Apply Now" 

o Serious Work, Seriously Cool People: Be part of a bold team that values creativity, collaboration, and fun! We are all for work that is rewarding.

 

o The Compensation Package: Enjoy competitive base salary with an enticing results-based bonus structure that rewards your hard work. Our people love our benefits package.

 

o We Make a Real Difference (Not Just Talk About It): At AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions, we help local businesses thrive through advertising strategies that create tangible impacts. Our media sales team isn't just selling ads; they're the boots on the ground, making a real difference where it counts. (And yes, it feels pretty good.)

 

o Career Growth Opportunities: We believe in investing in you. That's why you'll have access to training, mentorship, and career advancement opportunities to help you thrive. We are a leader in our industry, flexing our local charm and national muscle, to provide you with options to amplify your career in your local market or join one of our AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions teams in another city.

 

AMP is us. It's you. It isn't just a name; it's a mission. A promise to amplify our reach, amplify our innovation, and most importantly, amplify you. If you're ready to grow your career and help businesses achieve their goals, we'd love to hear from you.

job.title: Podcast Coordinator
job.description:
Fox News Audio is looking for a Podcast Coordinator to be part of the fast-paced and growing FOX News Podcast Network. The Podcast Coordinator will assist the Podcast Producers in blocking, booking, gathering sound, and assisting in the production of FOX News Audio’s daily and weekly podcasts. In addition to their production duties, the Podcast Coordinator will also create social media posts and website write-ups to promote the products. 

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Coordinate the programming and platform placement across the FOX News podcast portfolio
  • Assist in producing podcast segments, along with coordinating reporters, talent live remotes, and recordings
  • Manage and keep clear communication with reporters, editors, assignment desk, and anchors
  • Update content on platforms as stories progress
  • Work closely with producers on developing stories and new content creation
  • Create content to populate our social media pages across multiple verticals
  • Work with producers to fact check copy, QC audio quality, and ensure the final products meet editorial & CMS requirements
  • This role may also assist in the editorial structuring of podcast content

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • Experience editing all-news radio or producing podcast programming
  • Highly skilled in writing and copy editing
  • Strong digital journalism skills and social media experience
  • Ability to make the right decisions during breaking news situations, as well as during routine shifts
  • Ability to interact with high profile talent
  • Great communication skills, a terrific attitude, and ability to collaborate with the team
  • Creative and “out of the box” thinking
  • Avid news consumer with prior journalism experience, preferably in an audio newsroom
  • Flexibility to work a variety of shifts in a 24/7 news operation, including nights, overnights, weekends, and early mornings
  • Knowledge of iNews, ENCO, and Adobe Audition (Cool-Edit) is a plus

job.title: Systems Engineer
job.description:
The Systems Engineer is an individual contributor on the Digital Newsroom (DNR) Systems Administration team responsible for the engineering, automation, and operational reliability of the Dalet media-asset-management platform and related production systems in New York and Washington, DC. This backfill position replaces a retiring engineer and restores capacity for scripting, proactive monitoring, data migration, and frontline production support across NY and DC.

The Systems Engineer works closely with editorial, media desk, library, and operations teams, partners with Dalet support and internal engineering groups on Mimir, Pyramid, and Project Fresh Start initiatives, and contributes to the team's transition from reactive ticket handling to automated detection and remediation. Success requires strong Dalet platform knowledge, disciplined scripting in PowerShell and Bash, and dependable ownership through completion — including weekends and live production windows.

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITES:

  • Dalet Platform Engineering & Administration
    • Administer and troubleshoot the Dalet MAM environment in NY and DC — including Dalet Admin Tool configuration, BPM workflows, proxy generation, WebSpace, Wowza load balancers, workflow servers, and ingest/recording components (Brio).
    • Resolve escalated production issues: proxy-not-generating failures, media sync problems, ZID-to-DCID transfer errors, mount failures, TRINT workflow disruption, and slug/metadata special-character recording failures.
    • Configure Dalet Admin Tool settings and BPM rules to prevent recurring operational failures (e.g., illegal-character handling, recording-stuck conditions).
    • Support restricted-folder lifecycle, asset restore/purge requests, and media-desk coordination for NY and DC editorial workflows.
    • Partner with Dalet iCare/support on complex escalations; document root cause and remediation in ServiceNow (DNRNYD) and Confluence.
  • Monitoring, Scripting & Automation
    • Develop, maintain, and extend production monitoring and remediation scripts (PowerShell and Bash) covering recurring Dalet failure modes — Brio recording stuck, MDS/MDD agent health, AuditTrail freshness, BPM thresholds, NetXchange agents, WebSpace/Wowza restarts, send-to-NEXIO catchers, EDL agent errors, and DST offset checks.
    • Tie monitoring automation to tracked DNRNYD tickets with documented thresholds, alert logic, and remediation steps.
    • Contribute to the team's proactive monitoring posture and eventual integration with broader observability initiatives (e.g., Grafana).
    • Apply Python and modern tooling to extend operational automation where practical.
  • Mimir, Migrations & Platform Programs
    • Support Object Store-to-Mimir image and metadata migration work — including XML mappings, JSON watch-folder definitions, VOS re-tagging, shared-asset import logic, and batch validation.
    • Execute and validate large-scale content and metadata migrations (e.g., transcript backfill, person/non-person image regeneration) with minimal production impact.
    • Participate in Mimir Phase 2 and Pyramid platform testing — TestRail case authoring, post-upgrade retesting in DEV and PROD, and permissions/workflow validation with platform owners.
    • Support Project Fresh Start and Dalet upgrade activities (MFP testing, MS-SQL maintenance, version upgrades) as assigned.
  • Production Pipelines & Linux Administration
    • Own or support recurring production delivery workflows — including the Fox News Sunday Hulu unified-delivery package (format updates, captioning conversions, container changes, illegal-character handling, and external QA coordination).
    • Administer Linux systems supporting Dalet and related DNR infrastructure in NY and DC.
    • Perform MS-SQL queries and data tasks tied to Dalet metadata, migration, and reporting workflows.
    • Transform and validate XML metadata for ingest, migration, and platform-integration use cases.
  • Operations, Documentation & Collaboration
    • Provide frontline and weekend production support for NY and DC Dalet users — editors, media desk, library, and operations teams.
    • Respond to ServiceNow incidents and requests; maintain clear written documentation in Confluence for systems, scripts, and troubleshooting procedures.
    • Collaborate with peer DNR engineers (Mimir, Pyramid, ingest, editing platform) and BMT teams on cross-platform initiatives.
    • Participate in on-call and weekend coverage rotation aligned to live news production schedules.
    • Work a flexible schedule including evenings, weekends, and maintenance windows as required.

job.title: Manager, Revenue Partnerships
job.description:
Red Seat Ventures partners with the world's top creators across multiple genres to grow and monetize their content — through advertising, subscription, live events, and beyond. We take a multiplatform approach spanning podcasting, video, FAST, and more, backed by our own proprietary tech stack including Supercast (subscription) and Speakeasy (hosting, distribution, and monetization).

Named after Ted Williams' longest home run at Fenway Park, RSV was built with a simple mandate: swing for the fences. Today, we're the fastest-growing creator network, backed by Tubi Media Group and Fox Corporation.

ROLE SUMMARY

We are seeking a Manager Revenue Partnerships dedicated exclusively to our rapidly expanding Podcast & Audio Creator portfolio. In this role, you will sit at the intersection of podcast ad sales, revenue partnerships, and creator monetization. You will be responsible for transforming client marketing objectives into multi-platform podcast sponsorships. Acting as the strategic backbone for our sales executives, you will carve out and bring innovative ideas to the table that unlock custom budget across holding company agencies.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Podcast Strategy & Sponsorship Packaging

  • Custom Proposals: Architect both proactive and reactive custom campaigns tailored to brand objectives using our entire podcast audio and video ecosystem.
  • Inventory Packaging: Creatively package podcast inventory; including pre-roll, mid-roll, post-roll, and personal endorsements integrations around spiked interest periods throughout the year.
  • Multi-Platform Extensions: Integrate and build audio sponsorships with digital video (YouTube), social media extensions, events and distribution across streaming platforms.
  • Executive Storytelling: Build high-impact, visually compelling pitch presentations that are client-facing and best in class.

Sales Enablement & Monetization Growth

  • Marketing Support: Reporting directly to Revenue Partnerships, partner directly with Creator Partnerships, Sales Leadership and Account Executives to build narratives that support both creator’s initiatives and brand initiatives.
  • Market Intelligence: Work with Sales Research and Sales Marketing to monitor digital audio trends, creator economics, and competitive pricing benchmarks to maximize revenue per client.
  • Proactive Pitching: Turn proactive marketplace concepts into scalable, category-specific sales materials to unlock new brand budgets.
  • Creator Liaison: Collaborate with internal show producers and top talent to ensure revenue initiatives are met and brand integrations feel organic and brand-safe.
  • GTM Strategy and Framework: Coordinate cross-functionally with multiple teams to establish service level agreements, product minimums and streamline a process for GTM strategy for each show in the portfolio.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience: 4–7+ years in media/advertising sales development, media planning, digital audio partnerships, or agency-side audio buying.
  • Podcast Expertise: Deep knowledge of the podcast landscape, including host-read dynamics, programmatic audio and attribution tools.
  • Analytical Skills: Fluency with audience data and podcast analytics to evaluate campaign ROI and optimize ad spend.
  • Communication: Outstanding written and presentation skills, with a proven ability to pitch high-level media buyers and brand directors.
  • Adaptability: Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth startup environment backed by the enterprise scale of Fox Corporation.

job.title: Manager, News Technology Services
job.description:
#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?
We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, we’ve got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is… YOU! Becoming a part of Paramount means joining a team of passionate people who not only recognize the power of content but also enjoy a touch of fun and uniqueness. Together, we co-create moments that matter – both for our audiences and our employees – and aim to leave a positive mark on culture.

 

In This Role You’ll:

 

The Manager, News Technology Services leads technical operations for CBS News, managing technology infrastructure, hardware lifecycle, vendor relationships, and newsroom systems for major national and international coverage. This role requires technical expertise, attention to detail, and strong project management skills.

 

Responsibilities Include:

Strategic Leadership & Project Oversight

· Plan and deliver technology projects supporting news operations (broadcast, digital, live events).

· Oversee technology setup, logistics, and staffing for major news events.

· Coordinate cross-functional teams for system migrations, upgrades, and testing.

· Communicate goals, timelines, and outcomes to key partners and management

Technology & Infrastructure Management

· Manage lifecycle of technology assets (procurement, deployment, maintenance, disposal) across multiple locations.

· Ensure robust system administration, patching, vulnerability remediation, and monitoring using enterprise tools.

· Participate in administration of enterprise applications and user provisioning (Active Directory, OKTA, O365, Citrix, JAMF).

· Maintain system reliability, security, and compliance. (encompassing high-risk environments)

Financial & Vendor Management

· Develop and oversee budgets, capital purchase requests, scopes of work, purchase orders, and invoice processing.

· Participate in vendor selection, contract negotiation, and relationships with Corp Business Affairs and Corp Vendor Management.

· Provide financial updates to News and Corporate Finance; resolve invoice discrepancies and renew contracts.

Operational Excellence & Compliance

· Establish and implement IT service management guidelines and information security (ITIL or similar frameworks).

· Oversee employee onboarding/offboarding, asset recovery, and compliance with HR and Legal requirements.

· Monitor ServiceNow incidents and requests; establish KPIs and operational metrics.

· Lead incident response, security assessments, and InfoSec initiatives.

Team Leadership & Collaboration

· Build, mentor, and lead a high-performing technical team.

job.description:
#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?

  Overview   We are seeking a Senior Machine Learning Engineer to lead the development of our multimodal embedding and retrieval systems that power content discovery across Paramount's video library. In this role, you will own the full lifecycle of multi-modal embedding systems, optimized for text and video understanding, from generation, ingestion and indexing, to retrieval — directly impacting how millions of users discover and engage with short-form clips.   You will partner with product leadership, Content and Personalization engineering teams, mentor engineers and serve as a senior technical voice shaping how the platform "sees" and retrieves video clip content at scale.   The ideal candidate will be:
  • A hands-on systems builder who takes full ownership of pipelines that enable storing, indexing, and querying high-dimensional vector embeddings
  • Skilled at designing hybrid retrieval systems that combine vector similarity, lexical search, and reranking
  • Invested in multimodal video understanding as the foundation for meaningful content representations
  • Skilled at translating embedding system tradeoffs — latency, recall, cost — into product-relevant context that drives cross-functional decisions
  • Committed to mentoring and knowledge sharing with engineering resources
  • Effective at operating in a dynamic environment and comfortable taking ownership of project outcomes end-to-end


Responsibilities

Video Understanding & Multimodal Embedding

  • Design and build embedding pipelines for video content metadata and clip-level representation
  • Design collection and vector schemas to shape data structure, indexing behavior, and retrieval performance under scale and modality complexity
  • Lead the transition from traditional feature engineering to a vector-centric "context-first" architecture, through compositional queries and by designing high-dimensional hyper-vector representations that unify visual, textual, and behavioral signals
  • Design offline/online evaluation frameworks (e.g., nDCG, MRR, Recall@K) specifically for multimodal alignment, ensuring content embeddings match search intent
  Vector Search & Retrieval Infrastructure
  • Build hybrid retrieval systems that combine vector similarity search with lexical search and reranking layers to deliver fast, accurate, and scalable performance at production scale
  • Engineer the retrieval layer to capture nuanced user-content relationships that model training alone cannot surface, combining multimodal embeddings to improve recommendation depth at scale
  • Implement query-time optimizations including caching, filtering, and index sharding strategies
  • Tune vector quantization strategies (PQ, SQ, Binary Quantization) to reduce memory footprint and improve search throughput without compromising retrieval precision
  • Own performance SLAs and monitor retrieval systems for latency, throughput, recall, and cost efficiency
  Production Systems, Pipeline Engineering & APIs
  • Build and maintain scalable batch and streaming pipelines, with logging, metrics, and alerting to surface anomalies and maintain observability
  • Process content at scale using distributed frameworks such as Spark or Ray
  • Architect and build scalable integration layers on top of vector databases, exposing robust APIs and services for similarity search, hybrid retrieval, and metadata filtering
  • Own model versioning and embedding migration strategies, building compatibility tooling that prevents embedding drift from degrading retrieval quality across model upgrades
  • Collaborate with backend and platform teams to ensure interoperability with upstream data pipelines and integration with downstream personalization and discovery surfaces
  Cross-Functional Leadership & Collaboration
  • Communicate technical system behavior, tradeoffs, and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Mentor direct reports, providing technical guidance in multimodal ML, vector retrieval, and production systems design
  • Take ownership of project outcomes from scoping through delivery in a dynamic environment, proactively identifying and mitigating risks across video processing, metadata, and indexing workflows


Basic Qualifications

  • 5–8+ years of experience in machine learning engineering, with a focus on production ML systems
  • Expertise in multimodal ML, including experience with video, image, and/or audio embedding models
  • Deep knowledge of vector embedding generation, storage and retrieval, with preference for hands-on Qdrant experience (FAISS, Pinecone, Pgvector, AlloyDB or similar also considered)
  • Strong Python proficiency; Java is a plus
  • Demonstrated experience building and operating data pipelines at scale, including batch and streaming ingestion workflows
  • Solid understanding of hybrid retrieval systems: vector search, lexical search, and reranking
  • Proven ability to communicate technical concepts clearly and partner effectively with product and engineering teams
  • Track record of mentoring engineers and leading technical decisions in a team setting


Additional Qualifications

  • Experience with agentic systems and multi-agent orchestration
  • Knowledge of Diversity & Relevance algorithms such as Maximal Marginal Relevance (MMR) within the re-ranking phase
  • Background in video codecs, FFmpeg, or low-level video processing pipelines
  • Awareness with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems

Our vision is to build a thriving entertainment ecosystem where stories and worlds are imagined, brought to life and experienced. Paramount+ is looking for a Director of Social, EMEA. You’ll lead a team in creating standalone content, partner with colleagues to build social into the heart of marketing campaigns and stay curious about understanding results.

Part of the Paramount+ EMEA Marketing team, you’ll report to the VP Media and Social.

You’ll lead a high performing team partnering with Media, Marketing, Creative and PR teams to turn our biggest campaigns into cultural moments, not just activity that runs, but activity that gets talked about.   • Build a curious and creative high-performing team

  • Extensive experience in organic and paid social media at a leadership level. 
  • A strong track record in integrated social management within entertainment or a culturally engaged product, gained on either the brand or agency side.

KENS-TV San Antonio, the TEGNA-owned CBS affiliate in San Antonio, is seeking a competitive, coachable and results-driven Account Executive to develop new business and grow a portfolio of advertising clients. job.title: Senior Software Engineer
job.description:
Join the future of news

We’re on a mission to deliver riveting storytelling for all of America. At The Washington Post, you’ll help reinvent news. Our work is driven by a deep investigative spirit and enhanced by innovation to bring audiences closer to the stories that matter most.


About Our Team


The Washington Post is powered by the passion and talent of our people. It takes all of us to reinvent news. Beyond our award-winning News and Opinions teams, we work across many departments, including Brand & Events, Communications, Customer Care, Engineering & Product, Finance, Human Resources, Legal, Marketing & Advertising, Print Operations, and Sales.


Why This Role Matters

 

We are looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer to join the Subscriptions team at The Washington Post. This role spans the full application stack with a strong emphasis on the cloud infrastructure, delivery systems, and operational practices that keep our subscription products reliable and scalable. As a senior engineer, you will take ownership of complex technical work, contribute to architectural decisions, and help improve how the team builds, deploys, and operates software.


The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in AWS, CI/CD, cloud infrastructure, and production operations, along with strong application development experience in Java - our primary backend language - and Node.js, and familiarity with React. We value autonomy, initiative, strong communication, and meaningful day-to-day use of AI-assisted engineering tools, including continually finding new ways to apply AI to development, automation, operations, and team effectiveness.


What Motivates You

  • Strong sense of ownership and accountability for both the software you build and the systems that run it.
  • Passionate about reliable, scalable systems and making software delivery faster, safer, and more repeatable.
  • Proactive and comfortable driving complex work with a high degree of autonomy.
  • Comfortable moving across application code, AWS infrastructure, CI/CD, developer tooling, and production operations.
  • Actively uses AI in day-to-day engineering and continually looks for ways to expand its impact on development, automation, operations, and productivity.
  • Enjoys collaborating across teams, mentoring others, and communicating technical decisions clearly upward and sideways.

How You'll Support the Mission

  • Design, build, test, deploy, and operate applications and services supporting our subscription products.
  • Own technical solutions throughout their lifecycle, from design and implementation through deployment, observability, production support, and continuous improvement.
  • Design and maintain scalable, reliable AWS infrastructure using services such as ECS, Lambda, S3, RDS, IAM, CloudWatch, and related technologies.
  • Build and evolve Infrastructure as Code, with experience using AWS CDK strongly valued.
  • Design, maintain, and continuously improve CI/CD pipelines, deployment automation, and developer workflows.
  • Configure, operate, troubleshoot, and improve self-hosted engineering platforms such as Jenkins, Airflow, and similar systems.
  • Develop backend services and APIs primarily using Java, with Node.js used across supporting services, automation, and tooling.
  • Contribute to frontend applications built with React and modern JavaScript/TypeScript when needed.
  • Build automation that reduces operational overhead and improves the reliability and repeatability of development and production processes.
  • Establish strong observability and diagnose complex issues spanning applications, infrastructure, deployment pipelines, and third-party integrations.
  • Participate in the team’s on-call rotation, taking ownership of incident diagnosis, mitigation, communication, and systemic follow-up.
  • Identify technical debt, operational bottlenecks, and opportunities for improvement and proactively drive solutions.
  • Communicate technical decisions, risks, tradeoffs, and progress clearly to engineering peers, leadership, product partners, and adjacent teams.
  • Mentor engineers and contribute to technical standards, architecture discussions, documentation, and engineering best practices.
  • Use AI extensively throughout the engineering lifecycle and identify opportunities to apply it to development, infrastructure, troubleshooting, automation, incident investigation, and operational workflows.

The Skills and Experience You Bring


Minimum Qualifications

  • BA/BS in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5+ years of hands-on AWS experience, including designing, deploying, operating, and troubleshooting production workloads.
  • 4+ years of experience with CI/CD, deployment automation, and Infrastructure as Code in production environments.
  • 3+ years of backend development experience with Java, including building and operating production services and APIs. Java is the team’s primary backend language.
  • 2+ years of professional experience with Node.js, including services, automation, developer tooling, or infrastructure tooling.
  • Experience administering and operating self-hosted engineering platforms such as Jenkins, Airflow, or similar technologies in production environments.
  • Strong understanding of cloud architecture, networking, IAM, security, scalability, reliability, and operational best practices.
  • Experience building and maintaining Infrastructure as Code using AWS CDK, CloudFormation, Terraform, or comparable technologies.
  • Experience with containerized workloads and services such as Docker and ECS.
  • Strong production operations and observability experience, including logs, metrics, tracing, dashboards, alerting, and troubleshooting across applications and infrastructure.
  • Experience supporting business-critical systems through an on-call rotation, incident response, and post-incident remediation.
  • Strong software engineering fundamentals and the ability to contribute to application code when needed.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently identify, scope, and drive complex technical work with limited oversight.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate effectively upward and across organizational boundaries.
  • Significant hands-on use of AI-assisted engineering tools in day-to-day work. Candidates should be able to discuss concrete examples of applying AI to infrastructure, automation, software development, troubleshooting, incident investigation, documentation, or other engineering workflows.

Preferred Qualifications

  • 7+ years of hands-on AWS, DevOps, SRE, or cloud infrastructure experience, including ownership of highly available, scalable production environments.
  • 5+ years of experience designing and operating CI/CD, deployment automation, and Infrastructure as Code across multiple applications or teams.
  • 5+ years of backend development experience with Java and 3+ years with Node.js.
  • 2+ years of experience with React or a comparable modern frontend framework, with the ability to contribute to and support modern JavaScript/TypeScript applications when needed.
  • Deep experience with AWS CDK and building reusable infrastructure patterns, constructs, and deployment tooling.
  • Significant production experience administering and evolving Jenkins, Airflow, or comparable self-hosted engineering platforms.
  • Deep experience with AWS services such as ECS, Lambda, S3, RDS, IAM, CloudWatch, and related technologies.
  • Experience building reusable infrastructure, deployment patterns, automation, and developer tooling used across engineering teams.
  • Experience with observability platforms such as DataDog and AWS-native monitoring services.
  • Experience improving developer experience and engineering productivity through platform engineering, automation, and self-service tooling.
  • Experience mentoring engineers and influencing infrastructure, reliability, and operational practices across team boundaries.
  • Advanced use of AI-assisted engineering tools, including experience helping other engineers expand their effective use of AI across infrastructure, operations, automation, troubleshooting, and software development.

 

Collaboration makes us stronger. That’s why our offices are designed with open layouts, modern technology, and easy access to transportation. With certain exceptions for newsgathering and business travel, we work on-site five days a week.

Your story awaits. Apply today!

Learn more about The Post at careers.washingtonpost.com.

job.title: Fellow, A.I. Initiatives
job.description:
The mission of The New York Times is to seek the truth and help people understand the world. That means independent journalism is at the heart of all we do as a company. It’s why we have a world-renowned newsroom that sends journalists to report on the ground from nearly 160 countries. It’s why we focus deeply on how our readers will experience our journalism, from print to audio to a world-class digital and app destination. And it’s why our business strategy centers on making journalism so good that it’s worth paying for. 

Join the 2027 New York Times Fellowship class as an A.I. Initiatives fellow in New York.

We are looking for a fellow who will bring a mix of machine-learning and journalism experience to newsroom reporting projects. You will work with journalists across departments to identify, develop and execute projects that use the power of artificial intelligence, machine learning and data science techniques to address investigative challenges. You will be part of the A.I. Initiatives team, which includes editors, engineers and a product designer.

This is an in-office position and includes regular attendance in the office four days each week. There may be some flexibility to work remotely per your departmental guidance. You may be required to work some nights, weekends and holidays as needed.

Responsibilities: 

  • Collaborate with investigative reporters to support projects that benefit from A.I., including large-scale research, transcription, translation, document search, language analysis and computer vision tasks
  • Identify opportunities and experiment with responsible A.I. tools to empower the newsroom
  • Participate in training and social programs designed for the fellowship
  • Demonstrate support and understanding of our value of journalistic independence and a strong commitment to our mission to seek the truth and help people understand the world

Basic Qualifications:

  • No more than five years of full-time, professional experience in journalism and/or machine learning
  • Technical proficiency and experience analyzing data, developing applications and conducting research with machine-learning models
  • Editorial experience, such as interning in a newsroom or working on a college newspaper
  • Engineering skills and experience with APIs, front-end web applications and databases
  • Recent experience working with LLMs and other machine-learning models
  • Interest in the intersection of journalism and artificial intelligence
  • Understanding of ethical considerations surrounding the use of A.I. in journalism

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Record of multiple news or opinion journalism internships, or equivalent experience
  • Work demonstrating experience applying A.I. to real-world problems
  • Experience working with large datasets and cloud computing platforms
  • Experience working with Svelte or similar front-end frameworks

To apply, upload a résumé and cover letter. The application will prompt you when to upload materials. Applications that fail to include any of these materials or follow these instructions will not be considered.

This is an in-office position and includes regular attendance in the office four days each week. There may be some flexibility to work remotely per your departmental guidance. You may be required to work some nights, weekends and holidays as needed.

Responsibilities:

  • Write social copy and help shape how we share our journalism on social, analyze our presence and strategy on existing platforms, and evaluate opportunities on new social platforms
  • Interpret data and signals to shape how we present stories on and off our platforms
  • Optimize stories for search, and identify trending topics and competitive trends 
  • Work on projects to deepen engagement on our owned surfaces, including the home screen, push alerts, email and community products
  • Partner with the newsroom audience analytics team on deep and actionable analysis
  • Participate in training and social programs designed for the fellowship
  • Collaborate with colleagues across the newsroom
  • Demonstrate support and understanding of our value of journalistic independence and a strong commitment to our mission to seek the truth and help people understand the world

job.title: Sr. Manager, Website Personalization and Optimization
job.description:
Job Description

Are you a personalization strategist and operator who can turn vision into reality? Do you combine deep domain expertise with the ability to lead teams, influence without authority, and build scalable capabilities? We're looking for an experienced Sr. Manager who can elevate TR's digital experience through strategic personalization.


Key Responsibilities

In this opportunity as Senior Manager, Website Optimization & Personalization, you will own the end-to-end strategy, capability building, and execution of our personalization program—serving as the primary domain expert and strategic partner to our Senior Director of Web Experience Strategy & Optimization. This Senior Manager role carries a high level of scope and responsibility, requiring both strategic thinking and hands-on execution.


Strategic Personalization Leadership

  • Own the personalization strategy and vision for Thomson Reuters' digital properties, translating high-level business goals into a concrete, sequenced roadmap
  • Move the organization from one-size-fits-all messaging toward more sophisticated audience segmentation, content targeting, and journey customization—establishing what personalization maturity means for TR in a B2B context
  • Build the foundational capability roadmap: data infrastructure, audience layers, personalization frameworks, testing approaches, and technology architecture
  • Articulate the business case and ROI potential of personalization investments, translating technical capabilities into business outcomes across different customer journeys (awareness, consideration, purchase, retention, support)
  • Partner with the Senior Director on top-level stakeholder alignment, business strategy translation, and executive communication (Senior Director handles organizational positioning; you provide the domain expertise and operational clarity)

Program Building & Execution

  • Own the operationalization of the personalization program: define processes, workflows, governance, and ways of working that allow the organization to move from pilot to scale
  • Build the personalization roadmap in partnership with Digital Product Managers and other stakeholders, defining specific use cases, sequencing, dependencies, and resource requirements
  • Translate business requirements into technical specifications with particular attention to data strategy and instrumentation: work closely with Adobe experts (Target, Audience Manager, Experience Platform), WebOps, and CDP teams to understand technology constraints, data flow, and ensure proper analytical tagging that supports both optimization objectives and measurement integrity
  • Drive continuous testing and learning around personalization approaches—partner with the Senior Manager of Optimization on how to test and validate new personalization strategies
  • Own the learning engine—create documentation, maintain learning repositories, and produce artifacts that increase organizational knowledge about personalization & optimization successes, learnings, and best practices
  • Guide the Program Manager on program cadence management, milestone tracking, risk surfacing, and dependency management to keep the program moving forward
  • Leverage AI-native tools to enable personalization and speed to market.

Team Leadership & Development

  • Lead a high-performing team of junior and experienced optimization specialists, setting clear expectations and creating a culture of continuous learning and growth
  • Coach team members on both technical depth (testing methodology, analytics, audience segmentation) and soft skills (communication, cross-functional partnership, business acumen)
  • Build strong interpersonal skills: demonstrate emotional intelligence, establish psychological safety, and maintain clear boundaries that enable trust and accountability
  • Develop deep knowledge of each team member's potential and create growth opportunities that challenge them appropriately
  • Partner with the Program Manager on day-to-day operations, but own the team's direction, culture, effectiveness, and contribution to organizational objectives

Cross-Functional Alignment & Influence

  • Partner closely with Digital Product Managers and other marketing partners to understand business requirements and translate them into personalization opportunities
  • Coordinate across multiple reporting lines to ensure alignment on personalization strategy, shared standards, and data requirements
  • Serve as the translator between business stakeholders and technical teams—making complex personalization architecture accessible and helping teams understand business context and ROI implications
  • Escalate dependencies and blockers to Senior Director when cross-functional alignment needs organizational-level resolution

Required Qualifications

  • 8-10+ years in digital marketing, web personalization, optimization, or related roles,
  • 5+ years driving web personalization activities across large organization; ideally leveraging Adobe Target
  • 3+ years managing and developing teams, including coaching across different experience levels
  • Track record of successfully building personalization capabilities or programs from the ground up, or significantly expanding and maturing existing programs
  • Experience translating personalization strategy into operational roadmaps and delivering against them
  • Hands-on expertise with personalization technology stack from Adobe or other equivalent platforms, such as: Adobe Target (decisioning engine), Adobe Audience Manager (audience segmentation and activation), Adobe Analytics (measurement and insight), and Adobe Experience Manager
  • Experience with A/B testing and experimentation methodologies
  • Deep understanding of how to segment audiences, build and activate audience segments, configure targeting rules, and measure personalization impact across digital properties
  • Understanding of data strategy, data governance, and audience activation platforms
  • Success working in complex, matrixed organizations and influencing across reporting lines without direct authority
  • Experience in B2B or enterprise software is a plus

Required Skills & Attributes

  • Domain Expertise: You think in frameworks about personalization maturity, audience segmentation, content targeting, and testing methodologies. You deeply understand data architecture — how data flows through CDPs, how analytical tagging structures support both business reporting AND optimization/testing, and how audience activation works technically. You understand the technology stack deeply enough to advise on data strategy and capability roadmap, but you can translate technical concepts into business language.
  • Execution Operator: You don't just think strategically—you know how to turn strategy into concrete programs with clear phases, dependencies, and success metrics. You can operate in the ambiguity of building something new.
  • Independent and Self-Directed: You don't need to be told what to do. You understand the business context, you anticipate what needs to happen, and you take action. You have strong opinions grounded in experience, and you're not afraid to share them respectfully.
  • People Leader: You can manage diverse personalities and experience levels. You coach people, set clear expectations, hold boundaries, and create psychological safety. You're emotionally intelligent and patient, but also direct about performance.
  • Strategic Communicator: You can explain complex technical and strategic concepts to non-technical audiences. You can distill information and communicate at multiple levels (exec summary to detailed roadmap). You partner effectively with leadership on strategy translation.
  • Business Learner: You absorb organizational context quickly. You understand different customer journeys and business models. In B2B environments, you can learn fast and apply frameworks appropriately rather than just transplanting B2C patterns.
  • Cross-Functional Influencer: You can work effectively with teams that don't report to you. You build credibility, coordinate dependencies, and create alignment without formal authority.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Familiarity with marketing automation platforms and email personalization
  • Background in web development, statistics, or analytics
  • Experience presenting to executive leadership
  • Proven track record of developing high-performing teams
  • Experience using AI to advance personalization capabilities.

Personal Qualities

  • Intellectually curious and committed to continuous learning
  • Comfortable with ambiguity and changing priorities
  • Results-oriented and metric-driven
  • Collaborative, able to synthesize differing opinions into actionable directions
  • Energetic and forward-thinking about emerging personalization technologies and approaches

job.description:
About the Role

Are you ready to work at the forefront of applied AI research, where your work reaches real customers instead of staying in a lab notebook?


Thomson Reuters Labs (TR Labs) is the AI Research & Development arm of Thomson Reuters. We experiment, we build, we deliver.

Our mission is to create industry-leading AI solutions for Legal and Tax & Accounting professionals. These people make decisions that affect businesses, courts, markets, and lives.

We systematically explore emerging AI/ML technologies, and we stay focused on real customer problems and opportunities.


The Lead Applied Scientist is a senior, high-influence scientific leader within TR Labs. In this role, you will set the research strategy and lead the initiatives that shape Thomson Reuters' AI/ML roadmap across multiple product features.


You will drive innovation in specialized domains such as legal reasoning, document understanding, and knowledge graphs. You will establish the best practices and technical vision that other teams build on.


You will also serve as a thought leader, both inside Thomson Reuters and in the wider AI community, mentoring scientists across Labs and leading engagement with key stakeholders.


This is a role for someone who wants their ideas to ship. You will work with product, engineering, and business leaders to turn new methods into capabilities that customers use every day.


What You'll Do

  • Define the research strategy for your focus areas and align it with Thomson Reuters' AI/ML roadmap across multiple product features.
  • Lead high-impact initiatives from early experimentation through to production-ready AI capabilities.
  • Drive innovation in specialized domains such as legal reasoning, document understanding, and knowledge graphs.
  • Design, evaluate, and advance RAG architectures, agentic frameworks, and tool-using systems for complex professional use cases.
  • Establish best practices, evaluation methodologies, and technical standards that raise the quality bar across Labs.
  • Develop a deep understanding of customer problems and the data that informs them, and translate that understanding into the right AI solutions.
  • Show how novel methods can influence product roadmaps and business outcomes.
  • Lead stakeholder engagement across product, engineering, and business teams.
  • Mentor and grow scientists across Labs, building scientific depth and leadership capability.
  • Provide thought leadership through internal forums, external publications, conferences, and industry communities.
  • Deliver production-quality code with well-managed software and MLOps practices.

About You

You are a scientist who gets energy from turning hard, ambiguous problems into working solutions. You are comfortable moving between research and execution.


You can read a new paper in the morning, prototype an idea in the afternoon, and explain its business impact to a product leader the next day.


You combine deep technical expertise in modern AI with a strong product mindset. You are curious about the professional domains you work in, whether that is law, tax, medicine, or risk, and you want to understand customers' problems well enough to solve them properly.


You lead by influence. You build trust through scientific rigor, clear communication, and a genuine commitment to helping the people around you grow. You can explain complex ideas clearly to scientists, engineers, executives, and customers.

job.title: News producer
job.description:
Guardian Australia is part of Guardian News & Media (GNM), publisher of theguardian.com. As a leading global media organisation, we are renowned for our pioneering independent journalism and our award-winning digital products.

 

We are seeking for a news producer to be responsible for a full range of production tasks for Guardian Australia, including subediting and publishing stories, displaying them on the website and disseminating through social media.

 

This role is being offered on a full-time 12 month contract, working on a seven-day roster with early starts or late finishes, including one weekend day each week. This role is open to candidates in both 
Sydney and Melbourne.

 

In this role you will…

 

  • Edit copy for online content including articles, blogs, videos, galleries, interactives, podcasts and social media posts, correcting grammar and spelling, consistent with Guardian style
  • Ensure accuracy of what we publish
  • Write page furniture, assign tags
  • Add pictures and multimedia elements 
  • Write engaging and SEO-friendly web headlines
  • Add internal and external web links and cross-references
  • Create and/or edit picture galleries, polls and quizzes, video and audio pages
  • Display stories on the Guardian Australia website effectively and imaginatively 
  • Work on social media promotion of stories as required
  • Cover for the deputy production editor/production editor and news desk editors as required
  • Retrieve wire stories and use them to create articles
  • Liaise with reporters on story progress and to resolve any issues with filed stories
  • Liaise with lawyers, as needed, to resolve any outstanding issues before publication
     

You’ll bring….

 

Knowledge and experience

  • Subbing and production experience – ideally both online and print
  • Expertise in using web tools for editing and layout
  • Interest in and wide knowledge of the output of Guardian Australia
  • Demonstrable enthusiasm for and interest in web and print journalism
  • Understanding the editorial aims and values of the Guardian
  • Awareness of the needs and interests of the Guardian’s readers/audiences
  • Appreciation of Guardian history 
     

Skills and behaviours

  • Excellent writing and communication skills
  • Excellent production skills
  • Meticulous eye for detail, grammar and spelling
  • Ability to handle writers’ copy sensitively
  • Ability to learn and apply new skills quickly and thoroughly
  • Willingness to take responsibility for editing decisions, in collaboration with the news desk
  • Excellent planning and organisational skills 
  • Ability to edit copy quickly and accurately under pressure
  • Flair for writing headlines and other page furniture
  • Team player, enthusiastic with strong interpersonal skills
  • Logical, imaginative, adaptable and flexible
  • Ability to accept constructive criticism
  • A passion for independent journalism and an understanding of our editorial code and values


About working at Guardian Australia… 
 

  • Hybrid working 
  • Employee assistance program (EAP) to support employee wellbeing
  • Paid volunteer leave
  • Dedicated diversity and inclusion employee groups, action plans (including our Reconciliation Action Plan) and cultural competency training
  • Guardian digital subscription
     

For more information please view the full job description here.

 

This role is being offered on a full-time 12 month contract, working on a seven-day roster with early starts or late finishes, including one weekend day each week. This role is open to candidates in both 
Sydney and Melbourne.

 

To apply for this position, please apply online and upload your résumé (maximum three pages) plus covering letter. In your covering letter please outline your motivation for applying for the role and why you think you are suitable.

 

Closing date for applications: 3 November 2026

 

If you have application questions or if you require an adjustment to be made during the recruitment process, please email australia.hr@theguardian.com

 

GNM Australia Limited (Guardian Australia) is proud to be a fair and ethical employer. Australian editorial minimum rates of pay by band and grade are outlined in the Journalists (GNM Australia Pty Ltd) Enterprise Agreement 2024 for roles that fall under its coverage. 

 

We believe that our role in the Australian media is to give a voice to the most marginalised people in society and value and respect all differences in all people — including people of colour, Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples, people from different social classes, people with diverse gender and sexual identities, and people with disabilities (seen and unseen). We believe that these communities must be centred in the work we do, bringing a new perspective and a diversity of thought. We also encourage flexible working and aim to create a work environment where all employees feel respected.

job.description:
Job Summary:

JOB DESCRIPTION - CLIENT & EVENT SUPPORT MANAGER


Location: Brussels

Division: Global Support & Operations

Line Manager: Regional Operations Director

Contract Terms: Permanent, Full-Time 37.5 hours per week


THE TEAM


Global Support & Operations Organization has the mission to build a global support & operations center of excellence where all processes, tools & best practices are applied to all regions across the globe in order to achieve the highest levels of employee, fan & Client satisfaction.

EMEA Support & Operations team, a vertical of this organization, is accountable for supporting Clients in markets located under the EMEA Region (Europe, Middle East and Africa) and providing the ticketing service to the full life-cycle of their events (from onsale to entry).

Our Clients demand and value high service levels and we believe our people are the foundation to deliver great service. We are fortunate to have the most experienced and skilled operations experts on the field around the globe, regionally and locally, that have a deep understanding of our Clients’ needs. We then apply our own ticketing technology to help our Clients innovate in their offering and ticketing strategies.


THE JOB


As Client and Event Support Manager, you will lead and develop the Client and Event Support team in Belgium. You will be accountable for accurate, timely event programming across Ticketmaster’s Belgian client base and effective, proactive operational support for assigned top-tier clients. You will set clear priorities, plan team capacity and maintain agreed quality standards and service levels throughout the event lifecycle.


The role combines people leadership with practical operational involvement. You will coach the team, improve workflows and provide hands-on support for complex deliveries, peak periods and escalations. You will develop the team’s knowledge and judgement so that colleagues can manage their responsibilities confidently and resolve issues independently, involving specialists where needed.


You will help the team build trusted client relationships, anticipate requirements and support the adoption of relevant Ticketmaster tools and features. Working with Client Development and specialist teams, you will contribute to client retention and growth through reliable service, effective product use and practical improvements to clients’ ticketing operations.


WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING


Leadership and people development


  • Lead, coach and develop the Client and Event Support team, setting clear expectations for delivery, client service and collaboration.
  • Hold regular one-to-ones, provide constructive feedback and address performance concerns promptly. Agree development plans that build individual skills and support career progression.
  • Build team capability by facilitating training, knowledge sharing and cross-training, and by delegating work appropriately. Ensure sufficient expertise and cover across key responsibilities.

Event programming and service delivery


  • Oversee event programming across the Belgian client base, ensuring event setups and changes meet approved requirements, quality standards and agreed Event Management service levels.
  • Plan capacity, allocate work and maintain coverage for on-sales, event peaks and ongoing client support. Resolve competing priorities and escalate resource constraints or delivery risks early.
  • Maintain quality assurance and peer-review processes, ensure agreed procedures are followed and address the causes of programming errors and recurring delivery issues.
  • Provide hands-on operational support for complex deliveries, peak periods and escalations, while maintaining oversight of team priorities and performance.
  • Ensure event and support records in Salesforce are accurate and current, with clear ownership, status and next steps.

Client support and success


  • Build relationships with key contacts at assigned top-tier clients and ensure the team maintains regular dialogue and forward planning around their event calendars, priorities and service needs.
  • Act as the primary management escalation point for complex or high-impact client and event issues. Coordinate the response, involve relevant specialists and ensure clear ownership, timely communication and follow-through to resolution.
  • Oversee client onboarding, practical training and adoption of relevant Ticketmaster tools and features. Ensure the team follows up on difficulties and helps clients work confidently and independently.
  • Share client feedback, service risks and improvement opportunities with Client Development to support retention and growth. Coordinate agreed operational actions, while Client Development retains ownership of commercial agreements.

Process improvement and cross-functional coordination


  • Develop and maintain effective market-level workflows for Client Support and Event Management, adapting them to Belgian client needs while aligning with regional and global standards.
  • Monitor event accuracy, delivery timeliness, support responsiveness and resolution, recurring issues, client feedback and tool adoption. Use these measures to prioritise improvements, agree corrective actions and review their effectiveness.
  • Work with Client Development, Product Operations, Field Operations, Finance and Fan Support to coordinate service, clarify responsibilities and resolve issues that require input from multiple teams.
  • Represent Belgium in regional forums, sharing client needs, operational insights and successful practices. Coordinate local implementation of agreed product and process changes, ensuring procedures and team training remain current.

WHAT YOU NEED TO KNOW


Languages: The ability to communicate effectively in at least one local language (French and/or Dutch) is required, in addition to fluency in English.


  • Proven experience leading and developing teams, ideally within operations, client services or event management, including setting expectations, coaching colleagues and managing performance.
  • Strong understanding of ticketing platforms, event configuration and client support processes, with the ability to guide others, assess operational risks and support complex issue resolution.
  • Experience planning workloads, managing capacity and prioritising competing requests in an environment with time-critical delivery and changing demands.
  • The ability to design effective workflows, interpret performance data and lead practical improvements to quality, efficiency and service.
  • Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the judgement to manage client escalations, explain operational decisions and coordinate colleagues across different functions.
  • Confidence using business systems, CRM platforms and Microsoft Office, particularly Excel. Experience with Ticketmaster platforms, TM1 tools and Salesforce is an advantage.
  • An understanding of live entertainment or sports operations, and flexibility to support occasional evenings, weekends, holidays and on-site activity as required and agreed.

YOU


  • You give clear direction, make considered decisions and hold yourself and others accountable for commitments.
  • You develop people through practical coaching, constructive feedback and delegation, creating an environment where colleagues ask questions and raise concerns early.
  • You balance immediate delivery needs with improvements that build the team’s longer-term capability.
  • You build trust with clients and colleagues through reliability, clear communication and an understanding of their needs.
  • You remain calm when priorities shift, address difficult issues directly and raise capacity or delivery risks before they become service problems.
  • You stay curious about products and processes, welcome feedback, share knowledge and act with integrity.

LIFE AT TICKETMASTER


We are proud to be a part of Live Nation Entertainment, the world’s largest live entertainment company. Our vision at Ticketmaster is to connect people around the world to the live events they love. As the world’s largest ticket marketplace and the leading global provider of enterprise tools and services for the live entertainment business, we are uniquely positioned to successfully deliver on that vision. We do it all with an intense passion for Live and an inspiring and diverse culture driven by accessible leaders, attentive managers, and enthusiastic teams. If you’re passionate about live entertainment like we are, and you want to work at a company dedicated to helping millions of fans experience it, we want to hear from you.


Our work is guided by our values:


Reliability - We understand that fans and Clients rely on us to power their live event experiences, and we rely on each other to make it happen.

Teamwork - We believe individual achievement pales in comparison to the level of success that can be achieved by a team

Integrity - We are committed to the highest moral and ethical standards on behalf of the countless partners and stakeholders we represent

Belonging - We are committed to building a culture in which all people can be their authentic selves, have an equal voice and opportunities to thrive


EQUAL OPPORTUNITIES

We are passionate and committed to our people and go beyond the rhetoric of diversity and inclusion. You will be working in an inclusive environment and be encouraged to bring your whole self to work. We will do all that we can to help you successfully balance your work and homelife. As a growing business we will encourage you to develop your professional and personal aspirations, enjoy new experiences, and learn from the talented people you will be working with. It's talent that matters to us and we encourage applications from people irrespective of their gender, race, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability status or caring responsibilities.

job.title: Group Director, Omnichannel & Media Strategy
job.description:
At Real Chemistry, making the world a healthier place isn’t just an aspiration—it’s our everyday reality. Our drive to transform healthcare is informed by our blend of deep scientific expertise, human-centred creativity, and AI-driven insights, fostering a unique environment where innovation thrives and our people are impact-obsessed. As a global agency, we provide a full suite of services across healthcare communications and marketing to our clients, including top players in the pharmaceutical and biotech industries.

Our #LifeatRealChem culture is rooted in our people—we believe we are best together and are committed to excellence for both our clients and colleagues. Whether you're a seasoned professional or just starting your career, if you share our passion for healthcare and connection, we invite you to explore our opportunities.

Discover your purpose. Embrace innovation. Experience #LifeatRealChem.

Real Chemistry Media is the media engine of Real Chemistry, bringing together deep healthcare expertise, audience intelligence, data, technology, and creativity to build more connected and impactful experiences. We partner with healthcare and pharmaceutical brands to develop integrated media and omnichannel strategies designed around how people actually engage, make decisions, and take action.

The Group Director, Omnichannel & Media Strategy will lead and evolve omnichannel strategy across multiple clients, brands, therapeutic areas, and engagement programs. This role is responsible for driving integrated, measurable customer experiences that advance client business objectives while helping shape and grow Real Chemistry Media's omnichannel strategy capabilities.

As a senior strategic leader, you will bring a strong understanding of media strategy, audience planning, and the role paid media plays within the broader customer experience, combining that expertise with customer engagement strategy, behavioral science, data, analytics, and technology to create omnichannel solutions that influence behaviors and improve outcomes. You will serve as a trusted advisor to clients, a leader within the strategy discipline, and a key partner to Media, Analytics, Creative, Engagement, and Client Services teams.

What You'll Do

  • Lead omnichannel strategy development and delivery across multiple clients, brands, therapeutic areas, and engagement programs, ensuring consistent strategic excellence and measurable business impact.
  • Develop integrated media, audience, journey, engagement, and channel strategies that align with client objectives and drive behavior change across the customer experience.
  • Define the strategic role of paid media within the broader omnichannel ecosystem, connecting paid channels with CRM, owned, earned, field, content, and digital experiences.
  • Establish and evolve best practices for audience architecture, customer journey design, media and channel planning, orchestration, workshop facilitation, governance, and optimization.
  • Guide complex engagement ecosystems involving multiple customer types, media channels, markets, products, and business units.
  • Serve as a senior strategic advisor to clients, providing executive-level counsel on media and omnichannel strategy, customer experience, activation, measurement, and growth.
  • Own strategic delivery, client retention, and growth across a portfolio of accounts, including some of the agency's largest and most complex engagements.
  • Partner with Media, Analytics, Engagement Strategy, Creative, and Client Services teams to deliver integrated solutions grounded in data, audience insights, media performance, and business objectives.
  • Lead client workshops, strategic planning sessions, and executive presentations that influence decision-making and drive alignment.
  • Drive innovation by identifying opportunities to leverage media, technology, AI, analytics, and customer insights to improve client outcomes and strengthen agency capabilities.
  • Lead, develop, and coach strategists across the organization, supporting performance management, talent development, and succession planning.
  • Contribute directly to discipline growth through client expansion, business development, thought leadership, and the development of new strategic offerings and capabilities.
  • Maintain a strong billable contribution while supporting overall team utilization, revenue growth, and the continued evolution of Real Chemistry Media's omnichannel strategy practice.

This Position Is a Perfect Fit for You If

  • You are a strategic thinker who enjoys solving complex client and business challenges through audience insights, data, media, and collaboration.
  • You are adaptable, resilient, and energized by evolving client needs and business priorities.
  • You are proactive, resourceful, and comfortable leading through ambiguity.
  • You thrive in fast-paced environments and enjoy balancing strategic leadership with execution.
  • You are passionate about mentoring others and building high-performing teams.
  • You are motivated by driving measurable client impact and advancing the future of healthcare engagement.

What You Should Have

  • 12+ years of experience in media strategy and/or omnichannel strategy with significant media responsibility, within healthcare, pharmaceutical, biotech, or life sciences.
  • Strong knowledge of paid media strategy and the role channels such as paid search, paid social, programmatic, video, and other digital media play within an integrated healthcare customer experience.
  • Demonstrated success developing omnichannel strategies across multiple accounts, brands, therapeutic categories, customer types, channels, and markets.
  • Deep expertise in audience architecture, customer journey design, media and channel strategy, orchestration planning, behavioral science, measurement, and data-driven optimization.
  • Experience connecting paid media with CRM, field engagement, owned and earned channels, content, and digital experiences to create cohesive HCP and/or patient journeys.
  • Ability to interpret media performance, audience data, research, and customer insights and translate them into strategic recommendations for clients and cross-functional teams.
  • Proven ability to lead large, complex client engagements independently, advise executive stakeholders, and translate business objectives and insights into scalable strategic solutions.
  • Experience establishing consistent methodologies, governance models, operating frameworks, and strategic standards across teams and accounts.
  • Track record of driving client retention, organic growth, and new business while balancing billability, team utilization, and commercial objectives.
  • Experience leading multiple strategy teams and managing three to eight direct or indirect reports, including performance management, coaching, career development, succession planning, recruiting, and overall work quality.
