Job Summary:

Real Chemistry is looking for a Senior Account Manager to join our growing team!

 

As a Senior Account Manager, you will act as the key day-to-day client contact, managing relationships and taking responsibility for the delivery of several medium to large projects. As a client account lead or captain (depending on the size of the account), you will be responsible for managing the execution of parallel ongoing projects and take an active role in coaching your junior team and ensuring projects are delivered effectively alongside the account lead and/or sponsor.

 

You should have a clear understanding of the programme as a whole (not just the projects you are working on) across your accounts, increasing your involvement in the strategic planning and financial management of your accounts and focusing on developing your leadership style to actively manage up and down, based on project needs.

 

 

What you’ll do:

Client delivery

  • Act as day-to-day client contact: provide regular status updates to your client (leading updates on more complex projects); anticipate client needs; respond to client queries and share recommendations (following discussion with your account lead); manage client expectations on timelines, scope of project, etc.; take client briefs and clearly communicate to team members, implementing realistic project plans

  • Confidently formulate objectives and strategies for new client work with support from your account lead, ensuring that programme strategy is pulled through

  • Lead large projects with less support from your account lead, being accountable for the whole project from start to finish

  • Provide counsel to the client throughout the project with confidence to challenge the client when required; manage challenging conversations with the client, as required

  • Provide support to your account lead in addressing programme and team challenges

  • Formulate solutions to client challenges such as last-minute requests

  • Have a clear understanding of the programme as a whole (not just the projects you are working on), including the client objectives, strategy and environment so that you are able to confidently lead internal meetings and client calls

  • Ensure momentum is maintained across the programme and contact with client continues whenever the account lead is absent

 

Business development

  • Identify areas for organic growth within existing accounts (evolving existing programmes and/or additional tactics) and confidently sell new ideas in to clients, with support from your account lead

  • Play a management role in the new business process (assisting in the production of credentials and pitch presentations, coordinating and managing team members and external suppliers), having a significant share of voice/visibility with the internal cross-functional team

 

Team management

  • Begin to develop your leadership style, instilling professional values and good working habits in your teams

  • Look for opportunities to inspire, motivate, and empower your team on a daily basis, leading by example and setting the standard for junior accounts team members

  • Provide coaching and mentoring to junior team members and manage their performance

  • Support interviewing for new AAs – SAAs

  • Line manage at least one accounts team member AAs – SAAs, providing day-to-day support and longer-term career development guidance

 

Financial management

  • Develop more complicated budgets for integrated client programmes and track resource use against available budget throughout the month

  • Coach others to develop accurate budgets for clients, reflecting back on previous projects and gathering cost quotes

  • Support your account lead with the financial management of your accounts, proactively getting involved in invoicing, forecasting and resourcing and attend month-end finance meetings

  • Complete your timesheets and expense claims accurately and on time and take an active role in reviewing timesheets across the majority of your projects

 

Agency environment

  • Participate in internal initiatives which contribute to the culture or development of the Medical Communications team, or Real Chemistry more broadly (e.g., compliance/socials/inspiration)

  • Keep abreast of award-winning work and insights from other industries, sharing as appropriate

 

 

This position is a perfect fit for you if:

  • ​Our Company values – Best Together, Impact-Obsessed, Excellence Expected, Evolve Always and Accountability with an “I” – really speak to you.

  • You are adaptable, resilient, and OK with adjusting your scope, responsibilities, and focus as we grow. When things change, so do we. We’re always evolving.

  • You are proactive, driven, and resourceful with strong prioritization skills and a desire to dive into the data.

  • You are highly organized self-starter, able to work independently and under tight deadlines.

 

 

What you should have:

  • Relevant degree in a scientific subject

  • Excellent business communication skills, including informal/formal presentation and writing skills

  • Excellent business communication skills

  • Informal/formal presentation and writing skills; including presenting to clients

  • Skilled in data communication

  • Experience with Microsoft Office tools (PowerPoint, Word, and Excel).

  • Edit junior staff writing and presentation material

  • Must have Medical Education experience; integrated experience preferred.

  • Skilled in data communication and able to develop final documents and presentations

  • Able to develop solutions to client needs and problems, with a strong work ethic and a track record of high-quality deliverables on schedule and on budget

  • Experience coaching and mentoring junior team members

  • High energy, able to effectively operate in a fast-paced, growing and evolving environment

job.title: Accounts Payable Assistant
job.description:
Opportunity

Brunswick is seeking an Accounts Payable Assistant to join our Finance team. Working across a complex, international and fast-paced business, you’ll play an important role in ensuring our financial operations run seamlessly, taking ownership of everything from invoices and payments to expenses, supplier relationships and day-to-day queries.

This role combines accuracy and pace with a genuinely people-focused approach. You’ll have the opportunity to build trusted relationships with colleagues across the firm and contribute beyond the core AP process through wider projects and analysis.

We’re looking for someone who takes pride in delivering work to a high standard, demonstrates sound judgement and attention to detail, and enjoys being part of a collaborative team where professionalism, responsiveness and strong relationships matter.

About the Role

Your main responsibilities will include:

  • Ensuring invoices are processed accurately and on time, with a minimum of 30 invoices posted per day
  • Responding to AP mailbox queries within 24 hours
  • Reviewing and posting pending items daily, ensuring they are cleared within 48 hours
  • Preparing BACS payments every two weeks
  • Managing, reviewing and posting staff expense claims
  • Setting up and verifying supplier and staff bank details in line with company policy
  • Uploading batch journals
  • Reconciling supplier statements
  • Preparing and setting up ad hoc payments in the bank on a weekly basis
  • Responding to ad hoc queries and carrying out analysis as required
  • Supporting and reviewing the apprentice’s workload and development

 

What We’re Looking For

Standout candidates will demonstrate:

  • Accounts Payable processing experience, ideally within a multi-currency, multi-entity environment
  • A minimum of 12 months’ experience working within a finance team
  • A highly personable and collaborative business partner who can build strong relationships with colleagues and stakeholders
  • Strong numerical skills and excellent attention to detail

 

Why Join Us

Whether you are joining a client facing team, a core services team, or starting out on your professional career journey, joining Brunswick unlocks a range of employee benefits to support your financial future, health and wellness, family and community and continuous professional development.

 

About Brunswick

Brunswick is a global advisory firm. We help companies tackle high-stakes issues, navigate complex stakeholder relationships, and deliver high-impact outcomes. 

Our clients value our ability to anticipate, shape, and respond to the key players and forces in the financial and investment arena, regulatory and geopolitical universe, NGO community, workforce and beyond. They rely on us for deep experience, fresh perspectives and original thinking. So, in Brunswick you will find an exceptional range of experience and talent with a rich mix of backgrounds. From the beginning, we have prioritized attracting, developing, and retaining the best professionals in the industry, united by a culture of inclusivity, excellence, and intellectual curiosity.

Founded in 1987 in London, the firm has organically grown to 27 offices in 18 countries across the Americas, Europe, Middle East, Africa, Asia and Australia. We operate as a “one-firm firm” with no individual profit centers. This allows us to assemble fully integrated, bespoke teams for each client, able to draw on the full resources of Brunswick anywhere in the world. 

 

Brunswick is an equal opportunity employer.  All qualified applicants will be considered without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, disability, pregnancy, genetic information, or any other status protected by applicable law. Deutschland ist der drittgrößte Markt von WPP – geprägt von hoher Komplexität, vielfältigen Agenturstrukturen und umfassenden Transformationsprozessen. Um hier mehr Konsistenz, Transparenz und Effizienz zu schaffen, suchen wir dich als Head of Tax Germany (m/w/d).

Your role

As Canada’s national public broadcaster, CBC/Radio-Canada is committed to reflecting Canada’s diversity in its workforce, as well as across all of its platforms. 


CBC Saskatchewan is looking for a creative, innovative, collaborative and independent-thinking journalist/producer for a unique role as associate producer for the content diversification and creator network unit. This is a full-time, permanent position based in Regina or Saskatoon (open to candidates in either location)


This position is different from any other in Saskatchewan’s newsroom. Reporting to a senior producer, you will work with independent video creators, producing strong original stories that will find audiences on multiple emerging platforms. This work will push the boundaries of our storytelling, focusing on new, diverse perspectives and experiences, told in innovative ways with the goal to draw in new audiences. While the majority of your time will be spent working with and developing video storytelling projects with emerging creators, your job will also include bringing those stories to the audience, on multiple emerging platforms, to reach the audience where they are. From pitch to publication, you’ll strive to find homes for these diverse perspectives and stories at CBC Saskatchewan and across CBC, while fostering a community of creators and continuing to build this network.


Your strengths are both in imaginative storytelling and developing relationships with potential freelance creators, sources and audience members to develop projects that are firmly rooted in this community but that are also surprising to our audience. You are able to encourage and build momentum with emerging storytellers, bringing in their unique perspectives, while communicating the need to balance this with journalistically rigorous storytelling. 


Strong journalism, storytelling and relationship-building skills are needed, as well as an ability to write and edit. Video skills are an asset, but an interest in learning new ways of video storytelling is more important, alongside a genuine interest in exploring digital storytelling tools. 


An interest in mentoring and interacting with those outside the CBC is key, as well as a strong ability to communicate and share your work internally. An independent-thinker who can juggle multiple projects on multiple timelines is essential. Knowledge of contracting and rights issues is an asset.


As the primary associate producer for this unit in Saskatchewan, you will also  pitch original ideas that connect with the community, seek diverse perspectives and new creators as well as innovative treatments that help stories resonate with new audiences. You will work collaboratively with a small team based in Alberta, Saskatchewan and Manitoba. You will assist in developing digital content including researching, writing, editing, organizing shoots and reviewing freelancer work as needed. You will balance your work managing creator’s projects with content diversification or first person stories, on different deadlines. Work must adhere to CBC journalistic and/or show policies, practices and standards, but initiative and independent judgment are required.


Key Tasks include:

  • Seek out, connect and build relationships with emerging independent creators and talent from diverse and digital communities, mentor and guide them from pitch to publication and create a sense of belonging for them within the CBC.
  • Throughout the process, provide creative feedback and notes while communicating CBC’s journalistic principles and business and rights practices, ensuring that bar is met before publication.
  • Assist in developing content including idea generating, chasing of voices, writing, researching, editing, preparing questioning, setting up shoots, fact-checking, developing the writing or ideas of others
  • Assist in packaging Creator Network stories for multiple platforms as they evolve, including writing web articles, radio and tv scripts, YouTube titles and thumbnails, and producing social media content, as well as managing internal communications around publication. 
  • Contribute ideas for content and suggestions for treatment of original, compelling, diverse and people-focussed content diversification stories in Saskatchewan.
  • Potential to gather audio-visual material including interviews, video and photographs to enhance digital, print, and social media platforms as required. 
  • Potential to plan and execute community outreach events or other engagement-focused happenings that enhance the creator community and CBC’s role in it, or that generally address gaps in our coverage. This could include hosting screenings, workshops, meet-and-greets, speaking at journalism and film schools/ programs, and representing CBC at local film events and festivals. 
  • Develop and maintain contacts in a range of diverse communities around the region.  
  • Manage multiple projects on different timelines.
  • Communicate and collaborate effectively across multiple departments and outside CBC.
  • Act as a CBC ambassador in Saskatchewan’s production and creative communities.
  • Adhere to the Journalistic Standards and Practices of the CBC, some familiarity with media agreements, Business & Rights, budgets.

We are looking for a candidate with the following: 

  • University degree or equivalent
  • Five years’ practical and relevant experience, including some experience with collaborating in creative partnerships and content production
  • An understanding of local journalism, and the tools needed to produce it
  • A deep understanding of how to work with creatives from all walks of life, effectively communicating journalism, business and rights and other storytelling needs, while collaborating on unique, diverse, surprising and creative finished products
  • A strong sense of journalistic storytelling with an awareness of contemporary political, economic, cultural and social issues of importance to  this community, paired with a good understanding of the needs of a diverse Saskatchewan audience
  • A deep understanding and appreciation of diversity of perspective, opinion and experience and the ability to tell stories  from those perspectives – whatever that looks like.  
  • Must have strong creative judgement, initiative and a high degree of responsibility for the quality of work throughout the complete production cycle as well as publication, as well as the ability to provide imaginative and effective solutions, suggestions and feedback.
  • Excellent interpersonal and organizational skills, along with the ability to work under tight deadlines with multiple priorities interacting with different teams across the organization.
  • Strong critical thinking skills (familiarity with CBC’s Journalistic Standards and Practices is essential).
  • Excellent writing, editing, video producing and other digital storytelling skills
  • Able to keep track of a number of simultaneous activities and projects and prioritize and plan, and to keep enthusiasm and momentum going on projects that can take months and evolve over time.
  • Ability to generate, pitch and pursue strong, creative and original people-focussed story ideas and treatments with the goal of reaching new audience
  • Ability to seek out new voices and freelancers and develop relationships with audience members and potential collaborators
  • Knowledge of the digital space and trends as well as social media
  • A demonstrated connection to diverse communities within the Saskatchewan area as well as a commitment to producing journalism for audiences that are often underserved and/or underrepresented.
  • Excellent communication, interpersonal and outreach skills, along with the ability to work under tight deadlines with multiple priorities interacting with different teams across the organization.
  • Ability to give effective feedback and coach emerging content.

Behind the scenes, but ahead of the curve: help us develop the next-generation public service media organization.

 

Technology & Infrastructure (T&I) is the backbone and the future-forward arm of CBC/Radio-Canada. Our purpose is to constantly innovate to evolve and maintain the Corporation’s technology and infrastructure. We are the people that make stuff work. We make connections between media content, systems, people and places. We are the space in between.

 

A place with purpose. CBC/Radio-Canada has always been a highly regarded pioneer of media technology — not just in Canada but around the world. Today, we are transforming ourselves into a modern and agile public service media organization. Technology is the driving force, and we are the team making it happen.

 

This is a hybrid position with a mix of in-office and remote work. Work arrangements will be discussed with hiring managers per departmental guidelines.

 

Your Role


We are looking for highly skilled and organized Enterprise Architect with deep subject matter expertise in media systems Architecture for one of our downtown Toronto, Ottawa or Montreal Office locations.

 

Reporting to the Director of Media Systems Architecture, you will be responsible for establishing an unified technological vision by understanding media production processes and translating business requirements into technical solutions that deliver business value.

 

As part of the Architecture and Strategic Development (ASD) Department you will leave your mark by driving the shift from hardware-centric infrastructure to software-centric media production architecture.

 

You will enjoy innovative work in a creative and dynamic work environment, working with leading technologies and opportunities for continued professional development.  

 

How will you make an impact?

 

As an Enterprise Architect, you will:

  • Define and promote a common vision of Enterprise Architecture and establish clear direction on roles, responsibilities and priorities with stakeholders.
  • Lead the evolution of the Enterprise Architecture practice and drive the shift from hardware-centric infrastructure to software-centric media production architecture.
  • Define the strategy to connect Production systems with data governance,risk management, information security to monitor its implementation and effectiveness.
  • Participate in designing, documenting and communicating the current and target state architectures for major initiatives and other vendor-driven system replacements.
  • Document the High Level Architecture that outlines the structure, components, and relationships between business processes, data, applications and technology infrastructure.
  • Ensure that enterprise investments align with business goals and objectives.
  • Ensure that architectural decisions align with organizational policies, industry best practices and regulatory requirements.
  • Help establish and enforce architecture governance processes and standards.
  • Drive innovation by identifying emerging technologies and evaluating their potential for the organization.
  • Coach and mentor other architects, product owners/managers and business stakeholders to instill architectural thinking.
  • Build and maintain relationships with business and technology stakeholders.

 

Perks you can look forward to:

  • Four weeks of vacation per year.
  • Work from home opportunities.
  • Competitive total rewards package.
  • Opportunities to work with cutting edge technology.
  • Opportunities for continued learning and professional development - including access to e-learning services, customized courses and certification opportunities.
  • Opportunities to become a member of our Employee Resource Groups.
  • A creative and dynamic work environment, where your ideas and contributions can be heard, valued and respected.
  • A supportive management team committed to upholding the highest standards of diversity and inclusivity.

 

What you bring to our team

 

Minimum Requirements

  • Minimum Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, or computer science,Professional Engineer a definite asset.
  • Five or more years of enterprise or systems architecture and/or business experience in strategic and operations planning.
  • Ten or more years of experience in solution or technical architecture and application development
  • Knowledge of production systems ecosystems such as Playout, editing systems, Cloud Platforms, On-prem and hybrid solutions.
  • Understanding of business models, operating models, financial models, cost-benefit analysis, budgeting and risk management.
  • Familiarity with enterprise architecture tools, related graphical models and frameworks.
  • Understanding of various operating models such as project-centric and product-centric.
  • Effective leadership skills with strong soft and interpersonal skills, including teamwork, facilitation and negotiation.

 

Desired Skills

  • Organizationally savvy, with situational and contextual intelligence of the political climate of the enterprise and how to navigate obstacles and politics.
  • Balances the long-term (“big picture”) and short-term implications of individual decisions and organization goals.
  • Excellent written, verbal, communication and presentation skills with the ability to articulate new ideas and concepts to technical and non-technical audiences.

Run the board, play the appropriate music, features, billboards, commercials, etc. during live or recorded news and/or brokered radio programs.

Operate and troubleshoot radio equipment used in the course of the production of a live or recorded broadcast.

Technical perfection and flawless execution of control board and equipment to regulate the volume and sound quality during radio broadcasts.

Observe monitors and manage outgoing audio and sounds levels.

Follow program log.

Monitor all systems and make sure they are all running on schedule. Note any issues or concerns on log.

Monitor and update severe weather forecasts.

When required, go on-air to report on life-threatening or emergency situations until further support arrives.

Record, edit or play back any sound requested from broadcasts.

Voice and produce news stories/features as requested/needed.

Answer phone calls during shift and screen calls.

Monitor automation, transmitter controls, which includes pattern/tower changes and record required readings.

Assess emergency situations for the station, and make decisions on when to call for additional support.

Knowledgeable of, and applies as needed, all current FCC rules and regulations.

Report to work on time and work established schedule/hours. Ability to work other hours or alternate schedules as needed, as assigned or requested by Program Director with little or no notice. Such alternate/additional work can include weekdays, evenings and weekends.

Complete other duties as requested and needed.

Qualifications

High School diploma, GED or equivalent required, with a minimum one (1) year experience running a radio board preferred; or a combination of education and work experience to perform the essential functions of the job.

Must be able to respond and work well in a crisis and handle last minute and unexpected changes during work shift.

Be able to communicate quickly and clearly to co-workers and others as needed.

Ability to hear and speak clearly and follow both oral and written direction.

Ability to think critically and quickly and to articulate information in clear, concise manner to others.

Ability to think spontaneously and ad lib while on air in a coherent manner in situations that can change quickly.

Ability to learn automation systems.

Knowledge of transmission, broadcasting, switching, control, and operation of telecommunications systems.

Project a professional appearance and demeanor.

Ability to work in compliance with company and FCC policies and procedures.

Multi-task with a variety of duties while running the board.

Must be flexible and able to deal with unexpected changes calmly.

Able to make decisions and judgments quickly.

Follow directions well, especially over the phone.

Work well under pressure.

Available to work with short notice including early mornings, late evenings and weekends.

Ability to work established schedule and other hours as needed.

Physical Requirements: Ability to communicate in English, both verbally and in writing. Manual dexterity and fine motor skills to manipulate computer keys and board controls as well as general office equipment (telephone, copier, etc.) for extended periods of time. Wear headsets and be confined to a specific space during the course of work. Sit and/or stand for extended periods of time. Average pushing, pulling, bending, stooping and reaching over head. job.description:
Location: GA-Atlanta

Job Title:  Meteorologist - WSB TV

 

Position Overview

WSB-TV in Atlanta is seeking a Meteorologist to join Severe Weather Team 2. The Atlanta area experiences all four seasons, making forecasting a central part of our coverage. Severe weather is a major focus, and we’re seeking a candidate with strong on-air delivery who can provide breaking weather coverage with a clear, authoritative presence.

 

The ideal candidate is creative and clear in their presentation and graphic support, has a digital-first mindset and connects authentically with viewers both on-air and online. This Meteorologist will also contribute to daily editorial meetings and turn stories.

 

Please submit your resume, link to demo reel (including breaking weather coverage), and examples of digital/social content in your application.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Deliver clear, accurate, and engaging forecasts across multiple newscasts
  • Provide confident, in-depth coverage during severe and breaking weather events
  • Contribute to storm tracking and team coverage during high-impact weather
  • Create and publish timely, compelling content for digital, app, streaming, and social platforms
  • Produce weather explainers and enterprise content that enhances viewer understanding
  • Utilize The Weather Company and Baron Lynx weather systems to build visually compelling graphics and presentations
  • Collaborate with newsroom leadership to integrate weather coverage across all platforms
  • Represent the station at community events and public appearances

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree (or higher) in Meteorology or Atmospheric Science
  • Minimum 3–5 years of on-air broadcast meteorology experience (major or competitive mid-major market preferred)
  • Proven experience covering severe weather and extended storm events
  • Strong working knowledge of The Weather Company system
  • Excellent live presentation, ad-libbing, and storytelling skills
  • Demonstrated digital-first approach, including social media and app engagement
  • Flexible scheduling, including weekends and holidays, is required, along with participation in an on-call rotation
  • This is an on-site, in-station role in the WSB-TV Newsroom
  • Must have a valid driver's license and clean driving record

Preferred Qualifications

  • Active AMS Seal of Approval (CBM or CDM preferred)

About Cox Media Group 

CMG Media Corporation (d/b/a Cox Media Group) is an industry-leading media company with unparalleled brands, award-winning content, and exceptional team members. CMG provides valuable local and national journalism and entertainment content to the people and communities it serves. The company's businesses encompass 17 high-quality, market-leading television brands in 9 markets; 45 top-performing radio stations delivering multiple genres of content in 9 markets; and numerous streaming and digital platforms. CMG's TV portfolio includes multiple primary affiliates of ABC, CBS, FOX, NBC, Telemundo and MyNetworkTV, as well as several valuable news and independent stations. Stingray Group Inc. is a leading music, media, and technology company with over 1,200 employees worldwide. As a premium provider of curated direct-to-consumer and B2B services, we reach 400 million subscribers in 156 countries.

Stingray Advertising connects brands to passionate audiences across an expansive, multi-platform music ecosystem. Wherever consumers are watching, listening, or scrolling, Stingray is there.

Anchored by North America’s largest retail audio advertising network—reaching 800+ million monthly shoppers across 25,000+ top retail locations—we offer a seamless, full-funnel media suite across four core touchpoints:

  • In-Store Audio: Point-of-sale reach in major retail hubs like Walgreens and Albertsons.
  • In-Car Audio: Uninterrupted connection with commuters on the move.
  • In-Stream Audio: Digital audio streaming across premium music experiences.

From home to the car to the aisle, we empower brands to connect with active audiences at every step of their journey.

job.title: Broadcast & Media Technology Project Manager
job.description:
OVERVIEW OF THE COMPANY

Fox News Media

FOX News Media operates the FOX News Channel (FNC), FOX Business Network (FBN), FOX News Digital, FOX News Audio, FOX News Books, the direct-to-consumer digital streaming services FOX Nation and FOX News International and the newly announced platform FOX Weather. Currently the number one network in all of cable, FNC has also been the most watched television news channel for 20 consecutive years, while FBN currently ranks among the top business channels on cable. Owned by FOX Corporation, FOX News Media reaches 200 million people each month.

JOB DESCRIPTION

FOX News Media is seeking an experienced Broadcast & Media Technology Project Manager to lead complex technology initiatives across studio operations, live broadcast production, contribution/transmission networks, Media Asset Management (MAM) pipelines, and fast-turnaround content creation/editing environments.

 

This role will manage projects from initial discovery and technical requirements gathering through solution delivery, systems integration, testing, commissioning, and transition to 24/7 broadcast operations. The successful candidate will collaborate closely across broadcast engineering, studio operations, control rooms, post-production, editorial, transmission, infrastructure, cybersecurity, and external systems integrators/vendors.

 

The ideal candidate combines disciplined project management practices with a strong technical understanding of how broadcast content moves from field capture/ingest through studio control rooms, non-linear editing (NLE) suites, central MAM repositories, master control/playout, and multi-path transmission.

 

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITES

Project Delivery and Governance

  • Lead the full project lifecycle, including discovery, scoping, technical design coordination, procurement, installation, integration, testing, commissioning, cutover, hypercare, and operational handover.
  • Develop and maintain integrated project plans covering work breakdown structures, milestones, critical paths, dependencies, hardware/software lead times, risks, issues, and capital/operating budgets.
  • Establish governance routines, engineering working sessions, steering committee reporting, and change-control decision forums.
  • Coordinate workstreams across broadcast engineering, studio tech, transmission/traffic, newsroom operations, editing/post-production, IT infrastructure, and third-party vendors/systems integrators.
  • Track delivery against broadcast milestones, schedule, budget, quality standards, and operational-readiness criteria.
  • Maintain rigorous project documentation, including functional specs, system schematics coordination, rack elevations, acceptance test plans (ATP), cutover runbooks, and handover documentation.

Broadcast & Media Technology Delivery

  • Lead initiatives involving production switchers, audio consoles, studio cameras, robotics, multi-viewers, tally/intercom systems (e.g., Riedel, RTS), broadcast graphics (e.g., Vizrt), and virtual/augmented reality studio tech.
  • Oversee deployments for field acquisition, bonded cellular (e.g., LiveU, Dejero), satellite/fiber contribution, IP contribution protocols (SRT, RIST, Zixi), and baseband/IP ingest pipelines.
  • Manage MAM implementations, metadata schema standardization, ingest automation, nearline/deep archive tiers, LTO/cloud storage lifecycles, and media supply chain orchestration.
  • Drive technical delivery for non-linear editing (NLE) platforms (Adobe Premiere, Avid Media Composer), shared production storage (SAN/NAS/Isilon/Avid NEXIS), fast-turnaround news editing, and transcode/QC workflows.
  • Coordinate projects for playout automation, routing matrices (SDI and IP), primary/backup transmission paths, satellite uplink/downlink, terrestrial fiber circuits, and disaster recovery (DR) facilities.
  • Facilitate technical integration between newsroom systems (e.g., iNEWS, ENPS), rundown automation, prompters, and playback servers.
  • Translate operational and editorial requirements into clear engineering workstreams and technical deliverables.
  • Support infrastructure modernization and technology refreshes, such as SDI-to-ST 2110 IP transitions, cloud-assisted production, and hybrid on-prem/cloud workflows.
  • Coordinate technical design reviews alongside Principal Engineers, Systems Architects, and Technical Leads.

Live Operations, Commissioning & Deployment Readiness

  • Plan and direct factory acceptance testing (FAT), site acceptance testing (SAT), end-to-end rehearsal workflows, operational shadow periods, cutovers, and rollback strategies.
  • Schedule and oversee maintenance windows and deployment sequencing to ensure zero disruption to on-air linear feeds and 24/7 live studio operations.
  • Partner with Broadcast Operations and Engineering teams to establish support escalation models, monitoring/telemetry dashboards, signal path redundancies, runbooks, and SOPs.
  • Coordinate comprehensive operational training and knowledge transfer for operators, directors, editors, engineers, and technicians prior to on-air cutover.

Technology Modernization & Continuous Improvement

  • Partner with engineering leads to evaluate emerging broadcast standards (SMPTE ST 2110, NMOS, NDI) and cloud/virtualized production platforms.
  • Identify workflow bottlenecks in the content creation and turnaround pipeline, introducing automation for ingest, transcode, QC, and archiving.
  • Promote standard operating procedures and best-practice deployment frameworks across all broadcast and studio facilities.

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • Bachelor’s degree in Broadcast Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Media Technology, Computer Science, or equivalent practical industry experience.
  • Technology project management experience, with experience directly managing broadcast engineering, studio facility, transmission, or media production technology projects.
  • Proven track record leading projects through technical scoping, RFP/vendor evaluation, rack/facility buildout, systems integration, commissioning, and on-air cutover.
  • Demonstrated working knowledge across core broadcast domains, including:
    • Studio production, PCR/TCR control rooms, routing, and intercom systems.
    • Live contribution (SRT, RIST, ASI, Satellite, Fiber) and transmission pipelines.
    • MAM systems, automated transcode engines, and shared editing storage (SAN/NAS).
    • Post-production and NLE workflows (Avid, Adobe, automated QC).
    • Newsroom Computer Systems (NRCS) and broadcast automation/playout.
  • Solid grasp of broadcast video/audio signals and protocols (Baseband SDI, SMPTE ST 2110, AES67, Dante, PTP timing, MPEG-TS).
  • Experience coordinating structured acceptance testing (FAT/SAT) and high-stakes, off-hours facility cutovers with tight change-window constraints.
  • Proficiency with project management tools (e.g., Jira, Confluence, Smartsheet, Microsoft Project, Visio/Lucidchart).
  • Exceptional communication, leadership, and conflict-resolution skills, with the ability to bridge conversations between on-air talent/editorial teams and deep technical engineering specialists.
  • Experience leading facility buildouts, studio relocations, or control room overhauls.
  • Practical knowledge of IP media network architecture (SMPTE ST 2110, ST 2022-6/7, NMOS IS-04/IS-05).
  • Experience with broadcast equipment vendors and platforms (e.g., Grass Valley, Evertz, Ross Video, Sony, Avid, Imagine Communications, Vizrt, Harmonic, Telestream).
  • Familiarity with hybrid/cloud-based media workflows in AWS, Azure, or GCP.
  • Experience managing external Systems Integrators (SIs) and broadcast equipment hardware vendors.
  • Relevant industry certifications: PMP, CAPM, or technical broadcast certifications (e.g., SBE - Society of Broadcast Engineers certifications).

job.description:
About Gray Media:

About KMOV:

We operate a CBS + ABC duopoly in one of America's great news towns. That means more platforms for your work — First Alert 4 newscasts, new ABC 32 newscasts, and all-day streaming.

KMOV is the most watched television/digital news operation in Missouri and Southern Illinois with nationally-recognized and award-winning news, weather, and investigative content found both on-air and online. KMOV won the prestigious national Edward R. Murrow Award for Best Newscast in 2023. Based in suburban St. Louis County, KMOV’s home is a new multi-million-dollar state-of-the-art broadcasting and digital facility. Ranked as the #1 city in the nation in 2022 for new college graduates, St. Louis is now recognized for its low cost of living, convenient transportation, and robust arts and entertainment scene. Home to the world-famous Arch, St. Louis Cardinals baseball, City STL soccer, and Blues hockey, St. Louis is quickly becoming THE place to be.

Job Summary/Description:

We are hiring an MMJ to find the best moments in the St. Louis region.’ This MMJ will identify moments as they are happening and deliver them to the audience first.   If your instinct is to capture the moment that everyone will be talking about — the video, the sound, the development that makes our coverage the original source even when everyone in St. Louis is on the same story — keep reading.  

What Winning Looks Like Here:

In St. Louis, First Alert means something. It's a promise: when it matters, we alert first, we stay out front, and we don't wait for the 5 p.m. show to tell people what happened at 2 p.m.

As our Audience-First MMJ, you will:

• Hunt moments, not soundbites. Lead every story with the most memorable moment from the field — off the top, not buried at :45.
• Be the original source. On the day's biggest story, make our video, our detail, our reporting the one everyone else has to credit. How do you separate when it's 4 cameras on the same scene? Show us.
• Put audience over linear. Yes, your stories will air in our traditional newscasts on First Alert 4 and ABC 32. But first, you think audience: you shoot, you send, you collaborate live with our Digital Content Center to post with urgency — stream it, push it, publish it now.
• Live in the field. You hate sitting around in meetings. So do we — for this role. Your desk is your car. Your assignment is to be out, building, finding, breaking.

What You Do Every Day:

• Enterprise, break, and own hard news and breaking news in the St. Louis market
• Build and work sources aggressively — not just for today, but for the next big one
• Shoot, write, edit compelling, tight, moment-driven stories for broadcast, streaming, and digital
• Go live with confidence and clarity, especially when news is breaking and unscripted
• Communicate constantly with producers and the Digital Content Center: what's happening, what you have, what you need, what's next

You'll be coached, you'll be pushed, and you'll be given room to run if you earn it.

Qualifications/Requirements:

Who Thrives In This Role:

• 3+ years working in a TV newsroom as an MMJ/reporter — and you can prove you're different
• A reel that opens with moments, not standups. We should feel like we were there.
• Aggressive on breaking news, calm under chaos, relentless on follow-ups
• Strong photographer instincts: framing, natural sound, sequencing that tells the story without narration
• Digital-first habits: cut a vertical moment, write an urgent web alert and update it
• Source-builder: cops, courts, community, scanners, social — you have a system
• Team player who collaborates fast with photographers, producers, anchors, and digital producers

What We're Not Looking For:

• Someone who wants to anchor. This is not an anchor track.
• Someone who wants to wait for a 6 p.m. package to show their work.
• Someone who needs a meeting to decide to go after news.

How To Apply – Show Us You're Different

Don't send a generic cover letter. Send us:

1. Resume + link to reel (lead with your 3 best moments, not your 3 best packages)
2. In 150 words or less: Tell us about a time every station had the same story, and yours was different. What was the moment, how did you get it, and how fast did the audience see it?

job.title: Sales Planner
job.description:
We’re seeking a detail-oriented and analytical Sales Planner to join the AMP Sports Ad Sales team. This role is responsible for supporting the pre-sale and mid-flight operational process — developing accurate, strategic media plans and ensuring smooth campaign delivery across Digital, Linear, Social, and Audio platforms.

The Sales Planner works closely with Sales, Pricing & Planning, Inventory, and Ad Operations to ensure proposals, billing, and reporting are precise and aligned with business goals. This position is focused on sales and planning operations, not client relationship management.

Core Responsibilities

Pre-Sale Strategy & Proposal Development

  • Develop and refine multi-platform media plans aligned with sales strategy, pricing guidance, and client goals.
  • Partner with the Sales team to translate RFPs into actionable, competitive proposals.
  • Collaborate with Pricing & Planning to maintain rate integrity and ensure margin objectives are met.

 

Inventory & Deal Management

  • Coordinate with Inventory Management to confirm availability and optimize utilization across campaigns.
  • Maintain deal accuracy from proposal through IO submission, ensuring plans reflect current inventory and approved pricing.
  • Track sold inventory and forecast revenue pacing for assigned accounts.

 

Campaign Reporting & Billing Accuracy

  • Own the preparation and accuracy of campaign performance reports, surfacing results and pacing updates to the Account Manager for client delivery.
  • Partner with Campaign Management and Finance to reconcile billing, delivery, and revenue discrepancies.
  • Maintain up-to-date records of booked revenue, flight dates, and campaign changes to ensure accurate financial reporting.
  • Provide proactive visibility into any pacing or delivery concerns that may impact revenue or performance to Account Management and Sales.

 

Sales Operations & Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Process and review Insertion Orders (IOs) to ensure accuracy and alignment with approved plans.
  • Collaborate with Campaign Management and Traffick teams to support smooth campaign setup and execution readiness.
  • Support Operation Leadership in forecasting, reporting, and pipeline management.

 

Process Optimization & Collaboration

  • Maintain and improve internal planning documents, templates, and pricing matrices.
  • Identify workflow efficiencies to improve speed and accuracy across Sales Planning and Campaign Management.
  • Work with Marketing and Research to incorporate sponsorship opportunities or insights into proposals when applicable.

 

What You Bring

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience.
  • 3+ years of experience in media planning, sales operations, or pricing & inventory within a publisher, network, or agency.
  • Strong analytical and organizational skills, with exceptional attention to detail.
  • Proficiency in Excel and familiarity with ad sales systems such as Freewheel, Operative One/AOS, WideOrbit, Broadway, Prisma, or Google Ad Manager.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and work cross-functionally in a fast-paced environment.
  • A proactive, solutions-oriented mindset with a commitment to operational excellence.

 

The base salary compensation for this role is $66,500. In addition, this role may be eligible for a discretionary quarterly bonus, which would be awarded based on individual and company performance. job.title: Sales and Marketing Specialist - Business Development
job.description:
This Job Description May Cause Extreme Excitement and Career Growth 

At AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions, we believe a great workplace isn't just something we say - it's something you can feel when you join the team. Here, it's all about great collabs, ambition, and results but most importantly, we grow here, and we enjoy it here.  We're searching for that special someone, a driven, talented individual to join our innovative media sales team. In this role, you'll engage with new clients and show them how our innovative media solutions can amplify their brands and deliver measurable success. If you're energized by building relationships, closing deals, and making an impact, we'd love to hear from you. 

 

Sound like the right fit? Check out the checklist below and if it sounds like you, hit "Apply Now" and let's chat. 

 

Your Day-to-Day (aka the Playbook) 

Help Brands Thrive: 

Join our media sales team and play a pivotal role in helping brands and companies grow. By identifying new opportunities, building strong client relationships, and delivering impactful solutions, you'll showcase how our multi-media content platforms and digital assets can drive meaningful results for our partners. 

 

Your focus will be on helping clients achieve their goals, ensuring that every campaign is a success. When our clients win, we win - and we believe in celebrating those victories together! 

  

Make Connections: Embrace your powers of persuasion and make every handshake and meeting count! Every interaction is a chance to build a genuine connection and show clients how we can help them succeed. You're not just selling; you're building partnerships and long-lasting relationships. You're helping businesses find the right audience in the right place at the right time. When we say One Partner, Endless Possibilities, we mean it! 

 

Be A Trusted Guide: In this role, you'll connect with clients on a human level, understand their unique needs, and craft tailored sales and marketing solutions that deliver results. As their trusted advisor, you'll help them navigate the ever-evolving marketing landscape, ensuring every step of the journey is planned with care and precision.  

 

Shake Things Up: Bring your creativity and fresh ideas to the table! We're looking for someone who challenges the status quo, embraces innovation, and finds new ways to connect with our audience. Your contributions will help elevate our brand and drive meaningful results for your clients.  

 

Join us and Conquer the Media Landscape: You'll be part of a dedicated team of A1 media sales professionals, committed to achieving market leadership. Together, we amplify our impact, deliver exceptional outcomes, and help our clients succeed in ways that truly matter. 

 

Identify Emerging Opportunities: It's about being able to see what others can't, anticipating market shifts, analyzing data and predicting the next big thing. Your insights will position our clients and AMP for long-term success.  

  

What We're Looking For 

Proven Sales Ability and an Unstoppable Desire to Learn

You're a seasoned sales professional and we value your drive, energy, and passion for achieving results. 

 

Strong Communication Skills: You're a natural at building relationships and communicating effectively. Proficiency with digital tools and applications is a must. 

 

A Passion for helping Others: You're committed to understanding clients' needs, providing top-notch customer service and making a difference. You're not just selling a product; you're providing a solution.  

 

A Competitive Spirit: Do you get a little boost when you achieve a goal (especially if it was a tough one)? We love that for you (and us)!  We want someone who's driven to excel but also knows how to celebrate the victories (big and small) with their team. That drive makes you a valuable part of our organization.  

 

A Willingness to Grow: Do you thrive in environments where you're always learning something new? Excellent, you'll fit right in! The media world is constantly evolving, and the ability to learn, adapt, and embrace challenges in a fast-paced, digital-first environment is key.  

 

The Practical Stuff 

A valid driver's license, up-to-date insurance, and reliable transportation are necessary for connecting with clients in your community. 

 

Why Join AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions? / The Reasons You Should Hit "Apply Now" 

 

Serious Work, Seriously Cool People: Be part of a dynamic team that values creativity, collaboration, and fun! We are all for work that is rewarding.  

 

The Compensation Package: We offer a base salary, commission structure, and benefits package designed to support your success and well-being. Happy employees don't stage rebellions! ;) 

 

We Make a Real Difference (Not Just Talk About It): At AMP, we help local businesses thrive through advertising strategies that create tangible impacts. Our media sales specialist isn't just selling ads; they're the boots on the ground, making a real difference where it counts. (And yes, it feels pretty good.) 

 

Top-Notch Training and Support: We're not the kind of company that hires you and then disappears into the corporate abyss. We carefully select candidates for a cohort-based training program, where you'll join a group of sales professionals from all over the country. From onboarding to ongoing mentorship, we invest in your success with training programs that set you up for long-term growth. 

 

Career Growth Opportunities: We believe in investing in you. That's why you'll have access to training, mentorship, and career advancement opportunities to help you thrive. We are a leader in our industry, flexing our local charm and national muscle, providing you with options to amplify your career in your local market or join one of our AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions teams in another city.  

 

Comprehensive Media Education (We Are Your Power Source!): New to the industry? We've got you covered with training programs that turn curiosity into expertise.   

 

AMP is us. It's you. It isn't just a name; it's a mission. A promise to amplify our reach, amplify our innovation, and most importantly, amplify you. If you're ready to grow your career and help businesses achieve their goals, we'd love to hear from you.  

 

EEO AND INCLUSIVITY 

Sinclair is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and a drug free workplace. Employment practices will not be inﬂuenced or aﬀected by virtue of an applicant's or employee's race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, gender identity, and sexual orientation), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, military or veteran status or any other characteristic protected by law. 

 

The base salary compensation for this role is $60,000. This position is also eligible to earn uncapped commissions of sales the employee closes that meet the definition of "earned." Final compensation for this role will be determined by various factors such as a candidates’ relevant work experience, skills, certifications, and geographic location. Full time positions are eligible for benefits that include participation in a retirement plan, life and disability insurance, health, dental and vision plans, flexible spending accounts, 15 paid vacation days, 2 paid personal days, 9 paid holidays, 40 hours of paid sick leave, parental leave, and employee stock purchase plan.

job.description:
This Job Description May Cause Extreme Excitement and Career Growth 

At AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions, we believe a great workplace isn't just something we say — it's something you can feel when you join the team. Here, it's all about great collabs, ambition, and results but most importantly, we grow here, and we enjoy here.  We're searching for that special someone — a driven, talented individual to join our innovative media sales team. In this role, you'll engage with new and existing clients and show them how our innovative media solutions can amplify their brands and deliver measurable success. If you're energized by building relationships, closing deals, and making an impact, we'd love to hear from you. 


Sound like the right fit? Check out the checklist below and if it sounds like you, hit "Apply Now" and let's chat. 


Your Day-to-Day (aka the Playbook) 

Help Brands Thrive: 

Join our media sales team and play a pivotal role in helping brands and companies grow. By identifying new opportunities, building strong client relationships, and delivering impactful solutions, you'll showcase how our multi-media content platforms and digital assets can drive meaningful results for our partners. 


Your focus will be on helping clients achieve their goals, ensuring that every campaign is a success. When our clients win, we win—and we believe in celebrating those victories together! 

  

Make Connections: Embrace your powers of persuasion and make every handshake and meeting count! Every interaction is a chance to build a genuine connection and show clients how we can help them succeed. You're not just selling; you're building partnerships. You're helping businesses find the right audience in the right place at the right time. When we say One Partner, Endless Possibilities, we mean it! 

 

Be A Trusted Guide: In this role, you'll connect with clients on a human level, understand their unique needs, and craft tailored sales and marketing solutions that deliver results. As their trusted advisor, you'll help them navigate the ever-evolving marketing landscape, ensuring every step of the journey is planned with care and precision.  

 

Shake Things Up: Bring your creativity and fresh ideas to the table! We're looking for someone who challenges the status quo, embraces innovation, and finds new ways to connect with our audience. Your contributions will help elevate our brand and drive meaningful results for your clients.  

 

Join us and Conquer the Media Landscape: You'll be part of a dedicated team of A1 media sales professionals, committed to achieving market leadership. Together, we amplify our impact, deliver exceptional outcomes, and help our clients succeed in ways that truly matter. 

 

Identify Emerging Opportunities: It's about being able to see what others can't, anticipating market shifts, analyzing data and predicting the next big thing. Your insights will position our clients and AMP for long-term success.  

  

What We're Looking For 

Proven Sales Ability (or an Unstoppable Desire to Learn)

Strong Communication Skills: You're a natural at building relationships and communicating effectively. Proficiency with digital tools and applications is a must. 

 

A Passion for helping Others: You're committed to understanding clients' needs, providing top-notch customer service and making a difference. You're not just selling a product; you're providing a solution.  


A Competitive Spirit: Do you get a little boost when you achieve a goal (especially if it was a tough one)? We love that for you (and us)!  We want someone who's driven to excel but also knows how to celebrate the victories (big and small) with their team. That drive makes you a valuable part of our organization.  


A Willingness to Grow: Do you thrive in environments where you're always learning something new? Excellent, you'll fit right in! The media world is constantly evolving, and the ability to learn, adapt, and embrace challenges in a fast-paced, digital-first environment is key.  

 

The Practical Stuff 

A valid driver's license, up-to-date insurance, and reliable transportation are necessary for connecting with clients in your community. 

 

Why Join AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions? / The Reasons You Should Hit "Apply Now" 

 

Serious Work, Seriously Cool People: Be part of a dynamic team that values creativity, collaboration, and fun! We are all for work that is rewarding.  

 

The Compensation Package: We offer a base salary, commission structure, and benefits package designed to support your success and well-being. Happy employees don't stage rebellions! ;) 

 

We Make a Real Difference (Not Just Talk About It): At AMP, we help local businesses thrive through advertising strategies that create tangible impacts. Our media sales specialist isn't just selling ads; they're the boots on the ground, making a real difference where it counts. (And yes, it feels pretty good.) 

 

Top-Notch Training and Support: We're not the kind of company that hires you and then disappears into the corporate abyss. We carefully select candidates for a cohort-based training program, where you'll join a group of sales professionals from all over the country. From onboarding to ongoing mentorship, we invest in your success with training programs that set you up for long-term growth. 

 

Career Growth Opportunities: We believe in investing in you. That's why you'll have access to training, mentorship, and career advancement opportunities to help you thrive. We are a leader in our industry, flexing our local charm and national muscle, providing you with options to amplify your career in your local market or join one of our AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions teams in another city.  

 

Comprehensive Media Education (We Are Your Power Source!): New to the industry? We've got you covered with training programs that turn curiosity into expertise.

job.title: Producer
job.description:
Storytelling is, and will always be, the heart of what we do at Skydance. Our vision is to build a thriving entertainment ecosystem where stories and worlds are imagined, brought to life and experienced. We create for every age and audience, anchored by the strength of our content and experiences and the depth of our connection with fans. We are creator-first, audience-focused, tech-forward, globally scaled. Here, you’ll work with talented teams that move fast, think boldly and collaborate with purpose to deliver results. We aim high, champion the best ideas and win together, earning the trust of our employees, creators, partners and audiences every day. If you’re energized by the opportunity to help build the next-generation global media and entertainment company powered by creativity and technology, we’d be thrilled to welcome you aboard. LET’S GO! We are the now and the next. The power behind the people building the future. We are born from the spirit of innovation. We are created from the idea that people around the world want more, need more, deserve more. We are the home of the global digital revolution. We are CNN. ã

¤ Your New Role The Producer of Global Productions is a vital role in CNN’s feature content team. They will be responsible for producing feature content for all of CNN’s platforms - from written digital features to crafting bite-sized social videos to filming full 30-minute TV documentaries - and strive to innovate and experiment with new technologies. This position is ideal for a someone with experience of producing beautiful, impactful stories for digital, TV and social platforms. They will be journalists with a passion for global storytelling and travel. Your Role Accountabilities A Producer is a master storyteller who can write and crafts content that connects with audiences – wherever they are, and wherever they’re going next. They conceive story treatments across a range of different platforms, including digital, TV and social media, while maintaining CNN’s high standards. The Producer will work across CNN’s portfolio of sponsored series, often in partnership with other producers or specialist section editors, to deliver against defined KPIs. They will work in a team that travels extensively and collaborate with regional bureaus to introduce CNN’s global audience to the wonders, innovation and compelling characters found in other locations. The Producer will take on ambitious video storytelling challenges, working with CNN’s on-air talent and many different teams to deliver content that distinguishes CNN against the company’s competitors. They will organize production logistics and production schedule, regularly working to tight deadlines. They will work with camera operators and video editors to script and create editorial features to CNN’s editorial standards. They will also ensure that Ofcom guidelines are followed, and that CNN’s defined editorial processes and procedures are adhered to. The Producer will also create stand-out digital content including long and short-form articles, interactives, image galleries, videos, infographics, photo essays, social content, and opinion writes. This content will contribute to successful delivery of sponsorship KPIs and the wider CNN audience growth targets. This position will work under the Executive Producer who will assign budgets and goals for each sponsored campaign. The Producer will also work with Concept Development experts to ideate new sponsorship series proposals. This role is suitable for ambitious storytellers who nurture relationships and collaborate effectively with others to create content that helps the team to achieve success. Qualifications & Experience Proven track record of creating engaging content (written, video, social) that drives traffic. Strong writing and editing skills are essential skills for this role. Relevant experience and passion in using social media as a publishing and audience engagement tool Must be comfortable with news and feature production and understand the difference. Strong communicator and collaborator. Strong and proven editorial judgment. Deep understanding of multiple platforms and different devices. A good understanding of current affairs is a must. Must understand S&P and Ofcom compliance guidelines Must be organized, efficient and able to multi-task booking, logistics, and research. A positive, self-starting attitude will serve the candidate well in this position. About Skydance Skydance is a next-generation global media and entertainment company, comprised of three business segments: Studios, Direct-to-Consumer, and TV Media. Skydance's portfolio unites legendary brands, including Paramount, Warner Bros., HBO and HBO Max, Paramount+, Pluto TV, CBS, CNN, CBS Sports, TNT Sports, Nickelodeon, Cartoon Network, MTV, Food Network, BET, HGTV, and Comedy Central. Job Summary: Job Requirements Disney Cruise Line has established itself as a world-renowned leader in hospitality and entertainment and has been recognized as the top cruise line for families. Our cast & crew help to ensure magic, and memories are made while creating unforgettable vacation experiences and delivering outstanding guest service every day. Are you ready to have this magic start with you? You will be joining a highly collaborate team of recruiters located in Celebration, Florida. Your role will be to build and execute creative sourcing strategies, attract and acquire outstanding talent from around the world for employment on board our beautiful cruise ships with the potential to also support our shore side US-based professional recruitment needs . You will successfully make a difference to the fleet and shore side expansion and overall organizational growth of a dynamic business. As a dedicated talent connection professional supporting our shipboard Entertainment Operations, Security and/or Medical lines of business, you will help to source and select cast, crew and officers. If selected to interview, you must be receptive to any one of these areas as the specific lines of business will be a combination of this and confirmed at the time of offer. Working here is not your ordinary recruitment job. This position offers a fantastic opportunity for you to interact with different countries and cultures, while enriching the lives of others. As a team, our focus is on our candidates and crew. Our goal is to provide positive recruitment and smooth onboarding experiences to all while creating unforgettable career opportunities. We are in the business of changing lives! In this role, you will report to the Sr. Mgr-Disney Cruise Line Recruitment. You will be required to work in Celebration, FL days four days (commonly Monday-Thursday) a week collaborating with your team and clients in our on-site offices with Friday commonly being a remote day. In this role, you will be required to periodically travel, domestically and/or internationally, to support the needs of your line(s) of business. Your Responsibilities – How You Will Make a Difference Develop line of business specific search strategies by facilitating passive and active talent pipelining for shipboard crew and officers through creative sourcing strategies, interactive marketing plans and networking opportunities. Lead day-to-day shipboard recruitment needs based on labor forecasts and diversity strategies supporting shipboard Entertainment Operations, Security and/or Medical. Potentially help to also support full life cycle recruitment for professional cast working in our US land-based operation ensuring the candidate and client experiences are met with exceptional service delivery. Add to the success of ongoing virtual recruitment hire plans by conducting video interviews for entry level positions within Hotel & Entertainment Operations. Project lead results-driven recruitment and business growth needs. Collaborate with appropriate hiring leaders to develop an influential understanding of the department, business strategy and talent profiles to deliver on hiring needs. Cultivate and establish connections with key partners within Operations, Talent Connection Marketing, Analytics, Labor/Scheduling, Compensation, and Human Resources. Continuously develop business knowledge of the maritime and hospitality industry and current market dynamics and share your functional/technical expertise. Lead domestic and international recruitment trips and expand our recruitment brand through attendance at job/career fairs. Develop and cultivate relationships with Procurement Allies (hiring agents) from around the world so we can attract and excite candidates and ensure our ships are staffed with the best crew in the world. Discover alumni networks, schools, and organizations from around the world to increase brand awareness and promote Disney Cruise Line as an employer of choice. Lead projects that will recommend and activate new best practices to improve recruitment processes, services and/or the overall candidate experience. Basic Qualifications – What You Will Bring 5+ years of full life cycle recruiting and developing and driving comprehensive sourcing/recruitment plans. Readiness to collaborate with clients about talent needs, craft and implement recruitment strategies that build diverse talent pipelines to meet business needs. Experience succeeding in a fast-paced environment where multiple projects and the need to manage requisitions are the norm. Shown experience working as an influential change agent who can manage ambiguous and fluid situations. Passion for the lines of business you will eventually support. Avid social media user with proficiency in using platforms for marketing, engaging, networking, and sourcing. Excellent consultative, presentation, facilitation and influencing skills and outstanding diligence. Strong storyteller. Able to translate data, identify trends and relay insights. A spirit of adventure! Willingness to pack your bags as international travel is required. Preferred Qualifications Experience with Disney Cruise Line (shipboard or shore side). Expertise in the cruise industry. Experience with Brassring, Workday, Phenom, or an equivalent Applicant Tracking System. Education Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience. job.description: Keywords Location Search Jobs Production Associate Job ID 10162247 Location New York, New York, United States Business ABC News Date posted Oct. 20, 2026 Production Associate Apply Now Save Job SHARE Facebook LinkedIn Email WhatsApp Links open in new tabs. Job Summary: Job Requirements Production Associate Job Summary ABC News is looking for a Production Associate to support the Assignment Desk in our New York Bureau. This role provides editorial, production, and logistical support to producers, correspondents, and newsroom teams covering daily news and breaking stories across platforms. This is an overnight position, and candidates must be available to work overnight shifts. The ideal candidate is highly organized, adaptable, and passionate about current events and journalism. This position offers an opportunity to contribute to impactful storytelling while developing a broad understanding of operations in a 24/7 newsroom. Key Responsibilities Support producers and correspondents with assignment logistics, including travel bookings, scheduling, credentialing, and administrative coordination. Assist with live-shot production for broadcasts, including Good Morning America and World News Tonight , and coordinate live and recorded segments. Receive and monitor video feeds, news wires, and social platforms to track developing stories, flagging significant updates for editorial teams. Coordinate information across ABC News platforms, News Services clients, and owned and affiliated stations through Microsoft Teams, phone, and email. Research and pitch stories, gather information, and organize production materials to support accurate and timely coverage. Assist with clearing user-generated social media content. Log, transcribe, edit, and process video content for distribution across ABC News platforms. Support operational readiness as coverage priorities shift, performing additional production and newsgathering duties as assigned. Basic Qualifications Minimum of one year of experience in a newsroom or news-related environment. Genuine interest in current events, journalism, and news production. Strong organizational and multitasking skills, with close attention to detail. Ability to manage competing priorities, work effectively under pressure, and meet tight deadlines. Strong verbal and written communication skills. Proficiency with Microsoft Teams, email, and common business and communication tools, with the ability to learn newsroom systems. Availability to work the required overnight schedule, with flexibility for evenings, weekends, holidays, and extended hours as coverage demands. Preferred Qualifications Strong news judgment and curiosity about local, national, and international events. Ability to remain calm and focused during breaking news. Collaborative approach and willingness to support teams across functions. Initiative, accountability, and strong problem-solving skills. Adaptability as editorial and operational needs evolve. Required Education BA or BS from an accredited four-year college or university, or equivalent professional experience. Disclaimer PAY TRANSPARENCY he hiring range for this position in New York, NY is $57,400 to $77,000 per year based on a 40 hour work week. The amount of hours scheduled per week may vary based on business needs. A bonus and/or long-term incentive units may be provided as part of the compensation package, in addition to the full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits, dependent on the level and position offered. job.title: Freelance Assignment Editor, FOX Weather
job.description:
FOX Weather is America’s Weather Team, and we are seeking a confident, highly motivated, and proactive Freelance Assignment Editor to join our newsroom. This role is critical in driving real-time weather news coverage across all platforms. You will work closely with our programming and field teams to coordinate breaking weather events, select compelling live visuals, and support dynamic storytelling as we cover weather news. In this fast-paced environment, you must have strong news judgment, be comfortable handling multiple breaking stories at once, and thrive under pressure. Prior experience pitching, researching, writing, and building editorial elements in a collaborative team setting is key. An interest in weather is a must.

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Communicate with officials and sources for editorial information
  • Monitor both traditional and social media for breaking weather news stories
  • Pitch unique and interesting guests, stories, and segments
  • Conduct in-depth research and compile well-rounded reports for our field teams
  • Help find stunning live visuals to support all platforms
  • Select elements such as sound, video clips, and graphics to help tell a story
  • Manage daily deadline turnarounds of a live show environment
  • Monitor and coordinate contributor feeds and resources
  • Build strong relationships with Assignment Desks at FOX affiliates and other news service partners across the FOX News Media Family

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • A Bachelor’s Degree in journalism, communications, or a related field of study preferred, or equivalent experience
  • 1+ years of TV newsgathering, assignment desk, or field production experience
  • Strong editorial judgment and the ability to react quickly to breaking news
  • Ability to solve problems quickly, stay calm under pressure, and adapt rapidly to changing conditions
  • Willingness to work early mornings, late nights, and weekends
  • Ability to meet tight deadlines and manage multiple tasks without sacrificing accuracy
  • Basic understanding of meteorology and weather science concepts
  • Interest and understanding of weather, severe weather patterns, and their impacts
  • Previous network-level or national newsroom experience
  • Familiarity with newsroom systems such as iNews or similar editorial toolsA degree or certification in meteorology or atmospheric sciences equivalent is a plus

job.title: Senior Financial Analyst, Digital & Ad Tech
job.description:
We are looking for a motivated and career-oriented candidate with a proactive approach and strong analytical, Excel, and data set management skills. As a Senior Financial Analyst, Digital & Ad Tech, you will step into a critical position responsible for financial modeling to support the labor capitalization and software development process. The Senior Financial Analyst will work on monthly budgets and forecasts, key financial reporting, ad hoc analysis, tracking of KPIs, and creating dashboards and tools to review operational performance and initiatives.

This is a high-visibility and challenging position rich in data analytics.
