job.title: Broadcast & Media Technology Project Manager
job.description:
FOX News Media is seeking an experienced Broadcast & Media Technology Project Manager to lead complex technology initiatives across studio operations, live broadcast production, contribution/transmission networks, Media Asset Management (MAM) pipelines, and fast-turnaround content creation/editing environments.

This role will manage projects from initial discovery and technical requirements gathering through solution delivery, systems integration, testing, commissioning, and transition to 24/7 broadcast operations. The successful candidate will collaborate closely across broadcast engineering, studio operations, control rooms, post-production, editorial, transmission, infrastructure, cybersecurity, and external systems integrators/vendors.

The ideal candidate combines disciplined project management practices with a strong technical understanding of how broadcast content moves from field capture/ingest through studio control rooms, non-linear editing (NLE) suites, central MAM repositories, master control/playout, and multi-path transmission.

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITES

Project Delivery and Governance

  • Lead the full project lifecycle, including discovery, scoping, technical design coordination, procurement, installation, integration, testing, commissioning, cutover, hypercare, and operational handover.
  • Develop and maintain integrated project plans covering work breakdown structures, milestones, critical paths, dependencies, hardware/software lead times, risks, issues, and capital/operating budgets.
  • Establish governance routines, engineering working sessions, steering committee reporting, and change-control decision forums.
  • Coordinate workstreams across broadcast engineering, studio tech, transmission/traffic, newsroom operations, editing/post-production, IT infrastructure, and third-party vendors/systems integrators.
  • Track delivery against broadcast milestones, schedule, budget, quality standards, and operational-readiness criteria.
  • Maintain rigorous project documentation, including functional specs, system schematics coordination, rack elevations, acceptance test plans (ATP), cutover runbooks, and handover documentation.

Broadcast & Media Technology Delivery

  • Lead initiatives involving production switchers, audio consoles, studio cameras, robotics, multi-viewers, tally/intercom systems (e.g., Riedel, RTS), broadcast graphics (e.g., Vizrt), and virtual/augmented reality studio tech.
  • Oversee deployments for field acquisition, bonded cellular (e.g., LiveU, Dejero), satellite/fiber contribution, IP contribution protocols (SRT, RIST, Zixi), and baseband/IP ingest pipelines.
  • Manage MAM implementations, metadata schema standardization, ingest automation, nearline/deep archive tiers, LTO/cloud storage lifecycles, and media supply chain orchestration.
  • Drive technical delivery for non-linear editing (NLE) platforms (Adobe Premiere, Avid Media Composer), shared production storage (SAN/NAS/Isilon/Avid NEXIS), fast-turnaround news editing, and transcode/QC workflows.
  • Coordinate projects for playout automation, routing matrices (SDI and IP), primary/backup transmission paths, satellite uplink/downlink, terrestrial fiber circuits, and disaster recovery (DR) facilities.
  • Facilitate technical integration between newsroom systems (e.g., iNEWS, ENPS), rundown automation, prompters, and playback servers.
  • Translate operational and editorial requirements into clear engineering workstreams and technical deliverables.
  • Support infrastructure modernization and technology refreshes, such as SDI-to-ST 2110 IP transitions, cloud-assisted production, and hybrid on-prem/cloud workflows.
  • Coordinate technical design reviews alongside Principal Engineers, Systems Architects, and Technical Leads.

Live Operations, Commissioning & Deployment Readiness

  • Plan and direct factory acceptance testing (FAT), site acceptance testing (SAT), end-to-end rehearsal workflows, operational shadow periods, cutovers, and rollback strategies.
  • Schedule and oversee maintenance windows and deployment sequencing to ensure zero disruption to on-air linear feeds and 24/7 live studio operations.
  • Partner with Broadcast Operations and Engineering teams to establish support escalation models, monitoring/telemetry dashboards, signal path redundancies, runbooks, and SOPs.
  • Coordinate comprehensive operational training and knowledge transfer for operators, directors, editors, engineers, and technicians prior to on-air cutover.

Technology Modernization & Continuous Improvement

  • Partner with engineering leads to evaluate emerging broadcast standards (SMPTE ST 2110, NMOS, NDI) and cloud/virtualized production platforms.
  • Identify workflow bottlenecks in the content creation and turnaround pipeline, introducing automation for ingest, transcode, QC, and archiving.
  • Promote standard operating procedures and best-practice deployment frameworks across all broadcast and studio facilities.

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • Bachelor’s degree in Broadcast Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Media Technology, Computer Science, or equivalent practical industry experience.
  • Technology project management experience, with experience directly managing broadcast engineering, studio facility, transmission, or media production technology projects.
  • Proven track record leading projects through technical scoping, RFP/vendor evaluation, rack/facility buildout, systems integration, commissioning, and on-air cutover.
  • Demonstrated working knowledge across core broadcast domains, including:
    • Studio production, PCR/TCR control rooms, routing, and intercom systems.
    • Live contribution (SRT, RIST, ASI, Satellite, Fiber) and transmission pipelines.
    • MAM systems, automated transcode engines, and shared editing storage (SAN/NAS).
    • Post-production and NLE workflows (Avid, Adobe, automated QC).
    • Newsroom Computer Systems (NRCS) and broadcast automation/playout.
  • Solid grasp of broadcast video/audio signals and protocols (Baseband SDI, SMPTE ST 2110, AES67, Dante, PTP timing, MPEG-TS).
  • Experience coordinating structured acceptance testing (FAT/SAT) and high-stakes, off-hours facility cutovers with tight change-window constraints.
  • Proficiency with project management tools (e.g., Jira, Confluence, Smartsheet, Microsoft Project, Visio/Lucidchart).
  • Exceptional communication, leadership, and conflict-resolution skills, with the ability to bridge conversations between on-air talent/editorial teams and deep technical engineering specialists.
  • Experience leading facility buildouts, studio relocations, or control room overhauls.
  • Practical knowledge of IP media network architecture (SMPTE ST 2110, ST 2022-6/7, NMOS IS-04/IS-05).
  • Experience with broadcast equipment vendors and platforms (e.g., Grass Valley, Evertz, Ross Video, Sony, Avid, Imagine Communications, Vizrt, Harmonic, Telestream).
  • Familiarity with hybrid/cloud-based media workflows in AWS, Azure, or GCP.
  • Experience managing external Systems Integrators (SIs) and broadcast equipment hardware vendors.
  • Relevant industry certifications: PMP, CAPM, or technical broadcast certifications (e.g., SBE - Society of Broadcast Engineers certifications).
  • Studio production, PCR/TCR control rooms, routing, and intercom systems.
  • Live contribution (SRT, RIST, ASI, Satellite, Fiber) and transmission pipelines.
  • MAM systems, automated transcode engines, and shared editing storage (SAN/NAS).
  • Post-production and NLE workflows (Avid, Adobe, automated QC).
  • Newsroom Computer Systems (NRCS) and broadcast automation/playout.

As a Data Architect, you will play a foundational role in the design and implementation of Unified Data, a net-new, greenfield enterprise data ecosystem for NBCUniversal Operations & Technology. Built primarily on Microsoft Fabric, Unified Data will establish a centralized, governed data foundation that brings together real-time operational events and historical data across enterprise technology domains to support reporting, analytics, automation, AI, and reusable data products.

You will define the target-state architecture, data organization and modeling standards, integration patterns, security and governance framework, and engineering practices for the platform. Operating within a complex and evolving technical environment, you will exercise independent judgment to evaluate multiple architectural approaches, assess interdependencies and technical tradeoffs, and determine solutions where established patterns or precedent may be limited. The data landscape spans areas including IT service management, employee and workplace technology, endpoints and assets, identity and access, infrastructure and network services, collaboration platforms, operational telemetry, and enterprise master and reference data.

In addition to serving as the lead architect, you will act as a technical leader for the delivery team, providing guidance and translating architecture and business requirements into actionable engineering work, helping create and refine epics, stories, and tasks, identifying dependencies and sequencing, and ensuring work is aligned to the appropriate resources and teams while providing technical guidance throughout implementation.

Responsibilities:

  • Microsoft Fabric Architecture & Strategy: Independently define the end-to-end architecture for Microsoft Fabric, including OneLake, Lakehouse, Warehouse, Data Factory, Real-Time Intelligence, Eventstream/Eventhouse, notebooks, and semantic models to support cross-domain Operations & Technology use cases.
  • Greenfield Platform Architecture: Develop and establish the foundational architecture, standards, environment strategy, workspace organization, security boundaries, deployment patterns, and operating principles for a net-new enterprise data platform.
  • Technical Leadership & Delivery Enablement: Serve as the technical leader for the delivery team by translating architecture and program objectives into epics, stories, tasks, dependencies, and implementation sequencing while helping route work to the appropriate resources and teams.
  • Enterprise Data Centralization: Drive the consolidation of fragmented operational data into a centralized and discoverable ecosystem using domain-aligned data products, authoritative data sources, reusable shared datasets, and common data contracts.
  • Operational Data Architecture: Design solutions spanning IT service management, workplace technology, endpoints and assets, identity, infrastructure, networks, collaboration platforms, telemetry, events, logs, and enterprise reference data. Evaluate cross-domain dependencies and technical tradeoffs to determine architectural approaches that address complex and evolving requirements.
  • Real-Time & Historical Data Design: Architect solutions that combine streaming and event-driven operational data with historical, transactional, master, and reference data to support operational visibility, analytics, automation, and AI-enabled use cases.
  • Lakehouse & Warehouse Patterns: Establish scalable patterns for raw, enriched, and curated data layers, Delta-based lakehouse designs, warehouse workloads, OneLake shortcuts, virtualization, partitioning, optimization, retention, and performance management.
  • Data Modeling & Semantic Standards: Define enterprise modeling principles, canonical entities, conformed dimensions, shared business definitions, and semantic standards using dimensional, normalized, domain-oriented, or hybrid approaches as appropriate.
  • Integration & Pipeline Architecture: Define resilient and reusable ingestion, transformation, and orchestration patterns across APIs, databases, SaaS platforms, files, CDC, batch processing, and event streams.
  • Data Governance, Security & Quality: Partner with security, privacy, and governance teams to establish access controls, metadata, lineage, classification, data ownership, data contracts, quality standards, retention policies, and lifecycle controls.
  • Architecture Standards & Documentation: Independently develop and maintain target-state architectures, reference architectures, architecture decision records, data flow diagrams, technical standards, reusable patterns, and implementation roadmaps.
  • DevOps & Engineering Standards: Establish expectations for source control, CI/CD, environment promotion, infrastructure and configuration automation, testing, monitoring, deployment controls, and release management.
  • Architecture Review & Technical Governance: Lead reviews and advise teams on solution designs and major technical decisions to ensure implementations remain aligned with Unified Data architecture, security requirements, performance expectations, and engineering standards.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • 8+ years of experience in data engineering, data architecture, solution architecture, or related roles, including responsibility for designing, establishing, or materially evolving enterprise-scale data platforms.
  • Demonstrated experience translating architecture and technical strategy into executable roadmaps, epics, stories, tasks, and implementation plans.
  • Experience serving as a technical lead across multidisciplinary engineering teams or complex technical programs.
  • Strong experience designing lakehouse and/or warehouse architectures, including layered data patterns from raw ingestion through curated and consumable datasets.
  • Strong expertise in SQL and proficiency with Python and/or PySpark for data engineering, automation, prototyping, and technical validation.
  • Experience architecting data solutions on Microsoft Fabric, Microsoft Azure, or comparable enterprise cloud data platforms.
  • Experience designing both batch and real-time/event-driven data solutions.
  • Strong understanding of APIs, data integration, distributed data processing, and enterprise integration patterns.
  • Experience designing secure, scalable, observable, and supportable production data platforms.
  • Strong understanding of data modeling, metadata, lineage, governance, and data quality principles.
  • Ability to independently evaluate complex technical tradeoffs across scalability, reliability, maintainability, security, cost, and business requirements, and exercise judgment in determining appropriate architectural approaches.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate architectural concepts to engineers, product teams, stakeholders, and senior leadership.
  • Ability to operate effectively in a greenfield environment where standards, processes, and technical patterns are being established.

Desired Characteristics:

  • Experience designing or leading a greenfield enterprise data platform or significant modernization of an existing data ecosystem.
  • Deep hands-on experience with Microsoft Fabric, including OneLake, Lakehouse, Warehouse, Data Factory, notebooks, Real-Time Intelligence, Eventstream/Eventhouse, semantic models, and Power BI.
  • Experience establishing Microsoft Fabric workspace, domain, environment, security, capacity, and deployment strategies.
  • Experience with Microsoft Azure data technologies and services.
  • Experience with event streaming and messaging architectures such as Kafka, Azure Event Hubs, Kinesis, or equivalent technologies.
  • Experience designing change data capture (CDC) and near-real-time ingestion architectures.
  • Experience with data governance practices and tooling, including cataloging, lineage, classification, data contracts, retention, and privacy controls.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD and infrastructure automation technologies such as GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, Terraform, or Bicep.

  • Assist with quality control by confirming that approvals and final assets match requirements prior to delivery and launch. 
  • Document next steps, open questions, and dependencies (e.g., approvals, timing constraints, and workflow requirements) to reduce execution risk. 
  • College degree
  • On average 1–2 years of experience at an agency, media company, sales organization, or in sports production, with responsibility for presentation, creative, or promotion development
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail; ability to manage multiple timelines and stakeholders simultaneously.

The Director, Sales Planning & Administration is responsible for leading title lifecycle management, deal administration, rights governance, and operational execution across assigned international territories. The ideal candidate is a seasoned distribution operations leader with deep expertise in rights management, window management, title availability, and enterprise system governance. This individual will possess a comprehensive understanding of the international television distribution business, including output and volume licensing structures, first-run title commitments, product qualification processes, and the end-to-end workflow from deal negotiation through operational execution. The successful candidate must demonstrate strong people leadership, operational rigor, strategic thinking, and cross-functional influence while ensuring accountability, data integrity, and executional excellence across the organization.

Contract Governance & Rights Compliance

  • Oversee all licensing activities in strict accordance with executed agreements, approved deal terms, distribution policy, and corporate SLAs.
  • Conduct regular contract and rights audits to validate that system data matches active executed legal terms and mitigate operational exposure.
  • Partner with Legal and Commercial Sales to evaluate amendments, waivers, title substitutions, and contract revisions prior to execution.
  • Maintain official territory rules governing window structures, holdbacks, and commercial restrictions across transactional, output volume, and linear business models.

Database Integrity, Pre-Submission QA & System Controls

  • Oversee system setups in enterprise databases (SAFE) to ensure accurate configuration of rate cards, pricing, rights, and territory parameters prior to downstream release.
  • Execute rigorous quality control over all outgoing tracking grids, budget files, and system setups to prevent fulfillment errors, data gaps, or feed disruptions.
  • Manage database title blocking, pending order statuses, and configuration rules to ensure smooth supply chain feeds and eliminate artificial product availability blocks.
  • Implement workflow improvements, automation initiatives, and reporting controls to enhance operational scalability and data accuracy.

Strategic Operations & Cross-Functional Governance

  • Manage day-to-day operational support and title volume commitments across assigned international territories, ensuring full launch readiness and customer fulfillment.
  • Drive end-to-end visibility into active deal pipelines, rights availability constraints, and market-specific operational risks.
  • Act as the primary Sales Administration lead to Commercial Sales, Legal, Account Management, and Distribution Strategy on deal execution, windowing strategy, and title prioritization.
  • Partner with Finance to audit revenue recognition assumptions, billing readiness, and forecasting impacts prior to deal finalization.
  • Foster a culture of transparency, collaboration, and operational rigor across all internal stakeholder groups.

Team Leadership & Organizational Management

  • Provide leadership and oversight for Managers and Assistant Managers, including second-line management responsibilities where applicable.
  • Establish clear expectations around ownership, accountability, prioritization, and service delivery standards.
  • Coach people leaders on issue resolution, workload management, stakeholder engagement, and employee development.
  • Conduct performance management, talent development, and organizational capability building.
  • Lead onboarding, training, knowledge transfer, and territory transition activities to ensure business continuity and operational consistency.

job.description:

Your work will shape product, design, and algorithm strategy, helping us better understand our audiences and improve their streaming experiences. Reporting to the SVP, Streaming Research and Insights, you’ll exercise significant self-directed judgment in setting research strategy and methodology. You’ll partner directly with senior product, engineering, and data science leaders, making major roadmap and resourcing decisions in partnership with the SVP. This is an individual contributor role with no direct reports. You’ll provide technical mentorship while working in an office environment. New York or Burbank are the preferred locations, with the final location to be confirmed.   Responsibilities
  • Lead quantitative research and causal inference. Use multivariate testing and quasi-experimental methods. Apply statistical modeling. Measure the product's performance. Assess how well teams are collaborating. Evaluate customer satisfaction. Work on improving these areas. Partner closely with the devoted A/B testing team to use experiment results and infrastructure.
  • Evaluate and improve recommendation algorithms and other AI/ML product systems in partnership with engineering and data science. Apply research and modeling techniques to validate model outputs, identify failure modes, and quantify user impact.
  • Own the research roadmap for an assigned area of the product portfolio. Partner proactively with product, design, engineering, and business stakeholders to define priorities and develop a forward looking plan combining quantitative and mixed methods research. Report progress and priorities to the SVP, Streaming Research and Insights.
  • Apply AI modeling and analysis techniques including predictive modeling, analysis supported by machine learning, and AI assisted synthesis of qualitative data to scale research output and identify patterns that warrant deeper investigation.
  • Lead complementary qualitative and usability research through interviews, usability testing, and diary studies to explain the reasons behind quantitative and behavioral signals and build a complete, statistically grounded comprehension of user needs.
  • Translate complex findings into clear recommendations for senior product, engineering, data science, and executive stakeholders.
  • Directly shaping product and technical roadmaps.
  • Provide technical mentorship to peer researchers and partners across teams on experimental design, statistical rigor, and research best practices.

 

Basic Qualifications
  • Extensive experience in quantitative UX research, experimentation, or applied data science. This experience should come from a consumer technology, streaming, or digital product company. The candidate must have a proven record of leading complex research programs that rely on statistical analysis.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Statistics, Data Science, Human Computer Interaction, Computer Science, Psychology, or a related quantitative field.
  • A solid background in experimental design and causal inference. This includes skills in multivariate testing and quasi-experimental methods. You need good statistical skills to validate and defend your results to executives. Additionally, you must be able to collaborate well with a hardworking A/B testing team.
  • Technical proficiency in SQL and Python or R, with hands on experience applying AI/ML modeling techniques, such as predictive modeling, natural language processing, or recommendation system evaluation, to research problems.
  • Demonstrated experience evaluating and improving algorithmic systems in direct partnership with engineering and data science teams.
  • Experience with recommendation or personalization engines.
  • Proven ability to turn ambiguous questions into quantitative research plans.
  • Self-reliantly defining scope, executing research, and defending methodology with minimal oversight.
  • Excellent executive communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to translate complex statistical and technical findings into clear, actionable recommendations for senior and executive stakeholders.
  • Ability to manage multiple concurrent research and experimentation streams against shifting priorities in a fast paced, evolving office environment.

 

Bonus Skills (Nice-to-Haves)
  • Advanced degree, such as a master’s or PhD, strongly preferred, particularly a PhD in Statistics, Data Science, HCI, or a related quantitative or behavioral science field.
  • Experience with recommendation systems at scale, ranking algorithms, or generative AI and large language model evaluation.
  • Awareness with streaming media, entertainment, or subscription and advertising supported business models.

job.description:
#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?

ML Platform Lead Engineer, Training & Inference
Organization: Applied Machine Learning Group (AMLG) → ML Platform
Level: Lead / Senior Lead (IC4–IC5)

 

Overview 

We are seeking a Senior Lead / Lead ML Platform Engineer to architect and own the technical direction for our Training and Inference infrastructure. This is a high-leverage role designed for an expert who understands the deep technical stack required to shift ML models from research to global production. You will be responsible for the "engine room" of the AMLG, ensuring that our MLEs can train massive models efficiently and serve them with sub-millisecond reliability. This role requires a unique blend of expertise in distributed systems and hardware acceleration. You will lead the adoption and optimization of AnyScale (Ray) for distributed training and manage a high-performance Kubernetes-based inference environment. You aren't just managing clusters; you are building a seamless, scalable platform that abstracts the complexity of GPUs and distributed compute for the entire organization.

Why This Role Matters

The ML Platform Lead is the force-multiplier for every other ML pod. In this role, you will directly shape:

The Training Foundation: Establishing AnyScale/Ray as the standard for distributed compute, enabling MLEs to train models on petabytes of data without managing infrastructure.
Inference at Scale: Architecting the serving layer that handles billions of requests per day, optimizing for both p99 latency and GPU utilization.
Operational Excellence: Setting the organizational standards for how ML models are deployed, monitored, and scaled across the enterprise.

Key Responsibilities

Technical Roadmap & Strategy: Own the long-term architectural direction for the Training and Inference domains, ensuring the platform scales 10x over a 1–3 year horizon.
Distributed Training Leadership: Lead the implementation and optimization of Ray/AnyScale, providing a unified compute layer for batch processing, model training, and reinforcement learning.
High-Performance Inference: Design and maintain K8s-based inference servers (e.g., Triton, TorchServe, or vLLM) optimized for GPU memory management and high throughput.
Hardware & Cost Optimization: Navigate the trade-offs between different GPU instances (A100s, H100s, T4s), optimizing for cost, availability, and performance.
Cross-Team Standardization: Solve high-leverage problems that affect multiple pods (e.g., Entry, Session, Presentation), establishing reusable patterns for CI/CD, model versioning, and canary deployments.
Reliability Engineering: Define and enforce SLIs/SLOs for the platform, ensuring that infrastructure failures never interrupt the user-facing personalization experience.
Mentorship & Coaching: Act as a technical mentor to senior engineers across the ML Platform and Applied ML pods, raising the bar for system design and operational rigor.

Basic Qualifications

6-8+ years of experience in ML Infrastructure, Platform Engineering, or high-scale Backend Engineering.
Orchestration & Serving: Extensive experience with Kubernetes (K8s) and serving frameworks for large-scale ML models.
Hardware Proficiency: Strong knowledge of GPU architecture, CUDA, and optimizing ML workloads for hardware acceleration.
Leadership (IC4/5): Proven track record of owning the technical direction for a major domain anddriving impact across multiple teams.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with Infra-as-Code (Terraform/Pulumi) and building automated MLOps pipelines.
Distributed Systems Mastery: Deep expertise with Ray (AnyScale) or similar distributed compute frameworks.
Familiarity with ML observability tools (Prometheus, Grafana, Weights & Biases, or MLFlow).
Experience managing multi-cloud or hybrid-cloud ML environments.
Deep knowledge of Python and C++ for performance-critical systems.

What Success Looks Like

In your first 6–12 months, you will:

Unify the Compute Layer: Successfully transition the majority of AMLG training workloads to a governed AnyScale/Ray environment.
Optimize Inference ROI: Measurably improve GPU utilization and reduce inference costs through better auto-scaling and server optimization.
Establish Durable Standards: Author the "Gold Standard" for ML deployments that is adopted by at least three other pods in the organization.
Reduce Systemic Risk: Implement a self-healing infrastructure layer that significantly reduces manual intervention for cluster-related failures.

Ready for a Consistent Monday–Friday Schedule?

If you have experience in retail, hospitality, restaurants, customer service, call centers, or another fast-paced, people-focused environment, you may already have the skills to succeed in an office role.

LocaliQ/USA TODAY is looking for an Office Administrator – Public Notices to join our Green Bay team. This is an opportunity to bring your customer service and organizational skills into a structured office environment while developing new administrative and computer skills.

You'll work with customers, sales representatives, and internal teams to process public notices, manage information, meet deadlines, and ensure details are accurate.

You'll have a mix of administrative, computer-based, and customer service responsibilities, including:

Answering customer and sales representative questions about public notices

Is reliable and takes ownership of their responsibilities

You'll also enjoy:

Health, dental, and vision coverage

A supportive team environment

job.title: B2B Sales Director, Reputation Intelligence
job.description:
Job Description:


About the Opportunity 

Help communications and corporate affairs leaders understand emerging reputation risks—and build the customer base for a new Dow Jones intelligence platform.

 

Dow Jones Reputation Radar combines Storyful’s social and narrative intelligence with Factiva’s licensed news content. It helps organizations understand which narratives are gaining traction, who is influencing them and where reputational pressure may build next, so leaders can make better-informed decisions.

 

As we prepare for general availability, we are seeking an experienced enterprise seller to generate new business and help establish a focused, repeatable sales approach. You will combine the opportunity to build an emerging business with the credibility, customer relationships and market reach of Dow Jones.

 

About the Role

This is a senior, quota-carrying sales role with direct responsibility for creating pipeline, developing opportunities and winning enterprise customers.

 

Your initial focus will be communications and corporate affairs teams in financial services, with the potential to expand into other priority sectors as we establish successful use cases.

 

You will own opportunities from prospecting and discovery through demonstration, negotiation and close. Success requires understanding how customers make decisions, identifying a meaningful business need and building a compelling case for investment—including where Reputation Radar complements an existing set of tools.

 

You will work with Dow Jones account teams and colleagues across Product, Marketing and Intelligence. Your customer conversations will also help refine our targeting, messaging, sales materials and product priorities.

 

This role suits someone who enjoys personally winning business and using what they learn to improve how a new product is brought to market.

 

You Will

  • Create and convert new-business pipeline. Personally prospect into priority accounts, develop qualified opportunities and deliver against an agreed revenue target.
  • Build focused account plans. Select and prioritize accounts using customer needs, business triggers, revenue potential and likelihood to convert. Establish clear actions and next steps.
  • Lead consultative discovery. Understand how customers identify reputation risks, brief leadership and make decisions, and where their current approach falls short.
  • Build a credible value case. Connect Reputation Radar’s capabilities to the customer’s priorities and demonstrate why the investment matters.
  • Navigate enterprise buying groups. Build relationships with senior Communications, Corporate Affairs and related stakeholders, while engaging users, budget holders, Procurement and other decision makers.
  • Own the full sales cycle. Coordinate demonstrations and specialist input, develop proposals, negotiate commercial terms and progress opportunities through contracting and close.
  • Work with the wider Dow Jones sales organization. Partner with account teams to identify relevant opportunities within existing customer relationships and help them recognize where Reputation Radar can add value.
  • Turn Marketing activity into commercial action. Collaborate on targeted campaigns, events and content, and take ownership of account follow-up and conversion.
  • Bring customer insight back into the business. Share patterns in buyer needs, objections, competitive alternatives and purchasing decisions to strengthen positioning, sales enablement and product development.
  • Maintain commercial discipline. Keep accurate Salesforce records, qualify opportunities consistently and provide reliable forecasts.
  • Represent Dow Jones and Storyful in customer meetings, industry events and executive discussions.

 

You Have

  • A proven record of meeting or exceeding enterprise B2B sales targets, including personally creating and closing new business.
  • Experience selling information services, data, intelligence, strategic advisory or enterprise SaaS solutions.
  • Experience engaging senior Communications, Corporate Affairs, Marketing, Public Affairs, Risk or executive stakeholders, or a clear ability to translate relevant adjacent experience to these buyers.
  • The ability to sell through discovery, business value and customer outcomes, supported by clear examples of navigating complex buying decisions.
  • A structured approach to account selection, prospecting, qualification and pipeline development.
  • Strong listening, presentation and communication skills, with the ability to build credibility and adapt your approach to different stakeholders.
  • Experience collaborating with account managers, marketing teams and product or subject-matter specialists while retaining ownership of sales progress.
  • The judgment and initiative to operate effectively as a product and its commercial approach evolve.
  • Willingness to work in our Midtown Manhattan office at least three days a week.

 

Particularly Useful

  • Knowledge of the communications, reputation, public affairs, media intelligence or risk intelligence ecosystem.
  • Success introducing a new product, entering a new market or building demand where a buying category is still developing.
  • Experience selling to financial services organizations.
  • Existing relationships with senior communications and corporate affairs leaders.
  • Experience working across multinational enterprise accounts.

 

About Storyful

Storyful is a social and narrative intelligence company within Dow Jones. Combining proprietary technology with expert analysis and verification, Storyful helps organizations understand how information and narratives spread, influence stakeholders and shape reputation.

 

Dow Jones Reputation Radar brings together Storyful and Factiva capabilities to support communications and corporate affairs leaders with timely, decision-ready reputation intelligence.

Join the future of news

We’re on a mission to deliver riveting storytelling for all of America. At The Washington Post, you’ll help reinvent news. Our work is driven by a deep investigative spirit and enhanced by innovation to bring audiences closer to the stories that matter most.


About Our Team


The Washington Post is powered by the passion and talent of our people. It takes all of us to reinvent news. Beyond our award-winning News and Opinions teams, we work across many departments, including Brand & Events, Communications, Customer Care, Engineering & Product, Finance, Human Resources, Legal, Marketing & Advertising, Print Operations, and Sales.


Why This Role Matters

 

The Executive Assistant to the Chief Financial Officer (CFO) is a critical partner in ensuring the success of The Washington Post’s financial leadership. This role requires a high level of professionalism, confidentiality, and strategic awareness, providing seamless administrative and operational support to the CFO while navigating a fast-paced, high-stakes environment.


The ideal candidate is a proactive problem-solver with exceptional organizational skills, a service-minded attitude, and the ability to manage competing priorities with discretion, efficiency, and diplomacy. You’ll be responsible for maintaining the CFO’s calendar, coordinating cross-functional meetings, managing communications, and supporting the broader Finance team through administrative coordination and internal event planning. This is an opportunity to contribute meaningfully to the success of our finance function while working closely with senior leaders at The Washington Post. 


What Motivates You 

  • You thrive on supporting a senior leader in a complex, fast-moving organization. 
  • You take initiative, anticipate needs, and provide solutions before problems arise.
  • You take initiative, anticipate needs, and provide solutions before problems arise. 
  • You are energized by juggling multiple priorities and keeping everything organized. 
  • You enjoy being the reliable force behind the scenes that helps an executive and their team thrive.
  • You build strong, trusting relationships across functions and with all levels of an organization. 

 

How You’ll Support The Mission  

  • Manage executive’s schedule by scheduling meetings, reminding about upcoming appointments or reschedules, alerting about time-sensitive emails and requests, and preparing materials for meetings and events. 
  • Observe and monitor team dynamics, interactions, and performance. Provide accurate and timely reports to the executive, highlighting key developments, concerns, and opportunities within the team. Act as a trusted advisor to the executive, offering valuable perspectives and recommendations based on the observations and analysis. 
  • Support executive’s decision making for specific meetings, projects, or events by understanding the roles and responsibilities of employees in different departments within the organization, building relationships with colleagues across teams, and gathering and synthesizing relevant information to ensure successful outcomes. 
  • Draft, proofread, and edit professional correspondence, and basic presentation materials using available technology to improve quality and efficiency..
  • Leverage productivity tools, automation, and AI-enabled solutions thoughtfully.
  • Provide project management support and assistance at key internal and external events across the company. 
  •  Attends CFO direct reports meeting, sends a summary email to the finance department, keeps track of action items for the directors, ensures weekly updates are filled out timely by the directors  
  •  Support scheduling meetings with external guests by greeting the guests, completing security checks, and setting up food and drinks. 
  • Provide budgeting support, invoice review and contract management. 

 

The Skills and Experience You Bring 

  • At least 7 years of executive support experience; experience supporting a financial executive is a plus. 
  • 2+ years of experience in operations, project management, process improvements, etc. 
  • Experience reviewing, tracking, and managing contracts. 
  • Professional maturity and ability to remain calm and flexible under pressure. 
  • Outstanding interpersonal skills and attention to detail. 
  • Proven organizational acumen and interdepartmental coordination skills. 
  • Expertise with Microsoft Office, Google Suite, and other products and the ability to quickly learn new software tools and systems. 
  • Demonstrated curiosity and comfort using AI-enabled productivity tools and automation to improve efficiency, organization, and quality of work, with sound judgement around confidentiality, accuracy, and appropriate use.
  • Ability to maintain confidentiality of sensitive business and people matters. 
  • Ability to multitask and prioritize workload with minimal supervision 
  • Excellent editing and proofreading skills 
  • Strong consulting and project management skills.

job.title: Vice President, Finance
job.description:
We are UMG, the Universal Music Group. We are the world’s leading music company. In everything we do, we are committed to artistry, innovation and entrepreneurship. We own and operate a broad array of businesses engaged in recorded music, music publishing, merchandising, and audiovisual content in more than 60 countries. We identify and develop recording artists and songwriters, and we produce, distribute and promote the most critically acclaimed and commercially successful music to delight and entertain fans around the world.
 

How we LEAD:


The Vice President, Finance is a senior financial leader responsible for driving profitable growth, financial discipline, and strategic decision-making across a music merchandise and apparel business operating through eCommerce, wholesale, retail, licensing and touring channels.

 

This role will engage in financial planning and forecasting, product and channel profitability, inventory and cost accounting, commercial deal evaluation, and management reporting. The Vice President will partner closely with executive leadership and teams across merchandising, eCommerce, retail sales, touring, licensing, production, supply chain, and operations.

 

The ideal candidate combines deep apparel-industry financial expertise with strong commercial judgment and a practical understanding of the operational complexities associated with inventory, product development, fulfillment, royalties, licensing, and multi-channel distribution.

 

How you'll CREATE:

 

  • Participate in the annual budget, long-range plan and periodic reforecast.
  • Partner with commercial leaders to develop revenue targets, margin goals, expense plans, and performance improvement initiatives.
  • Develop integrated financial plans covering revenue, gross margin, operating expenses, working capital, cash flow, inventory, and capital investment.
  • Provide timely variance analysis of actual results compared to budget, forecast, prior year.
  • Identify key performance drivers, risks, and opportunities and translate them into clear recommendations for senior management.
  • Develop and maintain profitability reporting by artist and business line and evaluate margin performance
  • Support inventory planning, SKU rationalization, markdown strategies and end-of-cycle inventory decisions.
  • Partner with business and legal affairs and senior management in deal structuring and negotiation.
  • Support assortment planning, demand planning, pricing decisions, product launches, artist campaigns, tour planning, retail programs, and customer negotiations.
  • Develop executive dashboards and management reporting that provide clear visibility into revenue, margin, profitability, inventory, cash flow, and operational performance.

 

Bring your VIBE:

  • Significant progressive finance experience, including leadership responsibility in FP&A, commercial finance, operational finance, or a related function.

  • Familiarity with ERP and warehouse management systems, specifically SAP, BPC, Oracle HFM.

job.title: Director, Privacy and Data Protection
job.description:
We are UMG, the Universal Music Group. We are the world’s leading music company. In everything we do, we are committed to artistry, innovation and entrepreneurship. We own and operate a broad array of businesses engaged in recorded music, music publishing, merchandising, and audiovisual content in more than 60 countries. We identify and develop recording artists and songwriters, and we produce, distribute and promote the most critically acclaimed and commercially successful music to delight and entertain fans around the world.
 

Director, Privacy & Data Protection

Job Category: Business & Legal Affairs


How We LEAD:

The Director, Privacy & Data Protection will be an experienced privacy attorney supporting Universal Music Group's global privacy and data protection program. Working closely with the Senior Vice President, Privacy & Data Protection, this role will provide practical, hands-on legal support across privacy contracting, data subject rights, cybersecurity incidents, digital marketing and other matters involving the collection, use, sharing and protection of personal data.


As the world leader in music-based entertainment, UMG operates across a broad range of labels, artist businesses, digital platforms, e-commerce experiences, marketing initiatives and fan-facing services. The Director will work with colleagues across Legal, Information Security, Technology, Digital, Marketing, E-Commerce and the business to help UMG use data responsibly while supporting artists, creators and fans around the world.


The ideal candidate will combine strong privacy law fundamentals with excellent drafting and negotiation skills, sound judgment and a practical, business-oriented approach. This role requires an attorney who is comfortable managing a significant volume of day-to-day matters, can independently handle work within established frameworks, and recognizes when novel, sensitive or higher-risk issues require escalation.


How You'll CREATE:

  • Draft, review and negotiate data protection and privacy terms in commercial agreements, including data processing agreements, data-sharing arrangements, international data transfer provisions, information security terms and other privacy-related contractual provisions.
  • Partner with UMG's Business & Legal Affairs teams on privacy issues arising in artist, vendor, technology, platform, licensing, e-commerce, marketing and other commercial arrangements involving personal data.
  • Handle UMG's day-to-day legal work relating to data subject and consumer privacy rights requests, including assessing request scope and applicable legal requirements, advising on exemptions and response obligations, coordinating with privacy operations and relevant business teams, reviewing and drafting responses, and escalating complex or sensitive matters as appropriate.
  • Support the privacy-law aspects of cybersecurity and data security incidents, working closely with Information Security, Legal and other stakeholders to assess incident facts and affected data, analyze applicable notification and regulatory requirements, document legal assessments, and draft or review incident-related communications.
  • Assist with investigations of potential privacy and data security issues, including gathering relevant facts, evaluating legal obligations and coordinating with outside counsel where appropriate.
  • Advise business and legal teams on privacy requirements affecting UMG's websites, applications, digital platforms, artist and fan experiences, e-commerce operations, advertising and marketing activities.
  • Provide practical guidance on online advertising and tracking technologies, marketing communications, consent and preference management, and related privacy and consumer protection requirements.
  • Advise on compliance with U.S. federal and state privacy laws, GDPR and other applicable international privacy and data protection requirements.
  • Support privacy reviews of new and evolving business initiatives, technologies, vendors, products and uses of data, including privacy impact assessments where appropriate.
  • Assist with third-party privacy and data protection matters, including vendor diligence, data-transfer requirements, privacy questionnaires and remediation of identified issues.
  • Help maintain and improve privacy policies, procedures, templates, playbooks and other resources that support consistent and scalable privacy practices across UMG's labels, territories and business units.
  • Work with privacy operations, Information Security and business teams to identify recurring issues and improve processes for contract review, rights requests, incident response and other recurring privacy matters.
  • Support responses to regulatory inquiries, audits and other privacy or data protection matters as needed.
  • Monitor relevant developments in privacy, data protection, cybersecurity, digital marketing and consumer protection law and provide clear, practical guidance regarding developments relevant to UMG's businesses.
  • Provide privacy guidance and training to Legal, business and operational teams as needed.
  • Support privacy issues arising from emerging technologies and new uses of data as appropriate.
  • Collaborate effectively with colleagues across UMG's labels, business units and territories, handling routine and moderately complex matters independently and escalating novel, sensitive or significant matters as appropriate.

Bring Your VIBE:

  • J.D. from an accredited law school and active membership in good standing in at least one U.S. state bar.
  • 8+ years of relevant legal experience, with substantial experience in privacy, data protection, cybersecurity, technology transactions or a closely related field, gained at a law firm, in-house legal department or a combination of both.
  • Experience drafting and negotiating data processing agreements and privacy, data use and security provisions in commercial agreements.
  • Strong working knowledge of U.S. federal and state privacy laws, including CCPA/CPRA and other comprehensive state privacy laws, and meaningful familiarity with GDPR and international data protection requirements.
  • Experience advising on data subject and consumer privacy rights requests, including access, deletion, correction and related requests.
  • Experience advising on privacy issues arising from websites, digital advertising, online tracking technologies, e-commerce, marketing and other consumer-facing data practices.
  • Familiarity with consumer protection and marketing requirements relevant to digital and direct-to-consumer activities.
  • Meaningful experience supporting cybersecurity or data security incident response, including familiarity with breach-notification requirements and experience working with information security or technical teams during investigations.
  • Strong legal research, analytical, drafting and negotiation skills, with the ability to identify the issues that matter and provide clear, practical and business-oriented advice.
  • Ability to understand technical and operational facts sufficiently to identify relevant privacy, cybersecurity and digital marketing legal issues.
  • Sound judgment and the ability to handle a significant volume of matters independently while recognizing when an issue warrants escalation.
  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple matters and competing priorities in a fast-moving, global and highly collaborative environment.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, including the ability to explain complex privacy and data protection requirements clearly to lawyers and non-lawyers.
  • CIPP/US, CIPP/E or another relevant privacy certification preferred.
  • Experience in entertainment, music, digital media, technology, e-commerce, advertising or another consumer-facing and data-intensive industry is a plus.

job.title: Director, Distribution (Music Nation)
job.description:
Great music deserves accurate, trusted distribution.

As Director, Distribution - Music Nation, you’ll lead the royalty distribution operations supporting Music Nation, overseeing matching and identification, funds management, quarterly distributions, quality assurance, payment methodologies and market share calculations. You’ll play a key role in helping BMI deliver Rights Administration and Distribution services for an international collective management organization across both mechanical and performing rights.

This role sits at the intersection of royalty operations, repertoire integrity, data quality, technology and stakeholder partnership. You’ll ensure distribution processes are accurate, scalable and aligned with Music Nation’s licensing strategy while working across BMI to strengthen controls, improve data quality, manage operational risk and enhance the systems and processes that support distribution.

You’ll also help build BMI’s broader multi-right and multi-territory administration capabilities, bringing together operational leadership, analytical thinking, industry expertise and continuous improvement to support both today’s distribution cycles and future growth.

Position Summary

Direct, plan, and oversee all royalty distribution activities supporting Music Nation, including matching and identification, funds management, quarterly distributions, and quality assurance. Responsible for establishing and maintaining royalty payment methodologies, market share calculations, and royalty distributions.

This position serves as a key operational leader supporting BMI's delivery of Rights Administration and Distribution services to Music Nation and helps establish the organization's capability to manage mechanical and performing rights on behalf of an international collective management organization. The role ensures repertoire integrity across publisher, writer, society, and Music Nation data sources and supports the successful execution of Music Nation's licensing and distribution strategy.

FUNCTIONS OF THE JOB:

Essential Functions: which may be representative but not all-inclusive of those commonly associated with this position.

• Lead all royalty distribution activities supporting Music Nation, including matching and identification, funds management, methodology and market share management, and quarterly distribution processing.

• Serve as Music Nation’s subject matter expert for royalty distribution standards and industry data exchange initiatives, representing the organization in industry forums and discussions with societies and other stakeholders to help support evolving rights administration and distribution needs.

• Own and oversee quality assurance strategies that support Music Nation’s quarterly distribution cycles, with particular focus on radio, live concert, and general licensing markets.

• Ensure distribution data integrity through production cycle monitoring, reconciliation testing, variance analysis, and issue resolution across internal systems and third-party data sources.

• Identify, assess, and mitigate operational risk related to distribution processes, vendor inputs, and reporting outputs.

• Monitor changes to Music Nation License Agreements and ensure that distribution practices are appropriately aligned with any license agreement change. Work across the distribution supply chain to ensure the appropriate on-boarding of new licenses from inception through to distribution.

• Partner with internal stakeholders to translate complex data into clear, actionable insights for operational, leadership, and external audiences.

• Partner with SoundExchange team supporting the neighboring rights management and distribution for Music Nation

• Support prioritization, workload planning, and process improvement efforts to ensure timely and accurate distribution outcomes.

• Develop operational procedures, workflows, controls, and service standards supporting Music Nation royalty distribution management.

• Monitor and improve data quality, operational performance, and processing accuracy through reporting, audits, and quality assurance reviews.

• Own market share assessments used for license fee allocations and ongoing rate settings.

• Collaborate with Licensing, Rights Administration, Customer Service, International Relations, Technology, and Product teams to support Music Nation business objectives.

• Participate in business requirements definition, testing, implementation, and enhancement of Music Nation distribution platforms and supporting technologies.

• Maintain compliance with BMI policies, industry standards, copyright requirements, and Music Nation service commitments.

• Identify opportunities for automation, process improvement, and operational scalability.

• Prepare and deliver operational metrics, readiness reporting, and executive updates to leadership.

• Support Music Nation service readiness initiatives and the ongoing development of BMI's multi-right and multi-territory administration and distribution capabilities.

• Perform additional duties as assigned.

Supervisory Responsibilities

• Directly supervises managers, team leads, analysts, and/or operational specialists supporting Music Nation royalty distribution functions.

• Carries out supervisory responsibilities in accordance with BMI policies and applicable laws. Responsibilities include interviewing, hiring, training, coaching, performance management, succession planning, workload prioritization, and employee development.

• Provides leadership across all locations for operational resources supporting distribution activities.

POSITION QUALIFICATION REQUIREMENTS

Education

• Bachelor's degree from an accredited four-year college or university or equivalent combination of education and experience.

• Concentration in Music Business, Business Administration, Information Systems, or related field preferred.

• Extensive knowledge of music publishing, copyright administration, and collective rights management.

Experience

• Minimum 8-10 years of progressive experience in music publishing, repertoire administration, copyright operations, collective management, or related rights distribution disciplines.

• Experience managing teams and operational processes.

• Experience with industry standards such as CWR, CAF, CISAC, and related music rights management frameworks preferred.

• Experience working with international repertoire administration and distribution preferred.

Skills and Abilities: which may be representative but not all-inclusive of those commonly associated with this position.

• Expert knowledge of music publishing operations, repertoire administration, and royalty distribution methods.

• Strong understanding of mechanical and performing rights distribution.

• Excellent leadership, coaching, and employee development skills.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.

• Strong project and process management skills.

• Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional initiatives.

• Ability to balance strategic priorities with day-to-day operational execution.

• Strong stakeholder management and relationship-building skills.

• Experience analyzing large datasets and identifying data integrity issues.

• Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, evolving environment.

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications and enterprise business systems.

• Commitment to quality, accuracy, and continuous improvement.

What Success Looks Like

• You lead accurate, timely and well-controlled royalty distributions for Music Nation across matching, identification, funds management, market share and quarterly processing.

• You establish clear distribution methodologies, procedures, controls and service standards that support both operational consistency and Music Nation’s evolving business needs.

• You use data, reconciliation, variance analysis and quality assurance to identify issues early, protect distribution integrity and drive continuous improvement.

• You balance strategic priorities with day-to-day execution, keeping quarterly distribution cycles on track while improving scalability and operational efficiency.

• You build strong partnerships across Licensing, Rights Administration, Customer Service, International Relations, Technology, Product and external stakeholders to resolve complex issues and improve end-to-end outcomes.

• You translate complex royalty, repertoire and market-share data into clear insights and recommendations for operational teams, leadership and external audiences.

• You identify opportunities for automation and technology enhancement that improve accuracy, reduce risk and strengthen BMI’s ability to support multi-right and multi-territory administration.

• You develop a high-performing team with strong technical knowledge, clear priorities and a consistent focus on quality, accountability and service.

Why Join Us?

Distribution is where rights, data and value come together.

At BMI, accurate royalty distribution is central to delivering value to the creators, publishers and partners we serve. As Director, Distribution (Music Nation), you’ll have the opportunity to lead a highly visible operation supporting an international collective management organization while helping expand BMI’s capabilities across mechanical and performing rights.

You’ll work across teams, markets and technologies to strengthen distribution processes, improve data integrity, manage operational risk and help build scalable solutions for a growing multi-right, multi-territory service model.

If you’re energized by complex royalty operations, international rights management, data-driven decision making and building teams and processes that deliver accurate outcomes, we’d love to meet you!

job.title: DC Based Live Event Producer
job.description:
Producer


Decibel Events | Washington, DC | Full-Time


ABOUT DECIBEL EVENTS

Decibel Events (dB) is a full-service event production and management company based in Washington, DC. We create stunning live events for federal agencies, associations, and corporations throughout the US and abroad, from broadcast-quality general sessions and multi-day conferences to trade shows and city-wide festivals.


Our clients include the Library of Congress, the U.S. Small Business Administration, the Department of War, Trane Technologies, and T. Rowe Price, and some have been with us for more than 15 years. We are experts at what we do. We work side by side with our clients to make every event seamless, and the work we put into preproduction is what our clients see onsite. We are a team of six, so everyone here has a hand in the work and a direct relationship with the client.


ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for a full-time Producer to join our events team, reporting to Eric Bibbs, Senior Producer. You will own each event from the first planning call to the final cue. You'll lead discovery calls with the client, write the proposals, build the paperwork, hire the crew, and lead the team onsite. When the show needs a caller, you'll call it. When we're chasing new work, you'll help us win it. You’ll also support productions in our new Washington, DC studio, helping dB expand its podcast, video and content production capabilities


WHAT YOU'LL DO


Plan

·      Meet with clients to understand their goals, audience, budget, and what success looks like

·      Develop event concepts and production approaches with the client and the dB team

·      Build and manage production schedules and lead regular client calls from kickoff through load-out


Budget and Document

·      Build and manage event budgets, and write proposals, scopes of work, and pricing

·      Create show paperwork: run of show, cue sheets, crew schedules, and labor calls

·      Create or revise ground plans, stage plots, and room layouts in Vectorworks or CAD


Produce

·      Source and manage vendors, venues, and freelance crew, including federal facilities

·      Lead the production team through load-in, rehearsals, show, and strike

·      Call the show when needed, and back up our show callers on large general sessions

·      Support the operation of dB Studios, including podcast, video, virtual and hybrid productions; assist with studio setup, recording, switching, audio, lighting and client sessions as needed.


Grow

·      Mentor our production assistants

·      Lead the after-action review on your events

·      Support new business through proposals, site visits, pitches, and RFP responses


WHAT YOU BRING


Requirements

·      5+ years planning and producing live events, with deep experience in corporate, government, and association events in and around DC

·      Strong knowledge of DC venues, federal facilities, vendors, and labor

·      Experience managing budgets, proposals, vendors, and freelance crew

·      A solid understanding of audio, video, lighting, staging, and content

·      Excellent communication with clients, senior executives, government stakeholders, staff and crew

·      A flexible schedule, including evenings, weekends, and holidays

·      A valid passport


The X factor

Ever wonder what could set you apart as a candidate? That X factor. These fit the bill, and there could be others. Let your experience shine here and tell us more.

·      Showcalling: you've called shows and can jump in and take the headset

·      Vectorworks or CAD experience

·      A book of business or clients that want to move with you

·      Experience with federal clients or events in secure facilities

·      Experience operating a podcast, broadcast, livestream or video production studio, including familiarity with multi-camera production, audio mixing, lighting, video switching and virtual meeting platforms.


CMP certification

Decibel Events is dedicated to the Certified Meeting Professional (CMP) program. A current CMP is preferred. job.title: Technical Product Manager, AgencyIQ by POLITICO
job.description:
Job Description:

POLITICO is seeking an experienced Technical Product Manager to design and deliver new tools and features for  AgencyIQ by POLITICO, a policy-driven product for regulatory professionals in the life sciences, food, and chemicals sectors.

 

AgencyIQ combines expert research, data, and software tools for regulatory professionals in the life sciences, food, and chemicals industries. This Technical Product Manager will shape AgencyIQ’s roadmap and help the product team move from customer insight to working solutions faster. The role spans product innovation (including the development and roll-out of AI-driven tools), commercial strategy, and technology execution—driving measurable growth in subscriber acquisition, engagement, and retention across both product lines.

 

The ideal candidate combines strong technical capabilities with a proven ability to translate subscriber insights into product roadmaps that deliver commercial results, partnering closely with research, editorial, technology, data, and commercial teams.

Who You Are

 

  • You are a highly user-centric product manager with a strong track record of translating research, data, and market insight into clear roadmaps and measurable business impact.
  • You are comfortable with both customer discovery and hands-on technical work. You can test an idea with users, understand how it fits into a subscription product, and collaborate with engineers on APIs, data flows, security, and deployment.
  • You enjoy enabling others by creating repeatable processes that make the whole team more effective.

 

What You’ll Do


Product Strategy & Roadmap

  • Own and prioritize a roadmap for AgencyIQ features and workflows, balancing customer value, commercial impact, technical feasibility, and engineering capacity.
  • Interview customers and prospects; analyze usage, feedback, market developments, and competitors; turn findings into clear product requirements, experiments, and defined KPIs.
  • Partner with research, commercial, design, and engineering teams to improve acquisition, engagement, expansion, and retention of customers across the market segments we serve.

 

AI-Assisted Prototyping and Technical Enablement

  • Design and roll out a repeatable workflow that lets nontechnical product managers use approved AI coding tools, such as Codex or Claude Code, to build and test feature prototypes and data collection tools.
  • Work with POLITICO’s engineering and design teams to create reusable templates and documentation that adhere to company standards and connect to POLITICO systems through approved access paths.
  • Align new templates and workflows with the tooling, policies, and procedures established by POLITICO’s engineering and operations teams.
  • Define how prototypes are evaluated with users, reviewed by engineers, and either hardened for release or retired.
  • Build representative prototypes yourself and coach other product managers through the workflow, and improve it based on where they get stuck and what engineers need for an efficient handoff.
  • Create reusable evals for prototypes and AI-enabled features, using representative regulatory tasks, expected results, and clear quality thresholds. Run them as designs change and use the results to guide engineering review and release decisions.

 

Regulatory Data and Delivery

  • Scope and prototype reliable ways to collect public data from government sources in the United States, Europe, Japan, and other global jurisdictions using official APIs or structured feeds where available and compliant scraping where appropriate.
  • Partner with research and engineering on source provenance, data quality, parsing, change detection, monitoring, and maintainability so promising data prototypes can become dependable product capabilities.
  • Write clear specifications, make trade-offs visible, coordinate delivery to make the most of limited engineering capacity, and measure whether shipped features improve customer outcomes.

What You'll Need

 

  • 3+ years of product management experience delivering B2B software or data products, with evidence of strong product judgment and measurable customer or business results.
  • Hands-on ability to prototype with modern AI coding tools and enough working knowledge of code, APIs, databases, and software delivery to assess output and collaborate credibly with engineers.
  • Experience designing usable product workflows from interviews, usability tests, feedback, and behavioral data; fluency in product metrics and prioritization.
  • Experience working with engineering on technical requirements, integrations, testing, and release processes; sound judgment about security, data access, and where human review is necessary.
  • Ability to teach technical practices to colleagues with different backgrounds and to communicate decisions clearly to commercial, research, technology, and senior leadership teams.
  • Familiarity with Python or JavaScript, SQL, web data collection, cloud development environments, CI/CD, and API-based integrations.

Preferred Experience

 

  • Experience in information services, regulatory intelligence, or another B2B subscription business that combines expert content, structured data, and software.
  • Knowledge of public regulatory sources or the needs of regulatory affairs, policy, legal, or scientific users.
  • Knowledge of the U.S. capital markets—namely public equities and the institutions that trade them

COMPENSATION: $125,000 - 135,000 Annual Base. The final salary offered will be based on factors including relevant experience, skills, and qualifications.


We value our people. Click here for more on what we offer and what it’s like to work for POLITICO. 


Let’s keep in touch. You can view our list of open positions here and email us careers@politico.com. We hope to see your application soon! 


About Us. 

POLITICO illuminates the forces shaping global power. Since 2007, we have delivered intelligence that anticipates tomorrow's headlines, not reports on yesterday's news. As politics has increasingly become the defining force of our era, our work has never been more vital. 


Cabinet secretaries and Ministers start their mornings with our analysis. CEOs shape strategy around our reporting. Advocacy leaders rely on our insights to move policy. We deliver the straightforward facts and clear-eyed analysis they need to navigate the most complex political landscape of our lifetimes. 


Our 1,100+ publishing professionals across the world's key democratic capitals—Washington, Brussels, London, Paris, Berlin, Sacramento, and New York—form the world's premier politics and policy newsroom. We tell the story of how power really works by explaining who wields it and how they plan to exercise it, connecting dots others miss and delivering scoops from sources others don't even know exist. 


Innovation has always been a core tenet of our story. At launch, we bet that depth would trump scale, that talent would trump traffic, and that politics would become central to modern life. In 2011, we made another bet and launched POLITICO Pro to help decision-makers understand the business of government, transforming both how they shape government action and the business of journalism itself. 


These bets have made POLITICO the most successful digital news startup of its generation and the indispensable resource for leaders who shape the future. Today, we are a rarity in media: a growing, profitable, and sustainable news organization. 


POLITICO is a subsidiary of Axel Springer SE, a family-owned transatlantic media company headquartered in Berlin and New York. Axel Springer is dedicated to shaping the future of journalism in the free world, believing that a free and informed society is essential to democracy. The company’s guiding principles - first articulated as  The Essentials by founder Axel Springer in the aftermath of World War II - remain a cornerstone of the company’s foundation today. Learn more about Axel Springer.
