job.title: Senior Account Executive - Legal (PA, NJ, MD, DE)
job.description:
Job Description:

Sr Account Executive

This position is responsible for developing account plans for new and/or existing small to mid-sized corporate accounts in an assigned territory. Prospects new customers and new business at existing customers and close full solution sales to corporate customers.   

Location: Territory includes South Eastern PA, MD, DE, and Southern NJ.
Product: Products: Responsible for securing new sales and growing and retaining existing accounts selling Legal Tracker, HighQ, Practical Law Connect, Practical Law, Westlaw, and other legal solution and workflow tools to prospective customer base of attorneys working for Corporations.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Prospecting: Prospecting is a must.  Actively seek out new business opportunities with both new and existing customers to build a strong sales pipeline. Keep your sales pipeline clean and up to date, aiming for 3-4 times coverage of your sales targets on a monthly and quarterly basis. 
  • Account Management: Focused on companies with revenues of less than $500M, leading the entire sales process through account planning, to include initial contact, account planning, deal closing to renewal.  
  • Sales Goals: Meet or exceed your revenue targets.  
  • Cross-functional Collaboration: Work closely with other teams within the organization to tailor our solutions to address the customer needs.  
  • Relationship Building: Establish and maintain strong relationships with key decision-makers and stakeholders, understanding their challenges and demonstrating how our solutions can address them. 
  • Salesforce Maintenance: Regularly update our CRM system (salesforce.com) to maintain accurate records of your sales activities and to provide reliable sales forecasts. 
  • Engage in direct client meetings either in person or via platforms like MS Teams.  

   

Required Qualifications:

  • Proven ability to sell complex software solutions to small and medium companies (Less than $500M in revenue), using a consultative and value-based approach.  
  • Experience with high velocity sales, as well as land and expand approach. 
  • Must be a self-starter comfortable with ambiguity and possess a growth mindset, capable of managing change effectively.  
  • Experience selling to C-level executives applying a solution selling approach and the ability to identify business challenges and impact to their business if they don’t solve their challenges.  
  • Skilled in leading detailed sales processes involving various stakeholders. 
  • Strong commitment to the company's mission, with a deep understanding of artificial intelligence and its applications in enhancing legal department operations.  
  • Enthusiastic about prospecting and able to manage the entire sales cycle independently from initiation to closure.  
  • Ability to work well with teams across different departments (such as marketing, product, and legal) to achieve shared objectives.  
  • Eager to help refine sales strategies, enhance the sales team culture, improve the company’s value proposition, and develop sales tools to boost overall success.  
  • College degree preferred with a minimum of 4 years direct field sales experience (sales experience in the corporate sector preferred) with proven, exemplary track record of sales quota over achievement. 
  • Ability to develop and execute an account plan. 
  • Able to work from home office and travel to customer locations. 

Preferred Qualifications:

  • College degree preferred with a minimum of 4 years direct field sales experience (sales experience in the corporate sector preferred) with proven, exemplary track record of sales quota over achievement. 

#LI-D2E

 

 

What’s in it For You?

  • Flexibility & Work-Life Balance: Flex My Way is a set of supportive workplace policies designed to help manage personal and professional responsibilities, whether caring for family, giving back to the community, or finding time to refresh and reset. This builds upon our flexible work arrangements, including work from anywhere for up to 8 weeks per year, empowering employees to achieve a better work-life balance.

  • Career Development and Growth: By fostering a culture of continuous learning and skill development, we prepare our talent to tackle tomorrow’s challenges and deliver real-world solutions. Our Grow My Way programming and skills-first approach ensures you have the tools and knowledge to grow, lead, and thrive in an AI-enabled future.

  • Industry Competitive Benefits: We offer comprehensive benefit plans to include flexible vacation, two company-wide Mental Health Days off, access to the Headspace app, retirement savings, tuition reimbursement, employee incentive programs, and resources for mental, physical, and financial wellbeing.

  • Culture: Globally recognized, award-winning reputation for inclusion and belonging, flexibility, work-life balance, and more. We live by our values: Obsess over our Customers, Compete to Win, Challenge (Y)our Thinking, Act Fast / Learn Fast, and Stronger Together.

  • Social Impact: Make an impact in your community with our Social Impact Institute. We offer employees two paid volunteer days off annually and opportunities to get involved with pro-bono consulting projects and Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) initiatives.

  • Making a Real-World Impact: We are one of the few companies globally that helps its customers pursue justice, truth, and transparency. Together, with the professionals and institutions we serve, we help uphold the rule of law, turn the wheels of commerce, catch bad actors, report the facts, and provide trusted, unbiased information to people all over the world.

 

 

In the United States, Thomson Reuters offers a comprehensive benefits package to our employees. Our benefit package includes market competitive health, dental, vision, disability, and life insurance programs, as well as a competitive 401k plan with company match. In addition, Thomson Reuters offers market leading work life benefits with competitive vacation, sick and safe paid time off, paid holidays (including two company mental health days off), parental leave, sabbatical leave. These benefits meet or exceeds the requirements of paid time off in accordance with any applicable state or municipal laws. Finally, Thomson Reuters offers the following additional benefits: optional hospital, accident and sickness insurance paid 100% by the employee; optional life and AD&D insurance paid 100% by the employee; Flexible Spending and Health Savings Accounts; fitness reimbursement; access to Employee Assistance Program; Group Legal Identity Theft Protection benefit paid 100% by employee; access to 529 Plan; commuter benefits; Adoption & Surrogacy Assistance; Tuition Reimbursement; and access to Employee Stock Purchase Plan.

Thomson Reuters complies with local laws that require upfront disclosure of the expected pay range for a position. The target total cash compensation range varies across locations. For any eligible US locations, unless otherwise noted, the target total cash compensation range for this role is $189,000 USD - $351,000 USD. Pay is positioned within the range based on several factors including an individual’s knowledge, skills and experience with consideration given to internal equity. Base pay and any target sales incentive are part of a comprehensive Total Reward program which also includes flexible and supportive benefits and other wellbeing programs. Target total cash compensation ranges are inclusive of both base pay and any target sales incentive.

This job posting will close .

About Us

Thomson Reuters informs the way forward by bringing together the trusted content and technology that people and organizations need to make the right decisions. We serve professionals across legal, tax, accounting, compliance, government, and media. Our products combine highly specialized software and insights to empower professionals with the data, intelligence, and solutions needed to make informed decisions, and to help institutions in their pursuit of justice, truth, and transparency. Reuters, part of Thomson Reuters, is a world leading provider of trusted journalism and news.

We are powered by the talents of 26,000 employees across more than 70 countries, where everyone has a chance to contribute and grow professionally in flexible work environments. At a time when objectivity, accuracy, fairness, and transparency are under attack, we consider it our duty to pursue them. Sound exciting? Join us and help shape the industries that move society forward.

As a global business, we rely on the unique backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences of all employees to deliver on our business goals. To ensure we can do that, we seek talented, qualified employees in all our operations around the world regardless of race, color, sex/gender, including pregnancy, gender identity and expression, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, disability, age, marital status, citizen status, veteran status, or any other protected classification under applicable law. Thomson Reuters is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer providing a drug-free workplace.

We also make reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and for sincerely held religious beliefs in accordance with applicable law. More information on requesting an accommodation here.

job.title: #1 Operator in Bindery - 3rd Shift
job.description:
#1 Operator in Bindery, 3rd Shift


Job Description

We are hiring an experienced #1 Lead Bindery Operator for our printing plant team in Eagan, Minnesota. In this role, you will be responsible for the performance of the production line and crew on our Core Print Solutions team. You will also facilitate Tier 1 meetings and Gemba Walk discussions to drive process improvements.


Location: Eagan, Minnesota
Schedule: 3rd shift, 10:30 PM to 6:30 AM, with occasional overtime of up to 4 hours per day and occasional weekend shifts
Compensation: $2,500 sign-on bonus after 90 days in the role


Key Responsibilities

  • Provide leadership, work direction, and training to crew members to consistently optimize overall performance
  • Ensure the line runs smoothly and produces a quality product for customers
  • Facilitate Tier 1 meetings and Gemba Walk discussions to drive communication and improvements to equipment processes
  • Train crew members, including temporary staff and those coming from other areas, to meet workload demands
  • Motivate others and build a team environment

Required Qualifications

  • High School Diploma, GED, or higher
  • Experience leading and training others
  • Experience working in an industrial setting with a wide range of production machinery
  • Strong mechanical and technical skills, with the ability to troubleshoot, make decisions, and resolve machine issues
  • Experience with Lean and continuous improvement
  • Good communication skills, including experience sharing information across shifts and departments
  • Proven success as a trainer
  • Able to run multiple pieces of equipment
  • Experience as a lead on perfect binders with up to 40-station collators, 3-knife trimmers, inline boxing, and palletizing

Job Summary:

WHO ARE WE?

Live Nation Entertainment is the world’s leading live entertainment company, comprised of global market leaders: Ticketmaster, Live Nation Concerts, and Live Nation Media & Sponsorship. Ticketmaster is the global leader in event ticketing with over 500 million tickets sold annually and more than 12,000 clients worldwide.  Live Nation Concerts is the largest provider of live entertainment in the world promoting more than 40,000 shows and 100+ festivals annually for nearly 4,000 artists in over 40 countries. These businesses allow Live Nation Media & Sponsorship to create strategic music marketing programs that connect over 1,000 brands with the 98 million fans that attend Live Nation Entertainment events each year. For additional information, visit www.livenationentertainment.com.


WHO ARE YOU?

Passionate and driven, with an entrepreneurial spirit. Resourceful, innovative, forward-thinking, and collaborative. At Live Nation Entertainment, our people embrace these qualities, so if this sounds like you, please read on!


THE JOB

Live Nation Entertainment’s Media & Sponsorship Division is seeking a Regional Director, Sales. This successful sponsorship sales professional will be responsible for creating and selling branded, high-impact music marketing programs across our San Francisco and Pacific Northwest market properties.


Live Nation Media & Sponsorship architects, sells and manages the company’s national corporate sponsorship programs with the world’s most recognizable brands. It is an exciting, fast-paced team that collaborates with all facets of Live Nation’s business including venues, festivals, ticketing, artists, content, media (digital, social, mobile), promotions, and concert production. To learn more about our division, check out: https://livenationforbrands.com/


WHAT THIS ROLE WILL DO

  • Create, package and sell solution-based music marketing programs for Live Nation Entertainment. Including amphitheater, club and theater venues throughout the San Francisco and Pacific Northwest market areas, digital media and marketing promotions
  • Meet or exceed revenue and key account goals
  • Focus on developing and maintaining strong relationships with important decision makers at client marketing companies and their respective advertising agencies in a variety of business categories
  • Craft sales presentations that creatively and distinctly differentiate and communicate unique assets addressing the goals of targeted prospects
  • Educate/position Live Nation assets and marketing capabilities to the sponsor/advertiser marketplace; demonstrate the branding values of live music tie-ins to create unique marketing value with Live Nation's assets
  • Structure, price, successfully negotiate and close deals that will keep you performing to expectations in tracking to your budget
  • Oversee sponsor contracts, invoicing, and accounts receivable or develop processes to ensure execution and collections

WHAT THIS PERSON WILL BRING

  • Bachelor’s degree required
  • Minimum of 5 years of sponsorship/solution-based marketing programs
  • A reputation as a "go-getter" and "Rainmaker”
  • Solid relationships with senior level marketing executives at relevant brands/agencies located in or doing business in the market(s)
  • Demonstrated ability to develop and nurture relationships and work effectively at all levels of the decision process
  • Strong understanding of media/advertising buys to communicate value of sponsorship vs. pure media as a marketing solution
  • Strong interpersonal and leadership abilities with excellent oral and written communication skills

Applicants for employment in the U.S. must possess work authorization which does not require sponsorship by the employer for a visa.

WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR

The Staff Attorney will support the Chief Legal Officer, Associate General Counsel, Senior Managing Director of Legal Affairs, and overall Legal Affairs team with the Academy’s day-to-day transactional needs. Utilizing your excellent judgment, team collaboration skills, and commitment to the highest level of honesty, fidelity and integrity, you will provide legal advice to the Academy and its affiliates on a range of contracts.

 

 

WHAT YOU’LL DO

 

  • Draft, review and negotiate commercial contracts covering a range of Academy and affiliate activities, including vendor and services agreements, programming, events, licensing, technology and new initiatives under development.
  • Advise business teams on contract interpretation and obligations, explaining legal issues to non-lawyers in a digestible manner.
  • Issue spot and quickly assess when to escalate matters to more senior members of the Legal Affairs department.
  • Work with the team to streamline contract processes from commencement to conclusion, including maintaining contract playbooks and using technology to standardize processes.
  • Maintain organized records of executed contracts and related documents.
  • Collaborate intra- and inter-departmentally to maintain appropriate contract templates for business team use.
  • Assist with implementing and updating Academy and affiliate policies and procedures to ensure compliance and efficient administration of resources.
  • Stay informed about legal developments relevant to the Academy’s and its affiliates’ business operations.

 

 SKILLS & EXPERIENCE 
  • Juris Doctor degree from an accredited law school.
  • License to practice law (or ability to become licensed) in state of residence.
  • 2-3 years’ experience practicing transactional law at an established law firm and/or in-house in a corporate legal or business affairs department.  
  • Experience advising on music and entertainment business matters strongly preferred.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including an established track record of superior legal draftsmanship and negotiation, and the demonstrated ability to conclude matters efficiently and beneficially for the client. 
  • Must be a forward-thinking individual with sound, practical, and business-minded judgment including the ability to “think outside of the box,” come up with intelligent solutions to problems, master new technologies utilized to streamline contract systems, and assess and explain the business and legal impact of alternative options.

job.title: Account Director, Earned Media - Health & Wellness
job.description:
Who we are:

Burson, part of WPP, is the global communications leader built to create value for clients through reputation. With highly specialized teams, industry-leading technologies and breakthrough creative, we help brands and businesses redefine reputation as a competitive advantage so they can lead today and into the future. When you work at Burson, you are part of a global community of lifelong learners who thrive at the edge of innovation.

WPP (LSE/NYSE: WPP) is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com 

For more information visit bursonglobal.com and follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

More about the role:

We are seeking an Account Director, Earned Media to join our growing Health & Wellness practice and help lead earned media strategy and execution across pharmaceutical, biotech and wellness clients. This role is ideal for an experienced media relations professional who is passionate about finding compelling stories within complex healthcare topics, building strong relationships with journalists and helping clients earn meaningful attention in an increasingly fragmented media landscape.

You will play a hands-on role in developing and executing earned media strategies, identifying newsworthy opportunities and proactively engaging traditional, trade, consumer and emerging media. From complex science and clinical data to product milestones, disease awareness, thought leadership and consumer-facing campaigns, you will help translate healthcare stories into timely, relevant narratives that resonate with reporters and their audiences.

The ideal candidate brings strong healthcare communications experience, established media relationships, a track record of securing impactful coverage and the ability to confidently counsel clients and guide teams through execution. You will work closely with account, digital, social, creative and strategy colleagues to ensure earned media is integrated into broader communications programs.

The Team

The Health & Wellness team at Burson is one of the largest and most innovative groups in the space. We have pushed the limits of traditional healthcare communications with a complete 360-degree integrated offer for our clients: social, digital, data, brands, celebrity, science, corporate, consumer and more.

We are a group of people who work hard as a team to continue building our reputation as visionaries in the industry. We are looking for individuals who want to challenge both themselves and the status quo.

What you'll do:

  • Develop and execute earned media strategies for healthcare clients that align with client objectives, communications priorities and the evolving media landscape.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with healthcare, business, consumer and trade reporters, editors and other influential media contacts.
  • Proactively identify and pitch compelling stories ranging from complex science, clinical trial results, regulatory milestones and product approvals/launches to disease awareness campaigns, executive thought leadership and consumer-facing partnerships.
  • Translate complex scientific and healthcare information into clear, relevant and newsworthy narratives for different media audiences.
  • Serve as a trusted earned media counselor to clients, providing recommendations around story positioning, messaging, media targets, spokesperson preparation and outreach strategies.
  • Identify opportunities to insert clients and subject-matter experts into timely healthcare, cultural and industry conversations.
  • Work closely with account, digital, social, creative and strategy colleagues to integrate earned media into broader communications campaigns and ensure consistency across channels.
  • Manage day-to-day earned media programs from strategy through execution, keeping workstreams moving and ensuring teams deliver high-quality work.
  • Provide strategic counsel and support around issues management and sensitive media situations, working with senior team members as appropriate.
  • Help develop earned media plans, measurement frameworks and KPIs, and use performance insights to continually strengthen media strategies.
  • Oversee media monitoring and reporting across traditional, digital and trade outlets, identifying trends, opportunities and implications for clients.
  • Analyze earned media performance and translate results into actionable insights and recommendations for clients.
  • Manage and mentor junior team members, providing clear direction, feedback and opportunities to strengthen their media relations and healthcare communications expertise.
  • Review and provide thoughtful feedback on media materials including pitches, press releases, talking points, briefing materials, Q&As and media strategies.
  • Stay current on the evolving healthcare and media landscapes, bringing new reporters, platforms, trends and storytelling approaches to clients and internal teams.

Experience that contributes to success:

  • 7+ years of experience in public relations and communications, with meaningful experience in earned media and healthcare, pharmaceutical, biotech or wellness communications.
  • Demonstrated success securing media coverage for healthcare clients across areas such as product launches, clinical data, regulatory milestones, disease awareness, executive thought leadership and consumer-facing campaigns.
  • Strong relationships with healthcare, business, consumer and/or trade journalists, along with an understanding of how reporters and outlets approach healthcare stories.
  • Experience developing media strategies and translating those strategies into proactive, results-oriented media relations programs.
  • Working knowledge of the regulatory considerations that shape pharmaceutical and healthcare communications, including experience working within regulated client environments.
  • Strong client-management and counseling skills, with the confidence to present recommendations and provide thoughtful media guidance.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills and the ability to simplify complex scientific and healthcare information for a variety of audiences.
  • Strong judgment and an understanding of what makes a story timely, differentiated, credible and relevant to the media.
  • Experience managing multiple workstreams, deadlines and priorities in a fast-paced agency or communications environment.
  • Experience mentoring and developing junior team members and providing constructive feedback on media strategy and execution.
  • Experience using media monitoring, intelligence and measurement tools to evaluate earned media performance and inform recommendations.
  • Familiarity with integrated healthcare communications, including how earned media can work alongside digital, social, influencer, creative and corporate communications.
  • Desire to work in a diverse and inclusive organization as an active participant in culture initiatives, training opportunities and employee resource groups.

  • Great interest in and knowledge of radio and all forms of audio.

job.title: Senior Accountant
job.description:
About SBS:

As a pioneer in Spanish-language media, SBS has always been at the forefront of the evolution of Hispanic entertainment in the U.S. In this era of technological advancements and media convergence, SBS is poised to capitalize on its vast array of proprietary content across multiple platforms. Our unwavering commitment is to create exceptional, high-quality branded entertainment that resonates deeply with the Hispanic consumer. Our impressive growth on the web with LaMusica.com and the promising reception of our latest venture, the podcast initiative, are testament to SBS' long-term strategy. By seamlessly delivering content through diverse channels, we not only maximize revenue but also extend the reach of our beloved brands. SBS remains steadfast in our leadership position in today's dynamic and ever-expanding U.S. Hispanic market, and we are determined to continue pushing boundaries and shaping the future of Hispanic media.

Position Summary

The Senior Accountant is responsible for analyzing multiple complex financial reports in preparation to present the company’s financial statements.  The Senior Accountant regulates and authenticates financial transactions and maintains a ledger to ensure effectiveness and accuracy of all accounting tasks.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Overall accounting and variance analysis.
  • Perform various functions directly related to the accounting month-end close process, which include but are not limited to preparing journal entries and supporting schedules, reconciling bank and ledger accounts, and reviewing detailed transactions for accuracy and validity of accounting treatment.
  • Analyze and prepare entries related to payrolls, benefits, commissions, barter, invoices, contracts, and various vendor payments for posting to the general ledger.
  • Analyze actual results against budgets and forecasts.
  • Prepare ad-hoc or other financial reports, as necessary.
  • Maintain US GAAP accounting and ensure compliance with all relevant accounting literature.
  • Maintain SOX compliance and update related process flows.
  • Review and analysis of financial statements and key metrics for assigned areas.
  • Prepare general ledger entries and balance sheet reconciliation in compliance with policies and procedures.
  • Identify and implement process improvements as continuous improvement.
  • Liaise with external auditors and provide documentation as necessary.
  • Help design and implement internal controls over accounting processes.
  • Update and maintain schedules to reflect activities and balances at period end, involving generating relevant system reports or obtaining data from third-party sources (such as sub-ledger reports, GL details, amortization schedules, payroll reports, account statements, contracts, and invoices).
  • Ensure accuracy by reconciling figures with source documents and validate the completeness and accuracy of acquired data.
  • Conduct calculations for items like accrued commissions and bad debt reverses.
  • Conduct reconciliation for SL to GL and books to bank where applicable.
  • Gather documentation and conduct research to explain and support changes in activities compared to prior periods.
  • Investigate aged balance to propose appropriate resolutions for reconciling items or accrual components.
  • Execute necessary adjustments via Journal Entries to ensure accurate representation of financial data.
  • Verify and ensure all required adjustments impacting account balances were made for each market in consolidated schedules.
  • Reconcile consolidated schedules with the consolidated general ledger to ensure alignment.
  • Analyze balance sheet accounts to appropriately classify balances between Short Term and Long Term, distinguishing between receivables or payables with terms exceeding one year as Long Term.
  • Additional accounts reconciliation and analysis as needed.

Essential duties and responsibilities are those most important or most frequently performed duties.  Employees will be required to perform other job-related duties as required.

Supervisory Responsibilities

  • May lead projects.

Minimum Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in accounting.
  • 4 years of progressive accounting experience.
  • Strong technical accounting and financial analytical skills.
  • Detail-oriented and organized. Superior analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to meet a constant stream of deadlines.
  • Proven ability to work both independently and collaboratively with different levels of employees.
  • Familiarity with accounting software and programs.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills.
  • Advanced proficiency in Excel.
  • Proficient with Microsoft Office Suite or related software.

Why work for SBS?

 

Spanish Broadcasting Systems (SBS) offers a unique and exciting opportunity to be part of the leading Hispanic-focused media company in the industry. By joining our team, you will become an integral part of shaping and influencing the landscape of Spanish-language broadcasting. We take pride in our rich heritage and commitment to serving the vibrant Hispanic community with compelling content and innovative programming. At SBS, you will be surrounded by a diverse and talented group of professionals who share a passion for media, creativity, and cultural connectivity. We foster a collaborative and inclusive work environment where your ideas and contributions are valued and recognized. With access to state-of-the-art facilities and cutting-edge technologies, you will have the tools to bring your ideas to life and create impactful experiences for our audience. Additionally, SBS provides ample opportunities for personal and professional growth, with ongoing learning and development programs designed to enhance your skills and advance your career. If you are seeking a dynamic and rewarding career in the world of Spanish-language broadcasting, SBS is the place to be. Join us and be part of a team that is making a difference in the lives of millions of people every day.

JOB DESCRIPTION

As Hairstylist for Fox News, you know how to ready a person for their close-up! Your skills in hair styling guarantee that you can make anyone feel confident in their own skin. You will be a member of a team of artists responsible for preparing Fox News anchors, reporters, and contributors to appear on national television. This role will require a high level of proficiency in hair styling for both men and women, as well as the ability to understand and work in the rapidly changing environment of cable news.

  • Style hair in a manner appropriate for television - This has to be accomplished very quickly and includes a high level of proficiency in the techniques of blow-outs and velcro roller sets, as well as using hot irons to accomplish volume and smoothness and a defined hairstyle for women

OVERVIEW OF THE COMPANY

Fox News Media

FOX News Media operates the FOX News Channel (FNC), FOX Business Network (FBN), FOX News Digital, FOX News Audio, FOX News Books, the direct-to-consumer digital streaming services FOX Nation and FOX News International and the newly announced platform FOX Weather. Currently the number one network in all of cable, FNC has also been the most watched television news channel for 20 consecutive years, while FBN currently ranks among the top business channels on cable. Owned by FOX Corporation, FOX News Media reaches 200 million people each month.

JOB DESCRIPTION

Hannity is looking for a dedicated, creative, and experienced Associate Producer to join our team. In this role, you will pitch stories, produce segments, assist the monologue writers, support field shoots, and contribute to the show’s daily editorial process.


The ideal candidate thrives in a collaborative team environment and has a strong passion for current events and politics.

 

You will be offered the following shift: Monday – Friday from 2 PM – 10 PM, ET

 

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Pitch segment ideas, story ideas, and guests daily
  • Assist monologue writers with research, elements, and segment production
  • Build graphics for various segments
  • Write banners and teases
  • Periodically write introductions, mini-monologues, and monologues
  • Help arrange field shoots

You will do all of this in one of the fastest-growing regions in the country — beautiful Salt Lake City. Skiing, hiking, camping, city living: it's all here. Production Assistant | KVIA ABC-7 (El Paso / Las Cruces) Status: Non-Exempt | Hours Vary (Flexible Schedule Required) Ever wondered what it feels like when the studio floor goes quiet, the countdown hits zero, and the red tally lights flick on? Welcome to live television at KVIA-TV, the undisputed #1 station in El Paso and Las Cruces. We bring the Borderland its most critical news, sports, and live events every single day—and our production team is the heartbeat making it all come to life. If you are obsessed with media, thrive under the adrenaline rush of live broadcasting, and want a hands-on learning environment where you actually build real production chops from day one, this is your entry point. At AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions, we believe a great workplace isn't just something we say — it's something you can feel when you join the team. Here, it's all about great collabs, ambition, and results but most importantly, we grow here, and we enjoy here.  We're searching for that special someone — a driven, talented individual to join our innovative media sales and marketing solutions team. In this role, you'll engage with new and existing clients and show them how our innovative media solutions can amplify their brands and deliver measurable success. o Stay Ahead of the Curve: Keep your finger on the pulse of industry trends and competitive strategies to ensure we're always a step ahead in the marketplace.

o Proven Business Support Ability (or an Unstoppable Desire to Learn): Whether you're a seasoned administrative or business support specialist or just getting started, we value your drive, energy, and passion for achieving results.  

 

o Strong Communication Skills: You're a natural at building relationships and communicating effectively. Proficiency with digital tools and applications is a must.  

 

o A Passion for Helping Others: You are committed to understanding our teams' needs, providing top-notch administrative and business support, and making a difference.

 

o A Willingness to Grow: Do you thrive in environments where you're always learning something new? Excellent, you'll fit right in! The media world is constantly evolving, and the ability to learn, adapt, and embrace challenges in a fast-paced, digital-first environment is key.

 

Why Join AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions? / The Reasons You Should Hit "Apply Now" 

o Serious Work, Seriously Cool People: Be part of a dynamic team that values creativity, collaboration, and fun! We are all for work that is rewarding.

 

o Attractive Rewards: Enjoy competitive compensation that rewards your hard work. Our people love our benefits package.

Our media sales team isn't just selling ads; they're the boots on the ground, making a real difference where it counts. (And yes, it feels pretty good.)

 

o Career Growth Opportunities: We believe in investing in you. That's why you'll have access to training, mentorship, and career advancement opportunities to help you thrive. We are a leader in our industry, flexing our local charm and national muscle, to provide you with options to amplify your career in your local market or join one of our AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions teams in another city.

 

o Comprehensive Media Education (We Are Your Power Source!): New to the industry? We've got you covered with training programs that turn curiosity into expertise.

 

AMP is us. It's you. It isn't just a name; it's a mission. A promise to amplify our reach, amplify our innovation, and most importantly, amplify you. If you're ready to grow your career and help businesses achieve their goals, we'd love to hear from you.

Job Summary: The Walt Disney Company offers an internship in Lisbon as a Acquisitions Intern . The role will consist of: L earn how the team manages content acquisition across linear channels and streaming platform by performing essential tasks such as: Enter information from licensing agreements into programming and accounting/finance systems, as well as the master files; Process invoices related to Acquisitions or Local Productions and track payments; Review existing contracts in the system to identify any changes, inconsistencies or missing information (series renewals, date changes, changes in the number of episodes, etc. ); Provide updated information to the Programmers (calendars, US ratings info, etc. ); Back office support to effectively liaise with other departments (such as Legal, Finance, Materials, Creative, Marketing, etc. ); Collect information needed for internal reports (local, regional or global ); The skills we are looking for are: Interest in learning, particularly about the Television industry; Proactive, dynamic, motivated, responsible, with strong attention to detail and teamwork skills; Ability to complete tasks with tight timelines, both collaboratively and by self- managing; Proficient on MS Excel; The necessary qualifications of the position will be: Degree in Economics, Business Management or other similar studies [It is essential to have completed the studies and no more than 2 years have elapsed since the completion of it] Must be fluent in English and Portuguese. Spanish is a plus. We offer a 1 year internship program starting in November . Disney’s stories, characters and experiences reach consumers and guests from every corner of the globe. With operations in more than 40 countries, our employees and cast members work together to create entertainment experiences that are both universally and locally cherished. job.title: Business and Sales Internship
job.description: Keywords Location Search Jobs Business and Sales Internship Job ID 10162320 Location London, United Kingdom Business The Walt Disney Company (EMEA) Date posted Oct. 13, 2026 Business and Sales Internship Apply Now Save Job SHARE Facebook LinkedIn Email WhatsApp Links open in new tabs. Job Summary: Job Requirements Ready to make magic? We’re hiring for our 12-month undergraduate placement schemes. As a Business and Sales Intern, you will be exposed to the commercial functions across The Walt Disney Company (TWDC). You will contribute to strategic projects, play a key role in analysing commercial data which will contribute to improving business processes and commercial performance. The internship will encourage you to think strategically and advance your commercial acumen, as well as developing your interpersonal skills, critical thinking and project management skills. You’ll join a team grounded in our Disney values; acting with Integrity, welcoming everyone through Inclusion, embracing boundless Creativity, working together through Collaboration and caring deeply for our Community. These values shape how we work and how we support one another every day. We have multiple internships available within Business and Sales. By applying for this opportunity, you will be considered for one of the below areas. If you have a particular preference, please note this in your cover letter. Disney+ Content Acquisitions (Direct-to-Consumer & Media Networks) : You’ll be part of a team working across the non-linear (Disney+) brands and platforms, and linear (Star, FX & Disney Channels). You will provide support to the team by coordinating projects, working with external and internal partners to help source and review content for the Disney+ service, and working closely with various teams including Programming, Legal and Finance to best support content planned across Europe, the Middle East, and Africa (EMEA) region and generate a return on investment. Strategic Initiatives and Launch : In this role, you will support the delivery of high-profile strategic initiatives that bring together teams from across Disney+, including Programming, Marketing, Partnerships, Product, Commercial, Legal and Analytics. Working alongside experienced programme managers, you'll help coordinate launch plans across multiple international markets, track progress against key milestones, and ensure teams remain aligned throughout delivery. This role offers a unique opportunity to gain hands-on experience in programme management, contribute to projects with real business impact, and learn how a global streaming service plans, launches and operates major initiatives at scale. Disney Consumer Products Commercial, Account & Category Management : You will play a key role in supporting the sourcing, developing new partners and products across our Toy & Food businesses. From identifying trends, to thinking of exciting new product ideas, this internship will develop skills in creative & strategic thinking, commercial acumen and sales. This role would be suitable for those who are passionate about Disney products. Loyalty and Premiums : You will manage the relationship with the external Premium Partners and support the business’s promotional activities across every Disney brand. You will be responsible for all aspects of Account Management including, handling enquiries, and collaborating with multiple internal departments (from Product Development to Contracts). UK Retail Sales and Marketing : You will work with a range of UK retailers from grocery to e-commerce where you will support the activation of commercial and marketing plans across all the franchises and product categories associated with TWDC brand. E-Commerce Marketplaces : You’ll help drive the growth of our leading licensees across toys, fashion, home, publishing, health & beauty, and games. This role offers hands-on experience in brand management and e-commerce, from running campaigns and promotions to analysing sales data, reviewing category performance, and identifying new opportunities to boost sales and strengthen our global brand presence. Brand Commercialisation : You will work across a selection of the Disney, Pixar, Marvel, 20th Century Studios and Lucasfilm brands. You will be responsible for assisting the team in delivering global/regional (EMEA) strategies to maximise revenue and grow brand engagement for all audiences. You will gain hands-on experience in commercial brand strategy, brand health analysis, and partner pitching. This opportunity would suit a detail-oriented, analytical individual with a curiosity for the financial and consumer data insights that underpin our Brand Commercialisation strategies. Disney Destinations International Sales: Forming part of the travel division of Disney, this remit is responsible for the sales and marketing of Disneyland Paris (DLP), Walt Disney World (WDW) and Disney Cruise Line (DCL) across the UK, Ireland and the EMEA region. Interns will join the sales team, managing relationships with UK travel industry partners to enable them to sell our destinations and increase the sales of packages and tickets through a variety of activities and events. Disney Platform Distribution Affiliates Sales : You will play a key role in supporting the team and actively contribute to the affiliate sales success. You will be part of an array of projects across the distribution of Disney’s linear channels (National Geographic, Disney Channel) and Disney+ to platform partners (B2B) across EMEA markets. Key responsibilities will include market analysis, financial modelling on excel and contract reviews. Digital Stores : You’ll help drive digital movie and TV content sales across EMEA, working closely with global and local retailers. Key responsibilities include supporting new release launches, assisting with promotional catalogue projects, and providing project and administrative support to account managers. Sales and Deal Management : Interns joining this team will gain hands-on experience supporting sales and deal planning for dynamic television media platforms. You’ll collaborate with regional sales teams, interpret and record deal terms, and provide essential pre- and post-sales support across various EMEA markets. Commercial Development: You’ll play a key role in supporting the EMEA Commercial team, helping to drive commercial decision-making across the region. Working with teams across multiple EMEA markets, you’ll gain hands-on experience in content distribution, rights and licensing activity, sales planning, and market analysis. Key responsibilities include tracking content availability and sales, consolidating market updates for senior leadership, and supporting strategic projects that contribute to the growth and success of Disney’s content distribution business. Studios Home Entertainment Product Management: You’ll support the entire Physical Home Entertainment business from DVDs and Blu-rays to 4K UHD releases across brands like Disney, Pixar, Marvel, Lucasfilm, TV and Fox – bringing these stories to life in homes across Europe. You’ll play a key role in shaping product format strategy, product and performance analysis, driving distribution excellence, and ensuring every release is timely, cost-effective, and aligned with global strategy. Studio Distribution: Our team supports the theatrical distribution of Disney’s film slate across EMEA. Through market analysis, forecasting, performance reporting and strategic insights, we help local markets optimise release strategies and drive box office success. Theatrical Sales: You’ll support the department in successfully releasing all our films across the UK & Ireland, from Searchlight films to Marvel blockbusters and Disney family favourites. Key responsibilities will include analysing box office data, booking films with clients, facilitating screening events, supporting team meetings, and sharing industry reports across the department as well as working with internal and external partners. Character Voices International: Working with the Disney Character Voices International team, you will be responsible for planning and tracking the delivery of localised dubbed projects across EMEA. Job Summary: Job Requirements Ready to make magic? We’re hiring for our 12-month undergraduate placement schemes. We’re recruiting several Consumer Research & Data Insights Intern roles across the business. If you’re selected, you will be placed in one of Disney’s following business lines: Disney+, Media Networks (Kids, Factual, Entertainment and Sports TV channels), Ad Sales Insights, Product & Technology, Content Development & Licensing, Studios, Consumer Products or Parks & Resorts. By collaborating with third-party agencies and internal teams, you will assist in gathering, checking and analysing data to deliver best-in-class insights that inform and support business strategies across the Europe, Middle East, and Africa (EMEA) region. You will be integral in ensuring the quality and usability of data and insights, ultimately contributing to actionable, data-driven and visually engaging recommendations that influence business operations, across the Disney portfolio of brands (Disney, Pixar, Marvel, Lucasfilm, National Geographic, ESPN, Disney+ etc.). Some roles will influence marketing, some others will have an impact on content, some on social media, or brand, or commercial strategies – more details specific to your role will be shared during the recruitment process. You’ll join a team grounded in our Disney values; acting with Integrity, welcoming everyone through Inclusion, embracing boundless Creativity, working together through Collaboration and caring deeply for our Community. These values shape how we work and how we support one another every day. While all the roles we have on offer share much common ground, some lean a bit more into Consumer Research, some lean more into Data Analytics and Operations and some are a mix of both. If you have a preference, please note this in your cover letter. This is an office-based internship. 4 days working in the Hammersmith, London office with 1 day working from home (Monday or Friday). job.title: Product Licensing and Buying Internship
job.description: Keywords Location Search Jobs Product Licensing and Buying Internship Job ID 10162416 Location London, United Kingdom Business The Walt Disney Company (EMEA) Date posted Oct. 13, 2026 Product Licensing and Buying Internship Apply Now Save Job SHARE Facebook LinkedIn Email WhatsApp Links open in new tabs. Job Summary: Job Requirements Ready to make magic? We’re hiring for our 12-month undergraduate placement schemes. As a Product Licensing and Buying Intern you will be a part of our consumer products team who cover merchandising, store operations, imports and creative across our Europe Middle East and Africa (EMEA) region. You will assist with licensing for our partnerships as well as assessing samples, managing product catalogues, and analysing the market. This internship will develop your commercial and creative thinking, and you will gain an understanding of what goes on behind the scenes to create a quality Disney product. You’ll join a team grounded in our Disney values; acting with Integrity, welcoming everyone through Inclusion, embracing boundless Creativity, working together through Collaboration and caring deeply for our Community. These values shape how we work and how we support one another every day. We have multiple internships available within this remit. By applying for this opportunity, you will be considered for one of the below areas. If you have a particular preference, please note this in your cover letter. Commercial and Business Development As an intern on the Disney Consumer Products Commercial team, you will play a key role in supporting the sourcing, developing new partners and products across our Toy & Food businesses. From identifying trends, to thinking of exciting new product ideas, this internship will develop skills in creative & strategic thinking, commercial acumen and sales. This role would be suitable for those who are passionate about Disney products. Disney Home Supporting our growing Homewares remit across the EMEA Region, you will gain exposure to marketing and PR campaigns by working on new product launches and develop your business knowledge by supporting with aspects such as finance and reporting. You will hone your communication skills, through stakeholder management with external licensees and working independently on market research presentations. Disney Store Working directly with our wider retail team in Europe and North America, you will assist the Buying team with delivering a range of consumer products from initial competitor research through to launching the product in our Flagship Stores and online. You will develop your Buying, commercial retail, data analysis and presentation skills. You will become an expert in Disney and retail, building relationships across a global business that incorporates the Disney Stores from across the world, the Disney Parks and Disney’s major licensing partners. Site Merchandising Supporting the E-Commerce Merchandising team with planning, trading and optimising the online stores, you will help deliver engaging customer experiences across the Disney Store. You will support product launches by preparing product data and categorisation, build and schedule site content, and assist the Site Coordination team in delivering key campaigns and homepage updates. You will also maintain trading and planning documents, support day-to-day administration, and collaborate with Buying, Creative and other cross-functional teams. Through this role, you will gain hands-on experience in digital merchandising. Working in any of these remits will provide a phenomenal springboard for your future career. This is an office-based internship. 4 days working in the Hammersmith, London office with 1 day working from home (Monday or Friday). Eligibility Important: Please upload your CV and cover letter as a single document, as only one file can be submitted. Applications without a cover letter will not be considered. Must be a second-year undergraduate student on a placement year course returning to study in Autumn 2028 Must have the right to work in the UK already in place Available to start working full time from June 2027 Interested in the area you are applying for, whether this is through your studies, experiences, extracurricular activities or a general interest About you A strong curiosity in Buying, Licensing, E-Commerce, Retail or Consumer Products Attention to detail and the ability to work well under pressure Ability to connect with people at all levels in a professional and mature manner Ability to prioritise tasks, meet deadlines and undertake various administrative duties Strong MS Office skills The Perks Develop your workplace skills and experience to help build the foundations of your future career Constructive on-the-job training as well as companywide learning and development initiatives Learn how decisions and actions are made within a global business environment Tackle real responsibility and become an essential part of an encouraging team Have the support and network of a large community of interns Access to join and support our Employee Resource Groups ranging from WOMEN @ Disney, Disney MOSAIC, Disney PRIDE, our disability & neurodiversity focused group - ENABLED, and our Mental Health & Wellbeing Group – TRUST Annual salary of £28,000 with 25 days’ holiday (plus bank holidays) Contractually enrolled into Disney’s workplace pension scheme Discounts & Perks: You are entitled to discounts on designated Disney products, resort food & beverage and ticketing Access to free support services including Unmind, the mental wellbeing app Opportunity to select eye care and flu vouchers Interested? Before applying, we would strongly encourage you to read our hints and tips here: https://disneycasting.net/kenexa/profintern/Candidate_Hints_and_Tips.pdf so you can set yourself up for success and learn about the recruitment process. You will need to apply with your CV and cover letter via the link on this page. Please combine your CV and cover letter into one document (with your cover letter following your CV) and upload it when prompted to submit your resume. Please note, applications without a cover letter will not be considered. For your cover letter we will be looking for approximately 400 words and looking to understand the following areas: Why have you chosen Disney? Why have you chosen this internship? Why should Disney consider you for this internship? This deadline for applications is midnight 27th October 2026. Please only apply for one Internship across The Walt Disney Company. By applying for this opportunity, you may be considered for other roles that align with your interests and skillset. Once we have received your application, we will be in contact within 14 days to let you know more about the blended online assessment. The Walt Disney Company is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We strive to be a diverse workforce that is representative of our audiences, and where all can thrive and belong. Disney is committed to forming a team that includes and respects a variety of voices, identities, backgrounds, experiences and perspectives. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided the necessary accommodations to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive all benefits of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation. Disclaimer This position is with The Walt Disney Company Limited, which is part of a business we call The Walt Disney Company (EMEA). To learn more about Disney's guidelines on the use of AI for candidates, click here. The Walt Disney Company Limited is an equal opportunity employer. Applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, race, colour, religion or belief, sex, nationality, ethnic or national origin, sexual orientation, gender reassignment, marital or civil partner status, disability or pregnancy or maternity. Disney fosters a business culture where ideas and decisions from all people help us grow, innovate, create the best stories and be relevant in a rapidly changing world. Having technical issues? View the FAQs for help. Apply Now Save Job About The Walt Disney Company: The Walt Disney Company, together with its subsidiaries and affiliates, is a leading diversified international family entertainment and media enterprise that includes three core business segments: Disney Entertainment, ESPN, and Disney Experiences. From humble beginnings as a cartoon studio in the 1920s to its preeminent name in the entertainment industry today, Disney proudly continues its legacy of creating world-class stories and experiences for every member of the family. Disney’s stories, characters and experiences reach consumers and guests from every corner of the globe. With operations in more than 40 countries, our employees and cast members work together to create entertainment experiences that are both universally and locally cherished. job.description: Keywords Location Search Jobs Assistant Sales Studio Distribution Job ID 10161317 Location Madrid, Spain Business The Walt Disney Company (EMEA) Date posted Oct. 21, 2026 Assistant Sales Studio Distribution Apply Now Save Job SHARE Facebook LinkedIn Email WhatsApp Links open in new tabs. Job Summary: Job Requirements About the Role & Team As Assistant, Sales, Studio Distribution, you’ll provide broad administrative and coordination support to the Studio Distribution team during a busy period. Working with colleagues across Sales, Marketing, PR, Dubbing and Technical Operations, you’ll help manage reporting, events, stakeholder communication and a variety of day-to-day requests connected with theatrical releases. You’ll join a team grounded in our Disney values — acting with Integrity, welcoming everyone through Inclusion, embracing boundless Creativity, working together through Collaboration and caring deeply for our Community. These values shape how we work and how we support one another every day. This role will be based in our Madrid office, four days a week, with either Monday or Friday working from home. This is a fixed-term contract providing temporary team cover, expected to run from approximately mid-November 2026 until 25 February 2027. What You Will Do Support the coordination of internal, external and special screenings, including room bookings, internal approval requests, invitations, external security coordination, attendance tracking, attendee follow-up and reporting to global teams Support the preparation of monthly, quarterly and annual reports and presentations on line-of-business and competitor results, title performance, and local and global market performance Support the preparation and maintenance of quarterly non-theatrical exhibition data and related invoicing information Help communicate with exhibitors, producers and suppliers, including sharing terms and conditions with new clients or existing clients whose terms have changed, and following up on other stakeholder requests Help maintain up-to-date line-of-business contract information Support the organization of cinema events with other lines of business, including venue bookings, third-party invitations, catering, proposals, purchase orders and invoices, in line with accounting processes Help update official line-up content across relevant websites in Spain and Portugal Provide general administrative and logistical support to the team, including travel arrangements, expense reports, scheduling meetings with exhibitors, researching information, following up on approvals and helping resolve ad-hoc requests Required Qualifications & Skills Experience in a multi-function business support role within administration, coordination, events, logistics or a similar support environment Fluency in Spanish and sufficient level of spoken and written English to communicate effectively by email with regional and international colleagues Able to organise day-to-day tasks, find information independently and complete straightforward requests with limited supervision Confidence using Microsoft Office, particularly Outlook and Excel; with experience preparing reports or presentations Attention to detail and high level of accuracy in data handling, reporting and contract/invoicing information A practical problem-solver who can research information, follow up on requests and work with increasing independence Proactive, effective problem-solver with the ability to work efficiently in a multi-function role A collaborative team player who can communicate confidently with a range of internal and external contacts Flexible, adaptable and comfortable managing changing priorities and varied ad-hoc requests Familiarity with SAP or similar business systems would be an advantage The Walt Disney Company is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We strive to be a diverse workforce that is representative of our audiences, and where all can thrive and belong. Disney is committed to forming a team that includes and respects a variety of voices, identities, backgrounds, experiences and perspectives. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation. Disclaimer This position is with TWDC Iberia S.L, which is part of a business we call The Walt Disney Company (EMEA). job.title: Stage - Coach Sportif (F/H/NB)
job.description: Keywords Location Search Jobs Stage - Coach Sportif (F/H/NB) Job ID 10163005 Location Marne-la-Vallée, France Business Disneyland Paris Date posted Oct. 21, 2026 Stage - Coach Sportif (F/H/NB) Apply Now Save Job SHARE Facebook LinkedIn Email WhatsApp Links open in new tabs. Job Summary: Job Requirements Ensemble, cultivons l’art de faire rêver pour donner vie à la magie. À Disneyland Paris, chaque expérience est une opportunité d’apprendre et de se développer. Rejoindre nos équipes, c’est contribuer à des projets concrets dans un environnement dynamique et formateur pour votre carrière. C’est aussi grandir aux côtés de professionnel(le)s passionné(e)s et animé(e)s par l’esprit d’équipe. Vous êtes à la recherche d’un stage à partir de janvier 2027, et vous souhaitez l’effectuer au sein de Disneyland Paris ? Le spectacle vivant est au cœur des activités quotidiennes de Disneyland® Paris, que ce soit sur les parcs, le Disney Village ou encore les hôtels et leurs centres de convention. La Direction opérationnelle des scènes et théâtres propose un programme sportif de maintien en condition physique et de bien-être destiné aux artistes interprètes, artistes de complément, et photographes qui créent chaque jour la magie auprès de nos visiteurs. Vos missions · Vous prenez part à l' élaboration des programmes sportifs de remise en forme et de mise à niveau · Vous participez à l'encadrement des séances d'échauffements · Vous contribuez au suivi quotidien des équipes · Vous développez vos compétences techniques d'encadrement et de production par la mise en place d'un parcours interne spécifique · Vous collaborez à toutes les phases d'un projet de création et de production d'un spectacle et/ou d'une parade Work Experience · Vous préparez une formation BPJEPS AF ou vous êtes en Master Métier de la forme , et vous êtes à la recherche d’un stage de fin d’étude à partir du janvier pour une période de 3 à 6 mois · Vous avez des connaissances en activités sportives , et éventuellement dans le domaine du spectacle, de la danse et/ou du cirque · Vous êtes reconnu(e) pour votre bienveillance et votre écoute active , vous savez vous adapter à votre interlocuteur et faire preuve de pédagogie · Vous parlez français couramment (C1) et vous avez un niveau intermédiaire en anglais (B1) , la pratique d’ une troisième langue européenne est un plus · Vous êtes conscient qu’une flexibilité horaire est nécessaire pour ce métier : travail en semaine et le weekend , de 7h à 17h · Vous êtes à l’aise pour prendre la parole en public ou souhaitez développer cette compétence Benefits Un logement à proximité de nos parcs (sous conditions) Le remboursement de 100% des abonnements pour les transports domicile–travail Une offre diversifiée de restauration d’entreprise et une subvention allouée Des soirées et événements exclusifs, formations, conciergerie et comité d’entreprise, aide à la parentalité, complémentaire santé… Des réductions tarifaires dans les boutiques, restaurants et hôtels Disney Des accès aux parcs pour vous et vos job.description: Keywords Location Search Jobs Sr Product Mgr II- Commerce, Subscriber Growth & Monetization Job ID 10150028 Location San Francisco, California, United States / Santa Monica, California, United States / Glendale, California, United States / New York, New York, United States Business Disney Entertainment and ESPN Product & Technology Date posted Oct. 11, 2026 Sr Product Mgr II- Commerce, Subscriber Growth & Monetization Apply Now Save Job SHARE Facebook LinkedIn Email WhatsApp Links open in new tabs. Job Summary: Technology is at the heart of Disney’s past, present, and future. Disney Entertainment and ESPN Product & Technology is a global organization of engineers, product developers, designers, technologists, data scientists, and more – all working to build and advance the technological backbone for Disney’s media business globally. The team marries technology with creativity to build world-class products, enhance storytelling, and drive velocity, innovation, and scalability for our businesses. We are Storytellers and Innovators. Creators and Builders. Entertainers and Engineers. We work with every part of The Walt Disney Company’s media portfolio to advance the technological foundation and consumer media touch points serving millions of people around the world. Here are a few reasons why we think you’d love working here: Building the future of Disney’s media: Our Technologists are designing and building the products and platforms that will power our media, advertising, and distribution businesses for years to come. Reach, Scale & Impact: More than ever, Disney’s technology and products serve as a signature doorway for fans' connections with the company’s brands and stories. Disney+. Hulu. ESPN. ABC. ABC News…and many more. These products and brands – and the unmatched stories, storytellers, and events they carry – matter to millions of people globally. Innovation: We develop and implement groundbreaking products and techniques that shape industry norms, and solve complex and distinctive technical problems. Product Management is responsible for driving the overall user experience, feature strategies and concepts, and engagement paradigms for Disney Entertainment & ESPN's global portfolio of consumer-facing streaming and digital products – including Disney+, Hulu, ESPN, ABC, ABC News, Nat Geo, Marvel, and Star Wars. We’re looking for a Commerce & Growth Product Manager to drive impact across our most critical user and revenue surfaces — including acquisition, engagement, and retention. This is a high-visibility, high-velocity role designed for a PM who thrives in dynamic environments, can quickly ramp into new problem spaces, and consistently delivers measurable results. You’ll rotate through time-sensitive, high-priority initiatives across different product areas, partnering closely with engineering, design, data, marketing, and business teams. This role offers broad exposure to multiple growth levers and commerce systems, making it ideal for a PM who wants to deepen platform expertise while building a strong track record of business impact. What You’ll Do Own end-to-end product strategy and execution across commerce and growth initiatives, from discovery through launch and iteration. Drive impact across key surfaces including: ○ Acquisition (onboarding flows, landing experiences, conversion funnels) ○ Engagement (feature adoption, lifecycle experiences, experimentation) ○ Retention & Monetization (subscriptions, pricing, paywalls, incentives, lifecycle optimization) Rapidly ramp into new domains and deliver impact on time-sensitive, high-priority projects. Identify opportunities using qualitative research, data analysis, and experimentation. Define success metrics, design experiments (A/B tests, cohort analyses), and iterate based on results. Collaborate cross-functionally with engineering, design, data science, marketing, and operations. Balance short-term wins with long-term platform scalability and technical health. Communicate product vision, strategy, trade-offs, and results clearly to stakeholders and leadership. Who You Are 7+ years of product management experience , including experience building and shipping consumer products at scale. Proven experience working on growth, commerce, or monetization initiatives with measurable impact. Strong understanding of acquisition funnels, monetization, retention drivers, and lifecycle optimization. Comfortable working with experimentation frameworks and data-driven decision-making. Ability to quickly absorb platform architecture and constraints while maintaining deep empathy for users. Skilled at balancing business goals, user experience, and technical considerations. Thrives in ambiguous environments and can prioritize effectively under time constraints. Clear, concise communicator with strong stakeholder management skills. What Makes This Role Unique Rotational, high-impact projects : Work on urgent, strategic initiatives across multiple product areas. Broad surface area exposure : Gain hands-on experience across acquisition, engagement, retention, and monetization. Platform + User Depth : Develop a strong understanding of underlying systems while shaping end-to-end user experiences. Accelerated Growth : Ideal for PMs who want to expand their scope, sharpen execution skills, and build a diverse portfolio of impact. Preferred Qualifications Experience with subscription businesses, growth, and monetization. Experience leading cross-functional initiatives that required influencing without direct authority. Experience in experimentation and track record of driving impact. Experience working in fast-paced, high-growth environments. Demonstrates the ability to translate ML/AI capabilities into measurable growth outcomes across acquisition, engagement, retention, and monetization Strong understanding of model constraints, algorithms, and iteration cycles, with the ability to apply this knowledge to real product and user experience decisions Proven track record of partnering closely with ML engineering, data science, and cross-functional teams to ship scalable, production-ready solutions Data-driven mindset with hands-on experience in experimentation (A/B testing, cohort analysis) and defining success metrics to optimize performance Success in This Role Looks Like Delivering measurable improvements in conversion, retention, or revenue. Successfully ramping into new domains within weeks and shipping impactful improvements. Building strong cross-functional trust and momentum. Leaving each surface stronger, more scalable, and more user-centered than you found it. Required Education A bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, statistics, business, media or a related field. #Disneytech The hiring range for this position in San Francisco, CA $173,100.00 - $232,100.00 per year and in Glendale, CA and Santa Monica, CA is $158,100.00 - $211,900.00 per year and in New York is $165,600.00 - $222,000.00 per year. The base pay actually offered will take into account internal equity and also may vary depending on the candidate’s geographic region, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience among other factors. A bonus and/or long-term incentive units may be provided as part of the compensation package, in addition to the full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits, dependent on the level and position offered. job.description: Keywords Location Search Jobs Social Media Specialist II - College Networks Job ID 10163019 Location Bristol, Connecticut, United States Business ESPN Date posted Oct. 20, 2026 Social Media Specialist II - College Networks Apply Now Save Job SHARE Facebook LinkedIn Email WhatsApp Links open in new tabs. Job Summary: Job Requirements ESPN is seeking a Social Media Specialist II to discover, produce, and distribute a high volume of content across SEC Network and ACC Network social media platforms in addition to other brand accounts in the ESPN ecosystem. The Social Media Specialist II will have an emphasis on (but not limited to) college sports -- primarily football, M/W basketball, volleyball, softball, and baseball. An ideal candidate thrives in a team environment with a flexible work schedule and must have a passion and knowledge of college sports. The candidate should have extensive experience with optimizing social-first video, creating static graphics and writing social copy under pressure in a live window setting. A Social Media Specialist II will be responsible for composing comprehensive plans around event coverage and reports in support of college sports and collaborating across multiple teams to lead successful projects from start to finish. The Social Media Specialist II will report to the Social Media Manager. Responsibilities: Create socially optimized content for the following platforms: Instagram, X, TikTok, and Facebook Help manage content planning and strategy for our SEC Network and ACC Network brand pages Stay up to date on news and updates for both the SEC and ACC Collaborate with multiple internal partners to make social content compelling and comprehensive to a broad audience Edit and approve social posts for journalistic accuracy, audience relevance, and tone, including real-time decision-making at various stages of content development Maintain proficiency and knowledge in all the latest social media trends and best practices Analyze performance of social content and incorporate insights into future content decisions Lead on priority events and organize teammates to successfully cover key sports and championships Sports happen during nights, weekends, and holidays and those shifts will be regular and required in this position Required Qualifications: A minimum of 2 years’ experience working in a fast-paced social media environment with content creation responsibilities or relevant experience A minimum of 2 years’ experience using video editing software (e.g., Final Cut, Premiere) A minimum of 2 years’ experience using photo editing software (e.g., Photoshop, InDesign) Skilled in social media comprehension and execution across multiple social media platforms including X, Facebook, TikTok, and Instagram Possess excellent news judgement and verbal/written communication skills Strong understanding of journalistic standards Ability to work quickly and juggle multiple tasks during a typical workday Ability to analyze and apply data to decision-making Appreciation and understanding of pop culture that contributes to content creation Knowledge of current sports, including teams, players, and storylines Preferred Qualifications: Strong knowledge of college sports, specifically for SEC and ACC Demonstrated news judgement Experience using video editing software (e.g., Final Cut, Premiere) Previous brand voice and social account management Advanced knowledge of the latest social media and tech trends Required Education: Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in Journalism, Communications, Media, or related field Additional Information: Must be comfortable working weekends and nights #ESPNMedia Disclaimer PAY TRANSPARENCY The hiring range for this position in Bristol, CT is $78,700 to $108,100 per year based on a 40-hour work week. The amount of hours scheduled per week may vary based on business needs. A bonus and/or long-term incentive units may be provided as part of the compensation package, in addition to the full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits, dependent on the level and position offered.
