job.title: Sr Director, Programming Business Affairs
job.description: Keywords Location Search Jobs Sr Director, Programming Business Affairs Job ID 10156050 Location Bristol, Connecticut, United States / New York, New York, United States Business ESPN Date posted Oct. 11, 2026 Sr Director, Programming Business Affairs Apply Now Save Job SHARE Facebook LinkedIn Email WhatsApp Links open in new tabs. Job Summary: The Senior Director, Programming Business Affairs is a critical leadership role responsible for overseeing all aspects of sports rights acquisition, content licensing, contract administration, and rights management across ESPN and The Walt Disney Company (TWDC). Serving as a strategic partner to Programming, Legal, Ad Sales, Distribution, Business Development, and Finance, this executive will lead negotiations for key sports properties, ensure contractual compliance and execution, and maximize the value of content rights across linear, digital, streaming, direct-to-consumer, and emerging distribution platforms. This leader will act as the primary business affairs liaison for league and rights-holder partners, balancing sophisticated deal-making, relationship management, and operational excellence. The role requires a deep understanding of the evolving sports media landscape, media rights economics, and the strategic opportunities that drive audience growth, distribution expansion, and long-term business value. Key Responsibilities Sports Rights Acquisition & Negotiation Lead strategic preparation for major media rights renewals by organizing historical agreements, evaluating contractual obligations, identifying business opportunities, and coordinating enterprise-wide negotiation readiness. Lead and support negotiations for high-profile sports rights agreements, renewals, amendments, and strategic partnerships. Partner closely with senior Programming, Legal, Distribution, Ad Sales, Direct-to-Consumer, and Business Development leaders to maximize the value and flexibility of acquired rights. Evaluate new rights opportunities and emerging market trends, developing recommendations that support ESPN and TWDC's broader content strategy. Serve as a trusted advisor during complex negotiations, balancing business objectives, contractual protections, and partner relationships. Strategic Business Affairs Leadership Act as the central point of contact for league partners and rights holders on all business affairs matters. Provide strategic guidance and risk assessment on contractual issues, identifying solutions that align with both business priorities and legal requirements. Collaborate with executive leadership to develop scalable processes, governance structures, and best practices that support business growth and operational efficiency. Ensure alignment between contractual obligations and evolving distribution, monetization, and content strategies across the enterprise. Content Rights Management & Compliance Lead the Content Rights Management function, ensuring accurate interpretation, documentation, and administration of contractual rights across multiple platforms and businesses. Oversee the creation and maintenance of rights summaries, contract analyses, reporting frameworks, and compliance processes. Establish and maintain enterprise-wide standards, systems, and procedures that ensure contractual obligations are fulfilled, rights are fully leveraged, and cross-functional business initiatives remain compliant across ESPN and TWDC. Identify opportunities to optimize content utilization and unlock additional value from existing rights portfolios. Cross-Functional Partnership Partner with Programming leadership, including senior executives responsible for content strategy, to support long-term content planning and rights portfolio management. Work closely with Disney Platform Distribution, Disney Advertising Sales, ESPN Direct-to-Consumer, Finance, Strategy, and Legal teams to ensure coordinated execution of enterprise priorities. Build strong internal alignment around key rights decisions and associated business implications. Job Summary: Job Requirements The Supervisor, Production Operations will supervise a team of technical operators working on live events utilizing a Remote Integration (REMI) production model. The Supervisor will be responsible for the planning, support and execution of all operational requirements of all live event productions executed in a REMI production model. They will assume oversight and lead teams across various business units to ensure success of all assigned production units, to include special productions and special projects as assigned. They are responsible for understanding complex technical workflows within a fixed facility as well as interconnectivity with remote equipment and sites. They will be expected to develop and implement processes and workflows that drive efficiency in workflows, operation and cost. They will be expected to coordinate troubleshooting efforts with workflows or equipment and communicate with teams across ESPN, Disney and external clients and partners to fix and troubleshoot technical issues. The Supervisor will build relationships within Production Operations and across ESPN and Disney. Partnering with key shareholders and departments including but not limited to Production Operations, Content Production, Directing, Creative Studio and Engineering, they will drive collaboration, development and problem solving to best support each production and the business. A skilled leader, they are expected to create and lead development and training initiatives, evaluate performance and conduct quarterly reviews, partner in the management and scheduling of personnel and facility resources, plan and manage personnel crewing for productions, resolve employee conflicts, communicate efficiently and accurately, hire exceptional talent, enforce departmental SOP’s and company policies as well as support ESPN and Disney initiatives. Responsibilities: Supervise daily business, operational and technical support of team and department. Responsible for the technical and operational planning, execution and support of all live event productions executed in a non-traditional production model. Provides expert operational support to Production Operations and partners. In-depth understanding of the workflows and equipment associated with production control rooms, mobile units, and remote productions. Including but not limited to broadcast communication equipment, replay servers, graphics engines, telestration systems, all-in-one production units, signal conversion and video router infrastructure. Advanced understanding of remote production and mobile unit workflows and equipment. Set priorities for and coach team members to ensure deadlines and operational readiness are met. Impacts the quality, efficiency and effectiveness of own team and its contributions to the larger organization. Uses judgment to identify and resolve day-to-day technical and operational problems. Uses tact and diplomacy to exchange information and handle sensitive issues. Applies understanding of how the team relates to other closely associated areas in order to improve efficiency of the team. Required to remain current in their respective technical areas of responsibility as well as expand knowledge for support and coverage of other functional areas. Responsible for teaming with production management to meet the business and programming requirements, working closely to schedule, troubleshoot, and monitor the physical facilities and staff assignments. Requires full understanding and application of procedures and concepts within own specialty and basic knowledge of other specialties. Responsible for developing quality control initiatives and supporting efficiency in operations. Evaluate the performance of all assigned employees, conduct quarterly performance assessment and administer annual reviews for assigned staff members. Make recommendations regarding corrective measures and adjust the personnel and facility schedules to satisfy changing programming demands while maintaining maximum efficiency and flexibility. May be asked to supervise the implementation, installation and integration of new equipment and workflows. Implement training programs to improve efficiency and competency of the operating staff. Ensure adherence of all departmental SOP’s and company policies and initiatives. Lead operational triaging and documentation for issues affecting the on-air operation. Interface with applicable Programming and/or Production representatives in the advance planning stages to ensure the efficient provision of facilities and personnel to achieve desired results. Assists in developing and implementing the most efficient and effective workflows using existing systems and technologies. Contributes to the planning and integration of operational hardware while shaping workflows to ensure efficient and smooth operations Maintains an awareness of technical developments and trends in the industry. Keeps apprised of new technology and recommends appropriate solutions to the studio and remote based departments. Work with crews and staffing through late night shifts, weekends, and holidays. Performs a variety of tasks and special projects as needed. Any other duties needed to help achieve business objectives Qualifications: Minimum of 10 years practical Content Production or related experience at the regional to large market or network level. Knowledge of all Broadcast Production equipment and technology within assigned operating areas. Knowledge of the workflows and equipment associated with broadcast studios and control rooms, including audio consoles, video switchers, cameras, routers, servers, UDCs, tie lines, etc. Must demonstrate ability to perform and lead tasks under tight deadlines, work independently and lead simultaneous projects. Deep understanding of workflow in other business units, including their impact and/or specific integration with Production Operations. Organizational, efficiency and planning skills are required. Must be willing and able to adapt to a constantly changing environment. High functioning computer background (Microsoft 365, Smartsheet, JIRA, Confluence, etc...) Problem solves and troubleshoots using effective communication to best convey any issues needing resolution. Seeks out and participates in training programs, (physical, classroom, virtual, etc.) for self-career development and/or regarding any relevant equipment and workflow changes within the operation Effective communication skills. Flexibility to alter shifts/days off and work overtime to accommodate projects and departmental goals including the ability to work nights and weekends. Preferred Qualifications: Has in-depth understanding/background in Production Operations job roles in Studio, PCR, Network Control, and Editing. Proficient in business protocol and procurement techniques, as well as in-depth research and development in specified areas of expertise. Bi-lingual (English/Spanish) Required Education: High School Diploma or equivalent. Preferred Education: Bachelor's Degree or Technical School degree in communications, electronics, television production or related field. Additional Information: (i.e. physical requirements, holiday, nights, weekend shifts, etc.) Must be able to work nights, holidays and weekends. #ESPNMedia Disclaimer PAY TRANSPARENCY The hiring range for this position in Bristol, CT is $106,600 to $143,000 per year. job.title: Remote Coordinator
job.description:
FOX News Media is looking for a Remote Coordinator for our Resource Operations Center (ROC). The ROC is the heart of FOX News Media’s technical operations where all inbound and outbound audio and video signals are processed. The Remote Coordinator will connect IFBs, establish production bridges, troubleshoot with vendor studios / field crews, quality control all live shots, and book / change transmits between different remote studios. The Remote Coordinator should have a strong understanding of IFB signal flow, studio equipment, and transmission paths. You are consistently multi-tasking, troubleshooting, and communicating between departments to ensure all parties are aware of any technical issues. You are a team player who enjoys solving problems and helping others work through complex technical issues in a constantly evolving breaking news environment.

You will be offered one of the following shifts:

  • Tuesday to Saturday (1pm-9pm / 8-hour shift)
  • Wednesday to Saturday (11am-9pm / 10-hour shift)

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Quickly and effectively troubleshoot live audio/video feeds in order to get them on air in a constantly evolving breaking news environment
  • Work directly with control rooms to ensure live guests in studio are ready for air as well as coordinate and troubleshoot with other departments to ensure reporters/guests make it to air in a deadline driven environment
  • Book transmit lines between studios and effectively communicate any changes to the proper departments

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • Strong understanding of Satellite / Fiber / IP / Cellular transmissions
  • Solid understanding of IFB and studio equipment
  • In-depth knowledge of coordinating transmission lines between studios
  • Excellent communication and organizational abilities
  • Proven capability to work effectively both independently and collaboratively within a team
  • Ability to multi-task in high-pressure situations
  • Willingness to work occasional

job.title: Digital Art Director, Visual Innovation Studio (Motion Designer)
job.description:
Within FOX Entertainment’s Creative Advertising Group sits the Visual Innovation Studio (aka VIS). The VIS team is FOX Entertainment’s in-house design agency – combining the disciplines of design, animation, illustration, and photography to craft bespoke visuals for FOX’s marketing efforts.

The Digital Art Director at FOX Entertainment will have mastery of Art Direction, 2D & 3D Animation, and Traditional Design with the know-how and skillset to develop engaging digital content and experiences. This position will be expected to contribute conceptually, creatively, and technically while executing high-impact marketing initiatives with A+ quality for the digital and social media landscape. 

The Digital Art Director will be working on the VIS Digital Team with other creatives and designers to help build FOX show brands through campaign-level thinking and tactical executions across all social media and digital platforms. You will also have a deep knowledge and interest in the best practices and nuances of social platforms including Instagram, Facebook, X (formerly Twitter), Snapchat, TikTok, and emerging platforms, as well as producing engaging content in different formats, including static images, video animations, motion graphics, AR filters and more. You are proactive, hands-on, detail-oriented, and able to own projects from ideation through to execution.

Regular, on-site attendance at the workplace for a minimum of four (4) days per week is an essential function of the position. The selected candidate must be able to reliably meet this requirement.


A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Collaborate with Creative Directors and team members to conceptualize and execute top-tier creative content, leveraging digital and social media best practices, including video editing, eye-catching motion graphics, and sound design, to craft visually arresting digital content
  • Create storyboards, comps, animation, visual effects, photo-retouching, and image enhancements that meet or exceed strategic objectives
  • Produce animated motion graphics, titles, text, and infographics that captivate and inspire
  • Seamlessly coordinating with Project Managers to align on timelines and deliverables, ensuring flawless execution from conception to completion
  • Develop branding/design systems for FOX’s owned and operated Social Media verticals, fostering cross-platform cohesion and brand integrity

 
WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • Proficiency in Adobe Cloud with a focus on After Effects, Photoshop, and Illustrator
  • In-depth knowledge of digital ad products and placements, enabling the creation of channel-specific visuals that embody platform best practices
  • Critical eye for visual details such as color, typography, and composition
  • Highly organized and positive with a self-sufficient mentality
  • Highly collaborative and able to maintain creative excellence in a fast-paced, ever-changing landscape
  • Capability to work and transition seamlessly from projects across different media (social media, motion graphics, and static work)

NICE TO HAVE BUT NOT A DEALBREAKER

  • Knowledge of 3D Design within Cinema 4D or Blender

Position Summary

The Producer, Local Media Game Production, will work with the Local Game Production Supervisor, Game Production Lead, internal production teams, and local broadcast partners to plan, coordinate, and support the execution of live NBA game broadcasts and related programming. This role supports all phases of production, including pre-production planning, live game execution, and post-production activities, while helping ensure creative, editorial, technical, and operational excellence. Working in conjunction with the onsite NBA teams’ Producers/Directors and game production teams, the Producer provides production and editorial support for assigned NBA broadcasts and helps ensure the onsite team has the content, resources, information, and production assets necessary for successful game coverage. Reporting to the Game Production Lead, this role works closely with the Local Game Production Supervisor to coordinate game coverage and production support across assigned broadcasts.

Coordinate production planning with the Local Game Production Supervisor and work in conjunction with the onsite ATL Producer/Director team to support assigned broadcasts. Collaborate with internal and external partners on graphics, programming, advertising integration and trafficking, engineering, broadcast operations, and other production requirements. Support live game coverage for assigned broadcasts, working closely with the onsite ATL Producer/Director team to help ensure productions meet established creative, editorial, technical, and operational standards. Coordinate editorial direction and content needs with the Local Game Production Supervisor, onsite ATL Producer/Director, and other production personnel supporting assigned broadcasts. Ensure onsite production teams have the resources, content, information, and production assets necessary for successful broadcasts. Provide game production and editorial support during assigned NBA broadcasts, partnering with the onsite ATL Producer/Director and production personnel throughout game-day execution. Liaise with contracted and third-party vendors as needed to coordinate services, deliverables, production expectations, and issue resolution. Partner with Local Media leadership to identify and implement longer-term enhancements to live game productions. job.title: Associate Counsel / Counsel, Corporate Legal Affairs
job.description:
NBCUniversal is one of the world's leading media and entertainment companies. We create world-class content, which we distribute across our portfolio of film, television, and streaming, and bring to life through our global theme park destinations, consumer products, and experiences. We own and operate leading entertainment and news brands, including NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo, and Peacock, our premium ad-supported streaming service. We produce and distribute premier filmed entertainment and programming through our powerhouse film and television studios, including Universal Pictures, DreamWorks Animation, and Focus Features, and the four global television studios under the Universal Studio Group banner, and operate industry-leading theme parks and experiences around the world through Universal Destinations & Experiences, including Universal Orlando Resort, home to Universal Epic Universe, and Universal Studios Hollywood. NBCUniversal is a subsidiary of Comcast Corporation. Visit www.nbcuniversal.com for more information.

Our impact is rooted in improving the communities where our employees, customers, and audiences live and work. We have a rich tradition of giving back and ensuring our employees have the opportunity to serve their communities. We champion an inclusive culture and strive to attract and develop a talented workforce to create and deliver a wide range of content reflecting our world.

Role Purpose:

This position will provide legal support for a broad range of commercial transactions spanning the full spectrum of corporate functions and cross-business-unit initiatives of a global media and entertainment company. This attorney will independently draft, review, and negotiate a variety of commercial agreements and provide practical, business-oriented legal advice on related matters.

The role will involve supporting strategic procurement initiatives and transactions with a variety of vendors and innovative companies that provide cutting-edge solutions using emerging technologies, including AI.

The position offers an opportunity to take ownership of diverse commercial matters, collaborate with business stakeholders and attorneys across NBCUniversal, and help shape the organization's approach to commercial contracting through the development of company policies, template agreements and legal processes.

Responsibilities:

  • Provide day-to-day legal support for enterprise-wide corporate functions, such as NBCUniversal’s Finance, Human Resources, Talent Acquisition, Environmental Health and Safety, Facilities and Corporate Social Responsibility teams.
  • Independently draft, review, negotiate, and interpret a wide range of agreements, including SAAS licenses, professional service, research, equipment purchase and other commercial agreements supporting business units across NBCUniversal.
  • Negotiate and counsel clients regarding emerging issues in technology transactions, including AI.
  • Provide practical, business-oriented legal advice to stakeholders, identifying potential risks and developing creative, effective solutions that support business objectives.
  • Partner with executives and colleagues across NBCUniversal including cross-functional  subject matter experts such as the Privacy and Information Security teams.
  • Help develop and implement organization-wide best practices and processes, including creation and maintenance of contract templates, corporate policies and other resources to promote efficient and consistent approaches to commercial transactions.

Basic Requirements:

  • Member of the New York Bar.
  • JD or LLM degree from an accredited law school.
  • 1 to 3 years of experience for Associate Counsel and 4+ years for Counsel of relevant practicing attorney legal experience.
  • Interested candidates must submit a resume to be considered.
  • Must have unrestricted authorization to work in the United States.
  • Must be willing to work in New York, NY.

Desired Characteristics

  • Outstanding analytical, drafting, negotiation and communication skills.
  • Comfort explaining complex legal concepts and providing practical legal advice to business team members at all levels.
  • Strong organizational skills, ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines across a diverse range of subject matters and clients.
  • Interest in evolving legal and commercial issues across a global media and entertainment company.
  • Collaborative approach to partnering with business stakeholders and legal colleagues.

Hybrid: This position currently has a hybrid schedule, which requires contributing from the New York, NY office a minimum of four days per week. The Company reserves the right to change in-office requirements at any time. 

This position is eligible for company sponsored benefits, including medical, dental and vision insurance, 401(k), paid leave, tuition reimbursement, and a variety of other discounts and perks. Learn more about the benefits offered by NBCUniversal by visiting the Benefits page of the Careers website.

NBCUniversal’s Ad Sales One Platform Ad Products team builds and operates the systems that power NBCUniversal’s $10B+ advertising business, including core ad serving, programmatic, and activation capabilities across CTV and digital.

Within AP&S, the Programmatic Demand team is responsible for product strategy and development of demand-side capabilities across NBCU’s programmatic ecosystem.

We are seeking a Senior Product Manager, Programmatic Demand to drive the evolution of how programmatic demand is optimized, scaled, and productized across NBCU’s streaming footprint.

Role Overview

This role focuses on developing scalable products, systems, and workflows that improve programmatic demand performance across NBCU’s ad tech stack.

You will identify inefficiencies in auction dynamics, platform behavior, and partner integrations—and translate those insights into durable product solutions rather than one-off optimizations.

A key focus area will be live event monetization, where concurrency, DSP behavior, and system constraints introduce complex demand-side challenges that require structured, product-led solutions.

Key Responsibilities

Auction Performance & Optimization Systems

  • Design and build scalable solutions (tools, workflows, automation) to analyze and optimize auction performance across bid rate, win rate, fill, pacing, and timeouts
  • Translate performance insights into productized capabilities (e.g., automated optimization frameworks, configuration layers, or decisioning logic)
  • Partner with Engineering to implement systems that continuously improve demand efficiency and revenue outcomes

Live Event Monetization (CTV Focus)

  • Identify performance gaps and system constraints in live event auctions (e.g., scaling limits, DSP throttling, timeout behavior)
  • Drive development of product solutions to increase stability, scalability, and performance in high-concurrency environments
  • Partner cross-functionally and externally to ensure platform and partner readiness for tentpole events

Platform Configuration & Deal Strategy

  • Define product-driven approaches to deal structure, configuration standards, and optimization across PG and PMP
  • Improve how platform settings (e.g., in FreeWheel and partner DSPs) translate into predictable demand performance
  • Productize best practices to reduce inefficiencies and variability in deal execution

Partner Integrations & Performance

  • Identify systemic partner performance issues and drive long-term solutions (vs. one-off fixes)
  • Inform product strategy based on partner capabilities, limitations, and evolving DSP behavior

Additional Responsibilities

  • Product Development & Testing: Own requirements and validation for demand optimization features and experiments
  • Cross-Functional Leadership: Align Product, Engineering, Ad Ops, Sales, and Strategy on priorities and outcomes
  • Issue Resolution: Lead root cause analysis and improve systems/processes to prevent recurring issues
  • Documentation & Enablement: Translate product functionality into clear internal guidance and GTM alignment
  • Market Insights: Monitor industry trends and inform product direction

Qualifications

  • Strong understanding of programmatic advertising ecosystems, including digital ad serving, measurement frameworks, identity signals, and privacy controls—and how these components work together to enable scalable, addressable advertising across CTV and digital environments
  • Experience implementing and validating measurement and data pipelines, with a focus on ensuring consistency and accuracy across platforms (e.g., bid requests, attribution, viewability, IVT, and delivery metrics)
  • Solid working knowledge of privacy regulations and industry signals (e.g., CCPA, GDPR, GPP, ATT, COPPA), and their implications for data usage, identity resolution, targeting, and measurement in a programmatic context
  • Experience understanding identity and user signals (e.g., device IDs, platform identifiers, consent signals) to enable privacy-compliant audience targeting and optimization
  • Proven ability to translate complex technical, business, and regulatory requirements into scalable, productized solutions - particularly within programmatic demand, auction dynamics, or partner integrations
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with experience diagnosing performance gaps, data discrepancies, and system inefficiencies, and driving root-cause resolution in production environments
  • Experience developing or leveraging automation and/or AI-driven approaches to monitor, validate, and improve the stability, quality, and performance of demand systems and measurement capabilities
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to operate effectively across Product, Engineering, Ad Ops, Sales, Strategy, and external partners to drive aligned outcomes
  • Demonstrated ability to operate in high-scalability, high-concurrency environments (e.g., CTV and live events), with a product mindset focused on building durable, system-level solutions rather than one-off fixes
  • Minimum of 3+ years of product management experience, preferably within digital advertising, ad tech, or data-driven platforms; experience in CTV, streaming, or programmatic demand strongly preferred

Our vision is to build a thriving entertainment ecosystem where stories and worlds are imagined, brought to life and experienced. We create for every age and audience, anchored by the strength of our content and experiences and the depth of our connection with fans. We are creator-first, audience-focused, tech-forward, globally scaled. Here, you’ll work with talented teams that move fast, think boldly and collaborate with purpose to deliver results. We aim high, champion the best ideas and win together, earning the trust of our employees, creators, partners and audiences every day. If you’re energized by the opportunity to help build the next-generation global media and entertainment company powered by creativity and technology, we’d be thrilled to welcome you aboard. Overview:

The Paramount Skydance Corporate Development Group is responsible for sourcing, evaluating, executing, and integrating/separating the company’s strategic acquisitions, divestitures, investments, and joint ventures. The Manager role will work with team members and senior leadership throughout the Paramount Skydance business units to assess and execute external transaction opportunities and internal business-building opportunities. The Group has a process that governs the organization’s M&A activities. Within that framework, the individual is expected to work and make decisions with some level of independence. For unresolved issues, the individual is expected to recommend a course of action for discussion. The individual will have the opportunity to develop close working relationships with key leaders at and beyond Paramount Skydance, and as such will need to exercise good judgment and quick thinking.  

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to: 

  • Collaborate with team members, senior management, business units, and outside advisors to identify and assess potential external transactions in the form of acquisitions, divestitures, joint ventures, minority investments, and business development opportunities

job.title: Director, Creative Music (Paramount Pics)
job.description:
#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?
We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, we’ve got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is… YOU! Becoming a part of Paramount means joining a team of passionate people who not only recognize the power of content but also enjoy a touch of fun and uniqueness. Together, we co-create moments that matter – both for our audiences and our employees – and aim to leave a positive mark on culture.

 

Overview:

The Director of Creative Music, Paramount Pictures serves as a key creative partner across Paramount Pictures’ theatrical slate, supporting filmmakers and creative leadership in the development and execution of music for feature films. Operating as an in-house music supervisor, this role oversees all creative music elements from early development through final delivery, ensuring that each film’s musical vision enhances storytelling and supports the filmmaker’s intent.   This position works closely with directors, producers, composers, artists, and internal studio partners to deliver high-quality, filmmaker-driven music for Paramount Pictures’ theatrical releases. This position is based at the historic Paramount Lot in Los Angeles.  

Responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Partner with directors, producers, and Paramount Pictures creative executives to shape and execute the musical vision for assigned theatrical films.
  • Engage in projects early in development to provide creative guidance on score, source music, and overall music strategy.
  • Serve as a trusted creative collaborator to filmmakers and talent throughout pre-production, production, and post-production.
  • Advocate for the filmmaker’s creative vision while ensuring alignment with Paramount Pictures’ production goals and creative standards.
  • Act as the in-house music supervisor for assigned Paramount Pictures theatrical films.
  • Oversee all creative music elements including score, source music, needle drops, themes, and temp music.
  • Supervise spotting sessions, music reviews, and creative discussions with filmmakers and post-production teams.
  • Ensure music choices support narrative, tone, and emotional impact.
  • Identify, recommend, and help secure composers and music collaborators in partnership with filmmakers.
  • Guide composers creatively throughout the scoring process, maintaining clear communication between creative and post-production teams.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with composers, artists, music editors, and scoring partners.
  • Oversee music workflows through production and post-production, including scoring schedules, recording sessions, and final mixes.
  • Attend scoring sessions, dubbing sessions, and final mixes as appropriate.
  • Ensure all music is creatively approved, delivered on time, and ready for theatrical release.
  • Collaborate with internal Paramount Pictures teams including Production, Post-Production, Creative Affairs, Legal, Business Affairs, Finance, and Marketing.
  • Partner with music clearance and licensing teams to balance creative ambition with budgetary and legal requirements.

Speed-to-market, throughput and SLA adherence

Stakeholder satisfaction and production's contribution to performance marketing results

Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.

Budget, agency and vendor management experience

job.description:
Title: Account Executive

Join The Alton Telegraph to help deliver impactful media campaigns for our customers, leveraging our rich history, extensive audience reach, best-in-class advertising solutions, and the power of cutting-edge AI tools!

Role Overview:  Hearst Newspapers is investing in its sales force, and we want you to be a part of it! We are looking for a digitally savvy, highly motivated Account Executive to join our advertising team at The Alton Telegraph. As an Account Executive, you will be responsible for developing and managing a sales pipeline and building new business relationships with local advertisers throughout the Alton area. You will work with your customers to promote compelling solutions that best fit their marketing needs. As an advocate for the customer within the Alton Telegraph, the role works in cooperation with other departments to ensure we can meet and exceed customer expectations both in performance and process. Hearst Newspapers operates on a hybrid work week schedule. 

The Alton Telegraph?

Our people make the difference! Our diverse team is filled with passionate individuals who want to win. We offer an upbeat and collaborative working environment where challenging the norm is encouraged. With ample opportunities to learn new skills and advance within the organization, our team members are given the tools to learn and grow their careers.

Leverage Advanced AI for Maximum Efficiency and Earnings
Imagine having a personal assistant that never sleeps. Our state-of-the-art AI tools, including ChatGPT Enterprise and Gong.io, streamline your workflow, enabling you to close deals faster and manage your pipeline more effectively. 

This means more time to focus on what you love and a direct boost to your earnings potential.

Exclusive Partnership with OpenAI
Through our strategic content partnership with OpenAI and our exclusive ChatGPT Enterprise license, we have unparalleled access to the latest advancements in AI technology. 

This partnership provides us—and you—with a massive competitive edge in the market, ensuring you have the most powerful tools at your disposal to drive sales and exceed targets.

Personalized AI Tutors for Seamless Onboarding
Your success starts from day one. With our personalized AI tutors, every question you have, and every training need you encounter is met with instant, tailored support. 

These AI-driven mentors ensure you learn and sell as quickly and efficiently as possible, empowering you to hit the ground running and achieve your goals faster.

What will you do?

  • Drive Success with Innovative Tools: Utilize our AI-powered software to enhance every stage of the sales cycle, from prospecting and planning to presenting and closing deals.

  • Lead Generation: Call on local small to medium sized businesses to show the value of our suite of digital media advertising products from social media, display, video, programmatic, SEO/SEM to traditional advertisements. You will generate new leads through cold calling, networking, and prospecting, as well as staying aware of any new businesses opening in the area. You will own the sales cycle and will have the support of your local account management team to aid in continued support after the sale!

  • Product Expertise: Become an expert on our digital and print products/services. The first three weeks of hire, you will be provided with both global and local training to be fully educated before even going out on your own! You will also have full support throughout your career which includes continual learning and training to grow and achieve success as an Account Executive. 

  • Execute sales tactics: Implementing marketing strategies, delivering effective sales presentations with passion to consistently earn, retain and increase revenue.

  • Advertising Solutions: Create engaging advertising solutions to solve clients’ business needs.

  • Client Solutions: Recommend new products and promotional opportunities to current clients and handle objections efficiently. Be a large part of the local business community and boosting your clients’ businesses through multiple digital media channels.

  • Forecasting: Manage client pipeline and monthly revenue forecast in Salesforce.com.

 

What will it take to be successful?

  • Purposeful: You are direct and get things done quickly, with confidence, integrity, and determination.

  • Adaptable: You react and adjust to changing conditions and come up with practical ideas to deal with them.

  • Driven: You have self-assurance and competitive drive, delivering high-quality, organized, and repeatable results.

  • Communicator: You are a lively and intelligent person with a stimulating influence on others.

  • Trend-Savvy: you will keep informed of industry developments to ensure our digital advertising strategies remain cutting-edge and effective.

 

What we’re looking for:

  • Education: BA/BS degree in Advertising, Marketing, or Communications a plus or equivalent experience.

  • Experience: 2+ years of business-to-business outside sales in advertising or media, with a proven success in new business acquisition and exceeding revenue goals.

  • Skills: Superior presentation, interpersonal, and communication skills. Technically savvy with experience in Salesforce, Excel, and PowerPoint.

  • Mindset: Goal-oriented, competitive, and forward-thinking with strong business and financial acumen.

 

What we offer:

  • Dynamic Environment: A great work environment where it's never boring.

  • Comprehensive Training: Paid in-depth sales and product training.

  • Competitive Compensation: Competitive base salary with uncapped commissions for unlimited earning potential.

  • Collaborative Culture: Ideas and input are always welcome.

  • Learn more about Hearst Newspapers at www.joinhnp.com

 

Our Benefits: At Hearst Newspapers we not only support our employees through personal and professional development, but we also believe in promoting each individual’s physical, financial and emotional wellbeing (and that of their family).  Our industry-leading benefits include:

  • Physical Wellbeing: Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage to keep you and your family healthy.

  • Invest for the Future: Competitive retirement plan with matching program in most markets.

  • Generous Paid Time Off: Recharge with ample time off, including holidays and vacation.

  • Paid Parental Leave: Support for growing families, with paid leave for new parents.

  • Monthly Child & Dependent Care Reimbursement: Financial support for the care of your loved ones.

  • Emotional Wellbeing: Be your best self with our mental wellness benefits.

  • LGBTQ+ & Inclusive Health Services: Inclusive healthcare designed for every individual’s unique needs.

  • Fertility Coverage & Menopause Support: Helping you along every step of your family journey.

  • Pet Wellness Reimbursement & Rover Credits: We care about your pets, too – helping you keep them happy and healthy.

  • And more, click here for additional benefits and details.

Compensation: In accordance with applicable law, Hearst is required to include a reasonable estimate of the compensation for this role if hired in Connecticut. The reasonable estimate, if hired in Connecticut, is $35,000 - $40,000 base plus commissions based on individual performance, commissions are uncapped for unlimited earning potential. A final decision on the successful candidate’s starting salary will be based on a number of permissible, non-discriminatory factors, including but not limited to skills and experience, training, certifications, and education.

Benefits: Eligible employees enjoy Health, dental, vision coverage, Health savings and/or flexible spending accounts, short & long-term disability insurance, 401k with company match, paid time off for vacation, sick days, company holidays and floating holidays. 

About Hearst Newspapers:

With 2,500 employees across the nation, HNP represents a network of 24 daily and 52 weekly publications, including the San Francisco Chronicle, Houston Chronicle, San Antonio Express-News and Albany Times Union, several top digital-only news and lifestyle sites, marketing services businesses, and entertainment businesses such as King Features Syndicate. At HNP, we are investing in new and innovative ways to tell stories–growing newsrooms, diversifying tools, evolving platforms–to support the millions of people who trust us each month to help them make decisions, take action and be inspired.

You are organized, focused, and able to structure your tasks and priorities independently. You learn new tasks quickly and have both the ability and the willingness to support others, including colleagues and customers.


Implementation Consultant is a dynamic role that involves a broad range of responsibilities. job.description:
Job Description :


As Marketing Operations & AI Manager for Asia and Emerging Markets, you run the region's marketing technology, data, automation, and reporting. You own the platforms, integrations, data, dashboards, and AI workflows that the whole marketing team depends on, and you keep them working. This is the systems and data layer underneath marketing, distinct from campaign operations, who build and ship the campaigns themselves. Your job is to keep the demand engine running reliably, the data clean, and marketing's contribution to pipeline measurable and trusted. TR is investing in AEM marketing so it runs on better systems and practical automation. Done well, this role takes manual, repetitive work off the team, gives everyone reporting they can rely on, and makes AI an everyday tool rather than a project.


Key Responsibilities :

  • Run the marketing technology stack:  administer, configure, and maintain the regional marketing technology platforms and their integrations day to day, including Eloqua (or the regional marketing automation platform) and Salesforce, covering system configuration, user management, data flows, and platform migrations. 
  • Own the lead lifecycle and routing:  build and maintain lead capture, scoring, and lifecycle management, the routing rules, and the MQL to SQL definitions and handoff into business development and sales, so leads move cleanly and fast. 
  • Own reporting, analysis, and insight:  own the KPI and reporting framework and the data behind it, including tracking and attribution; analyse marketing and pipeline performance; and turn the numbers into clear insight and recommendations for marketing and commercial leaders, what they mean and what to do. Build and maintain reporting in Power BI and SQL, and guide the more junior analyst who produces routine reporting. 
  • Build AI and automation into the work:  design, build, and run AI and agent workflows for repetitive operations tasks such as data hygiene, lead routing, segmentation, reporting, and localisation, turning manual effort into fast, reliable automation. 
  • Keep data clean and compliant:  maintain data quality, enrichment and the integrity of records, and keep marketing activity compliant with data regulation across AEM markets. 
  • Keep marketing organised:  maintain campaign taxonomy, naming, and the standard processes and templates that keep marketing consistent across markets, and support budget tracking and reporting. 
  • Document, train, and work with vendors:  create clear documentation and run onboarding and training so marketers across the region use the tools and processes consistently, and work with external vendors and platform partners. 

Required Qualifications:


  • Five or more years hands-on in marketing operations, marketing technology, or go-to-market operations in a B2B technology environment.
  • Strong hands-on experience administering a marketing automation platform such as Eloqua or Marketo, and Salesforce, including automation, integrations, lead scoring, and lifecycle management.

  • Experience working across a matrixed, multi-region organisation, ideally across Asia or emerging markets.

job.title: Director, Technology Partner Architecture Solutions – Legal
job.description:
Job Description

What if you could be the technical architect behind the partnerships that bring AI and workflow technology into legal practice, and you were accountable for whether those solutions actually work for customers? As Director, Partner Solutions Architect (PSA) for Legal on our Partnerships & Alliances team, you will lead the technical design of solutions that combine Thomson Reuters legal content and technology with our strategic partners' platforms. You will set architecture standards for partner offerings and make sure they are scoped, secure, and ready to sell before we commit to customers. You will work across Product, Engineering, Sales, and Legal theater leaders to turn partner opportunities into solutions customers can adopt. You will lead a team of solutions architects, guide technical due diligence on partners, and serve as the trusted technical voice in conversations with partner executives.  This role combines deep technical judgment, customer empathy, and the discipline to hold partners to the commitments they make. 


Key Responsibilities

Solution Architecture & Design 

  • Define the reference architecture for partner-delivered legal solutions, including integration patterns, data flows, and security and privacy controls. 
  • Translate partner capabilities and customer workflows in legal practice into scoped, buildable solution designs. 
  • Review and approve technical designs for partner offerings before commitments are made to customers or Sales. 

Partner Technical Due Diligence 

  • Assess partner platforms, APIs, and AI models for technical fit, scalability, reliability, and compliance with legal industry requirements. 
  • Evaluate partner security, data residency, and model governance practices, and document the risks that need mitigation. 
  • Advise Partnerships on which technical capabilities warrant investment and which should be limited in scope. 

 Customer Solution Engagement 

  • Lead technical discovery and solution workshops with prospective customers, including law firms and corporate legal departments. 
  • Design proofs of concept and pilots that demonstrate partner-integrated offerings with early customers. 
  • Support Sales with technical positioning, objection handling, and solution proposals in complex deals. 

Product & Engineering Alignment 

  • Work with Product to shape the partner roadmap, prioritize integration work, and resolve gaps between partner commitments and product capacity. 
  • Partner with Engineering on integration delivery, release readiness, and technical support models for partner solutions. 
  • Bring customer and partner feedback into product planning so that solutions improve with each deployment. 

Delivery Quality & Accountability 

  • Establish technical success criteria and health metrics for each partner solution, and monitor them after launch. 
  • Lead technical reviews and escalation response when partner-delivered solutions fall short of commitments. 
  • Recommend whether partner solutions should be scaled, fixed, or retired based on technical performance and customer outcomes. 

Team Leadership & Standards 

  • Set goals and direction for the solutions architecture team, and manage performance and development for each team member. 
  • Build architecture standards, reusable reference assets, and a shared knowledge base across the Legal theater. 
  • Coach and mentor solutions architects, and grow the team's technical depth in AI, integration, and legal domain workflows. 

Required Qualifications

  • 12+ years of experience in solutions architecture, software engineering, or technical consulting, including at least five years leading architecture for enterprise software or platform partnerships. 
  • Hands-on experience designing integrations with partner APIs, cloud platforms, and enterprise data systems. 
  • Experience designing AI or machine learning enabled solutions, including retrieval, model integration, and evaluation approaches. 
  • Track record of translating technical designs into commercial offerings with Product, Sales, and Partnerships teams. 
  • Experience leading and developing a team of technical professionals, including setting goals, managing performance, and coaching. 
  • Strong knowledge of security, privacy, and compliance requirements for handling confidential client and legal information. 

 Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in legal technology, legal publishing, or professional services software. 
  • Presales experience. 
  • Familiarity with legal workflows such as legal research, contract review, litigation support, or legal operations. 
  • Experience with cloud and AI ecosystem partner programs (e.g., AWS, Google Cloud, Anthropic). 
  • A law degree or equivalent legal industry experience, or an advanced degree in computer science or engineering.

job.description:
Job Description


Duty Editor, Sub Saharan Africa

 

The Duty Editor, Sub Saharan Africa is a key supporting editorial role within Reuters' One Newsroom structure. Reporting to the Hub Editor, the Duty Editor provides hands-on support in coordinating daily news coverage by desk-based journalists across Sub Saharan Africa and helps deliver fast, accurate and compelling journalism across formats.

 

The Duty Editor works under the direction of the Hub Editor and alongside the Executive Producer, Planning, Assignments & Photography Editor and deputies to help execute agreed editorial priorities. The role supports specific newsroom functions: helping coordinate coverage, reporting and production resources, editing and reviewing content for its quality, ethics and standards, monitoring developing stories and following through on editorial decisions in appropriate formats for Reuters clients and audiences.

 

The successful candidate will be an experienced journalist with strong news judgement who thrives in a fast-moving news environment. They will help coordinate reporting and production resources in line with agreed priorities, support breaking news coverage, contribute to news planning and work across text, video and photography teams to maximise the impact of Reuters journalism.

 

This role requires a collaborative journalist who can remain calm under pressure, make sound editorial judgements within agreed priorities and help execute newsroom decisions across the region.

 

Key Responsibilities


As Duty Editor, Sub Saharan Africa, you will:


  • Support the Hub Editor in coordinating daily news coverage and editorial priorities across Sub Saharan Africa.
  • Help Reuters win breaking news stories by supporting fast, accurate and well-coordinated elemental coverage.
  • Support the Hub Editor and other responsible editors in executing Reuters' response to breaking and developing stories, with a focus on journalism originating from desk-based reporters and producers.
  • Work closely with reporters, correspondents, photographers and video journalists to help deliver compelling cross-format journalism.
  • Contribute to daily news planning and help implement coverage and deployment decisions set by the Hub Editor, Planning, Assignments & Photography Editor and other responsible editors.
  • Help coordinate coverage across bureaux, desks and formats as part of Reuters' One Newsroom approach.
  • Edit stories and content to Reuters' high editorial standards, ensuring accuracy, fairness and clarity.
  • Help coordinate available reporting resources in line with priorities and deployment decisions set by the relevant editors.
  • Identify and flag opportunities to strengthen, extend and deepen Reuters coverage across text, video and photography.
  • Work with regional and global teams to help ensure Africa's most important stories reach Reuters' worldwide audience.
  • Contribute to cross-format collaboration and newsroom transformation initiatives.
  • Support the coaching and development of journalists and help foster a collaborative newsroom culture.



Required Qualifications


  • Significant experience in a fast-paced newsroom, preferably with a news agency, international newsroom or major digital publisher.

  • Proven multimedia and strong visuals experience covering and coordinating breaking news.

  • Experience working across text, video and photography in a multimedia news environment.
  • Excellent communication, planning and organisational skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to work collaboratively across teams and disciplines in a One Newsroom environment.
  • Commitment to the Reuters Trust Principles of independence, integrity and freedom from bias.



Preferred Qualifications

  • Proven track record covering major breaking news events, elections, conflicts, disasters or other complex stories.
  • Experience supporting coverage across multiple bureaux or regions.
  • Knowledge of digital publishing workflows and audience-focused storytelling.

job.title: Manager, Data Science
job.description:
Job Description


Thomson Reuters is expanding its Data Science and AI organization and is looking for a Manager to lead a team building intelligent products and automation. You will own the full lifecycle of ML and GenAI solutions, from problem framing to production deployment and operation. The work spans traditional machine learning and modern GenAI systems, including LLM applications, RAG, agents, and multi-agent platforms. You will set technical direction, develop your team, and partner with business stakeholders to deliver measurable impact.


Key Responsibilities


Problem framing and solution design

  • Translate business problems into well-scoped data science and AI use cases with clear hypotheses, success metrics, and value estimates.
  • Lead the design and development of ML and GenAI solutions, including predictive models, LLM applications, RAG, and agents, from exploration through validated prototype.
  • Partner with engineering to move solutions into production by defining model requirements, performance thresholds, and monitoring and retraining needs.

Evaluation and impact measurement

  • Define evaluation frameworks for classical models and LLM and agent solutions, covering accuracy, groundedness, safety, and regression.
  • Design experiments and pilots, including A/B tests, to measure business impact and adoption, and use results to guide iteration and prioritization.
  • Analyze post-launch model and agent performance, including quality, drift, and cost signals, and recommend improvements.

AI roadmap and portfolio prioritization

  • Shape the data science and AI roadmap for the team’s use case portfolio, prioritizing by business value, feasibility, and risk.
  • Identify reusable agentic patterns such as prompts, skills, workflow templates, and evaluation sets, and partner with engineering to make them available across teams.
  • Provide data science input into build-versus-buy decisions, including evaluation of model and vendor quality.

Coaching and mentoring

  • Lead, coach, and grow data scientists and AI engineers through feedback, code and design reviews, and career development.
  • Build a culture of rigor, experimentation, and ownership.
  • Hire, onboard, and retain strong talent.

Stakeholder partnership

  • Partner with Sales, Marketing, Product, and Operations to prioritize use cases and design solutions.
  • Apply AI and data science to business problems such as workflow automation, customer retention, cross-sell, segmentation, pricing, and recommendations.
  • Communicate results and trade-offs clearly to audiences from engineers to senior leadership.


Required Qualifications


  • 8-10 years of experience in data science and machine learning, with models deployed in production.
  • Experience leading, mentoring, or managing data scientists or ML engineers.
  • Hands-on experience building LLM applications, including prompt engineering, RAG, embeddings, and vector search.
  • Experience designing and shipping agentic systems, including tool use, orchestration, and agent evaluation.
  • Strong foundation in statistics, machine learning, and hypothesis testing.
  • Expert Python and strong SQL skills.
  • Experience with scikit-learn, PyTorch, or TensorFlow.
  • Experience with cloud platforms (preferably AWS), containerization, and CI/CD for model deployment.
  • Experience applying ML to business problems such as predictive analytics, segmentation, pricing, or recommendations.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Bachelor's degree or higher; a quantitative field is preferred.

Preferred Qualifications


  • Experience building multi-agent platforms with frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, or AutoGen.
  • Experience with MCP and building reusable tools and skills for agents.
  • Experience with LLMOps tooling, including tracing, evaluation, guardrails, and prompt management.
  • Experience with advanced RAG techniques such as hybrid search, re-ranking, and retrieval evaluation.
  • Familiarity with responsible AI practices, including hallucination mitigation, privacy, and governance.

job.title: CRM Executive
job.description:
Join our team at the Guardian and be a part of a diverse and inclusive global organisation that delivers fearless, investigative journalism, and holds power to account. Our team of award-winning journalists, cutting-edge commercial professionals, and industry-leading digital experts are committed to making a difference and represent a wide range of backgrounds and perspectives. We offer a challenging and exciting environment for career development, with a focus on training, growth and fostering an inclusive culture.

 

We are now looking for a CRM Executive to join the team. The CRM Executive will be planning and implementing multi-channel CRM activity across the reader lifecycle.

 

About the role

  • Plan, develop and implement multi-channel campaigns such as but not limited to; acquisition, in-life, upsell/cross-sell, renewal, winback
  • Deliver multi-channel and measurable customer campaigns and journeys
  • Presenting plans and activity performance to a broad range of stakeholders, taking part in team and cross functional meetings 

 

About you

  • Experience of building campaigns using a CRM tool (ideally Braze but not essential)
  • Experience of marketing performance tracking, analysis and reporting
  • Experience in audience-centric, data-driven marketing
  • Experience of executing activity across email, but other channels would be a bonus

 We actively encourage applications from groups traditionally underrepresented in the UK media 

We operate in a hybrid environment working 3 days a week from our offices in Kings Cross and 2 days a week remotely. 

 

We value and respect all differences (seen and unseen) in all people. We aspire to have inclusive working experiences and an environment that reflects the audience we serve, where our people have equal access to career development opportunities, their voices are heard and can contribute to our future. We actively encourage applications from people of all backgrounds. Many of our staff work flexibly and we will consider all requests for flexible working arrangements.

 

How to apply

To apply, please upload your latest CV and cover letter which answers the following questions:

 

  1. Why are you interested in working on CRM specifically within a reader-funded, publisher environment like The Guardian compared to traditional e-commerce?

  2. Give one example of a revenue-focused or conversion campaign you have worked on. Briefly, what was the goal, channels used and key metric/business impact achieved?

 

We appreciate the time taken to prepare each application we receive. We do not use AI-assisted technology to review applications; every application is reviewed by a member of our recruitment team. Thank you for bearing with us during the screening process.

 

The closing date for applications is 6pm, Friday 30th October 2026.

 

Guardian News and Media is proud to be a London Living wage employer. The minimum salary for any full-time role within the organisation is £30,000 per annum. Salary ranges are dependent on skills and experience. 

 

All roles at the Guardian are open for everybody to apply. It is important to us that you feel supported and comfortable throughout your recruitment process, in order to perform your best. Please let us know if there are any changes we could make to help your application, this includes providing documents in accessible formats or personalising the process to better support your needs. Please contact Karen Walter on karen.walter@theguardian.com to discuss further so we can work with you to support you through your application.

 

Benefits at the Guardian

You'll have 30 days of annual leave per year (plus bank holidays) with the option to purchase an additional 5 days. Our pension scheme is generous; if you contribute 5% then we will contribute 8-12% (depending on your age). We believe in giving back, which is why employees are given 2 volunteering days annually and the option of payroll giving. Season ticket loans are also available.

You are entitled to private healthcare, life cover, income protection, and eye tests. You can also opt in to dental insurance.

We have enhanced maternity, paternity, adoption and shared parental leave policies in place. We also support our employees by offering an IVF, menopause, baby loss, and trans equality policy.

 

Culture and wellbeing

We want everyone to feel like they belong at the Guardian and we champion diversity of thought. Our various employee forums provide a platform to use their voice to foster an inclusive workplace. We became the first major media organisation to achieve B Corp status.

We offer tools to help you prioritise your wellbeing including access to our employee benefits platform which provides tailored support for health and wellbeing. In addition, we also offer free yoga and Pilates classes. These run alongside our corporate gym membership and cycle to work scheme. Our canteen has views overlooking the Regents Canal and caters for breakfast, lunch and dinner.

 

Learning and development

We encourage personal and professional growth. Employees have access to a broad range of tools and solutions, and we are happy to support the pursuit of professional qualifications through vocational courses and apprenticeships.

job.title: Senior Data Analyst – Paid Media
job.description:
Company Information

AEG brings music, sports, and live entertainment together to create moments people remember around the world. Each year, more than 100 million fans experience live events across five continents—from global touring, concerts, and festivals to iconic sports and entertainment destinations.

Through our music division, AEG Presents, one of the world’s leading operators of tours, concerts, and music festivals, we help shape the sound of now. We work with artists at every stage of their careers to bring live music to life, connecting artists with fans on stages around the world.

Headquartered in Los Angeles, AEG Presents is driven by creativity, innovation, and purpose, and powered by people who want their work to show up in the real world.

If you’re ready to help create moments that matter, there’s a place for you here. Because it happens here.

 

The Senior Data Analyst – Paid Media sits on the Data Analytics, Reporting & Strategy team and serves as the analytical partner and lead for the Paid Media team. Paid Media drives company-wide digital media strategy, campaign management, and consultative support across AEG divisions, including AEG Presents, Global Touring, Festivals, Goldenvoice, Bowery Presents, and Global Partnerships. Campaigns run across a broad mix of channels, including Meta, Google Ads, TikTok, and other social, search, and programmatic platforms.

This role is responsible for pulling, transforming, and modeling campaign data from those ad platforms and joining it with other data sources to build a unified view of performance. The analyst will design scalable data models and automated reporting that measure campaign effectiveness and surface opportunities to optimize budget allocation, audience targeting, creative, and customer acquisition. The role also turns findings into clear, practical recommendations that drive ticket sales, event awareness, and brand initiatives.

The Senior Data Analyst will work closely with the Paid Media, Product, and Data Engineering teams on cross-functional projects covering paid media data ingestion, aggregation, mastering, measurement, and visualization. The position will lead the work to make sure tracking and tagging (pixels, conversion APIs, UTMs) capture accurate marketing data. It will also develop and maintain attribution models and set performance benchmarks for key metrics such as CPA, ROAS, CTR, and conversion rate.

Essential Functions

 

  • Provide analytical support to Paid Media and Marketing teams, compiling performance marketing reports across digital channels using internal BI tools, Google Analytics, native advertising platforms. Communicate results to stakeholders, working with media and strategy teams to demonstrate clear actionable insights for media plans, budget forecasting, targeting/audiences, and creative.
  • Build and maintain comprehensive measurement plans to evaluate paid media performance, calculate benchmarks based on objectives, develop + maintain attribution models to identify trends, testing opportunities, and insights by channel, audience, festival/tour/regional show, and business unit.
  • Partner with Data, Product, Engineering teams to manage data pipelines + ingestion for channel metrics, define data collection requirements and enforce optimal taxonomy for reporting implementations, continual data hygiene + integrity across ad buying and internal platforms.
  • Collaborate with media, marketing, and data teams to inform audience and targeting strategies. Develop tests to evaluate new campaign strategies, ad products, optimization tactics, and targeting features.
  • Manage and lead paid media projects involving data aggregation and measurement tools such as Datorama, Google Analytics / GA4, Tag Manager, DOMO, BigQuery, LiveRamp, server-server integrations with media partners. Ensure appropriate site tracking is in place to capture relevant data points to measure marketing effectiveness.
  • Work closely with data team to develop and maintain reporting dashboards for internal and external use, while providing support for ad hot reporting requests.

 

Required Qualifications

  • BA/BS degree (4-year) in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Business, Marketing, or a related quantitative field
  • 4–6 years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, or a similar role, with exposure to paid media or digital marketing data on the client, publisher, or agency side; e-commerce experience preferred
  • Advanced SQL skills and experience pulling, transforming, and analyzing large, complex datasets
  • Strong ability to build data models, data flows, and ETL/ELT pipelines using SQL and/or Python, bringing together data from multiple media channels into a scalable, automated insights reporting structure
  • Proficiency in BI and data visualization tools such as DOMO, Looker Studio, Tableau, or similar, with strong dashboard design and data storytelling skills
  • Experience with Salesforce Marketing Cloud Intelligence (formerly Datorama) or similar marketing data integration platforms is a strong plus
  • Working knowledge of paid media data and performance metrics, including impressions, CTR, CPC, CPA, conversion rate, and ROAS, across platforms such as Meta, Google Ads, and TikTok
  • Familiarity with tracking infrastructure such as GA4, Google Tag Manager, pixels, Conversions API, UTMs, and server-side tracking
  • Experience applying statistical methods to performance benchmarking, attribution modeling, and media mix modeling (MMM)
  • Understanding of the ad tech and Martech landscape (programmatic buying, DSP/SSP, audience management, ad serving, social buying platforms), and of privacy regulations’ impact on measurement, including cookie-less tracking and multi-touch customer journeys
  • Ability to clearly communicate insights and recommendations to technical and non-technical stakeholders, and manage multiple cross-functional projects at once

Payscale: $82,158.00 -$125,000.00

Bonus:  This position is not eligible for a bonus under the current bonus plan requirements.

Benefits: Full-time: We offer a comprehensive benefits package that includes: medical, dental and vision insurance, paid holidays, vacation and sick time, company paid basic life insurance, voluntary life insurance, parental leave, 401k Plan (with a current employer match of 3%), flexible spending and health savings account options, and wellness offerings.

For more than 20 years, AEG has played a pivotal role in transforming sports and live entertainment.   • Able to work independently and as part of a team to accomplish the goals of finance department

job.title: LN Venues, Assistant Production Manager - The Truth
job.description:
Job Summary:

WHO ARE WE?

Live Nation Entertainment is the world’s leading live entertainment company, comprised of global market leaders: Ticketmaster, Live Nation Concerts, and Live Nation Media & Sponsorship. Ticketmaster is the global leader in event ticketing with over 620 million tickets sold annually and approximately 10,000 clients worldwide.  Live Nation Concerts is the largest provider of live entertainment in the world promoting more than 50,000 events annually for nearly 7,000 artists in 40+ countries. These businesses allow Live Nation Media & Sponsorship to create strategic music marketing programs that connect more than 1,200 sponsors with the 145 million fans that attend Live Nation Entertainment events each year. For additional information, visit www.livenationentertainment.com.

 

WHO ARE YOU?

Passionate and motivated. Driven, with an entrepreneurial spirit. Resourceful, innovative, forward thinking and committed. At Live Nation Entertainment, our people embrace these qualities, so if this sounds like you then please read on! 

 

THE JOB

The Assistant Production Manager is responsible for all off-stage, backstage, and non-technical details of concerts and events. This includes advancing and obtaining hospitality, VIP, and merchandise information, as well as rider requirements, staffing, scheduling, and operational needs,

 

WHAT THIS ROLE WILL DO

  • Ensure positive and creative environment for Production team
  • Assist day-of-show in maintaining department standards for all production positions
  • Develop and maintain department manuals and training materials for all production positions
  • Assist and support production department personnel with job functions as needed
  • Complete and distribute a daily show flash (P&L) of every event 
  • Have a detailed understanding of deal structure and the settlement process
  • Assist in in managing budgetary requirements and tracking the financial aspects of shows
  • Create and maintain daily band cost spreadsheet
  • Ensure production department is following standard operating procedures
  • Implement daily and weekly show schedule
  • Work with the Production Manager scheduling appropriate number of staff while maintaining labor costs within the assigned budgetary guidelines
  • Ensure all procedures are cost effective
  • Maintain regular communications with Production Manager and the GM
  • Advance and facilitate all tour merchandise needs
  • Collect merchandise settlements per contracted agreements
  • Facilitate proper interdepartmental communication and organization
  • Assist in managing stage, sound, and lighting crews
  • Will lead the production team for special events or shows should the production manager be unable to attend
  • Coordinate operational feedback with the Production Manager
  • Advance details for VIP Meet & Greets, Soundcheck Parties, and Backstage Experiences
  • Assist with operation needs of any VIP engagements
  • Advance backstage food and beverage/hospitality requirements
  • Ensure information is distributed to Production Coordinator in a timely basis
  • Responsible for scheduling casual labor such as runners and merchandise vendors
  • Advise and implement needed venue projects including upgrades and repairs
  • Attend production and operation meetings as outlined by Production Manager
  • Maintain a detailed and thorough filing system of all “past show” files on the shared drive
  • Maintain accurate daily show records and end of night reporting
  • Responsible for documenting and delivering disciplinary actions to production crew
  • As part of the venue leadership team, establish and maintain a positive and supportive workplace culture.
  • Foster positive experiences for artists/clients and staff in a manner that establishes the venue as a safe, enjoyable, and supportive environment.

 

 

WHAT THIS PERSON WILL BRING

 

Required:

  • Flexible Schedule (days/nights, late hours, weekends, and holidays)
  • Calm, Professional and customer service oriented
  • Ability to make clear concise decisions, sometimes with limited information
  • 3 years minimum Tour and Stage Production experience
  • Strong people skills with an emphasis on competent and diplomatic communication with tour/production manager representatives
  • Experience in stage lighting, pro audio systems and basic video systems
  • Ability to handle multiple projects simultaneously
  • Computer literate in Windows applications (Excel and Word a must)
  • Must possess superior interpersonal communication and organizational skills
  • High School Diploma
  • Tolerance of all cultures, music, and art forms

Preferred:

  • Some College or College Degree in related field
  • Point of Sales knowledge
  • Multitasking Skills
  • Cash handling experience
  • Experience in a live music environment 

Physical Demands/Working Environment:

Job Summary:

WHO ARE WE?
