job.title: Broadcast Technician - Relocation to Huntsville, ON
job.description:
Reporting to the Director of Technical Operations, the Broadcast Technician is responsible for maintaining Vista Radio’s cluster of stations across our Ontario markets, ensuring reliable broadcast operations and supporting all technical processes related to transmission, studio systems, and content delivery.

This is a permanent, full-time position based in Huntsville, Ontario. Interested candidates must be willing to relocate. Relocation assistance will be provided.

About the Role

The Broadcast Technician plays a critical role in keeping our stations on-air and operating at peak performance. This position supports transmitter sites, studio environments, automation systems, and network infrastructure, while ensuring compliance, uptime, and operational excellence across the cluster.

Responsibilities

Installation, maintenance, and troubleshooting of FM/AM broadcast transmitter systems

Diagnose RF and transmission system issues using strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills; assess equipment health onsite and remotely, determine repair options, dismantle components for off-site repair, and complete replacements and installations as required

Installation, maintenance, and troubleshooting of radio studio equipment including computers, AXIA IP audio consoles, nodes, processors, analog consoles, mixers, microphones, amplifiers, speakers, and STL systems

Troubleshoot mixed digital and analog broadcast environments

Installation, maintenance, and ongoing troubleshooting of broadcast computers and hardware supporting ENCO Radio automation systems, servers, regulatory audio loggers, IP online streams, and audio distribution systems

Maintain building infrastructure, documentation, and inspection reports; identify current or potential issues and implement preventative maintenance measures to improve uptime

Proactively monitor critical equipment and make necessary adjustments to ensure broadcast continuity and content delivery

Troubleshoot, maintain, and repair radio automation systems and related networks, routers, switches, and wireless access points

Provide remote and hands-on technical support to station staff, including support for remote broadcasts

Liaise with management to address facility issues including HVAC, power outages, generators, internet and phone outages, working toward timely restoration

Maintain accurate and up-to-date technical records and generate reports with findings and recommendations; liaise with community contractors to obtain project costing aligned with departmental budgets

Travel to transmitter sites throughout the province for maintenance, testing, and site upkeep, including vegetation removal near towers and building entrances

Participate in after-hours and on-call rotations as required; respond to emergency and off-air situations. Travel may be required

Qualifications

Minimum three (3) years of recent and direct radio engineering experience in a Broadcast Technician role

Graduate of an electronics technician or technologist program preferred

Strong technical aptitude and hands-on troubleshooting skills

Self-motivated, reliable, and safety-conscious

Detail-oriented, highly organized, and able to prioritize effectively in response to changing needs or critical off-air emergencies

Demonstrated interest in staying current with industry trends and technical standards

Positive attitude with a strong customer service mindset

Demonstrates Vista Radio’s core values: Integrity, Respect, Compassion, Responsibility, and Excellence

Ability and willingness to work in all climates

Valid driver’s license with a clean driving abstract

Proficiency in written and spoken English

Working Conditions

Permanent, full-time position based in Huntsville, Ontario

Relocation required for candidates not currently residing in the area; relocation assistance will be provided

After-hours and on-call work required

Travel within Ontario required

job.description:

Role Overview

The Chief Engineer is an in-house leadership role responsible for overseeing the technical operations across our Ontario radio markets. This role provides leadership within each cluster, guiding and supporting the technical team while maintaining their own responsibilities. The Chief Engineer will take the lead from the primary technician in each market, supervise project initiatives, and serve as a key support for technical staff. The technical team within each cluster reports into this role, which in turn reports to the Director of Technical Operations.

Responsibilities

Provide technical leadership and support within each cluster, ensuring all technical staff receive guidance and oversight on project initiatives.

Oversee the installation, maintenance, and troubleshooting of FM/AM broadcast transmitter systems.

Diagnose and resolve RF and transmission system issues both onsite and remotely, determining repair strategies in the field and offsite as needed.

Supervise the installation, maintenance, and troubleshooting of all radio studio equipment, including computers, AXIA IP audio consoles, nodes, processors, analog consoles, mixers, microphones, amps, speakers, and STL systems.

Maintain and troubleshoot mixed digital and analog environments, ensuring seamless integration of broadcast automation systems, servers, regulatory audio loggers, IP streams, and audio distribution systems.

Conduct proactive monitoring of critical broadcast equipment and implement necessary adjustments to maintain uptime.

Manage building infrastructure, maintain documentation and inspection reports, and schedule preventative measures to improve reliability.

Lead the troubleshooting, maintenance, and repair of radio automation systems, network infrastructure, routers, switches, and wireless access points.

Provide both remote and hands-on technical support for station staff, including troubleshooting remote broadcasts.

Act as the primary liaison with management regarding facility issues, such as HVAC, power outages, generator operations, internet, and phone service disruptions, working towards prompt resolution.

Maintain accurate records and generate reports on system health, equipment status, and recommended improvements. Develop costing estimates for projects in alignment with budget expectations.

  • News Junkie Mentality: A strong knowledge of current events, topics making headlines and stories that matter to our audience.

  • Digital Fluency: Basic experience with digital news production, live streaming workflows, and newsroom technologies. Familiarity with a Tricaster is a huge plus, but a willingness and ability to learn new technology quickly is a must.

  • Strategic Mindset: Strong organizational and planning skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and always think several steps ahead.

  • On-Camera Presence: Excellent unscripted delivery and communication skills are required.

OVERVIEW OF THE COMPANY

Fox TV Stations

FOX Television Stations (FTS) owns and operates 29 full power broadcast television stations, including stations in 14 of the top 15 markets and duopolies in 11. JOB DESCRIPTION

KCPQ Fox 13 is seeking a per-diem Transmitter Engineer to support our primary broadcast transmitter facilities at Capitol Hill in Seattle, and Gold Mountain near Bremerton.


This role requires extensive experience in television transmitter site operations and maintenance.


Key Responsibilities


Transmitter Operations (Capitol and Gold Mtn sites)

· Primary Sites Ownership: Manage the daily operation, routine calibrations, and emergency troubleshooting of our high-power solid-state/air and liquid-cooled transmitters and RF switchgear.

· Transmitter testing, failover testing, transport signal path monitoring, local MPEG encoder operation and baseband signal flow testing. Ability to work during high-profile events such as Sunday football games, The World Series, and other events.

· Infrastructure & Power: Monitor critical site support systems, including site-located IT systems, microwave and terrestrial signal transport systems, satellite downlinks, UPS and generator systems, and other site-located equipment.

· IT Knowledge: Basic IT/networking skills (IP addresses, subnets, switches, PC’s ).

· Driving & Logistics: Must have a valid driver's license, a clean driving record, and the confidence to drive mountain roads in rain, fog, or light winter conditions.

· Physical Demands: Ability to lift up to 50 lbs., climb ladders, and work comfortably behind equipment racks.

job.title: SOCIAL VIDEO PRODUCER - KTVK/KPHO
job.description:
About Gray Media:

Today, we are a growing multimedia company headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia. We are the nation's largest owner of top-rated local television stations and digital assets serving 117 full-power television markets that collectively reach approximately 37% of US television households. The portfolio includes 80 markets with the top-rated television station and 100 markets with the first- and/or second-highest-rated television station in average all-day ratings across 116 of such markets that were measured by Nielsen in 2025. We also own the largest Telemundo Affiliate group with 46 markets and Gray Digital Media, a full-service digital agency offering national and local clients digital marketing strategies with the most advanced digital products and services. Our additional media properties include video production companies Raycom Sports, Tupelo Media Group, and PowerNation Studios, and studio production facilities Assembly Atlanta and Third Rail Studios.

About KTVK/KPHO:

Home to 3TV, CBS 5, and Arizona’s Family Sports, Arizona’s Family produces 100+ hours of local news and programming every week. 3TV is #1 in Arizona and one of the strongest independent stations in the country. Our CBS station is highly competitive in news and has top-rated sports and prime content. Our digital reach is also best-in-market—Azfamily.com leads the market in multi-platform unique users and is home to Arizona’s Family Originals (long-form programs, documentaries, docuseries, and podcasts, including True Crime Arizona, nearing 2M downloads). Arizona’s Family Sports features premier properties, including the Arizona Cardinals, Phoenix Suns, Phoenix Mercury, Phoenix Rising, and AIA state championships.

Job Summary/Description:

Are you obsessed with the creator economy? Do you understand why some videos explode to millions of views while others disappear into the void? Can you take a 45-minute podcast episode and turn it into five pieces of content that each hit differently on five different platforms? Then we need to talk.

Arizona's Family is looking for a Social Media Video Producer who is laser-focused on growing our content and talent through bold, creative, platform-native video content. This isn't a traditional TV job — this is a digital-first, audience-obsessed, growth-driven role for someone who thinks like a content creator, executes like a producer, and analyzes like a strategist.

You'll be the engine behind turning our long-form streaming content and podcast episodes into short-form social gold — building loyal audiences, driving subscriptions, and putting Arizona's Family at the forefront of the next era of local media.

Duties/Responsibilities include (but are not limited to):

• Transform long-form into short-form magic: Watch, listen to, and deeply understand our streaming shows and podcast episodes — then identify and clip the moments that will hook audiences on TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, Facebook, and X.
• Produce original social video content: Concept, shoot, and edit original short-form video content — teasers, trailers, behind-the-scenes, host spotlights, audiograms, and promotional clips — that drive tune-in and subscriptions.
• Grow our streaming and podcast audiences: Develop and execute platform-specific social strategies designed to convert casual scrollers into loyal subscribers and regular listeners/viewers.
• Be a storytelling architect: Identify the most compelling hooks, soundbites, and moments from each episode and package them into irresistible, binge-worthy content that leaves audiences wanting more.
• Manage content calendars: Plan, schedule, and publish content across all platforms with consistency and strategic timing — building anticipation before episodes drop and sustaining momentum after.
• Optimize for each platform: You don't post the same video everywhere. You understand aspect ratios, caption strategies, hashtag culture, trending audio, and algorithm behavior on every major platform — and you create accordingly.
• Engage and grow communities: Foster authentic engagement around our shows and podcasts — responding to comments, collaborating with hosts on their personal channels, and identifying opportunities to tap into trending conversations.
• Track, analyze, and iterate: Monitor performance metrics, including views, watch time, follower growth, click-throughs, and conversion rates, and use data to continuously refine your content strategy.
• Collaborate with field crews and talent: Work closely with our team and coach them to create authentic, engaging content, ensuring their personal brands amplify azfamily.
• Stay ahead of trends: You're always watching what's working in the creator space, new formats, emerging platforms, and viral trends that you're quick to test and adapt.
• Self-starter energy: You don't wait to be told what to create. You bring ideas, pitch concepts, and take full ownership of your content pipeline.
• Collaborative spirit: You work well with hosts, talent, and cross-functional teams — making everyone around you look and sound better.
• Bonus: Experience with audiogram tools (Headliner, Descript), podcast distribution platforms (Spotify, Apple Podcasts, iHeart), or streaming platform management (Roku, Amazon Fire, YouTube TV).
• College degree preferred.

What You'll Be Growing:

• You'll play a direct role in expanding the reach and audience of Arizona's Family's growing portfolio, which may include:
• Original podcasts covering Arizona news, politics, sports, lifestyle, and culture
• Streaming shows distributed across platforms like Roku, Amazon Fire TV, Apple TV, and YouTube
• Long-form interview and documentary-style content
• Arizona-focused lifestyle and community programming

Why You'll Love It Here:

• Be a pioneer: This is a ground-floor opportunity to shape how Arizona's Family grows in the streaming and podcast space — your fingerprints will be on everything.
• Creative freedom: Bring your boldest ideas. We want someone who pushes boundaries, experiments fearlessly, and isn't afraid to try something new.
• See your impact in real time: Watch follower counts climb, episode downloads grow, and audiences engage with content you created.
• Work with great talent: Collaborate with experienced journalists, charismatic hosts, and a passionate digital team who are all rowing in the same direction.
• Arizona's biggest media stage: Help build the future of local media in one of the fastest-growing markets in the country.
• Room to grow: Gray Media is investing heavily in streaming and digital — and so are we. This role has serious upward trajectory.

Qualifications/Requirements:

• 2–4+ years of experience in social media video production, digital content creation, or a related field — ideally with experience growing a podcast, streaming show, YouTube channel, or creator brand.
• Expert short-form video skills: You live and breathe Reels, TikToks, and Shorts. You know how to hook an audience in the first 2 seconds and keep them watching.
• Strong video editing proficiency: Fluency in Adobe Premiere Pro, CapCut, DaVinci Resolve, or similar tools. Motion graphics experience (After Effects) is a major plus.
• Platform-native thinking: You don't just repurpose content — you reimagine it for each platform's unique culture, format, and audience behavior.
• Podcast and streaming fluency: You're a regular podcast listener and streaming viewer. You understand the medium, the audience expectations, and what makes people subscribe and come back.
• Copywriting chops: You can write scroll-stopping captions, compelling CTAs, and engaging on-screen text that enhances your video content.
• Growth mindset: You're not satisfied with vanity metrics. You care about real audience growth, retention, and conversion — and you know how to move those numbers.
• Self-starter energy: You don't wait to be told what to create. You bring ideas, pitch concepts, and take full ownership of your content pipeline.
• Collaborative spirit: You work well with hosts, talent, and cross-functional teams — making everyone around you look and sound better.
• Bonus: Experience with audiogram tools (Headliner, Descript), podcast distribution platforms (Spotify, Apple Podcasts, iHeart), or streaming platform management (Roku, Amazon Fire, YouTube TV).
• College degree preferred.

job.title: Digital Content Producer
job.description:
WCVB-TV is building a team of journalists dedicated to growing and diversifying the station's digital storytelling — original video and multiplatform content that lives across WCVB's digital platforms (web, app, YouTube, social, streaming) and within Chronicle and News broadcasts. We are seeking candidates for two off-camera positions. 

One position is based in the News department and is focused on fast-turn digital publishing, breaking news video, and enterprise/investigative reporting that extends NewsCenter 5's original journalism. The second position is based in Chronicle and is focused on field-produced, Chronicle-style long-form storytelling built for digital-first release in addition to broadcast use. 

What You'll Do

Field Production & Storytelling

  • Produce original video stories from pitch to final edit, largely working independently in the field
  • Conduct interviews, gather b-roll, and craft narratives with strong visual and storytelling quality
  • Bring either a Chronicle-style sensibility (tone, pacing, visual craft) or a news-enterprise sensibility (depth, context, follow-up reporting) to assigned stories, depending on the context
  • Ability to travel throughout New England — occasionally outside the region — is required
  • In-person attendance is required

Digital-First Publishing

  • Produce and edit short-form and long-form video optimized for digital platforms, including web, app, YouTube, and social
  • Turn content on a fast timeline — including breaking news — without sacrificing production quality
  • Package stories with strong titling, structure, and visual hooks suited to each platform
  • Adapt Chronicle and newsroom material for streaming, social, and other digital-first formats

Enterprise & Long-Form Storytelling

  • Develop digital-first stories that go beyond the day's headlines — true crime, investigative, lifestyle, archival, and multi-part features
  • Identify opportunities to advance a story or archival footage beyond its initial reporting
  • Identify opportunities to expand a single story into a series, or structure stories with future broadcast compilation in mind

Audience & Growth

  • Track platform trends and audience behavior, and identify stories with strong shareability
  • Experiment with emerging formats and growth strategies, evaluate results, and share what works with the team
  • Contribute to analytics-informed content planning, including for weekends and streaming events
  • Collaborate closely with digital, newsroom, and Chronicle teams to maximize reach

Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in video production, TV news, digital media, and/or documentary-style storytelling
  • Strong mastery of the Adobe editing suite
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently in the field, from pitch through final edit
  • Comfort balancing speed with production quality in a high-volume environment
  • Working knowledge of platform algorithms, digital video trends, and audience behavior
  • Strong writing skills and command of AP style

Preferred / Bonus Skills

  • Experience producing serialized, episodic, or multi-part digital content
  • Experience with YouTube and social platform optimization
  • Familiarity with leveraging archival content to build context or reimagine past stories in new formats
  • Experience developing or supporting strategy for streaming events with on-air talent

What Success Looks Like

  • Increased video views, watch time, and engagement across digital platforms
  • Growth in YouTube subscribers and overall channel performance
  • Consistent production of high-quality, platform-optimized video
  • Effective repurposing and extension of newsroom and Chronicle material
  • Energetic, inspirational collaboration across editorial, digital, and production teams

Salary

The estimated base salary range for this role is between $76,000 and $90,000. The actual base pay offered is dependent upon many factors, such as transferable skills, work experience, business needs, market demands and conditions, including geographic location where the work will be performed, and other factors permitted by law. The base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future.

job.title: Part-Time Storm Chaser
job.description:
Part-Time Storm Chaser (Field Weather Coverage)

KOCO-TV is looking for a part-time Storm Chaser to join one of our many two-person severe weather chase teams. This is high-pressure, real-time work supporting on-air meteorologists during rapidly changing conditions. One team member drives. The other monitors radar, data, and communications. Precision, calm judgment, and ethical decision-making are non-negotiable. This role reports to the News Director.

Role Overview
Storm Chasers provide critical, ground-level reports during severe weather events. This position may serve as either the driver or the radar/data operator, depending on assignment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Safely operate a vehicle or monitor radar, weather data, and communications from the passenger seat during severe weather.
  • Capture live and recorded video using station-authorized equipment for on-air and digital platforms.
  • Report live on-air observations when directed.
  • Relay accurate, timely storm details to station meteorologists, including severity, movement, and real-time conditions from the field.
  • Monitor weather conditions before and during deployments to anticipate storm development.
  • Adhere strictly to journalistic ethics, safety protocols, and station policies at all times.

Work Schedule

  • No fixed schedule. Hours are dictated by weather conditions.
  • Availability required on short notice when severe weather is forecast.
  • Assignments are made at the direction of station meteorologists or news management.
  • In-person attendance is required.

Important Note
This is not a casual field position. Severe weather coverage is intense, unpredictable, and safety critical. Teamwork, judgment, and professionalism are essential.

Required Qualifications

  • Clean driving record (required for all team members).
  • Strong situational awareness and the ability to remain calm under pressure.
  • Understanding of and commitment to journalistic ethics and accuracy.
  • Ability to follow direction precisely and communicate clearly in fast-moving situations.
  • Willingness to work in all weather conditions.

You will produce and anchor newscasts, write stories and approve scripts. You will serve as an MMJ Reporter and fill-in anchor during the week.

 

The Weekend Anchor must maintain an on-air persona that is friendly, energetic and authoritative, exhibit urgency every day, particularly during breaking news, and have a high-level of engagement on all social media platforms.

  

Applicants should have at least two years of professional on-air anchoring experience and/or professional reporting experience. Producing experience is preferred.

 

Overall, we’re looking for an experienced, hard-working journalist with a positive attitude and a team-oriented, leadership nature who can connect with viewers and tell impactful stories across Northwest Arkansas. 

 

 

Northwest Arkansas is a rapidly growing and vibrant community filled with rolling hills, rivers, lakes and Fortune 500 company headquarters. Many high-end business industries call NWA home, and they bring in some of the best talent in their fields. Cost of living is low, and quality of life is high. Add in our world-class museums, performing arts centers, major sporting venues, amazing concerts, fantastic foodie destinations and tons of community-centric events, and Northwest Arkansas can’t be beat!

 

In fact, U.S. News ranks Fayetteville seventh best place to live in the country!  http://realestate.usnews.com/places/arkansas/fayetteville

  

Our newsroom is forward-thinking and built on a strong emphasis of positive reinforcement, feedback, growth and development of talent, and a desire to win. We are consistently winning awards from our local audiences for our commitment to our community and our service-centered sense of duty.

 

Whether you’re looking for a place to settle in or a place to equip yourself and launch into that “big step” – we have a proven track record of providing both outcomes.

  • Communicate clearly and respectfully with management and team members.

  • Interact with viewers/users on social media sites.
  • Promote teamwork and maintain attitude of cooperation with all station personnel.

job.title: Director of Engineering, WTXL
job.description:
WTXL, the ABC affiliate in Tallahassee, Florida, owned by The E.W. Scripps Company, is searching for its next Director of Engineering. This is your opportunity to lead the technology that keeps a local television station connected, innovative, and ready to serve its community every day. You’ll guide the station’s technical operations, lead engineering initiatives, and collaborate across teams to keep critical systems performing at their best. Bring your technical expertise, leadership, and problem-solving mindset to a role where what you do behind the scenes makes an impact on everything we deliver to our audiences.

 

WHAT YOU'LL DO:


  • Model and lead a culture of empathy, customer service and leadership.
  • Lead the research, design, installation and repair of all television, digital, OTT, Internet Systems, high power RF systems, production environments and all associated equipment using current platforms and protocols. 
  • Manage building facilities and grounds, including HVAC, power generation and security systems.
  • Partner with the news department to develop, build and support content workflow and support systems including integration and problem-solving software, hardware, networking and infrastructure while facilitating a collaborative environment between newsroom and production control staff.
  • Motivate and manage a staff of professional and technical engineers, operators and IT technicians. Develop and grow staff in technology and Scripps culture to meet the on-going and future technological needs of the station and evaluate staff growth opportunities and assessments.
  • Establish and implement engineering policies and procedures.
  • Evaluate and maintain the spectrum and broadband usage of the facility.
  • Manage projects.
  • Plan, design and document current and future broadcast and digital systems.
  • Collaborate with other departments to determine current and future studio and transmission and workflow needs.
  • Prepare and track capital, expense, repair and maintenance budgets.
  • Use company purchasing management system to purchase and track assets and services as well as replacement cycles.
  • Evaluate equipment solutions.
  • Keep the station compliant with the FCC Rules and Regulations, as well as related local, state, and federal regulations.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

 

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:


  • BS/BA in related discipline or equivalent years of experience preferred
  • Generally, 10+ years of experience in related field preferred
  • Prior managerial experience preferred
  • Network, SBE and/or Project Management certification preferred

WHAT YOU'LL DO:


  • “Customer service first” mindset, ability to deliver a high level of customer service
  • Strong interpersonal skills
  • Strategic planning abilities
  • Excellent managerial skills in working with management, users, staff, peers and vendors
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills
  • Ability to relate technical matters to non-technical users
  • Ability to relate business matters to technical staff
  • Team player
  • Self-directed and can work independently
  • Strong project management skills
  • Can manage shifting priorities, demands and timelines smoothly
  • Knowledge of FCC rules
  • Understanding of electronic, electrical, mechanical and information systems
  • Keen interest in emerging broadcast related technologies and how they might be utilized in our business environment
  • Valid driver's license, good driving record, and ability to provide proof of insurance with the company required insurance limits

job.title: Assistant News Director, WEWS
job.description:
WEWS, The E.W. Scripps Company ABC affiliate in Cleveland, Ohio, is looking for an experienced and collaborative Assistant News Director to help lead one of the market's most trusted news operations. Working alongside the News Director, you will help oversee all news broadcasts and online content — shaping editorial direction, driving cross-platform audience strategies, and developing the talented team that keeps Cleveland informed. From planning landmark coverage of elections and major local events to managing the budgetary and operational heartbeat of the newsroom, your leadership will have a real and lasting impact. If you're a seasoned news leader who thrives under pressure and is passionate about delivering journalism that matters, WEWS wants to hear from you.


WHAT YOU'LL DO:


  • Assist news director with supervisory responsibility for all news broadcasts and online content.
  • Involved in hiring and performance management of direct reports.
  • Assist news director in the on-going evaluation of personnel.
  • Create tactics and strategies to increase demos performance in key target areas for multiple platforms.
  • Implement and have working knowledge of federal, state and local laws impacting operations.
  • Ability to manage cross platform content creation and distribution.
  • Write copy and edit scripts for air and web.
  • Knowledge of and proficiency in posting content to station websites.
  • Schedule anchors and multi-media journalists.
  • Lead coverage planning of major events, i. e. elections, special events.
  • Proactively communicate news initiatives across departments.
  • Evaluate workflow efficiencies.
  • Assist news director in managing the budgetary aspects of newsroom operations.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:


  • BS/BA in related discipline or equivalent years of experience preferred
  • Generally, 7+ years of experience in related field preferred
  • Prior managerial experience preferred

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:


  • Advanced oral and written communication skills
  • Advanced computer skills including Microsoft Office
  • Broad understanding of newsroom operations and equipment
  • Proven ability to manage multiple tasks in a fast paced environment

WHERE YOU'LL LIVE, WORK, AND PLAY:

Cleveland, Ohio is a city on the rise, sitting on the southern shore of Lake Erie with a rich cultural heritage and a passionate, proud community. Home to the Rock & Roll Hall of Fame, the Cleveland Museum of Art, and the world-renowned Cleveland Orchestra at Severance Music Center, the city offers an exceptional arts and culture scene. The vibrant neighborhoods of Ohio City, Tremont, and Little Italy are filled with acclaimed restaurants, craft breweries, and independent boutiques that give Cleveland its distinctive, welcoming character.


Sports are woven into the fabric of life here. Cheer on the Cleveland Guardians at Progressive Field, rally behind the Cleveland Cavaliers at Rocket Mortgage FieldHouse, or soak in the electric atmosphere of a Cleveland Browns game at Huntington Bank Field. Cleveland's passionate fan base and storied sports history make it one of the most spirited towns in the country.


Beyond downtown, Greater Cleveland delivers outstanding outdoor recreation along the shores of Lake Erie, with stunning Metroparks, world-class kayaking, and easy access to Cuyahoga Valley National Park — Ohio's only national park. With a cost of living well below most major markets, a booming food-and-drink scene, and a community that is warm and genuine, Cleveland is a place where your career and your life outside of work will both truly thrive.

job.title: Multimedia Journalist, WEWS
job.description:
WEWS News 5, The E.W. Scripps Company ABC station in Cleveland, Ohio, is looking for a Multimedia Journalist to join our award-winning newsroom. This is not an entry-level position. We are seeking a journalist who can separate us from the competition through exceptional source-building, enterprise reporting, and compelling storytelling. We want someone who knows how to uncover stories that no one else has and deliver them in a way that informs, engages, and serves our community.


Cleveland is a resilient and passionate city with a rich history, diverse neighborhoods, and a strong sense of pride. From the shores of Lake Erie and the vibrant downtown district to world-class healthcare, arts, sports, and cultural institutions, Northeast Ohio offers endless opportunities to tell meaningful stories that impact viewers' lives. WEWS News 5 has a long-standing reputation for trusted journalism, investigative reporting, innovation, and community engagement. Our newsroom is committed to helping journalists grow, develop their skills, and make a difference in the communities they serve. If you're ready to tell stories that matter and be part of a team dedicated to impactful journalism, apply today.


WHAT YOU'LL DO:


  • Receive assignments or evaluate news leads and tips to develop original story ideas.
  • Gather and verify factual information through interviews, observation, and research.
  • Organize material, determine story emphasis, and write content according to editorial standards and AP style.
  • Shoot video and still photos to illustrate stories.
  • Edit, or assist in editing, video for television, digital, social, and streaming platforms.
  • Appear on television programs while conducting interviews or providing narration.
  • Deliver live reports from the scene of breaking news and community events.
  • Work collaboratively with photographers and other newsroom staff when assigned.
  • Assist producers in preparing newscasts and coverage plans.
  • Partner with digital teams to create compelling multimedia content for all platforms.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:


  • Bachelor's degree in Broadcast Journalism, Communications, or a related field, or equivalent years of experience
  • Generally, 3+ years of professional reporting experience preferred
  • Valid driver's license, good driving record, and ability to provide proof of insurance with company-required limits

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:


  • Strong journalism skills, including enterprise reporting, source development, and storytelling
  • Proven ability to develop exclusive stories through relationship-building, public records research, and enterprise reporting that delivers meaningful impact for local communities
  • Computer literacy, including experience with newsroom content management systems
  • Videography and non-linear editing experience preferred
  • Knowledge of broadcast-quality camera equipment
  • Ability to edit video using Final Cut Pro, Adobe Premiere, or similar editing systems
  • Strong broadcast writing and AP style skills
  • Experience publishing content across digital, social, and streaming platforms
  • Self-motivated with the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment
  • Strong news judgment and a commitment to accurate, ethical journalism
  • Ability to lift up to 50 pounds

WHERE YOU'LL LIVE, WORK AND PLAY:

Cleveland, Ohio is a city on the rise, blending Midwest charm with big-city energy. Situated on the shores of Lake Erie, Cleveland offers stunning waterfront views, vibrant neighborhoods, and a thriving cultural scene. The city is home to the Rock & Roll Hall of Fame, world-renowned Cleveland Orchestra, Cleveland Museum of Art, and championship sports teams including the Guardians, Browns, and Cavaliers. Food lovers will appreciate the city's diverse culinary landscape, from historic West Side Market to innovative farm-to-table restaurants and craft breweries.


Cleveland's affordable cost of living, strong sense of community, and access to outdoor recreation—including Metro Parks, lakefront trails, and nearby Cuyahoga Valley National Park—make it an ideal place to build both your career and your life. With a revitalized downtown, diverse neighborhoods like Tremont, Ohio City, and Little Italy, and a growing tech and healthcare sector, Cleveland offers the perfect balance of professional opportunity and quality of life.

job.title: Sales and Marketing Specialist
job.description:
This Job Description May Cause Extreme Excitement and Career Growth 

At AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions, we believe a great workplace isn't just something we say — it's something you can feel when you join the team. Here, it's all about great collabs, ambition, and results but most importantly, we grow here, and we enjoy here.  We're searching for that special someone — a driven, talented individual to join our innovative media sales team. In this role, you'll engage with new and existing clients and show them how our innovative media solutions can amplify their brands and deliver measurable success. If you're energized by building relationships, closing deals, and making an impact, we'd love to hear from you. 

 

Sound like the right fit? Check out the checklist below and if it sounds like you, hit "Apply Now" and let's chat. 

 

Your Day-to-Day (aka the Playbook) 

Help Brands Thrive: 

Join our media sales team and play a pivotal role in helping brands and companies grow. By identifying new opportunities, building strong client relationships, and delivering impactful solutions, you'll showcase how our multi-media content platforms and digital assets can drive meaningful results for our partners. 

 

Your focus will be on helping clients achieve their goals, ensuring that every campaign is a success. When our clients win, we win—and we believe in celebrating those victories together! 

  

Make Connections: Embrace your powers of persuasion and make every handshake and meeting count! Every interaction is a chance to build a genuine connection and show clients how we can help them succeed. You're not just selling; you're building partnerships. You're helping businesses find the right audience in the right place at the right time. When we say One Partner, Endless Possibilities, we mean it! 

 

Be A Trusted Guide: In this role, you'll connect with clients on a human level, understand their unique needs, and craft tailored sales and marketing solutions that deliver results. As their trusted advisor, you'll help them navigate the ever-evolving marketing landscape, ensuring every step of the journey is planned with care and precision.  

 

Shake Things Up: Bring your creativity and fresh ideas to the table! We're looking for someone who challenges the status quo, embraces innovation, and finds new ways to connect with our audience. Your contributions will help elevate our brand and drive meaningful results for your clients.  

 

Join us and Conquer the Media Landscape: You'll be part of a dedicated team of A1 media sales professionals, committed to achieving market leadership. Together, we amplify our impact, deliver exceptional outcomes, and help our clients succeed in ways that truly matter. 

 

Identify Emerging Opportunities: It's about being able to see what others can't, anticipating market shifts, analyzing data and predicting the next big thing. Your insights will position our clients and AMP for long-term success.  

  

What We're Looking For 

Proven Sales Ability (or an Unstoppable Desire to Learn) 

Whether you're a seasoned sales professional or just getting started, we value your drive, energy, and passion for achieving results. 

 

Strong Communication Skills: You're a natural at building relationships and communicating effectively. Proficiency with digital tools and applications is a must. 

 

A Passion for helping Others: You're committed to understanding clients' needs, providing top-notch customer service and making a difference. You're not just selling a product; you're providing a solution.  

 

A Competitive Spirit: Do you get a little boost when you achieve a goal (especially if it was a tough one)? We love that for you (and us)!  We want someone who's driven to excel but also knows how to celebrate the victories (big and small) with their team. That drive makes you a valuable part of our organization.  

 

A Willingness to Grow: Do you thrive in environments where you're always learning something new? Excellent, you'll fit right in! The media world is constantly evolving, and the ability to learn, adapt, and embrace challenges in a fast-paced, digital-first environment is key.  

 

The Practical Stuff 

A valid driver's license, up-to-date insurance, and reliable transportation are necessary for connecting with clients in your community. 

 

Why Join AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions? / The Reasons You Should Hit "Apply Now" 

 

Serious Work, Seriously Cool People: Be part of a dynamic team that values creativity, collaboration, and fun! We are all for work that is rewarding.  

 

The Compensation Package: We offer a base salary, commission structure, and benefits package designed to support your success and well-being. Happy employees don't stage rebellions! ;) 

 

We Make a Real Difference (Not Just Talk About It): At AMP, we help local businesses thrive through advertising strategies that create tangible impacts. Our media sales specialist isn't just selling ads; they're the boots on the ground, making a real difference where it counts. (And yes, it feels pretty good.) 

 

Top-Notch Training and Support: We're not the kind of company that hires you and then disappears into the corporate abyss. We carefully select candidates for a cohort-based training program, where you'll join a group of sales professionals from all over the country. From onboarding to ongoing mentorship, we invest in your success with training programs that set you up for long-term growth. 

 

Career Growth Opportunities: We believe in investing in you. That's why you'll have access to training, mentorship, and career advancement opportunities to help you thrive. We are a leader in our industry, flexing our local charm and national muscle, providing you with options to amplify your career in your local market or join one of our AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions teams in another city.  

 

Comprehensive Media Education (We Are Your Power Source!): New to the industry? We've got you covered with training programs that turn curiosity into expertise.   

 

AMP is us. It's you. It isn't just a name; it's a mission. A promise to amplify our reach, amplify our innovation, and most importantly, amplify you. If you're ready to grow your career and help businesses achieve their goals, we'd love to hear from you.  

The base salary compensation for this role is $42,000. This position is also eligible to earn uncapped commissions of sales the employee closes that meet the definition of ‘earned." Final compensation for this role will be determined by various factors such as a candidates’ relevant work experience, skills, certifications, and geographic location. Full time positions are eligible for benefits that include participation in a retirement plan, life and disability insurance, health, dental and vision plans, flexible spending accounts, 15 paid vacation days, 2 paid personal days, 9 paid holidays, 56 hours of paid sick leave, parental leave, and employee stock purchase plan.

EEO AND INCLUSIVITY 

Sinclair is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and a drug free workplace. Employment practices will not be inﬂuenced or aﬀected by virtue of an applicant's or employee's race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, gender identity, and sexual orientation), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, military or veteran status or any other characteristic protected by law.

job.title: Senior Data Engineer
job.description:
SOBRE EL PUESTO Y EL EQUIPO

En TelevisaUnivision, somos la empresa líder mundial de medios de comunicación en español,

llegando a millones de consumidores a través de plataformas digitales, streaming, redes

sociales, audio, televisión lineal y eventos en vivo. A medida que continuamos expandiendo

nuestra plataforma global de streaming, ViX, estamos realizando importantes inversiones en

tecnología, datos e innovación para ofrecer experiencias excepcionales a nuestros suscriptores e

impulsar el crecimiento sostenible del negocio a largo plazo.

El equipo de Ingeniería de Datos (Data Engineering) diseña, desarrolla y opera pipelines de

datos de gran volumen y alta velocidad que impulsan ViX. Estos incluyen eventos de

reproducción e interacción de usuarios, datos de suscripciones, información publicitaria y el

almacén de datos analíticos (data warehouse), que permite transformar esta información en

decisiones de negocio. El equipo colabora estrechamente con las áreas de Ingeniería, Producto,

Ciencia de Datos y Analítica de TelevisaUnivision.

El Senior Data Engineer desempeñará un papel clave en el diseño, desarrollo e implementación

de nuestra plataforma de datos para streaming. Será responsable de gestionar integralmente

pipelines de datos en producción, desde la ingesta en tiempo real hasta la transformación de

datos estructurados y preparados para su análisis. Asimismo, colaborará con los equipos de

Ciencia de Datos, Analítica y Producto para comprender sus necesidades de información y llevar

las iniciativas hasta su implementación.

El candidato ideal combina sólidos conocimientos técnicos con una mentalidad colaborativa,

pasión por resolver desafíos complejos relacionados con los datos y compromiso con la entrega

de soluciones de alta calidad a gran escala.


SOBRE TI

Eres un profesional de Ingeniería de Datos que se desenvuelve con éxito en entornos dinámicos

y colaborativos, y disfruta transformando datos complejos en información de valor para el

negocio.

Cuentas con:

• Amplia experiencia en plataformas modernas de datos en la nube, especialmente

Google Cloud Platform (GCP), incluyendo BigQuery, Pub/Sub, Dataflow y Cloud

Composer.

• Dominio avanzado de Python, SQL y frameworks de transformación de datos como dbt.

• Experiencia práctica en el desarrollo de pipelines de datos a gran escala, tanto por lotes

(batch) como en tiempo real (streaming).

• Experiencia trabajando con sistemas distribuidos a gran escala y tecnologías de Big Data,

incluyendo Spark y Hadoop.

• Experiencia con herramientas de Infraestructura como Código (IaC), como Pulumi o

Terraform.

• Excelentes habilidades de resolución de problemas y capacidad para diseñar soluciones

escalables y eficientes.

• Gran atención al detalle y capacidad para gestionar múltiples prioridades de manera

efectiva.

• Excelentes habilidades de comunicación y colaboración, con capacidad para trabajar con

equipos técnicos y no técnicos.

• Mentalidad de mejora continua y pasión por la mentoría y el intercambio de

conocimientos.


RESPONSABILIDADES DEL DÍA A DÍA

Desarrollo de la plataforma de datos

• Diseñar, desarrollar y mantener pipelines de datos por lotes (batch) escalables,

confiables y eficientes utilizando Airflow (Cloud Composer), Python, SQL y dbt.

• Desarrollar y mantener pipelines de ingesta de datos en tiempo real que permitan

transferir datos de eventos desde Pub/Sub hacia Cloud Storage y BigQuery mediante

Dataflow.

• Desarrollar y optimizar modelos dimensionales de datos y flujos de trabajo dentro del

almacén de datos analíticos (data warehouse) para respaldar iniciativas de reportes,

analítica, Machine Learning y Producto.

• Gestionar integralmente los pipelines asignados, desde su diseño y desarrollo hasta las

pruebas, implementación y soporte en producción.

• Garantizar la calidad, integridad, seguridad y disponibilidad de los datos en todo el

ecosistema.

Colaboración multifuncional

• Colaborar con Gerentes de Producto, Científicos de Datos, Analistas y equipos de

Ingeniería para comprender los requerimientos del negocio y traducirlos en soluciones

técnicas.

• Contribuir a las discusiones sobre arquitectura de datos y a la estrategia de largo plazo

de la plataforma.

• Trabajar con las distintas partes interesadas para identificar oportunidades de mejora de

procesos y eficiencia operativa.

Rendimiento y optimización

• Optimizar el almacenamiento, procesamiento y orquestación de datos para mejorar el

rendimiento, la escalabilidad y la eficiencia de costos, incluyendo los costos de consultas

y almacenamiento en BigQuery.

• Monitorear, diagnosticar y resolver problemas relacionados con los pipelines y la

plataforma de datos, así como contribuir a las revisiones de incidentes.

• Implementar mejores prácticas de gobierno de datos, observabilidad, pruebas e

integración y entrega continuas (CI/CD).

Liderazgo y contribución al equipo

• Brindar mentoría y apoyo a ingenieros de datos junior mediante orientación técnica,

revisiones de código e intercambio de conocimientos.

• Contribuir a las decisiones arquitectónicas y a la definición de mejores prácticas de

ingeniería.

• Participar en entrevistas técnicas y apoyar el desarrollo de un equipo de Ingeniería de

Datos de alto desempeño.


REQUISITOS Y EXPERIENCIA

Experiencia y habilidades requeridas

• Licenciatura o maestría en Ciencias de la Computación, Ingeniería, Sistemas de

Información o un campo técnico relacionado.

• Más de 7 años de experiencia en Ingeniería de Datos, Data Warehousing o entornos de

Big Data.

• Dominio avanzado de Python y SQL.

• Experiencia práctica en el desarrollo y gestión integral de pipelines de datos de nivel

productivo, desde su diseño hasta su operación.

• Amplia experiencia con Google Cloud Platform (GCP), incluyendo BigQuery, Cloud

Storage, Pub/Sub, Dataflow y Cloud Composer. También se considerará experiencia con

AWS.

• Experiencia con herramientas de orquestación de flujos de trabajo y transformación de

datos, como Airflow y dbt.

• Experiencia en el desarrollo de pipelines de datos en tiempo real o casi en tiempo real.

• Sólido conocimiento de las mejores prácticas de almacenamiento de datos (data

warehousing), incluyendo modelado relacional y dimensional.

• Experiencia con herramientas de Infraestructura como Código (IaC), como Pulumi o

Terraform.

• Sólido conocimiento de frameworks de procesamiento distribuido de datos, incluyendo

Spark.

• Fuertes habilidades analíticas, de diagnóstico y resolución de problemas.

Requisitos deseables

• Experiencia brindando soporte a flujos de trabajo de Machine Learning y Ciencia de

Datos.

• Familiaridad con herramientas de observabilidad de datos, frameworks de calidad de

datos y prácticas de integración y entrega continuas (CI/CD).

• Experiencia trabajando en organizaciones de suscripción, medios de comunicación,

plataformas de streaming o productos digitales.


REQUISITOS DE ELEGIBILIDAD

• Disponibilidad para trabajar en Santa Fe, Ciudad de México.

• Se verificará la experiencia laboral y académica.

Univision es un empleador que ofrece equidad e igualdad de oportunidades. Todos los solicitantes calificados recibirán consideración para el empleo sin distinción de sexo, identidad de género, orientación sexual, raza, color, religión, origen nacional, discapacidad, estado de veterano protegido, edad o cualquier otra característica protegida por la ley.

decisiones de negocio. El equipo colabora estrechamente con las áreas de Ingeniería, Producto,

Ciencia de Datos y Analítica de TelevisaUnivision.

arquitectónicas de largo plazo, la capacidad de influir y alinear equipos sin autoridad jerárquica

Eres un líder técnico con experiencia práctica que diseña plataformas completas, no solo

pipelines de datos. Te sientes igualmente cómodo desarrollando código para entornos de

producción, defendiendo decisiones arquitectónicas durante revisiones de diseño, colaborando

con ingenieros junior para resolver problemas complejos y explicando las ventajas y desventajas

de distintas soluciones a líderes ejecutivos.

especialmente BigQuery, Pub/Sub, Dataflow (Apache Beam), Cloud Composer y Cloud

Storage.

• Amplia experiencia en el diseño de arquitecturas en tiempo real y orientadas a eventos,

incluyendo semánticas de procesamiento exactamente una vez (exactly-once), manejo

de datos que llegan con retraso y evolución de esquemas.

• Dominio avanzado de Python y SQL, así como de frameworks de transformación de

datos como dbt.

• Experiencia comprobada definiendo la dirección técnica de plataformas utilizadas por

múltiples equipos y liderando su implementación a lo largo de varios trimestres.

• Experiencia con herramientas de Infraestructura como Código (IaC), como Pulumi o

Terraform.

• Excelentes habilidades de resolución de problemas y capacidad para diseñar soluciones

escalables y eficientes.

• Gran atención al detalle y capacidad para gestionar múltiples prioridades de manera

efectiva.

• Excelentes habilidades de comunicación y colaboración, con capacidad para trabajar con

equipos técnicos y no técnicos.

• Mentalidad de mejora continua y pasión por la mentoría y el intercambio de

conocimientos.

• Interés genuino en desarrollar ingenieros junior y fomentar una cultura de ingeniería

sólida.


RESPONSABILIDADES DEL DÍA A DÍA

Arquitectura de la plataforma de datos, desarrollo y estrategia técnica

• Desarrollar implementaciones de referencia, frameworks y bibliotecas reutilizables que

puedan ser adoptadas por otros ingenieros, incluyendo plantillas de ingesta de datos,

patrones de dbt y Airflow, y módulos de IaC en Pulumi.

• Liderar el diseño de pipelines de datos en tiempo real utilizando Pub/Sub y Dataflow,

incluyendo esquemas de eventos, registros y evolución de esquemas, procesamiento

exactly-once, gestión de marcas de tiempo (watermarking) y manejo de datos que llegan

con retraso.

• Gestionar integralmente los pipelines asignados, desde su diseño y desarrollo hasta las

pruebas, implementación y soporte en producción.

• Garantizar la calidad, integridad, seguridad y disponibilidad de los datos en todo el

ecosistema.

Colaboración multifuncional

• Colaborar con Gerentes de Producto, Científicos de Datos, Analistas y equipos de

Ingeniería para comprender los requerimientos del negocio y traducirlos en soluciones

técnicas.

• Contribuir a las discusiones sobre arquitectura de datos y a la estrategia de largo plazo

de la plataforma.

• Trabajar con las distintas partes interesadas para identificar oportunidades de mejora de

procesos y eficiencia operativa.

Rendimiento y optimización

• Optimizar el almacenamiento, procesamiento y orquestación de datos para mejorar el

rendimiento, la escalabilidad y la eficiencia de costos, incluyendo los costos de consultas

y almacenamiento en BigQuery.

• Monitorear, diagnosticar y resolver problemas relacionados con los pipelines y la

plataforma de datos, así como contribuir a las revisiones de incidentes.

• Implementar mejores prácticas de gobierno de datos, observabilidad, pruebas e

integración y entrega continuas (CI/CD).

• Liderar la respuesta ante incidentes graves relacionados con los datos, realizar análisis

posteriores a incidentes sin atribución de culpas (blameless postmortems) e impulsar

soluciones estructurales para prevenir su recurrencia.

Liderazgo y contribución al equipo

• Brindar mentoría y apoyo a ingenieros de datos junior mediante orientación técnica,

revisiones de código e intercambio de conocimientos.

• Contribuir a las decisiones arquitectónicas y a la definición de mejores prácticas de

ingeniería.

• Participar en entrevistas técnicas y apoyar el desarrollo de un equipo de Ingeniería de

Datos de alto desempeño.

• Evaluar e impulsar la adopción de tecnologías emergentes, incluyendo flujos de trabajo

de ingeniería asistidos por inteligencia artificial y herramientas de datos basadas en

modelos de lenguaje de gran tamaño (LLM), manteniendo altos estándares de calidad y

seguridad.


REQUISITOS Y EXPERIENCIA

Experiencia y habilidades requeridas

• Licenciatura o maestría en Ciencias de la Computación, Ingeniería, Sistemas de

Información o un campo técnico relacionado, o experiencia equivalente.

Big Data.

junior e intermedio.

real y de gran volumen en entornos de producción, por ejemplo, plataformas que

Job Summary: Job Requirements “We Power the Magic!” That’s our motto at Disney Experiences (DX). Our team creates world-class immersive digital experiences for the Company’s premier vacation brands including Disney’s Parks & Resorts worldwide, Disney Cruise Line, Aulani, a Disney Resort & Spa, and Disney Vacation Club. We are responsible for the end-to-end digital and physical Guest experience for all technology & digital-led initiatives across the Attractions & Entertainment, Food & Beverage, Resorts & Transportation and Merchandise lines of business as well as other initiatives including MyDisneyExperience and Hey, Disney! This role sits in the WDW Entitlements Software Engineering organization within Technology & Digital for Disney Experiences. It works closely with Product Management, Park Operations, and Guest-facing ticketing and admissions teams from across the company. The Lead Software Engineer will report to the Manager, Software Engineering. About the Role & Team This team develops and supports the high-volume entitlements and ticketing platforms that power guest admission, tickets, and passes across Walt Disney World. As a Lead Software Engineer, you will primarily focus on backend development, designing and building scalable, high-performance systems that support millions of guest transactions while ensuring reliability, security, and operational excellence. What You’ll Do: Lead the design, development, testing, and implementation of backend applications and services. Build and enhance scalable APIs, microservices, and distributed systems supporting admission and ticketing platforms. Drive technical solutions for complex, high-throughput, customer-facing applications. Partner with stakeholders to define requirements and deliver innovative software solutions. Mentor engineers, provide technical leadership, and support Agile delivery practices. Participate in on-call support and major release activities to ensure system stability. Required Qualifications 7+ years of software engineering experience with a strong focus on backend development. Expertise in Java, J2EE, Spring Boot, RESTful APIs, and Microservices Architecture . Hands-on experience with SQL Server, Oracle, and MongoDB . Experience building and supporting large-scale, high-availability enterprise applications. Strong understanding of cloud-based architectures and Agile development methodologies. Experience with AWS and/or Azure environments. Excellent problem-solving, debugging, and technical leadership skills. Preferred Qualifications Experience with high-volume ticketing, admissions, entitlement, or transaction-processing systems. Familiarity with DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud-native application development. Experience integrating with POS, CRM, or operational systems. Scrum Master or other Agile certifications are a plus. Familiarity with AI technologies and concepts, including generative AI, large language models (LLMs), prompt engineering, and AI integration with enterprise applications. Experience reverse-engineering complex existing codebases to understand business logic, dependencies, and system behavior in support of troubleshooting, documentation, and modernization. Required Education : Bachelor's or foreign equivalent Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Software, Electrical or Electronics Engineering, or comparable field of study, and/or equivalent work experience #techatdisney Disclaimer PAY TRANSPARENCY The hiring range for this position in Orlando, FL is $150,500 to $201,800 per year. The base pay actually offered will take into account internal equity and also may vary depending on the candidate’s geographic region, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience among other factors. A bonus and/or long-term incentive units may be provided as part of the compensation package, in addition to the full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits, dependent on the level and position offered. job.description: Keywords Location Search Jobs Logistics Analyst I Job ID 10162716 Location Bristol, Connecticut, United States Business Disney Entertainment and ESPN Product & Technology Date posted Oct. 21, 2026 Logistics Analyst I Apply Now Save Job SHARE Facebook LinkedIn Email WhatsApp Links open in new tabs. Job Summary: Job Requirements About the Role & Team Disney Entertainment and ESPN Product & Technology Technology is at the heart of Disney’s past, present, and future. Disney Entertainment and ESPN Product & Technology is a global organization of engineers, product developers, designers, technologists, data scientists, and more – all working to build and advance the technological backbone for Disney’s media business globally. The team marries technology with creativity to build world-class products, enhance storytelling, and drive velocity, innovation, and scalability for our businesses. We are Storytellers and Innovators. Creators and Builders. Entertainers and Engineers. We work with every part of The Walt Disney Company’s media portfolio to advance the technological foundation and consumer media touch points serving millions of people around the world. Here are a few reasons why we think you’d love working here: 1. Building the future of Disney’s media : Our Technologists are designing and building the products and platforms that will power our media, advertising, and distribution businesses for years to come. 2. Reach, Scale & Impact : More than ever, Disney’s technology and products serve as a signature doorway for fans' connections with the company’s brands and stories. Disney+. Hulu. ESPN. ABC. ABC News…and many more. These products and brands – and the unmatched stories, storytellers, and events they carry – matter to millions of people globally. 3. Innovation: We develop and implement groundbreaking products and techniques that shape industry norms and solve complex and distinctive technical problems. The Business Operations team helps guide and articulate technology strategy and research and is responsible for driving the day-to-day operation of the Product & Technology organization, including: project and portfolio management and tracking; organization-level capital, space, and resource management and allocation; process management; technical incident management; and our administrative and workplace experience support team. What You Will Do: The Logistics Center (LC) is an integral part of the Technology landscape. Technology and many other departments/teams across the company utilize the Logistics Center and our services daily. The Logistics Analyst is deeply involved in the processes that maintain the financial, contractual, compliance and asset management requirements defined by Disney policy. Responsibilities and Duties of the Role: • Coordinates all phases of material logistics including receiving, shipping, material handling, tagging, storage and asset management to ensure timely and accurate handling of the financial assets of the company. • Manages and assures material inventories are coordinated throughout Technology, while providing accurate information about the stored financial assets. • Scans and audits deployed technology assets across the Bristol campus to verify asset location, maintain inventory accuracy, and ensure compliance with company asset management policies. • Prepares commercial invoices for international shipments of company assets in compliance with Disney policy. • Receives goods, verifies accuracy and condition, and completes goods receipt transactions in SAP, Coupa, Maximo, and ServiceNow. • Stages and releases client-requested items and completes transactions in SAP, Coupa, Maximo and Service Now. • Supports Disney Finance team by assisting with financial asset reports and by verifying SAP, Coupa, Maximo and Service Now financial record information. • Develops and maintains short term/long term approaches in concert with stakeholders for inventory retention, asset management and equipment disposal that ensure accuracy and transactional integrity. • Provides Item Master entries and approvals in Maximo and Coupa. • Supports clients by identifying damaged items, shortages, and mis-shipments, returning refused products while informing vendors and management of each issue. • Creates and completes inventory audits, inventory tracking reports and recycling/disposal documentation for stored financial assets. • Maintains a casual buyer role in SAP and Coupa. • Supports the Maximo, Coupa and Service Now integrations through feedback, training and liaising with the application support teams and end users. • Utilizes specialized packaging equipment to ship high value and sensitive equipment. • Resolves problems with the order and delivery process, working closely with others in Technology. • Assures that defective equipment and return materials authorizations (RMA) are complete, accurate and appropriately communicated. • Responsible for accurate, neat and safe storage of materials, optimizing product and location dimensions to maximize storage capacity. • Works with Technology stakeholders and clients to provide product ordering and receipt information. • Picks inventory and packages products for loading and shipping. • Identifies and assists in implementing Logistics Center workflow and process efficiencies. • Assists in daily Logistics Center workflow and operational continuity in the absence of management. • Orders and maintains inventory of all Logistics Center operational supplies to ensure uninterrupted business operations. • Serves as the Maximo Administrator for all Logistics Center functions, including Maximo, Coupa system administration, user support, process improvements and data integrity. • Works independently with minimal supervisory review. • Expedites receipt of critical orders and monitors material deliveries in accordance with project schedules. • Updates and maintains Maximo inventory tracking. Required Qualifications & Skills: • General work or internship experience. • Proven knowledge of inventory control and distribution. • Working knowledge of asset management and asset lifecycles. • Experienced & effective in client and vendor issue resolution. • Advanced understanding of shipping & receiving practices. • Strong communication skills. • Strong organizational skills. • Ability to lift 75 pounds. Preferred Qualifications: • Advanced understanding of Maximo, Coupa goods receipt processes. • High-level understanding of the Maximo and Service Now software applications. • Experience in electrostatic discharge (ESD) handling of electronic assets. Education • Bachelor's Degree or equivalent training or work experience. Disclaimer PAY TRANSPARENCY The hiring range for this position in Bristol, CT is $59,800 to $82,100 per year based on a 40 hour work week. The amount of hours scheduled per week may vary based on business needs. The base pay actually offered will take into account internal equity and also may vary depending on the candidate’s geographic region, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience among other factors. A bonus and/or long-term incentive units may be provided as part of the compensation package, in addition to the full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits, dependent on the level and position offered. job.description: Keywords Location Search Jobs Analyst, Digital Media Strategy Job ID 10162434 Location Buenos Aires, Argentina Business The Walt Disney Company (LATAM) Date posted Oct. 21, 2026 Analyst, Digital Media Strategy Apply Now Save Job SHARE Facebook LinkedIn Email WhatsApp Links open in new tabs. Job Summary: Job Requirements BUILD SOMETHING BIGGER THAN YOURSELF The Walt Disney Company, together with its subsidiaries and affiliates, is a leading diversified international family entertainment and media enterprise with the following business segments: Disney Entertainment, ESPN, Disney Parks, and Experiences and Products. From humble beginnings as a cartoon studio in the 1920s to its preeminent name in the entertainment industry today, Disney proudly continues its legacy of creating world-class stories and experiences for every member of the family. Disney’s stories, characters and experiences reach consumers and guests from every corner of the globe. With operations in more than 40 countries, our employees and cast members work together to create entertainment experiences that are both universally and locally cherished. How will you contribute to our magical experience? The Analyst, Digital Media Strategy will be responsible for the digital campaigns, focusing on performance purposes. Also branding, to meet the company's defined business objectives. The Analyst, Digital Media Strategy will be responsible for: Act as the primary point of contact between business partners and the Digital Paid Agencie, ensuring the translation of each line of business objectives into achievable digital metrics. Develop digital media plans that take full advantage of the features available on each buying platform, as well as the digital assets available to each business partner. The focus of the role will be on developing conversion campaigns. Monitor campaign execution through the Digital Paid Agencies, suggest improvements or modifications to campaign operators, and monitor the impact of these modifications maintaining an analytical perspective and make data-driven decisions. Provide campaign performance information and reporting to different areas of the company in a consistent and comparable manner. Have focus on platform updates and new market opportunities. What we need from you to be part of this story: 2+ years of experience in digital media planning, platform optimization, and comprehensive reporting for performance-driven and conversion-focused campaigns. Hands-on experience in managing and optimizing campaigns across key social platforms, including Meta (Facebook/Instagram), TikTok, X (formerly Twitter), as well as DV360 campaigns and programmatic buying via DSPs (Demand Side Platforms). Strong understanding of pixel implementation, custom conversions, and event tracking across platforms like Meta, TikTok, Google, and X, ensuring accurate campaign measurement and performance tracking. (Experience with these tools is a plus). Advanced proficiency in English (spoken and written) is a plus, enabling smooth communication in a dynamic, global environment. Data-driven profile, able to turn insights into actionable recommendations and communicate them clearly and concisely, both verbally and in writing. Agile and tailored approach to business needs. Additional Information: At Disney, we believe it takes great people to create the memorable experiences, products and services our consumers know and love. We are a team of storytellers and hire under equal opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, disability and gender identity. We foster a corporate culture of belonging and inclusiveness, which empowers our staff and company to thrive. At Disney, everyone has the opportunity to speak up and participate, grow and share ideas. “You can design and create, and build the most wonderful place in the world. But it takes people to make the dream a reality.” Walt Disney. Disclaimer This position is with TWDC Argentina S.A., which is part of a business we call The Walt Disney Company (LATAM). From humble beginnings as a cartoon studio in the 1920s to its preeminent name in the entertainment industry today, Disney proudly continues its legacy of creating world-class stories and experiences for every member of the family. Disney’s stories, characters and experiences reach consumers and guests from every corner of the globe. With operations in more than 40 countries, our employees and cast members work together to create entertainment experiences that are both universally and locally cherished. How will you contribute to our magical experience? This role will be responsible for understanding the current portfolio and competitive landscape, creating and monitoring portfolio recommendations based on our own performance data and market data and ensuring alignment between Product and Biz Ops on initiative feasibility. The role will document and benchmark the portfolio on an ongoing basis, evaluate the impact of proposed changes, and translate insights into clear, actionable recommendations that support decision-making and drive differentiation. The Senior Analyst, Disney+ Portfolio Strategy will be responsible for: Monitor and document the portfolio (tiers, plans, content, perks, channels, sports rights) and perform portfolio benchmarking across SVOD and other industries. Monitor Disney+ portfolio KPIs (tier mix, upgrade/downgrade, ad fill rate, etc.) as well as competitor performance and market drivers, continuously assessing the company's own ability to compete. Navigate existing dashboards with agility, pull and cross-reference tables from different sources, and track the health of the tier mix, acquisition/retention, upgrade/downgrade, feature usage, and Disney+ content consumption, monitoring tier mix by channel and country. Develop portfolio improvement and change recommendations that contribute to differentiation, including new bundles and new add-ons. Lead research requests to evaluate proposed changes, run impact modeling, and evaluate the impact of proposed initiatives. Identify and translate business insights (market, consumer, and product) into clear, actionable inputs for the financial modeling and sizing of initiatives, in coordination with Finance. Ensure feasibility of initiatives, maintaining a fluent relationship with Legals, PMO / Product / Commerce. What we need from you to be part of this story: 3+ years of experience in Data Analytics, Market/Consumer Insights, Finance, or similar roles. Bachelor’s degree in business administration, Economics, Industrial Engineering, Marketing, Statistics, or related fields. Advanced level in English. Experience working in data-driven environments, driving decision-making through data. High numeracy and analytical rigor, attention to detail. Agility reading and interpreting existing dashboards (Looker), pulling tables, and cross-referencing information from multiple sources. Building dashboards from scratch is not required, but comfort navigating BI tools is essential. Ability to turn portfolio and competitive data into clear opportunities and insights, and from there into concrete recommendations. Experience with competitive benchmarking across SVOD and other industries. Ability to evaluate the feasibility and impact of proposed initiatives, and to translate that evaluation into clear inputs for modeling, without needing to run the model itself. Excellent stakeholder management, with experience working closely with PMO, Product, and Business Operations teams. Curiosity and a critical eye for industry trends and competitor moves. Strong communication skills to present findings and recommendations to stakeholders, including Finance and Product. Additional Information: At Disney, we believe it takes great people to create memorable experiences, products and services our consumers know and love. We are a team of storytellers and hire under equal opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, disability and gender identity. We foster a corporate culture of belonging and inclusiveness, which empowers our staff and company to thrive. At Disney, everyone has the opportunity to speak up and participate, grow and share ideas. “You can design and create and build the most wonderful place in the world. But it takes people to make the dream a reality.” Walt Disney Disclaimer This position is with TWDC Argentina S.A., which is part of a business we call The Walt Disney Company (LATAM). Streaming Media Assistant Apply Now Save Job SHARE Facebook LinkedIn Email WhatsApp Links open in new tabs. Job Summary: Job Requirements Overview Disney Streaming is responsible for developing and operating The Walt Disney Company's direct-to-consumer video businesses globally, including the ESPN+ premium sports streaming service; Star+ which brings live sports and general entertainment exclusively to the Latin America region; and Disney+, the dedicated streaming home for entertainment from Disney, Pixar, Marvel, Star Wars, National Geographic. Our core mission is to deliver global audiences the freedom to access content on their terms across any connected device, time or location. We serve consumers by bringing the world's most beloved characters, timeless stories, legendary athletes, and epic sporting events to global audiences through best-in-class direct-to-consumer video services. We strive daily to imaginatively challenge convention with innovative technology that gives consumers the freedom to access content on their terms across any connected device, time or location. The Media Operations Department at Disney Streaming Services consists of agile and responsive teams of technicians that perform the daily processes and procedures of our live and on-demand streaming video products. The department's responsibilities consist of round-the-clock support for these products, ensuring proper functionality across all platforms. The Streaming Media Assistant is part of a streaming Media Operations team staffed 24/7. SMA's routinely provide live, hands-on operational and procedural support for our partner products, including system health monitoring and incident management , in addition to live and VOD streaming media orchestration using proprietary software . Responsibilities Basic Qualifications: · Must be available to work flexible hours, including nights, weekends, and holidays. · Strong understanding of computers and applications. · Must have an exemplary attention to detail. · Must possess strong communication skills, including written and verbal. · Must possess solid organizational skills. · Must be able to learn quickly and adapt to new situations. · Must have a strong ability to multitask and work in a fast-paced, time-sensitive environment. Preferred Qualifications: · A solid computer and technical background, with experience working in digital media and online organizations. · Familiarity with streaming and broadcast media, particularly HTTP Live Streaming (HLS) · A team player who is enthusiastic with a strong work ethic. · Ability to troubleshoot efficiently. · 1+ years of relevant working experience.
