job.title: Manager, Product Software Engineer
job.description: Keywords Location Search Jobs Manager, Product Software Engineer Job ID 10162722 Location Glendale, California, United States Business Disney Entertainment and ESPN Product & Technology Date posted Oct. 21, 2026 Manager, Product Software Engineer Apply Now Save Job SHARE Facebook LinkedIn Email WhatsApp Links open in new tabs. Job Summary: Job Requirements Technology is at the heart of Disney’s past, present, and future. Disney Entertainment and ESPN Product & Technology is a global organization of engineers, product developers, designers, technologists, data scientists, and more – all working to build and advance the technological backbone for Disney’s media business globally. The team marries technology with creativity to build world-class products, enhance storytelling, and drive velocity, innovation, and scalability for our businesses. We are Storytellers and Innovators. Creators and Builders. Entertainers and Engineers. We work with every part of The Walt Disney Company’s media portfolio to advance the technological foundation and consumer media touch points serving millions of people around the world. Here are a few reasons why we think you’d love working here: Building the future of Disney’s media: Our Technologists are designing and building the products and platforms that will power our media, advertising, and distribution businesses for years to come. Reach, Scale & Impact: More than ever, Disney’s technology and products serve as a signature doorway for fans' connections with the company’s brands and stories. Disney+. Hulu. ESPN. ABC. ABC News…and many more. These products and brands – and the unmatched stories, storytellers, and events they carry – matter to millions of people globally. Innovation: We develop and implement groundbreaking products and techniques that shape industry norms, and solve complex and distinctive technical problems. The Advertising Platforms team is responsible for the development and ongoing advancement of the technical and operational functions that power the sale, management, and delivery of advertising across Disney's media properties. This includes the self-service tools that put campaign creation, targeting, and optimization directly into the hands of our advertisers. The global team also plays a critical role as the primary collaboration point for Product & Technology with Disney's advertising sales, operations, and regional business teams. Job Summary We are the team behind Disney Campaign Manager , Disney's self-service advertising application, with a mission to empower advertisers of every size to plan, launch, and optimize campaigns across Disney's premier media portfolio. Disney Campaign Manager is part of the Disney Entertainment & ESPN Technology segment which is responsible for The Walt Disney Company's direct-to-consumer businesses globally, including the ESPN+ sports streaming service, programmed in conjunction with ESPN; Disney+, the Disney-branded direct-to-consumer streaming service; global advertising sales and ad technology for all of Disney's media properties, including ABC, ESPN, Freeform, FX Networks, National Geographic and the Disney Channels; Hotstar, the leading over-the-top streaming service in India; and the Company's majority ownership stake in Hulu. As the Manager, Product Software Engineer on our team, you will be responsible for leading several a team of full stack developers working across varying projects to build and scale Disney Campaign Manager, our customer-facing self-service advertising platform. This is a full stack role: your teams own everything from the customer-facing web experience through the backend services and APIs that power it, and you are expected to be conversant across the entire stack. As their leader, you will mentor and guide, as well as assist in the tactical execution at the ground level. You are still expected to have a deep understanding of the technology we build, and the tools we use to do so. You will participate in code reviews and help with larger architectural decision making, while also managing the operations of your teams. Because this is a product our advertisers interact with directly, you will keep the customer experience — usability, performance, reliability, and trust — at the center of every decision. Responsibilities Responsible for software engineering leadership and direction across the customer-facing self-service experience (campaign creation, audience targeting, creative setup, budgeting, and optimization workflows). Responsible for software engineering leadership and direction across the platform and integration services that power Campaign Manager (ad serving and delivery integrations, external APIs, reporting and measurement pipelines, and supporting infrastructure). Be accountable for the performance and results of a single team of software engineers. Make decisions and provide leadership in high pressure and time sensitive situations, guided by resource availability and functional objectives. Facilitate communication and healthy collaboration between your team and the product, design, marketing, QA and business teams we work closely with. Exhibit expert knowledge to analyze the intricacies of complex technical challenges; stay informed of industry innovations; provide new perspectives on existing solutions. Work closely with your project management counterparts to manage team timelines and resourcing. Mentor and grow the careers of managers and senior engineers. Help with software design and review and approve software architecture and development plans for new and complex products and features. Minimum Qualifications 8+ years of experience building complex platform applications at scale or other relevant experience. Passion for leadership and relationship building across cross-functional teams. Hands on full stack development experience, spanning a modern front-end stack (React, TypeScript, and Next.js) and Java or Node backend systems. Experience designing and operating REST APIs within a microservices architecture. Experience with both relational (e.g., PostgreSQL/MySQL) and NoSQL data stores, along with caching layers (e.g., Redis) to meet performance needs. Experience delivering platform services on AWS using open-source technologies. Experience building and operating customer-facing applications at scale, with strong instincts for performance, reliability, and observability. Ability to make decisions about technical best practices and your team's operational process. Be practical and personable with strong communication and writing skills. Good understanding of agile software development methodologies. Experience building multiple concurrent projects of high technical complexity. Preferred Qualifications 10 years of experience leading teams of software engineers building complex applications at scale. Industry experience building customer-facing SaaS or self-service web applications. Experience with advertising technology, campaign management, or ad-serving/programmatic ecosystems. Experience with reporting, measurement, and data visualization for end users. Depth in both front-end and backend architecture design, with the ability to guide technical decisions across the full stack. Familiarity with server-side rendering and front-end performance optimization (e.g., Next.js) for high-traffic, customer-facing applications. Required Education Bachelor's degree in computer science, Engineering, or related field or equivalent experience demonstrating an expert level understanding of software development and infrastructure. #disneytech Disclaimer PAY TRANSPARENCY The hiring range for this position in Glendale, CA is $174,100 to $233,500 per year.The base pay actually offered will take into account internal equity and also may vary depending on the candidate’s geographic region, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience among other factors. A bonus and/or long-term incentive units may be provided as part of the compensation package, in addition to the full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits, dependent on the level and position offered. This position is with Disney Entertainment & Sports LLC, which is part of a business we call Disney Entertainment and ESPN Product & Technology. To learn more about Disney's guidelines on the use of AI for candidates, click here. Disney Entertainment & Sports LLC is an equal opportunity employer. Applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Disney champions a business environment where ideas and decisions from all people help us grow, innovate, create the best stories and be relevant in a constantly evolving world. DISABILITY ACCOMMODATION FOR EMPLOYMENT APPLICATIONS The Walt Disney Company and its Affiliated Companies are Equal Employment Opportunity employers and welcome all job seekers including individuals with disabilities and veterans with disabilities. If you have a disability and believe you need a reasonable accommodation in order to search for a job opening or apply for a position, visit the Disney candidate disability accommodations FAQs . We will only respond to those requests that are related to the accessibility of the online application system due to a disability. Having technical issues? View the FAQs for help. From humble beginnings as a cartoon studio in the 1920s to its preeminent name in the entertainment industry today, Disney proudly continues its legacy of creating world-class stories and experiences for every member of the family. Disney’s stories, characters and experiences reach consumers and guests from every corner of the globe. With operations in more than 40 countries, our employees and cast members work together to create entertainment experiences that are both universally and locally cherished. job.description: Keywords Location Search Jobs ABC News Audience Engagement Intern, Spring 2027 Job ID 10163290 Location New York, New York, United States Business Disney Entertainment Television Date posted Oct. 21, 2026 ABC News Audience Engagement Intern, Spring 2027 Apply Now Save Job SHARE Facebook LinkedIn Email WhatsApp Links open in new tabs. Job Summary: About the Role & Program The ABC News Audience Development team is responsible for creating, distributing, curating, and optimizing ABC News content across digital platforms, including ABCNews.com, mobile apps, major social media platforms, search, video, and other distribution channels. The team plays a critical role in connecting audiences with breaking news and original journalism while identifying opportunities to grow engagement across existing and emerging platforms. As an Audience Development Intern, you will gain hands-on experience at the intersection of journalism, audience strategy, analytics, and digital storytelling. Working alongside experienced audience development professionals, you will learn how editorial judgment, data insights, and experimentation help drive audience growth and engagement. The ideal candidate is passionate about news and current events, follows digital media trends, and is interested in understanding how audiences discover and consume content across platforms. This internship is a full-time, six-month commitment in the New York, New York area from January 2027 - June 2027 What You Will Do On any given day, you will support audience development initiatives across ABC News digital platforms, including ABCNews.com, mobile apps, search, social media, video, and other distribution channels. You will help curate content experiences across owned platforms, support audience growth strategies, and assist in distributing content to external partners to help maximize visibility during major news events. You will contribute to headline testing efforts, monitor news, search, and social trends, and help identify emerging platforms, formats, and audience behaviors. This role offers the opportunity to strengthen editorial judgment, analytical thinking, collaboration, and digital storytelling skills while gaining exposure to how data and audience insights inform content strategy. Required Qualifications & Skills Experience with journalism, news reporting, news production, digital media, or content creation through coursework, internships, campus media, or related projects. Understanding of the 24/7 news cycle, current events, and breaking news coverage. Demonstrated writing and editing skills through coursework, internships, campus media, or published content samples. Experience using social media platforms, digital publishing tools, or content distribution channels through academic, extracurricular, internship, or personal projects. Familiarity with audience metrics, analytics, or data-informed decision-making through coursework, projects, or prior experience. Ability to manage multiple assignments, meet deadlines, and collaborate effectively in a fast-paced environment. Preferred Qualifications & Skills Experience conducting research or analyzing audience, engagement, or content performance data. Familiarity with social media management, content publishing, or audience analytics tools. Experience creating content for digital, social, or campus media platforms. Experience working in a newsroom, media organization, student publication, or related environment. Familiarity with SEO, headline writing, or audience engagement strategies. Interest in emerging digital platforms and evolving audience consumption behaviors. Education Junior or Senior year preferred. Major or coursework in Journalism, Broadcast Journalism, Communications, Digital Media, Media Studies, Marketing, or a related field preferred. Eligibility Requirements & Program Information Candidates for this opportunity MUST meet all of the below requirements: Be enrolled in an accredited college/university pursuing a degree taking at least one class at time of application OR currently participating in a Disney College Program or Disney Internship. Current Disney Interns, College, International, or Culinary Program Participants: You may only work for ONE consecutive year (12 months) in any combination of an internship and/or program. Be at least 18 years of age Possess unrestricted work authorization Additional Information Able to have a consistent, reliable work schedule throughout the internship Fully available from January 2027 through June 2027 Fully available from Monday through Friday, 40 hours each week Able to provide own housing for the duration of the internship program in the New York, New York area Able to provide/have reliable transportation to/from work in the New York, New York area Materials Requested: A portfolio review is required for this position. For full consideration, please include a link to your portfolio on your résumé. Applications without a portfolio link on the résumé will not be considered a completed application packet and may not be fully considered for the position. Please visit our support site or additional information. The pay rate for this role in New York is $23.00 per hour. Select benefits may be provided as part of the compensation package, such as medical, financial, and/or other benefits, dependent on the level and position offered. To learn more about our benefits visit: https://jobs.disneycareers.com/benefits. job.title: Product Software Engineer I
job.description: Keywords Location Search Jobs Product Software Engineer I Job ID 10162134 Location New York, New York, United States Business Disney Entertainment and ESPN Product & Technology Date posted Oct. 21, 2026 Product Software Engineer I Apply Now Save Job SHARE Facebook LinkedIn Email WhatsApp Links open in new tabs. Job Summary: Job Requirements On any given day at Disney Entertainment & ESPN Technology, we’re reimagining ways to create magical viewing experiences for the world’s most beloved stories while also transforming our media business for the future. Whether that’s evolving our streaming and digital products in new and immersive ways, powering worldwide advertising and distribution to enhance flexibility and efficiency, or delivering Disney’s unmatched entertainment and sports content, every day is a moment to make a difference to partners and to hundreds of millions of people around the world. A few reasons why we think you’d love working here: Building the future of Disney’s media: DE&E Technologists are designing and building the infrastructure that will power our media, advertising, and distribution businesses for years to come. Reach & Scale: The products and platforms this group builds and operates delight millions of consumers every minute of every day – from Disney+ and Hulu, to ABC News and Entertainment, to ESPN and ESPN+, and much more. Innovation: We develop and implement groundbreaking products and techniques that shape industry norms and enhance how audiences experience sports, entertainment & news. Job Summary The Cannonball squad sits within MarTech Tools in Commerce & Identity (Commerce – Acquire). We build internal platforms that power how Disney Streaming markets and publishes to hundreds of millions of unauthenticated visitors across Disney+, Hulu, ESPN+, and Star+. Cannonball is the enterprise CMS and publish engine for marketing landing pages and related experiences. Editors use it to model content, author in a rich entry editor, schedule and bulk-publish, and roll out localized variants globally. Cannonball sits at the center of a connected MarTech suite: Magic Frame: Source for incoming assets and templates Royalball: Editorial content workflow management Nexus / Web Growth: Delivery pipeline for published end-user experiences Pixelball & Wayback: Experience validation and historical archiving Product Marketing, Paid Media, Marketing Design, SEO, Ad Ops, Legal, and Customer Support all depend on this stack to ship campaigns faster with built-in governance. We work in two-week sprints (CNBL), ship from the cnbl/monorepo, and invest heavily in engineering-owned quality, including Playwright E2E, test data infrastructure (TDI), and SonarQube gates on every PR. Responsibilities and Duties of the Role As Product Software Engineer I on Cannonball, you will grow by shipping real product with close mentorship from senior engineers. Your day-to-day work typically includes: Feature Development: Build features on the Cannonball web app and supporting services—including entry editor, content models, publishing workflows, localization/locale behavior, and integrations with the broader MarTech ecosystem. UI & API Engineering: Implement bug fixes and incremental improvements in Vue 3 / TypeScript UI and Node-based APIs, with a strong focus on clarity and maintainability. Automated Testing: Write unit tests (Vitest), integration tests, and Playwright E2E suites for Tier 1 publish journeys following squad Definition of Done and coverage expectations. Agile Participation: Participate actively in code reviews, sprint ceremonies, and tech discussions; ask questions early and document learnings. Operational Awareness: Leverage stage/pre-prod environments and our isolated E2E environment to validate changes prior to production. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with QA governance, sibling squads (Web Growth / Nexus), and internal daily power users. Basic Qualifications Solid understanding of JavaScript or TypeScript and core web fundamentals (HTML/CSS, HTTP, REST, browser devtools). Coursework, internships, or personal projects demonstrating your ability to implement, test, and debug small features end-to-end. Comfort learning within a large codebase and proactively seeking guidance. Clear written and verbal communication skills; ability to work effectively in a hybrid, cross-functional team. Preferred Qualifications Exposure to Vue, React, or another modern SPA framework. Familiarity with Git version control, code reviews, and CI/CD workflows (GitHub Actions or similar). Experience with automated testing (unit, integration, or E2E). Interest in CMS platforms, content modeling, localization, or marketing technology. Job Summary: Job Requirements Technology is at the heart of Disney’s past, present, and future. Disney Entertainment and ESPN Product & Technology is a global organization of engineers, product developers, designers, technologists, data scientists, and more – all working to build and advance the technological backbone for Disney’s media business globally. The team marries technology with creativity to build world-class products, enhance storytelling, and drive velocity, innovation, and scalability for our businesses. We are Storytellers and Innovators. Creators and Builders. Entertainers and Engineers. We work with every part of The Walt Disney Company’s media portfolio to advance the technological foundation and consumer media touch points serving millions of people around the world. Here are a few reasons why we think you’d love working here: Building the future of Disney’s media: Our Technologists are designing and building the products and platforms that will power our media, advertising, and distribution businesses for years to come. Reach, Scale & Impact: More than ever, Disney’s technology and products serve as a signature doorway for fans' connections with the company’s brands and stories. Disney+. Hulu. ESPN. ABC. ABC News…and many more. These products and brands – and the unmatched stories, storytellers, and events they carry – matter to millions of people globally. Innovation: We develop and implement groundbreaking products and techniques that shape industry norms, and solve complex and distinctive technical problems. Product Management is responsible for driving the overall user experience, feature strategies and concepts, and engagement paradigms for Disney Entertainment & ESPN's global portfolio of consumer-facing streaming and digital products – including Disney+, Hulu, ESPN, ABC, ABC News, Nat Geo, Marvel, and Star Wars. Job Summary: We are seeking a Senior Product Manager II to own the Involuntary Churn Prevention & Experimentation domain within our Commerce Product team. This role is responsible for protecting and recovering subscriber revenue across Disney+, Hulu, and ESPN+ — a portfolio serving tens of millions of global subscribers. You will define the strategy for minimizing payment-related churn, lead a rigorous experimentation program, and drive the product roadmap for recovery systems that directly impact subscriber retention and operating income. This is a high-visibility role that partners closely with Data Science, Engineering, Analytics, and external payment partners to solve complex problems at global scale. Responsibilities: Strategic Leadership: Define and evangelize the global roadmap for involuntary churn prevention, aligning stakeholders across Data Science, Engineering, and Analytics with long-term retention goals. Independent Domain Management: Act as the end-to-end owner of complex recovery systems, including advanced ML models, global retry logic, and third-party integrations (e.g., Mastercard POP) across all regions. Advanced Experimentation: Lead a sophisticated experimentation program, prioritizing high-impact A/B tests and leveraging predictive modeling to deploy personalized intervention strategies. Executive Communication: Distill complex payment health metrics and churn drivers into clear, strategic updates for senior leadership, providing actionable recommendations to protect revenue. Cross-Functional Orchestration: Lead large-scale, cross-departmental initiatives to resolve systemic billing issues and optimize the "behind-the-scenes" customer experience. Industry Advocacy: Serve as the primary point of contact for global Payment Service Providers (PSPs) and Networks, influencing their product roadmaps to better support Disney’s unique scale and recovery needs. Basic Qualifications Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience. 7+ years of product management experience in payments, subscription commerce, or fintech, with increasing ownership of complex domains. Deep understanding of the global payments ecosystem — specifically recurring billing, card network rules, retry logic, and involuntary churn mitigation strategies. Experience designing and analyzing A/B tests with statistical rigor, including comfort with experimentation frameworks and significance testing. Demonstrated ability to operate independently, managing multiple high-priority workstreams without daily oversight. Proven experience influencing executive-level stakeholders and driving consensus across diverse, cross-functional and global teams. Strong analytical skills with hands-on proficiency in SQL; ability to use data to frame strategic decisions and justify architectural or investment tradeoffs. Preferred Qualifications An advanced degree (MBA, Master's in Data Science, or equivalent) is a plus. Experience leading retention or payment recovery products for a large-scale digital subscription business (global streaming service) is a plus. Working knowledge of machine learning applications in the context of payment routing and churn propensity/predictive modeling. Experience managing complex third-party relationships with payment processors, card networks, or financial institutions. #disneytech Disclaimer PAY TRANSPARENCY The hiring range for this position in New York, NY is $165,600 to $222,000 per year, in San Francisco, CA is $173,100 to $232,100 per year and in Los Angeles, CA is $158,100 to $211,900 per year. job.title: Lead Product Software Engineer
job.description: Keywords Location Search Jobs Lead Product Software Engineer Job ID 10162578 Location San Francisco, California, United States Business Disney Entertainment and ESPN Product & Technology Date posted Oct. 21, 2026 Lead Product Software Engineer Apply Now Save Job SHARE Facebook LinkedIn Email WhatsApp Links open in new tabs. Job Summary: Job Requirements On any given day at Disney Entertainment & ESPN Technology, we’re reimagining ways to create magical viewing experiences for the world’s most beloved stories while also transforming Disney’s media business for the future. Whether that’s evolving our streaming and digital products in new and immersive ways, powering worldwide advertising and distribution to maximize flexibility and efficiency, or delivering Disney’s unmatched entertainment and sports content, every day is a moment to make a difference to partners and to hundreds of millions of people around the world. A few reasons why we think you’d love working for Disney Entertainment & ESPN Technology Building the future of Disney’s media business: DE&E Technologists are designing and building the infrastructure that will power Disney’s media, advertising, and distribution businesses for years to come. Reach & Scale: The products and platforms this group builds and operates delight millions of consumers every minute of every day – from Disney+ and Hulu, to ABC News and Entertainment, to ESPN and ESPN+, and much more. Innovation: We develop and execute groundbreaking products and techniques that shape industry norms and enhance how audiences experience sports, entertainment & news. Ad Platforms organization within Disney Entertainment and ESPN Technology is fully responsible for building, enhancing and maintaining the high-performance, distributed, microservice-based Advertising Platform across all of Disney online properties, including Hulu and ESPN+. We build and maintain proprietary technology, ranging from ad serving and ad delivery, campaign management, reporting as well as all the integrations internal and external that come with evolving and maintaining a best-in-class video advertising business. The Forecasting team is under Ad Platforms , and its mission is to support Ads Inventory Forecasting business requirements. The Inventory Forecasting Platform provides unified inventory forecasting modelling and result accessing. This is a strong cross-domain team to deliver E2E solutions covering tech areas ranging from machine learning, big data, microservices to data visualization. Our team is seeking a Lead Software Engineer . The right person for this role should have extensive experience on big data as well as solid expertise on backend services or full stack. If you are someone who is proactive, hardworking, and enthusiastic in these domains, this is a phenomenal role for you! WHAT YOU’LL DO Contribute to a team of big data and backend engineers to deliver high value projects Build components of large-scale data platform for batch and real-time processing, and own features of big data applications to fit evolving business needs Build next-gen cloud based big data infrastructure for batch and streaming data applications, and continuously improve performance, scalability and availability Balance architectural and design considerations such as performance, scalability, reusability and flexibility issues Advocate the best engineering practices, including the use of design patterns, CI/CD, code review and automated test Collaborate with researchers to productize cutting edge innovations at scale Collaborate with program managers, product managers, SDET, and researchers in an open and innovative environment Minimum Qualifications At least Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Electronics Engineering, or related field At least 7 years of professional programming and design experience in Scala, Java, Python etc. 3+ years of big data development experience with technical stacks like Databricks, Spark, Hive, SingleStore, Airflow, and AWS Strong knowledge of system / application design and architecture Experience with processing large amount of data at petabyte level Demonstrated ability with cloud infrastructure technologies, including Terraform, K8S, Spinnaker, etc. Passionate about technologies, and openness to interdisciplinary work Strong communication skills and project leading experience Preferred Qualifications Demonstrated ability with cloud infrastructure technologies, including Terraform, K8S, Spinnaker, etc. Experience with Grafana, Datadog. Experience in widely used Web framework (React.js, Vue.js, Angular, etc.) and good knowledge of Web stack HTML, CSS, Webpack Ads domain knowledge #disneytech Disclaimer PAY TRANSPARENCY The hiring range for this position in San Francisco, CA is $173,100 to $232,100 per year. The base pay actually offered will take into account internal equity and also may vary depending on the candidate’s geographic region, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience among other factors. A bonus and/or long-term incentive units may be provided as part of the compensation package, in addition to the full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits, dependent on the level and position offered. This position is with Disney Entertainment & Sports LLC, which is part of a business we call Disney Entertainment and ESPN Product & Technology. To learn more about Disney's guidelines on the use of AI for candidates, click here. Disney Entertainment & Sports LLC is an equal opportunity employer. Applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Disney champions a business environment where ideas and decisions from all people help us grow, innovate, create the best stories and be relevant in a constantly evolving world. DISABILITY ACCOMMODATION FOR EMPLOYMENT APPLICATIONS The Walt Disney Company and its Affiliated Companies are Equal Employment Opportunity employers and welcome all job seekers including individuals with disabilities and veterans with disabilities. If you have a disability and believe you need a reasonable accommodation in order to search for a job opening or apply for a position, visit the Disney candidate disability accommodations FAQs . We will only respond to those requests that are related to the accessibility of the online application system due to a disability. Having technical issues? View the FAQs for help. Apply Now Save Job About The Walt Disney Company: The Walt Disney Company, together with its subsidiaries and affiliates, is a leading diversified international family entertainment and media enterprise that includes three core business segments: Disney Entertainment, ESPN, and Disney Experiences. From humble beginnings as a cartoon studio in the 1920s to its preeminent name in the entertainment industry today, Disney proudly continues its legacy of creating world-class stories and experiences for every member of the family. Disney’s stories, characters and experiences reach consumers and guests from every corner of the globe. With operations in more than 40 countries, our employees and cast members work together to create entertainment experiences that are both universally and locally cherished. Hiring Process Where Does Your Story Begin? Explore Disney Careers and the Life at Disney blog to learn about all the amazing opportunities waiting to be discovered at The Walt Disney Company. Be Part of the Story There are many different brands and businesses to explore. Once you've found the opportunity that is right for you, take the next step by completing your application. The Next Chapter Once you've applied, you will receive an email allowing you to access your candidate dashboard. Create your login and make sure to check your dashboard often to see your application progress. Explore this Location San Francisco, CA Famous for grand-dame Victorians, cable cars, a dynamic waterfront, and a soaring golden bridge, San Francisco truly has it all. With trend-defining cuisine ranging from Michelin-starred dining to outrageous food trucks; world-renowned symphony, ballet, theater, and opera; plus almost boundless outdoor adventures, San Francisco justifiably stands out as one of the ultimate must-visit cities on any traveler’s wish list. Job Summary: Job Requirements Technology is at the heart of Disney’s past, present, and future. Disney Entertainment and ESPN Product & Technology is a global organization of engineers, product developers, designers, technologists, data scientists, and more – all working to build and advance the technological backbone for Disney’s media business globally. The team marries technology with creativity to build world-class products, enhance storytelling, and drive velocity, innovation, and scalability for our businesses. We are Storytellers and Innovators. Creators and Builders. Entertainers and Engineers. We work with every part of The Walt Disney Company’s media portfolio to advance the technological foundation and consumer media touch points serving millions of people around the world. Here are a few reasons why we think you’d love working here: Building the future of Disney’s media: Our Technologists are designing and building the products and platforms that will power our media, advertising, and distribution businesses for years to come. Reach, Scale & Impact: More than ever, Disney’s technology and products serve as a signature doorway for fans' connections with the company’s brands and stories. Disney+. Hulu. ESPN. ABC. ABC News…and many more. These products and brands – and the unmatched stories, storytellers, and events they carry – matter to millions of people globally. Innovation: We develop and implement groundbreaking products and techniques that shape industry norms and solve complex and distinctive technical problems. Product Engineering is a unified team responsible for the engineering of Disney Entertainment & ESPN digital and streaming products and platforms. This includes product engineering, media engineering, quality engineering, and the engineering behind personalization, commerce, lifecycle, and identity. Job Summary: The DEEP & Technology team is seeking a Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) I to support the quality engineering and test automation of our innovative advertising systems. As a key member of the Engineering Services team, you will develop foundational skills in test automation, collaborate with experienced engineers, and contribute to the delivery of robust, high-quality products. This is an exciting opportunity to learn from industry leaders and play a direct role in ensuring ads delivered to Disney viewers are reliable, engaging, and relevant. Ideal candidates are inquisitive, fast learners, and eager to grow their technical expertise in a collaborative, high-impact environment. Responsibilities and Duties of the Role: Test Automation & Execution Assist in the design, development, and maintenance of automated test scripts under the guidance of senior engineers. Execute manual and automated test cases for UI, API, and integration testing, reporting bugs and issues clearly and promptly. Participate in basic code reviews and gain hands-on experience with test frameworks and software development tools. Collaboration & Learning Collaborate closely with software engineers, SDETs, and QA leads to understand system functionality and testing requirements. Attend team meetings, design discussions, and knowledge-sharing sessions to continuously improve your understanding of testing practices and team processes. Seek and act on feedback to grow your technical and problem-solving abilities. Basic Qualifications: Proficiency with Python Understanding of basic software testing principles and interest in automation Strong communication, organization, and teamwork skills Eagerness to learn, adapt, and receive feedback in a fast-paced environment Required Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a comparable field of study, or equivalent work experience Disclaimer PAY TRANSPARENCY The hiring range for this position in Seattle, WA is $85,700 to $114,900 per year based on a 40 hour work week. The amount of hours scheduled per week may vary based on business needs. The base pay actually offered will take into account internal equity and also may vary depending on the candidate’s geographic region, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience among other factors. A bonus and/or long-term incentive units may be provided as part of the compensation package, in addition to the full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits, dependent on the level and position offered. This position is with Disney Entertainment & Sports LLC, which is part of a business we call Disney Entertainment and ESPN Product & Technology. Job Summary: About the Role & Program: “This Week with George Stephanopoulos” is ABC News flagship public affairs program featuring newsmaker interviews, political analysis, and debates on a wide range of issues! Each week's show includes interviews with top newsmakers (including some of the nation's top political leaders) as well as a roundtable discussion, usually featuring journalists from ABC and other news organizations, of the week's happenings. This internship is a full-time, six-month commitment in the Washington D.C area from January 2027 - June 2027. Student must be fully available from Thursday through Sunday, 40 hours each week . Thursday through Saturday generally begins at 9:30 a.m. and ends approximately at 6:00 p.m. Sunday requires an in-person 5:00 a.m. start and generally ends by 12 pm. What You Will Do: As an intern with "This Week," you play a vital role within the editorial team! Your responsibilities may encompass: Generating and communicating ideas in editorial pitch meetings Conducting background research for headline interviews and roundtable segments Transcribing prerecorded interviews Assisting in the production of the live show on Sunday mornings, including guest greeting Publishing digital stories summarizing headline interviews post-show Required Qualifications & Skills: Demonstrated knowledge of politics, current events, and public affairs through coursework, campus media, or related experience. Demonstrated ability to research, evaluate, and synthesize information from multiple sources Demonstrated writing and editing experience for news, journalism, or digital media audiences. Experience managing multiple projects, prioritizing deadlines, and maintaining attention to detail. Ability to communicate professionally and collaborate effectively in an editorial or production environment. Preferred Qualifications: Previous internship experience in a professional newsroom or editorial environment. Experience editing written content for print, digital, or student publications. Education: Major or coursework in Journalism, Political Science, Communications, Media Studies, Film/Television, or a related field. Undergraduate students in their Junior or Senior year preferred Eligibility Requirements & Program Information: Candidates for this opportunity MUST meet all of the below requirements: Be enrolled in an accredited college/university pursuing a degree taking at least one class at time of application OR currently participating in a Disney College Program or Disney Internship. Current Disney Interns, College, International, or Culinary Program Participants: You may only work for ONE consecutive year (12 months) in any combination of an internship and/or program. Be at least 18 years of age Possess unrestricted work authorization Additional Information: Able to have a consistent, reliable work schedule throughout the internship Fully available from January 2027 through June 2027 Fully available from Thursday through Sunday, 40 hours each week . Thursday through Saturday generally begins at 9:30 a.m. and ends approximately at 6:00 p.m. Sunday requires an in-person 5:00 a.m. start and generally ends by 12 pm. Able to provide own housing for the duration of the internship program in the Washington D.C. area Able to provide/have reliable transportation to/from work in the Washington D.C. area Materials Requested: A portfolio review is required for this position. For full consideration, please include a link to your portfolio on your résumé. Applications without a portfolio link on the résumé will not be considered a completed application packet and may not be fully considered for the position. Please visit our support site or additional information. The pay rate for this role in Washington D.C. is $23.00 per hour. job.title: Freelance Makeup Artist and Hairstylist
job.description:
Fox News Media has a great opportunity for a Freelance Makeup Artist and Hairstylist!  As a Freelance Makeup Artist and Hairstylist, you know how to ready a person for their close-up! Your makeup artistry and hairstyling skills guarantee that you can make anyone feel confident in their skin. You will be a member of a team of artists responsible for preparing Fox News anchors, reporters, and contributors to appear on national television. The Freelance Makeup Artist and Hairstylist will require a high level of proficiency in makeup artistry and hairstyling for both men and women, as well as the ability to understand and work in the rapidly changing environment of cable news.

**Please note that this position requires the candidate to style Hair AND Makeup.**

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Makeup application in a manner appropriate for television for both men and women; often this must be accomplished very quickly with a high level of skill, especially for women

  • Hairstyling in a manner appropriate for television. This too must be accomplished very quickly and includes a high level of proficiency in the techniques of blow-outs and velcro roller set, as well as using hot irons to accomplish volume and smoothness and a defined hairstyle for women

  • Provide excellent customer service for Fox News anchors, reporters, and contributors who are visiting Fox News by always projecting a friendly, helpful demeanor.

  • Demonstrate the ability to identify and solve problems by proposing solutions.

  • Be a dedicated teammate at all times. Jump in to help others who are readying talent for air. Be a good steward of the hair and makeup room by sharing this responsibility with your colleagues

  • Keep the hair and makeup room and one's personal space clean, tidy, and free of clutter, and identify products that need to be replenished to management so that supplies are well-stocked

  • Understand that the nature of television news requires employees to be able to change their schedule and/or work earlier or later than a planned shift to accommodate the needs of a news bureau responding to breaking news

job.title: Broadcast Production Engineer
job.description:
FOX News is on the hunt for a stellar Broadcast Production Engineer to work in our Washington DC bureau. This role involves providing support and routine compliance for our substantial media and broadcast systems within a competitive, live, 24/7 news environment. As a cornerstone of our Production Engineering team, within the Broadcast and Media Technology group, you'll coordinate with various engineering teams, providing support to IT groups/helpdesk, broadcast production, technical operation personnel, and network operations aggregations.

As our ideal candidate, you are enthused about broadcast engineering/IT and comfortable acclimating to evolving media technologies, concepts, and trends such as Media over IP, Cloud Computing, and Radio Workflows.

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Support infrastructure for on-air broadcast production systems

  • Oversee studio operations including video walls, video processing systems, and cameras

  • Supervise live control room production systems and subsystems

  • Handle infrastructure systems like routers, intercom, monitoring, KVM, audio suites, and live production-related equipment

  • Provide maintenance and support for off-site remote locations including the White House, Capitol Hill, etc.

  • Address, communicate, manage, and track technical issues in a live 24/7 production environment

  • Perform maintenance of subsystems including software and hardware updates, modifications, and replacements as warranted

  • Develop and retain process benchmarks for deployment and support documentation for operations

  • Collaborate on a team that works hands-on with the latest generation of production systems and technologies

  • Work on complex audio processing tasks and Audio-over-IP setups including gating, compression, equalization of talent microphone audio, and multi-band processing of outbound audio programming using Orban processors

  • Set up up small Dante audio networks

  • 5+ years' experience in broadcast production and live television

  • Extensive knowledge of standards like SMPTE for broadcast television and video environments

  • Strong technical skills in troubleshooting and repairing broadcast equipment

  • Aptitude to troubleshoot traditional SDI and IP audio/video signal routing environments

  • Familiarity with studio technologies including video walls, cameras, VR set technologies, image processing systems, touch screens, and lighting

  • Solid understanding of production control automation (e.g., Ross Overdrive) and Newsroom Computer System (NRCS) workflows

  • Proficiency in MS Windows workstation and server platforms

  • Experience with file-based workflows and knowledge of enterprise Media Asset Management systems (e.g. Dalet)

  • Ability to interpret technical documentation standards 

  • Demonstrated working knowledge of IT/networking theory, topology, and best practices

  • Ability to handle multiple tasks independently and as part of a team.

  • Aptitude to work a flexible schedule based on the needs of a live production environment, including overtime, holidays, weekends

  • Capability to remove, lift, and replace equipment in racks as warranted

job.description:

  • Present results and insights during CRM team meetings, proactively recommending opportunities to improve performance.

  • Comfort analyzing customer and audience data to inform segmentation, targeting, personalization, and testing results into actionable recommendations.

  • Strong project management, communication, and organizational skills, with demonstrated ability to manage campaigns from planning through deployment.

• Has high standards for work, excellent organizational and multi-tasking skills, attention to detail

NBCUniversal’s Enterprise Product Team builds products that provide essential capabilities to organizations throughout NBCUniversal. As a part of the Product team, you will be responsible for several products in your department.  You will be in constant communication with clients on anything product related, including development progress, deliverables, and timelines. You will lead grooming sessions, and execute product demos, and walkthroughs.  You are an expert in your area’s product features, capabilities, and functionality.  You will be a consultant on new multi-product initiatives or programs.  You will be a mentor to Product Specialists. 

Essential Responsibilities

Product Lifecycle Management

  • Manage the end-to-end life cycle of products, from ideation through delivery and ongoing optimization.
  • Define and own overall product vision, strategy, and success metrics for key initiatives, including data warehouse and business intelligence platforms.

Roadmap & Backlog Ownership

  • Develop and maintain feature roadmaps, prioritizing capabilities based on business needs and strategic goals.
  • Lead grooming sessions to ensure a consistently up-to-date backlog of clearly defined features and user stories.
  • Fully document product features and capabilities in JIRA, including measurable acceptance criteria.

Stakeholder Engagement & Requirements Gathering

  • Collaborate across functions (Engineering, Ad Sales, Programming, Operations, Product, Architecture) to capture and analyze requests, define data needs, and align priorities.
  • Translate complex business requirements into actionable product features and conceptual models.

Technical Collaboration & Solution Design

  • Partner with architecture and solutions leaders to identify optimal technical solutions that meet client and business needs.
  • Work closely with engineering teams and vendors to implement automation and workflow optimizations.

Data-Driven Product Development

  • Perform hands-on data exploration and analysis of large datasets to inform product decisions and enable data-driven features.
  • Continually leverage business insights and analytics to refine platform strategy and solve high-impact problems.

Quality Assurance & Compliance

  • Define and execute user acceptance testing for new features and integrations.
  • Ensure all workflows and vendor deliverables adhere to NBCUniversal standards and industry regulations.

Incident & Change Management

  • Coordinate resolution of operational issues promptly to minimize disruption.
  • Manage change requests effectively to maintain stability in live environments.

Reporting & Analytics

  • Track and report on vendor performance metrics (uptime, error rates, turnaround times).
  • Provide actionable insights and recommendations to improve service quality and operational efficiency.

Documentation & Governance

  • Maintain comprehensive documentation for processes, integrations, and SLAs.
  • Ensure all product and vendor workflows comply with internal standards and regulatory requirements.

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience required.
  • Minimum 5+ years of relevant work experience in the technology or media industry.
  • Minimum 3+ years’ experience in a role demonstrating strong technical, quantitative, and analytical skills.
  • Minimum 3+ years’ experience in a role exhibiting excellent written and oral communications, effective interpersonal skills, project management, and strong formal presentation abilities.
  • Expertise in the SDLC process, with a focus on scoping, iteration planning, user story and acceptance criteria writing, rollout management.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills - capable of assessing ambiguous situations, evaluating diverse factors, and adapting existing approaches to devise effective solutions.
  • Proven ability to influence and collaborate with senior stakeholders - including those unfamiliar with the subject matter, by tailoring communication style and providing guidance on challenging issues.
  • Experience working on problems of diverse scope - requiring sound judgment, interpretation, and decision-making with minimal supervision.

  • At least 2 years of direct client engagement experience
  • Experience in Television/Broadcast, Media, Technology, or related field

NBCUniversal’s Cyber Defense Operations team provides cyber threat intelligence, event monitoring, incident response, and threat hunting across the enterprise in a highly collaborative, fast-paced, and agile environment. Cyber Response Operations serves as NBCUniversal’s 24x7 first line of defense against cyber threats. Event Analysts and Incident Responders follow the Incident Response Plan to identify, assess, contain, remediate, and document cyber events and incidents.

The Manager of Cyber Incident Response leads the Incident Response team while guiding and supporting the Event Analyst function. The role oversees escalations involving containment, remediation, forensic analysis, and coordination with impacted businesses and partner teams. This leader establishes the operating rigor needed for consistent performance while enabling responders to exercise sound judgment, creativity, and ownership.

The Manager is accountable for team readiness, workflow prioritization, escalation quality, process maturity, and employee development. The role requires regular engagement with business stakeholders, Information Security Officers, technical teams, vendors, and senior leadership during both routine operations and active incidents.

 

Duties and Responsibilities

  • Manage Incident Response operations, including prioritization, resource allocation, shift coverage, tooling requirements, workflow management, and escalation processes.
  • Ensure the NBCUniversal Incident Response Plan and supporting procedures are implemented and followed in day-to-day operations.
  • Oversee and manage cyber incidents across the NBCUniversal enterprise, from escalation and validation through containment, remediation, recovery support, and closure.
  • Serve as an Incident Handler or Incident Commander for significant incidents, coordinating response activities with impacted businesses, technical owners, and partner teams.
  • Act as the managerial escalation point for potential cyber incidents, responder support needs, and decisions requiring leadership awareness or approval.
  • Participate in the manager on-call rotation for cyber incident escalation and handling in a 24x7x365 global environment.
  • Supervise operational performance across shifts, ensuring consistent prioritization, ticket ownership, escalation discipline, and adherence to company standards.
  • Review shift handovers, queue health, and open incidents to ensure continuity, clear accountability, and timely follow-through across operating periods.
  • Maintain and enforce event and incident documentation standards, case-management requirements, key performance indicators, and process adherence.
  • Monitor operational metrics and trends, identify gaps, and implement improvements that strengthen effectiveness, risk reduction, and business impact.
  • Lead the review and governance of response processes, playbooks, tuning requests, automation opportunities, and technical procedures.
  • Drive the maturity, enhancement, and strategy of the Incident Response program in alignment with business and enterprise priorities.
  • Act as a strategic partner to Information Security Officers, business stakeholders, and other security and technology teams.
  • Develop and maintain process documentation, including clear ownership, review cycles, approval requirements, and change management.
  • Lead, coach, and develop Incident Response personnel, providing regular feedback and supporting technical, professional, and career growth.
  • Create and deliver monthly metrics and executive reporting that communicate operational effectiveness, risk reduction, material trends, and business impact.
  • Communicate incident status, operational concerns, decisions, and risk clearly to business VIPs and senior leadership.

Qualifications and Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in an information technology-related field and/or equivalent work experience.
  • Seven or more years of cybersecurity or investigations experience, including at least four years in Incident Response, a Security Operations Center, threat intelligence, or a similar function.
  • Previous experience leading incident response operations, cybersecurity personnel, or complex incident coordination.
  • In-depth understanding of cyber threats, adversary techniques, response procedures, network and enterprise architecture, and threat detection.
  • Demonstrated ability to make evidence-based decisions under uncertainty and coordinate response activities across multiple teams.
  • Willingness to work in a fast-paced, high-demand role that may require nonstandard working hours.
  • Availability to support employee development and accept escalations arising in a 24x7x365 global environment.
  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple workstreams, incidents, and escalation paths.
  • Working knowledge of core enterprise technology concepts, including web application architecture, networking, identity, endpoint, email, and cloud services.
  • Experience with host-based and network-based forensic tools and analysis.
  • Knowledge of recognized security and analysis frameworks, including MITRE ATT&CK, the Cyber Kill Chain, the Diamond Model, and NIST incident response guidance.
  • Experience applying security concepts in AWS, Azure, and/or Google Cloud Platform environments.
  • Knowledge of incident response technologies and capabilities such as EDR, XDR, SOAR, case management, and response automation.
  • Experience developing or improving incident-management processes, playbooks, metrics, or automation.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to brief technical professionals, business stakeholders, and senior executives.
  • Strong leadership, coaching, interpersonal, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to adapt to changing and fast-paced environments.

Paramount Global (NASDAQ: PARA, PARAA) is a leading global media and entertainment company that creates premium content and experiences for audiences worldwide. Driven by iconic studios, networks and streaming services, Paramount's portfolio of consumer brands includes CBS, Showtime Networks, Paramount Pictures, Nickelodeon, MTV, Comedy Central, BET, Paramount+, Pluto TV and Simon & Schuster, among others. Paramount delivers the largest share of the U.S. television audience and boasts one of the industry's most important and extensive libraries of TV and film titles. In addition to offering innovative streaming services and digital video products, the company provides powerful capabilities in production, distribution and advertising solutions.

 

Role Details
The Convergent Account Executive owns the full advertising relationship across both linear and streaming for their assigned clients — spanning Broadcast dayparts (Prime, News, Late Night and Daytime), Cable Networks, and the full Streaming/CTV portfolio, including programmatic and direct IO (DIO) channels. This includes regular scheduled programming as well as specials (e.g., The VMAs, Golden Globes, AMAs) and sponsorship/integration opportunities. The Convergent AE is the single point of accountability for delivering unified, cross-platform (“360”) solutions, working in tandem with specialty, programmatic, and AM partners to maximize revenue across the entire Paramount portfolio. This position sets its own sales agenda and is responsible for growing and maintaining a book of business across both linear and streaming properties.

job.description:
About TEGNA

TEGNA Inc. helps people thrive in their local communities by providing the trusted local news and services that matter most. With 64 television stations in 51 U.S. markets, TEGNA reaches more than 100 million people monthly across the web, mobile apps, streaming, and linear television. Together, we are building a sustainable future for local news.

 

WUSA-TV Washington, the TEGNA-owned CBS affiliate in Washington is seeking an innovative Producer to shape our daily newscasts. At WUSA-TV Washington, we build creative shows that engage, educate and inform our audiences. We prioritize original storytelling and investigative journalism as key components of our newscasts to set our product apart in the Washington market. 

At TEGNA, we are committed to our core values: We Win, We Work Smarter, We Demand the Truth, and We Do the Right Thing. These values guide how we create content and serve our communities.

We value a collaborative, motivated journalist who works well within a team to bring the truth to our growing audiences across platforms, starting with our streaming and broadcast services. We want your authentic personality to drive your storytelling and writing in an exciting and captivating manner to hold the audience.

You’ll also have access to modern tools and workflows as TEGNA continues to drive innovation.

 

Responsibilities:

  • Use your natural curiosity to pitch compelling stories.
  • Show off your creativity and storytelling skills.
  • Craft stories of all lengths on all platforms for specific audiences.
  • Meet daily deadlines.
  • Combine live pictures, graphics, compelling video and emotional sound to create an engaging experience for our audience.
  • Booth continuous coverage on our live streams for breaking news and community events.
  • Consistently try new things after thoughtful discussion with supervisors.
  • Allow the impactful and emotional conversations the community needs to drive the content in your rundown.
  • Use data analytics to help shape the content of your show.
  • Challenge traditional ways of doing things.
  • Ensure all communities and viewpoints have a voice and presence in your show.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree preferred in journalism, communications or related field or equivalent years of experience.
  • 5-7 years of news content experience.
  • Top-notch communication skills are an absolute must.
  • Solid journalistic judgement and a news philosophy that emphasizes accurate, fair and unique local content, along with community engagement. 
  • Understanding of the tenets of professional journalism.
  • Skills in producing engaging, content-driven newscasts and digital content.
  • Strong social media skills, including an active news hound presence on your preferred social platforms. 
  • Organizational skills and the ability to work under time pressure deadlines.
  • Ability to calmly handle live, breaking news situations and changing events. 
  • ENPS and Edius system experience preferred.

Benefits: 

TEGNA offers comprehensive benefits designed to safeguard the physical, mental and financial health of our employees and their families. TEGNA offers two medical plan options for full and part-time employees through Blue Cross Blue Shield of Texas, as well as access to dental and eye care coverage; fertility, surrogacy and adoption assistance; disability and life insurance.

Our 401(k) program offers full, part-time and temporary employees the opportunity to contribute 1% - 80% of their pay on a pre-tax basis to TEGNA’s 401(k). Contributions made up to the first 4% of pay are eligible for a 100% match from the company and are 100% vested from day one.

Regardless of participation in TEGNA medical plans, ALL employees and their eligible family members receive nine free virtual doctor’s appointments with a physician through Teladoc, and 12 free annual therapy sessions with a licensed clinician through Spring Health.

TEGNA offers a generous Paid Time Off (PTO) benefit as well as nine paid holidays per year.

job.title: Electrician II
job.description:
Electrician II

Gannett Publishing Services / USA TODAY CO

Des Moines, IA

Position Details:

Performs advance level electrical maintenance (including preventive), diagnostics and repairs on production equipment and systems in an industrial environment to support efficient production operations as needed.

Serve in a lead role as part of a team to achieve and maintain on-time production performance, product quality and accuracy standards as well as operational safety including OSHA and EPA compliance.

Provide direction on electrical repairs of production equipment and perform electrical maintenance, diagnostics and repairs on specified equipment which may include, but are not limited to:  CTP Imagers, processors, benders; press controls, printing units, reels, dampening & inking systems; inserting equipment, stackers, strappers, labelers, applicators, bindery equipment, conveyors, motors, pumps, dryers and other ancillary equipment.  Potential involvement with the building department infrastructure equipment (HVAC and plumbing).

Monitor all production reporting for maintenance/repair issues. Record entries in repair log (failed equipment) and preventive maintenance log books while looking for trends in machine performance.   Communicate repair/maintenance issues and provide updates of ongoing projects and preventative maintenance programs to supervisor.

Safety:

Always work in a safe manner and consistently utilize required safety equipment to promote top-of-mind safety awareness:

Maintain a clean and safe work environment.  Assist in leading safety compliance within the department including accident investigations and follow up.

Complete required annual OSHA safety training programs.

Ensure all machine safety-guards are installed, functioning properly, and in use.

Immediately report any potential safety hazards, operational concerns and all accidents/injuries and near misses to production management.

An individual in this position must be able to successfully perform the essential duties and responsibilities listed above. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this position.

Requirements:

High school diploma or GED equivalent

Certified electrical training required (Vocational school, military, trade)

Journeyman level electrical certification required

Experience Required or Preferred

Minimum five years’ experience in electrical maintenance, diagnostics and repair required

Specialized Knowledge Required or Preferred:

Ability to read blueprints and sufficient computer skills required for diagnostic applications.

Ability to use precision instruments and measuring tools.

Ability to read pneumatic and electrical schematics/wiring diagrams. Ability to use testing equipment. Experience with PLC controllers. Experience uploading programs to a CPU and downloading to a laptop.   Experience with synchronous and asynchronous motors.  Understanding of AC frequency drive controllers, instrumentation and measurements.

Proficient verbal and written communication skills

Proven excellent time management skills working in a fast-paced deadline driven environment with a sense of urgency

Strong mechanical aptitude.

May be required to work flexible shifts; including weekend, nighttime and holiday shifts around loud production equipment.  May be on call for emergency services.

This partnership provides us—and you—with a massive competitive edge in the market, ensuring you have the most powerful tools at your disposal to drive sales and exceed targets.

job.title: Climate Fellow
job.description:
South Florida is ground zero for climate change, where rising seas, record heat and extreme storms are reshaping daily life. The Miami Herald is offering a six-month reporting fellowship focused on the region’s most urgent climate challenges — and the people, ideas and solutions shaping its future.

As our multimedia climate reporter, you’ll drive daily coverage, break news and deliver exclusive enterprise stories that connect the science and policy of climate change to the lived experience of South Floridians. You’ll use digital tools and audience data to spot trends, test new formats and engage readers where they are — from social platforms to newsletters and beyond. AI and automation will help you spend less time on routine tasks and more time on reporting, sources and storytelling that matters.

You’ll work closely with editors and fellow reporters, pitching and producing original stories, recaps and multiformat versions that meet newsroom goals for audience growth and retention. Your reporting will focus on solutions and actionable information, helping readers understand not just the threat but what they can do about it.

What you’ll do:

  • Own daily and enterprise coverage of climate issues in South Florida, with a focus on solutions and impact
  • Use digital tools, analytics and social media to inform, distribute and measure your work
  • Collaborate across the newsroom to develop ideas, test new formats and reach new audiences
  • Build and maintain a diverse network of sources
  • Uphold the highest standards of accuracy, ethics and public service journalism
  • Embrace new technology, including AI, to work smarter and deliver more value to our readers

This is a six-month, grant-funded position.

We welcome candidates with at least 1-3 years of newsroom experience, a strong grounding in journalism ethics and a passion for digital-first, audience-focused reporting. Fluency in video, photo and social media storytelling is a plus.

To apply, submit a cover letter, resume and 4-6 samples of their work.

The Miami Herald and McClatchy are committed to building a newsroom that reflects and serves all of South Florida. Join us at the forefront of digital journalism, where every audience matters and every signal counts.

job.title: Senior Director, Product Design
job.description:
Join the future of news

We’re on a mission to deliver riveting storytelling for all of America. At The Washington Post, you’ll help reinvent news. Our work is driven by a deep investigative spirit and enhanced by innovation to bring audiences closer to the stories that matter most.


About Our Team


The Washington Post is powered by the passion and talent of our people. It takes all of us to reinvent news. Beyond our award-winning News and Opinions teams, we work across many departments, including Brand & Events, Communications, Customer Care, Engineering & Product, Finance, Human Resources, Legal, Marketing & Advertising, Print Operations, and Sales.


Why This Role Matters

 

The Washington Post is looking for a senior design leader with exceptional product judgment, a strong point of view about the future of digital experiences, and the ability to translate ambitious ideas into products that create meaningful value for customers and the business.

As a senior member of the Product organization, you will set the design vision for The Washington Post's product portfolio and help define how millions of people discover, experience, and engage with our journalism. You will work with leaders across Product, Technology, Newsroom, Opinion, and business units to ensure design is a strategic driver of product direction, subscriber value, and growth.

This is a pivotal moment for The Post and the broader media industry. Artificial intelligence, changing consumer behaviors, platform disruption, and evolving expectations for digital products are reshaping how people find and interact with information. You will help The Post respond to these changes by creating experiences that are more useful, distinctive, intuitive, and essential to people's daily lives.

Design is central to how we differentiate our products, build lasting relationships with audiences, and translate the quality and credibility of our journalism into experiences people value and trust.

What Motivates You

  • You are energized by the opportunity to define the future of a globally recognized digital product and shape how people experience high-quality journalism.
  • You enjoy setting an ambitious long-term vision and building the organizational alignment and momentum needed to turn that vision into meaningful customer experiences.
  • You see design as a strategic business capability and are motivated by using it to improve customer value, engagement, conversion, retention, and growth.
  • You thrive at the intersection of product, technology, journalism, and business strategy and enjoy bringing different perspectives together around a shared customer experience.
  • You care deeply about craft and believe enduring product quality comes from strong leaders, teams, systems, and standards.
  • You are curious about how AI, personalization, and emerging interaction models will reshape digital experiences and want to help define what those changes mean for journalism.
  • You want to build experiences that are distinctive, useful, and worthy of audiences' time and trust.

How You'll Support the Mission

  • Sets the design vision and long-term strategy for The Washington Post's product portfolio, establishing a distinctive and cohesive customer experience and driving sustained progress and iteration against that vision.
  • Shapes product and business strategy with senior leaders across Product, Technology, Newsroom, Opinion, and business units, using design to advance audience growth, engagement, retention, and other strategic priorities.
  • Drives the design strategy for premium subscriber experiences and products that convert new audiences into paying customers, ensuring customer needs, business objectives, and The Post's journalistic mission inform product decisions.
  • Leads the product expression of The Post's visual identity in partnership with Product and Editorial leadership, creating consistent, recognizable, and differentiated experiences across customer touchpoints.
  • Oversees the strategy and evolution of The Post's design system, interaction patterns, and emerging experience frameworks, establishing scalable standards that improve product quality, consistency, accessibility, and speed across teams.
  • Advances new approaches to experiencing journalism, including personalization, adaptive experiences, and emerging interaction models, positioning The Post to respond to changing customer expectations and technology.
  • Builds and leads a high-performing product design organization, developing leaders and talent while establishing the priorities, practices, and cross-functional partnerships required to deliver exceptional customer experiences at scale.

The Skills and Experience You Bring

  • A clear track record of 5+ years leading and improving user-facing digital products and experiences, with experience in direct-to-consumer, media, subscription, or similarly complex digital businesses.
  • Demonstrated success defining and advancing a long-term product design vision and strategy across multiple products, platforms, or customer journeys.
  • Experience leading and developing high-performing product design teams and design leaders while strengthening organizational capability and performance.
  • Demonstrated ability to use design to influence meaningful customer and business outcomes, including acquisition, conversion, engagement, retention, and subscription growth.
  • Experience partnering with senior leaders across Product, Technology, Editorial or Content, and business functions to establish priorities, influence strategy, navigate trade-offs, and make consequential product decisions.
  • Deep expertise in digital product, interaction, and visual design, with strong judgment across customer journeys, design systems, and emerging experience models.
  • Experience establishing and evolving scalable design systems, interaction standards, and practices across multiple products and customer touchpoints.
  • Strong understanding of direct-to-consumer customer journeys and how product experience creates differentiated value for prospective and existing subscribers.
  • Experience operating effectively in complex and ambiguous environments, creating clarity and alignment across teams with different priorities and perspectives.
  • A thoughtful perspective on how AI and emerging technologies are changing digital interfaces, customer expectations, and the practice of product design.
  • A portfolio or body of work demonstrating significant impact on customer experience, product strategy, design quality, and business outcomes.
  • Demonstrated commitment to building inclusive teams and creating accessible experiences that serve audiences with a wide range of backgrounds, needs, and abilities.

 

Collaboration makes us stronger. That’s why our offices are designed with open layouts, modern technology, and easy access to transportation. With certain exceptions for newsgathering and business travel, we work on-site five days a week.

Compensation and Benefits

Wherever you are in your life or career, The Washington Post offers comprehensive and inclusive benefits for every step of your journey:

  • Competitive medical, dental and vision coverage

  • Company-paid pension and 401(k) match

  • Three weeks of vacation and up to three weeks of paid sick leave

  • Nine paid holidays and two personal days

  • 20 weeks paid parental leave for any new parent

  • Robust mental health resources

  • Backup care and caregiver concierge services

  • Gender affirming services

  • Pet insurance

  • Free Post digital subscription

  • Leadership and career development programs

Benefits may vary based on the job, full-time or part-time schedule, location, and collectively bargained status.

The salary range for this position is:

$211,700 - $352,900 Annual

The actual salary within this range will depend on individual skills, experience, and qualifications as they relate to specific job requirements. This position may be eligible for a bonus or incentive program, and a member of the Talent Acquisition team will discuss bonus payment terms and conditions during the interview process.

Your story awaits. Apply today!
